'''História do NPC'''
* Esse NPC apareceu no 10º Aniversário do Tibia em Edron, mas ele aparentemente andava por todo o continente até a festa acabar. * Ele dava [[Fireworks Rocket]]s, [[Party Hat]]s, [[Party Trumpet]]s e outros [[Party Item|itens de festa]]. Ele dava um limite de itens, o número máximo era 22. * Para conseguir um item, você precisava falar "'''Item'''". Quando você conseguia um item, a conversa acabava, e você devia começar a conversa de novo. Até hoje ele diz ser filho de Alfred Nobel.
Atualmente ele vende [[Fireworks Rocket]]s para celebrar o ano novo.
Sua localização durante essa época pode variar entre: * [[Ab'Dendriel]], norte da entrada. * [[Carlin]], sul do depot. * [[Edron]], sul da entrada. * [[Kazordoon]], sul do castelo. * [[Liberty Bay]], oeste do depot. * [[Thais]], leste do navio. Depois da época de ano novo ele vai embora. Arquivo:nednobelportal.jpg {{Veja|Eventos e Festividades}} | buysell = sim | buys = Nada. | sells = {{Trades/Sell | Fireworks Rocket}} | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Ned Nobel:''' Hi fellow, do you need rockits for the upcoming turn of the year? Just let me know if you want to trade.
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''
'''Ned Nobel:''' My name is Ned. Ned Nobel. Maybe you knew my father, his name was Alfred!
''Jogador:'' '''Alfred''' / '''Father'''
'''Ned Nobel:''' He laid the foundation for my invention.
''Jogador:'' '''Invention'''
'''Ned Nobel:''' I did plenty of testing and I can proudly say that they are much safer and better now. Nevertheless I can't tell you the formula. It's a secret.
''Jogador:'' '''secret'''
'''Ned Nobel:''' No, I will not tell you and now stop bothering me I have to work. ''(termina a conversa)''
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
'''Ned Nobel:''' I'm an inventor and a salesman. You know, without money no inventions.
''Jogador:'' '''Trade'''
'''Ned Nobel:''' Here, take a look. But don't light them here in my pocket! I wish you a Happy New Year!
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
'''Ned Nobel:''' I wish you a prosperous new year ''Jogador''! }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Rashid:''' Ah, a customer! Be greeted, ''Jogador''!
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
'''Rashid:''' I am a travelling trader. I don't buy everything, though. And not from everyone, for that matter.
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''
'''Rashid:''' I am Rashid, son of the desert.
''Jogador:'' '''Offers''' / '''Trade'''
'''Rashid:''' Of course, old friend. You can also browse only armor, legs, shields, helmets, boots, weapons, enchanted weapons, jewelry or miscellaneous stuff.
''Jogador:'' '''Ab'Dendriel'''
'''Rashid:''' Elves... I don't really trust them. All this talk about nature and flowers and treehugging... I'm sure there's some wicked scheme behind all this.
''Jogador:'' '''Ankrahmun'''
'''Rashid:''' My beloved hometown! Ah, the sweet scent of the desert sands, the perfect shape of the pyramids... stunningly beautiful.
''Jogador:'' '''Carlin'''
'''Rashid:''' I have to go to Carlin once in a while, since the queen wishes to see my exclusive wares in regular intervals.
''Jogador:'' '''Cormaya'''
'''Rashid:''' Cormaya? Not a good place to make business, it's way too far and small.
''Jogador:'' '''Darashia'''
'''Rashid:''' It's not the real thing, but almost as good. The merchants there claim ridiculous prices, which is fine for my own business.
''Jogador:'' '''Edron'''
'''Rashid:''' Ah yes, Edron! Such a lovely and quiet island! I usually make some nice business there.
''Jogador:'' '''Fibula'''
'''Rashid:''' Too few customers there, it's not worth the trip.
''Jogador:'' '''Greenshore'''
'''Rashid:''' Um... I don't think so.
''Jogador:'' '''Kazordoon'''
'''Rashid:''' I don't like being underground much. I also tend to get lost in these labyrinthine dwarven tunnels, so I rather avoid them.
''Jogador:'' '''Liberty Bay'''
'''Rashid:''' When you avoid the slums, it's a really pretty city. Almost as pretty as the governor's daughter.
''Jogador:'' '''Northport'''
'''Rashid:''' Um... I don't think so.
''Jogador:'' '''Port Hope'''
'''Rashid:''' I like the settlement itself, but I don't set my foot into the jungle. Have you seen the size of these centipedes??
''Jogador:'' '''Senja'''
'''Rashid:''' Um... I don't think so.
''Jogador:'' '''Svargrond'''
'''Rashid:''' I wish it was a little bit warmer there, but with a good mug of barbarian mead in your tummy everything gets a lot cosier.
''Jogador:'' '''Thais'''
'''Rashid:''' I feel uncomfortable and rather unsafe in Thais, so I don't really travel there.
''Jogador:'' '''Vega'''
'''Rashid:''' Um... I don't think so.
''Jogador:'' '''Venore'''
'''Rashid:''' Although it's the flourishing trade centre of Tibia, I don't like going there. Too much competition for my taste.
''Jogador:'' '''Time'''
'''Rashid:''' It's almost time to journey on.
''Jogador:'' '''King'''
'''Rashid:''' Kings, queens, emperors and kaliphs... everyone claims to be different and unique, but actually it's the same thing everywhere.
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
'''Rashid:''' Farewell, ''Jogador'', may the winds guide your way.
}}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

| buysell = sim | buys = {{Trades/Buy | Brass Helmet | Brass Legs | Chain Helmet | Chain Legs | Iron Helmet | Leather Boots | Leather Helmet | Leather Legs | Legion Helmet | Plate Legs | Small Axe | Soldier Helmet | Steel Helmet | Studded Helmet | Studded Legs | Viking Helmet}} | sells = {{Trades/Sell | Brass Helmet | Brass Legs | Chain Helmet,52 | Chain Legs | Iron Helmet | Leather Boots, 10 | Leather Helmet, 12 | Leather Legs, 10 | Sandals | Soldier Helmet | Steel Helmet | Studded Helmet, 63 | Studded Legs | Viking Helmet}} | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''hi'''
'''Aldo:''' Just great, another ... 'customer'. Hello, ''Jogador''.
''Jogador:'' '''job'''
'''Aldo:''' I am a salesman, I sell headgear ... uhm ... oh well, and shoes.
''Jogador:'' '''name'''
'''Aldo:''' I'm Aldo. No one calls me 'lucky Aldo' though, guess why!
''Jogador:'' '''time'''
'''Aldo:''' Is it time for lunch already? Hey, stop making fun of me!
''Jogador:'' '''king''' ou '''Tibianus'''
'''Aldo:''' One day I will sell the king a pair of shoes made by me and will get out of that stinky hole I live in and my family will never find me. HE, HE!
''Jogador:'' '''Tibia'''
'''Aldo:''' I doubt I will ever see much of it. It's like i am cursed to haunt this site here for the rest of my life.
''Jogador:'' '''army'''
'''Aldo:''' So many feet ... so many ... a nightmare!
''Jogador:'' '''amazons'''
'''Aldo:''' I heard that chicks wear some revealing pieces of armor!
''Jogador:'' '''Ferumbras'''
'''Aldo:''' Can't be worse than my wife.
''Jogador:'' '''Excalibug'''
'''Aldo:''' I have other stuff to worry about, like paying my bills.
''Jogador:'' '''bills'''
'''Aldo:''' Yes, I have to pay o lot of bills, and some georges, and a john, and several steves.
''Jogador:'' '''Carlin'''
'''Aldo:''' A city ruled by women!? Could anything be worse?
''Jogador:'' '''Thais'''
'''Aldo:''' I will never in my life make it there.
''Jogador:'' '''Hugo'''
'''Aldo:''' My boss, an evil slaver of good people like me.
''Jogador:'' '''shoes'''
'''Aldo:''' We sell leather boots and sandals.
''Jogador:'' '''wife'''
'''Aldo:''' Leave me alone with her while I am working at least. My only pleasure around here!
''Jogador:'' '''bye'''
'''Aldo:''' That's music in my ears.
''Jogador:'' '''hi'''
'''Aldo:''' Just great, another ... 'customer'. Hello, ''Jogador''.

== Frases Espontâneas ==
'''Ebenizer''': Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Tibian Bank before you head out for adventure.

== Palavras-Chave ==
''Jogador'': '''hi'''</br>
'''Ebenizer''': Yes? What may I do for you, ''Jogador''? Bank business, perhaps?

''Jogador'': '''bank'''</br>
'''Ebenizer''': We can change money for you. You can also access your bank account or your guild account options.

''Jogador'': '''job'''</br>
'''Ebenizer''': I am running this bank.

''Jogador'': '''name'''</br>
'''Ebenizer''': My name? Ebenizer!

''Jogador'': '''news''' / '''rumors'''</br>
'''Ebenizer''': I only care about financial news.

''Jogador'': '''edron'''</br>
'''Ebenizer''': The riches of our isle are its mineral resources.

''Jogador'': '''time'''</br>
'''Ebenizer''': It is ''horas'', precisely.

''Jogador'': '''ferumbras'''</br>
'''Ebenizer''': A true threat to wealth and trade.

''Jogador'': '''excalibug'''</br>
'''Ebenizer''': This weapon, if real, might be worth a lot.

''Jogador'': '''king''' / '''tibianus'''</br>
'''Ebenizer''': Hail to the king!

''Jogador'': '''army'''</br>
'''Ebenizer''': Soldiers have not that much money that I would care about.

''Jogador'': '''thais'''</br>
'''Ebenizer''': We are in constant contact with the city of Thais.

''Jogador'': '''tibia'''</br>
'''Ebenizer''': There are countless ways of profit in this world.

''Jogador'': '''carlin'''</br>
'''Ebenizer''': It's underdeveloped and economically insignificant.

''Jogador'': '''bye'''</br>
'''Ebenizer''': Have a nice day.
|}}

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Ahmet | job = Comerciante de Ferramentas | npcclass = Humanos | npcsprite = Mage | city = Southern Darama | subarea = Ankrahmun | location = [[Ankrahmun]] ({{Mapa|33127,32810,6:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 7.3 | notes = Vende vários equipamentos.

* Depois de terminar a [[Steal from Thieves Quest]], você pode ter um emprego de guarda pessoal de segurança. Ele vai falar com você de maneira diferente depois disso. * Faz parte da [[Threatened Dreams Quest]]. * Faz parte da [[The Thieves Guild Quest]].

| buysell = sim | buys = {{Trades/Buy | Closed Trap | Crowbar | Fishing Rod | Machete | Pick | Rope | Scythe | Shovel | Watch | Wooden Hammer}} | sells = {{Trades/Sell | Basket | Bottle | Bucket | Candelabrum | Candlestick | Closed Trap | Crowbar | Crusher | Cup | Document | Fishing Rod, 150 | Golden Backpack | Golden Bag | Machete | Oil | Parchment (Yellow) | Pick | Plate | Present | Rope | Scroll | Scythe, 50 | Shovel, 50 | Torch | Watch | Water (Líquido), 40 | Worm}} Somente vendido durante uma quest. {{Trades/Sell |Deed of Ownership}} | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Ahmet:''' Be mourned pilgrim in flesh. I'm selling general goods.
''Jogador:'' '''Offer Ou Buy Ou Wares'''
'''Ahmet:''' My inventory of general goods and is large, ask me for a trade to take a look.
''Jogador:'' '''Trade'''
'''Ahmet:''' Of course, just browse through my wares.
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''
'''Ahmet:''' I am the mourned Ahmet.
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
'''Ahmet:''' Are you interested in being my private security slave ...er...officer?
''Jogador:'' '''Time'''
'''Ahmet:''' It would be foolish of me to tell you the time as you won't buy a watch then.
''Jogador:'' '''Carlin''' / '''Thais''' / '''Venore'''
'''Ahmet:''' The vain cities of the Tibian continent think they are at the centre of the universe. Little do they know about the wisdom of the Pharaoh.
''Jogador:'' '''Kazordoon''' / '''Dwarfs'''
'''Ahmet:''' We rarely see a traveller of the small folk here.
''Jogador:'' '''Ab'dendriel''' / '''Elves'''
'''Ahmet:''' Elves are a rare sight in our lands.
''Jogador:'' '''Tibia'''
'''Ahmet:''' The world is nothing but a sigil of death, a monument of decay. We have to attune to death to become one with the world.
''Jogador:'' '''Darashia'''
'''Ahmet:''' The foolishness of their ways will eventually spell their doom.
''Jogador:'' '''Darama'''
'''Ahmet:''' Life here is harsh, but only this way can we deny the temptations that might damage our Rah and our Uthun to our traitorous flesh.
''Jogador:'' '''Mission'''
'''Ahmet:''' I'm glad I don't require the help of anyone else than......ME.
''Jogador:'' '''Ankrahmun'''
'''Ahmet:''' Our city will endure the sands of the desert and the grinding teeth of time.
''Jogador:'' '''Rah'''
'''Ahmet:''' The Rah could be called our soul.
''Jogador:'' '''Uthun'''
'''Ahmet:''' The Uthun is that what we learn and remember.
''Jogador:'' '''Pharaoh'''
'''Ahmet:''' Blessed be the Pharaoh. He is our saviour. I hope that I will be chosen one day.
''Jogador:'' '''Suspicious'''
'''Ahmet:''' I think this is the guy who robbed me!!!! WAIT, no...false alarm!
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
'''Ahmet:''' May enlightenment be your path, ''Jogador''. }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

== Frases Espontâneas ==
Não possui.

== Palavras-Chave ==
''Jogador:'' '''Hi''' / '''Ashari'''</br>
'''Anerui:''' Ashari ''Jogador''. Just came back from my hunt, look at that fine meat.

''Jogador:'' '''Name'''</br>
'''Anerui:''' My name is Anerui Mourningleaf.

''Jogador:'' '''Job'''</br>
'''Anerui:''' I'm the mistress of hunting. At this place you can buy food we get from our hunts.

''Jogador:'' '''Time'''</br>
'''Anerui:''' Watch the sky, it will tell you.

''Jogador:'' '''Roderick'''</br>
'''Anerui:''' He is our contact person to the Thaian kingdom and a necessary evil.

''Jogador:'' '''Olrik'''</br>
'''Anerui:''' He'd love to be an elf but he is rather some kind of a pale orc.

''Jogador:'' '''Thais'''</br>
'''Anerui:''' Thais is too far away to pose a threat but it is also too far away to help us if problems should occur.

''Jogador:'' '''Venore'''</br>
'''Anerui:''' Venore profits greatly from the trade with Ab'Dendriel. In my eyes, those traders are leeches that exhaust our resources.

''Jogador:'' ''cArlin''''</br>
'''Anerui:''' Carlin needs our protection and resources. Of course they will turn on us as soon as they feel strong enough.

''Jogador:'' '''Cenath'''</br>
'''Anerui:''' The magic they wield is all that matters to them.

''Jogador:'' '''Kuridai'''</br>
'''Anerui:''' The Kuridai are too aggressive, not only against people but also against the environment. They lack any understanding of the balance that we know as nature.

''Jogador:'' '''Deraisim'''</br>
'''Anerui:''' We try to live in harmony with the forces of nature.

''Jogador:'' '''Abdaisim'''</br>
'''Anerui:''' The Abdaisim are our brothers and sisters in spirit. We stay in contact with them, exchanging news and items.

''Jogador:'' '''Hunter'''</br>
'''Anerui:''' Hunters live a life of freedom, close to nature, unlike a simple farmer or bug herder.

''Jogador:'' '''Hunt''' / '''Game''' / '''Play'''</br>
'''Anerui:''' Hunting is an art which is too often practised by amateurs. Every fool with a bow or a spear considers himself a hunter.

''Jogador:'' '''Art'''</br>
'''Anerui:''' I'm the mistress of hunting. At this place you can buy food we get from our hunts.

''Jogador:'' '''Bow''' / '''Arrow''' / '''Spear'''</br>
'''Anerui:''' Bow, arrow, and spear are the hunter's best friends. I heard somebody is selling such tools in the North-east of this town.

''Jogador:'' '''Nature'''</br>
'''Anerui:''' Nature is not a friend but an unforgiving teacher, and the lessons we have to learn are endless.

''Jogador:'' '''Bug herder'''</br>
'''Anerui:''' A person who herds bugs, what else?

''Jogador:'' '''Bugs'''</br>
'''Anerui:''' The bugs provide us with chitin for equipment, bug milk and bug meat.

''Jogador:'' '''Bug milk'''</br>
'''Anerui:''' It's delicious. Brasith sells it in his store.

''Jogador:'' '''Forest'''</br>
'''Anerui:''' The forests are the gardens of life. Nature provides enough for everyone's need, but not enough for everyone's greed.

''Jogador:'' '''Teacher'''</br>
'''Anerui:''' Most lessons nature teaches are about life and death.

''Jogador:'' '''Life''' / '''Death'''</br>
'''Anerui:''' Life and death are significant parts of the balance.

''Jogador:'' '''Balance'''</br>
'''Anerui:''' The balance of nature, of course. It's everywhere, so don't ask but observe and learn.

''Jogador:'' '''Ferumbras'''</br>
'''Anerui:''' The defiler. I'm not going to talk about him.

''Jogador:'' '''Crunor'''</br>
'''Anerui:''' I believe it's a human god. I don't know much about this entity.

''Jogador:'' '''Elf''' / '''Elves'''</br>
'''Anerui:''' That is the race to which I belong.

''Jogador:'' '''Dwarf'''</br>
'''Anerui:''' I'll never understand these little people from the mountains.

''Jogador:'' '''Human'''</br>
'''Anerui:''' Humans are a loud and ugly race. They lack any grace and are more kin to orcs than to us.

''Jogador:'' '''Troll'''</br>
'''Anerui:''' I despise their presence in our town, but it may be a necessary evil.

''Jogador:'' '''Offer''' / '''Goods''' / '''Food''' / '''Buy'''</br>
'''Anerui:''' I sell meat and ham. If you like to see my offers, ask me for a trade.

''Jogador:'' '''Bye''' / '''Asha Thrazi'''</br>
'''Anerui:''' Asha Thrazi, ''Jogador''.
}}

{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Elvith | job = Comerciante de Instrumentos | npcclass = Humanóides | npcsprite = Elf | city = Ab'Dendriel | subarea = Ab'Dendriel City | location = [[Ab'Dendriel City]] ({{Mapa|32669,31607,7:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 6.2 | notes = Elvith é um típico elfo, ele ama ouvir música e é muito interessado nisso. Sabe muito sobre a música e ele vê musicalidade em tudo. Não pertence a nenhuma classe de elfos.

* Faz parte da [[The Shattered Isles Quest]].

| buysell = sim | buys = Nada. | sells = {{Trades/Sell | Drum | Lute | Lyre | Simple Fanfare}} ''Somente ao conversar'' {{Trades/Sell | Poem Scroll}} | falas = '''Nota:''' palavras sublinhadas são erros de ortografia e pode ser corrigida pela Cipsoft. ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Elvith:''' Ashari ''Jogador''.
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
'''Elvith:''' I sell musical instruments of many kinds.
''Jogador:'' '''Instruments'''
'''Elvith:''' I sell lyres, lutes, drums, and simple fanfares.
''Jogador:'' '''Music'''
'''Elvith:''' Music is an attempt to condensate emotions in harmonies and save them for the times to come.
''Jogador:'' '''Time'''
'''Elvith:''' Time has its own song. Close your eyes and listen to the symphony of the seasons.
''Jogador:'' '''Song'''
'''Elvith:''' Everything is a song. Life, death, history ... everything. To listen to the song of something is the first step to understand it.
''Jogador:'' '''Melody'''
'''Elvith:''' Everything is a song. Life, death, history ... everything. To listen to the song of something is the first step to understand it.
''Jogador:'' '''Elf'''
'''Elvith:''' We are the most graceful of all races. We feel the music of the universe in our hearts and souls.
''Jogador:'' '''Kuridai'''
'''Elvith:''' They could dig some halls for a big musical event, but they won't listen to me about that matter.
''Jogador:'' '''Teshial'''
'''Elvith:''' I bet they were great musicians.
''Jogador:'' '''Crunor'''
'''Elvith:''' That is some god the humans worship. Our pople are not interested in this gods anymore.
''Jogador:'' '''Human'''
'''Elvith:''' They are too loud and don't even understand the concept of a melody.
''Jogador:'' '''Deraisim'''
'''Elvith:''' The other deraisim are too much concerned with mastering the nature so they don't listen to its music anymore.
''Jogador:'' '''Cenath'''
'''Elvith:''' The Cenath think they know the 'art' but the only true art is the music.
''Jogador:'' '''Troll'''
'''Elvith:''' I went down to the mines and tried to lighten up their spirit, the foolish creatures did not listen to my songs, though.
''Jogador:'' '''Magic'''
'''Elvith:''' Sorry, I don't feel like teaching magic today.
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
'''Elvith:''' Asha Thrazi. }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.wikitext:

| buysell = sim | buys = {{Trades/Buy | Ancient Coin | Black Pearl | Blue Crystal Shard | Blue Crystal Splinter | Brown Crystal Splinter | Coral Brooch | Crunor Idol | Cyan Crystal Fragment | Dragon Figurine | Gemmed Figurine | Giant Emerald | Giant Ruby | Giant Sapphire | Giant Shimmering Pearl | Gold Ingot | Gold Nugget | Green Crystal Fragment | Green Crystal Shard | Green Crystal Splinter | Onyx Chip | Opal | Ornate Locket | Prismatic Quartz | Rainbow Quartz | Red Crystal Fragment | Small Amethyst | Small Diamond | Small Emerald | Small Enchanted Amethyst | Small Enchanted Emerald | Small Enchanted Ruby | Small Enchanted Sapphire | Small Ruby | Small Sapphire | Small Topaz | Tiger Eye | Unicorn Figurine | Violet Crystal Shard | Wedding Ring | White Pearl}} | sells = {{Trades/Sell | Black Pearl | Bronze Goblet | Golden Amulet | Golden Goblet | Ruby Necklace | Silver Goblet | Small Amethyst | Small Diamond | Small Emerald | Small Ruby | Small Sapphire | Watermelon Tourmaline (Fatia) | Watermelon Tourmaline (Lapidada) | Wedding Ring | White Pearl}} | falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == '''Briasol:''' Come and take a look at the finest gems in the lands of Tibia. == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Briasol:''' Ashari, ''Jogador'' and welcome to the Jewel Store of Ab'Dendriel. ''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
'''Briasol:''' I am a jeweller. I hope you are here for a trade. ''Jogador:'' '''Name'''
'''Briasol:''' I am Briasol Crithanath. ''Jogador:'' '''Time'''
'''Briasol:''' I don't know the time, sorry. I do not care for this concept. Watches are your master, they tell you what to do and when. ''Jogador:'' '''Offer''' / '''Buy''' / '''Goods''' / '''Sell'''
'''Briasol:''' I sell the finest gems. Ask me for a trade if you're interested. ''Jogador:'' '''Roderick'''
'''Briasol:''' I have only little dealings with him. ''Jogador:'' '''Olrik'''
'''Briasol:''' I only talk to him when I send a parcel to one of my customers in a far away city. He seems friendly and is a bit eager to please. ''Jogador:'' '''Carlin'''
'''Briasol:''' Carlin is a quite lovely city, given that its a city of humans. ''Jogador:'' '''Thais'''
'''Briasol:''' Thais has a high demand on the jewelry that I craft. ''Jogador:'' '''Venore'''
'''Briasol:''' The tradesmen of Venore offer high prices for my wares. ''Jogador:'' '''Cenath'''
'''Briasol:''' They are the ones responsible for most of the magic and the like in this town. ''Jogador:'' '''Kuridai'''
'''Briasol:''' Our caste are workers out of passion. ''Jogador:'' '''Deraisim'''
'''Briasol:''' They hunt for us and patrol the woods. ''Jogador:'' '''Abdaisim'''
'''Briasol:''' I don't know much about them. ''Jogador:'' '''Teshial'''
'''Briasol:''' They are lost in time. ''Jogador:'' '''Gem'''
'''Briasol:''' You can buy and sell small diamonds, sapphires, rubies, emeralds and amethysts or sell topazes. ''Jogador:'' '''Pearl'''
'''Briasol:''' There are white and black pearls you can buy or sell, as well as giant green and brown pearls which you can sell. ''Jogador:'' '''Jewel'''
'''Briasol:''' Currently you can purchase wedding rings, golden amulets, and ruby necklaces. We also buy gold ingots. ''Jogador:'' '''Talon'''
'''Briasol:''' We don't trade with them. ''Jogador:'' '''Excalibug'''
'''Briasol:''' It's a weapon of times long gone. It's lost for our time. ''Jogador:'' '''News'''
'''Briasol:''' I know nothing of importance. ''Jogador:'' '''Ferumbras'''
'''Briasol:''' He will be gone sooner or later. ''Jogador:'' '''Crunor'''
'''Briasol:''' Gods are eternal. They learn so much in their existence. ''Jogador:'' '''Elves'''
'''Briasol:''' Our lifespan is longer then that of other races. We should keep that in mind everytime. ''Jogador:'' '''Dwarfs'''
'''Briasol:''' They live that long and make not much out of it. ''Jogador:'' '''Humans'''
'''Briasol:''' I mourn them. As soon as you get to know one he's dead. ''Jogador:'' '''Troll'''
'''Briasol:''' We take care of them, give them shelter, and a reason to live. ''Jogador:'' '''Bye''' / '''Asha Thrazi'''
'''Briasol:''' Asha Thrazi. }}

== Frases Espontâneas ==
'''Alexander''': Selling all sorts of magic equipment. Come and have a look.

== Palavras-Chave ==
''Jogador'': '''hi'''</br>
'''Alexander''': Hi there ''Jogador'', and welcome to the magic store.

''Jogador'': '''job'''</br>
'''Alexander''': I trade with runes and other magical items.

''Jogador'': '''name'''</br>
'''Alexander''': I'm Alexander.

''Jogador'': '''news''' / '''rumors'''</br>
'''Alexander''': There are always rumors about the dangers in the far north of Edron.

''Jogador'': '''time'''</br>
'''Alexander''': It's ''horas'' right now.

''Jogador'': '''ferumbras'''</br>
'''Alexander''': A hero has to be well-prepared to face this threat.

''Jogador'': '''excalibug'''</br>
'''Alexander''': Ah, I would trade a fortune for this fabulous item.

''Jogador'': '''magic'''</br>

''Jogador'': '''king''' / '''tibianus'''</br>

''Jogador'': '''army'''</br>
'''Alexander''': The army uses weapons and armor rather then items of magic.

''Jogador'': '''thais'''</br>
'''Alexander''': I'm glad the king founded this academy far away from the mundane troubles of Thais.

''Jogador'': '''tibia'''</br>

''Jogador'': '''carlin'''</br>
'''Alexander''': I heard it's a druid city.

''Jogador'': '''edron'''</br>

''Jogador'': '''bye'''</br>

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Benjamin | job = Carteiro | npcclass = Humanos | npcsprite = Citizen | city = Thais | subarea = Thais City | location = [[Thais City]] ({{Mapa|32350,32220,7:2|aqui}}). | implemented = Pré-6.0 | notes = Ele é, na verdade, o lendário General Thaian, que perdeu sua memória em uma luta contra Ferumbras. Ele se aposentou e, em seguida, a posição de carteiro lhe foi dada pelo Rei Tibianus.

* Após completar a [[The Postman Missions Quest]], os [[Parcel]]s custarão somente 10 [[gp]]s e, as [[letter]]s, somente 5 [[gp]]s.

| buysell = sim | buys = Nada | sells = {{Trades/Sell | Label | Letter | Parcel}} | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Benjamin:''' Hello. How may I help you ''Jogador''? Ask me for a trade if you want to buy something. I can also explain the mail system.
''Jogador:'' '''Trade'''
'''Benjamin:''' Don't forget that you need to buy a label too if you want to send a parcel. Always write the name of the receiver in the first line and make sure you entered it correctly.
''Jogador:'' '''Receiver'''
'''Benjamin:''' Well, the receiver - or addressee - is the person you want to send mail to. Always make sure to enter his or her name correctly.
''Jogador:'' '''Mail'''
'''Benjamin:''' With our mail system you can send letters and parcels to other Tibians. I can either explain how letters and parcels work or sell them to you if you ask me for a trade.
''Jogador:'' '''Letters'''
'''Benjamin:''' If you want to buy a letter, ask me for a trade. Or do you want me to explain how letters work?
''Jogador:'' '''Explain'''
'''Benjamin:''' With a letter you can send a message to another Tibian's depot. If you want to send it to 'Ben' in Thais, use the letter - so that a form opens - and write 'Ben' in the first line. Write your message below that. ...
'''Benjamin:''' Then drag your letter on one of the blue mailboxes here to send it.
''Jogador:'' '''Depot'''
'''Benjamin:''' Each major city has at least one depot. Just step in front of one of the lockers and you can store items inside. Your mail will also arrive there. It doesn't matter which depot you stored it in - you can retrieve all your items from any depot in any city!
''Jogador:'' '''Mailboxes'''
'''Benjamin:''' With our mail system you can send letters and parcels to other Tibians. I can either explain how letters and parcels work or sell them to you if you ask me for a trade.
''Jogador:'' '''Parcels'''
'''Benjamin:''' If you want to buy a parcel, ask me for a trade. Or do you want me to explain how parcels work?
''Jogador:'' '''Label'''
'''Benjamin:''' If you want to buy a label, ask me for a trade. Or do you want me to explain how labels work?
''Jogador:'' '''King/King Tibianus'''
'''Benjamin:'''The King? Oops,I... can't remember his name.
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''
'''Benjamin:'''My Name is Benjamin.
''Jogador:'' '''Kevin'''
'''Benjamin:''' That name sounds familiar... Who might that be...
''Jogador:'' '''Thais'''
'''Benjamin:''' This is the town you are currently in.
''Jogador:'' '''Carlin'''
'''Benjamin:'''You can send letters and parcels to Carlin.
''Jogador:'' '''Ferumbras / General / Army'''
'''Benjamin:''' TO THE ARMS! MAN THE WALLS! FERUMBRAS IS NEAR''
''Jogador:'' ''' Eclesius'''
'''Benjamin:''' I know him because he always forgets to write the name of the recipient on his parcels and letters. The hardest part is to find out who he actually wanted to send it to.''
''Jogador:'' ''' Sam'''
'''Benjamin:''' Ham? No thanks, I already ate fish.''
''Jogador:'' ''' Lynda'''
'''Benjamin:''' She's SO pretty!''
''Jogador:'' ''' Xodet'''
'''Benjamin:''' The young sorcerer is a good businessman.''
''Jogador:'' ''' Muriel'''
'''Benjamin:''' This Muriel has a lot of correspondence.''
''Jogador:'' '''Baxter'''
'''Benjamin:''' This naughty child, always stealing apples!''
''Jogador:'' ''' Bozo'''
'''Benjamin:''' He hangs around here quite often. He says that I inspire him.''
''Jogador:'' '''Elane'''
'''Benjamin:''' Oh, she lives next door.''
''Jogador:'' ''' Lugri'''
'''Benjamin:''' NO! NO! NO! GO AWAY!.''
''Jogador:'' '''Frodo'''
'''Benjamin:''' Frodo... Frodo... ? Uhm... isn't that the guy that brings me food at lunchtime?''
''Jogador:'' '''Gorn'''
'''Benjamin:''' He sells equipment.''
''Jogador:'' ''' Gregor'''
'''Benjamin:''' Never heard of him.''
''Jogador:'' ''' Harkath Bloodblade'''
'''Benjamin:''' Oh, young Harkath will be a fine warrior some day.''
''Jogador:'' ''' Kevin'''
'''Benjamin:''' That name sounds familiar... who might that be...''
''Jogador:'' ''' Marvik'''
'''Benjamin:''' He's always talking about healing me even though I'm fine... I believe he is a bit nuts, poor man.''
''Jogador:'' ''' Quentin'''
'''Benjamin:''' Ooooh, nice man, visits me often... I think.''
''Jogador:'' ''' Quero'''
'''Benjamin:''' I love his music! He's my best friend and I visit him as often as I can.''
''Jogador:'' ''' Sherry McRonald'''
'''Benjamin:''' I don't drink alcohol while I'm on duty.''
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
'''Benjamin:''' It was a pleasure to help you, ''Jogador''.
}}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Charlotta | job = Druid Guild Leader | city = Vandura | subarea = Liberty Bay | location = [[Liberty Bay]] ({{mapa|32269,32842,7:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 7.8 | notes = Ela é a Líder da Guild de Druidas de Liberty Bay e uma aliada de Eleonore.
A partir do update 15.22 do dia 27 de janeiro de 2026 não é mais possível comprar magias com esse NPC pois a CipSoft removeu a interação com a palavra "Spell", e a função de comprar magias, visto que agora as magias passaram a ser adicionadas automaticamente assim que o players chega ao nível necessário. | buysell = sim | buys = | sells =
'''Magias para Druids''' {{Ensina | Apprentice's Strike | Chill Out | Creature Illusion | Cure Bleeding | Cure Burning | Cure Electrification | Cure Poison | Energy Strike | Envenom | Find Person | Flame Strike | Food (Spell) | Great Light | Haste | Heal Friend | Ice Strike | Ice Wave | Intense Healing | Invisible | Levitate | Light | Light Healing | Magic Patch | Magic Rope | Magic Shield | Mass Healing | Mud Attack | Physical Strike | Strong Haste | Strong Ice Strike | Strong Ice Wave | Strong Terra Strike | Summon Creature | Summon Grovebeast | Terra Strike | Terra Wave | Ultimate Healing | Ultimate Light}} '''Magias para fazer runas:''' {{Ensina | Animate Dead Rune | Avalanche Rune | Chameleon Rune | Convince Creature Rune | Cure Poison Rune | Destroy Field Rune | Disintegrate Rune | Energy Field Rune | Energy Wall Rune | Explosion Rune | Fire Bomb Rune | Fire Field Rune | Fire Wall Rune | Heavy Magic Missile Rune | Icicle Rune | Intense Healing Rune | Light Magic Missile Rune | Paralyse Rune | Poison Bomb Rune | Poison Field Rune | Poison Wall Rune | Stalagmite Rune | Stone Shower Rune | Ultimate Healing Rune}} | falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == Não possui. == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Charlotta''': Ah, welcome! Welcome ''Jogador''! If you need druid spells, you’ve come to the right place. Otherwise it’s just nice to have a visitor. ''Jogador'': '''job''' / '''place'''
'''Charlotta''': Oh well, I cure this and that. People come to me to hear about the future or to buy lucky charms. ''Jogador'': '''future'''
'''Charlotta''': No, your future is far beyond my abilities to see. I can divine only the future of ordinary lives of ordinary people. Your life is full of danger and excitement. ''Jogador'': '''charms'''
'''Charlotta''': Trading with lucky charms is not overly liked by the authorities, so please don’t ask. ''Jogador'': '''chondur'''
'''Charlotta''': Chondur is a great man of great knowledge and wisdom. He understands the ancient ways and voodoo. You ask where you can find him? You will find him when the time is right. ''Jogador'': '''cult'''
'''Charlotta''': May they be cursed! They bring doom upon us all. Calling powers they can’t control. Whoever may be the dark master they are serving, he’d do better to devour them all. ''Jogador'': '''djinn'''
'''Charlotta''': Djinns are a rare sight here. Although it is rumoured that one of their kind lives on a remote island here. ''Jogador'': '''eleonore'''
'''Charlotta''': She has the heart in the right place even though she is a Thaian. She is so pure. Not corrupted by politics or gold. Don’t forget to mention the secret word: peg leg. That will tell her we can trust you. ''Jogador'': '''ferumbras'''
'''Charlotta''': The dark one. He has some place of power on these isles. I wouldn’t advice to search this place. If you are clever, stay away from Ferumbras and everything that he represents. ''Jogador'': '''governor'''
'''Charlotta''': He does what he has to do, I guess. We are all slaves of the cards that fates deals us. Still we don’t have to like the roles others are playing. ''Jogador'': '''isolde'''
'''Charlotta''': ''Jogador'': '''king'''
'''Charlotta''': What has a king in Thais to do with the people here in Liberty Bay? He should just leave us alone and everything would be fine. ''Jogador'': '''liberty bay'''
'''Charlotta''': The name has become a cruel joke of fate. Once it stood for freedom until selfish fightings led all dreams burst. But in the end, you can’t truly kill a dream. ''Jogador'': '''light healing'''
'''Charlotta''': Do you want to have the spell ‘Light Healing’ for free? ''Jogador'': '''loveless''' / '''theodore'''
'''Charlotta''': This man is the worst example of a selfish and greedy Venorean profiteer. He’s the long arm of the trade barons that hold us by the throat. ''Jogador'': '''magic currents'''
'''Charlotta''': ou should probably talk with Chondur about this issue. ''Jogador'': '''pirate'''
'''Charlotta''': Well, there are pirates and then there are pirates. ''Jogador'': '''plantations'''
'''Charlotta''': Once there were only a few plantations on which free and happy men were working. Now the isle is full of plantations and the workers there are nothing else than slaves of foreigners. ''Jogador'': '''quara'''
'''Charlotta''': Nobody knows where they come from and what’s on their agenda. They are even more alien than the Thaian invaders and obviously more destructive. ''Jogador'': '''striker'''
'''Charlotta''': We both know that this man is a freedom fighter and not a pirate. ''Jogador'': '''rum'''
'''Charlotta''': Rum is a fine medicine in some cases. But as with all medicines, it has to be handled with care. ''Jogador'': '''spell''' (''se você não for druid'')
'''Charlotta''': Sorry, I don’t teach spells for your vocation. ''Jogador'': '''sugar'''
'''Charlotta''': The sugar was our blessing in the past. The money we gained trading it was enough to make a good living for everybody and even a little profit. But then it caught the attention of greedy people from other cities and now it has turned into our curse. ''Jogador'': '''thais'''
'''Charlotta''': Thais and the Thaians should mind their own business. ''Jogador'': '''tristan'''
'''Charlotta''': For a Thaian he is not that bad. ''Jogador'': '''venore'''
'''Charlotta''': The Venorean traders are the source of all evil here. It was them who convinced the king in Thais to intervene and to ‘rescue’ us by sending an occupational force. ''Jogador'': '''voodoo'''
'''Charlotta''': There is some knowledge that is less accurate but yet more true than the knowledge that the sorcerer’s guild presents us as truth. ''Jogador'': '''wyrmslicer'''
'''Charlotta''': A thoroughgoing soldier. Efficient, yet without a thought of his own. He is only a pawn of the mighty ones. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Charlotta''': Good bye my dear visitor. }}

pages.title: A Ghostly Guardian
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = A Ghostly Guardian | job = Guarda | job2 = Fantasma | npcclass = Humanos | npcsprite = Knight | city = Venore | subarea = Dream Realm | location = [[Dream Realm]] ({{mapa|32755,32345,14:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 7.9 | notes = Conta histórias sobre a [[Pits of Inferno]]. | buysell = não | buys = não | sells = não | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
[[A Ghostly Guardian]]: ''Jogador'', it is you. I knew you'd be coming someday. The guardian greets you.
''Jogador:'' '''Job / Guardian'''
[[A Ghostly Guardian]]: Once I was a guardian in these halls. It was my duty to welcome those who braved the challenge. But the Brotherhood infiltrated this place using stolen knowledge and their evil seed took root.
''Jogador:'' '''Brotherhood / evil'''
[[A Ghostly Guardian]]: The Brotherhood intruded these halls that are made of dreams. They defiled them to suit their needs. Beware of taking the wrong path ...
[[A Ghostly Guardian]]: It will lead you to a powerful master of evil and I fear that he may try luring someone as powerful as you to his side. He will urge you to join his order of evil ...
[[A Ghostly Guardian]]: Resist the temptation of power! Stick to the virtues and seek out the Dream Master for spiritual guidance.
''Jogador:'' '''Dream master'''
[[A Ghostly Guardian]]: The Dream Master is perhaps the last living member of the Nightmare Knights. He used to be a teacher of young aspiring knights. So mighty was his power that even the Bone Master did not dare to challenge him.
''Jogador:'' '''Dream challenge / Nightmare Knights'''
[[A Ghostly Guardian]]: Once the Dream Challenge was a test to find out who was worthy to talk to the Dream Master. Worthy to become a Nightmare Knight. Now ... I am not sure ...
[[A Ghostly Guardian]]: I don't know if there are any Dream Masters left. Perhaps you might find one of them like in the days of old. Before the evil came.
''Jogador:'' '''Bone master'''
[[A Ghostly Guardian]]: By using stolen secrets from our order as well as dark magic one of the last remaining bone masters found his way to this place ...
[[A Ghostly Guardian]]: He did not dare to challenge the Dream Master in fair combat. Instead, he decided to hide here and to poison the minds of those who sought the Master's guidance, luring them to the side of evil.
''Jogador:'' '''Bye / farewell'''
[[A Ghostly Guardian]]: I am guarding this place ... forever.
}}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Hjaern | job = Shaman | city = Hrodmir | subarea = Nibelor | location = [[Nibelor]] ({{mapa|32351,31028,7:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.0 | notes = Juntamente com [[Siflind]], Hjaern é extremamente adepto à artes espíritas. Ensina [[Druid#Spells|Magias de Druid]].

* Faz parte da [[The Ice Islands Quest]]. * Você só poderá vender os [[Shard]]s depois de ter obtido os dois addons do [[Norseman Outfits|Norseman Outfit]].

[[Categoria:NPCs Liberados por Quest]] | buysell = sim | buys = {{Trades/Buy | Shard}} | sells = {{Ensina | Apprentice's Strike | Chill Out | Creature Illusion | Cure Bleeding | Cure Burning | Cure Electrification | Cure Poison | Energy Strike | Envenom | Find Person | Flame Strike | Food (Spell) | Great Light | Haste | Heal Friend | Ice Strike | Ice Wave | Intense Healing | Invisible | Levitate | Light | Light Healing | Magic Patch | Magic Rope | Magic Shield | Mass Healing | Mud Attack | Physical Strike | Strong Haste | Strong Ice Strike | Strong Ice Wave | Strong Terra Strike | Summon Creature | Summon Grovebeast | Terra Strike | Terra Wave | Ultimate Healing | Ultimate Light}} '''"Magias para fazer runas"''' {{Ensina | Avalanche Rune | Chameleon Rune | Convince Creature Rune | Cure Poison Rune | Destroy Field Rune | Disintegrate Rune | Energy Field Rune | Energy Wall Rune | Explosion Rune | Fire Bomb Rune | Fire Field Rune | Fire Wall Rune | Heavy Magic Missile Rune | Icicle Rune | Intense Healing Rune | Light Magic Missile Rune | Paralyse Rune | Poison Bomb Rune | Poison Field Rune | Poison Wall Rune | Stalagmite Rune | Stone Shower Rune | Ultimate Healing Rune}} | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
[[Hjaern]]: Be greeted, ''Jogador''. The spiritual world looks upon you and your deeds.
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''
[[Hjaern]]: The spirits call me by the name of Hjaern and that is how I shall be known.
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
[[Hjaern]]: I would not consider this as a job. But one of my responsibilities is the training of young shamans. Even druids can learn a few new tricks from me.
''Jogador:'' '''Shamans'''
[[Hjaern]]: We try to figure out the will of the spirits and ways to appease them.
''Jogador:'' '''News'''
[[Hjaern]]: The news I receive are from the spiritual world. They would be of little importance for you.
''Jogador:'' '''Cult'''
Hjaern: We had no contact with the people that passed Svargrond. Their arrival has caused some disturbance in the spirits' world though. ...
Hjaern: Ancient spirits are restless. It seems that some things that should have been left alone, have awoken from their slumber. I can't tell more yet.
''Jogador:'' '''Gods'''
[[Hjaern]]: Your foreign gods are concepts we don't really understand.
''Jogador:'' '''King'''
[[Hjaern]]: There should be no such thing like a human that is ruling over the lives of other humans.
''Jogador:'' '''Chakoya'''
[[Hjaern]]: The chakoyas are like a force of nature. It would be wrong to try to exterminate them. On the other hand, we can't allow their carnivorous nature to threaten our lives.
''Jogador:'' '''Yeti'''
[[Hjaern]]: The yetis are real. They are elusive but dangerous. Some say they are rather residents of the spirits' world than ours. The spirits are silent about them which is an even greater enigma.
''Jogador:'' '''Ferumbras'''
[[Hjaern]]: He is of no importance here.
''Jogador:'' '''Svargrond'''
[[Hjaern]]: The city was a necessity. Just like the spirit needs a haven of safety and retreat, so does the body need it.
''Jogador:'' '''Excalibug'''
[[Hjaern]]: That's something I only heard about in curious questions of people like you.
''Jogador:'' '''Rumours'''
[[Hjaern]]: Months ago, many strange looking people passed Svargrond. The inhabitants tell stories about a cult they belong to. ...
[[Hjaern]]: It is rumoured that they are trying to awake unholy spirits in the mountains. Maybe other people know more about that cult.
''Jogador:'' '''Chyll'''
[[Hjaern]]: Father north wind is the supreme ruler of the North. His ways are almost unpredictable to us humans since his thoughts span ages. ...
[[Hjaern]]: We can only do our best to interpret his will correctly and act accordingly. One has to move with the wind after all, else it will destroy you. This is the way things are here in the North and the way of our people.
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
[[Hjaern]]: Good bye, ''Jogador''. }}

== Frases Espontâneas ==
'''Dane''': Have a nice warm milk, crystal clear water, or fresh lemonade in the Wave Cellar.

== Palavras-Chave ==
''Jogador'': '''hi'''</br>
'''Dane''': Welcome to the Wave Cellar, ''Jogador''. Have a drink.

''Jogador'': '''name'''</br>
'''Dane''': I'm Dane.

''Jogador'': '''time'''</br>
'''Dane''': It's exactly ''horas''.

''Jogador'': '''job''' / '''saloon'''</br>
'''Dane''': I'm the owner of this place of relaxation.

''Jogador'': '''cellar'''</br>
'''Dane''': It's pretty, isn't it?

''Jogador'': '''news'''</br>
'''Dane''': I heard nothing interesting lately.

''Jogador'': '''drink''' / '''offer''' / '''sell'''</br>
'''Dane''': I can offer you milk, water, and lemonade. Ask me for a trade if you need refreshments.

''Jogador'': '''food'''</br>
'''Dane''': Sorry, we just sell drinks.

''Jogador'': '''alcohol''' / '''wine''' / '''beer'''</br>
'''Dane''': Alcohol makes people too aggressive. We don't need such stuff in Carlin.

''Jogador'': '''special'''</br>
'''Dane''': Well, apart from not selling alcohol, you mean? I guess another specialty of Carlin are evergreen flower bowls.

''Jogador'': '''rumour'''</br>
'''Dane''': A sailor from Carlin told me that the natives of the Ice Islands pray to different gods. I think 'Chyll' is one of them or was that the name of the northern winds?? Well, doesn't matter! Primitives!

''Jogador'': '''rumour'''</br>
'''Dane''': I heard something about the fauna of the Ice Islands. The people tattle about birds that don't fly but swim!!! Isn't that ridiculous?!?!

''Jogador'': '''rumour'''</br>
'''Dane''': I heard it through the grapevine that the people on the Ice Islands eat fish all the time. But not only usual fish, no. They eat red and green fishes! ...</br>
'''Dane''': ... The only green fish I know is the one you can buy at Permaret in Edron as a 'special offer' and that would be your last meal. Trust me!

''Jogador'': '''rumour'''</br>
'''Dane''': I heard about one guy, that is living in the capital of the Ice Islands, who has become crazy after searching the mines there. He always mumbles things about ancient demons and the end of the world.

''Jogador'': '''rumour'''</br>
'''Dane''': A friend of mine, Captain Ogden Brewboiler, travelled to the forgotten northern sea. He is an ambitious sailor but still I have a bad feeling about it. I hope he's doing well.

''Jogador'': '''rumour'''</br>
'''Dane''': The people talk about a huge mountain of ice, several hundreds of metres thick located in the centre of the main Ice Island.

''Jogador'': '''rumour'''</br>
'''Dane''': Have you heard about the natives of the Ice Islands? It sounds very confusing to me. ...</br>
'''Dane''': ... I mean there are barbarians and barbarians, some are good, the others not. One call themselves 'Norsir' the others 'Raiders', but actually they are all the same.

''Jogador'': '''rumour'''</br>
'''Dane''': Some old people tell stories about the creation war and these islands in the North ruled by snow and ice. They say it once was a fertile region. Mighty magicians used a huge crystal of ice to store all the coldness inside.

''Jogador'': '''rumour'''</br>
'''Dane''': I heard about dozens of sea serpents terrorising the sea around the islands in the North. ...</br>
'''Dane''': ... It seems that this was the reason why nobody has discovered the Ice Islands before. Something must have happened because at a moment's notice they disappeared.

''Jogador'': '''rumour'''</br>
'''Dane''': A sailor told me a story about female raiders. He said they can talk to the beasts that live in the wilderness of the north. ...</br>
'''Dane''': ... The wolves and bears protect them and tear their foes into pieces if they order them to. If you ask me, this is just gossip.

''Jogador'': '''rumour'''</br>
'''Dane''': A week ago an old drunkard mumbled something about hairy elephants!! I wonder who's telling all that weird stuff. I never met someone who was in the North and returned to the main continent.

''Jogador'': '''rumour'''</br>
'''Dane''': I heard something about the barbarian tribes, who live on the newly discovered Ice Islands, that are called 'raiders'. The mightiest of them is headed by a shaman witch. There are rumours that she is immortal.

''Jogador'': '''rumour'''</br>
'''Dane''': I heard that the town is mostly built out of wood. The inhabitants nearly stubbed all their forests. ...</br>
'''Dane''': ... That must be the reason why the Carlin traders are so interested in getting there. They sense gold in selling wood.

''Jogador'': '''rumour'''</br>
'''Dane''': I heard something about a civil war going on in the North. It seems that there are different tribes of 'raiders' making the whole area an even rougher place than it is already.

''Jogador'': '''rumour'''</br>
'''Dane''': I received a letter from a friend who works on the Ice Islands. ...</br>
'''Dane''': ... He was writing strange things about suspicious inhabitants and something about a test to become one of them. It was very hard to read the letter, I think he was drunk as hell when he wrote it.

''Jogador'': '''rumour'''</br>
'''Dane''': A guy told me that the Carlin Trading Syndicate sent out an employee to the new market in the North to open up a new branch of their company.

''Jogador'': '''rumour'''</br>
'''Dane''': Some citizens from Venore settled on one of the islands in the North. I heard stories about exotic products they are gathering from their hunts.

''Jogador'': '''rumour'''</br>
'''Dane''': The Carlin Trading Syndicate is sending expedition after expedition to the new discovered islands in the north. ...</br>
'''Dane''': ... I heard that they dig for valuable ore which was found in an old mine. I wonder why nobody of them has returned yet.

''Jogador'': '''rumour'''</br>
'''Dane''': I heard about some strange creatures that appeared on one of the smaller ice islands. Reportedly they have a human torso but the lower body of a white-furred goat! Can you imagine that? ...</br>
'''Dane''': Travellers told me that they recently moved into the caverns beneath the island. There, they are growing fresh grass and even flowers! How is that possible in a frozen cave? Some kind of magic has to be involved. ...</br>
'''Dane''': I'm just not sure whether it is of the benevolent or the malicious kind.

''Jogador'': '''bye'''</br>
'''Dane''': Please come back from time to time.
}}

pages.title: Queen Eloise
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Queen Eloise | job = Rainha | npcclass = Humanos | npcsprite = Queen | city = Carlin | subarea = Carlin City | location = [[Carlin City]] ({{Mapa|32314,31754,7:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 5.1 | notes = Honre a Rainha de Carlin. Ela tem o poder de promover dignos aventureiros. Não ofenda ela, ou as suas guardas irão atacar você, deixando você com 1 de [[HP|vida]]. Para falar com ela, você deve usar a frase 'Hail Queen Eloise'.

* Faz parte da [[The Postman Missions Quest]]. * Faz parte da Mini World Change [[Mini_World_Changes#Lumberjack|Lumberjack]].

| buysell = sim | sells =
Outfit {{{!}} style="border-collapse: collapse; border-color: #A7D7F9;" border="1" cellpadding="2" {{!}}- bgcolor="#CEDFF2" !style="text-align:center;width:175px"{{!}}Item !style="text-align:center;width:120px"{{!}}Valor {{!}}- {{!}}[[Golden_Outfits_Quest#Outfit|Golden Outfit]] {{!}}style="background-color:#9eff8e; font-weight: bold;color:#000; line-height:100%; text-align:right"{{!}}500 000 000 [[gp]]s {{!}}- {{!}}[[Golden_Outfits_Quest#Addon_1|Golden Outfit Addon 1]] {{!}}style="background-color:#9eff8e; font-weight: bold;color:#000; line-height:100%; text-align:right"{{!}}250 000 000 [[gp]]s {{!}}- {{!}}[[Golden_Outfits_Quest#Addon_2|Golden Outfit Addon 2]] {{!}}style="background-color:#9eff8e; font-weight: bold;color:#000; line-height:100%; text-align:right"{{!}}250 000 000 [[gp]]s {{!}}} Promotions {{Trades/Sell | Vocation Promotion}} | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hail Queen'''
'''Queen Eloise:''' I greet thee, my loyal subject.
'''Fenbala:''' HAil To The Queen!'''
'''Barbara:''' HAIL TO THE QUEEN!
''Jogador:'' '''Subject''' / '''job'''
'''Queen Eloise:''' I am '''Queen''' Eloise. It is my duty to reign over this marvellous city and the lands of the north.
''Jogador:'' '''Queen'''
'''Queen Eloise:''' I am the Queen, the only rightful ruler on the continent!
''Jogador:'' '''City''' / '''Carlin'''
'''Queen Eloise:''' Isn't our city marvellous? Have you noticed the lovely gardens on the roofs?
''Jogador:'' '''Lands''' / '''Tibia'''
'''Queen Eloise:''' Soon the whole land will be ruled by women at last!
''Jogador:'' '''Women'''
'''Queen Eloise:''' We women try to bring justice and wisdom to all, even to males.
''Jogador:'' '''Mission''' / '''Quest'''
'''Queen Eloise:''' I will call for heroes as soon as the need arises again.
''Jogador:'' '''Heroes'''
'''Queen Eloise:''' We need the assistance of heroes now and then. Even males prove useful now and then.
''Jogador:'' '''Thais'''
'''Queen Eloise:''' They dare to reject my reign over them!
''Jogador:'' '''Druids''' / '''Padreia'''
'''Queen Eloise:''' The druids of Carlin are our protectors and advisors. Their powers provide us with wealth and food.
''Jogador:'' '''Knight''' / '''Trisha'''
'''Queen Eloise:''' The knights of Carlin are the bravest.
''Jogador:'' '''Paladins''' Ou '''Legola'''
'''Queen Eloise:''' The paladins are great hunters.
''Jogador:'' '''Castle'''
'''Queen Eloise:''' It's my humble domain.
''Jogador:'' '''Gods'''
'''Queen Eloise:''' We honour the gods of good in our fair city, especially Crunor, of course.
''Jogador:'' '''Dungeons'''
'''Queen Eloise:''' Dungeons are places where males crawl around and look for trouble.
''Jogador:'' '''Sell'''
'''Queen Eloise:''' Sell? Your question shows that you are a typical member of your gender! (Para Homens)
Ou
'''Queen Eloise:''' I beg your pardon? A queen that sells things? Be serious! (Para Mulheres)
''Jogador:'' '''Enemies'''
'''Queen Eloise:''' Our enemies are numerous. We have to fight vile monsters and have to watch this silly king in the south carefully.
''Jogador:'' '''Monsters'''
'''Queen Eloise:''' Go and hunt them! For queen and country!
''Jogador:'' '''Excalibug'''
'''Queen Eloise:''' A man's tale ... that means 'nonsense', of course.
''Jogador:'' '''Ferumbras'''
'''Queen Eloise:''' He is the scourge of the whole continent!
''Jogador:'' '''Order'''
'''Queen Eloise:''' The order that Crunor gives the world is essential for survival.
''Jogador:'' '''Tbi'''
'''Queen Eloise:''' A disgusting organisation, which could be only created by men.
''Jogador:'' '''Eremo'''
'''Queen Eloise:''' It is said that he lives on a small island near Edron. Maybe the people there know more about him.
''Jogador:'' '''Sewers'''
'''Queen Eloise:''' I don't want to talk about 'sewers'.
''Jogador:'' '''Shops'''
'''Queen Eloise:''' My subjects maintain many fine shops. Go and have a look at their wares.
''Jogador:'' '''Guilds'''
'''Queen Eloise:''' The four major guilds are the Knights, the Paladins, the Druids, and the Sorcerers.
''Jogador:'' '''Merchants'''
'''Queen Eloise:''' Ask around about them.
''Jogador:'' '''Time'''
'''Queen Eloise:''' Don't worry about time in the presence of your Queen.
''Jogador:'' '''Army'''
'''Queen Eloise:''' Ask one of the soldiers about that.
''Jogador:'' '''Evil'''
'''Queen Eloise:''' The forces of evil have a firm grip on this puny city to the south.
''Jogador:'' '''Minotaurs'''
'''Queen Eloise:''' They havn't troubled our city lately. I guess they fear the wrath of our druids.
''Jogador:'' '''Taxes'''
'''Queen Eloise:''' Our city is rich and prospering.
''Jogador:'' '''Reward'''
'''Queen Eloise:''' If you want a reward, go and bring me something this silly King Tibianus wants dearly!
''Jogador:'' '''Lea'''
'''Queen Eloise:''' The sorcerers have a small isle for their guild. So if they blow something up it does not burn the whole city down.
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
'''Barbara:''' LONG LIVE THE QUEEN! You may leave now!
'''Fenbala:''' LONG LIVE THE QUEEN! You may leave now!
'''Queen Eloise:''' Farewell, ''Jogador'' }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

'''Gorn:''' Oh, please come in, ''Jogador''. What do you need?</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Magic'''</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Name'''</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Time'''</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Druids'''</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Sorcerers'''</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Paladins''' / '''Elane'''</br>
'''Gorn:''' She's the leader of the paladin guild.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Baxter'''</br>
'''Gorn:''' Old Baxter was a rowdy, once. In our youth we shared some adventures and women.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Bozo'''</br>
'''Gorn:''' Bah! Go away with this bozoguy.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Frodo'''</br>
'''Gorn:''' Frodo is a jolly fellow.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Ferumbras'''</br>
'''Gorn:''' We had a clash or two in the old days.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Gregor'''</br>
'''Gorn:''' Even the strong knights need my equipment on their travels though Tibia.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Lynda'''</br>
'''Gorn:''' That's a pretty one.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''McRonald'''</br>
'''Gorn:''' I hardly know the McRonalds.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Muriel'''</br>
'''Gorn:''' You can find him in the sorcerer guild.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Oswald'''</br>
'''Gorn:''' This Oswald has not enough to work and too much time to spread rumours.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Quentin'''</br>
'''Gorn:''' He advices newcomers to buy at my store. I love that guy!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Sam'''</br>
'''Gorn:''' Strong as an ox, could armwrestle a minotaur, I bet.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Xodet'''</br>
'''Gorn:''' He owns the magic shop here. But be aware: The prices are enormous.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''</br>
'''Gorn:''' Good bye.
}}<noinclude>[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]</noinclude>

O cão do Lubo é nomeado Ruffy.

* Faz parte da [[Citizen Outfits Quest]]. * Faz parte da [[The Paradox Tower Quest]].

| buysell = sim | buys = {{Trades/Buy | Closed Trap | Crowbar | Fishing Rod | Machete | Pick | Rope | Scythe | Shovel | Watch | Wooden Hammer}} | sells = {{Trades/Sell | Backpack,25 | Basket | Bottle | Bucket | Candelabrum | Candlestick | Closed Trap | Crowbar | Crusher | Fishing Rod, 150 | Machete | Pick | Present | Red Apple | Rope | Scythe, 50 | Shovel, 50 | Torch | Watch | Water (Líquido),10 | Worm}} | falas = {{TOC left}} {{clear}} === Palavras-chave Gerais === ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Lubo:''' Welcome to my adventurer shop, ''Jogador''! What do you need?
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
'''Lubo:''' I am selling equipment for adventurers. Do you need anything?
''Jogador:'' '''Equipment'''
'''Lubo:''' I sell torches, fishing rods, ropes, water hoses, backpacks, apples, and maps.
''Jogador:'' '''Maps'''
'''Lubo:''' Oh! I'm sorry, I sold the last one just five minutes ago.
''Jogador:'' '''Magic'''
'''Lubo:''' There's a lot of magic flowing in the mountain to the north.
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''
'''Lubo:''' I am Lubo, the owner of this shop. ''Jogador:'' '''Time'''
'''Lubo:''' It is exactly 0:00 am. ''Jogador:'' '''Weapon'''
'''Lubo:''' If you want to buy weapons, you'll have to go to a town or city. ''Jogador:'' '''Mountains'''
'''Lubo:''' It is said that once there lived a great magician on the top of this mountain. ''Jogador:'' '''Magician'''
'''Lubo:''' I don't remember his name, but it's said that his banner was the black eye. === Crunor's Cottage === ''Jogador:'' '''Crunor's Cottage'''
'''Lubo:''' Ah yes, I remember my grandfather talking about that name. This house used to be an inn a long time ago. My family bought it from some of these flower guys.
''Jogador:'' '''Flower guys'''
'''Lubo:''' Oh, I mean druids of course. They sold the cottage to my family after some of them died in an accident or something like that.
''Jogador'': '''Accident'''
'''Lubo:''' As far as I can remember the story, a pet escaped its stable behind the inn. It got somehow involved with powerful magic at a ritual and was transformed in some way.
''Jogador:'' '''Stable'''
'''Lubo:''' My grandpa told me, in the old days there were some behind this cottage. Nothing big though, just small ones, for chicken or rabbits. }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

== Frases Espontâneas ==
'''Timur''': Equipment and general goods!</br>
'''Timur''': Selling ammunition and buying bows and crossbows!</br>

== Palavras-Chave ==
''Jogador'': '''hi'''</br>
'''Timur''': Welcome to my little shop, adventurer ''Jogador''! If you need general goods, just ask me for a trade.

''Jogador'': '''name''' / '''timur'''</br>
'''Timur''': I am Timur. Sorry, I have not much equipment for sale. The business is running low.

''Jogador'': '''job'''</br>
'''Timur''': I am selling equipment. Do you want something?

''Jogador'': '''time'''</br>
'''Timur''': I am sorry, I have no watch.

''Jogador'': '''goods''' / '''equipment'''</br>
'''Timur''': I sell torches, scrolls, documents, parchments, ropes, fishing rods, worms, arrows, bolts, and a nice helmet. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a trade.

''Jogador'': '''weapon'''</br>
'''Timur''': At the moment I have no weapons to offer. Weapons are very rare on this isle, so I have to buy a few.

''Jogador'': '''bow'''</br>
'''Timur''': We have too few bows on this isle for our hunters.

''Jogador'': '''crossbow'''</br>
'''Timur''': We have too few crossbows on this isle for our hunters.

''Jogador'': '''wand''' / '''rod''' / '''spellbook'''</br>
'''Timur''': Nope, not here.

''Jogador'': '''fibula'''</br>
'''Timur''': It's a very nice isle. But we don't have enough weapons to defeat the many wolves.

''Jogador'': '''wolves'''</br>
'''Timur''': They are everywhere around the village.

''Jogador'': '''magic''' / '''potion'''</br>
'''Timur''': The magic shops have a monopole on potions now... argl!

''Jogador'': '''bye'''</br>
'''Timur''': Bye, bye, ''Jogador''.
}}

''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''</br>
'''Gamon:''' Nice to meet you, Mister ''Jogador''! Looking for furniture? You've come to the right place!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Artist'''</br>
'''Gamon:''' Yes! Selling is a form of art! The elaborate combination of rhetoric and acting which serves to create a sublime longing for the infinite, embodied by second class furniture.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''</br>
'''Gamon:''' I am <u>Thais's</u> foremost furniture salesman.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Furniture'''</br>
'''Gamon:''' I sell statues, tables, chairs, flowers, pillows, pottery, instruments, decoration, tapestries and containers.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Quality'''</br>
'''Gamon:''' Our furniture is produced by the finest carpenters on the continent using the rare wood of the Venorean marsh willow!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Marsh willow'''</br>
'''Gamon:''' You can't get any better wood in this world. And it has got a nice smell to it, too. There is nothing nicer than a marsh willow campfire.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''King'''</br>
'''Gamon:''' His Royal Highness will start to appreciate the superior quality of our stock soon enough!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''</br>
'''Gamon:''' My friends call me Gamon. My fans call me the incredible Gammy!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Quest'''</br>
'''Gamon:''' A quest?! Who needs quests when there is interior decorating!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Smiling'''</br>
'''Gamon:''' Yes! Smiling! How a professional sales artist such as myself is supposed to work in such an atmosphere is beyond me!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Tibia'''</br>
'''Gamon:''' Tibia is a wonderful place full of business opportunities.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Time'''</br>
'''Gamon:''' Any time's a good time to buy some furniture.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Topsy / Turvy / Twins'''</br>
'''Gamon:''' Ah, those twins. Strange people they are (*sigh*). Oh, they are great work with, of course. Excellent quality, competetive prices! But well... (whispers) they give me creeps!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Creeps'''</br>
'''Gamon:''' Yes! I can never figure out which is which. And they are always watching me!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Watching'''</br>
'''Gamon:''' Look! They are doing it again! And they are always smiling!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Sam'''</br>
'''Gamon:''' I heard rumours he has some special offers for customers who know to ask for the correct things.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Eclesius'''</br>
'''Gamon:''' Ecle- who? No... can't say I know him.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''The First Dragon'''</br>
'''Gamon:''' A thaian folklore tale.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Benjamin'''</br>
'''Gamon:''' He's incredibly slow. Just your average postman, I guess.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Gorn'''</br>
'''Gamon:''' He sells stuff of inferior quality. Nothing compared to venores high quality goods.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Quentin'''</br>
'''Gamon:''' That old monk has probably never left that overcrowded town here.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Bozo'''</br>
'''Gamon:''' Bozo! Damn that clown! He keeps making fake orders. It isn't funny to deliver a wardrobe to an address that doesn't even exist, you know!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Elane'''</br>
'''Gamon:''' She's pretty, but I am the kind of man who enjoys a long and healthy life.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Marvik'''</br>
'''Gamon:''' Druids are obsessed with trees and the bane of any carpenter.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Gregor'''</br>
'''Gamon:''' Those knights know how to party. And after such parties there's always need for new furniture.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Muriel'''</br>
'''Gamon:''' The sorcerers guild could really need someone with taste to redecorate it.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Power'''</br>
'''Gamon:''' There are a few rumours about a rebellion, but that is all they are.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Rebellion'''</br>
'''Gamon:''' Well - a few paranoid souls think that Venore wants to gain independence from Thais. Nothing more than rumours.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Rug'''</br>
'''Gamon:''' Oh, silly me! Rugs are out of stock at the moment! But we expect a new shipment anytime. Just watch out for the next update!... Of our inventory I mean.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Castle'''</br>
'''Gamon:''' I've said it a thousand times! That place needs a complete refurbishing!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Thais'''</br>
'''Gamon:''' Thais is obsessed with its past. Everybody here is so proud of their history. Bah! Thais might have a long history, but it has no idea when it comes to interior decoration.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Venore'''</br>
'''Gamon:''' The place where it all happens. That town really rocks! Thais could learn a lot about interior decoration from Venore!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''</br>
'''Gamon:''' You'll come back. They all do.</br>
}}<noinclude>[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]</noinclude>

'''Quero:''' Welcome ''Jogador''! Can I help you?</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''</br>
'''Quero:''' I make instruments and sometimes I'm wandering through the lands of Tibia as a bard.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Elves'''</br>
'''Quero:''' They live in the northeast of Tibia..</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Instruments'''</br>
'''Quero:''' You can buy a lyre, lute, drum, and simple fanfare.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Bard'''</br>
'''Quero:''' Selling instruments isn't enough to live on and I love music. That's why I wander through the lands from time to time.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Music'''</br>
'''Quero:''' I love the music of the elves.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''</br>
'''Quero:''' My name is Quero.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Time'''</br>
'''Quero:''' Sorry, I don't know what time it is.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Benjamin'''</br>
'''Quero:''' He's nice.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Eclesius'''</br>
'''Quero:''' That name rings a bell, wait... I've last seen him several days ago when he went to buy some bread at the farm.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Benjamin'''</br>
'''Quero:''' He's nice.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Child'''</br>
'''Quero:''' Yes, I have a small daughter. Her room is upstairs.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''</br>
'''Quero:''' Good bye.</br>

| notes       = Frodo é dono da Frodo's Cabana. Ele negocia alimentos e bebidas. Com algumas palavras-chave certas, ele falará sobre os últimos rumores. Ele também pode responder aleatoriamente 18 rumores sobre Ice Islands.
