''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' Welcome to Frodo's Hut. You heard about the news?</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Army'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' Hehe. Great customers.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Frodo's Hut'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' I hope you like it. Would you like some food?</br>

''Jogador:'' '''News'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' Some travelers from Edron told about a great treasure guarded by cruel demons in the dungeons there.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Job''' / '''saloon'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' I am the owner of this saloon. I call it Frodo's Hut. I am also selling food.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Food''' / '''selling'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' I can offer you bread, cheese, ham, or meat. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a trade.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''King'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' Oh, our beloved king! Thanks to him, alcohol is so cheap.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Name'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' Just call me Frodo.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Time'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' It is exactly ''Horário dentro do jogo''.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Dungeons''' / '''graveyard'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' Ah yes, the graveyard dungeon. All I know is this riddle: His Grave to the south, the tree above, his soul in the shade. No idea what that means, though!</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Riddle'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' I heard it when I was a child.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Hengis Wulfson'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' He is a great bard. He often graced my hut with his presence, songs, and rhymes. I wonder what happened to him lately.</br>
:''Jogador:'' '''Killed''' / '''dead''' / '''death''' / '''slain'''</br>
:'''Frodo:''' Oh, by the gods! What do you say happened to him?</br>
:''Jogador:'' '''Cyclops killed'''</br>
:'''Frodo:''' That's horrible! I am in grief. I will never hear his songs again. I will even miss that strange rhyme he was obsessed with.</br>
:''Jogador:'' '''Rhyme'''</br>
:'''Frodo:''' He recitated it that often that I learned it by heart myself. I would recitate it, but I am not skilled in that kind of things.</br>
:''Jogador:'' '''Recitate'''</br>
:'''Frodo:''' Uhm. If you insist, but I am so awful. I will stop now and then and wait, so you can tell if I should proceed, ok?</br>
:''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''</br>
:'''Frodo:''' Well ok, but don't blame me. Chhrrr... chhrrrr,... it goes like this... chhrrr: and when the dead feast at midnight...</br>
:''Jogador:'' '''Proceed'''</br>
:'''Frodo:''' ... the ancient enemy will no longer guard the place of his unlucky heir and the living will walk the paths of the old way...</br>
:''Jogador:'' '''Proceed'''</br>
:'''Frodo:''' ... Death awaits the greedy and the brave alike and many will be mourned until the long lost treasure is unearthed.</br>
:''Jogador:'' '''Proceed'''</br>
:'''Frodo:''' That's all. He recitated it when he was in one of his melancholy moods.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Excalibug'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' Nothing more than a tale for warriors.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Ferumbras'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' Uhm, do not mention him. It may scare customers away.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Hugo'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' I think some time ago a stranger from [[Fibula]] with that name stayed here for some nights.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Elane'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' Can you believe that she actually told her guildfellows that alcohol is a bad thing?</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Tibia'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' Come on! You know that our world is called Tibia.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Carlin'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' Many travellers tell funny stories about all the emancipated women in this northern town.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Thais'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' Here in Thais is the center of Tibia.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Baxter'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' He's able to drink a bottle or two.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Bozo'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' I am trying to hire him for an evening or two.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Donald McRonald'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' The McRonalds are a nice couple. Donald is a dear friend of mine.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Galuna'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' She makes excellent arrows and bows.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Gorn'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' Many of his customers visit my Hut, too.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Gregor'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' The knights have sometimes parties here after some arena fights.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Harkath Bloodblade'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' Too disciplined to enjoy life.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Lungelen'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' A sorceress, you can find her in her guild, poring over a book - always!</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Lynda'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' Just between you and me: What a babe! A shame that she is such a prude.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Muriel'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' Muriel has never visited this place.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Oswald'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' I hate him. Each of his visits here ends with a bar brawl.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Quentin'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' He hardly visits my humble tavern.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Samuel'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' A loud neighbour, I get a lot of complaints about him.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Xodet'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' I don't know where he gets these potions. If I could sell them here, the hut would be crowded.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Cropwell'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' No idea who that is, but maybe you'll find something in the Royal Archives...</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Royal Archives'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' Oh, the Royal Archives are in Rain Castle!</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Rain Castle'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' The king's residence has been renovated lately.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Lugri'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' I overheared some conversations about his evilness. That's enough to hope, that I never ever meet him.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Todd'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' That fellow is filthy rich. He rented a room upstairs for months in advance and always orders the best beer and wine I serve.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Rumour'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' A guy told me that the Carlin Trading Syndicate sent out an employee to the new market in the North to open up a new branch of their company.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Rumour'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' I heard something about the fauna of the Ice Islands. The people tattle about birds that don't fly but swim!!! Isn't that ridiculous?!?!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Rumour'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' I heard something about the barbarian tribes, who live on the newly discovered Ice Islands, that are called 'raiders'. The mightiest of them is headed by a shaman witch. There are rumours that she is immortal.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Rumour'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' A sailor told me a story about female raiders. He said they can talk to the beasts that live in the wilderness of the north. ...</br>
'''Frodo:''' ... The wolves and bears protect them and tear their foes into pieces if they order them to. If you ask me, this is just gossip.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Rumour'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' Some old people tell stories about the creation war and these islands in the North ruled by snow and ice. They say it once was a fertile region. Mighty magicians used a huge crystal of ice to store all the coldness inside.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Rumour'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' A week ago an old drunkard mumbled something about hairy elephants!! I wonder who's telling all that weird stuff. I never met someone who was in the North and returned to the main continent.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Rumour'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' The people talk about a huge mountain of ice, several hundreds of metres thick located in the centre of the main Ice Island.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Rumour'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' I heard that the town is mostly built out of wood. The inhabitants nearly stubbed all their forests. ...</br>
'''Frodo:''' ... That must be the reason why the Carlin traders are so interested in getting there. They sense gold in selling wood.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Rumour'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' Have you heard about the natives of the Ice Islands? It sounds very confusing to me. ...</br>
'''Frodo:''' ... I mean there are barbarians and barbarians, some are good, the others not. One call themselves 'Norsir' the others 'Raiders', but actually they are all the same.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Rumour'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' I heard it through the grapevine that the people on the Ice Islands eat fish all the time. But not only usual fish, no. They eat red and green fishes! ...</br>
'''Frodo:''' ... The only green fish I know is the one you can buy at Permaret in Edron as a 'special offer' and that would be your last meal. Trust me!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Rumour'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' Some citizens from Venore settled on one of the islands in the North. I heard stories about exotic products they are gathering from their hunts.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Rumour'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' I heard something about a civil war going on in the North. It seems that there are different tribes of 'raiders' making the whole area an even rougher place than it is already.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Rumour'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' A sailor from Carlin told me that the natives of the Ice Islands pray to different gods. I think 'Chyll' is one of them or was that the name of the northern winds?? Well, doesn't matter! Primitives!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Rumour'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' I heard about one guy, that is living in the capital of the Ice Islands, who has become crazy after searching the mines there. He always mumbles things about ancient demons and the end of the world.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Rumour'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' I received a letter from a friend who works on the Ice Islands. ...</br>
'''Frodo:''' ... He was writing strange things about suspicious inhabitants and something about a test to become one of them. It was very hard to read the letter, I think he was drunk as hell when he wrote it.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Rumour'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' A friend of mine, Captain Ogden Brewboiler, travelled to the forgotten northern sea. He is an ambitious sailor but still I have a bad feeling about it. I hope he's doing well.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Rumour'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' I heard about dozens of sea serpents terrorising the sea around the islands in the North. ...</br>
'''Frodo:''' ... It seems that this was the reason why nobody has discovered the Ice Islands before. Something must have happened because at a moment's notice they disappeared.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Rumour'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' The Carlin Trading Syndicate is sending expedition after expedition to the new discovered islands in the north. ...</br>
'''Frodo:''' ... I heard that they dig for valuable ore which was found in an old mine. I wonder why nobody of them has returned yet.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Malvik'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' Marvik seldom leaves his guildhall at all.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''General'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' Harkath Bloodblade is the royal general.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Donald'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' He is a little shy. In his youth he dreamed to become a druid.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Satanic'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' Hmm, I have heard of a 'satanic influence' theory by someone called Newton or something like that... Maybe there's more in the Royal Archives.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Sunset Homes'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' The sunset homes are a block of flats south of the harbour.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''One eyed stranger'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' Yes, I remember him. His name was Berfasmur.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Berfasmur'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' Sorry, he spoke only very little. I know nothing more about him.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Bye / farewell'''</br>
'''Frodo:''' Please come back from time to time.
}}<noinclude>[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]</noinclude>

pages.title: Baxter
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Baxter | job = Guarda | job2 = Recrutador | job3 = Curtidor | npcclass = Humanos | npcsprite = Knight | city = Thais | subarea = Thais City | location = [[Thais City]] ({{Mapa|32323,32189,7:2|aqui}}). | implemented = Pré-6.0 | notes = Somente se você puder ser voluntário para a Orc War. Baxter é um membro do exército do King Tibianus. Ele protege o castelo. É também responsável por lutar contra pragas de ratos nos esgotos. Na sua juventude, ele era um aventureiro e explorador. Nos velhos tempos, juntamente com Gorn, eles estavam procurando pela [[Excalibug]]. Procure não xingá-lo, ou ele lhe jogara um hit de [[fire|fogo]] que lhe causará aproximadamente 100 hitpoints de dano.

* Converse com ele para começar a [[Machinery of War Quest]].

 | buysell = sim | buys = {{Trades/Buy | Broken Helmet | Broken Shamanic Staff | Dead Rat,1 | Orcish Gear | Orc Leather | Orc Tooth | Shamanic Hood | Skull Belt}} | sells = {{Trades/Sell | Bricklayers' Kit}} | falas = (nota: palavras sublinhadas são erros de ortografia e pode ser corrigida pela Cipsoft) ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Baxter:''' LONG LIVE KING TIBIANUS!
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
'''Baxter:''' I am a proud member of the king's army. It is my duty to guard the castle.
''Jogador:'' '''King'''
'''Baxter:''' King Tibianus III is our wise and just leader!
''Jogador:'' '''Work''' / '''Mission''' / '''Quest'''
'''Baxter:''' We have a rat problem in the sewers. In the name of our glorious king I am paying 1 blinking piece of gold for every freshly killed rat you bring to me.
''Jogador:'' '''Sell'''
'''Baxter:''' Visit Tibia's shopkeepers to buy their fine wares.
''Jogador:'' '''TBI'''
'''Baxter:''' There is almost nothing known about that organization.
''Jogador:'' '''Castle'''
'''Baxter:''' His Royal Highness ordered the castle to be open for all his subjects.
''Jogador:'' '''Subjects'''
'''Baxter:''' We all live under the benevolent guidance of our king.
''Jogador:'' '''City'''
'''Baxter:''' Now that the king returned, we will clean the city from all scum.
''Jogador:'' '''Scum'''
'''Baxter:''' To much scum roams our streets in our days, the red guards will take care of them.
''Jogador:'' '''Red guards'''
'''Baxter:''' They are our special forces. Some serve as cityguards, others as secret police.
''Jogador:'' '''Secret police'''
'''Baxter:''' Ask a higher offical about that.
''Jogador:'' '''Rat'''
'''Baxter:''' Do you bring a freshly killed rat for a bounty of 1 gold?
''Jogador:'' '''No'''
'''Baxter:''' Come on. Don't waste my time with your jests.
''Jogador:'' '''Excalibug'''
'''Baxter:''' Gorn and I searched for this weapon in the darkest corners of each dungeon, but found nothing.
''Jogador:'' '''King'''
'''Baxter:''' King Tibianus III is our wise and just leader!
''Jogador:'' '''Benjamin'''
'''Baxter:''' He was one of the king's best generals, now he is a bit ...uhm... forgetful.
''Jogador:'' '''Bozo'''
'''Baxter:''' The royal jester. I dont think he is funny.
''Jogador:'' '''Chester'''
'''Baxter:''' This man is paranoid, but I guess that is useful in his job.
''Jogador:'' '''Gorn'''
'''Baxter:''' An old friend of mine. He was once a great warrior and adventurer, now he is running a shop.
''Jogador:'' '''Harsky'''
'''Baxter:''' He is soldier in the silver guard.
''Jogador:'' '''Sam]]uel'''
'''Baxter:''' He is a fine blacksmith. Almost all our weapons are made by him.
''Jogador:'' '''Stutch'''
'''Baxter:''' He is soldier in the silver guard.
''Jogador:'' '''Partos'''
'''Baxter:''' He was wanted for a long time and got caught stealing some time ago.
''Jogador:'' ''anything''
'''Baxter:''' What has this to do with this Partos guy? ''Jogador:'' '''Army'''
'''Baxter:''' Our brave army, which protects our city, consists of three battlegroups.
''Jogador:'' '''Battlegroups'''
'''Baxter:''' There are the dogs of war, the red guards, and the silver guards.
''Jogador:'' '''The dogs of war'''
'''Baxter:''' They are our main army.
''Jogador:'' '''Red guards'''
'''Baxter:''' They are our special forces. Some serve as cityguards, others as secret police.
''Jogador:'' '''Silver guards'''
'''Baxter:''' The best sorcerers, paladins, knights, or druids of our forces are choosen to serve as silver guards. They are the bodyguards of the king.
''Jogador:'' '''Mission'''
'''Baxter:''' We've got a rat problem in the sewers. In the name of our glorious king, I'm paying 1 blinking piece of gold for every freshly killed rat you bring me. ... '''Baxter:''' You seem strong! Do you want to help fighting the orcs? They prepare themselves for war! We need everyone who's capable of killing greenskins! Ask me about the orc war if you are interested. ''Jogador:'' '''Orc War'''
'''Baxter:''' I have already told you about your mission! Haven't you wrote down everything in your logbook? Look in there if you need to refresh your memory. ''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
'''Baxter:''' LONG LIVE THE KING!
}}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

''Jogador'': '''hi'''</br>

''Jogador'': '''here''' / '''job'''</br>
'''Donald McRonald''': I run a farm, what else?!

''Jogador'': '''name'''</br>
'''Donald McRonald''': Donald McRonald.

''Jogador'': '''donald'''</br>
'''Donald McRonald''': I am Donald.

''Jogador'': '''farm'''</br>
'''Donald McRonald''': It is my farm, yes.

''Jogador'': '''time'''</br>
'''Donald McRonald''': Who cares?

''Jogador'': '''wife'''</br>
'''Donald McRonald''': Sherry is my wife.

''Jogador'': '''weather'''</br>
'''Donald McRonald''': Weather is good enough to work on the fields.

''Jogador'': '''crops'''</br>
'''Donald McRonald''': It is hard to grow but worth the effort.

''Jogador'': '''fields'''</br>
'''Donald McRonald''': My fields are enchanted by the druids and the wheat grows very quickly.

''Jogador'': '''city'''</br>
'''Donald McRonald''': The city is to the north.

''Jogador'': '''mill'''</br>
'''Donald McRonald''': I sometimes have to bring the wheat there.

''Jogador'': '''spooked'''</br>
'''Donald McRonald''': I dont know.

''Jogador'': '''spider'''</br>
'''Donald McRonald''': I will give you 2 gold for every spider you bring me. But not a rotten spider that was already dead for some time. Do you have any with you?

:''Jogador'': '''yes''' ''(se você possuir uma dead spider morta recentemente)''</br>

:''Jogador'': '''no'''</br>
:'''Donald McRonald''': Hmpf.

''Jogador'': '''trade'''</br>
'''Donald McRonald''': Of course, just browse through my wares.

''Jogador'': '''buy''' / '''sell''' / '''offer''' / '''goods''' / '''stuff''' / '''ware''' / '''equipment''' / '''food'''</br>
'''Donald McRonald''': I can offer you wheat, cheese, carrots, and corncobs. If you’d like to see my offers, ask me for a trade.

''Jogador'': '''king'''</br>
'''Donald McRonald''': King Tibianus is our king.

''Jogador'': '''frodo'''</br>
'''Donald McRonald''': Frodo? He is a friend of mine.

''Jogador'': '''oswald'''</br>
'''Donald McRonald''': He ignores us and we ignore him.

''Jogador'': '''bloodblade'''</br>
'''Donald McRonald''': A general in the army.

''Jogador'': '''muriel'''</br>
'''Donald McRonald''': I don’t trust sorcerers like you. ''(se você for sorcerer)''</br>
'''Donald McRonald''': I don’t trust sorcerers. ''(se você não for sorcerer)''

''Jogador'': '''elane'''</br>
'''Donald McRonald''': Too noble to care about us.

''Jogador'': '''gregor'''</br>
'''Donald McRonald''': Knights always feel superior to us farmers.

''Jogador'': '''marvik'''</br>
'''Donald McRonald''': Druids are a great help for us, they know much about nature.

''Jogador'': '''gorn'''</br>
'''Donald McRonald''': Hardly know him.

''Jogador'': '''sam'''</br>
'''Donald McRonald''': A blacksmith, eh?

''Jogador'': '''quentin'''</br>
'''Donald McRonald''': A generous person.

''Jogador'': '''lynda'''</br>
'''Donald McRonald''': She has a good soul.

''Jogador'': '''eclesius'''</br>
'''Donald McRonald''': He sometimes comes to shop our food.

''Jogador'': '''bye'''</br>
'''Donald McRonald''': Yes, bye!

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}}
| name        = Bambi Bonecrusher
| job         = Guarda
| npcclass    = Humanos

| city        = Carlin
| subarea     = Carlin City
| location    = [[Carlin City]] ({{Mapa|32341,31748,7:2|aqui}}).
| implemented = 5.1
| notes       = Membra da [[Bonecrushers|família Bonecrusher]], Bambi ajuda a manter a cidade de Carlin protegida de Amazons e Orcs.
| buysell     = não
| falas       =__NOTOC__
== Frases Espontâneas ==
'''Bambi Bonecrusher''': Don't throw your litter on the streets of Carlin!

== Palavras-Chave ==
''Jogador'': '''hi'''</br>
'''Bambi Bonecrusher''': LONG LIVE THE QUEEN!

-----

=== Sobre Bambi Bonecrusher: ===
''Jogador'': '''name'''</br>
'''Bambi Bonecrusher''': It's Miss Bonecrusher to you!

''Jogador'': '''how are you'''</br>
'''Bambi Bonecrusher''': I am healthy and vigilant.

''Jogador'': '''job'''</br>
'''Bambi Bonecrusher''': It's my duty to protect our fair city.

-----

=== Sobre NPC's: ===
''Jogador'': '''queen''' / '''leader'''</br>
'''Bambi Bonecrusher''': Queen Eloise is our beloved sovereign!

''Jogador'': '''trisha''' / '''knight'''</br>
'''Bambi Bonecrusher''': Trisha is the leader of our knights guild. It is in the north of the town, near the gate.

''Jogador'': '''legola''' / '''paladin'''</br>
'''Bambi Bonecrusher''': Legola runs the local paladins guild, it's near the west gate.

''Jogador'': '''padreia''' / '''druid'''</br>
'''Bambi Bonecrusher''': Padreia is the greatest druid of the continent. You find the guild of the benevolent druids in the southwest of the city.

''Jogador'': '''lea''' / '''sorcerer'''</br>
'''Bambi Bonecrusher''': Lea is the head of the local sorcerers guild. You can find it south of the town centre at the magic shop of Rachel.

''Jogador'': '''rachel''' / '''magic''' / '''spell'''</br>
'''Bambi Bonecrusher''': Rachel sells equipment for all magic users in her shop. There is also the sorcerer guild on the second floor.

''Jogador'': '''sarina''' / '''provisioner'''</br>
'''Bambi Bonecrusher''': Sarina is our provisioner. You can find her in the town centre, south of the weapon shops.

''Jogador'': '''dane''' / '''tavern'''</br>
'''Bambi Bonecrusher''': Dane runs the local tavern and hotel. You can find it at the southwest beach of Carlin.

''Jogador'': '''liane''' / '''post'''</br>
'''Bambi Bonecrusher''': Liane is a kind person. She runs the post office in the town centre.

''Jogador'': '''bunny'''</br>
'''Bambi Bonecrusher''': My sister is in charge of our mighty army. If you want to talk to her, call her 'general' or she may be a little choleric.

''Jogador'': '''bambi''' / '''busty''' / '''blossom'''</br>
'''Bambi Bonecrusher''': We are Bonecrushers. Mess with one of us, and we all will come for you!

''Jogador'': '''barbara''' / '''fenbala'''</br>
'''Bambi Bonecrusher''': Fine warrioress, even if not of our family.

''Jogador'': '''tod'''</br>
'''Bambi Bonecrusher''': There once was an adventurer with this name in town, made some trouble, got kicked out. No big deal.

''Jogador'': '''general''' / '''bonecrusher'''</br>
'''Bambi Bonecrusher''': The bonecrusher family has been serving in the army of Carlin for generations. My sister Bunny is the general of our army.

-----

=== Outras Palavras-Chave: ===
''Jogador'': '''castle'''</br>
'''Bambi Bonecrusher''': The castle is in the northwest corner of the city.

''Jogador'': '''ghostlands'''</br>
'''Bambi Bonecrusher''': In theory the ghostlands are off limits. But we don't enforce that. Anyone stupid enough to go there will meet his deserved fate.

''Jogador'': '''graveyard''' / '''crypt'''</br>
'''Bambi Bonecrusher''': Stay away from the graveyard, it's haunted!

''Jogador'': '''sovereign''' / '''city'''</br>
'''Bambi Bonecrusher''': Behave well while in the city, or we'll get you! Do you want to know where to find a shop or a guild?

''Jogador'': '''shop'''</br>
'''Bambi Bonecrusher''': There's a smith, a provisioner, a tavern, a magic shop, and the royal post office, of course.

''Jogador'': '''guild'''</br>
'''Bambi Bonecrusher''': In the city you will find the guild houses of the Knights, the Paladins, the Druids, and the Sorcerers.

''Jogador'': '''smith''' / '''weapon''' / '''armor''' / '''fletcher'''</br>
'''Bambi Bonecrusher''': You can find the weapon and armour shops just west of the town centre.

''Jogador'': '''guard'''</br>
'''Bambi Bonecrusher''': I am a guard and proud of it.

''Jogador'': '''army'''</br>
'''Bambi Bonecrusher''': Of course, we guards are members of the army.

''Jogador'': '''banor'''</br>
'''Bambi Bonecrusher''': Praise Banor! May the great warrior be with us!

''Jogador'': '''news'''</br>
'''Bambi Bonecrusher''': I am busy. Please ask the citizens for news.

''Jogador'': '''knights of noodles'''</br>
'''Bambi Bonecrusher''': WOOF! WOOF! Go away with these puny king's puppies.

''Jogador'': '''green ferrets'''</br>
'''Bambi Bonecrusher''': Brave warriors, indeed.

''Jogador'': '''haunted'''</br>
'''Bambi Bonecrusher''': Strange things happen in our graveyard, and sometimes there are ... noises.

''Jogador'': '''noise'''</br>
'''Bambi Bonecrusher''': I never heard them myself, but people one can trust did.

''Jogador'': '''scum'''</br>
'''Bambi Bonecrusher''': We will get rid of all scum.

''Jogador'': '''male'''</br>
'''Bambi Bonecrusher''': Bah! Who cares about males? Let them do males' work, cleaning the sewers for example.

''Jogador'': '''sewer'''</br>
'''Bambi Bonecrusher''': Sewers are filthy and disgusting. We let the men take care of them.

''Jogador'': '''rebellion''' / '''resistance'''</br>
'''Bambi Bonecrusher''': What a joke. The men have no guts for a rebellion.

''Jogador'': '''secret police'''</br>
'''Bambi Bonecrusher''': Ask a higher official about that.

''Jogador'': '''depot'''</br>
'''Bambi Bonecrusher''': We have some depots in our town. You can't miss them.

''Jogador'': '''sell'''</br>
'''Bambi Bonecrusher''': Visit Carlin's shopkeepers to buy their fine wares.

''Jogador'': '''fuck''' / '''idiot''' / '''stupid''' / '''ass''' / '''shit''' / '''fag''' / '''tyrant''' / '''lunatic''' ''(a NPC lhe causará dano de fogo por desrespeitá-la)''</br>
'''Bambi Bonecrusher''': Take this!

''Jogador'': '''bye'''</br>
'''Bambi Bonecrusher''': LONG LIVE THE QUEEN!
}}

pages.title: Bunny Bonecrusher
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Bunny Bonecrusher | job = Guarda | npcclass = Humanos | npcsprite = Knight | city = Carlin | subarea = Carlin City | location = [[Carlin City]] ({{Mapa|32316,31751,5:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 5.1 | notes = Membra da [[Bonecrushers|família Bonecrusher]], Bunny ajuda na segurança de Carlin contra Amazons e Orcs. Somente falará com você se dirigir-se à ela com seu título, ''"Hail General."''

* Faz parte da [[Tower Defence Quest]].

| buysell = não | falas =__NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == Não possui. == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Bunny Bonecrusher''': Address me with my title, commoner Bacca Chewie! ''Jogador'': '''hail general''' / '''salutations general'''
'''Bunny Bonecrusher''': LONG LIVE THE QUEEN! ''Jogador'': '''how are you'''
'''Bunny Bonecrusher''': We are in constant training and in perfect health. ''Jogador'': '''job''' / '''commoner''' ''(se você for homem)''
'''Bunny Bonecrusher''': I am the general of the queen's army. I don't have time to explain this concept to you. ''Jogador'': '''queen'''
'''Bunny Bonecrusher''': HAIL TO QUEEN ELOISE, OUR NOBLE LEADER! ''Jogador'': '''leader'''
'''Bunny Bonecrusher''': Queen Eloise is a fine leader for our fair town, indeed! ''Jogador'': '''god'''
'''Bunny Bonecrusher''': I worship Banor, the first warrior! ''Jogador'': '''banor'''
'''Bunny Bonecrusher''': He is the idol for all fighting women and a reminder of what a man could become if he jumps over his own shadow! ''Jogador'': '''join'''
'''Bunny Bonecrusher''': Join what? ''Jogador'': '''join army'''
'''Bunny Bonecrusher''': Sorry, we don't recruit foreigners. Maybe you can join if you prove yourself in a mission for the queen. ''Jogador'': '''quest''' / '''mission''' ''(se você for homem)''
'''Bunny Bonecrusher''': Yeah. Entrusting a male with an important quest. Get serious! ''Jogador'': '''rowenna''' / '''weapon'''
'''Bunny Bonecrusher''': Rowenna is responsible for our troops' supply of weapons. ''Jogador'': '''legola'''
'''Bunny Bonecrusher''': She is a distant cousin of me and my sisters. ''Jogador'': '''cornelia''' / '''armor'''
'''Bunny Bonecrusher''': Cornelia forges the armor for our troops. ''Jogador'': '''ferumbras'''
'''Bunny Bonecrusher''': Believe it or not, I killed him two times with my own bow, but some unholy forces rise him again and again. ''Jogador'': '''bambi''' / '''busty''' / '''blossom''' / '''family'''
'''Bunny Bonecrusher''': She is one of my beloved sisters and serves Carlin as a town guard. ''Jogador'': '''barbara''' / '''fenbala'''
'''Bunny Bonecrusher''': She is one of the Green Ferrets and one of the queen's bodyguards. ''Jogador'': '''zathroth'''
'''Bunny Bonecrusher''': Don't mention the dark one in the city of life! ''Jogador'': '''sister''' / '''bonecrusher'''
'''Bunny Bonecrusher''': Our family has been serving the Carlin army since countless generations! ''Jogador'': '''castle'''
'''Bunny Bonecrusher''': The castle was not built for defence but as a residence for the royal family. ''Jogador'': '''graveyard''' / '''cemetery''' / '''crypt'''
'''Bunny Bonecrusher''': Bah! Just men's tales! Who believes in such rubbish? Perhaps we should put some men there overnight and see what happens. Hehehe! ''Jogador'': '''monster'''
'''Bunny Bonecrusher''': We cleared the woods around Carlin of most monsters. But lately, more and more show up again. ''Jogador'': '''excalibug'''
'''Bunny Bonecrusher''': I'm sure only a woman has the courage and strength to wield this weapon of myth. ''Jogador'': '''guard''' / '''army'''
'''Bunny Bonecrusher''': The army protects the defenceless males of our city. Our elite forces are the Green Ferrets. ''Jogador'': '''news''' / '''report'''
'''Bunny Bonecrusher''': Our reports are only for internal use. ''Jogador'': '''knights of noodles'''
'''Bunny Bonecrusher''': They are rumoured to be skilled fighters. Then again, in the land of the blind... ''Jogador'': '''green ferrets'''
'''Bunny Bonecrusher''': Our elite forces are trained by rangers and druids. In the woods they come a close second to elves. ''Jogador'': '''city'''
'''Bunny Bonecrusher''': Our city blends in with the nature surrounding it. Our druids take care of that. ''Jogador'': '''dogs of war'''
'''Bunny Bonecrusher''': This is a men's club, mainly busy with bragging and drinking alcohol. ''Jogador'': '''subject'''
'''Bunny Bonecrusher''': Our citizens are lucky to live under the wise rule of our beloved queen! ''Jogador'': '''kiss'''
'''Bunny Bonecrusher''': K.I.S.S.! Keep It Simple, Stupid! Complicated tactics are too easy to be crushed by a twist of fate. ''Jogador'': '''bloodblade'''
'''Bunny Bonecrusher''': Old man. I can't tell what's worse for the shape of Thais' army. ''Jogador'': '''druid'''
'''Bunny Bonecrusher''': They are our main magic support and play a major role in our battle tactics. ''Jogador'': '''tactics'''
'''Bunny Bonecrusher''': Our tactic is to kiss. ''Jogador'': '''thais'''
'''Bunny Bonecrusher''': It's just a rotten hideout for drunks and men too lazy to do some serious work. ''Jogador'': '''sell'''
'''Bunny Bonecrusher''': Are you suggesting I am corruptible? ''Jogador'': '''yes''' ''(a NPC lhe causará dano de fogo por desrespeitá-la)''
'''Bunny Bonecrusher''': Take this! ''Jogador'': '''no'''
'''Bunny Bonecrusher''': You should be careful with your words! ''Jogador'': '''fuck''' / '''idiot''' / '''stupid''' / '''ass''' / '''shit''' / '''fag''' / '''tyrant''' / '''lunatic''' ''(a NPC lhe causará dano de fogo por desrespeitá-la)''
'''Bunny Bonecrusher''': Take this! ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Bunny Bonecrusher''': LONG LIVE THE QUEEN! }}

pages.title: Busty Bonecrusher
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}}
| name        = Busty Bonecrusher
| job         = Guarda
| npcclass    = Humanos
| npcsprite   = Knight
| city        = Carlin
| subarea     = Carlin City
| location    = [[Carlin City]] ({{Mapa|32294,31789,7:2|aqui}}).
| implemented = 5.1
| notes       = Membra da [[Bonecrushers|família Bonecrusher]], Busty ajuda na segurança de Carlin contra Amazons e Orcs.
| buysell     = não
| falas       =__NOTOC__
== Frases Espontâneas ==
Não possui.

== Palavras-Chave ==
''Jogador'': '''hi'''</br>
'''Busty Bonecrusher''': LONG LIVE THE QUEEN!

-----

=== Sobre Busty Bonecrusher: ===
''Jogador'': '''name'''</br>
'''Busty Bonecrusher''': It's Miss Bonecrusher to you!

''Jogador'': '''how are you'''</br>
'''Busty Bonecrusher''': I am healthy and vigilant.

''Jogador'': '''job'''</br>
'''Busty Bonecrusher''': It's my duty to protect our fair city.

-----

=== Sobre NPC's: ===
''Jogador'': '''queen''' / '''leader'''</br>
'''Busty Bonecrusher''': Queen Eloise is our beloved sovereign!

''Jogador'': '''trisha''' / '''knight'''</br>
'''Busty Bonecrusher''': Trisha is the leader of our knights guild. It is in the north of the town, near the gate.

''Jogador'': '''legola''' / '''paladin'''</br>
'''Busty Bonecrusher''': Legola runs the local paladins guild, it's near the west gate.

''Jogador'': '''padreia''' / '''druid'''</br>
'''Busty Bonecrusher''': Padreia is the greatest druid of the continent. You find the guild of the benevolent druids in the southwest of the city.

''Jogador'': '''lea''' / '''sorcerer'''</br>
'''Busty Bonecrusher''': Lea is the head of the local sorcerers guild. You can find it south of the town centre at the magic shop of Rachel.

''Jogador'': '''rachel''' / '''magic''' / '''spell'''</br>
'''Busty Bonecrusher''': Rachel sells equipment for all magic users in her shop. There is also the sorcerer guild on the second floor.

''Jogador'': '''sarina''' / '''provisioner'''</br>
'''Busty Bonecrusher''': Sarina is our provisioner. You can find her in the town centre, south of the weapon shops.

''Jogador'': '''dane''' / '''tavern'''</br>
'''Busty Bonecrusher''': Dane runs the local tavern and hotel. You can find it at the southwest beach of Carlin.

''Jogador'': '''liane''' / '''post'''</br>
'''Busty Bonecrusher''': Liane is a kind person. She runs the post office in the town centre.

''Jogador'': '''bunny'''</br>
'''Busty Bonecrusher''': My sister is in charge of our mighty army. If you want to talk to her, call her 'general' or she may be a little choleric.

''Jogador'': '''bambi''' / '''busty''' / '''blossom'''</br>
'''Busty Bonecrusher''': We are Bonecrushers. Mess with one of us, and we all will come for you!

''Jogador'': '''barbara''' / '''fenbala'''</br>
'''Busty Bonecrusher''': Fine warrioress, even if not of our family.

''Jogador'': '''tod'''</br>
'''Busty Bonecrusher''': There once was an adventurer with this name in town, made some trouble, got kicked out. No big deal.

''Jogador'': '''general''' / '''bonecrusher'''</br>
'''Busty Bonecrusher''': The bonecrusher family has been serving in the army of Carlin for generations. My sister Bunny is the general of our army.

-----

=== Outras Palavras-Chave: ===
''Jogador'': '''castle'''</br>
'''Busty Bonecrusher''': The castle is in the northwest corner of the city.

''Jogador'': '''ghostlands'''</br>
'''Busty Bonecrusher''': In theory the ghostlands are off limits. But we don't enforce that. Anyone stupid enough to go there will meet his deserved fate.

''Jogador'': '''graveyard''' / '''crypt'''</br>
'''Busty Bonecrusher''': Stay away from the graveyard, it's haunted!

''Jogador'': '''sovereign''' / '''city'''</br>
'''Busty Bonecrusher''': Behave well while in the city, or we'll get you! Do you want to know where to find a shop or a guild?

''Jogador'': '''shop'''</br>
'''Busty Bonecrusher''': There's a smith, a provisioner, a tavern, a magic shop, and the royal post office, of course.

''Jogador'': '''guild'''</br>
'''Busty Bonecrusher''': In the city you will find the guild houses of the Knights, the Paladins, the Druids, and the Sorcerers.

''Jogador'': '''smith''' / '''weapon''' / '''armor''' / '''fletcher'''</br>
'''Busty Bonecrusher''': You can find the weapon and armour shops just west of the town centre.

''Jogador'': '''guard'''</br>
'''Busty Bonecrusher''': I am a guard and proud of it.

''Jogador'': '''army'''</br>
'''Busty Bonecrusher''': Of course, we guards are members of the army.

''Jogador'': '''banor'''</br>
'''Busty Bonecrusher''': Praise Banor! May the great warrior be with us!

''Jogador'': '''news'''</br>
'''Busty Bonecrusher''': I am busy. Please ask the citizens for news.

''Jogador'': '''knights of noodles'''</br>
'''Busty Bonecrusher''': WOOF! WOOF! Go away with these puny king's puppies.

''Jogador'': '''green ferrets'''</br>
'''Busty Bonecrusher''': Brave warriors, indeed.

''Jogador'': '''haunted'''</br>
'''Busty Bonecrusher''': Strange things happen in our graveyard, and sometimes there are ... noises.

''Jogador'': '''noise'''</br>
'''Busty Bonecrusher''': I never heard them myself, but people one can trust did.

''Jogador'': '''scum'''</br>
'''Busty Bonecrusher''': We will get rid of all scum.

''Jogador'': '''male'''</br>
'''Busty Bonecrusher''': Bah! Who cares about males? Let them do males' work, cleaning the sewers for example.

''Jogador'': '''sewer'''</br>
'''Busty Bonecrusher''': Sewers are filthy and disgusting. We let the men take care of them.

''Jogador'': '''rebellion''' / '''resistance'''</br>
'''Busty Bonecrusher''': What a joke. The men have no guts for a rebellion.

''Jogador'': '''secret police'''</br>
'''Busty Bonecrusher''': Ask a higher official about that.

''Jogador'': '''depot'''</br>
'''Busty Bonecrusher''': We have some depots in our town. You can't miss them.

''Jogador'': '''sell'''</br>
'''Busty Bonecrusher''': Visit Carlin's shopkeepers to buy their fine wares.

''Jogador'': '''fuck''' / '''idiot''' / '''stupid''' / '''ass''' / '''shit''' / '''fag''' / '''tyrant''' / '''lunatic''' ''(a NPC lhe causará dano de fogo por desrespeitá-la)''</br>
'''Busty Bonecrusher''': Take this!

''Jogador'': '''bye'''</br>
'''Busty Bonecrusher''': LONG LIVE THE QUEEN!
}}

== Frases Espontâneas ==
'''Captain Greyhound''': Passages to Thais, Ab'Dendriel, Venore, Svargrond, Yalahar and Edron.

== Palavras-Chave ==
''Jogador'': '''hi'''</br>
'''Captain Greyhound''': Welcome on board, Sir/Madam ''Jogador''. Where can I sail you today?

''Jogador'': '''name'''</br>
'''Captain Greyhound''': My name is Captain Greyhound from the Royal Tibia Line.

''Jogador'': '''captain''' / '''job'''</br>
'''Captain Greyhound''': I'm the captain of this sailing ship.

''Jogador'': '''sail''' / '''passage''' / '''trip''' / '''go''' / '''town''' / '''destination'''</br>
'''Captain Greyhound''': Where do you want to go? To Thais, Ab'Dendriel, Venore, Svargrond, Yalahar or Edron? Or to Travora - a place between the worlds?

''Jogador'': '''thais''' / '''ab'dendriel''' / '''venore''' / '''svargrond''' / '''yalahar''' / '''edron'''</br>
'''Captain Greyhound''': Do you seek a passage to ''cidade'' for ''valor'' gold?

''Jogador'': '''travora'''</br>
'''Captain Greyhound''': Travora is the place for the character world transfer, so if you travel there make sure you actually do want to change worlds. Do you want to purchase a new daily ticket for 1000 gold?

''Jogador'': '''carlin'''</br>
'''Captain Greyhound''': This is Carlin. Where do you want to go?

''Jogador'': '''tibia''' / '''ship''' / '''route''' / '''line''' / '''company'''</br>
'''Captain Greyhound''': The Royal Tibia Line connects all seaside towns of Tibia.

''Jogador'': '''ice''' / '''folda''' / '''senja''' / '''vega'''</br>
'''Captain Greyhound''': I'm sorry, but we don't serve the routes to Senja, Folda or Vega. I could bring you to Svargrond, though.

''Jogador'': '''darashia''' / '''darama'''</br>
'''Captain Greyhound''': I'm not sailing there. This route is afflicted by a ghost ship! However, I heard that Captain Fearless sails there from Venore.

''Jogador'': '''ghost'''</br>
'''Captain Greyhound''': Many people who sailed to Darashia never returned because they were attacked by a ghost ship! I'd never sail there!

''Jogador'': '''good'''</br>
'''Captain Greyhound''': We can transport everything you want.

''Jogador'': '''passenger'''</br>
'''Captain Greyhound''': We would like to welcome you on board.

''Jogador'': '''bye'''</br>
'''Captain Greyhound''': Good bye. Recommend us if you were satisfied with our service.
}}

pages.title: Cerdras
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Cerdras | job = Druid Guild Leader | npcclass = Humanos | npcsprite = Druid | city = Carlin | subarea = Carlin City | location = [[Carlin City]] ({{Mapa|32301,31816,6:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.5 | notes = Um pesquisador.

* Faz parte da [[Shadows of Yalahar Quest]].

| buysell = não | buys = n/a | sells = n/a | falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == '''Cerdras''': What a lovely flower!
'''Cerdras''': Ah! The beauty of nature! == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Cerdras''': Greetings, my friend! Is there anything I can do for you! ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Cerdras''': I am Cerdras of the Carlinian Druid Guild. ''Jogador'': '''job''' / '''do for you'''
'''Cerdras''': I’m merely a humble druid like so many others here. I may not be the most talented of healers, but I am gifted with a special attunement to the elements. ''Jogador'': '''elements'''
'''Cerdras''': How can I explain my connection to the elements so that you can understand it? Hmmm, it is like a faint melody, a song, that is always there. …
'''Cerdras''': I hear that melody shifting in time with the shifts in the elements. With so many years of listening, I have learned to interpret these shifts and so come to a deeper understanding of the elements. …
'''Cerdras''': It was a natural step for me to become responsible for researching elemental lore. I try to learn as much as I can and share it with my fellow druids. …
'''Cerdras''': Unfortunately, much of my understanding is instinctive, and our language just doesn’t contain the right words for me to adequately express the things I feel. ''Jogador'': '''song''' / '''melody'''
'''Cerdras''': It is hard to explain. Of course, it’s not a real song as you would understand it. I don’t hear it with my ears, but rather, I feel it deep inside of me. …
'''Cerdras''': Calling it a song or melody is the best I can do to describe it to those who don’t share this kind of perception. …
'''Cerdras''': It also helps me to express and understand something for which our language has no appropriate expression. …
'''Cerdras''': You know, we are so dependent on words that we can’t think about concepts when we don’t have words for them. …
'''Cerdras''': I sometimes think words have become just as much of a hindrance as a help. …
'''Cerdras''': Perhaps we would fare better if only we forgot words and dealt purely in feelings. Then perhaps all of us could hear the wonderful melody of nature. ''Jogador'': '''nature'''
'''Cerdras''': For me, nature is the harmony of the elements. This harmony can be disturbed by certain events, but nature always finds its way back to harmony in the end. ''Jogador'': '''druid'''
'''Cerdras''': Druids are supposed to be healers and preservers of nature. And what have most of us become? Hunters and killers who are only interested in furthering their own cause. ''Jogador'': '''earth'''
'''Cerdras''': The song of earth is always with me. As is the song of air. Both are often in some kind of harmony and sometimes it is hard to separate the one from the other. …
'''Cerdras''': If I concentrate hard enough I can distinguish the many individual songs that make the melody. …
'''Cerdras''': Each boulder, each stone, each grain of sand has its own voice in the symphony of the great melody. ''Jogador'': '''yalahari'''
'''Cerdras''': I have heard little of the Yalahari. And the little that I know does not tempt me to learn more. ''Jogador'': '''yalahar'''
'''Cerdras''': The city sounds like a urban nightmare to me. ''Jogador'': '''carlin'''
'''Cerdras''': The city has forgotten its original and true raison d’être. Harmony with our world has ceased to be important and slowly but surely Carlin’s people are losing their ability to empathise with nature. ''Jogador'': '''hunt'''
'''Cerdras''': The hunt can be part of the cycle of life and death. Nowadays that cycle has been broken. People take more than they give and greed dictates their actions. ''Jogador'': '''crunor''' / '''greed'''
'''Cerdras''': Crunor has not forsaken us despite our failings. Crunor’s love for life is truly great. ''Jogador'': '''golem'''
'''Cerdras''': I have indeed gathered some knowledge in the field of elemental golems. Particularly the secrets of the Earth element, which is involved in the process of their creation. ''Jogador'': '''telas'''
'''Cerdras''': Ah, yes, dear Telas. It is a pity that he has closed his eyes to nature’s beauty, but I can’t reproach him for that. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Cerdras''': Good bye, ''Jogador''. }}

pages.title: Alia
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Alia | job = Sacerdote | job2 = Curador | npcclass = Humanos | npcsprite = Mage | city = Carlin | subarea = Carlin City | location = [[Carlin City]] ({{Mapa|32360,31782,7:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 5.1 | notes = É a sacerdotiza do templo de Carlin, oferece cura caso o jogador esteja [[Poison|envenenado]], [[Fire|queimado]] ou [[Energy|eletrificado]].

* Você pode conseguir uma pedra especial falando '''Hi - Adventurer's Stone - Yes''' para este NPC. * Se você usar uma [[Adventurer's Stone]] dentro de [[templo]], você será teleportado para a ilha da [[Adventurers' Guild]].

| buysell = não | falas =__NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == Não possui. == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Alia:''' Welcome ''Jogador''! Welcome to the temple of Carlin. If you need healing, I can help you.
''Jogador:'' '''Job''' / '''Temple'''
'''Alia:''' I'm a nun, serving the gods of Tibia in this temple. I also heal wounded adventurers.
''Jogador:'' '''Gods'''
'''Alia:''' They created Tibia and all life on it.
''Jogador:'' '''Tibia'''
'''Alia:''' That's where we are. Tibia is our world.
''Jogador:'' '''Life''' / '''Crunor'''
'''Alia:''' Crunor is one of the favoured gods in our city, especially the druids venerate him.
''Jogador:'' '''Heal''' ''(quando você não estiver com a vida baixa)''
'''Alia:''' You do not need any healing right now. ''Jogador:'' '''Carlin'''
'''Alia:''' Carlin is a place of peace and prosperity thanks to the guidance of our beloved queen.
''Jogador:'' '''Thais'''
'''Alia:''' Thais is a rough city with rough habits. It's a pity they don't learn from us.
''Jogador:'' '''Venore'''
'''Alia:''' The Venoreans are quite aggressive. They show only little interest in the teachings of the gods. Most people there only worship money.
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''
'''Alia:''' My name is Alia.
''Jogador:'' '''Time'''
'''Alia:''' Now, it is 0:00 pm. You should consider buying a watch.
''Jogador:'' '''Zathroth'''
'''Alia:''' The Zathroth cult is forbidden in our city.
''Jogador:'' '''Dwarfs''' / '''Dwarves'''
'''Alia:''' The dwarfs are a strange race. Despite their odd religion and their somewhat rude manners, they are brave and honest people.
''Jogador:'' '''Elves'''
'''Alia:''' The nature-loving elves like to exchange knowledge with our druids. Still, it troubles me that they don't acknowledge the true gods.
''Jogador:'' '''Ferumbras'''
'''Alia:''' Don't mention this name here.
''Jogador:'' '''Excalibug'''
'''Alia:''' Sorry, I can't help you with that.
''Jogador:'' '''Ghostlands'''
'''Alia:''' Uh, don't ask. That's a place even the brave women of Carlin don't dare to explore!!!
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
'''Alia:''' May the gods be with you, ''Jogador''! }}

pages.title: Dalbrect
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Dalbrect | job = Capitão de Navios | npcclass = Humanos | npcsprite = Hunter | city = Carlin | subarea = Reokon's Tundra | location = [[Reokon's Tundra]] ({{Mapa|32204,31756,6:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 7.2 | notes = Dalbrect Windtrouser pode levar você para [[Isle of the Kings]] por 10 gps se você virar seu amigo. Ele é membro da família que uma vez foi a orgulhosa Windtrouser family. Agora ele é um pobre pescador que vive no porto ao oeste de Carlin. Sua família era nobre e muito rica, mas agora é pobre. Nada saiu de sua fortuna. Somente um emblema de sua família, perdido em algum lugar das Ghostlands, pode ajudá-lo a lembrar dos velhos dias de glória e riquezas da família. A família de Dalbrect perdeu sua riqueza em um projeto mal sucedido. Quando Carlin tentou colonizar a região hoje conhecida como Ghostlands, sua família investiu dinheiro nesse projeto. Mas a colonização dessa área falhou, e eles perderam toda sua fortuna.

* Faz parte da [[The White Raven Monastery Quest]].

| buysell = não | falas = '''Nota:''' palavras sublinhadas são erros de ortografia e pode ser corrigida pela Cipsoft. ''Jogador'': '''Hi'''
'''Dalbrect''': Be greeted, traveler. Welcome to my hut. ''Jogador'': '''Job'''
Dalbrect: I am merely a humble fisher now that nothing is left of my noble legacy. ''Jogador'': '''Legacy'''
'''Dalbrect''': Once my family was once noble and wealthy, but fate turned against us and threw us into poverty. ''Jogador'': '''Poverty''' / '''Fate'''
'''Dalbrect''': When Carlin tried to colonize the region now known as the ghostlands, my ancestors put their fortune in that project. ''Jogador'': '''Ghostlands'''
'''Dalbrect''': Our family fortune was lost when the colonization of those cursed lands failed. Now nothing is left of our fame or our fortune. If I only had something as a reminder of those better times. ''Jogador'': '''Brooch'''
'''Dalbrect''': What? You want me to examine a brooch? ''Jogador'': '''No'''
'''Dalbrect''': Then stop being a fool. I am poor and I have to work the whole day through! ''Jogador'': '''Name'''
'''Dalbrect''': My name is Dalbrect Windtrouser, of the once proud windtrouser family. ''Jogador'': '''Carlin'''
'''Dalbrect''': To think my family used to belong to the local nobility! And now those arrogant women are in charge! ''Jogador'': '''Passage'''
'''Dalbrect''': I have only sailed to the isle of the kings once or twice. I dare not anger the monks by bringing travellers there without their permission. ''Jogador'': '''Bye'''
'''Dalbrect''': Good bye. You are welcome. }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Padreia | job = Druid Guild Leader | job2 = Comerciante de Alimentos | npcclass = Humanos | npcsprite = Mage | city = Carlin | subarea = Carlin City | location = [[Carlin City]] ({{Mapa|32301,31815,7:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 5.1 | notes = Padreia é a grande druid de Carlin. Como maioria dos NPCs de Carlin, é uma mulher e ensina todo seu conhecimento sobre magias. Ela é responsável não só pela guild mas também pelos campos, e pela saúde dos cidadãos de Carlin.
A partir do update 15.22 do dia 27 de janeiro de 2026 não é mais possível comprar magias com esse NPC pois a CipSoft removeu a interação com a palavra "Spell", e a função de comprar magias, visto que agora as magias passaram a ser adicionadas automaticamente assim que o players chega ao nível necessário.

* Faz parte da [[The Ape City Quest]]. * Faz parte da [[The Exterminator Quest]].

'''Itens:''' {{Trades/Sell | Flask of Cough Syrup}} '''Magias:''' {{Ensina | Apprentice's Strike | Chameleon Rune | Chill Out | Convince Creature | Creature Illusion | Cure Poison | Cure Poison Rune | Destroy Field | Disintegrate Rune | Energy Field Rune | Energy Wall | Find Person | Fire Bomb | Fire Field Rune | Food (Spell) | Great Light | Heavy Magic Missile | Ice Wave | Intense Healing | Intense Healing Rune | Invisible | Light | Light Healing | Light Magic Missile | Magic Patch | Magic Shield | Mud Attack | Poison Field Rune | Poison Wall | Stalagmite Rune | Summon Creature | Terra Wave | Ultimate Healing Rune}} '''Magias para fazer runas''' {{Ensina | Avalanche Rune | Chameleon Rune | Convince Creature Rune | Cure Poison Rune | Destroy Field Rune | Energy Field Rune | Energy Wall Rune | Explosion | Fire Bomb Rune | Fire Field Rune | Fire Wall Rune | Heavy Magic Missile | Intense Healing Rune | Light Magic Missile Rune | Poison Field Rune | Poison Wall Rune | Stalagmite Rune | Ultimate Healing Rune}} | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Padreia:''' Welcome to our humble guild, wanderer. May I be of any assistance to you?
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
'''Padreia:''' I am the grand druid of Carlin. I am responsible for the guild, the fields, and our citizens' health.
''Jogador:'' '''Magic'''
'''Padreia:''' Every druid is able to learn the numerous spells of our craft.
''Jogador:'' '''Spell'''
'''Padreia:''' Sorry, I don't teach spells for your vocation.
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''
'''Padreia:''' I am Padreia, grand druid of our fine city.
''Jogador:'' '''Time'''
'''Padreia:''' Time is just a crystal pillar - the centre of creation and life.
''Jogador:'' '''Druids'''
'''Padreia:''' We are druids, preservers of life. Our magic is about defence, healing, and nature.
''Jogador:'' '''Sorcerers'''
'''Padreia:''' Sorcerers are destructive. Their power lies in destruction and pain.
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
'''Padreia:''' Farewell. }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.wikitext:
{{Event}}{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Hoaxette | job = Comerciante | city = Thais | subarea = Thais City | location = [[Thais City]] ({{Mapa|32380,32215,7:1|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.1 | notes = Apareceu pela primeira vez no jogo em 1º de abril de 2008, o "Dia dos Tolos". Aparece sempre no dia 1º de Abril e fica disponível o mês todo. Após o dia 01/04/2009 ela passou a trocar um [[Jester Doll]] pelas suas 6 partes separadas (dropados de [[Undead Jester]]s). Pode ser encontrada andando entre os shoppings e o templo de Thais.

:'''Fazer um Jester Doll''' :Nas invasões de Undead Jesters, ao matar as criaturas, há uma chance de cair as peças que você precisa. Precisa de todas as seis partes para poder trocar para um Jester Doll: :* [[Arquivo:The_Head_of_a_Jester_Doll.gif|link=]] [[The Head of a Jester Doll]] :* [[Arquivo:The_Torso_of_a_Jester_Doll.gif|link=]] [[The Torso of a Jester Doll]] :* [[Arquivo:Part_of_a_Jester_Doll_(Right_Leg).gif|link=]] [[Part of a Jester Doll (Right Leg)]] :* [[Arquivo:Part_of_a_Jester_Doll_(Left_Leg).gif|link=]] [[Part of a Jester Doll (Left Leg)]] :* [[Arquivo:Part_of_a_Jester_Doll_(Right_Arm).gif|link=]] [[Part of a Jester Doll (Right Arm)]] :* [[Arquivo:Part_of_a_Jester_Doll_(Left_Arm).gif|link=]] [[Part of a Jester Doll (Left Arm)]] :'''Transcrições''' :''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
:'''Hoaxette:''' Hiddeliho my friend ''Jogador''!
:''Jogador:'' '''Jester Doll'''
:'''Hoaxette:''' Oh! Have you found all six parts of a jester doll and would like to assemble them?
:''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''
:'''Hoaxette:''' Goodie! Here you are!

| buysell = sim | buys = Nada. | sells = {{Trades/Sell | Present (Explosive) | Spellwand | Yellow Pillow (Supersoft)}} | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Hoaxette:''' Hiddeliho my friend ''Jogador''!
''Jogador:'' '''Friend'''
'''Hoaxette:''' I'm here to enrich your life and to sell little trinkets of fun and joy. Just ask about my goods if you like to learn more.
''Jogador:'' '''Sell'''
'''Hoaxette:''' I sell special spellwands, pillows and presents that have ... funny effects. Where would be the fun if I told everything you about it? Ask me for a trade!
''Jogador:'' '''Trade'''
'''Hoaxette:''' Have fun with all my ... funny stuff.
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''
'''Hoaxette:''' I'm the lovely, inimitable, and hilarious Hoaxette. I'll stay here for the whole month before I leave this country again.
''Jogador:'' '''Jester'''
'''Hoaxette:''' Oh! Have you found all six parts of a jester doll and would like me to assemble them?
:Respostas: :''Jogador:'' '''No'''
:'''Hoaxette:''' Well, admittedly, owning parts of a doll can be just as fun. Hehe!
:''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''
:'''Hoaxette:''' Are you trying to make a fool out of me? You don't have all six body parts!
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
'''Hoaxette:''' I'm here to enrich your life and to sell little trinkets of fun and joy. Just ask about my goods if you like to learn more.
''Jogador:'' '''Fun'''
'''Hoaxette:''' If it were up to me, the whole year would be prank time!
''Jogador:'' '''Prank'''
'''Hoaxette:''' A prank in the morning and the day won't be boring . I offer funny items for this purpose. Let me know if you are interested in my offers.
''Jogador:'' '''King'''
'''Hoaxette:''' I'd love to play a prank on the king if he showed up here.
''Jogador:'' '''Joke'''
'''Hoaxette:''' I'm not specialised in telling jokes - I'm offering ITEMS that make people laugh. I can tell you something about my offers if you are interested.
''Jogador:'' '''Offers'''
'''Hoaxette:''' I sell special spellwands, pillows and presents that have ... funny effects. Where would be the fun if I told everything you about it? Ask me for a trade!
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
'''Hoaxette:''' See you, ''Jogador''! Have fun playing pranks on your friends! }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.title: Al Dee
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Al Dee | job = Comerciante de Ferramentas | npcclass = Humanos | npcsprite = Citizen | city = Thais | subarea = Rookgaard | location = [[Rookgaard]] ({{Mapa|32063,32182,7:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 6.1 | notes = Ele é o único dono da [[pick]], a qual é negociada exclusivamente em sua loja, por um [[Small Axe]]. Ele abastece a cidade com equipamentos e quer ser o único comerciante de Rookgaard, por este motivo é chamado de Louco Al. Irmão de [[Gree Dee]], que trabalha em [[Yalahar]] também como lojista de equipamentos. Ele é uma das [[Alusões#Aldi|Alusões]] no Tibia.
Suas placas podem ser encontrados em muitos lugares estranhos e obscuros, anunciando seus produtos: Na caverna de Rats, próxima de Al Dee: :"'''You read: Buy ropes at Al Dee's shop.'''" Também, perto da ponte que leva à área de região selvagem na parte ocidental: :"'''You read: Never enter dungeons without a rope or you may be lost forever.
Al Dee's shop - come to where the ropes are!'''" Em profundos lugares de Rookgaard há uma placa: :"'''Feeling alone in the dark?
Is your torch running out?
Al Dee's shop - come to where the torches are!'''" outra placa localizada em cavernas profundas: :"'''You read: Feeling lost?
Would you give all your gold for a rope now?
Al Dee's shop - come to where the ropes are!'''" | buysell = sim | buys = {{Trades/Buy | Fishing Rod, 0 | Rope,8 | Shovel}} | sells = {{Trades/Sell | Backpack, 10 | Bag | Fishing Rod, 150 | Rope | Scroll | Scythe, 12 | Shovel, 10 | Torch | Worm}} | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Al Dee:''' Hello, hello, ''Jogador''! Please come in, look, and buy! I'm a specialist for all sorts of tools. Just ask me for a trade to see my offers! You can also ask me for general hints about the game. ...
'''Al Dee:''' You can also ask me about each citizen of the isle.
''Jogador:'' '''How Are You?'''
'''Al Dee:''' I'm fine. I'm so glad to have you here as my customer.
''Jogador:'' '''Tools'''
'''Al Dee:''' As an adventurer, you should always have at least a backpack, a rope, a shovel, a weapon, an armor and a shield.
''Jogador:'' '''offer'''
'''Al Dee:''' Just ask me for a trade to see my offers.
''Jogador:'' '''Trade'''
'''Al Dee:''' Take a look in the trade window to your right.
''Jogador:'' '''Gold'''
'''Al Dee:''' Well, no gold, no deal. Earn gold by fighting monsters and picking up the things they carry. Sell it to merchants to make profit!
''Jogador:'' '''Backpack''' / '''Rope''' / '''Shovel'''
'''Al Dee:''' I am a merchant. What can I do for you?
''Jogador:'' '''Weapon'''
'''Al Dee:''' Oh, I'm sorry, but I don't deal with weapons. That's Obi's or Lee'Delle's business. I could offer you a pick in exchange for a small axe if you should happen to own one.
''Jogador:'' '''Armor''' / '''Shield'''
'''Al Dee:''' Armor and shields can be bought at Dixi's or at Lee'Delle's. Dixi runs that shop near Obi's.
'''Al Dee:''' Hmm, the best address to look for food might be Willie or Billy. Norma also has some snacks for sale.
''Jogador:'' '''Potions'''
'''Al Dee:''' Sorry, I don't sell potions. You should visit Lily for that.
''Jogador:'' '''Cookies''' / '''Fishing'''
'''Al Dee:''' I sell fishing rods and worms if you want to fish. Simply ask me for a trade.
''Jogador:'' '''Cooking'''
'''Al Dee:''' I you want to find someone who may want to buy your cookies, you should meet Lily.
''Jogador:'' '''Fish'''
'''Al Dee:''' No thanks. I don't like fish.
''Jogador:'' '''Torch'''
'''Al Dee:''' No thank you. I can already overstock the market with torches.
''Jogador:'' '''Worms'''
'''Al Dee:''' I have enough worms myself and don't want any more. Use them for fishing.
''Jogador:'' '''Bone'''
'''Al Dee:''' You better put that bone back there where you dug it out.
''Jogador:'' '''Help'''
'''Al Dee:''' If you need general equipment, just ask me for a trade. I can also provide you with some general hints about the game.
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
'''Al Dee:''' I'm a merchant. Just ask me for a trade to see my offers.
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''
'''Al Dee:''' My name is Al Dee, but you can call me Al. Can I interest you in a trade?
''Jogador:'' '''Time'''
'''Al Dee:''' It's about 0:00 am. I'm so sorry, I have no watches to sell. Do you want to buy something else?
''Jogador:'' '''Premium'''
'''Al Dee:''' As a premium adventurer you have many advantages. You really should check them out!
''Jogador:'' '''King'''
'''Al Dee:''' The king encouraged salesmen to travel here, but only I dared to take the risk, and a risk it was!
''Jogador:'' '''Sell'''
'''Al Dee:''' Just ask me for a trade to see what I buy from you.
''Jogador:'' '''Wares''' / '''Stuff'''
'''Al Dee:''' Just ask me for a trade to see my offers.
''Jogador:'' '''Ck''' / '''Small Axe'''
'''Al Dee:''' Picks are hard to come by. I trade them only in exchange for high quality small axes. Would you like to make that deal?
''Jogador:'' '''No (depois de Pick ou Small Axe'''
'''Al Dee:''' Well, then don't.
''Jogador:'' '''Yes (depois de Pick ou Small Axe - sem um Small Axe'''
'''Al Dee:''' Sorry, I am looking for a SMALL axe.
''Jogador:'' '''Yes (depois de Pick ou Small Axe - com um Small Axe'''
'''Al Dee:''' Splendid! Here, take your pick.
''Jogador:'' '''Dungeon'''
'''Al Dee:''' If you want to explore the dungeons such as the sewers, you have to equip yourself with the vital stuff I am selling. It's vital in the deepest sense of the word.
''Jogador:'' '''Sewers'''
'''Al Dee:''' Oh, our sewer system is very primitive - it's so primitive that it's overrun by rats. But the stuff I sell is safe from them. Just ask me for a trade to see it!
''Jogador:'' '''Vital'''
'''Al Dee:''' Well, vital means - necessary for you to survive!
''Jogador:'' '''Rats'''
'''Al Dee:''' Rats plague our sewers. You can sell fresh rat corpses to Seymour or Tom the tanner.
''Jogador:'' '''Monsters'''
'''Al Dee:''' If you want to challenge monsters in the dungeons, you need some weapons and armor from the local merchants.
''Jogador:'' '''Merchants'''
'''Al Dee:''' To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a trade. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.
''Jogador:'' '''Tibia'''
'''Al Dee:''' One day I will return to the continent as a rich, a very rich man!
''Jogador:'' '''Rookgaard'''
'''Al Dee:''' On the island of Rookgaard you can gather important experiences to prepare yourself for mainland.
''Jogador:'' '''Mainland'''
'''Al Dee:''' Have you ever wondered what that 'main' is people are talking about? Well, once you've reached level 8, you should talk to the oracle. You can choose a profession afterwards and explore much more of Tibia.
''Jogador:'' '''Profession'''
'''Al Dee:''' You will learn everything you need to know about professions once you've reached the Island of Destiny.
''Jogador:'' '''Island of Destiny'''
'''Al Dee:''' The Island of Destiny can be reached via the oracle once you are level 8. This trip will help you choose your profession!
''Jogador:'' '''Thais'''
'''Al Dee:''' Thais is a crowded town.
''Jogador:'' '''Academy'''
'''Al Dee:''' The big building in the centre of Rookgaard. They have a library, a training centre, a bank and the room of the oracle. Seymour is the teacher there.
''Jogador:'' '''Bank'''
'''Al Dee:''' A bank is quite useful. You can deposit your money safely there. This way you don't have to carry it around with you all the time. You could also invest your money in my wares!
''Jogador:'' '''Temple'''
'''Al Dee:''' The monk Cipfried takes care of our temple. He can heal you if you're badly injured or poisoned.
''Jogador:'' '''Citizen'''
'''Al Dee:''' If you tell me the name of a citizen, I'll tell you what I know about him or her.
''Jogador:'' '''Al Dee'''
'''Al Dee:''' Yep, that's me. Smart of you to notice that!
''Jogador:'' '''Amber'''
'''Al Dee:''' She's currently recovering from her travels in the academy. It's always nice to chat with her!
''Jogador:'' '''Billy'''
'''Al Dee:''' This is a local farmer. If you need fresh food to regain your health, it's a good place to go. He's only trading with premium adventurers though.
''Jogador:'' '''Cipfried'''
'''Al Dee:''' He is just an old monk. However, he can heal you if you are badly injured or poisoned.
''Jogador:'' '''Dallheim'''
'''Al Dee:''' ome call him a hero. He protects the town from monsters.
''Jogador:'' '''Dixi'''
'''Al Dee:''' She's Obi's granddaughter and deals with armors and shields. Her shop is south west of town, close to the temple.
''Jogador:'' '''Hyacinth'''
'''Al Dee:''' He mostly stays by himself. He's a hermit outside of town - good luck finding him.
''Jogador:'' '''Lily'''
'''Al Dee:''' She sells health potions and antidote potions. Also, she buys blueberries and cookies in case you find any.
''Jogador:'' '''Loui'''
'''Al Dee:''' No idea who that is.
''Jogador:'' '''Norma'''
'''Al Dee:''' She used to sell equipment, but I think she has opened a small bar now. Talks about changing her name to 'Mary' and such, strange girl.
''Jogador:'' '''Obi'''
'''Al Dee:''' He sells weapons. His shop is south west of town, close to the temple.
''Jogador:'' '''Paulie'''
'''Al Dee:''' He's the local bank clerk.
''Jogador:'' '''Santiago'''
'''Al Dee:''' He dedicated his life to welcome newcomers to this island.
''Jogador:'' '''Seymour'''
'''Al Dee:''' Seymour is a teacher running the academy. He has many important information about Tibia.
''Jogador:'' '''The Oracle'''
'''Al Dee:''' You can find the oracle on the top floor of the academy, just above Seymour. Go there when you are level 8.
''Jogador:'' '''Tom'''
'''Al Dee:''' He's the local tanner. You could try selling fresh corpses or leather to him.
''Jogador:'' '''Willie'''
'''Al Dee:''' This is a local farmer. If you need fresh food to regain your health, it's a good place to go. However, many monsters also carry food such as meat or cheese. Or you could simply pick blueberries.
''Jogador:'' '''Zerbrus'''
'''Al Dee:''' Some call him a hero. He protects the town from monsters.
''Jogador:'' '''Zirella'''
'''Al Dee:''' Poor old woman, her son Tom never visits her.
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
'''Al Dee:''' Bye, bye ''Jogador''. }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

| notes       = Phillip é um professor da escola em Carlin. Ele menciona sobre os professores viajantes chamados Loremasters.

''Jogador:'' '''Hello''' / '''Hi'''</br>
''Inferior ao nível 4:'' '''Phillip:''' Hello, pupil ''Jogador''. I hope I can help you on your quest for knowledge.</br>
''Inferior ao nível 15:'' '''Phillip:''' Hello, seeker of knowledge ''Jogador''. How may I assist you?</br>
''Inferior ao nível 25:'' '''Phillip:''' Hello, mighty adventurer ''Jogador''. Can I teach you something you don't know?</br>
''Level 25 ou superior:'' '''Phillip:''' Hello, famous ''Jogador''. It should be you teaching me!</br>
'''Phillip:''' Did the bell ring?</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Bye''' / '''Farewell'''</br>
'''Phillip:''' Go and be careful. Remember what you have learned!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''How are you'''</br>
'''Phillip:''' I am fine, thank you very much.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Sell'''</br>
'''Phillip:''' My business is knowlegde and it is for free.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''</br>
'''Phillip:''' I am honored to be teacher in this school.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Teacher'''</br>
'''Phillip:''' I run this school, there are other travelling teachers who we call [[Loremasters]].</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Loremaster'''</br>
'''Phillip:''' If you are lucky you'll meet one in your journeys.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''</br>
'''Phillip:''' My name is Phillip.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Time'''</br>
'''Phillip:''' It is 12:14 am.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Help'''</br>
'''Phillip:''' I will provide you with all knowledge I have.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Monster'''</br>
'''Phillip:''' Monsters come in different shape and power. It's said there is a zoo in the dwarfs' town.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Dungeon'''</br>
'''Phillip:''' Dungeons are places of danger and puzzles. In some of them a bright mind will serve you more then a blade.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Sewer'''</br>
''Mulher:'' '''Phillip:''' The sewers of Carlin are a disgusting place. Better never crawl around in these stinking tunnels.</br>
''Homem:'' '''Phillip:''' An interesting place you should consider to visit.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Thank you'''</br>
'''Phillip:''' You don't have to thank me, it's only my duty.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''God'''</br>
'''Phillip:''' To learn about gods, visit the temples and talk to the priests.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''King''' / '''Queen'''</br>
'''Phillip:''' The southern king is called Tibianus. He and our queen Eloise are in a constant struggle.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Rumour''' / '''Gossip''' / '''News'''</br>
'''Phillip:''' I don't like rumours.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Weapon'''</br>
'''Phillip:''' To learn about weapons read appropriate books or talk to the smiths.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Magic'''</br>
'''Phillip:''' To learn about magic talk to the guild leaders.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Rebellion'''</br>
'''Phillip:''' Rebellion? What for? We are contend with our situation.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''In tod we trust'''</br>
'''Phillip:''' Tod will come and save us all. He will bring freedom and beer to the men of Carlin.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Lugri'''</br>
'''Phillip:''' This servant of evil is protected by the dark gods and can't be harmed.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Ferumbras'''</br>
'''Phillip:''' He is a follower of evil. His powers were boosted by a sinister force and he is beyond human restrictions now.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Excalibug'''</br>
'''Phillip:''' This weapon is said to be very powerful and unique. It was hidden in ancient times and now is thought to be lost.
}}<noinclude>[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]</noinclude>

| subarea     = Carlin City
| location    = [[Carlin City]] ({{Mapa|32383,31780,7:2|aqui}}).
