''Jogador:'' '''Hail''' / '''Salutations''' / '''Hello''' / '''Hi'''</br>
'''Shauna:''' Howdy, ''Jogador''!</br>
''Jogador:'' <vaNish> / '''Bye'''</br>
'''Shauna:''' LONG LIVE THE QUEEN!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''News'''</br>
'''Shauna:''' No news are good news.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Queen''' / '''Leader'''</br>
'''Shauna:''' HAIL TO QUEEN ELOISE!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''</br>
'''Shauna:''' What do you think? I am the sheriff of Carlin.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''How Are You'''</br>
'''Shauna:''' Just fine.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Sell'''</br>
'''Shauna:''' Would you like to buy the general key to the town?</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''</br>
'''Shauna:''' Yeah, I bet you'd like to do that! HO, HO, HO!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Army''' / '''Guard'''</br>
'''Shauna:''' If they make trouble, I'll put them behind bars like all others.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''General''' / '''Bonecrusher'''</br>
'''Shauna:''' The Bonecrusher family is ideally suited for military jobs.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Enemies''' / '''Enemy''' / '''Criminal''' / '''Murderer'''</br>
'''Shauna:''' If you have a crime to report and clues, then do it, but dont waste my time.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Castle'''</br>
'''Shauna:''' The castle is one of the safest places in Carlin.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Subject'''</br>
'''Shauna:''' Our people are fine and peaceful.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Tbi'''</br>
'''Shauna:''' I bet they spy on us... not my business, however.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Todd'''</br>
'''Shauna:''' I scared this bigmouth so much that he left the town by night. HO, HO, HO!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''City'''</br>
'''Shauna:''' The city is is a peacful place, and it's up to me to keep it this way.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hain'''</br>
'''Shauna:''' He is the guy responsible to keep the sewers working. Someone has to do such kind of jobs. I can't handle all the garbage of the city myself.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Rowenna''' / '''Weapon'''</br>
'''Shauna:''' Rowenna is one of our local smiths. When you look for weapons, look for Rowenna.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Cornelia''' / '''Armor'''</br>
'''Shauna:''' Cornelia is one of our local smiths. When you look for armor, look for Cornelia.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Legola'''</br>
'''Shauna:''' She has the sharpest eye in the region, I'd say.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Padreia'''</br>
'''Shauna:''' Her peacefulness is sometimes near stupidity.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''God'''</br>
'''Shauna:''' I worship Banor of course.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Banor'''</br>
'''Shauna:''' For me, he's the god of justice.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Zathroth'''</br>
'''Shauna:''' His cult is forbidden in our town.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Brog'''</br>
'''Shauna:''' Wouldn't wonder if some males worship him secretly. HO, HO, HO!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Monster'''</br>
'''Shauna:''' I deal more with the human mosters, you know? HO, HO, HO!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Excalibug'''</br>
'''Shauna:''' Would certainly make a good butterknife. HO, HO, HO!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Rebellion'''</br>
'''Shauna:''' The only thing that rebels here now and then is the stomach of a male after trying to make illegal alcohol. HO, HO, HO!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Alcohol'''</br>
'''Shauna:''' For obvious reasons it's forbidden in our city.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Waterpipe''' / '''Pipe'''</br>
'''Shauna:''' Oh, there's a waterpipe in one of my cells? ...</br>
'''Shauna''': I guess my last prisoner forgot it there.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Prisoner'''</br>
'''Shauna:''' my last prisoner? hmm. ...</br>
'''Shauna:''' I think he was some guy from darama. can't remember his name. ...</br>
'''Shauna:''' He was here just for one night, because he got drunk and annoyed our citizens. ...</br>
'''Shauna:''' Obviously he wasn't pleased with this place, because he headed for thais the next day. ...</br>
'''Shauna:''' Something tells me that he won't stay out of trouble for too long.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Fuck''' / '''Idiot''' / '''Asshole''' / '''Ass''' / '''Fag''' / '''Stupid''' / '''Tyrant''' / '''Shit''' / '''Lunatic'''</br>
'''Shauna:''' Take this!
}}<noinclude>[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]</noinclude>

pages.title: Tibra
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}}
| name        = Tibra
| job         = Sacerdote
| city        = Carlin
| npcclass    = Humanos
| npcsprite   = Mage
| subarea     = Carlin City
| location    = [[Carlin City]] ({{Mapa|32314,31784,7:2|aqui}}).
| implemented = 5.1
| notes       = Tem grande conhecimentos dos Deuses. Ela também pode curar você caso esteja [[Poison|envenenado]], [[Fire|queimado]] ou [[Energy|eletrocutado]]. Você podoar 15 gps para ela.
| buysell     = não
| buys        = 
| sells       = 
| falas       = 
''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''</br>
'''Tibra:''' Welcome: in the name of the gods, pilgrim ''Jogador''!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''</br>
'''Tibra:''' I am a priest of the great pantheon.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Life'''</br>
'''Tibra:''' The teachings of Crunor tell us to honor life and not to harm it.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Mission''' / '''Quest'''</br>
'''Tibra:''' It is my mission to bring the teachings of the gods to everyone.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''</br>
'''Tibra:''' My name is Tibra. Your soul tells me that you are ''Jogador''.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Queen'''</br>
'''Tibra:''' Queen Eloise is wise to listen to the proposals of the druidic followers of Crunor.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Sell'''</br>
'''Tibra:''' The grace of the gods must be earned, it cannot be bought!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Tibia'''</br>
'''Tibra:''' The world of Tibia is the creation of the gods.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Time'''</br>
'''Tibra:''' Now, it is 11:51 pm.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Crypt'''</br>
'''Tibra:''' There's something strange in its neighbourhood. But whom we gonna call for help if not the gods?</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Help'''</br>
'''Tibra:''' You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I need my powers for cases more severe than yours.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Monsters'''</br>
'''Tibra:''' Remind: Not everything you call monster is evil to the core!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Excalibug'''</br>
'''Tibra:''' The mythical blade was hidden in ancient times. Its said that powerful wards protect it.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Ferumbras'''</br>
'''Tibra:''' The fallen one should be mourned, not feared.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Lugri'''</br>
'''Tibra:''' Only a man can fall as low as he did. His soul rotted away already.</br>
=== Sins ===
''Jogador:'' '''Sins'''</br>
'''Tibra:''' Do you wish to confess your sins, my child?</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''</br>
'''Tibra''': So tell me, what shadows your soul, my child.</br>
''Jogador:'' I killed a deer ''(ou o que quiser dizer)''</br>
'''Tibra''': Meditate on that and pray for your soul.</br>
=== Doação ===
''Jogador:'' '''Donation'''</br>
'''Tibra''': Do you want to make a donation?</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''</br>
'''Tibra:''' May the gods bless you!</br>
=== Deuses do Bem ===
''Jogador:'' '''Gods'''</br>
'''Tibra:''' The gods of good guard us and guide us, the gods of evil want to destroy us and steal our souls!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Gods of good'''</br>
'''Tibra:''' The gods we call the good ones are Fardos, Uman, the Elements, Suon, Crunor, Nornur, Bastesh, Kirok, Toth, and Banor.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Fardos'''</br>
'''Tibra:''' Fardos is the creator. The great obsever. He is our caretaker.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Uman'''</br>
'''Tibra:''' Uman is the positive aspect of magic. He brings us the secrets of the arcane arts.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Air'''</br>
'''Tibra:''' Air is one of the primal elemental forces, sometimes worshipped by tribal shamans.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Fire'''</br>
'''Tibra:''' Fire is one of the primal elemental forces, sometimes worshipped by tribal shamans.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Sula''' ''(não mencionados como Deus do bem)''</br>
'''Tibra:''' Sula is the essence of the elemental power of water.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Suon'''</br>
'''Tibra:''' Suon is the lifebringing sun. He observes the creation with love.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Crunor'''</br>
'''Tibra:''' Crunor, the great tree, is the father of all plantlife. He is a prominent god for many druids.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Nornur'''</br>
'''Tibra:''' Nornur is the mysterious god of fate. Who knows if he is its creator or just a chronist?</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Bastesh'''</br>
'''Tibra:''' Bastesh, the deep one, is the goddess of the sea and its creatures.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Kirok'''</br>
'''Tibra:''' Kirok, the mad one, is the god of scientists and jesters.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Toth'''</br>
'''Tibra:''' Toth, Lord of Death, is the keeper of the souls, the guardian of the afterlife.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Banor'''</br>
'''Tibra:''' Banor, the heavenly warrior, is the patron of all fighters against evil. He is the gift of the gods to inspire humanity.</br>
=== Deuses do Mal ===
''Jogador:'' '''Evil'''</br>
'''Tibra:''' The gods we call the evil ones are Zathroth, Fafnar, Brog, Urgith, and the Archdemons!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Zathroth'''</br>
'''Tibra:''' Zathroth is the destructive aspect of magic. He is the deciver and the thief of souls.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Fafnar'''</br>
'''Tibra:''' Fafnar is the scorching sun. She observes the creation with hate and jealousy.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Brog'''</br>
'''Tibra:''' Brog, the raging one, is the great destroyer. The berserk of darkness.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Urgith'''</br>
'''Tibra:''' The bonemaster Urgith is the lord of the undead and keeper of the damned souls.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Archdemons'''</br>
'''Tibra:''' The demons are followers of Zathroth. The cruelest are known as the ruthless seven.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Ruthless Seven'''</br>
'''Tibra:''' I dont want to talk about that subject!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''</br>
'''Tibra:''' Good bye, ''Jogador''. May the gods be with you to guard and guide you, my child!
}}<noinclude>[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]</noinclude>

<big>Antes do [[Updates/10.20|Update 10.20]].</big></br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' What is this? An optically challenged entity called ''Jogador''. How fascinating!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Death'''</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' Yes, yes, I will kill you soon enough, now let me continue my investigation on you.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''God'''</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' They will mourn the day they abandoned us.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' I am the great librarian.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Library'''</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' It's a fine library, isn't it?</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' I am 486486 and NOT 'Blinky' as some people called me ... before they died.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Tibia'''</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' It's 1, not 'Tibia', silly.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Cyclops'''</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' Uglyness incarnate. One eye! Imagine that! Horrible!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Elves'''</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' These fools and their superstitious life cult don't understand anything of importance.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Excalibug'''</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' Only inferior species need weapons.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Ab'Dendriel'''</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' I heard that elves moved in upstairs.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Numbers'''</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' Numbers are essential. They are the secret behind the scenes. If you are a master of mathematics you are a master over life and death.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Book'''</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' Our books are written in 469, of course you can't understand them.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''469'''</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' The language of my kind. Superior to any other language and only to be spoken by entities with enough eyes to blink it.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Orc'''</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' Noisy pests.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Minotaur'''</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' Their mages are so close to the truth. Closer then they know and closer then it's good for them.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Humans'''</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' Good tools to work with ... After their death, that is.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' Wait right there. I will eat you after writing down what I found out.</br>

<big>Após o [[Updates/10.20|Update 10.20]].</big></br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' What's this? An optically challenged entity called ''Jogador''. How fascinating!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Tibia'''</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' It's 1, not 'Tibia', silly.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Gods'''</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' They will mourn the day they abandoned us.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Ab'dendriel'''</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' I heard that elves moved in upstairs.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Death'''</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' Yes, yes, I'll kill you soon enough, now let me continue my investigations about you.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Library'''</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' It's a fine library, isn't it? All this knowledge! All those books!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Books'''</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' Our books are written in 469, of course you can't understand them.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''469'''</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' The language of my kind. Superior to any other language and only to be spoken by entities with enough eyes to blink it.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Language'''</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' Our language is beyond comprehension by your lesser beings. It heavily relies on mathemagic ...</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' Your brain is not suited for the mathemagical processing necessary to understand our language ...</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' To decipher even our most basic texts, it would need a genius that can calculate numbers within seconds in his brain.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Our'''</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' The world is full of inferior species. Once, our race ruled the whole world, but then the gods destroyed our empire ...</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' But our race is proficient in the return from death. One day we will rise again, that's for sure!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Numbers'''</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' Numbers are essential. They are the secret behind the scenes. If you are a master of mathematics, you are a master over life and death.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' I'm 486486 and NOT 'Blinky' as some people called me ... before they died. So don't ... confuse your numbers, as my kind says.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' I'm the great librarian of this library of a once great city.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Librarian'''</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' So much knowledge was lost in the great wars when we had to retreat to hidden places beneath the surface ...</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' Most of our data storages are lost and so are the means to read or recreate some of them ...</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' We had to use the primitive storage form of books to recreate some of the lost knowledge. In the past, we used far more advanced forms of storage ...</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' Such as bound spirits but also means your puny brain would never be able to comprehend.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''City'''</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' This city is nothing but a pale shadow compared to the cities of the past. Our race was forced to retreat to such insignificant underground outposts after the wars.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Wars'''</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' Our race has fought many wars in the past and has won most of them. Sometimes, though, it takes only one loss to bring a race down ...</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' All the more if the gods you are fighting for, turn out to be traitors.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Cyclops'''</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' Ugliness incarnated. Only one eye! Imagine that! How horrible!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Elves'''</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' These fools and their superstitious life cult don't understand anything of importance.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Excalibug'''</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' Only inferior species need weapons.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Ab'dendriel'''</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' I heard that elves moved in upstairs.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Orcs'''</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' Noisy pests.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Minotaurs'''</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' Their mages are so close to the truth. Closer than they know and closer than it's good for them.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Humans'''</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' Good tools to work with ... once they are dead, that is.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Blinky'''</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' Interesting how foolish you are. Take this and see how long you'll last.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Bonelord'''</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' Our race is very old. Over the time, we have been given many different names by other races ...</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' The term bonelord sticks to us for quite a while now ...</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' In our language the name of our race is not fixed but a complex formula, and as such it always changes for the subjective viewer.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''0'''</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' Go and wash your eyes for using this obscene number!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''</br>
'''A Wrinkled Bonelord:''' Wait right there. I'll eat you right after writing down what I found out.
}}<noinclude>[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]</noinclude>

pages.title: Amber
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Amber | job = Viajante | npcclass = Humanos | npcsprite = Citizen | city = Thais | subarea = Rookgaard | location = [[Rookgaard]] ({{Mapa|32101,32185,8:2|aqui}}). | implemented = Pré-6.0 | notes = Amber veio para Rookgaard de Mainland a fim de ajudar os jogadores mais inexperientes a encontrarem sua própria aventura.
Ela é uma das poucas pessoas que dominaram a [[Orc Language|língua dos Orcs]], porque ficou alguns meses presa com eles, e está disposta a ensiná-lo em troca de seu alimento preferido.
Ela deixou sua jangada na costa sudeste da ilha e esqueceu seu diário "[[Amber's Notebook (Book)|Amber's Notebook]]" lá.

* Ela pode ensinar algumas palavras da [[Orc Language]] a cada [[Salmon]] que você der a ela. [[Salmon]]s podem ser encontrados na [[Captain Iglues Treasure Quest]]. * Você pode trocar com ela um [[Amber's Notebook (Book)|Amber's Notebook]], obtida na [[Short Sword Quest]], por uma [[Short Sword]]. * Faz parte da [[Citizen Outfits Quest on Rook]].

| buysell = não | buys = | sells = | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Amber:''' Oh hello, nice to see you ''Jogador''.
''Jogador:'' '''How are you?'''
'''Amber:''' I'm recovering from a sea passage.
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
'''Amber:''' I'm an explorer who seeks adventures.
''Jogador:'' '''Adventure'''
'''Amber:''' I fought fierce monsters, climbed the highest mountains, explored the deepest dungeons and crossed the sea on a raft.
''Jogador:'' '''Sea'''
'''Amber:''' My voyage on the sea was exhausting. The weather was bad, the waves high and my raft quite simple. There's a certain excitement to it, though.
''Jogador:'' '''Explore'''
'''Amber:''' I've been almost everywhere in Tibia.
''Jogador:'' '''Tibia'''
'''Amber:''' I'm trying to explore each spot of Tibia, and one day I'll have seen it all.
''Jogador:'' '''Time'''
'''Amber:''' Sorry, I lost my watch in a storm.
''Jogador:'' '''Dungeon'''
'''Amber:''' I had no time to explore the dungeons of this isle yet, but I've seen two big caves in the East, and there is a ruined tower to the north-west. Oh, and there're the sewers.
''Jogador:'' '''Sewer'''
'''Amber:''' I like sewers. I made my very first battle experience in the sewers below Thais. The small sewer system of Rookgaard has some nasty rats to fight.
''Jogador:'' '''King'''
'''Amber:''' King Tibianus is the ruler of Thais. The island of Rookgaard belongs to his kingdom.
''Jogador:'' '''Rookgaard'''
'''Amber:''' It's a nice little island on which you can learn how to fight. I can see it in your eyes - you want to become a famous adventurer and explorer just like me!
''Jogador:'' '''Academy'''
'''Amber:''' A fine institution, but it needs definitely more funds from the king.
''Jogador:'' '''Help''' ou '''information'''
'''Amber:''' Well, I can give you general hints or tell you about my adventures and many other topics. Oh, and if you are bored, I might have a small quest for you.
''Jogador:'' '''Destiny'''
'''Amber:''' You will find your destiny. I'm sure it's something big and important.
''Jogador:'' '''Thais'''
'''Amber:''' A fine city, but the king has some problems enforcing the law.
''Jogador:'' '''Main'''
'''Amber:''' You'll be surprised once you leave this island. The world outside there is gigantic.
''Jogador:'' '''Castle'''
'''Amber:''' If you travel to Thais, you really should visit the marvellous castle there.
''Jogador:'' '''Magic'''
'''Amber:''' Spells are only taught in the guildhalls of the mainland.
''Jogador:'' '''Weapon'''
'''Amber:''' The best weapons on this isle are just toothpicks, compared with the weapons warriors of the mainland wield.
''Jogador:'' '''Monsters'''
'''Amber:''' Oh, I fought orcs, cyclopses, minotaurs, even dragons, and many other creatures.
''Jogador:'' '''Orcs'''
'''Amber:''' Not the nicest guys you can encounter. I had some clashes with them and finally ended up being their prisoner for a few months.
''Jogador:'' '''Cyclops'''
'''Amber:''' I don't like the way they look at you. Their eye seems to pierce right through you. Creepy!
''Jogador:'' '''Minotaur'''
'''Amber:''' They are nasty monsters, particularly as they have distance fighters and mages in their clans. My backpack is handmade from minotaur leather.
''Jogador:'' '''Dragon'''
'''Amber:''' Their breath is so hot! I had to cut my hair after my last encounter with a dragon because the ends were all burnt. That's what you gotta deal with as a female adventurer!
''Jogador:'' '''Premium'''
'''Amber:''' I wouldn't want to miss being a premium adventurer. Everything is so much easier!
''Jogador:'' '''Bank'''
'''Amber:''' I have almost no money with me anyway, so no need to deposit any at the bank.
''Jogador:'' '''Orcish''' ou '''prisoner'''
'''Amber:''' I speak some Orcish words, not many though, just a few basics like 'yes' and 'no'.
''Jogador:'' '''Yes (após orcish ou prisoner)'''
'''Amber:''' It's 'mok' in Orcish. I tell you more if you bring me some food.
''Jogador:'' '''No (após orcish ou prisoner)'''
'''Amber:''' In Orcish that's 'burp'. I tell you more if you bring me some food.
''Jogador:'' '''Food'''
'''Amber:''' My favourite dish is salmon. Oh please, bring me some.
''Jogador:'' '''Salmon'''
'''Amber:''' Yeah! If you give me some salmon, I'll tell you another Orcish word. Okay?
''Jogador:'' '''No (após salmon)'''
'''Amber:''' Ok, then I won't tell you another Orcish word.
''Jogador:'' '''Yes (após salmon - sem salmon)'''
'''Amber:''' You don't have any salmon!
''Jogador:'' '''Tools'''
'''Amber:''' The most important tools you need are a rope, a shovel and maybe a torch.
''Jogador:'' '''Rope'''
'''Amber:''' One day I fell into a hole without having a rope. I was yelling for help for three whole days! Eventually a fisherman passed by and pulled me out with his own rope, lucky me.
''Jogador:'' '''Shovel'''
'''Amber:''' Sometimes I have the strong urge to use it to knock someone out.
''Jogador:'' '''Torch'''
'''Amber:''' You know, on mainland you will be able to cast magic spells which provide you with light. You won't really need torches anymore.
''Jogador:'' '''Weapon'''
'''Amber:''' The best weapons on this isle are just toothpicks compared with the weapons warriors wield on the mainland.
''Jogador:'' '''Raft''' or '''mission''' or '''quest'''
'''Amber:''' I left my raft at the south-eastern shore. I forgot my private notebook on it. If you could return it to me, I would be very grateful.
''Jogador:'' '''Notebook'''
'''Amber:''' Do you bring me my notebook?
''Jogador:'' '''No (após notebook)'''
'''Amber:''' Too bad.
''Jogador:'' '''Yes (após book - sem notebook)'''
'''Amber:''' Mhm, whatever you have there, it is not my notebook.
''Jogador:'' '''Al Dee'''
'''Amber:''' I don't have much to say about him. I think he sells tools.
''Jogador:'' '''Amber'''
'''Amber:''' Did you know my name is also the name of a gem?
''Jogador:'' '''Billy'''
'''Amber:''' He brought me some of his famous rat stew. I really didn't want to insult him, but I simply can't eat something like that. So I told him I'm a vegetarian and I only eat fish.
''Jogador:'' '''Cipfried'''
'''Amber:''' A gentle person. You should visit him if you have questions or need healing.
''Jogador:'' '''Dallheim'''
'''Amber:''' An extraordinary warrior. He's the first and last line of defence of Rookgaard.
''Jogador:'' '''Dixi'''
'''Amber:''' I don't really know her, but she seems to be a nice girl.
''Jogador:'' '''Hyacinth'''
'''Amber:''' Hyacinth is a great healer. He lives somewhere hidden on this isle.
''Jogador:'' '''Lily'''
'''Amber:''' Hm, I think I haven't met her yet.
''Jogador:'' '''Loui'''
'''Amber:''' Never seen him around.
''Jogador:'' '''Norma'''
'''Amber:''' She has changed a lot since I last saw her.
''Jogador:'' '''Obi'''
'''Amber:''' He's a funny little man.
''Jogador:'' '''Paulie'''
'''Amber:''' No, I didn't go to the bank yet.
''Jogador:'' '''Santiago'''
'''Amber:''' He promised to repair my raft.
''Jogador:'' '''Seymour'''
'''Amber:''' I think this poor guy was a bad choice as head of the academy.
''Jogador:'' '''The Oracle'''
'''Amber:''' The oracle is said to show you your destiny once you are level 8.
''Jogador:'' '''Tom'''
'''Amber:''' To me he seems a bit rude, but maybe that's just my impression.
''Jogador:'' '''Willie'''
'''Amber:''' He's funny in his own way.
''Jogador:'' '''Zerbrus'''
'''Amber:''' An extraordinary warrior. He's the first and last line of defence of Rookgaard.
''Jogador:'' '''Zirella'''
'''Amber:''' She seriously asked me if she could have the remains of my raft as fire wood! Can you imagine that??
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
'''Amber:''' See you later, ''Jogador''.
}}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.title: King Tibianus
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = King Tibianus | job = Rei | city = Thais | subarea = Thais City | location = [[Thais City]] ({{Mapa|32311,32170,6:2|aqui}}). | implemented = Pré-6.0 | notes = King Tibianus é o rei de Thais e tem o poder de promover aventureiros dignos. Cumprimente-o falando "Hail King" ou então ele irá ignorá-lo. Se você o xingar, seus guardas irão te atacar, te deixando com 1 ponto de vida. Seu cachorro Noodles, é reconhecido como o melhor cão farejador do reino.

* Faz parte da [[The New Frontier Quest]]. * Faz parte da Mini World Change [[Mini_World_Changes#Noodles_is_Gone|Noodles is Gone]]. * Faz parte da Mini World Change [[Mini_World_Changes#Thais_Kingsday|Thais Kingsday]]. :[[Arquivo:Achievement.gif|link=]] Ao falar "Hail King" para o King Tibianus durante esta Mini World Change, você receberá o achievement '''"{{Achievement|Loyal Subject}}"'''.

| buysell = sim | buys = Nada. | sells =
Outfit {{{!}} style="border-collapse: collapse; width:100%; border-color: #A7D7F9;" border="1" cellpadding="2" {{!}}- bgcolor="#CEDFF2" !style="text-align:center;width:185px"{{!}}Item !style="text-align:center;width:105px"{{!}}Valor {{!}}- {{!}}[[Golden_Outfits_Quest#Outfit|Golden Outfit]] {{!}}style=" background-color:#9eff8e; font-weight: bold;color:#000; line-height:100%; text-align:right"{{!}}500 000 000 [[gp]]s {{!}}- {{!}}[[Golden_Outfits_Quest#Addon_1|Golden Outfit Addon 1]] {{!}}style=" background-color:#9eff8e; font-weight: bold;color:#000; line-height:100%; text-align:right"{{!}}250 000 000 [[gp]]s {{!}}- {{!}}[[Golden_Outfits_Quest#Addon_2|Golden Outfit Addon 2]] {{!}}style=" background-color:#9eff8e; font-weight: bold;color:#000; line-height:100%; text-align:right"{{!}}250 000 000 [[gp]]s {{!}}} Promotions {{Trades/Sell | Vocation Promotion}} | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hail King!'''
'''King Tibianus:''' I greet thee, my loyal subject.'''
'''Stutch:''' HAIL TO THE KING!
'''Harsky:''' HAIL TO THE KING!
''Jogador:'' '''Enemies'''
'''King Tibianus:''' Our enemies are numerous. The evil minotaurs, Ferumbras, and the renegade city of Carlin to the north are just some of them.
''Jogador:'' '''Gods'''
'''King Tibianus:''' Honor the gods and pay your taxes.
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
'''King Tibianus:''' I am your sovereign, King Tibianus III, and its my duty to provide justice and guidance for my subjects.
''Jogador:'' '''King'''
'''King Tibianus:''' I am the king, so mind your words!
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''
'''King Tibianus:''' It's hard to believe that you don't know your own king!
''Jogador:'' '''Mission''' / '''Quest'''
'''King Tibianus:''' I will call for heroes as soon as the need arises again and then reward them appropriately.
''Jogador:'' '''Sell'''
'''King Tibianus:''' Sell? Sell what? My kingdom isn't for sale!
''Jogador:'' '''TBI'''
'''King Tibianus:''' This organisation is important in holding our enemies in check. Its headquarter is located in the bastion in the northwall.
''Jogador:'' '''Tibia'''
'''King Tibianus:''' Soon the whole land will be ruled by me once again!
''Jogador:'' '''Time'''
'''King Tibianus:''' It's a time for heroes, that's for sure!
''Jogador:'' '''Noodles''' / '''Treasure'''
'''King Tibianus:''' The royal poodle Noodles is my greatest treasure!
''Jogador:'' '''Castle'''
'''King Tibianus:''' Rain Castle is my home.
''Jogador:'' '''Dungeon'''
'''King Tibianus:''' Dungeons are no places for kings.
''Jogador:'' '''Druids'''
'''King Tibianus:''' We need the druidic healing powers to fight evil.
''Jogador:'' '''Sorcerers'''
'''King Tibianus:''' The magic of the sorcerers is a powerful tool to smite our enemies.
''Jogador:'' '''Paladins'''
'''King Tibianus:''' The paladins are great protectors for Thais.
''Jogador:'' '''Knights'''
'''King Tibianus:''' The brave knights are necessary for human survival in Thais.
''Jogador:'' '''Heroes'''
'''King Tibianus:''' It's a time for heroes, that's for sure!
''Jogador:'' '''Monsters'''
'''King Tibianus:''' Go and hunt them! For king and country!
''Jogador:'' '''Excalibug'''
'''King Tibianus:''' It's the sword of the kings. If you could return this weapon to me I would reward you beyond your dreams.
''Jogador:'' '''Ferumbras'''
'''King Tibianus:''' He is a follower of the evil god Zathroth and responsible for many attacks on us. Kill him on sight!
''Jogador:'' '''Order'''
'''King Tibianus:''' We need order to survive!
''Jogador:'' '''Zathroth'''
'''King Tibianus:''' Please ask a priest about the gods.
''Jogador:'' '''Carlin'''
'''King Tibianus:''' They dare to reject my reign over the whole continent!
''Jogador:'' '''Eremo'''
'''King Tibianus:''' It is said that he lives on a small island near Edron. Maybe the people there know more about him.
''Jogador:'' '''Thais'''
'''King Tibianus:''' Our beloved city has some fine shops, guildhouses, and a modern sytem of sewers.
''Jogador:'' '''Sewers'''
'''King Tibianus:''' What a disgusting topic!
''Jogador:'' '''Shops'''
'''King Tibianus:''' Visit the shops of our merchants and craftsmen.
''Jogador:'' '''Guilds'''
'''King Tibianus:''' The four major guilds are the knights, the paladins, the druids, and the sorcerers.
''Jogador:'' '''Merchants'''
'''King Tibianus:''' Ask around about them.
''Jogador:'' '''Harkath Bloodblade''' / '''General'''
'''King Tibianus:''' Harkath Bloodblade is the general of our glorious army.
''Jogador:'' '''Army'''
'''King Tibianus:''' Ask the soldiers about that topic.
''Jogador:'' '''Evil'''
'''King Tibianus:''' We need all strength we can muster to smite evil!
''Jogador:'' '''Minotaurs'''
'''King Tibianus:''' Vile monsters, but I must admit they are strong and sometimes even cunning ... in their own bestial way.
''Jogador:'' '''Taxes'''
'''King Tibianus:''' To pay your taxes, visit the royal tax collector.
''Jogador:'' '''Royal tax collector'''
'''King Tibianus:''' He has been lazy lately. I bet you have not payed any taxes at all.
''Jogador:'' '''Reward'''
'''King Tibianus:''' Well, if you want a reward, go on a quest to bring me Excalibug!
''Jogador:'' '''Benjamin'''
'''King Tibianus:''' He was once my greatest general. Now he is very old and senile but we entrusted him with work for the Royal Tibia Mail.
''Jogador:'' '''Bozo'''
'''King Tibianus:''' He is my royal jester and cheers me up now and then.
''Jogador:'' '''Chester'''
'''King Tibianus:''' A very competent person. A little nervous but very competent.
''Jogador:'' '''Elane'''
'''King Tibianus:''' The paladins are great protectors for Thais.
''Jogador:'' '''Frodo'''
'''King Tibianus:''' He is the owner of Frodo's Hut and a faithful tax-payer.
''Jogador:'' '''Gorn'''
'''King Tibianus:''' He was once one of Tibia's greatest fighters. Now he is selling equipment.
''Jogador:'' '''Gregor'''
'''King Tibianus:''' The brave knights are necessary for human survival in Thais.
''Jogador:'' '''Muriel'''
'''King Tibianus:''' The magic of the sorcerers is a powerful tool to smite our enemies.
''Jogador:'' '''Sam'''
'''King Tibianus:''' He is a skilled blacksmith and a loyal subject.
''Jogador:'' '''Falcon'''
'''King Tibianus:''' As a young prince I have heard high tales of the Order of the Falcon. It was a topic in history lessons as well. As far as I know, their significance faded after a dispute with my father King Xenom. ...
'''King Tibianus:''' Their stronghold to the north is still largely intact and we left it alone for the most part. People tend to avoid it as the Order's disappearance was never truly solved.
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
'''King Tibianus:''' Good bye, ''Jogador''!
'''Stutch:''' LONG LIVE THE KING! You may leave now!
'''Harsky:''' LONG LIVE THE KING! You may leave now! }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}}
| name        = Partos
| job         = Criminoso
| city        = Thais
| subarea     = Thais City
| location    = [[Thais City]] ({{Mapa|32324,32280,8:2|aqui}}).
| implemented = Pré-6.0
| notes       = Partos é um ladrão que foi capturado. Ele possui algumas informações valiosas e supostamente possui [[The Djinn War Quest|relações]] em Ankrahmun.
| buysell     = sim
| buys        = {{Trades/Buy
| Broken Key Ring}}
| sells       = Nada.
| falas       = __NOTOC__
== Frases Espontâneas ==
Não possui.

== Palavras-Chave ==
''Jogador'': '''hi'''</br>
'''Partos''': Welcome to my little kingdom, ''Jogador''.

''Jogador'': '''name'''</br>
'''Partos''': My name is Partos, but you can call me Party.

''Jogador'': '''job'''</br>
'''Partos''': Guess it! I’ll give you a hint: I am not in this cell to clean it up! …</br>
'''Partos''': I wish I had never left Ankrahmun…

''Jogador'': '''ankrahmun'''</br>
'''Partos''': Yes, I’ve lived in Ankrahmun for quite some time. Ahh, the good old times! …</br>
'''Partos''': Unfortunately I had to relocate. <sigh> …</br>
'''Partos''': Business reasons – you know.

''Jogador'': '''time'''</br>
'''Partos''': Geee, someone stole my watch. Bad company down here.

''Jogador'': '''how are you'''</br>
'''Partos''': I am great! Free food, free room, and now and then someone coming down here to ask me silly questions. Wouldn’t you love that, too?

''Jogador'': '''baa’leal''' / '''djinns''' / '''mal’ouquah''' / '''supplies'''</br>
'''Partos''': I won’t talk about that.

''Jogador'': '''army'''</br>
'''Partos''': Bah, the king’s pawns. I spit on them.

''Jogador'': '''gold''' / '''money'''</br>
'''Partos''': Gold got me in here. But I’d offer you some gold for keys.

''Jogador'': '''thais''' / '''city'''</br>
'''Partos''': I love the city. I just wish I could see some other part of it now and then.

''Jogador'': '''prison''' / '''jail''' / '''cell'''</br>
'''Partos''': You mean this is a JAIL? They told me it’s the finest hotel in town! THAT explains the lousy room service!

''Jogador'': '''citizen'''</br>
'''Partos''': Rich enough to spare a little, don’t you agree? Well, they didn’t agree.

''Jogador'': '''key'''</br>
'''Partos''': I sort of collect them. Broken key rings, that is. You never know. If you wanna trade, you know where to find me.

''Jogador'': '''criminal'''</br>
'''Partos''': Bah, I did nothing serious. I just had a little fun. In Ankrahmun nobody would have cared about these kind of things…

''Jogador'': '''slay''' / '''fight'''</br>
'''Partos''': Hey, most people I killed were even worse than me.

''Jogador'': '''noodles'''</br>
'''Partos''': I bet one could get some fine ransom, if he dognaps this furball.

''Jogador'': '''sell'''</br>
'''Partos''': I would like to sell you a secret, but I’m out of business for too long.

''Jogador'': '''monster'''</br>
'''Partos''': At least I am safe from them down here.

''Jogador'': '''news'''</br>
'''Partos''': I hardly hear any news down here.

''Jogador'': '''quentin'''</br>
'''Partos''': By the gods, he visits us ‘criminals’ now and then to ‘save’ us. Who is going to save me from this boredom on two legs?

''Jogador'': '''trade'''</br>
'''Partos''': I collect broken key rings. Just an old habit of mine.

''Jogador'': '''party'''</br>
'''Partos''': Yeah! Come in and let’s have a party.

''Jogador'': '''king'''</br>
'''Partos''': Yeah, a king is a man that can rob people by law, and not by night like me.

''Jogador'': '''god'''</br>
'''Partos''': The gods seldom show up down here, so don’t ask me.

''Jogador'': '''eclesius'''</br>
'''Partos''': Yeah sure, I go out with him all the time… NOT.

''Jogador'': '''bye'''</br>
'''Partos''': Good bye, visit me again, ''Jogador''. I will be here, promised.
}}

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}}
| name        = Todd
| job         = Viajante
| city        = Thais
| subarea     = Thais City
| location    = [[Thais City]] ({{Mapa|32362,32210,6:2|aqui}}).
| implemented = Pré-6.0
| notes       = Todd é um viajante que bebeu demais e queixa-se de dor de cabeça. Ele parece ser independente e rico, pois ele alugou a sala acima da loja do Frodo já faz algum tempo. Inquéritos dizem que existe outro Todd que pode estar em Venore. Karl, na caverna secreta de Carlin, em resposta à palavra-chave "Todd" diz que ele é "um verdadeiro combatente pelos homens". Shauna diz que assustou tanto ele, que ele deixou a cidade durante a noite. Karl também diz que deu todo seu dinheiro da resistência contra a tirania das mulheres para Todd - isto explica porque ele é tão rico.
| buysell     = sim
| buys        = {{Trades/Buy
| Small Notebook
| Scroll of Heroic Deeds}}
| sells       = Nada.
| falas       = 
''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''</br>
'''Todd:''' Uhm oh hello... not so loud please... my head...</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''</br>
'''Todd:''' I am... a traveler.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''</br>
'''Todd:''' My Name? I am To... ahm... hum... My name is Hugo.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Todd'''</br>
'''Todd:''' Uh .. I... I met a Todd on the road. He told me he was traveling to Venore, look there for your Todd.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hugo'''</br>
'''Todd:''' Yes, that's my name of course.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Thais'''</br>
'''Todd:''' I love that city.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Carlin'''</br>
'''Todd:''' I never was there. Now leave me alone.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Karl'''</br>
'''Todd:''' Uhm, never heard about him... and you can't prove otherwise.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Money'''</br>
'''Todd:''' I don't know anything about money, missing or not.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Resistance'''</br>
'''Todd:''' Resistance is futile... uhm... I wonder where I picked that saying up. Oh my head...</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Head'''</br>
'''Todd:''' Uhhh ohhhh one of the beers yesterday must have been bad.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Smuggler'''</br>
'''Todd:''' I am a honest person and don't like to be insulted!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''William'''</br>
'''Todd:''' Thats a common name, perhaps I met a William, not sure about that.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Eclesius'''</br>
'''Todd:''' He often comes here. But his constant confusion gives me a worse headache than Frodo's beer. I rather avoid him.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Trade / Interesting'''</br>
'''Todd:''' I'd really like to rebuild my reputation someday and maybe find a nice girl. If you come across scrolls of heroic deeds or addresses of lovely maidens... let me know! ...</br>
'''Todd:''' Oh no, it doesn't matter what name is on the scrolls. I'm, uhm... flexible! And money - yes, I can pay. My, erm... uncle died recently and left me a pretty sum. Yes.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''How are you'''</br>
'''Todd:''' Oh, this headache, one of the beers Frodo served me must have been foul.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''</br>
'''Todd:''' Yes, goodbye ''Jogador'', just leave me alone.
}}<noinclude>[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]</noinclude>

pages.title: Wally
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Wally | job = Carteiro | city = Kazordoon | subarea = Kazordoon | location = [[Tibian Mail Post Office Headquarters|Tibian Mail Post Office]] ({{mapa|32566,32019,7:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 7.3 | notes =

* Após completar a [[The Postman Missions Quest]], os [[Parcel]]s custarão somente 10 [[gp]]s e [[Letter]]s somente 05 [[gp]]s.

| buysell = sim | buys = Nada. | sells = {{Trades/Sell | Label | Letter | Parcel}} | falas = (nota: palavras sublinhadas são erros de ortografia e pode ser corrigida pela Cipsoft) ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
Wally: Be greeted, traveller.
''Jogador'': '''job'''
Wally: I am working here at the post office for Kevin.
''Jogador'': '''Kevin'''
Wally: Oh, our boss is upstairs. Better only disturb him with important issues though.
''Jogador'': '''mission'''
Wally: Ask Mr. Postner about your current missions.
''Jogador'': '''name'''
Wally: I'm Wally the post officer.
''Jogador'': '''Wally'''
Wally: Yes, thats me, Wally!
''Jogador'': '''elven'''
Wally: Elven volunteers for becoming a postofficer are quite rare. We had to rely on a human living there to ensure our postsystems function. Most elvish members of the guild prefer to work as courriers.
''Jogador'': '''Edron'''
Wally: I gues Edron isn't the source of wealth and rescources as the thaians hoped. The defection of those knights did cause the expansion and exploitation there to an halt.
''Jogador'': '''dwarfs''' ou '''Kazordoon'''
Wally: The city of the dwarfs is a bit hidden and new postoficers often get lost while looking for it. Just look for a hidden passage to a western valley in the mountaion called the big old one.
''Jogador'': '''The Big Old One'''
Wally: Its a huge Mountain, north of here, just across the river.
''Jogador'': '''Thais'''
Wally: One of the oldest holdings of humanity that still exist and the heart of the biggest kingdom in the known world.
''Jogador'': '''Venore'''
Wally: I think no longer is king Tibianus reigning this city, nor are the merchants ruling it, regardless what they might think. The true monarch before whom all there bow is the money.
''Jogador'': '''bones'''
Wally: If I would be looking for bones I'd inspect some skeletons ... If I weren't so affraid of them that is.
''Jogador'': '''Markwin'''
Wally: This minotaur is quite moody. Better make sure not to anger him. He's likely to call for his guards as soon as he notices a stranger, so you are on tough luck if you ever find him.
''Jogador'': '''Noodles'''
Wally: This dog is his majestys most priced possesion and heavily guarded. Anger the dog and you anger the king.
''Jogador'': '''Benjamin'''
Wally: Old Ben lost some of his marbles in some battle long ago. He is still a quite capable postman though ... on second thought thats some disturbing fact.
''Jogador'': '''Dove'''
Wally: Dove is as good as a dozend pigeons. He He He.
''Jogador'': '''Liane'''
Wally: Although I never met her in person we became penpals over the time.
''Jogador'': '''Lokur'''
Wally: Dwarfs make quite good postmen. They are stubborn, strong and ... sturdy. Its a waste that he prefers a job behind the counter.
''Jogador'': '''Olrik'''
Wally: This Olrik was made postman only for convenience. He is quite aware that his attitude and affiliation with the thaian government makes it impossible for him to rise in rank. This leads only to him behaving even worse tough.
''Jogador'': '''Waldo'''
Wally: Waldo is an explorer. We always feared he might one day take a risk too great for him. I hope he is okay, though.
''Jogador'': '''bye'''
Wally: It was a pleasure to help you.
}} [[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

'''Ulrik''': Weapons and armors for young knights. Come have a look.

== Frases Espontâneas ==
'''Tokel''': Are you hungry? I offer bread, cheese, ham and meat. Perfect for a little snack.

== Palavras-Chave ==
''Jogador'': '''hi'''</br>
'''Tokel''': Hi there, ''Jogador''. You look quite hungry, maybe you should buy some food.

''Jogador'': '''name'''</br>
'''Tokel''': My name is Tokel.

''Jogador'': '''job'''</br>
'''Tokel''': I am a farmer, and proud of it.

''Jogador'': '''food''' / '''offer''' / '''buy'''</br>
'''Tokel''': I can offer you bread, cheese, ham, or meat. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a trade.

''Jogador'': '''how are you'''</br>
'''Tokel''': I am fine, thank you.

''Jogador'': '''god'''</br>
'''Tokel''': I pray to Crunor to bless our harvests.

''Jogador'': '''king'''</br>
'''Tokel''': I wish I'd be as rich as him.

''Jogador'': '''magic'''</br>
'''Tokel''': I know nothing but about such stuff.

''Jogador'': '''spell'''</br>
'''Tokel''': I know nothing but about such stuff.

''Jogador'': '''weapon'''</br>
'''Tokel''': I know nothing but about such stuff.

''Jogador'': '''dungeons'''</br>
'''Tokel''': Here are no dungeons as far as I know.

''Jogador'': '''monsters'''</br>
'''Tokel''': It's relatively peaceful here.

''Jogador'': '''greenshore'''</br>
'''Tokel''': The soil is a bit dry and there are a lot of stones. It's very hard to work this soil.

''Jogador'': '''tibia'''</br>
'''Tokel''': I have not seen much of it yet. I am thinking about moving to Edron soon.

''Jogador'': '''edron'''</br>
'''Tokel''': They say life is easy there, the soil is rich, the city save. One day I might move there.

''Jogador'': '''thais'''</br>
'''Tokel''': The city is too lousy and crowded for my taste.

''Jogador'': '''time''' ''(o NPC vai encerrar a conversa)''</br>
'''Tokel''': Oh, now that you mention it: I have much left to do, please excuse me.

''Jogador'': '''bye'''</br>
'''Tokel''': Bye.
}}

pages.title: Aruda
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Aruda | job = Criminoso | npcclass = Humanos | npcsprite = Nobleman | city = Thais | subarea = Thais City | location = [[Thais City]] ({{Mapa|32364,32215,7:2|aqui}}). | implemented = Pré-6.0 | buysell = não | buys = | sells = | notes = Aruda é uma jovem astuta que perambula por [[Thais]]. Ela atrai rapazes para si para poder roubá-los. Todas as pessoas devem tomar cuidado, pois assim que você falar com ela, ela rapidamente pegará seu [[gp|dinheiro]] e fugirá. Observe a semelhança do nome dela com a palavra "rude". Alguns rumores sugerem que ela pode ser uma poderosa usuária de magia.
Segundo Oswald, ela era namorada de [[Partos]], que também é ladrão.
Quando ela diz "Oh, sorry, I was distracted, what did you say?" ("Me desculpe, eu estava distraída, o que você disse?"), significa que ela roubou dinheiro de você (até 10 [[gp]]). Se você não estiver com dinheiro algum ou chama-la de ladra, ela irá dizer "Oh, I just remember I have some work to do, sorry. Bye!" ("Eu acabo de lembrar que tenho trabalho a fazer, desculpe. Adeus!") e vai embora.
Se você disser "Time" (Hora) e olhar para o relógio, ela o roubará da sua mochila.
Aruda supostamente foi responsável por ter roubado o ex membro da Sociedade dos Exploradores, [[Ratha]]. '''Aviso: Tenha cuidado! Se Aruda estiver perto (dentro de 4 quadrados) de um NPC e você disser oi, ela ainda roubará seu ouro!''' }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Bozo | job = Bobo da Corte | npcclass = Humanos | npcsprite = Jester | city = Thais | subarea = Thais City | location = [[Thais City]] ({{Mapa|32313,32182,7:2|aqui}}). | implemented = Pré-6.0 | notes = Bozo conta piadas engraçadas sobre muitas criaturas e tem interessantes comentários sobre seus amigos de Thais. Embora seu trabalho é ser o bobo real, quando perguntado, ele mente que é um cobrador de taxas e pergunta se você gostaria de pagar as suas taxas. Em Rookgaard você pode encontrar um túmulo do ''Palhaço Bozo e Artista Escapado''. O seu túmulo pode ser aberto e leva a uma caverna com skeletons, e a placa ''Maze of Fury'' perto de um túnel desabado. Bozo é uma clara alusão ao [[Wikipédia:Bozo|Bozo, o Palhaço]], geralmente encurtado para "Bozo" na vida real. | buysell = sim | buys = Nada. | sells =
* Quando perguntado sobre armas, ele tentará lhe vender uma "[[Mace of the Fury]]" (na verdade um [[Rolling Pin]], por 250 [[gp]]s). * Quando perguntado sobre magias, ele pergunta se você gostaria de aprender a magia "Lessen Your Load" ("Dinheiro Perdido") por 200 [[gp]]s e não lhe dará nada. | falas =

Mace of the Fury

''Jogador:'' '''Sell'''
'''Bozo:''' Sell? Hmm, I know a little about magic and by chance I can sell you a truly unusual weapon.
''Jogador:'' '''Weapon'''
'''Bozo:''' Do you want to buy a 'mace of the fury' for 250 gold?
''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''
'''Bozo:''' And here it is, it suits you well!
''You see a rolling pin.
''It weighs 5.00 oz.''

Pague suas taxas

''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
'''Bozo:''' I am the royal jes ... uhm ... the royal tax-collector! Do you want to pay your taxes?
''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''
'''Bozo:''' Thank you very much. I will have a drink or two on your health! ''(if you have money he takes 50gp)''
'''Bozo:''' Come back, when you have enough money. ''(if you don't have money)''

Nova magia?

''Jogador:'' '''Magic'''
'''Bozo:''' I actually know some spells! Do you want to learn how to 'lessen your load' for 200 gold?
''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''
'''Bozo:''' Here you are, I already lessened your load.
This magic is to "lessen your load". Exactly 20.00 oz. Why? Because it's the weigh of 200 gold coins.

Jester's guild

''Antes do Update de Natal 2007:''
''Jogador:'' '''Jester'''
'''Bozo:''' Do you wish to join the fools' guild?
''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''
'''Bozo:''' Sorry, you already are a member.
''Depois do Update de Natal 2007:''
''Jogador:'' '''Jester'''
'''Bozo:''' Do you wish to become a jester and join the fools guild?'
''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''
'''Bozo:''' So you want to make a total fool of yourself? Fine with me, but note that becoming a real fool means moe than being just an ordinary fool ...
'''Bozo:''' 'You will have to master a whole series of challenging, lengthy and, above all, totally foolish quests ...'
'''Bozo:''' Are you sure you want to waste a part of your limited lifetime on a quest that makes a fool of yourself and which might award you with the prestigious title of a grand fool in a far away future?
''Jogador:'' '''Yes''' '''Bozo:''' What a foolish decision! You are indeed a worthy candidate! But let's talk about business ...
'''Bozo:''' Being a jester is not just about telling jokes. A 'good jester heavily relies on requisites ...
'''Bozo:''' Getting some requisites will be your first job. First of all we need a good supply of water squirt flowers ...
'''Bozo:''' I'm making them on my own in my spare time but I need the right material. South of Thais, next to the Whiteflower Temple, you will find the ideal flowers ...
'''Bozo:''' Take a kitchen knife,
cut the thickest and healthiest flower and bring it here. Then talk to me about your mission.
''Se você já é um jester:'' ''Jogador:'' '''Jester'''
'''Bozo:''' Wow, your stupidity would be pride and joy for every fool. You've already applied as a member. Let's rather talk about your current mission.'
 === Piadas sobre Vocações === ''Jogador:'' '''Druid'''
'''Bozo:''' If you are in Druidville, do as the rabbits do.
''Jogador:'' '''Knight'''
'''Bozo:''' Did you notice that old knights have their scars just on their backs?
''Jogador:'' '''Paladin'''
'''Bozo:''' They are the king's favourites, because they know how to 'bow'.
''Jogador:'' '''Sorcerer'''
'''Bozo:''' The good thing about them is that they can't be at two places at the same time.
''Jogador:'' '''Your vocation here'''
'''Bozo:''' I wanted to become a ''your vocation here'', too, but I was overqualified!
=== Piadas sobre Mulher === '''Bozo:''' Hello, hello, hello, little lady ''your name here''!
''Jogador:'' '''Lady?'''
'''Bozo:''' Has any man said to you that you're not only beautiful but also intelligent?
''Jogador:'' '''No'''
'''Bozo:''' Well, think about it!
''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''
'''Bozo:''' This is a world of fantasy and full of surprises!
''Se o seu personagem é masculino:'' ''Jogador:'' '''Hi''' '''Bozo:''' Hi there, how's it hanging, ''Jogador''!
''Jogador:'' '''Lady'''
'''Bozo:''' Well, you don't behave ladylike just because you dress like one!
=== Piadas sobre Criaturas === ''Jogador:'' '''Bonelord'''
'''Bozo:''' Why are bonelords so ugly? ... Because their mom and dad were bonelords, too!
''Jogador:'' '''Cyclops'''
'''Bozo:''' How many eyes does a cyclops have? ... One for each IQ point of their opponents!
''Jogador:'' '''Demon'''
'''Bozo:''' Why are the experienced heroes quicker than others? ... The demons love fast food!
''Jogador:'' '''Dog'''
'''Bozo:''' Are we talking about Noodles?
''Jogador:'' '''Dragon'''
'''Bozo:''' Why do dragons breathe fire? ... They ate too many sorcerers in chili sauce!
''Jogador:'' '''Minotaur'''
'''Bozo:''' What do all little minotaurs want to become when they are grown-ups? ... Cowboys, of course!
''Jogador:'' '''Orc'''
'''Bozo:''' Why do orcs have green skin? ... They ate at Frodo's!
''Jogador:'' '''Rat'''
'''Bozo:''' Why does the rat have a wooden leg? ... Because it is a former pirate!
''Jogador:'' '''Skeleton'''
'''Bozo:''' Why do skeletons flee if wounded? ... They are so spineless!
''Jogador:'' '''Spider'''
'''Bozo:''' Why did the spider cross the road? ... Because it ... oh you already know this one!?
''Jogador:'' '''Troll'''
'''Bozo:''' Why do trolls live underground? ... Because on the ground there are so many PKs!
''Jogador:'' '''Wolf'''
'''Bozo:''' Why do the wolves howl? ... Hey, if you're online that long you can't help but behave that way!
=== Piadas sobre Pessoas === ''Jogador:'' '''Benjamin'''
'''Bozo:''' He would make a fine jester, too.
''Jogador:'' '''Elane'''
'''Bozo:''' She's pretty but has a kind of too burning affection for my taste.
''Jogador:'' '''Marvik'''
'''Bozo:''' Humourless old guy! Once turned me into a frog for painting his distasteful cave in pink.
''Jogador:'' '''Muriel'''
'''Bozo:''' Better don't mess with sorcerers!
''Jogador:'' '''Noodles'''
'''Bozo:''' Hey, the little one is almost as funny as me!
''Jogador:'' '''Oswald'''
'''Bozo:''' If you believe half the rumours he's spreading, you are going to get in a lot of trouble.
''Jogador:'' '''Quentin'''
'''Bozo:''' He's my baby brother. If you tell him I sent you, he will grant you an extra spell or two.
''Jogador:'' '''Sam'''
'''Bozo:''' Did you know that he now sells a 'power axe of doom'? Run and buy it, he has only three in store.
''Jogador:'' '''Gorn'''
'''Bozo:''' He sells spell scrolls each day at midnight, but you have to address him that very second.
''Jogador:'' '''Gregor'''
'''Bozo:''' A man of steel, with a stomach of wax. Never offer him a beer!
=== Piadas Diversas === ''Jogador:'' '''Durin'''
'''Bozo:''' Isn't he the author of the book 'fun with demons'?
''Jogador:'' '''Stephan'''
'''Bozo:''' He is kind of a father figure to me. Of course he denies all kinship to me.
''Jogador:'' '''Steve'''
'''Bozo:''' He's a smart one. I heared he hid in a foreign country as the first bugs showed up.
''Jogador:'' '''God'''
'''Bozo:''' I better make no jokes about THIS matter.
''Jogador:'' '''King'''
'''Bozo:''' Nah, no jests about His Royal Highness.
''Jogador:'' '''Guild'''
'''Bozo:''' Since the first guild showed up there's a great demand for jesters and fools to join them.
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''
'''Bozo:''' My name is Bozo. But it's more than a name, it's a lifestyle to me!
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
'''Bozo:''' Remember: A joke a day keeps the ghouls away! }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.title: Chester Kahs
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Chester Kahs | job = Líder da TBI | city = Thais | subarea = Thais City | location = [[Thais City]] ({{Mapa|32348,32185,6:2|aqui}}). | implemented = Pré-6.0 | notes = Chester é o capitão do Departamento Tibiano de Investigação ([[TBI]]), o serviço secreto de [[HRH|Sua Alteza Real]]. Seu diretor superior é o Rei Tibianus. Ele tem controle sobre a '[[Carlin#Red Legion|Legião Vermelha]]' mas prefere trabalhar sozinho. Ele deixou a cena pública depois de sua incapacidade para defender a colônia de Carlin contra os orcs. Chester é muito suspeito, quase paranóico. Ele tem informações detalhadas sobre quase todos os cidadãos de Thais. Ele restaura seu HP em troca de um [[Life Ring]], basta você dizer "heal" e depois "yes", com o seu anel na bolsa.

* Faz parte da [[Gamel Quest]]. * Faz parte da [[Secret Service Quest]]. Como recompensa por trazê-lo uma "''Magic Crystal''" ([[Life Crystal]]), ele lhe dará um [[Life Ring]]:
''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Chester Kahs:''' Salutations, stranger.
''Jogador:'' '''Gamel rebel'''
'''Chester Kahs:''' Are you saying that Gamel is a member of the rebellion?
''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''
'''Chester Kahs:''' Do you know what his plans are about?
''Jogador:'' '''Magic Crystal Lugri Deathcurse'''
'''Chester Kahs:''' That is terrible! Will you give me the crystal?
''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''
'''Chester Kahs:''' Thank you! Take this ring. If you ever need some healing, come here, bring me the ring and ask me to 'heal' you.
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
'''Chester Kahs:''' Take care out there!

| buysell = não | falas = (nota: palavras sublinhadas são erros de ortografia e pode ser corrigida pela Cipsoft) ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Chester Kahs:''' Salutations, stranger.
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
'''Chester Kahs:''' I am the head of the TBI.
''Jogador:'' '''TBI'''
'''Chester Kahs:''' The Tibian Bureau of Investigation, the secret service of His Royal Highness.
''Jogador:'' '''Investigation'''
'''Chester Kahs:''' We collect information about people and incidents.
''Jogador:'' '''Incidents'''
'''Chester Kahs:''' There are things that must be kept secret.
''Jogador:'' '''People'''
'''Chester Kahs:''' We know much about the citizens and some other people.
''Jogador:'' '''Citizens'''
'''Chester Kahs:''' I only can give you some official information about our citizens. About whom do you wish to talk?
''Jogador:'' '''Secret'''
'''Chester Kahs:''' Certain information is not for the eyes and ears of everyone. Please understand that.
''Jogador:'' '''King'''
'''Chester Kahs:''' King Tibianus III is our leader and my direct superior.
''Jogador:'' '''Superior'''
'''Chester Kahs:''' I report directly to the king himself.
''Jogador:'' '''Report'''
'''Chester Kahs:''' My reports are confidential and for the ears and eyes of the king only.
''Jogador:'' '''Castle'''
'''Chester Kahs:''' The castle isn't safe! I warned them of the entrance to the dungeons, but no one is litstening. How many people have to die before they do something about that?
''Jogador:'' '''Dungeon'''
'''Chester Kahs:''' Monsters lurk in each corner of the dungeons, which spread beneath us, breeding in the shadows and plotting to destroy us all.
''Jogador:'' '''City'''
'''Chester Kahs:''' The city is open to almost everyone. That literally opens doors for all kinds of criminals and fiends.
''Jogador:'' '''Criminals'''
'''Chester Kahs:''' There are so many murderers and thiefs out there that I wonder if there is some greater force of evil subtly encouraging that.
''Jogador:'' '''Enemies'''
'''Chester Kahs:''' The people of the northern city, the minotaurs, the followers of Zathroth, the demons, and countless others!
''Jogador:'' '''News'''
'''Chester Kahs:''' Sorry, almost news that are a little interesting are confidential.
''Jogador:'' '''Dangers'''
'''Chester Kahs:''' Danger is common like day and night for a Tibian, who keeps his eyes open.
''Jogador:'' '''Druids'''
'''Chester Kahs:''' It is said that druids are preservers of life and good aligned, but let me ask you if it's so 'good' to sell runes to the highest bidder, no matter who that might be? I hink you get the point!
''Jogador:'' '''Knights'''
'''Chester Kahs:''' It's too easy to become a knight. They take almost everyone. And if you look in the streets you can see what happens if you give training and a flashy title to almost veryone.
''Jogador:'' '''Paladins'''
'''Chester Kahs:''' They should be noble warriors, but does it take bravery to shoot someone from a certain distance? The former paladins were virtuous heroes, the ones you meet today are just simple treasure hunters.
''Jogador:'' '''Sorcerer]]s'''
'''Chester Kahs:''' I don't know where they got their secret spells in the first place, nor did most of them know ... If I were a sorcerer that would be a fact to give me nightmares.
''Jogador:'' '''Demons'''
'''Chester Kahs:''' They say there are just two of them in the underground ruins! These damned fools! There are dozens of them! And the two they already saw are only some of the eakest of demonkind!
''Jogador:'' '''Underground Ruins'''
'''Chester Kahs:''' We have no clue what happened to the civilization that once dwelled underground, but their complete extinction should be a warning to us!
''Jogador:'' '''Benjamin'''
'''Chester Kahs:''' Something happened to him that snapped his mind. Can we be sure what more might have happened to him unnoticed?
''Jogador:'' '''Bozo'''
'''Chester Kahs:''' He isn't the fool he pretends to be. So to what is he up to?
''Jogador:'' '''Frodo'''
'''Chester Kahs:''' Have you noticed how easy it would be to poison his supplies and kill a great deal of people with ease?
''Jogador:'' '''Gorn'''
'''Chester Kahs:''' A man too concerned about profit to be trustworthy. This kind of man sells his soul to the highest bidder. It's just a question if he has done it already or will do it soon.
''Jogador:'' '''Lynda'''
'''Chester Kahs:''' She puts her trust in the help of beings she can't comprehend. Think by yourself if that's clever.
''Jogador:'' '''McRonald'''
'''Chester Kahs:''' Have you ever wondered what these caves under their farm are good for? And have you noticed how many adventurers go down there and never return? Well, think about it!
''Jogador:'' '''Partos'''
'''Chester Kahs:''' This criminal was wanted for many crimes. At last he got caught and put to jail.
''Jogador:'' '''Quentin'''
'''Chester Kahs:''' A peaceful man. But in our days peace is just an illusion. We are surrounded by enemies and dangers.
''Jogador:'' '''Sam'''
'''Chester Kahs:''' I say it's a mistake to rely on a single person for such vital services.
''Jogador:'' '''Ferumbras'''
'''Chester Kahs:''' Some say he's the avatar of Zathroth himself, but perhaps the truth about him is even darker then the worst rumours can imagine.
''Jogador:'' '''Harsky'''
'''Chester Kahs:''' He is one of the few people I can trust.
''Jogador:'' '''Stutch'''
'''Chester Kahs:''' He is one of the few people I can trust.
''Jogador:'' '''Guards'''
'''Chester Kahs:''' I think we can't trust the guards anymore.
''Jogador:'' '''Ruthless seven'''
'''Chester Kahs:''' We know little about them. But even that gives me nightmares! But it's your lucky day, since this information is confidential, and so it can't bother you.
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
'''Chester Kahs:''' Take care out there! }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]
