pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}}
| name        = Edowir
| job         = Astrólogo
| city        = Thais
| subarea     = White Flower Temple
| location    = [[White Flower Temple]] ({{Mapa|32339,32365,7:1|aqui}}).
| implemented = Pré-6.0
| notes       = Edowir conhece muito sobre a história de Tibia.
| buysell     = não
| falas       = 
(Nota: palavras sublinhadas são erros de ortografia e podem ser corrigidos pela Cipsoft)

''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' Oh, hello ''Player''! How nice of you to visit an old man like me.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' I gather wisdom and knowledge. I am also an astrologer.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''God'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' Learn about the gods to learn from the gods.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''King'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' Kings are children adorned with crowns.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Magic'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' I believe that true love is stronger than all magic, don't you agree?</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' I am Edowir, but don't worry about remembering my name. I will forget your name as well.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Tibia'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' If Tibia is a fallen god, does that makes us the maggots crawling on it?</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Queen of the banshee'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' The legendary banshee queen is incredibly old and likely next to invincible. She's rumoured to have her lair in the deepest caverns of the ghostlands. She seems to be more likely to talk than her sisters, but is certainly even more evil than them.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Time'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' Time is a pillar and our lives wind around it like vine.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Weapon'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' Those who live by the sword get shot by those who don't.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Monster'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' Man or monster, the difference is often just a matter of hides and scales.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Castle'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' A strong wall may protect from an assault, but what will protect you from the enemy within?</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Dungeon'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' Dungeons are a place of danger, not of joy. Keep that in mind on your travels.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Banshee'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' The Banshees are creatures that grief and despair turned into vengeful spirits after their death. Their wail is deadly, and they draw new strength from the pain and fear of others.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Cyclops'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' Cyclopses are seen as the smithes of blog, whom they call 'the ragehammer' or 'ragehammerer'. Indeed their skills create mostly crude and nasty looking weapons and armor which are incredibly effective nontheles.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Brog'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' Brog is the god of rage and fierce battle. He's also the patron of power, although a power to oppress and bully others around. He is the son of Zathroth and one of the Tibian suns.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Bozo'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' Who laughs last, thinks slowest.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Elane''' ou '''Paladin'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' A paladin is more than just a knight armed with a bow and some spells, though most seem to be unaware of that fact.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Gregor''' ou '''Knights'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' Knights could be artists, but tend to become sellswords.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Muriel'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' Mages claim to be be wise, but how wise can it be to sacrifice your life to books and scrolls and not for the people?</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Sorcerer'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' Mages claim to be be wise, but how wise can it be to sacrifice your life to books and scrolls and not for the people?</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Druids'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' Druids seek enlightenment in nature, but they often just find what they brought with them.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Oldrak'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' Growing old is mandatory, growing up is optional.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Chalice of life'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' This chalice was a tool of the gods which they created to make their task to create life easier. Zathroth who lacked the knowledge of creation stole that chalice and used it to spawn his evil minions.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Uman'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' Uman is the light twin of Zathroth. Their unity and separation at once is a concept we cannot hope to grasp. He is the patron of light magic, the knowledge that benefits all and brings progress to the society.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Zathroth'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' Zathroth is the dark twin of Uman. They are one and they are two separate entities. We mortals can't really grasp this concept. He is the patron of dark magic and even darker secrets, the lust for dominance through cunning, and manipulation.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Demons'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' Demons are the servants of evil. More or less devoted servers of Zathroth they cause strife and havoc wherever they appear. Their masters are known as Demonlords, Demon Overlords and Archdemon.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Demon Overlords'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' The overlords of the demonkind are more powerful than even demonlords are. They are nearly indestructible. Armoured with layers of impenetrable hide and endowed with awesome magical power, demon overlords are true incarnation of death.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Archdemons'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' The archdemons are few, and they are extremely rare. And a good thing, too, for they are the rulers of the demonrace. They are vain and powerhungry creatures who tend to form only small cabals and fight each other instead of allying up against creation.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Cabalss'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' There are at least five demonic cabals of archdemons. The ruthless seven are the most prominent and powerful.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Ruthless Sevens'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' They are more than a myth, they are a horrible reality. It is possible that they still reside in the pits of inferno.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Pits of inferno'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' An infernal place in which the nightmare knights created a base to fight the minions of evil. It was lost when the Ruthless Seven conquered it.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''The Triangle of Terror'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' The Triangle of Terror is a cabal of three archdemons that have put aside their quarrels to establish some power in the shadows of the Ruthless Seven. Although they are all very mighty demons, compared to one of the seven, they appear weak ...</br>
'''Edowir:''' So they try not to interfere much with the doings of the seven and look for power elsewhere. Their members are Morgaroth, the schemer, Ghazbaran, the lord of blades and Zoralurk, the demon with the thousand faces.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Morgaroth'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' Morgaroth belongs to the cabal Triangle of Terror. He usually has minions to do his work rather than doing it himself. Although sometimes he enters our world in person to inspire the fear his cabal is built upon.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Ghazbaran'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' Ghazbaran is a member of the demonic cabal Triangle of Terror. He likes the physical challenge and combat as much as the pain and death he inflicts.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Zoralurk'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' Zoralurk is said to be a member of the demon cabal called Triangle of Terror. She is rumoured to wander the lands in many disguises, poisoning the body and minds of people by word or deed.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Plains of Havoc'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' Somewhere in the Plains of Havoc, where the Necromant King was defeated lies the secret entrance to the pits of inferno.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hugo'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' I think you are referring to the beast Hugo that is said to still haunt the Plains of Havoc. The legends which tell of this creature are ancient and almost forgotten.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Nightmare knights'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' The Nightmare Knights were an ancient order dedicated to fight evil. They were guided by prophetic dreams. The order ceased to exist after their war against the Brotherhood of Bones.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Brotherhood of Bones'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' This brotherhood was an secret society of necromancers and followers of purest evil. They were vanquished long ago by their arch-enemies, the Nightmare Knights.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Legends'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' As far as we know, once a terrible beast roamed the lands we now call the Plains of Havoc. It was so fierce that no one dared to even dream about killing it. Finally it was tricked by the knight Endulos.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Endulos'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' Endulos was not a great warrior, but a man of wit and genius. After many of his brethren of the Nightmare Knights had fallen prey to the beast, he came up with a cunning plan to end that threat.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Cunning plan'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' He lured Hugo into a trap. Bound by roots and stones charged with powerful magic he could not move anymore. Now, the beast lies trapped in a hidden cave for eternity.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hidden cave'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' The legends tell us that the Nightmare Knights trapped it beneath one of their fortresses, or rather that they built a fortress on top of his eternal prison.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Paradox Tower'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' The Paradox Tower was home of a mighty but mad wizard. It is said that only the cunning and mad can brave the tests of that tower to gain its treasures.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Riddler'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' As far as I can tell, this creature is not fond of cheaters and won't allow them to pass his tests.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Defile'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' Whatever the original meaning of that underground complex was, it is now like an open wound in the nearby lands, spreading madness and attracting all kinds of ghosts and apparitions.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Goshnar'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' The Necromant King. He is dead forever, and that is the nicest thing I can say about him. May he rot in his tomb.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Djinn'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' Legend has it that the Djinn were created by Zathroth by using the stolen chalice of life. They roamed the world for Aeons causing strife and despair until Gabel, one of their lords met a very special human.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Gabel'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' Gabel was the most powerful among the Djinn lords. He was cruel and merciless, until one day his minions brought a certain human to him whom they had captured and tortured.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Certain human'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' This human showed no fear and did not yield under torture. They could bend him, but they never managed to break him. Impressed by this mortal, Gabel talked to him and learned about his philosophy.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Philosophy'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' The human whom the Djinn had caught was none other but Daraman. The mighty Gabel was intrigued by his philosophy an changed his ways according to Daramans teachings.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Teachings'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' The teachings of asceticism, inner peace and ascension appealed to the Djinn, although in the beginning this was probably only because of his vanity and his greed for divinity. However, Malor and his followers opposed him.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Malor'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' Malor was second in power only to Gabel and his followers among the Djinn were many. It was not easy for the evil Djinn to change their ways, and many preferred to follow Malor instead of Gabel. In the end a civil war erupted.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Civil war'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' In the war of the Djinn citys were levelled, lands were cursed and islands sunk. Finally, Malor was caught and imprisoned in an enchanted bottle. His followers fled this plane, while the good djinn laid to rest to recover their strength.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Daraman'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' Daraman was a sage with ambition, that is for sure. His philosophy centred around the idea that by controlling yourself you could improve yourself. The closer you are coming to perfection, the closer you are to ascension to divinity.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Cenath'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' The cenath favour magic above all other. They are the keeper of elven lore and wisdom. They are responsible for the astounding feats of druidic magic the elves are capable of.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Deraisim'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' One could call the Deraisim the scouts and rangers of elvenkind. Although all elves are formidable in that area, the Deraisim excel them all.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Kuridai'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' The Kuridai are the craftsmen and warriors of elvenkind. They are always moving, always scheming. They are the most aggressive elves and distrust outsiders. An outsider might be each non-Kuridai to them.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Teshial'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' Its said that those elves were the masters of the dreams. Which many consider as a special brand of magic. However they seem to have vanished from the face of tibia ages ago and their fate is unknown.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Ab'Dendriel'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' Although lovely, the city of the elves lacks the grace and the vibrance of the elven cities of old. The elves are still working on improvement of their settlement.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Carlin'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' A city in the far north. It separated from the Thaian kingdom about 100 years ago. Now it is ruled by a dynasty of queens.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Darashia'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' The town of Darashia is built around one of the few sweet water supplies of Darama. It is famous for its sand wasp honey and its sandworm stew.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Darama'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' The desert lands of Darama are harsh and unforgiving. Therefore Daraman led his people there to found a new community based upon his teachings.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Edron'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' Edron is the latest colony of the Thaian kingdom. However, structures of an earlier colonisation have been found. We cannot tell if those inhabitants were human or of any other known race.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Drefia'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' The dreaded town of Drefia was once a haven for heretics, necromancers and demon worshipper. Its was destroyed in the war of the Djinn.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Ghostland'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' The Ghostlands are haunted by their past. In bygone days some ancient race lived there. Deep beneath the earth some of their structures are still intact and defile the surrounding lands.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Kazordoon'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' The ancient fortrescity of the dwarf was carved into the mountain known as 'the big old one'. Its quite hidden and heavily guarded to withstand any assault.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Mintwallin'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' The underground city of the minotaurs can be reached through a dangerous passage from the old temple.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Mount Sternum'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' Behind the mountain lies a land of great danger.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Old temple'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' In the old days the underground temple was built for the glory of Banor after a victory over the orcish hordes. It is now an abandoned and dreary place overrun by rotworms.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Rookgaard'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' It was on rookgaard where the soul vortex appeared. The Thaian kingdom holds an outpost there to protect the vortex and to guide the newly arrived souls.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Thais'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' Thais is the capital of an ancient human kingdom. Once its rule was more or less undisputed. In the years the strength of the thaian kingdom eroded by different events.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Venore'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' Venore is a center of commerce and trade. Its ambitious trade-barons are nominally subjects of the thaian kingdom.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Trade Barons'''</br>
'''Edowir:'''The swamp city is a centre of commerce, and know for it riches and its merchant barons. It is part of the Thaian Kingdom.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Excalibug'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' The ancient dwarven kings forged it using magic metal , which they took from cyclopses who found it in the heart of a fallen star.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Magic Metal'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' There are several kinds of magic metals in our world, the best known are called Mesh Kaha Rogh, Za'Kalortith, Uth'Byth, Uth'Morc, Uth'Amon, Uth'Maer, Uth'Doon, and Zatragil.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Mesh Kaha Rogh'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' The so-called singing steel causes a constant humming while it is forged. It is said this was a sign of its absorbing magic powers in the process, and it was presumably easy to enchant. Sadly, the secret where to mine or how to create this ore has been lost in the ourse of time.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Za'Kalortith'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' This is the metal of 'evil', the hell-forged iron no ordinary flames can melt. It is rumoured to be harvested in hell from iron rocks in which damned souls were imprisoned.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Uth'Byth'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' This steel absorbs magic. While it is of inferior quality compared to ordinary steel, its absorbing qualities make it important though.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Uth'Morc'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' What makes this black steel exceptional is its lightness and peculiar property of lacking the common steel 'noise'. It is also called 'silent steel' or 'thief's steel' for this reason.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Uth'Amon'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' The luminescent brightsteel is used for artwork mainly. In ancient times, items of great magic power were crafted using brightsteel. Those crafts were lost with the races who held the secret to them.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Uth'Maer'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' The dwarfs call it heartiron and claim it is part of the heart of The Big Old One. Therefore, they hold it sacred and its use is limited and regulated.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Uth'Doon'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' The dwarven high steel is relatively common but expensive and still hard to come by. The elite dwarven weaponry and armours are made of Uth'Doon.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Zatragil'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' The so-called dreamsilver is a legendary metal. Almost everything we know about it are rumours only.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Dwarf''' ou '''Dwarves'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' The small but strong dwarves are tireless workers and fierce warriors. They are familiar with several crafts and mastered most of them. In our days their smithing skills are rivalled only by those of the cyclopses.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Soulvortex'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' The gods created the vortex to guide powerful souls to our world so they might join the battle for creation.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''</br>
'''Edowir:''' Come back whenever you're in need of wisdom.
}}<noinclude>[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]</noinclude>

pages.title: A Confused Frog
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = A Confused Frog | job = Roleplay | npcclass = Anfíbios | npcsprite = Green Frog | city = Thais | subarea = Thais | location = [[Thais]] ({{Mapa|32289,32295,9:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.5 | notes = Seu nome é (ou foi) [[Turian]].

* Faz parte da [[The Scatterbrained Sorcerer Quest]].

| buysell = não | falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == Rrrribbit? == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''assistant'''
'''A Confused Frog''': I don’t want to be an assistant anymore. Ribbit. I just want my dream pond. ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''A Confused Frog''': Well… ribbit… my name is Turian. But that doesn’t really matter anymore. ''Jogador'': '''kiss'''
'''A Confused Frog''': Errr… I’d rather not. Don’t take it personally. ''Jogador'': '''magic'''
'''A Confused Frog''': Magic, pah. Ribbit. I don’t need magic. I just want some flies, actually. Ribbit. ''Jogador'': '''job'''
'''A Confused Frog''': I used to be Eclesius’ assistant! Argh! Then – ribbit – one of his crazy experimental spells backfired and hit me. That’s when I lost my job I guess. Ribbit. ''Jogador'': '''demon'''
'''A Confused Frog''': That demon is called ribbit. Erm, no, I mean Samael. He is one REALLY annoyed demon overlord, but we get along okay. Not sure if I’d let him out of there though. Ribbit. ''Jogador'': '''samael'''
'''A Confused Frog''': Yep, he told me one day that that was his name. In the tone of voice that makes your ears almost explode and singes your hair. ''Jogador'': '''frog'''
'''A Confused Frog''': You know… being a frog isn’t that bad. Ribbit. I don’t want to be a human again. I just wish I could get out of this cage and live by a lovely little pond. ''Jogador'': '''ribbit'''
'''A Confused Frog''': Yeah, you said it. Ribbit. Told you, being a frog isn’t that bad, see. ''Jogador'': '''eclesius'''
'''A Confused Frog''': That old fool! He should be locked up with his weird theories and ideas and forced to study some serious magic! Rrrribbit! ''Jogador'': '''pond'''
'''A Confused Frog''': I like the pond north of Thais. It’s a really cosy place. Not just for humans, but especially for frogs. Ribbit. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''A Confused Frog''': Take care. Ribbit. }}

pages.title: Gregor
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Gregor | job = Knight Guild Leader | city = Thais | subarea = Thais City | location = [[Thais City]] ({{Mapa|32405,32199,6:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 4.0 | notes = Ele afirma ter sido o primeiro [[Knight]] e ter treinado alguns dos maiores heróis de Tibia. Também era responsável por ensinar [[magias]] para [[Knights]].

A partir do update '''15.22''', lançado em '''27 de janeiro de 2026''', não é mais possível comprar magias com este NPC. A CipSoft removeu a interação com a palavra '''"spell"''' e a funcionalidade de compra de magias, já que elas passaram a ser aprendidas automaticamente assim que o jogador atinge o nível necessário. | buysell = não | buys = Nada. | sells = Nada. | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi''' (quando o jogador é knight)
'''Gregor:''' Welcome home, Knight ''Jogador''!
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
'''Gregor:''' I am the first knight. I trained some of the greatest heroes of Tibia.
''Jogador:'' '''Heroes'''
'''Gregor:''' Of course, you heard of them. Knights are the best fighters in Tibia.
''Jogador:'' '''King'''
'''Gregor:''' Hail to our King!
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''
'''Gregor:''' You are joking, eh? Of course, you know me. I am Gregor, the first knight.
''Jogador:'' '''Gregor'''
'''Gregor:''' A great name, isn't it?
''Jogador:'' '''Spell'''
'''Gregor:''' I have spells for all magic levels up to level 3. In what level do you want to learn a spell?
''Jogador:'' '''Tibia'''
'''Gregor:''' Beautiful Tibia. And with our help everyone is save.
''Jogador:'' '''Time'''
'''Gregor:''' It is time to join the Knights!
''Jogador:'' '''Knights'''
'''Gregor:''' Knights are the warriors of Tibia. Without us, no one would be safe. Every brave and strong man or woman can join us.
''Jogador:'' '''Bozo'''
'''Gregor:''' Some day someone will make something happen to him...
''Jogador:'' '''Elane'''
'''Gregor:''' A bow might be a fine weapon for someone not strong enough to wield a REAL weapon.
''Jogador:'' '''Frodo'''
'''Gregor:''' I and my students often share a cask of beer or wine at Frodo's hut.
''Jogador:'' '''Gorn'''
'''Gregor:''' Always concerned with his profit. What a loss! He was adventuring with baxter in the old days.
''Jogador:'' '''Baxter'''
'''Gregor:''' He was an adventurer once.
''Jogador:'' '''Lynda'''
'''Gregor:''' Before she became a priest she won the Miss Tibia contest three times in a row.
''Jogador:'' '''McRonald'''
'''Gregor:''' Peaceful farmers.
''Jogador:'' '''Ferumbras'''
'''Gregor:''' A fine game to hunt. But be careful, he cheats!
''Jogador:'' '''Muriel'''
'''Gregor:''' Bah, go away with these sorcerer tricks. Only cowards use tricks.
''Jogador:'' '''Oswald'''
'''Gregor:''' What an idiot.
''Jogador:'' '''Quentin'''
'''Gregor:''' I will never understand this peaceful monks and priests.
''Jogador:'' '''Sam'''
'''Gregor:''' He has the muscles, but lacks the guts.
''Jogador:'' '''Tibianus'''
'''Gregor:''' Hail to our King!
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
'''Gregor:''' Be careful on your journeys.
}}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}}
| name        = Grof, The Guard
| job         = Guarda
| city        = Thais
| subarea     = Thais City
| location    = [[Thais City]] ({{Mapa|32368,32182,7:2|aqui}}).
| implemented = 8.2
| notes       = Ele protege Thais contra o ataque de criaturas.
| buysell     = não
| buys        =
| sells       =

== Frases Espontâneas ==
Não possui.

== Palavras-Chave ==
''Jogador'': '''hi'''</br>
'''Grof, The Guard''': LONG LIVE THE KING!

-----

=== Sobre Grof: ===
''Jogador'': '''job'''</br>
'''Grof, The Guard''': It's my duty to protect the city.

''Jogador'': '''guard'''</br>
'''Grof, The Guard''': I am a guard and proud of it.

''Jogador'': '''news'''</br>
'''Grof, The Guard''': I am busy. Please ask the citizens for news.

''Jogador'': '''how are you'''</br>
'''Grof, The Guard''': I am healthy and vigilant.

''Jogador'': '''red guards'''</br>
'''Grof, The Guard''': We of the red guard are the special forces.

-----

=== Sobre NPC's: ===
''Jogador'': '''bozo'''</br>
'''Grof, The Guard''': The royal jester.

''Jogador'': '''sam''' / '''smith''' / '''weapon'''</br>
'''Grof, The Guard''': Sam is our blacksmith. You'll find him north of the main crossroads. His shop is to the left.

''Jogador'': '''harsky''' / '''stutch'''</br>
'''Grof, The Guard''': He is a soldier in the silver guard.

''Jogador'': '''king''' / '''tibianus''' / '''leader'''</br>
'''Grof, The Guard''': Tibianus III is our beloved king! He resides in the castle in the north west of the city.

''Jogador'': '''gorn''' / '''provisioner'''</br>
'''Grof, The Guard''': Gorn is our provisioner. You'll find him north of the main crossroads. His shop is to the right.

''Jogador'': '''frodo''' / '''tavern'''</br>
'''Grof, The Guard''': Frodo runs the local tavern. You'll find it at the main crossroads to the north-west.

''Jogador'': '''gregor''' / '''knight'''</br>
'''Grof, The Guard''': The high knight of the knights' guild. It is in north-east of the town.

''Jogador'': '''marvik''' / '''druid'''</br>
'''Grof, The Guard''': Marvik is the great druid of the local guild. You'll find him by climbing up the citywalls at the east.

''Jogador'': '''muriel''' / '''sorcerer'''</br>
'''Grof, The Guard''': Muriel is the head of the local sorcerers' guild. You'll find it in the south-west of the city.

''Jogador'': '''elane''' / '''paladin'''</br>
'''Grof, The Guard''': Elane is responsible for the local paladins' guild. It's in the west of the town, directly south of the post office.

''Jogador'': '''baxter'''</br>
'''Grof, The Guard''': He is a role model for us.

''Jogador'': '''benjamin''' / '''post'''</br>
'''Grof, The Guard''': Benjamin was a brave fighter. He runs the post office in the west of the city.

''Jogador'': '''eclesius'''</br>
'''Grof, The Guard''': I only see him when he heads home in the wrong direction.

''Jogador'': '''harkath''' / '''general'''</br>
'''Grof, The Guard''': The royal general. A warrior worth Banor's blessings.

-----

=== Outras Palavras-Chave: ===
''Jogador'': '''city'''</br>
'''Grof, The Guard''': Behave while in the city or we get you! Do you want to know where to find a shop or a guild?

''Jogador'': '''shop'''</br>
'''Grof, The Guard''': There's a smith, a provisioner, and a tavern.

''Jogador'': '''castle'''</br>
'''Grof, The Guard''': The castle is at the west of the city.

''Jogador'': '''guild'''</br>
'''Grof, The Guard''': In the city you will find the guildhouses of the knights, paladins, druids, and sorcerers.

''Jogador'': '''banor'''</br>
'''Grof, The Guard''': Praise Banor! May the great warrior be with us!

''Jogador'': '''army'''</br>
'''Grof, The Guard''': Of course we guards are members of the army.

''Jogador'': '''sell'''</br>
'''Grof, The Guard''': Visit Tibia's shopkeepers to buy their fine wares.

''Jogador'': '''silver guard'''</br>
'''Grof, The Guard''': Only the best of the best serve as silver guards.

''Jogador'': '''dogs of war'''</br>
'''Grof, The Guard''': Brave warriors, indeed.

''Jogador'': '''news'''</br>
'''Grof, The Guard''': I am busy. Please ask the citizens for news.

''Jogador'': '''''palavra ofensiva'''''</br>
'''Grof, The Guard''': Take this! (burning effect, 5 turnos de 10 hitpoints)

''Jogador'': '''bye'''</br>
'''Grof, The Guard''': LONG LIVE THE KING!</br>
}}

{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Billy | job = Comerciante de Alimentos | npcclass = Humanos | npcsprite = Beggar | city = Thais | subarea = Rookgaard | location = [[Rookgaard]] ({{Mapa|32054,32204,7:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 7.11 | notes = Billy, junto com seu irmão [[Willie]], trabalha em um moinho que se expande entre a linha free e premium de Rookgaard. Billy está no lado premium, comprando e vendendo vários tipos de comida. Billy quer fazer uma das suas famosas sopas, mas precisa de Rats e uma [[Pan]]ela.

* Você pode trocar uma [[Pan]], obtida na [[Goblin Temple Quest]], por um [[Small Health Potion]] com ele.

| buysell = sim | buys = {{Trades/Buy | Meat | Bread, 1 | Carrot | Cheese | Cherry | Dead Rat | Egg | Ham | Salmon}} | sells = {{Trades/Sell | Bread,3 | Cheese,5 | Ham,8 | Meat,5}} | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Billy:''' Howdy ''Jogador''.
''Jogador:'' '''God'''
'''Billy:''' I am the god of cooking, indeed!
''Jogador:'' '''Help'''
'''Billy:''' Can't help you, sorry. I'm a cook, not a priest.
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
'''Billy:''' I am farmer and a cook.
''Jogador:'' '''Time'''
'''Billy:''' I came here to have some peace and leisure so leave me alone with 'time'.
''Jogador:'' '''King'''
'''Billy:''' The king and his tax collectors are far away. You'll meet them soon enough.
''Jogador:'' '''Magic''' / '''Spell'''
'''Billy:''' I can spell but know no spell.
''Jogador:'' '''Sell'''
'''Billy:''' I sell various kinds of food.
''Jogador:'' '''Buy'''
'''Billy:''' I buy food of most kind. Since I am a great cook I need much of it.
''Jogador:'' '''Food'''
'''Billy:''' Are you looking for food? I have bread, cheese, ham, and meat.
''Jogador:'' '''Weapon'''
'''Billy:''' Ask one of the shopkeepers. They make a fortune here with all those wannabe heroes.
''Jogador:'' '''Dungeon'''
'''Billy:''' You'll find a lot of dungeons if you look around.
''Jogador:'' '''Rat'''
'''Billy:''' So you bring me a fresh rat for my famous stew?
''Jogador:'' '''No'''
'''Billy:''' Then not.
''Jogador:'' '''Pan'''
'''Billy:''' Have you found a pan for me?
''Jogador:'' '''No'''
'''Billy:''' $&*@!
''Jogador:'' '''Monsters'''
'''Billy:''' Don't be afraid, in the town you should be save.
''Jogador:'' '''Amber'''
'''Billy:''' Shes pretty indeed! I wonder if she likes bearded men.
''Jogador:'' '''Cipfried'''
'''Billy:''' He never leaves this temple and only has time to care about those new arivals.
''Jogador:'' '''Dallheim'''
'''Billy:''' One of the kings best men, here to protect us.
''Jogador:'' '''Obi'''
'''Billy:''' I like him, we usualy have a drink or two once a week and share storys about Willie.
''Jogador:'' '''Seymour'''
'''Billy:''' I don't like his headmaster behaviour. Then again, he IS a headmaster after all.
''Jogador:'' '''Willie'''
'''Billy:''' Don't listen to that old wannabe, I'm the best cook around.
''Jogador:'' '''Cook'''
'''Billy:''' I am the best cook around. You can sell me most types of food.
''Jogador:'' '''Bye''' }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Blind Orc | job = Comerciante de Armas | npcclass = Humanóides | npcsprite = Orc | city = Thais | subarea = Rookgaard | location = [[Rookgaard]] ({{Mapa|32100,32129,4:2|aqui}}). | implemented = Pré-6.0 | buysell = sim | buys = Nada. | sells = {{Trades/Sell | Bow, 400 | Brass Shield | Hatchet | Leather Armor, 25 | Sabre | Short Sword, 30 | Studded Armor | Studded Helmet, 60 | Sword | Arrow}} | notes = O Blind Orc foi um grande líder para seu povo que vivia na pequena ilha de Rookgaard. Eles prosperaram por muito tempo até que mensagens chegaram informando que os guerreiros eram necessários na guerra do outro lado do oceano. Os mais fortes partiram rapidamente com destino ao norte de [[Tibia (Continente)]] para ajudar seus amigos no confronto contra os homens. Os orcs mais fracos foram deixados com alguns guardas orcs. O Blind Orc ficou fascinado com esses "homens", mas ele não sabia falar a língua deles. Até hoje, muitos visitam sua pequena montanha para comprar equipamentos. Ele é o único que vende bows e arrows em Rookgaard, que ele cria a partir das árvores e coelhos que existem por lá. Para se comunicar e negociar com ele, você precisa saber a [[Orc Language|língua dos orcs]]. Se você não fala essa língua, talvez algumas pessoas que vivem na vila possam ensiná-la a você.

* Você pode aprender [[Orc Language]] com a [[Amber]]. Ela pode ensinar algumas palavras da [[Orc Language]] a cada [[Salmon]] que você der a ela. [[Salmon]]s podem ser encontrados na [[Captain Iglues Treasure Quest]].

}} [[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

== Frases Espontâneas ==
'''Cipfried''': Feeling lost, my child? Ask me for hints or help!</br>
'''Cipfried''': Welcome to the temple of Rookgaard!</br>
'''Cipfried''': Come to me if you need healing!</br>
'''Cipfried''': Don't despair! Help is near!

== Palavras-Chave ==
''Jogador'': '''hi'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': Hello, ''Jogador''! I'll heal you if you are injured or poisoned. Feel free to ask me for help or general hints.

-----

=== Outras palavras-chave: ===
''Jogador'': '''job'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': Me? Oh, I'm just a humble monk. Ask me if you need help or healing.

''Jogador'': '''name'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': My name is Cipfried.

''Jogador'': '''monk'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': I have sacrificed my life to serve the good gods of Tibia and to help newcomers in this world.

''Jogador'': '''tibia'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': That's where we are - the world of Tibia, in a village called Rookgaard, to be precise, with many monsters, quests and citizens around.

''Jogador'': '''rookgaard'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': The gods have chosen this isle as the point of arrival for newborn souls. The citizens will help you if you ask them.

''Jogador'': '''god'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': They created Tibia and all life on it. Visit our academy and learn about them.

''Jogador'': '''citizen'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': Only a few people live in our village, most of them are merchants. You can either ask them for a trade or about various other topics, like the names of other citizens, their job or Tibia in general.

''Jogador'': '''academy'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': The academy is just north of here. You can learn helpful things there from Seymour, if you wish to!

''Jogador'': '''monster'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': Monsters are a constant threat to this village. You would tremendously help us by fighting them, starting with rats in the sewers, then turning to spiders or wolves.

''Jogador'': '''rat'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': A single rat doesn't pose a grave danger to you, but be careful not to get cornered by many of them. They could still kill you.

''Jogador'': '''sewer'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': The sewers are right below this village. North of this temple, you find a sewer grate which leads down, but there are also many small huts in the village which are connected to the sewers.

''Jogador'': '''kill''' / '''death'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': If you get killed, you will revive in this temple. However, you will lose experience and also equipment, which can be quite painful. Take good care of yourself!

''Jogador'': '''weapons'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': To defend yourself against enemies, you will need a weapon. You can purchase weapons at Obi's shop.

''Jogador'': '''armor''' / '''shield'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': To defend yourself against enemies, you will need armor and shields. You can purchase both at Dixi's shop.

''Jogador'': '''shop''' / '''merchants'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': You can buy and sell goods from merchants. To do so, simply talk to them and ask them for a trade. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.

''Jogador'': '''equipment'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': You can buy equipment from the merchants in this village once you earned some gold. Some monsters also carry equipment pieces with them.

''Jogador'': '''heal'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': You aren't looking really bad, ''Jogador''. I can only help in cases of real emergencies. Raise your health simply by eating food.

''Jogador'': '''food'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': Food is very important for your health. If you are hurt in a fight with a monster, select 'Use' on food such as cheese, ham or meat to eat it. This will slowly refill your health.

''Jogador'': '''help'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': How can I help you? I can tell you about specific citizens if you tell me their name. I can also give you general hints about Tibia.

''Jogador'': '''quest''' / '''mission'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': Oh, I can handle my tasks myself, thank you. If you are looking for something to do, you should listen to the local citizens and ask them for quests. You could also help us fight monsters.

''Jogador'': '''gold''' / '''money'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': You can earn a fair amount of gold by fighting monsters and picking up the things they carry. Many citizens are buying some of that loot, simply ask around.

''Jogador'': '''time'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': Now it is ''horas'', my child.

''Jogador'': '''explorer''' / '''adventure'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': I can see a bright future for you... you will soon embark on a very big adventure and explore the world of Tibia - maybe even influence history!

''Jogador'': '''ropes'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': Never go adventuring without a rope! If you don't have one when you fall through a hole in the ground, you won't be able to leave without a rope.

''Jogador'': '''shovels'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': Shovels are very useful. There may be a hidden entrance under a loose pile of stone and without a shovel, how would you know?

''Jogador'': '''knight'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': Knights are close combat fighters. They usually wield melee weapons such as swords, axes or clubs.

''Jogador'': '''paladin'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': Paladins are well-trained distance fighters and can cast holy magic. You will usually see them wearing bows or crossbows.

''Jogador'': '''druid'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': Druids are nature magicians. Their speciality is casting ice and earth magic, as well as providing healing for others.

''Jogador'': '''sorcerer'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': Sorcerers are elemental magicians. They have mastered fire, energy and death magic.

''Jogador'': '''vocation'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': There are four vocations in Tibia: knight, sorcerer, paladin or druid. Each vocation has its unique special abilities.

''Jogador'': '''destiny'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': Your near destiny will be to choose a vocation once you are level 8. Whether you will become a knight, sorcerer, paladin or druid is a big decision!

''Jogador'': '''potion'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': Potions will come in handy once you are in a fight deep in a dungeon. If you aren't in immediate danger, you can simply eat food to regain health, though.

''Jogador'': '''spider'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': If you face spiders, beware of the poisonous ones. If you are poisoned, you will constantly lose health. Come to me and I'll heal you from poison.

''Jogador'': '''poison'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': Poison is very dangerous! Don't ever drink green liquids, they are poisonous and will make you lose health!

''Jogador'': '''wolf''' / '''wolves'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': Wolves can only be found outside of the village. If you want to know where their dens are, best talk to Dallheim or Zerbrus at the bridges.

''Jogador'': '''thank'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': Of course.

''Jogador'': '''premium'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': As a premium adventurer, you are an official tax payer and thus privileged in many ways. For example, you can travel by ship and get better deals from merchants.

''Jogador'': '''ship'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': Ships are a comfortable way of travelling to distant cities. At any harbour, you can board the ship and ask its captain where he sails to. ...</br>
'''Cipfried''': Travelling by ship will cost you some gold, though, so be sure to have money with you.

''Jogador'': '''sell''' / '''buy'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': I'm sorry, but I'm not interested in worldly goods. If you want to buy or sell something, you should ask a local merchant for a trade.

''Jogador'': '''bank'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': You can deposit your money at the bank. That way you won't lose it if you get killed. The bank is just under the academy and to the right.

''Jogador'': '''trade'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': I don't have any goods for trade, but if you ask one of the merchants, he or she will gladly show you what you can buy or sell.

''Jogador'': '''''palavra ofensiva'''''</br>
'''Cipfried''': Hey ''Jogador''! We have rules here! You'll have a much easier life if you respect them.

''Jogador'': '''rules'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': A general rule is to be polite and kind towards fellow Tibians. This includes not to insult them or to steal their monsters. If you are friendly, you will quickly make friends.

-----

=== Sobre NPCs: ===
''Jogador'': '''obi'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': Obi's shop is to the north-east of this humble temple. He sells weapons, and his granddaughter Dixi sells armor and shields upstairs.

''Jogador'': '''seymour'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': Seymour is a loyal follower of the king and a teacher in the academy.

''Jogador'': '''willie'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': Willie is a farmer, just like his cousin Billy. His farm is located left of the temple. You can buy and sell food there.

''Jogador'': '''dallheim'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': May the gods bless our loyal guardsmen! Day and night they stand watch on our bridges, ensuring that it is not passed by dangerous monsters!

''Jogador'': '''dixi'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': That's Obi's granddaughter. Her counter is just upstairs from Obi's shop. She helps him by selling armor and shields.

''Jogador'': '''cipfried'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': Yes? How can I help you?

''Jogador'': '''billy'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': He's a farmer, just like his cousin Willie. He doesn't talk to everybody, though.

''Jogador'': '''asralius'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': He came together with Vascalir. He seems like a powerful mage and investigates the disturbances in the magical atmosphere.

''Jogador'': '''vascalir'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': He has recently arrived from a far-away country to help us fight against the orcs.

''Jogador'': '''al dee'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': In Al Dee's shop you'll find important general equipment such as ropes, shovels and torches.

''Jogador'': '''amber'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': Amber is such a lovely girl, and also a very experienced explorer and adventurer. It's always interesting to chat with her.

''Jogador'': '''oracle'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': You can find the oracle on the top floor of the academy, just above Seymour. Go there when you are level 8 to find your destiny.

''Jogador'': '''lily'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': You must have passed the house of Lily on your way here. She sells potions. If you pick blueberries or find cookies, she'll buy them from you.

''Jogador'': '''seymour'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': Seymour is a loyal follower of the king and a teacher in the academy.

''Jogador'': '''hyacinth'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': Hyacinth is a close friend of mine. He left the village many years ago to live in solitude. I think all this bustle here simply was too much for him.

''Jogador'': '''lee'delle'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': Lee'Delle's shop is on the premium side of the village. You should visit her!

''Jogador'': '''loui'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': That's a sad story. He used to help me guard this temple, but for some reason he went out of his mind.

''Jogador'': '''norma'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': She recently opened a little bar north of this village.

''Jogador'': '''paulie'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': He is the bank clerk, making sure your money remains safe.

''Jogador'': '''king'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': Well, King Tibianus of course. The island of Rookgaard belongs to his kingdom.

''Jogador'': '''tom'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': Tom is the main provider for leather armor in this village. You can sell fresh corpses or even minotaur leather to him.

''Jogador'': '''zerbrus'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': May the gods bless our loyal guardsmen! Day and night they stand watch on our bridges, ensuring that it is not passed by dangerous monsters!

''Jogador'': '''santiago'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': I absolutely appreciate what he's doing. He has helped me a lot since he took up the job of welcoming newcomers to this island.

''Jogador'': '''zirella'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': That old lady hasn't had an easy life. Her son Tom completely abandoned her, but I have no idea why.

-----

=== Ao pedir dicas: ===
''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': If you don't know the meaning of an icon on the right side, move the mouse cursor on it and wait a moment.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': Send private messages to other players by right-clicking on the player or the player's name and select 'Message to ....'. You can also open a 'private message channel' and type in the name of the player.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': Use the shortcuts 'SHIFT' to look, 'CTRL' for use and 'ALT' for attack when clicking on an object or player.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': If you already know where you want to go, click on the automap and your character will walk there automatically if the location is reachable and not too far away.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': To open or close skills, battle or VIP list, click on the corresponding button to the right.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': 'Capacity' restricts the amount of things you can carry with you. It raises with each level.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': Always have a look on your health bar. If you see that you do not regenerate health points anymore, eat something.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': Always eat as much food as possible. This way, you'll regenerate health points for a longer period of time.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': After you have killed a monster, you have 10 seconds in which the corpse is not moveable and no one else but you can loot it.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': Be careful when you approach three or more monsters because you only can block the attacks of two. In such a situation even a few rats can do severe damage or even kill you.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': There are many ways to gather food. Many creatures drop food but you can also pick blueberries or bake your own bread. If you have a fishing rod and worms in your inventory, you can also try to catch a fish.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': Baking bread is rather complex. First of all you need a scythe to harvest wheat. Then you use the wheat with a millstone to get flour. ...</br>
'''Cipfried''': This can be be used on water to get dough, which can be used on an oven to bake bread. Use milk instead of water to get cake dough.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': Dying hurts! Better run away than risk your life. You are going to lose experience and skill points when you die.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': When you switch to 'Offensive Fighting', you deal out more damage but you also get hurt more easily.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': When you are on low health and need to run away from a monster, switch to 'Defensive Fighting' and the monster will hit you less severely.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': Many creatures try to run away from you. Select 'Chase Opponent' to follow them.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': The deeper you enter a dungeon, the more dangerous it will be. Approach every dungeon with utmost care or an unexpected creature might kill you. This will result in losing experience and skill points.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': Due to the perspective, some objects in Tibia are not located at the spot they seem to appear (ladders, windows, lamps). Try clicking on the floor tile the object would lie on.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': If you want to trade an item with another player, right-click on the item and select 'Trade with ...', then click on the player with whom you want to trade.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': Stairs, ladders and dungeon entrances are marked as yellow dots on the automap.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': You can get food by killing animals or monsters. You can also pick blueberries or bake your own bread. If you are too lazy or own too much money, you can also buy food.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': Quest containers can be recognised easily. They don't open up regularly but display a message 'You have found ....'. They can only be opened once.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': Better run away than risk to die. You'll lose experience and skill points each time you die.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': You can form a party by right-clicking on a player and selecting 'Invite to Party'. The party leader can also enable 'Shared Experience' by right-clicking on him- or herself.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': You can assign spells, the use of items, or random text to 'hotkeys'. You find them under 'Options'.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': You can also follow other players. Just right-click on the player and select 'Follow'.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': You can found a party with your friends by right-clicking on a player and selecting 'Invite to Party'. If you are invited to a party, right-click on yourself and select 'Join Party'.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': Only found parties with people you trust. You can attack people in your party without getting a skull. This is helpful for training your skills, but can be abused to kill people without having to fear negative consequences.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': The leader of a party has the option to distribute gathered experience among all players in the party. If you are the leader, right-click on yourself and select 'Enable Shared Experience'.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': There is nothing more I can tell you. If you are still in need of some hints, I can repeat them for you.

-----

''Jogador'': '''bye'''</br>
'''Cipfried''': Farewell, ''Jogador''!
}}

== Frases Espontâneas ==
'''Dixi''': <CLEARS THROAT> GET YOUR ARMOR AND SHIELDS HEEEEEEERE! UPSTAIRS!</br>
'''Dixi''': Need some help? Just ask me, I can show you around!</br>
'''Dixi''': Don't forget to protect yourself with a shield!</br>
'''Dixi''': Selling the finest armors on Rookgaard!</br>
'''Dixi''': Don't let these mean monsters hurt you - get better equipment now!

== Palavras-Chave ==
''Jogador'': '''hi''' ''(Se o seu personagem for homem)''</br>
'''Dixi''': Good day, Sir. How may I help you, ''Jogador''? If you like to see my offers, simply ask me for a trade!

''Jogador'': '''hi''' ''(Se o seu personagem for mulher)''</br>
'''Dixi''': Good day, Mam. How may I help you, ''Jogador''? If you like to see my offers, simply ask me for a trade!

-----

=== Outras palavras-chave: ===
''Jogador'': '''job'''</br>
'''Dixi''': I'm helping my grandfather Obi with this shop. If you like to see my offers, simply ask me for a trade!

''Jogador'': '''name'''</br>
'''Dixi''': I'm Dixi.

''Jogador'': '''dixi'''</br>
'''Dixi''': Did I hear my name somewhere?

''Jogador'': '''time'''</br>
'''Dixi''': It's ''horas''.

''Jogador'': '''help'''</br>
'''Dixi''': How can I help you? I can give you general hints, information about citizens or talk about many other topics. Just ask me!

''Jogador'': '''sell'''</br>
'''Dixi''': Just ask me for a trade to see what I buy from you.

''Jogador'': '''weapon'''</br>
'''Dixi''': Oh, I'm sorry, but my grandfather Obi doesn't like seeing me waving around with pointy things. He sells weapons himself, just go downstairs!

''Jogador'': '''club'''</br>
'''Dixi''': I'm sorry, we don't buy this.

''Jogador'': '''stuff''' / '''wares''' / '''offer'''</br>
'''Dixi''': Me and my grandfather Obi sell equipment of all kinds. Just ask him or me for a trade if you like to see our offers.

''Jogador'': '''backpack''' / '''rope''' / '''shovel''' / '''fishing'''</br>
'''Dixi''': You should never embark on an adventure without it. Ask Al Dee or Lee'Delle for it!

''Jogador'': '''worm'''</br>
'''Dixi''': YUCK!

''Jogador'': '''torch'''</br>
'''Dixi''': If you need a torch, go see Al Dee's store.

''Jogador'': '''armor''' / '''shield''' / '''helmet'''</br>
'''Dixi''': Yes, I can sell that to you. Just ask me for a trade to see what I buy from you.

''Jogador'': '''equipment'''</br>
'''Dixi''': As an adventurer, you should always have at least a backpack, a rope, a shovel, a weapon, an armor and a shield.

''Jogador'': '''monster'''</br>
'''Dixi''': If you want to fight monsters in dungeons, you definitely need some good equipment such as a weapon, an armor and a shield.

''Jogador'': '''rookgaard'''</br>
'''Dixi''': Our lovely village will provide shelter for you. Once you are level 8, you can travel to mainland and choose a profession.

''Jogador'': '''premium'''</br>
'''Dixi''': As a premium adventurer you can visit different regions on this island, trade with Lee'Delle and much more.

''Jogador'': '''potions'''</br>
'''Dixi''': Lily sells effective health potions and antidote potions against poison.

''Jogador'': '''bank'''</br>
'''Dixi''': You can deposit your money there to keep it safe. However, you still need cash to buy something here.

''Jogador'': '''king'''</br>
'''Dixi''': King Tibianus is a wise and noble monarch. This island of Rookgaard belongs to his kingdom.

''Jogador'': '''academy'''</br>
'''Dixi''': The big building in the centre of Rookgaard. They have a library, a training centre, a bank and the room of the oracle. Seymour is the teacher there.

''Jogador'': '''destiny'''</br>
'''Dixi''': The Island of Destiny can be reached via the oracle once you are level 8. This trip will help you choose your profession!

''Jogador'': '''food'''</br>
'''Dixi''': Are you hungry? Then you should visit Willie or Billy in the West of town. Norma also has yummy stuff! Oh, and you could pick blueberries or eat the food some monsters carry with them.

''Jogador'': '''dungeons'''</br>
'''Dixi''': You need to make sure you have some basic equipment before you head into dungeons such as the sewers.

''Jogador'': '''mainland'''</br>
'''Dixi''': The main continent provides so many adventures! Once you've reached level 8, you should talk to the oracle. You can choose a profession and explore much more of Tibia.

''Jogador'': '''profession'''</br>
'''Dixi''': You will learn everything you need to know about professions once you reach the Island of Destiny.

''Jogador'': '''merchants'''</br>
'''Dixi''': To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a trade.

''Jogador'': '''money''' / '''gold'''</br>
'''Dixi''': I'm sorry honey, but I can't lend you gold. Earn it yourself by fighting monsters and picking up the things they carry. Sell it to merchants to make profit!

''Jogador'': '''blueberr'''</br>
'''Dixi''': There are many blueberry bushes in and around this village. Just use them to your liking!

''Jogador'': '''sewer'''</br>
'''Dixi''': There is a sewer grate which you can use to enter the sewers just left of this building. Eww, this smell!

-----

=== Sobre NPCs: ===
''Jogador'': '''al dee'''</br>
'''Dixi''': In Al Dee's shop you will find important general equipment such as ropes, shovels and torches.

''Jogador'': '''amber'''</br>
'''Dixi''': One day, I want to become a brave adventurer like her and leave this town!

''Jogador'': '''billy'''</br>
'''Dixi''': Billy can be kind of scary. He swears a lot and doesn't talk to everybody.

''Jogador'': '''cipfried'''</br>
'''Dixi''': He can heal you if you're injured or poisoned.

''Jogador'': '''dallheim'''</br>
'''Dixi''': He's one of our reliable guardsmen. Without them, many monsters would roam the village of Rookgaard!

''Jogador'': '''hyacinth'''</br>
'''Dixi''': I think he's a bit strange, living alone outside this village. How can he dislike to chat with everybody here?

''Jogador'': '''lee'delle'''</br>
'''Dixi''': Lee'Delle's shop is on the premium side of the village. You should visit it!

''Jogador'': '''lily'''</br>
'''Dixi''': I always give my cookies and blueberries to Lily. She loves them! Also, she sells potions.

''Jogador'': '''loui'''</br>
'''Dixi''': I never understand what he's talking about.

''Jogador'': '''norma'''</br>
'''Dixi''': Norma used to sell equipment, but she finally earned enough money to fulfil one of her dreams - her own bar!

''Jogador'': '''obi'''</br>
'''Dixi''': Obi is my beloved grandfather. He sells weapons, most of them forged by himself!

''Jogador'': '''paulie'''</br>
'''Dixi''': He is the local bank clerk.

''Jogador'': '''seymour'''</br>
'''Dixi''': Seymour is a loyal follower of the king and a teacher in the academy.

''Jogador'': '''oracle'''</br>
'''Dixi''': You can find the oracle on the top floor of the academy, just above Seymour. Go there when you are level 8 to find your destiny.

''Jogador'': '''tom'''</br>
'''Dixi''': I wish he would talk to his mother Zirella again. I feel so sorry for her. Anyway, as Tom is a tanner, you can sell leather and fresh corpses to him.

''Jogador'': '''willie'''</br>
'''Dixi''': Uncle Willie and Billy are farmers, which means they are a good place to sell and buy food.

''Jogador'': '''zirella'''</br>
'''Dixi''': Sometimes, I help Zirella collecting wood. Her old back aches all the time. It's a shame her son Tom doesn't help her.

''Jogador'': '''zerbrus'''</br>
'''Dixi''': He's one of our reliable guardsmen. Without them, many monsters would roam the village of Rookgaard!

-----

=== Ao pedir dicas: ===
''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Dixi''': If you don't know the meaning of an icon on the right side, move the mouse cursor on it and wait a moment.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Dixi''': Send private messages to other players by right-clicking on the player or the player's name and select 'Message to ....'. You can also open a 'private message channel' and type in the name of the player.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Dixi''': Use the shortcuts 'SHIFT' to look, 'CTRL' for use and 'ALT' for attack when clicking on an object or player.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Dixi''': If you already know where you want to go, click on the automap and your character will walk there automatically if the location is reachable and not too far away.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Dixi''': To open or close skills, battle or VIP list, click on the corresponding button to the right.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Dixi''': 'Capacity' restricts the amount of things you can carry with you. It raises with each level.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Dixi''': Always have a look on your health bar. If you see that you do not regenerate health points anymore, eat something.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Dixi''': Always eat as much food as possible. This way, you'll regenerate health points for a longer period of time.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Dixi''': After you have killed a monster, you have 10 seconds in which the corpse is not moveable and no one else but you can loot it.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Dixi''': Be careful when you approach three or more monsters because you only can block the attacks of two. In such a situation even a few rats can do severe damage or even kill you.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Dixi''': There are many ways to gather food. Many creatures drop food but you can also pick blueberries or bake your own bread. If you have a fishing rod and worms in your inventory, you can also try to catch a fish.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Dixi''': Baking bread is rather complex. First of all you need a scythe to harvest wheat. Then you use the wheat with a millstone to get flour. ...</br>
'''Dixi''': This can be be used on water to get dough, which can be used on an oven to bake bread. Use milk instead of water to get cake dough.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Dixi''': Dying hurts! Better run away than risk your life. You are going to lose experience and skill points when you die.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Dixi''': When you switch to 'Offensive Fighting', you deal out more damage but you also get hurt more easily.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Dixi''': When you are on low health and need to run away from a monster, switch to 'Defensive Fighting' and the monster will hit you less severely.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Dixi''': Many creatures try to run away from you. Select 'Chase Opponent' to follow them.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Dixi''': The deeper you enter a dungeon, the more dangerous it will be. Approach every dungeon with utmost care or an unexpected creature might kill you. This will result in losing experience and skill points.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Dixi''': Due to the perspective, some objects in Tibia are not located at the spot they seem to appear (ladders, windows, lamps). Try clicking on the floor tile the object would lie on.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Dixi''': If you want to trade an item with another player, right-click on the item and select 'Trade with ...', then click on the player with whom you want to trade.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Dixi''': Stairs, ladders and dungeon entrances are marked as yellow dots on the automap.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Dixi''': You can get food by killing animals or monsters. You can also pick blueberries or bake your own bread. If you are too lazy or own too much money, you can also buy food.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Dixi''': Quest containers can be recognised easily. They don't open up regularly but display a message 'You have found ....'. They can only be opened once.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Dixi''': Better run away than risk to die. You'll lose experience and skill points each time you die.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Dixi''': You can form a party by right-clicking on a player and selecting 'Invite to Party'. The party leader can also enable 'Shared Experience' by right-clicking on him- or herself.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Dixi''': You can assign spells, the use of items, or random text to 'hotkeys'. You find them under 'Options'.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Dixi''': You can also follow other players. Just right-click on the player and select 'Follow'.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Dixi''': You can found a party with your friends by right-clicking on a player and selecting 'Invite to Party'. If you are invited to a party, right-click on yourself and select 'Join Party'.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Dixi''': Only found parties with people you trust. You can attack people in your party without getting a skull. This is helpful for training your skills, but can be abused to kill people without having to fear negative consequences.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Dixi''': The leader of a party has the option to distribute gathered experience among all players in the party. If you are the leader, right-click on yourself and select 'Enable Shared Experience'.

''Jogador'': '''hint'''</br>
'''Dixi''': There is nothing more I can tell you. If you are still in need of some hints, I can repeat them for you.

-----

''Jogador'': '''bye''' ''(Se o seu personagem for homem)''</br>
'''Dixi''': Good bye, Sir.

''Jogador'': '''bye''' ''(Se o seu personagem for mulher)''</br>
'''Dixi''': Good bye, Mam.
}}

''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''</br>
'''Hyacinth:''' Greetings, traveller ''Jogador''.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Gods'''</br>
'''Hyacinth:''' Teaching you about the gods would require too much time. But you can always read the books in the library.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''</br>
'''Hyacinth:''' I am a druid and healer, a follower of Crunor.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Name'''</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Time'''</br>

''Jogador:'' '''King'''</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''</br>
'''Hyacinth:''' May Crunor bless you.

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Buddel | job = Balseiro | job2 = Bêbado | npcclass = Humanos | npcsprite = Barbarian | city = Hrodmir | subarea = Helheim, Krimhorn, Okolnir, Svargrond, Tyrsung | location = [[Helheim]] ({{mapa|32462,31173,7:2|aqui}}), [[Krimhorn]] ({{mapa|32020,31294,7:2|aqui}}), [[Okolnir]] ({{mapa|32224,31381,7:2|aqui}}), [[Svargrond]] ({{Mapa|32255,31197,7:2|aqui}}) e [[Tyrsung]] ({{Mapa|32332,31227,7:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.0 | buysell = sim | buys = {{Trades/Buy | Compass}} | sells = Nada. | notes = O embriagado velejador Buddel pode levar você para algumas ilhas de gelo por 50 [[gp]], os destinos válidos são [[Helheim]], [[Krimhorn]], [[Okolnir]], [[Svargrond]] e [[Tyrsung]]. Mas cuidado! Este NPC esta sempre bêbado e por isso é muito provável que ele irá levar você para lugares errados ocasionalmente. Levando um [[Dwarven Ring]] em sua [[Backpack]] faz levar você para o lugar certo mas você pode perder o anel. Quando o [[Dwarven Ring]] é usado você também não tem que pagar os 50 [[gp]]s. Para que ele te leve para a regiões dos acampamentos de bárbaros: [[Bittermor]], [[Krimhorn]] ou [[Ragnir]], você deve usar a palavra-chave '''Barbarian Camp''' quando o NPC perguntar para onde quer ir.

* É necessário completar as missões do ''Barbarian Test'' da [[The Ice Islands Quest]] para utilizar os serviços de Buddel.

[[Buddel]]: Hey big guys. *HICKS*

''Jogador:'' ''Jogador''
[[Buddel]]: Ahh, ''Jogador''. And you?
''Jogador:'' '''''Jogador'' '''
[[Buddel]]: You are also called ''Jogador''?!?!? Your mother was not very inventive *HICKS* but very convenient. ...

''Jogador:'' '''''Any Name'''''
[[Buddel]]: Aha! And you?
''Jogador:'' '''''Any Name'''''
[[Buddel]]: Huhuhu,..... er..... shouldn't be offensive, but this is a funny name you have! 3. primeiro nome, qualquer nome como o segundo: ''Jogador:'' '''Name'''
[[Buddel]]: There was a time I was called Bejorn. But everyone calls me Buddel. ..... and you are?
''Jogador:'' '''''Jogador'''''
[[Buddel]]: Ahh, ''Jogador''. And you?
''Jogador:'' '''''Any Name'''''
[[Buddel]]: Huhuhu,..... er..... shouldn't be offensive, but this is a funny name you have! 4. Um nome como o primeiro, o nome do jogador como o segundo: ''Jogador:'' '''Name'''
[[Buddel]]: There was a time I was called Bejorn. But everyone calls me Buddel. ..... and you are?
''Jogador:'' '''''any name'''''

[[Buddel]]: I am a fisher aaaaaaand maybe I can show you the other islands. Depends on how good I know you two. Just ask me for a passage!

[[Buddel]]: I'M THE KING OF THIS SHIP AND ALL RUM FLASKS IN IT!!

[[Buddel]]: Druids are strange. Are you two druids? Er, not that you look strange!! No, no, no! *HICKS*
''Jogador:'' '''Shamans'''

''Jogador:'' '''Ferumbras'''

''Jogador:'' '''Breezelda'''

[[Buddel]]: *HICKS* Big, big island east of here. Venorian hunters settled there ..... I could bring you north of their camp.
''Jogador:'' '''Helheim'''
[[Buddel]]: T'at is a small island to the east.
''Jogador:'' '''Camp'''

''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''</br>
'''Imbul:''' Hi, ''Jogador''. If you wat me to transport you to the other end of the city, feel free to ask me for a passage.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''</br>
'''Imbul:''' My name is mbul.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''</br>
'''Imbul:''' I'm a ferryan. If you want me to transport you to the other end of the city, feel free to ask me for a passage.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Passage'''</br>
'''Imbul:''' I can bring youeither to the east end of Port Hope or to the centre of the town, where would you like to go?</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Tibia'''</br>
'''Imbul:''' That is our wrld, yes.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Thais'''</br>
'''Imbul:''' It's where th king lives. The roads there must be made of gold or marble at least.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Carlin'''</br>
'''Imbul:''' It's a city, Iknow that.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Venore'''</br>
'''Imbul:''' Here are many eople from Venore. I used to live there but I lost my job and took the chance to come here.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Kazordoon'''</br>
'''Imbul:''' I think those dwaves came from Kazordoon.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Ab'Dendriel'''</br>
'''Imbul:''' What is that?</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Darama'''</br>
'''Imbul:''' Many came hereto make their fortune. But it might take a while to become rich.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Darashia'''</br>
'''Imbul:''' That's somewherebehind that mountain.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Ankrahmun'''</br>
'''Imbul:''' I heard it's a ghst town or something like that.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Ferumbras'''</br>
'''Imbul:''' Why have some magcians to become evil?</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Excalibug'''</br>
'''Imbul:''' I never heard abot that.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''King'''</br>
'''Imbul:''' It must be fn to be a king.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Time'''</br>
'''Imbul:''' Sorry, I dont own a watch.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Jungle'''</br>
'''Imbul:''' We already los many settlers to the jungle. No one knows who is next.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Dwarfs'''</br>
'''Imbul:''' The dwarves tht live here are searching for gold.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Elfs'''</br>
'''Imbul:''' The elven quen is the most beautiful woman in Tibia.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''</br>
'''Imbul:''' Bye.</br>
}}<noinclude>[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]</noinclude>

pages.title: Old Adall
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Old Adall | job = Balseiro | city = Tiquanda | subarea = Port Hope | location = [[Port Hope]] ({{Mapa|32632,32769,7:1|aqui}}). | implemented = 7.5 | notes = Adall atualmente é balseiro em Port Hope mas em sua juventude foi um marinheiro. Passou boa parte de sua vida em Thais. Ele transporta qualquer um em Port Hope por balsa para: * Área oeste da cidade, no [[NPC]] [[Imbul]] por 7 [[gp]]s, {{mapa|32558,32780,7:4|aqui}}. * Área leste da cidade, no [[NPC]] [[Lorek]] por 7 [[gp]]s, {{mapa|32679,32776,7:4|aqui}}. {{Veja|Balsas de Port Hope}} | buysell = não | buys = | sells = | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Old Adall:''' Hi, ''Jogador''. Need a passage?
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''
'''Old Adall:''' My name is Adall but everyone is calling me old Adall.
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
'''Old Adall:''' I am a ferryman now, in my youth I was a sailor though. If you want to travel to one of the ends of the town, just ask me for a passage.
''Jogador:'' '''Passage'''
'''Old Adall:''' I can bring you either to the east end of Port Hope or to the west end of the town, where would you like to go?
''Jogador:'' '''Tibia'''
'''Old Adall:''' The world offers much to discover. Whether you find your fortune or your doom, it is a private thing between you and fate though.
''Jogador:'' '''Thais'''
'''Old Adall:''' It used to be a lovely town but over the years it has become crowded and noisy.
''Jogador:'' '''Carlin'''
'''Old Adall:''' Hehe, it's not such a bad town for a visit, as long as you have your own alcohol on board and are not catched drunk in the city. I had to learn it the hard way and was arrested twice in my youth.
''Jogador:'' '''Venore'''
'''Old Adall:''' Those newcomers have quite an attitude and it is growing worse with the years. Ambition, ambition. It's all about ambition.
''Jogador:'' '''Kazordoon'''
'''Old Adall:''' I have never seen this inland town on my own.
''Jogador:'' '''Ab'Dendriel'''
'''Old Adall:''' A curious town of curious people but I have seen odder things during my travels.
''Jogador:'' '''Edron'''
'''Old Adall:''' Edron is not the lovely little isle people tend to think it is. There are secrets and ancient evil beneath the ground. Things that had better been left buried, have been unearthed.
''Jogador:'' '''Darama'''
'''Old Adall:''' One might think it's a strange place for an old man to settle down but I never had a child and I like to see this settlement grow and come of age in my last days.
''Jogador:'' '''Darashia'''
'''Old Adall:''' The people of Darashia are friendly. Still there is nothing exciting that would justify a voyage there.
''Jogador:'' '''Ankrahmun'''
'''Old Adall:''' That city has given me the creeps for as long as I have known about it. Whenever we sailed there, I had a bad feeling of impending doom.
''Jogador:'' '''Ferumbras'''
'''Old Adall:''' I wonder if he's the Thaian version of the boogey man.
''Jogador:'' '''Excalibug'''
'''Old Adall:''' I heard about that weapon in each and every harbour I have visited. Never heard more than rumours though.
''Jogador:'' '''King'''
'''Old Adall:''' I saw the king and even his father. Thais used the be my home port in the old times.
''Jogador:'' '''Time'''
'''Old Adall:''' Hehe, old men have no need for watches. Watches are mocking you, you know?
''Jogador:'' '''Jungle'''
'''Old Adall:''' The challenge the jungle is providing is something for the young and daring. I am not going to leave the security of the town, I'll just stay here and watch how things turn out.
''Jogador:'' '''Dwarfs'''
'''Old Adall:''' Some dwarves joined the colony. They are looking for treasures and minerals in the jungle.
''Jogador:'' '''Elfs'''
'''Old Adall:''' Elves are somewhat strange but most get along well with humans.
''Jogador:'' '''Watch'''
'''Old Adall:''' Watches seem to tell you that not much time is left and how much time you have already lost. They only remind you of everything that is already gone and all the things you will never achieve.
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
'''Old Adall:''' Bye. }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]
