pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Siflind | job = Shaman | job2 = Comerciante de Itens Mágicos | city = Hrodmir | subarea = Nibelor | location = [[Nibelor]] ({{mapa|32359,31029,6:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.0 | notes = Como [[Hjaern]], Siflind é extremamente adepta a arte de espíritos. Ela precisa de sua ajuda para lutar contra espíritos e criaturas.

* Animal Cure é somente vendido durante a [[In Service of Yalahar Quest]] e não aparece no [[NPC Trade]], sendo necessário conversar com npc.

 | buysell = sim | buys = {{Trades/Buy | Empty Potion Flask (Small) | Empty Potion Flask (Medium) | Empty Potion Flask (Large) | Spellwand | Vial}} | sells = {{Trades/Sell | Avalanche Rune | Blank Rune | Chameleon Rune | Convince Creature Rune | Cure Poison Rune | Destroy Field Rune | Durable Exercise Rod | Durable Exercise Wand | Energy Field Rune | Energy Wall Rune | Exercise Rod | Exercise Wand | Explosion Rune | Fire Bomb Rune | Fire Field Rune | Fire Wall Rune | Great Fireball Rune | Great Health Potion | Great Mana Potion | Great Spirit Potion | Hailstorm Rod | Health Potion | Heavy Magic Missile Rune | Intense Healing Rune | Lasting Exercise Rod | Lasting Exercise Wand | Light Magic Missile Rune | Mana Potion | Moonlight Rod | Necrotic Rod | Northwind Rod | Poison Field Rune | Poison Wall Rune | Snakebite Rod | Spellbook | Spellbook of the Novice | Springsprout Rod | Stalagmite Rune | Strong Health Potion | Strong Mana Potion | Sudden Death Rune | Supreme Health Potion | Terra Rod | The Scorcher | The Chiller | Ultimate Health Potion | Ultimate Healing Rune | Ultimate Mana Potion | Ultimate Spirit Potion | Underworld Rod | Wand of Cosmic Energy | Wand of Decay | Wand of Draconia | Wand of Dragonbreath | Wand of Inferno | Wand of Starstorm | Wand of Voodoo | Wand of Vortex}} Somente durante uma quest. {{Trades/Sell | Animal Cure}} | falas = ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Siflind:''' Be greeted, ''Jogador''. If you are in need of potions or magical equipment, just ask me about my offers.
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''
'''Siflind:''' I am Siflind, my child.
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
'''Siflind:''' I am a shaman. That should tell you everything you want to know, my child. But I also sell some potions, wands and runes.
''Jogador:'' '''Offers'''
'''Siflind:''' I'm selling spirit, health and mana potions, runes, wands, rods and spellbooks. If you'd like to see all of my offers, ask me for a trade.
''Jogador:'' '''Trade'''
'''Siflind:''' Of course, just browse through my wares. Or do you want to look only at potions, wands or runes?
''Jogador:'' '''News'''
'''Siflind:''' News are usually bad news in these times. So be happy if there aren't any news.
''Jogador:'' '''Rumours'''
'''Siflind:''' I don't think much of rumours but in fact there is a story that always comes to my mind. It is more a tale than a rumour, but anyway ...... it says the chakoyas have not always been that hostile. ...
'''Siflind:''' There must have been an incident that shook their trust in manhood so strongly that it would last forever. Imagine that we could be friends if only that incident never happened ......... whatever that was.
''Jogador:'' '''Chakoyas'''
'''Siflind:''' The chakoyas can be a terrible menace if they aren't kept away.
''Jogador:'' '''Yeti'''
'''Siflind:''' Even an old woman like me has not seen a yeti yet. However, this does not mean that they don't exist.
''Jogador:'' '''Cult'''
'''Siflind:''' I heard a secretive group of people passed Svargrond a while ago. Later others followed. We don't know why they came here and where they went.
''Jogador:'' '''Svargrond'''
'''Siflind:''' The city seems to have brought the needed stability and peace to my people.
''Jogador:'' '''Barbarian'''
'''Siflind:''' We barbarians are proud people.
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
'''Siflind:''' Good bye and take care, ''Jogador''. }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.title: Chondur
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Chondur | job = Shaman | city = Vandura | subarea = Meriana | location = [[Meriana]] ({{Mapa|32362,32549,7:1|aqui}}). | implemented = 7.8 | notes = Chondur é o voodoomaster local, responsável pela maioria dos encantamentos à respeito de alguns habitantes de Sabrehaven.

* Faz parte da [[Shaman Outfits Quest]]. * Faz parte da [[The Shattered Isles Quest]]. * Faz parte da [[The Blessed Stake Quest]]. * Ele pode te dar a montaria [[Stampor (Mount)|Stampor]] se você entregar 30 [[Hollow Stampor Hoof]], 50 [[Stampor Horn]] e 100 [[Stampor Talon]] para ele.

| buysell = sim | buys = {{Trades/Buy |Black Skull (Item) |Blood Goblet |Blood Herb |Enigmatic Voodoo Skull |Mysterious Voodoo Skull}} | sells = Nada. | falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == '''Chondur''': Spirits of the ancestors, guide me. == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Chondur''': Be greeted, child. What do you want in an old shaman’s hut? ''Jogador'': '''job''' / '''shaman'''
'''Chondur''': I was chosen by the spirits of the ancestors to serve the people as healer and spiritual leader. ''Jogador'': '''banana'''
'''Chondur''': A banana staff is the sign of a high ape magician. ''Jogador'': '''barrier''' / '''energy'''
'''Chondur''': Ah, the energy barrier set up by the cult is maintained by lousy magic, but it’s still effective. Without a proper counterspell, you won’t be able to pass it. ''Jogador'': '''counterspell''' / '''ritual'''
'''Chondur''': Hm. I don’t think you need another one of my counterspells to cross the barrier on Goroma. ''Jogador'': '''cult'''
'''Chondur''': The cult is a mockery of true voodoo. They play with powers they don’t even rudimentarily understand and some dark and sinister power is working behind the curtains. Some evil puppet master is misusing them for plans unknown to me. ''Jogador'': '''cure'''
'''Chondur''': It’s my part to cure the body and the spirit. Only the people can cure the land they inhabit. ''Jogador'': '''goroma'''
'''Chondur''': One of the Forbidden Islands. No sane captain will agree to bring you there. ''Jogador'': '''governor'''
'''Chondur''': The man is a captive of his orders and papers. He lacks to see the true world of spirituality. ''Jogador'': '''king'''
'''Chondur''': The king is far away. Our myth are closer to us than any king in faraway Thais could ever be. ''Jogador'': '''loveless''' / '''theodore'''
'''Chondur''': I sense no evil in this man. Actually I sense nothing in him. This man is hollow and has more of a machine than of a person. ''Jogador'': '''pirate'''
'''Chondur''': You have to understand that there are two groups of people that are called pirates. One consists of evil thieves and murderers for whom the word pirate actually stands for. …
'''Chondur''': The others are resistance fighters for whom old ideals are hold true and that are the assertors of the native people. ''Jogador'': '''plantations'''
'''Chondur''': In the past the plantations were in possession of free people who enjoyed their work. The workers were singing about the joy of live. Nowadays, their songs have turned melancholic. ''Jogador'': '''quara'''
'''Chondur''': This race rose from slavery to a shadow of their former masters. The dark power that once ruled the ocean here was annihilated by some disaster and the quara used to be one of their serving races. ''Jogador'': '''striker'''
'''Chondur''': He is a venturous man with honour and ideals. ''Jogador'': '''rum'''
'''Chondur''': The rum is the only thing left to give some comfort to the most desperate. And there are many of them these days. ''Jogador'': '''sugar'''
'''Chondur''': The sugar belongs to the native people of the isles, not to greedy trade barons or oppressors. ''Jogador'': '''thais'''
'''Chondur''': The people see the Thaian occupation like a crippling disease that befalls our isles. Some try to live with it, others are looking for a cure. ''Jogador'': '''trade'''
'''Chondur''': Well, I currently buy mysterious and enigmatic voodoo skulls and a few other things I might need for my rituals. ''Jogador'': '''tribal mask'''
'''Chondur''': Sometimes dworcs are seen with these masks. ''Jogador'': '''venore'''
'''Chondur''': The tradesmen of Venore are tainted with greed. They have so little spirituality that their souls must be starving. ''Jogador'': '''magic currents'''
'''Chondur''': Hm, well one could call it like this I guess. Magic is strong on these isles. Too strong for many to handle it safely. ''Jogador'': '''voodoo'''
'''Chondur''': Together with the spirits of the ancestors, I seek for wisdom. Together we can change the flow of magic to do things that are beyond the limits of ordinary magic. …
'''Chondur''': In conversations with the spirits, I gain insight into secrets that would have been lost otherwise. ''Jogador'': '''wyrmslicer'''
'''Chondur''': Great anger leads to great danger. In his pride he is too blind to see the obvious truth. That makes him a dangerous man. ''Jogador'': '''secrets'''
'''Chondur''': The spirits speak about a great battle on these isles. Cause for the conflict was the strong magic here. …
'''Chondur''': The peaceful dwellers, that used to live here in a magical paradise created by themselves, were attacked by a dark power from the depths of the ocean. …
'''Chondur''': The war destroyed both races and changed the flow of magic forever. ''Jogador'': '''dark power'''
'''Chondur''': In the shadow of the depth, a strange and enigmatic race evolved. Using magic to the darkest purposes. …
'''Chondur''': What they lacked in understanding magic like the dwellers, they made up for in number and destructive determination. ''Jogador'': '''forever''' / '''disaster'''
'''Chondur''': Yes, the ancestors hint that there has been some disaster in the past that disarranged the magic of the isles and destroyed whole civilisations. ''Jogador'': '''disarranged'''
'''Chondur''': Hm, well one could call it like this I guess. Magic is strong on these isles. Too strong for many to handle it safely. ''Jogador'': '''civilisations'''
'''Chondur''': The spirits tell about two powerful races that once called this area their home. They annihilated themselves in a war. ''Jogador'': '''spirits''' / '''ghosts'''
'''Chondur''': Spirits are all around us and on these isles they are especially strong and numerous. ''Jogador'': '''isles'''
'''Chondur''': These isles are a place of strong but secret magic. This magic is strong enough to devour the souls of the weak. ''Jogador'': '''magic'''
'''Chondur''': Magic here is like a powerful and wild beast. You need all your strength to master it. If you fail, your punishment will be swift and hard. Voodoo gives me the power and wisdom necessary to handle those energies. ''Jogador'': '''ancestors'''
'''Chondur''': The ancestors still have contact to the world of those alive. If you know how to talk to them, they can be wise guides and powerful friends. ''Jogador'': '''mermaid'''
'''Chondur''': The mermaids are a possible offspring of one of the magical creatures that some ancient race once created here. …
'''Chondur''': They are vain and self-centred. Their magic is powerful and almost impossible to reverse once it is cast on some human. …
'''Chondur''': The only good thing is they quickly lose interest into their victims if something of slightly more interest comes up. …
'''Chondur''': If you are ever in trouble with a mermaid, look for a distraction. ''Jogador'': '''stake'''
'''Chondur''': Would you like to receive a spiritual prayer to bless your stake? ''Jogador'': '''outfit''' / '''addon'''
'''Chondur''': The time has come, my child. I sense great spiritual wisdom in you and I shall grant you a sign of your progress if you can fulfil my task. ''Jogador'': '''task'''
'''Chondur''': Your task is to retrieve a mandrake from the Tiquandan jungle and 5 dworcish voodoo dolls. ''Jogador'': '''mandrake''' / '''doll'''
'''Chondur''': Have you gathered the mandrake and the 5 voodoo dolls from the dworcs? :''Jogador'': '''no'''
:'''Chondur''': Well, it seems you aren’t ready yet. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Chondur''': Good bye. }}

pages.title: Kjesse
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Kjesse | job = Sacerdote | job2 = Shaman | city = Hrodmir | subarea = Svargrond | location = [[Svargrond]] ({{mapa|32212,31133,7:1|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.0 | buysell = não | notes = Ele pode curá-lo e contar sobre as [[Blessing|Bênçãos]].

* Você pode conseguir uma pedra especial falando '''Hi - Adventurer's Stone - Yes''' para este NPC. * Se você usar uma [[Adventurer's Stone]] dentro de templo, você será teleportado para pequena ilha da [[Adventurers' Guild]].

| falas = ''Jogador'': '''Hi'''
[[Kjesse]]: May the spirits be with you, ''Jogador''!
''Jogador:'' '''Svargrond'''
[[Kjesse]]: There is nothing wrong with seeking the shelter of a city but we have to be careful not to lose our connection with the spirits.
''Jogador:'' '''Thais''' ou '''Carlin''' ou '''venore'''
[[Kjesse]]: Speak to the outsiders who live here to learn about them and their cities.
''Jogador:'' '''Edron'''
[[Kjesse]]: That is just another far away place of no concern to us.
''Jogador:'' '''Chakoya'''
[[Kjesse]]: Only the harsh nature of the land keeps the chakoyas at the bay. If they would grow in numbers, they would surely annihilate all life here.
''Jogador:'' '''Dwarf'''
[[Kjesse]]: Knowing the chakoya, we know better than to underestimate the small ones.
''Jogador:'' '''Elf'''
[[Kjesse]]: At least those creatures seem more in touch with nature then other outsiders.
''Jogador:'' '''Mine'''
[[Kjesse]]: The mines are lost territory. It's the problem of the people from Carlin though.
''Jogador:'' '''Yeti'''
[[Kjesse]]: The yeti does exist.
''Jogador:'' '''Cult'''
[[Kjesse]]: This is not of our concern.
''Jogador:'' '''Barbarian'''
[[Kjesse]]: In our old language it means as much as 'the true people'. I understand that the word has a slightly different meaning in other languages.
''Jogador:'' '''Blessing'''
[[Kjesse]]: There are five different blessings available in five sacred places. These blessings are: the spiritual shielding, the spark of the phoenix, the embrace of Tibia, the fire of the suns and the wisdom of solitude.
''Jogador:'' '''Wisdom'''
[[Kjesse]]: I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and recieved this blessing.
''Jogador:'' '''Years Of Serpents'''
[[Kjesse]]: It was not natural for the sea serpents to behave that way. As suddenly as this behaviour started, as suddenly it ended. Nature got its way in the end.
''Jogador:'' '''Jarl'''
[[Kjesse]]: The jarl oversees all affairs of common interest. We shamans oversee the spiritual affairs.
''Jogador:'' '''Raiders'''
[[Kjesse]]: They enjoy violence and destruction. They are so wrong on their misguided way. That's all Yakchal's fault. She poisoned their minds with false ideas. She's a disgrace for all shamans.
''Jogador:'' '''Shaman''' Ou '''druid'''
[[Kjesse]]: Even though we call ourself shamans, our doctrines and our magic are quite similar to those of the druids.
''Jogador:'' '''Chyll'''
[[Kjesse]]: That's the name of the spirit essence of the north wind.
''Jogador:'' '''Nibelor'''
[[Kjesse]]: The isle of Nibelor has been the centre of our shamanistic forefathers in ancient times.
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''
[[Kjesse]]: I am Kjesse.
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
[[Kjesse]]: I am a shaman.
''Jogador:'' '''Mission''' Ou '''task'''
[[Kjesse]]: Your mission should be to become one with nature. That is maybe the only way to bear Chyll's icy breath.
''Jogador:'' '''King'''
[[Kjesse]]: Our jarl is more of a spokesperson. We don't know any kings or queens here.
''Jogador:'' '''Queen'''
[[Kjesse]]: Our jarl is more of a spokesperson. We don't know any kings or queens here.
''Jogador:'' '''Gods'''
[[Kjesse]]: Our believes are different from those of the outsiders. Ask on Nibelor to learn more about our believes.
''Jogador:'' '''Ferumbras'''
[[Kjesse]]: He must be driven by the darkest spirits.
''Jogador:'' '''Excalibug'''
[[Kjesse]]: It's only an outsider's tale.
''Jogador:'' '''News'''
[[Kjesse]]: I am not overly interested in the affairs of men.
''Jogador:'' '''Offer'''
[[Kjesse]]: I have nothing to sell but I can tell you where to go if you want to get a blessing.
''Jogador:'' '''How Are You?'''
[[Kjesse]]: I am fine.
''Jogador:'' '''Rumours'''
[[Kjesse]]: It's rather a wisdom than a rumour I want to give you on your way. When you feel Chyll in your heart and you have no fear anymore, your way to Everspring will be flattened.
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
[[Kjesse]]: May the spirits guide your way, ''Jogador''. }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Obi | job = Comerciante de Armas | city = Thais | subarea = Rookgaard | location = [[Rookgaard]] ({{Mapa|32110,32203,7:2|aqui}}). | implemented = Pré-6.0 | notes = Compra e vende [[Weapons|armas]] para aventureiros. Sua neta [[Dixi]] trabalha no andar de cima e negocia [[Armor|armaduras]] e [[Shields|escudos]]. No topo da [[Wasp Tower]] há uma placa escrita: :"'''You read: Feeling ill?
Are you poisoned?
This does not have to happen to you again!
Buy quality armor at Obi's!'''" | buysell = sim | buys = {{Trades/Buy | Axe | Bone Club | Dagger | Hand Axe | Hatchet | Katana | Mace | Machete | Rapier | Sabre | Scythe, 3 | Short Sword | Sickle | Spear | Sword}} | sells = {{Trades/Sell | Axe, 20 | Dagger, 5 | Hand Axe, 8 | Rapier | Sabre, 25 | Scythe, 12 | Short Sword, 30 | Sickle, 8 | Spear, 10}} | falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == '''Obi''': Selling and buying all sorts of weapons, come and have a look!
'''Obi''': Give those monsters a good whipping with my weapons!
'''Obi''': Only quality steel and wood used for my weapons! == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Obi''': Hello, hello, ''Jogador''! Please come in, look, and buy! If you like to see my offers, ask me for a trade! ----- === Outras palavras-chave: === ''Jogador'': '''job'''
'''Obi''': I'm a merchant and the local weapon smith. If you like to see my quality wares or sell weapons to me, ask me for a trade. ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Obi''': My name is Obi, just Obi, the honest merchant. If you like to trade, just ask. ''Jogador'': '''how are you'''
'''Obi''': I'm fine. It's a little hot near the crucible, but I enjoy the sound of forging weapons. ''Jogador'': '''obi'''
'''Obi''': Yes, yes, that's my name. ''Jogador'': '''merchant'''
'''Obi''': Sadly, not many merchants are as honest as I am. ''Jogador'': '''time'''
'''Obi''': It's about ''horas''. Yes, ''horas''. I'm so sorry, I have no watches for sale. ''Jogador'': '''rookgaard'''
'''Obi''': Ah, Rookgaard. Home sweet home, that's what it became for me, but I will always miss Thais and Sam. ''Jogador'': '''bank'''
'''Obi''': If I were you, I'd invest my money in quality steel rather than putting it in a so-called safe bank account! ''Jogador'': '''money''' / '''gold'''
'''Obi''': Well, no gold, no deal. Earn gold by fighting monsters and picking up the things they carry. Sell it to merchants to make profit! ''Jogador'': '''thais'''
'''Obi''': Oh, Thais, I'll be back. One day, I'll be back. ''Jogador'': '''potion'''
'''Obi''': I wish I could help you with that, but no, I was told to stick to weapons. Go see Lily. ''Jogador'': '''weapon'''
'''Obi''': Yes, I'm selling weapons. Just ask me for a trade to see my offers and the things I buy from you. ''Jogador'': '''mainland'''
'''Obi''': Well, the mainland also consists of several continents. You can go there once you are level 8 and have talked to the oracle. ''Jogador'': '''academy'''
'''Obi''': I think good practice is better than reading a boring book. Of course, you will need proper equipment to be able to get practice! ''Jogador'': '''equipment'''
'''Obi''': As an adventurer you should always have at least a backpack, a rope, a shovel, a weapon, an armor and a shield. ''Jogador'': '''buy''' / '''offer''' / '''wares''' / '''stuff'''
'''Obi''': I sell weapons of all kinds. Just ask me for a trade if you like to see my offers. ''Jogador'': '''sell'''
'''Obi''': Just ask me for a trade to see which things I buy from you. ''Jogador'': '''armor''' / '''shield''' / '''helmet'''
'''Obi''': Oh, just upstairs. My granddaughter Dixi is in charge of selling armors and shields. ''Jogador'': '''weapoon'''
'''Obi''': Yes, I'm selling weapons. Just ask me for a trade to see my offers and the things I buy from you. ''Jogador'': '''club'''
'''Obi''': I don't buy this garbage! ''Jogador'': '''monster'''
'''Obi''': Good monsters to start with are rats. They live in the sewers under the village of Rookgaard. ''Jogador'': '''sewers'''
'''Obi''': There are many sewer entrances throughout Rookgaard. One is right outside this shop and to the left. For more details about monsters and dungeons, best talk to one of the guards. ''Jogador'': '''dungeon'''
'''Obi''': Be careful down there! Make sure you bought enough torches and a rope or you might get lost. ''Jogador'': '''rope''' / '''shovel''' / '''backpack'''
'''Obi''': I wish I could help you with that, but no, I was told to stick to weapons. Go see Al Dee or Lee'Delle. ''Jogador'': '''pick'''
'''Obi''': I am sorry, we are out of pick axes. I heard that old greedy Al Dee has some but he will charge a fortune. ''Jogador'': '''worm'''
'''Obi''': I don't buy worms. I only sell them. You can use them for fishing. Ask Al Dee if you need any. ''Jogador'': '''torch'''
'''Obi''': Al Dee sells torches. ''Jogador'': '''food'''
'''Obi''': I told them to let me sell food, but no! Sorry, you have to ask Willie or Billy on the farms west of here. ''Jogador'': '''blueberr'''
'''Obi''': There are many blueberry bushes in and around this village. Nature's for free. ''Jogador'': '''king'''
'''Obi''': The king encouraged salesmen to travel here, but only I dared to take the risk, and a risk it was! ''Jogador'': '''guard'''
'''Obi''': The bridge guard Dallheim is north of here, just follow the street, you can't miss it. ''Jogador'': '''tibia'''
'''Obi''': It's really heart-warming to see how the Tibia economy is prospering. ''Jogador'': '''thank'''
'''Obi''': Oh, you're welcome, very welcome. ''Jogador'': '''help'''
'''Obi''': Well, how can I help you? Do you need some general hints? Or, if you're interested in a trade, just ask. ----- === Sobre NPCs: === ''Jogador'': '''dallheim'''
'''Obi''': What a hero, what a hero. ''Jogador'': '''cipfried'''
'''Obi''': He shouldn't heal people for free, no he shouldn't. That would be a great source of income for the village that could be invested in enhancing the smithy. ''Jogador'': '''lily'''
'''Obi''': I knew it! I knew she would try to get the monopoly on potions in this village! But no one has listened to me! ''Jogador'': '''sam'''
'''Obi''': My good old cousin Sam. Oh, how I miss him. ''Jogador'': '''dixi'''
'''Obi''': Oh, what an endearing little girl, and she's working so hard to help me, even without receiving payment. Such a sweet little girl! ''Jogador'': '''loui'''
'''Obi''': I told him there was no danger, but he wouldn't listen to me, no one listens to me. ''Jogador'': '''billy'''
'''Obi''': He's just like his cousin Willie. ''Jogador'': '''willie'''
'''Obi''': This guy doesn't understand that he should entrust me with the food business, too. He really should do. Then he had time for his farm. ''Jogador'': '''zirella'''
'''Obi''': An old woman shouldn't be treated like that, no way, that's bad. ''Jogador'': '''tom'''
'''Obi''': Well, he just buys what no one else wants. Stuff that's long dead. I can live with that, yes, I can live with that. ''Jogador'': '''lee'delle'''
'''Obi''': She ruins the market with her offers! This is bad for us honest merchants, really bad. ''Jogador'': '''al dee'''
'''Obi''': Oh, this guy is so greedy, so greedy. Ripping off poor adventurers like you! ''Jogador'': '''santiago'''
'''Obi''': I suggested him opening a tourist guide company with me, Obi's and Santiago's, but he didn't approve. I really don't understand why. ''Jogador'': '''amber'''
'''Obi''': She is beautiful, very, very beautiful. I hope I can impress her somehow. ''Jogador'': '''hyacinth'''
'''Obi''': I don't like him, actually I dislike him deeply. He is so greedy that he doesn't want to share his profit he gains from health potions. ''Jogador'': '''norma'''
'''Obi''': I don't know how anyone could give up the flourishing business she led. She should have listened to me and find someone who continues that business for her. ''Jogador'': '''seymour'''
'''Obi''': He is the head of the local academy. I encouraged him to sponsor you, but no one listens to Obi, no one listens to me, as usual. ''Jogador'': '''oracle'''
'''Obi''': The oracle, ah, such a weird being! It will lead you off this island once you are level 8, yes it will, mark my words. ''Jogador'': '''paulie'''
'''Obi''': I told everyone he will cause trouble. He talks people into giving him their money and putting it on the bank! They rather should leave it here with us honest merchants! ''Jogador'': '''seymour'''
'''Obi''': He is the head of the local academy. I encouraged him to sponsor you, but no one listens to Obi, no one listens to me, as usual. ''Jogador'': '''zerbrus'''
'''Obi''': What a hero, what a hero. ----- === Ao pedir dicas: === ''Jogador'': '''hint'''
'''Obi''': If you don't know the meaning of an icon on the right side, move the mouse cursor on it and wait a moment. ''Jogador'': '''hint'''
'''Obi''': Send private messages to other players by right-clicking on the player or the player's name and select 'Message to ....'. You can also open a 'private message channel' and type in the name of the player. ''Jogador'': '''hint'''
'''Obi''': Use the shortcuts 'SHIFT' to look, 'CTRL' for use and 'ALT' for attack when clicking on an object or player. ''Jogador'': '''hint'''
'''Obi''': If you already know where you want to go, click on the automap and your character will walk there automatically if the location is reachable and not too far away. ''Jogador'': '''hint'''
'''Obi''': To open or close skills, battle or VIP list, click on the corresponding button to the right. ''Jogador'': '''hint'''
'''Obi''': 'Capacity' restricts the amount of things you can carry with you. It raises with each level. ''Jogador'': '''hint'''
'''Obi''': Always have a look on your health bar. If you see that you do not regenerate health points anymore, eat something. ''Jogador'': '''hint'''
'''Obi''': Always eat as much food as possible. This way, you'll regenerate health points for a longer period of time. ''Jogador'': '''hint'''
'''Obi''': After you have killed a monster, you have 10 seconds in which the corpse is not moveable and no one else but you can loot it. ''Jogador'': '''hint'''
'''Obi''': Be careful when you approach three or more monsters because you only can block the attacks of two. In such a situation even a few rats can do severe damage or even kill you. ''Jogador'': '''hint'''
'''Obi''': There are many ways to gather food. Many creatures drop food but you can also pick blueberries or bake your own bread. If you have a fishing rod and worms in your inventory, you can also try to catch a fish. ''Jogador'': '''hint'''
'''Obi''': Baking bread is rather complex. First of all you need a scythe to harvest wheat. Then you use the wheat with a millstone to get flour. ...
'''Obi''': This can be be used on water to get dough, which can be used on an oven to bake bread. Use milk instead of water to get cake dough. ''Jogador'': '''hint'''
'''Obi''': Dying hurts! Better run away than risk your life. You are going to lose experience and skill points when you die. ''Jogador'': '''hint'''
'''Obi''': When you switch to 'Offensive Fighting', you deal out more damage but you also get hurt more easily. ''Jogador'': '''hint'''
'''Obi''': When you are on low health and need to run away from a monster, switch to 'Defensive Fighting' and the monster will hit you less severely. ''Jogador'': '''hint'''
'''Obi''': Many creatures try to run away from you. Select 'Chase Opponent' to follow them. ''Jogador'': '''hint'''
'''Obi''': The deeper you enter a dungeon, the more dangerous it will be. Approach every dungeon with utmost care or an unexpected creature might kill you. This will result in losing experience and skill points. ''Jogador'': '''hint'''
'''Obi''': Due to the perspective, some objects in Tibia are not located at the spot they seem to appear (ladders, windows, lamps). Try clicking on the floor tile the object would lie on. ''Jogador'': '''hint'''
'''Obi''': If you want to trade an item with another player, right-click on the item and select 'Trade with ...', then click on the player with whom you want to trade. ''Jogador'': '''hint'''
'''Obi''': Stairs, ladders and dungeon entrances are marked as yellow dots on the automap. ''Jogador'': '''hint'''
'''Obi''': You can get food by killing animals or monsters. You can also pick blueberries or bake your own bread. If you are too lazy or own too much money, you can also buy food. ''Jogador'': '''hint'''
'''Obi''': Quest containers can be recognised easily. They don't open up regularly but display a message 'You have found ....'. They can only be opened once. ''Jogador'': '''hint'''
'''Obi''': Better run away than risk to die. You'll lose experience and skill points each time you die. ''Jogador'': '''hint'''
'''Obi''': You can form a party by right-clicking on a player and selecting 'Invite to Party'. The party leader can also enable 'Shared Experience' by right-clicking on him- or herself. ''Jogador'': '''hint'''
'''Obi''': You can assign spells, the use of items, or random text to 'hotkeys'. You find them under 'Options'. ''Jogador'': '''hint'''
'''Obi''': You can also follow other players. Just right-click on the player and select 'Follow'. ''Jogador'': '''hint'''
'''Obi''': You can found a party with your friends by right-clicking on a player and selecting 'Invite to Party'. If you are invited to a party, right-click on yourself and select 'Join Party'. ''Jogador'': '''hint'''
'''Obi''': Only found parties with people you trust. You can attack people in your party without getting a skull. This is helpful for training your skills, but can be abused to kill people without having to fear negative consequences. ''Jogador'': '''hint'''
'''Obi''': The leader of a party has the option to distribute gathered experience among all players in the party. If you are the leader, right-click on yourself and select 'Enable Shared Experience'. ''Jogador'': '''hint'''
'''Obi''': There is nothing more I can tell you. If you are still in need of some hints, I can repeat them for you. ----- ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Obi''': Farewell, I hope you were satisfied with our service. }}

''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''</br>
'''Lily:''' Welcome, ''Jogador''! You look a little stressed today. If you like to view my offers of potions, just ask me for a trade. In case you're looking for the marketplace and dungeons, just follow the path to the east!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Monsters'''</br>
'''Lily:''' Sadly, our little village of Rookgaard is invaded by monsters. From the dungeons they creep to the surface and attack the city. We always need adventurers helping us to fight them.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''</br>
'''Lily:''' I'm a druid, bound to the spirit of nature. My potions will help you if you feel bad. I also buy blueberries and cookies. Just ask me for a trade.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''</br>
'''Lily:''' My name is Lily, like the flower. It also stands for purity, just like my potions are!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Lily'''</br>
'''Lily:''' Yes?</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Time'''</br>
'''Lily:''' It is about "''hora''" am/pm. But does it really matter? Don't rush yourself and enjoy all these little moments.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Mainland'''</br>
'''Lily:''' The main continent is huge! The gods of Tibia created everything from great seas, deep jungles and large deserts.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Druid'''</br>
'''Lily:''' Being a druid is a wonderful profession. You control the forces of nature and can heal others.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Tibia'''</br>
'''Lily:''' Tibia is our beautiful world, created by the gods. Being a druid, I'm a worshipper of Crunor.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hyacinth'''</br>
'''Lily:''' Hyacinth also sells small health potions. He lives outside the village, in a hidden place.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Crunor'''</br>
'''Lily:''' Crunor is the great lord of trees and the creator of all plants. Despite what some people believe, he didn't create the monsters, though.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''</br>
'''Lily:''' Take care, ''Jogador''.</br>
}}<noinclude>[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]</noinclude>

Ela acha seu nome "muito normal" e pretende mudá-lo para Marylien. Ela é a única NPC em Rookgaard que usa um chapéu. Você pode perguntar à ela sobre o addon.
Antes do [[Updates/8.2|Update 8.2]], Norma vendia equipamentos e ferramentas, e apenas para Jogadores com [[Premium Account]], semelhante à [[Lee'Delle]] nos dias de hoje.

* Faz parte da [[Citizen Outfits Quest on Rook]].

Nada. | sells = {{Trades/Sell | Beer,3 | Bread,3 | Cheese,5 | Egg,2 | Lemonade | Milk,2 | Party Cake | Wine}} | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''name'''
'''Norma:''' Well, my name is Norma.
''Jogador:'' '''Norma'''
'''Norma:''' I hate that name, it sounds so boring. Almost like 'normal'. I think I should change my name to something more exciting. Like... Marylin! Oh, what a glamorous sound!
''Jogador:'' '''Marylin'''
'''Norma:'''
''Jogador:'' '''Time'''
'''Norma:''' It's about 11:47 am. Time just flies, doesn't it?
''Jogador:'' '''Monster'''
'''Norma:''' Ah, the monsters are far away. Let's party now!
''Jogador:'' '''Tibia'''
'''Norma:''' This is the world we live in, oh-oh-oh, and these are the hands we're given, oh-oh... oh, I'm sorry, I got carried away!
''Jogador:'' '''Al Dee'''
'''Norma:''' Al Dee treats his customers friendly, but he's badmouthing them once he had a few beers.
''Jogador:'' '''Amber'''
'''Norma:''' I'm curious about her adventures. She really should come here more often!
''Jogador:'' '''Billy'''
'''Norma:''' He got lucky when Willie and him played a game of dice about who gets to farm on which side of the river. Ever since, Willie holds a grudge against him.
''Jogador:'' '''Cipfried'''
'''Norma:''' That monk with his holier-than-thou attitude hasn't anything against a good mug of wine now and then.
''Jogador:'' '''Dallheim'''
'''Norma:''' If you listen to him, you could get the impression my little bar is the devil himself. He says he has more work now keeping drunken adventurers in than monsters out of the city. Such an exaggeration!
''Jogador:'' '''Dixi'''
'''Norma:''' She told me that she dreams of leaving this island to go on a big adventure.
''Jogador:'' '''Hyacinth'''
'''Norma:''' That's probably someone I'll never see in my bar.
''Jogador:'' '''Lee'Delle'''
'''Norma:''' That girl thinks that she is soooo special and 'high society'. We used to be friends, but well, things change.
''Jogador:'' '''Lily'''
'''Norma:''' She loves cookies, but she should rather stick to her diet, honestly.
''Jogador:'' '''Loui'''
'''Norma:''' They tell me strange stories about him and some monsters in a hole. Weird!
''Jogador:'' '''Obi'''
'''Norma:''' I think it's rather strange that he lives here with his granddaughter. No one's ever seen the parents of '''Dixi'''.
''Jogador:'' '''Paulie'''
'''Norma:''' That guy seriously needs some partying and a girlfriend.
''Jogador:'' '''Santiago'''
'''Norma:''' I think that poor guy never gets a break from work. At least he never comes here.
''Jogador:'' '''Seymour'''
'''Norma:''' What Seymour doesn't teach you is how much fun you can have here!
''Jogador:'' '''The Oracle'''
'''Norma:''' The oracle is on the top floor of the academy. You should go there once you are level 8 to leave this island.
''Jogador:'' '''Tom'''
'''Norma:''' Oh shush! It's kinda disgusting when he walks in here with animal blood on his hands!
''Jogador:'' '''Willie'''
'''Norma:''' Hehe, that guy doesn't pretend to be anyone that he isn't. He is what he is - rude, but honest.
''Jogador:'' '''Zerbrus'''
'''Norma:''' If you listen to him, you could get the impression my little bar is the devil himself. He says he has more work now keeping drunken adventurers in than monsters out of the city. Such an exaggeration!
''Jogador:'' '''Zirella'''
'''Norma:''' I invited her to my bar, but she refused. Oh well, it was worth a try! }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.title: Santiago
pages.wikitext:
<noinclude>{{deprecated}}</noinclude>{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}}
| name        = Santiago
| job         = Pescador
| city        = Rookgaard
| subarea     = Tutorial Island
| location    = [[Tutorial Island]] ({{Mapa|32030,32272,6:1|aqui}}).
| implemented = 8.2
| buysell     = não
| buys        = 
| sells       =
| notes       = Santiago era o NPC que recepcionava novos jogadores na antiga ilha de tutorial, ao sul de Rookgaard. A ilha e seus NPCs se tornaram inacessíveis com a implementação de [[Dawnport]].
| falas       = 
''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' Hello again, ''Jogador''! It's great to see you. If you like, we can chat a little. Just use the dark blue keywords again to choose a topic.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Keywords'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' Right, this was a keyword. But actually there are more interesting topics to talk about.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' I catch fish for a living. But I'm telling you, those cockroaches are ruining me.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' Oh, my name is Santiago. I could tell you some gossip about me, harhar. I also know many stories.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Time'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' Time is passing slowly on Rookgaard, I can tell you!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Rookgard'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' We are currently south of the village of Rookgaard, just follow the path to the east. Once you are there, you will meet many other citizens.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Main'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' The main continent is so much bigger than Rookgaard. You can travel there once you are level 8 and have chosen a vocation.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Vocation'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' The Tibian vocations are knight, paladin, sorcerer and druid, each of them has its own specialities.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Knight'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' Knights are strong melee fighters. They usually use weapons such as swords, clubs or axes.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Druid'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' Druids are nature magic users, specialised in earth, ice and healing.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Paladin'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' Paladins are distance fighters and holy magic users. They outrun their enemies and shoot them with arrows or bolts.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Sorcerer'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' Sorcerers are elemental magic users, specialised in fire, energy and death magic.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Cockroach'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' Every morning, I'm missing about a dozen fishes. Once, I've seen one of those beasts nibbling on a fish! They are SO disgusting!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Tibia'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' Tibia is a huge world with many cities - most of them threatened by monsters. If you help us fighting them, you will earn experience and grow into a strong warrior.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Cities'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' There are many cities on the main continent, much bigger than our little village here. You should visit all of them!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Monsters'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' Here on Rookgaard, we are lucky that the monsters threatening our village are rather weak. I wouldn't want to have the dragons and demons of the main continent here!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Dragons'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' You'll never forget your first dragon. That is true even after all those years. Fierce beasts they are!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Demons'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' There are numerous different demons all over Tibia. They mostly hide deep in dungeons, but sometimes they dare entering the human realm.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Citizens'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' Most of the citizens are merchants. We have also two guards and a healer, and a teacher in our academy.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Santiago'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' Everyone in Tibia has a job, and I'm a fisherman! Well - I used to be a famous pirate, to be honest, but all those adventures were too much for me.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Gossip'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' Did you hear that story about me catching this HUUUUGE fish?! It was so big that I couldn't pull it on board of my ship... and... and ...</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Stories'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' There are so many things I could tell you, I don't even know where to start! My best stories are about Svargrond and the explorer society.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Merchants'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' We have a weapon smith called Obi, Dixi is selling armors and Al Dee is offering general tools. Also, you can buy potions from Lily. I think those are the most important people to trade with.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Guards'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' The bridge guards Dallheim and Zerbrus can tell you which monsters are suitable for your level and where to find them.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Healer'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' Our healer is called Cipfried. He guards the temple.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Teacher'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' The teacher of the academy is called Seymour. The academy is just north of the temple.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Fisherman'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' To be a fisherman, you only need a fishing rod and worms. You can become one too! Fishing rods can be bought in all cities, even in Rookgaard.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Pirate'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' Oh, that life is over. I've settled down. Fighting against those cockroaches is the only excitement I have nowadays, and that's already enough!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Adventures'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' You'll experience more than enough adventures soon enough, I'm sure! You look young and strong, Tibia awaits you!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Svargrond'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' There was a huge fuzz about it. Actually no one ever knew that it existed until a while ago when the sea serpents which had blocked the sea passage there suddenly disappeared ...</br>
'''Santiago''': Nowadays there is a barbarian settlement, and I heard that you need to win a drinking contest to become an inhabitant! Now that's something! ...</br>
'''Santiago''': Also, there are many different types of fish. They catch them through ice holes there.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Explorer society'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' The explorer society has always work for brave adventurers. You can join them in Port Hope or Northport once you arrive on the main continent.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Port hope'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' That's a small settlement in the south of Tibia. The jungle of Tiquanda is all around it. There are many places to discover like Banuta, Trapwood or Chor.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Northport'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' That's a very small village near one of the main cities, Carlin. I considered living there because it's almost as quiet as Rookgaard.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Banuta'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' That is the name of the ape town. They say there is an ape who can talk! I don't believe that, harharhar!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Chor'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' This place was discovered some years ago. It's a lizard town and those snake-human mixed thingies are still there! I wonder why they haven't been discovered earlier.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Trapwood'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' Wild horses couldn't drag me there!! Evil little beasts called dworcs live there. They use a weird type of voodoo magic.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Trade'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' Oh sorry, I don't trade. But if you meet other citizens, it can't hurt to ask them for a trade! If they have offers or buy your stuff, they'll tell you.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Obi'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' Obi is a skilled smith. If you need weapons, you can buy them at his shop.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Dixi'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' She's Obi's granddaughter and deals with armors and shields, just upstairs from Obi's shop.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Al dee'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' Al Dee sells tools such as torches, ropes and shovels. You will learn about them soon!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Lily'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' Lily's shop is just behind the bridge that leads to the village. She sells potions which will refill your health or cure poison.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Dallheim''' ou '''zerbrus'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' He's a great warrior. He can also tell you much about monsters and dungeons on this island.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Cipfried'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' Visiting Cipfried is a good idea if you are badly injured or poisoned. Just ask him for a heal.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Seymour'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' Seymour is a teacher running the academy. He has many important information about Tibia.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Tom'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' He's the locla tanner. You could try selling fresh corpses or leather to him.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Experience'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' Earning experience and gaining levels will make you stronger. It's all about power in Tibia!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Warrior'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' Well, everybody is a 'warrior' in general. You can choose between four vocations once you are level 8.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Quest'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' I think apart from killing cockroaches there's no quest I could give you. There are many more quests on the main continent, just ask around!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Oracle'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' Oh, you're a bit young to hear about the oracle. Be patient, you'll learn everything in time.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Skip tutorial'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' Oh, so you know everything about Tibia already? Do you really want to skip the tutorial?</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' Well, then good luck and take care!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' Take care, ''Jogador''!</br></br>

Sugestões</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' If you don't know the meaning of an icon on the right side, move the mouse cursor on it and wait a moment.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' Send private messages to other players by right-clicking on the player or the player's name and select 'Message to ....'. You can also open a 'private message channel' and type in the name of the player.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' Use the shortcuts 'SHIFT' to look, 'CTRL' for use and 'ALT' for attack when clicking on an object or player.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' If you already know where you want to go, click on the automap and your character will walk there automatically if the location is reachable and not too far away.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' To open or close skills, battle or VIP list, click on the corresponding button to the right.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' 'Capacity' restricts the amount of things you can carry with you. It raises with each level.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' Always have a look on your health bar. If you see that you do not regenerate health points anymore, eat something.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' Always eat as much food as possible. This way, you'll regenerate health points for a longer period of time.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' After you have killed a monster, you have 10 seconds in which the corpse is not moveable and no one else but you can loot it.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' Be careful when you approach three or more monsters because you only can block the attacks of two. In such a situation even a few rats can do severe damage or even kill you.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' There are many ways to gather food. Many creatures drop food but you can also pick blueberries or bake your own bread. If you have a fishing rod and worms in your inventory, you can also try to catch a fish.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' Baking bread is rather complex. First of all you need a scythe to harvest wheat. Then you use the wheat with a millstone to get flour. ...</br>
'''Santiago''': This can be be used on water to get dough, which can be used on an oven to bake bread. Use milk instead of water to get cake dough.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' Dying hurts! Better run away than risk your life. You are going to lose experience and skill points when you die.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' When you switch to 'Offensive Fighting', you deal out more damage but you also get hurt more easily.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' When you are on low health and need to run away from a monster, switch to 'Defensive Fighting' and the monster will hit you less severely.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' Many creatures try to run away from you. Select 'Chase Opponent' to follow them.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' The deeper you enter a dungeon, the more dangerous it will be. Approach every dungeon with utmost care or an unexpected creature might kill you. This will result in losing experience and skill points.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' Due to the perspective, some objects in Tibia are not located at the spot they seem to appear (ladders, windows, lamps). Try clicking on the floor tile the object would lie on.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' If you want to trade an item with another player, right-click on the item and select 'Trade with ...', then click on the player with whom you want to trade.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' Stairs, ladders and dungeon entrances are marked as yellow dots on the automap.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' You can get food by killing animals or monsters. You can also pick blueberries or bake your own bread. If you are too lazy or own too much money, you can also buy food.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' Quest containers can be recognised easily. They don't open up regularly but display a message 'You have found ....'. They can only be opened once.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' Better run away than risk to die. You'll lose experience and skill points each time you die.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' You can form a party by right-clicking on a player and selecting 'Invite to Party'. The party leader can also enable 'Shared Experience' by right-clicking on him- or herself.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' You can assign spells, the use of items, or random text to 'hotkeys'. You find them under 'Options'.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' You can also follow other players. Just right-click on the player and select 'Follow'.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' You can found a party with your friends by right-clicking on a player and selecting 'Invite to Party'. If you are invited to a party, right-click on yourself and select 'Join Party'.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' Only found parties with people you trust. You can attack people in your party without getting a skull. This is helpful for training your skills, but can be abused to kill people without having to fear negative consequences.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' The leader of a party has the option to distribute gathered experience among all players in the party. If you are the leader, right-click on yourself and select 'Enable Shared Experience'.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Santiago:''' There is nothing more I can tell you. If you are still in need of some hints, I can repeat them for you.
}}<noinclude>[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]</noinclude>

pages.title: Paulie
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}}
| name        = Paulie
| job         = Banqueiro
| city        = Thais
| subarea     = Rookgaard
| location    = [[Rookgaard]] ({{Mapa|32117,32188,8:2|aqui}}).
| implemented = 7.9
| notes       = Paulie está treinando para ser um banqueiro e sonha um dia ir para [[Tibia (Continente)]]. Ele trabalha no banco de Rookgaard. Ele troca [[Gold Coin]]s, [[Platinum Coin]]s e [[Crystal Coin]]s. Você pode depositar e tirar dinheiro, podendo sempre checar o balanço de sua conta, mas você só pode depositar até 1000 gold, para depositar mais você precisa ir para mainland.
| buysell     = não
| buys        = 
| sells       = 
| falas       = __NOTOC__
== Frases Espontâneas ==
'''Paulie''': Any questions about the functions of your bank account? Feel free to ask me for help!</br>
'''Paulie''': Deposit your money here in the safety of the Tibian Bank!

== Palavras-Chave ==
''Jogador'': '''hi'''</br>
'''Paulie''': Welcome ''Jogador''! Here, you can deposit or withdraw your money from your bank account and change gold. I can also explain the functions of your bank account to you.

-----

=== Outras palavras-chave: ===
''Jogador'': '''job'''</br>
'''Paulie''': I'm still a bank clerk-in-training. They say I can work on the mainland of Tibia once I have proven myself!

''Jogador'': '''name'''</br>
'''Paulie''': I'm Paulie.

''Jogador'': '''paulie'''</br>
'''Paulie''': That's me, in all my beauty! <coughs>

''Jogador'': '''mainland'''</br>
'''Paulie''': I'm looking forward to work on the mainland. The great Tibian cities are so much more interesting than this little village of Rookgaard.

''Jogador'': '''rookgaard'''</br>
'''Paulie''': What a godforsaken place! Well, at least there are no criminals robbing the bank which would be - me. <gulp>

''Jogador'': '''king'''</br>
'''Paulie''': HAIL TO THE KING!

''Jogador'': '''time'''</br>
'''Paulie''': It's exactly ''horas''.

''Jogador'': '''sell''' / '''buy''' / '''wares''' / '''offer''' / '''stuff''' / '''trade''' / '''weapon''' / '''armor''' / '''sword''' / '''shield''' / '''equip''' / '''food''' / '''potions'''</br>
'''Paulie''': Sorry, I don't trade. Ask the shop owners for a trade instead. I can only help you with your bank account.

''Jogador'': '''premium'''</br>
'''Paulie''': Another excellent way of investing your money.

''Jogador'': '''academy'''</br>
'''Paulie''': The academy is the big stone building in the town centre. When you are ready to leave Rookgaard, you should visit the oracle there.

''Jogador'': '''temple'''</br>
'''Paulie''': The temple is south of the city. Go there and talk to Cipfried if you are in dire need of healing.

-----

=== Sobre NPCs: ===
''Jogador'': '''al dee'''</br>
'''Paulie''': He sells general equipment such as ropes or torches.

''Jogador'': '''amber'''</br>
'''Paulie''': <blushes> It's making me nervous to have her around my working place all the time. Actually it's distracting, but I can't say why.

''Jogador'': '''billy'''</br>
'''Paulie''': A fine cook and farmer.

''Jogador'': '''cipfried'''</br>
'''Paulie''': He guards the temple and can heal you if you are badly injured or poisoned.

''Jogador'': '''dallheim''' / '''zerbrus'''</br>
'''Paulie''': Thank god that guy guards our bridge. Without him, I believe all sorts of critters would storm the bank!

''Jogador'': '''dixi'''</br>
'''Paulie''': She's Obi's granddaughter and deals with armors and shields. Her shop is southwest of town, close to the temple.

''Jogador'': '''hyacinth'''</br>
'''Paulie''': Hm, I've never seen him. He's supposed to be a druid.

''Jogador'': '''lee'delle'''</br>
'''Paulie''': Her shop is on the premium side of town. She has really good offers.

''Jogador'': '''lily'''</br>
'''Paulie''': Lily sells potions in the South of town.

''Jogador'': '''loui'''</br>
'''Paulie''': I don't know that guy.

''Jogador'': '''norma'''</br>
'''Paulie''': Going to her bar is not so much my cup of tea... I prefer reading a good book about economy.

''Jogador'': '''obi'''</br>
'''Paulie''': He sells weapons. His shop is south west of town, close to the temple.

''Jogador'': '''seymour'''</br>
'''Paulie''': A well-educated man.

''Jogador'': '''oracle'''</br>
'''Paulie''': You can find the oracle on the top floor of the academy, just above Seymour. Go there when you are level 8.

''Jogador'': '''tom'''</br>
'''Paulie''': He's the local tanner. You could try selling fresh corpses or leather to him and then bring the earned money to our bank.

''Jogador'': '''willie'''</br>
'''Paulie''': He's incredibly rude! I don't know what I've done to him. Well, he buys and sells food.

''Jogador'': '''zirella'''</br>
'''Paulie''': She's a nice old lady, but I guess she prefers keeping her savings in one of her socks. She never comes to my bank.

-----

=== Funções de banqueiro: ===
''Jogador'': '''money''' / '''bank'''</br>
'''Paulie''': You can deposit and withdraw money from your bank account here. I can also change money for you.

''Jogador'': '''functions''' / '''account''' / '''help'''</br>
'''Paulie''': Every Tibian has a bank account. You can deposit your gold in one bank and withdraw it from the same or any other Tibian bank. Ask me for your balance to learn how much money you've already saved. There are also advanced functions.

''Jogador'': '''deposit'''</br>
'''Paulie''': Please tell me how much gold you would like to deposit.

''Jogador'': '''withdraw'''</br>
'''Paulie''': Please tell me how much gold you would like to withdraw.

''Jogador'': '''change'''</br>
'''Paulie''': There are three different coin types in Tibia: 100 gold coins equal 1 platinum coin, 100 platinum coins equal 1 crystal coin. For example, if you like to change 100 gold coins into 1 platinum coin, simply say 'change gold' and then '1 platinum'.

''Jogador'': '''balance'''</br>
'''Paulie''': Your account balance is ''quantidade'' gold.

''Jogador'': '''advanced'''</br>
'''Paulie''': Once you are on the Tibian mainland, you can access new functions of your bank account, such as transferring money to other players safely, accessing your guild account or taking part in house auctions. ...</br>
'''Paulie''': Just ask any of my colleagues on the Mainland and they'll be happy to tell you all about the advanced functions of your bank account.

-----

''Jogador'': '''bye'''</br>
'''Paulie''': Good bye, and remember: entrusting us with your gold is the safest way of storing it!
}}

pages.title: Zirella
pages.wikitext:
<noinclude>{{deprecated}}</noinclude>{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}}
| name        = Zirella
| job         = Pescador
| city        = Rookgaard
| subarea     = Tutorial Island
| location    = [[Tutorial Island]] ({{Mapa|32058,32269,7:1|aqui}}).
| implemented = 8.2
| notes       = Zirella ensinava novos jogadores na antiga ilha de tutorial, ao sul de Rookgaard. A ilha e seus NPCs foram removidos do jogo com a implementação de [[Dawnport]].
| buysell     = não
| falas = 
''Jogador:'' '''hi'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' Oh, welcome back, dear ''Jogador''! Are you here for a little chat? Just use the dark blue keywords again to choose a topic.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''keywords'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' Right, this was a keyword. But actually there are more interesting topics to talk about.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Time'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' An old woman like me has all the time in the world.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Rookgaard'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' We are currently south of the village of Rookgaard, just follow the path to the east. Once you are there, you will meet many other citizens.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''main'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' The main continent is so much bigger than Rookgaard. You can travel there once you are level 8 and have chosen a vocation.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Vocation'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' The Tibian vocations are knight, paladin, sorcerer and druid, each of them has its own specialities.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Knight'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' Knights are strong melee fighters. They usually use weapons such as swords, clubs or axes.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Druid'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' Druids are nature magic users, specialised in earth, ice and healing.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Paladin'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' Paladins are distance fighters and holy magic users. They outrun their enemies and shoot them with arrows or bolts.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Sorcerer'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' Sorcerers are elemental magic users, specialised in fire, energy and death magic.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''tibia'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' Tibia is a huge world with many cities - most of them threatened by monsters. If you help us fighting them, you will earn experience and grow into a strong warrior.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''cities'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' There are many cities on the main continent, much bigger than our little village here. You should visit all of them!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Monsters'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' Here on Rookgaard, we are lucky that the monsters threatening our village are rather weak. I wouldn't want to have the dragons and demons of the main continent here!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''[[Dragon]]s'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' You'll never forget your first dragon. That is true even after all those years. Fierce beasts they are!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''[[Demon]]s'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' There are numerous different demons all over Tibia. They mostly hide deep in dungeons, but sometimes they dare entering the human realm.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''citizens'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' Most of the citizens are merchants. We have also two guards and a healer, and a teacher in our academy.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Zirella'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' Everyone in Tibia has a job, and I'm a fisherman! Well - I used to be a famous pirate, to be honest, but all those adventures were too much for me.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''stories'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' Hmm hmm, I could tell you some stories about Thais and the old days..</br>
''Jogador:'' '''merchants'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' We have a weapon smith called Obi, Dixi is selling armors and Al Dee is offering general tools. Also, you can buy potions from Lily. I think those are the most important people to trade with.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''guards'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' The bridge guards Dallheim and Zerbrus can tell you which monsters are suitable for your level and where to find them.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''healer'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' Our healer is called Cipfried. He guards the temple.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''teacher'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' The teacher of the academy is called Seymour. The academy is just north of the temple.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Thais'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' Thais was the first city in Tibia, back then it was even called 'Tibia City'. There were dragons just outside the gates! ...</br>
'''Zirella:''' In the past years, brave adventurers have pushed them back into the dungeons, though. Also, there was this great battle with Ferumbras! Those were the days.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Ferumbras'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' He is a mighty and evil wizard. Back then, all Tibians stuck together and managed to defeat him. I heard he fled and found a refuge to recover. ...</br>
'''Zirella:''' There is a citadel on one of the Tibian islands which he uses to regain his power. Now and then, brave Tibians invade and weaken him again.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''trade'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' Oh sorry, I don't trade. But if you meet other citizens, it can't hurt to ask them for a trade! If they have offers or buy your stuff, they'll tell you.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''dungeons'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' There is a huge cave system under Tibia. Even Rookgaard has many underground dungeons. The bridge guards know all about them.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''obi'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' Obi is a skilled smith. If you need weapons, you can buy them at his shop.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''dixi'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' She's Obi's granddaughter and deals with armors and shields, just upstairs from Obi's shop.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Al Dee'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' Al Dee sells tools such as torches, ropes and shovels. You will learn about them soon!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Lily'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' Lily's shop is just behind the bridge that leads to the village. She sells potions which will refill your health or cure poison.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Dallheim or zerbrus'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' He's a great warrior. He can also tell you much about monsters and dungeons on this island.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Cipfried'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' Visiting Cipfried is a good idea if you are badly injured or poisoned. Just ask him for a heal.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Seymour'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' Seymour is a teacher running the academy. He has many important information about Tibia.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Tom'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' Oh, my beloved son. He is a tanner, so he buys fresh corpses. I wish he would visit me more often.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Experience'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' Earning experience and gaining levels will make you stronger. It's all about power in Tibia!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Warrior'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' Well, everybody is a 'warrior' in general. You can choose between four vocations once you are level 8.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Oracle'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' Oh, you're a bit young to hear about the oracle. Be patient, you'll learn everything in time.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''bye'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' Good bye ''Jogador'', may Uman bless you!</br>
</br>Hints</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' If you don't know the meaning of an icon on the right side, move the mouse cursor on it and wait a moment.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' Send private messages to other players by right-clicking on the player or the player's name and select 'Message to ....'. You can also open a 'private message channel' and type in the name of the player.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''hints'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' Use the shortcuts 'SHIFT' to look, {{tecla|CTRL}} for use and {{tecla|ALT}} for attack when clicking on an object or player.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' If you already know where you want to go, click on the automap and your character will walk there automatically if the location is reachable and not too far away.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' To open or close skills, battle or VIP list, click on the corresponding button to the right.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' 'Capacity' restricts the amount of things you can carry with you. It raises with each level.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' Always have a look on your health bar. If you see that you do not regenerate health points anymore, eat something.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' Always eat as much food as possible. This way, you'll regenerate health points for a longer period of time.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' After you have killed a monster, you have 10 seconds in which the corpse is not moveable and no one else but you can loot it.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' Be careful when you approach three or more monsters because you only can block the attacks of two. In such a situation even a few rats can do severe damage or even kill you.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' There are many ways to gather food. Many creatures drop food but you can also pick blueberries or bake your own bread. If you have a fishing rod and worms in your inventory, you can also try to catch a fish.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' Baking bread is rather complex. First of all you need a scythe to harvest wheat. Then you use the wheat with a millstone to get flour. ...</br>
'''Zirella:''' This can be be used on water to get dough, which can be used on an oven to bake bread. Use milk instead of water to get cake dough.</br>
''Player'': '''Hints'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' Dying hurts! Better run away than risk your life. You are going to lose experience and skill points when you die.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' When you switch to 'Offensive Fighting', you deal out more damage but you also get hurt more easily.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' When you are on low health and need to run away from a monster, switch to 'Defensive Fighting' and the monster will hit you less severely.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' Many creatures try to run away from you. Select 'Chase Opponent' to follow them.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' The deeper you enter a dungeon, the more dangerous it will be. Approach every dungeon with utmost care or an unexpected creature might kill you. This will result in losing experience and skill points.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' Due to the perspective, some objects in Tibia are not located at the spot they seem to appear (ladders, windows, lamps). Try clicking on the floor tile the object would lie on.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' If you want to trade an item with another player, right-click on the item and select 'Trade with ...', then click on the player with whom you want to trade.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' Stairs, ladders and dungeon entrances are marked as yellow dots on the automap.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' You can get food by killing animals or monsters. You can also pick blueberries or bake your own bread. If you are too lazy or own too much money, you can also buy food.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' Quest containers can be recognised easily. They don't open up regularly but display a message 'You have found ....'. They can only be opened once.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' Better run away than risk to die. You'll lose experience and skill points each time you die.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' You can form a party by right-clicking on a player and selecting 'Invite to Party'. The party leader can also enable 'Shared Experience' by right-clicking on him- or herself.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' You can assign spells, the use of items, or random text to 'hotkeys'. You find them under 'Options'.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' You can also follow other players. Just right-click on the player and select 'Follow'.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' You can found a party with your friends by right-clicking on a player and selecting 'Invite to Party'. If you are invited to a party, right-click on yourself and select 'Join Party'.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' Only found parties with people you trust. You can attack people in your party without getting a skull. This is helpful for training your skills, but can be abused to kill people without having to fear negative consequences.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' The leader of a party has the option to distribute gathered experience among all players in the party. If you are the leader, right-click on yourself and select 'Enable Shared Experience'.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''</br>
'''Zirella:''' There is nothing more I can tell you. If you are still in need of some hints, I can repeat them for you.</br>
}}<noinclude>[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]</noinclude>
