pages.title: Willie
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Willie | job = Comerciante de Alimentos | city = Thais | subarea = Rookgaard | location = [[Rookgaard]] ({{Mapa|32067,32203,7:2|aqui}}). | implemented = Pré-6.0 | notes = Willie e seu irmão, [[Billy]], trabalham num moinho. Willie trabalha na área free, comprando e vendendo várias comidas. Ele costuma ser um pouco mal educado. Se você sair sem se despedir, ele ira xingá-lo. Mesmo odiando [[fish|peixe]], ele compra [[salmon|salmão]]. Willie está tentando atualmente uma nova receita, mas ele precisa de [[Banana|bananas]].

* Você pode trocar com ele uma [[Banana]], obtida na [[Studded Shield Quest]], por um [[Studded Shield]].

| buysell = sim | buys = {{Trades/Buy | Meat | Bread, 1 | Carrot | Cheese | Cherry | Egg | Ham | Salmon}} | sells = {{Trades/Sell | Bread,3 | Cheese,5 | Ham,8 | Meat,5}} | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Willie:''' Hiho ''Jogador''.
''Jogador:'' '''God'''
'''Willie:''' I am a farmer, not a preacher.
''Jogador:'' '''Help'''
'''Willie:''' Help yourself, I have not stolen my time.
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
'''Willie:''' I am a farmer and a cook.
''Jogador:'' '''Cook'''
'''Willie:''' I try out old and new recipes. You can sell me all food you have.
''Jogador:'' '''Food'''
'''Willie:''' Are you looking for food? I have bread, cheese, ham, and meat.
''Jogador:'' '''Recipes'''
'''Willie:''' I would love to try a banana-pie. But I lack the bananas. If you get me one, I will reward you.
''Jogador:'' '''Banana'''
'''Willie:''' Have you found a banana for me?
''Jogador:'' '''No'''
'''Willie:''' Too bad.
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''
'''Willie:''' Willie.
''Jogador:'' '''Time'''
'''Willie:''' Am I a clock or what?
''Jogador:'' '''King'''
'''Willie:''' I'm glad that we don't see many officials here.
''Jogador:'' '''Magic'''
'''Willie:''' I am magician in the kitchen.
''Jogador:'' '''Tibia'''
'''Willie:''' If I were you, I would stay here.
''Jogador:'' '''Sell'''
'''Willie:''' I sell food of many kinds.
''Jogador:'' '''Buy'''
'''Willie:''' I buy food of any kind. Since I am a great cook I need much of it.
''Jogador:'' '''Spell'''
'''Willie:''' I know how to spell and i know how to spit, you little @!#&&. Wanna see?.
''Jogador:'' '''Weapon'''
'''Willie:''' I'm not in the weapon business, but if you don't stop to harass me, I will put my hayfork in your &$&#$ and *$!&&*# it.
''Jogador:'' '''Dungeon'''
'''Willie:''' I have no time for your dungeon nonsense.
''Jogador:'' '''Monsters'''
'''Willie:''' Are you afraid of monsters ... you baby?
''Jogador:'' '''Amber'''
'''Willie:''' Quite a babe.
''Jogador:'' '''Cipfried'''
'''Willie:''' Our little monkey.
''Jogador:'' '''Dallheim'''
'''Willie:''' Uhm, fine guy I think.
''Jogador:'' '''Obi'''
'''Willie:''' This little $&#@& has only #@$*# in his mind. One day I will put a #@$@ in his *@&&#@!
''Jogador:'' '''Seymour'''
'''Willie:''' This joke of a man thinks he is sooo important.
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
'''Willie:''' Yeah, bye.
''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Willie:''' Hiho ''Jogador''.
'''Willie:''' YOU RUDE $!@##& }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.title: Seymour
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Seymour | job = Bibliotecário | job2 = Curtidor | city = Thais | subarea = Rookgaard | location = [[Rookgaard]] ({{Mapa|32104,32191,7:2|aqui}}). | implemented = Pré-6.0 | buysell = sim | buys = {{Trades/Buy | Dead Rat}} | sells = Nada. | notes = Seymour foi enviado a Rookgaard para trabalhar na biblioteca da cidade, professor dos [[Newbie|iniciantes]]. Ele quer enviar um presente ao rei de Thais, mas não tem uma caixa de presente para isso.

* Você pode trocar com ele um [[Present]], obtido na [[Present Quest]], por um [[Legion Helmet]].

| falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Seymour:''' Hello, ''Jogador''. What do you need?
''Jogador:'' '''Gods'''
'''Seymour:''' You can learn much about Tibia's gods in our library.
''Jogador:'' '''Help''' / '''Hints'''
'''Seymour:''' I can assist you with my advice.
''Jogador:'' '''Advice'''
'''Seymour:''' Read the blackboard for some hints and visit the training center in the cellar.
''Jogador:'' '''Training''' / '''Cellar'''
'''Seymour:''' You can try some basic things down there, but don't challenge the monsters in our arena if you are inexperienced.
''Jogador:'' '''Monsters'''
'''Seymour:''' You can learn about Tibia's monsters in our library.
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
'''Seymour:''' I am the master of this fine academy.
''Jogador:'' '''Academy'''
'''Seymour:''' Our academy has a library, a training center in the cellars and the oracle upstairs.
''Jogador:'' '''Library'''
'''Seymour:''' Go and read our books. Ignorance may mean death, so be careful.
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''
'''Seymour:''' My name is Seymour, but to you I am 'Sir' Seymour.
''Jogador:'' '''Time'''
'''Seymour:''' It is 8:26 pm, so you are late. Hurry!
''Jogador:'' '''King'''
'''Seymour:''' Hail to King Tibianus! Long live our king! Not that he cares for an old veteran who is stuck on this godforsaken island...
''Jogador:'' '''Magic'''
'''Seymour:''' The only magic-user on this isle is old Hyacinth.
''Jogador:'' '''Tibia'''
'''Seymour:''' Oh, how I miss the crowded streets of Thais. I know one day I will get promoted and get a job at the castle... I must get out of here! The faster the better! It is people like you who are driving me mad.
''Jogador:'' '''Sell'''
'''Seymour:''' I sell the Key to Adventure for 5 gold! If you are interested, tell me that you want to buy the key.
''Jogador:'' '''Key'''
'''Seymour:''' Do you want to buy the Key to Adventure for 5 gold coins?
''Jogador:'' '''No'''
'''Seymour:''' As you wish.
''Jogador:'' '''Mission''' / '''Quest'''
'''Seymour:''' Well I would like to send our king a little present, but I do not have a suitable box. If you find a nice box, please bring it to me.
''Jogador:'' '''Box'''
'''Seymour:''' Do you have a suitable present box for me?
''Jogador:'' '''No'''
'''Seymour:''' HEY! You don't have one! Stop playing tricks on me or I will give some extra work!
''Jogador:'' '''Weapon'''
'''Seymour:''' You need fine weapons to fight the tougher beasts. Unfortunately only the most basic weapons and armor are available here. You will have to fight some monsters to get a better weapon.
''Jogador:'' '''Castle'''
'''Seymour:''' The castle of Thais is the greatest achievement in Tibian history.
''Jogador:'' '''Dungeon'''
'''Seymour:''' There are some dungeons on this isle. You should strong enough to explore them now, but make sure to take a rope with you.
''Jogador:'' '''Oracle''' / '''Vocation'''
'''Seymour:''' You will find the oracle upstairs. Talk to the oracle as soon as you have made level 8. Choose a vocation and a new home town, and you will be sent off to the continent.
''Jogador:'' '''Rat'''
'''Seymour:''' Have you brought a dead rat to me to pick up your reward?
''Jogador:'' '''No'''
'''Seymour:''' Go and find some rats to kill!
''Jogador:'' '''Rookgaard'''
'''Seymour:''' Here on Rookgaard we have some people, a temple, some shops, a farm and an academy.
''Jogador:'' '''People'''
'''Seymour:''' Well, there's me, Cipfried, Willie, Obi, Amber, Dallheim, Al Dee, Norma, and Hyacinth.
''Jogador:'' '''Quentin'''
'''Seymour:''' He is responsible for the temple in Thais.
''Jogador:'' '''Al Dee'''
'''Seymour:''' He is a shop owner in the northwestern part of the village.
''Jogador:'' '''Amber'''
'''Seymour:''' A traveller from the main land. I wonder what brought her here, since no one comes here of his own free will.
''Jogador:'' '''Cipfried'''
'''Seymour:''' A humble monk with healing powers, and a pupil of the great Quentin himself.
''Jogador:'' '''Dallheim'''
'''Seymour:''' Oh good Dallheim! What a fighter he is! Without him we would be doomed.
''Jogador:'' '''Hyacinth'''
'''Seymour:''' A mysterious druid who lives somewhere in the wilderness. He sells small health potions just like Lily.
''Jogador:'' '''Potions'''
'''Seymour:''' Use a small health potion in case of emergencies to fill up around 75 health points. You can buy them at Lily's shop. She also has antidote potions. ''Jogador:'' '''Obi'''
'''Seymour:''' A cousin of Thais' smith Sam. He has a shop here where you can buy most stuff an adventurer needs.
''Jogador:'' '''Willie'''
'''Seymour:''' Willie is a fine farmer, although he has short temper.
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
'''Seymour:''' Good bye! And remember: No running up and down in the academy!
''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Seymour:''' Hello, ''Jogador''. What do you need?
'''Seymour:''' Good bye! And remember: No running up and down in the academy! }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.title: Guide Luke
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Guide Luke | job = Guia | city = Thais | subarea = Thais City | location = [[Thais City]] ({{Mapa|32320,32209,6:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.2 | notes = Ajuda os jogadores iniciantes a se locomover pela cidade e fornece informações adicionais sobre a cidade e o Tibia. A partir do [[updates/9.8|Updates 9.8]] passou a marcar no mapa do jogo os principais pontos da cidade.

* Diga: '''Hi''' - '''Map''' - '''Yes''' para ter os principais pontos da cidade marcados em seu mapa. * Diga: '''Hi''' - '''Information''' - '''Status''' - '''Change''' - e keyword especifica para saber o status de uma [[World Change]]. * Diga: '''Hi''' - '''Depot''' - '''Yes''' para ter seu personagem levado ao depot (apenas até o level 9). * [[Arquivo:Achievement.gif|link=]] Ao falar com todos os NPCs Guias para marcar o seu mapa, você receberá o achievemet '''"{{achievement|Territorial}}"'''

 | buysell = não }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.title: Harkath Bloodblade
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}}
| name        = Harkath Bloodblade
| job         = Guarda
| city        = Thais
| subarea     = Thais City
| location    = [[Thais City]] ({{Mapa|32344,32184,7:2|aqui}}).
| implemented = Pré-6.0
| notes       = Harkath é o general do exército do Rei. Ele só conversará com você se você cumprimentá-lo com "Hail General".
| buysell     = não
| buys        = 
| sells       = 
| falas       = 
''Jogador:'' '''Hail General'''</br>
'''Harkath Bloodblade:''' Salutations, commoner ''Jogador''!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Enemy'''</br>
'''Harkath Bloodblade:''' Evil has many faces. The servants of evil cannot always be recognized as easily as Ferumbras, for instance.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''God'''</br>
'''Harkath Bloodblade:''' I whorship Banor, the first warrior!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''</br>
'''Harkath Bloodblade:''' I am the general of the king's army.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''King'''</br>
'''Harkath Bloodblade:''' HAIL TO KING TIBIANUS, OUR WISE LEADER!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Mission''' / '''Quest'''</br>
'''Harkath Bloodblade:''' Sometimes the king calls for heroes. Keep eyes and ears open! I also heared Baxter has some work for young adventurers.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Sell'''</br>
'''Harkath Bloodblade:''' Are you suggesting I am corruptible?</br>
''Jogador:'' '''TBI'''</br>
'''Harkath Bloodblade:''' The Tibian Bureau of Investigation. Kind of secret police. I don't bother much about such things, I prefer my fights eye to eye.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Weapon'''</br>
'''Harkath Bloodblade:''' Sam is responsible to supply our troops with weapons and armor.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Castle'''</br>
'''Harkath Bloodblade:''' The castle is prepared to withstand any direct assault.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''City'''</br>
'''Harkath Bloodblade:''' The rapid growth of the city makes it hard to patrol and vulnerable to attacks.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Monsters'''</br>
'''Harkath Bloodblade:''' They seldom dare to attack the city itself.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Excalibug'''</br>
'''Harkath Bloodblade:''' In the legends it is told, that this weapon made its wielder able to fight the mightiest demons hand to hand.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Ferumbras'''</br>
'''Harkath Bloodblade:''' He is allied with evil itself! Each time we kill him he returns to take revenge.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Banor'''</br>
'''Harkath Bloodblade:''' He is the idol of all knights and paladins.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Elane'''</br>
'''Harkath Bloodblade:''' AH! WHAT A WOMAN!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Benjamin'''</br>
'''Harkath Bloodblade:''' He was the king's general before I was promoted. Poor guy, lost his mind in a battle against the evil Ferumbras.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Bozo'''</br>
'''Harkath Bloodblade:''' I hardly know him.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Chester'''</br>
'''Harkath Bloodblade:''' I don't know much about him. He is a very secretive person.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Gorn'''</br>
'''Harkath Bloodblade:''' He was an adventurer once. He was a fine fighter but lacked the discipline to serve in our army.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Harsky'''</br>
'''Harkath Bloodblade:''' He is one of our best men and serves in the silver guard.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Sam'''</br>
'''Harkath Bloodblade:''' Sam is responsible to supply our troops with weapons and armor.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Army'''</br>
'''Harkath Bloodblade:''' The army protects our city. I divided it into three battlegroups.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Battlegroup'''</br>
'''Harkath Bloodblade:''' The battlegroups are the 'dogs of war', the 'red guards', and the 'silver guards'.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Dogs of war'''</br>
'''Harkath Bloodblade:''' They are our main army.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Red guards'''</br>
'''Harkath Bloodblade:''' They are our special forces. Some serve as city guards, others as secret police.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Silver guards'''</br>
'''Harkath Bloodblade:''' The best sorcerers, paladins, knights, and druids of our forces are chosen to serve as silver guards. They are the bodyguards of the king.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Sell'''</br>
'''Harkath Bloodblade:''' Are you suggesting I am corruptible?</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''</br>
'''Harkath Bloodblade:''' Take this!</br>
(''Você perde 10 de HP a cada turno de 10 turnos, num total 100 hp'')
}}<noinclude>[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]</noinclude>

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}}
| name        = Hoggle
| job         = Pescador
| city        = Thais
| subarea     = Thais
| location    = [[Thais]] ({{Mapa|32538,32142,6:2|aqui}}).
| implemented = Pré-6.0
| notes       = Aparentemente para um humilde pescador é difícil nadar e pescar ao mesmo tempo. Claro que isso é necessário para qualquer pescador que coloca buracos no seu barco para torná-lo mais aerodinâmico. Se você acha que esse cara é louco, pergunte para ele sua opinião sobre peixes. Ele acha que até podem falar mas são sábios demais para isso. Antes de Port Hope ser descoberta, ele foi o único NPC à ver uma sereia. Abaixo da doca de Hoggle você pode encontrar três [[barrel]]s. Em ambos ele armazena 4 [[Leather Boots]], 10 [[Fish]]es e 10 [[Salmon]]s.</br></br>

Também neste andar é possível encontrar uma porta. Para abri-la você deve conversar com Hoggle e perguntar sobre seu jardim ('''garden'''). Ele perguntará se você está interessado em cortar a [[Jungle Grass|grama]] do jardim por 5 gp. Ao dizer ''yes'', você ganha o direito de abrir a porta e entrar no jardim. Para cortar a grama é necessário um [[machete]]. Esta grama cresce novamente em 2 minutos.
| buysell     = não
| buys        = 
| sells       = 
| falas       = 
''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''</br>
'''Hoggle:''' Welcome to my humble home!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''</br>
'''Hoggle:''' I am just a poor fisherman.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Fisherman'''</br>
'''Hoggle:''' It's a very hard job, cause without a boat I have to swim and fish at the same time!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Fish'''</br>
'''Hoggle:''' I think they can talk, but they are wise enough to be silent. Once I saw a mermaid.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Mermaid'''</br>
'''Hoggle:''' I saw one! She had the body of a fish, and also the head of a fish. Amazing!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Mountain'''</br>
'''Hoggle:''' Yes, there is a mountain to the north, but it's of no interest. There isn't any fish on it.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Map'''</br>
'''Hoggle:''' If you go north-west you will find Lubo and his adventurer shop. I think he sells maps.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''</br>
'''Hoggle:''' I am Hoggle. I live in this house.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Time'''</br>
'''Hoggle:''' No, it's not time now to go fishing.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Carlin'''</br>
'''Hoggle:''' There are stories about a city behind the mountain, but why should I go there? There is enough fish here.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Thais'''</br>
'''Hoggle:''' I know this city. Sometimes I sell fish to Frodo.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Frodo'''</br>
'''Hoggle:''' He buys my fish.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''</br>
'''Hoggle:''' Good bye.
}}<noinclude>[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]</noinclude>

== Frases Espontâneas ==
Não possui.

== Palavras-Chave ==
''Jogador'': '''hi'''</br>
'''Kulag, The Guard''': LONG LIVE THE KING!

-----

=== Sobre Kulag: ===
''Jogador'': '''job'''</br>
'''Kulag, The Guard''': It's my duty to protect the city.

''Jogador'': '''guard'''</br>
'''Kulag, The Guard''': I am a guard and proud of it.

''Jogador'': '''news'''</br>
'''Kulag, The Guard''': I am busy. Please ask the citizens for news.

''Jogador'': '''how are you'''</br>
'''Kulag, The Guard''': I am healthy and vigilant.

''Jogador'': '''red guards'''</br>
'''Kulag, The Guard''': We of the red guard are the special forces.

-----

=== Sobre NPC's: ===
''Jogador'': '''bozo'''</br>
'''Kulag, The Guard''': The royal jester.

''Jogador'': '''sam''' / '''smith''' / '''weapon'''</br>
'''Kulag, The Guard''': Sam is our blacksmith. You'll find him north of the main crossroads. His shop is to the left.

''Jogador'': '''harsky''' / '''stutch'''</br>
'''Kulag, The Guard''': He is a soldier in the silver guard.

''Jogador'': '''king''' / '''tibianus''' / '''leader'''</br>
'''Kulag, The Guard''': Tibianus III is our beloved king! He resides in the castle in the north west of the city.

''Jogador'': '''gorn''' / '''provisioner'''</br>
'''Kulag, The Guard''': Gorn is our provisioner. You'll find him north of the main crossroads. His shop is to the right.

''Jogador'': '''frodo''' / '''tavern'''</br>
'''Kulag, The Guard''': Frodo runs the local tavern. You'll find it at the main crossroads to the north-west.

''Jogador'': '''gregor''' / '''knight'''</br>
'''Kulag, The Guard''': The high knight of the knights' guild. It is in north-east of the town.

''Jogador'': '''marvik''' / '''druid'''</br>
'''Kulag, The Guard''': Marvik is the great druid of the local guild. You'll find him by climbing up the citywalls at the east.

''Jogador'': '''muriel''' / '''sorcerer'''</br>
'''Kulag, The Guard''': Muriel is the head of the local sorcerers' guild. You'll find it in the south-west of the city.

''Jogador'': '''elane''' / '''paladin'''</br>
'''Kulag, The Guard''': Elane is responsible for the local paladins' guild. It's in the west of the town, directly south of the post office.

''Jogador'': '''baxter'''</br>
'''Kulag, The Guard''': He is a role model for us.

''Jogador'': '''benjamin''' / '''post'''</br>
'''Kulag, The Guard''': Benjamin was a brave fighter. He runs the post office in the west of the city.

''Jogador'': '''eclesius'''</br>
'''Kulag, The Guard''': I only see him when he heads home in the wrong direction.

''Jogador'': '''harkath''' / '''general'''</br>
'''Kulag, The Guard''': The royal general. A warrior worth Banor's blessings.

-----

=== Outras Palavras-Chave: ===
''Jogador'': '''city'''</br>
'''Kulag, The Guard''': Behave while in the city or we get you! Do you want to know where to find a shop or a guild?

''Jogador'': '''shop'''</br>
'''Kulag, The Guard''': There's a smith, a provisioner, and a tavern.

''Jogador'': '''castle'''</br>
'''Kulag, The Guard''': The castle is at the west of the city.

''Jogador'': '''guild'''</br>
'''Kulag, The Guard''': In the city you will find the guildhouses of the knights, paladins, druids, and sorcerers.

''Jogador'': '''banor'''</br>
'''Kulag, The Guard''': Praise Banor! May the great warrior be with us!

''Jogador'': '''army'''</br>
'''Kulag, The Guard''': Of course we guards are members of the army.

''Jogador'': '''sell'''</br>
'''Kulag, The Guard''': Visit Tibia's shopkeepers to buy their fine wares.

''Jogador'': '''silver guard'''</br>
'''Kulag, The Guard''': Only the best of the best serve as silver guards.

''Jogador'': '''dogs of war'''</br>
'''Kulag, The Guard''': Brave warriors, indeed.

''Jogador'': '''news'''</br>
'''Kulag, The Guard''': I am busy. Please ask the citizens for news.

''Jogador'': '''''palavra ofensiva'''''</br>
'''Kulag, The Guard''': Take this! (burning effect, 5 turnos de 10 hitpoints)

''Jogador'': '''bye'''</br>
'''Kulag, The Guard''': LONG LIVE THE KING!</br>
}}

pages.title: Loria
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}}
| name        = Loria
| job         = Mage
| job2        = Roleplay
| city        = Thais
| subarea     = Alatar Lake
| location    = [[Alatar Lake]] ({{Mapa|32384,32130,7:1|aqui}}).
| implemented = Pré-6.0
| notes       = Ela conhece muito sobre magias e poderá falar sobre elas se você perguntar. Loria é uma ex-aprendiz de [[Alatar]], o Sábio. Ela fez parte de uma quest para aprender a magia Ultimate Explosion de Edron. Se você falar sobre a quest, ela irá dizer "Eu ouvi falar de um osso místico do Senhor Lich abaixo da Casa dos Necromancers. Traga o para mim, e você receberá uma recompensa."
| buysell     = não
| falas       = __NOTOC__
== Frases Espontâneas ==
Não possui.

== Palavras-Chave ==
''Jogador'': '''hi'''</br>
'''Loria''': Welcome ''Jogador''.

''Jogador'': '''job'''</br>
'''Loria''': I am studying the power of magic all the time.

''Jogador'': '''magic'''</br>
'''Loria''': I could tell you much about all sorcerer spells, but you won't understand it. Anyway, feel free to ask me.

''Jogador'': '''time'''</br>
'''Loria''': Time means nothing to me.

''Jogador'': '''name'''</br>
'''Loria''': I am Loria, a former apprentice of Alatar, the Sage.

''Jogador'': '''lake'''</br>
'''Loria''': I hope you like it. It is named like my master, Alatar, the Sage.

''Jogador'': '''alatar'''</br>
'''Loria''': Well, he was my great master. He taught me all these fantastic things about magic. I really miss him.

''Jogador'': '''power'''</br>
'''Loria''': Although your attack spells get stronger with your usage of magic, real power is gained by finding strategies to properly use your magic abilities.

''Jogador'': '''quest'''</br>
'''Loria''': I heard from a mystic bone of the lich lord below the House of Necromant. Bring it to me, and you will receive a reward.

''Jogador'': '''necromant'''</br>
'''Loria''': He lived in a lonely house in the south eastern part of Tibia beyond the mountains.

''Jogador'': '''reward'''</br>
'''Loria''': I'll teach you a very seldom spell.

''Jogador'': '''seldom spell'''</br>
'''Loria''': I'll teach you 'exevo gran mas vis', but bring me this bone first!

''Jogador'': '''spell'''</br>
'''Loria''':  Oh, I can tell you a lot about all sorcerer spells. Feel free to ask me about the spell name or the '''formula''' to cast it.

''Jogador'': '''formula'''</br>
'''Loria''':  Which is the spell you need the formula to? (ao falar a o nome da magia, ela dirá como lançar. EX: Find Person > Exiva 'name')

''Jogador'': '''mana'''</br>
'''Loria''':  Mana is the source of all magic. If you use spells, it will drain mana from your energy pool. This mana regenerates slowly, if you eat, or if you drink those mana potions you can buy at Xodet's.

''Jogador'': '''xodet'''</br>
'''Loria''': He runs a magic shop in the main road.

''Jogador'': '''gorn'''</br>
'''Loria''': He runs an equipment shop close to the north gate of the city.

''Jogador'': '''muriel'''</br>
'''Loria''': He runs his magic shop in the southwest of the city. He sells runes and spells and helps you, if you want to become a sorcerer.

''Jogador'': '''find person'''</br>
'''Loria''': If you search someone, this spell will give you an idea of the direction you must head. You will not be able to see, whether he is below or above you.

''Jogador'': '''light'''</br>
'''Loria''': A ray of light will emerge from your flat hand to illuminate your environment.

''Jogador'': '''light healing'''</br>
'''Loria''': The paths to the next temple are long. Even in Tibia. So learn this spell, and be able to heal yourself during your travels. This spell will only cure small wounds, but it is pretty helpful.

''Jogador'': '''light magic missile'''</br>
'''Loria''': You can activate this spell by pointing your index finger in the direction of your enemy, conjure the power of your rune and shoot the magic missiles in your enemy's body.

''Jogador'': '''antidote'''</br>
'''Loria''': This spell sucks the venom out of your veins, that some enemy might have injected.

''Jogador'': '''intense healing'''</br>
'''Loria''': This spell will cure more wounds or greater ones at once. This is of course more 'mana intensive', but everybody will sooner or later get in a situation where mana is nothing - compared to life.

''Jogador'': '''poison field'''</br>
'''Loria''': This spell will create a single field of poisonous gas. Cast it on a creature you were not able to arrange a peace treaty with. If it has no antidote, watch what could happen if you forget yours.

''Jogador'': '''fire field'''</br>
'''Loria''': This spell acts similar to the 'poison field' spell, except that you create fire instead of poisonous gas. Don't enter it yourself or you will realize why it is said that 'fire eats everything'.

''Jogador'': '''heavy magic missile'''</br>
'''Loria''': Remember the spell where you only got to wave your hand? Well, wave it twice and shoot a heavy magic missile at your enemy. This spell will create a rune with five charges.

''Jogador'': '''magic shield'''</br>
'''Loria''': I could tell you much about all sorcerer spells, but you won't understand it. Anyway, feel free to ask me.

''Jogador'': '''fireball'''</br>
'''Loria''': A perfect symbiosis of fire and wind. More is not to be said about this spell. Use this fireball as a warning or as your defence, but don't burn your fingers.

''Jogador'': '''energy field'''</br>
'''Loria''': This one will create a field of energy. Everyone stepping in will be struck from lightning. This field will not last as long as poison or fire fields, but it is more deadly.

''Jogador'': '''destroy field'''</br>
'''Loria''': Trapped again between fire, poison and energy fields? This spell will give you the ability to destruct the fields, so you can pass safely.

''Jogador'': '''fire wave'''</br>
'''Loria''': Turn to you opponent and release the forces of nature with a whisper of your voice. A triangle of fire will burn all persons in your view, so take care, in which direction you look!

''Jogador'': '''ultimate healing'''</br>
'''Loria''': This spell is able to cure almost every injury at a higher cost than the other healing spells.

''Jogador'': '''great fireball'''</br>
'''Loria''': Imagine scaling the normal fireball by two and raising the fire temperature.

''Jogador'': '''firebomb'''</br>
'''Loria''': With a snip of your finger you can cover the floor with a burning carpet that keeps on burning for a while.

''Jogador'': '''poison wall'''</br>
'''Loria''': With this one you can create a huge wall of poisonous gas. Many monsters will be too scared to pass the wall and if they do, they will choke from nausea.

''Jogador'': '''explosion'''</br>
'''Loria''': A strong blast of fire wounds the opponent you point at, and the adjacent squares.

''Jogador'': '''firewall'''</br>
'''Loria''': As the poison wall, this spell creates an even larger wall of fire, burning everyone who passes.

''Jogador'': '''great energy beam'''</br>
'''Loria''': A lightning bolt strikes the point you look at.

''Jogador'': '''invisible'''</br>
'''Loria''': This spell drains the colors out of you body, making yourself invisible for an hour or two.

''Jogador'': '''summon creature'''</br>
'''Loria''': This one gives you the ability to summon monsters that aid you in your battles.

''Jogador'': '''energy wall'''</br>
'''Loria''': Attracts lightning bolts from the sky, to form a giant wall, seriously damaging everyone who passes.

''Jogador'': '''sudden death'''</br>
'''Loria''': The best spell for deciding a battle within seconds. The spell tries to interrupt the opponents heart beat, leading to his instant death in most cases.

''Jogador'': '''ultimate explosion'''</br>
'''Loria''': A strong blast of fire wounds the opponent you point at, and the adjacent squares.

''Jogador'': '''crystals'''</br>
'''Loria''': The mystic crystal should be able to resurrect fresh corpses.

''Jogador'': '''bye'''</br>
'''Loria''': May the magic be with you, ''Jogador''.
}}

pages.title: Lugri
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Lugri | job = Roleplay | city = Thais | subarea = Alatar Lake | location = [[Alatar Lake]] ({{mapa|32389,32119,8:1|aqui}}). | implemented = Pré-6.0 | notes = Ele é um empregado dos Ruthless Seven. Se você disser "death to Noodles" e der a ele um [[Life Crystal]], fará com que você queime. Este fogo durará 10 minutos, com hits de aproximadamente 15 em 15 segundos, causando no total um dano de 250. Este NPC é também o responsável pelos divórcios.

* Conversando com esse NPC você poderá iniciar a task de necromancers da [[Killing in the Name of... Quest]].

| buysell = não | falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == Não possui. == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Lugri''': What is it that you want, ''Jogador''? ''Jogador'': '''job'''
'''Lugri''': I am a priest of Zathroth, the bringer of dark secrets. ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Lugri''': My name is Lugri. ''Jogador'': '''king'''
'''Lugri''': This puny king is no threat for our master's plans. ''Jogador'': '''life'''
'''Lugri''': Life is war. It's about survival of the fittest. ''Jogador'': '''mission''' / '''quest'''
'''Lugri''': Aren't we all on a quest for survival and supremacy? ''Jogador'': '''fight'''
'''Lugri''': Life is an eternal fight! ''Jogador'': '''help'''
'''Lugri''': If you cant help yourself you are not worth of my assistance. ''Jogador'': '''people'''
'''Lugri''': The people of Tibia are sheep, so be smart and strong enough to become their wolf. ''Jogador'': '''time'''
'''Lugri''': Who cares? ''Jogador'': '''monsters'''
'''Lugri''': They are a challenge to sift the chaff from the wheat. ''Jogador'': '''pits of inferno'''
'''Lugri''': After the ruthless seven conquered it, it's again a holy place for the followers of the dark path. ''Jogador'': '''excalibug'''
'''Lugri''': It's existence is just a lie to inspire hope and bravery in the hearts of the followers of good. ''Jogador'': '''necromants nectar'''
'''Lugri''': That's none of your business! ''Jogador'': '''task'''
'''Lugri''': What? Who are you to imply I need help from a worm like you? ... :''Jogador'': '''yes'''
:'''Lugri''': You do? I mean - wise decision. Let me explain. By now, Tibia has been overrun by numerous followers of different cults and beliefs. The true Necromancers died or left Tibia long ago, shortly after their battle was lost. ... :'''Lugri''': What is left are mainly pseudo-dark pretenders, the old wisdom and power being far beyond their grasp. They think they have the right to tap that dark power, but they don't. ... :'''Lugri''': I want you to eliminate them. As many as you can. Both necromancers and priestesses. And as I said, don't expect a reward - this is what has to be done to cleanse Tibia of its false dark prophets. ''Jogador'': '''donation'''
'''Lugri''': Do you want to make a donation? :''Jogador'': '''yes'''
:'''Lugri''': May the gods of darkness bless you! ----- === Deuses e Demônios: === ''Jogador'': '''god'''
'''Lugri''': The gods of darkness give us the chance to reach our whole potentials, the gods of good want to capture us in eternal stasis! ''Jogador'': '''gods of darkness'''
'''Lugri''': The glorious gods of darkness are Zathroth, Fafnar, Brog, Urgith, and the Archdemons. ''Jogador'': '''zathroth'''
'''Lugri''': Zathroth represents the true and unbound power of magic. He is the keeper of great secrets. ''Jogador'': '''fafnar'''
'''Lugri''': Fafnar is the power of the sun. She burns the weak to ashes. ''Jogador'': '''brog'''
'''Lugri''': Brog, the raging one, the great destroyer, the berserk of darkness ... call him how you like, but fear his awesome power. ''Jogador'': '''urgith'''
'''Lugri''': Urgith is the master of the undead. The bonemaster also takes care of the damned souls. ''Jogador'': '''archdemons'''
'''Lugri''': The demons are powerful followers of Zathroth. Their leaders are known as the ruthless seven. ''Jogador'': '''ruthless Seven'''
'''Lugri''': Infernatil, Pumin, Verminor, Tafariel, Apocalypse, Bazir and Ashfalor. ''Jogador'': '''infernatil'''
'''Lugri''': The incendiary of hell. ''Jogador'': '''pumin'''
'''Lugri''': He is the lord of despair. ''Jogador'': '''verminor'''
'''Lugri''': Ah, the plaguelord. ''Jogador'': '''tafariel'''
'''Lugri''': She is the mistress of the damned! Rewarding or torturing, it is the same for her victims! ''Jogador'': '''apocalypse'''
'''Lugri''': It is said even speaking its TRUE name will bring total destruction to you! ''Jogador'': '''bazir'''
'''Lugri''': He is the great deciver, the lord of lies. ''Jogador'': '''ashfalor'''
'''Lugri''': The right hand of Urgith. The general of the undead hordes. ''Jogador'': '''goshnar'''
'''Lugri''': The necromant king was only defeated by the nightmare knights due to a bad twist of fate. ''Jogador'': '''good''' / '''light'''
'''Lugri''': The so-called Gods of Good are Fardos, Uman, the Elements, Suon, Crunor, Nornur, Bastesh, Kirok, Toth, and Banor. ''Jogador'': '''fardos'''
'''Lugri''': Fardos is the creator. He is a helpless watcher whose 'creation' is far more then he bargained for. ''Jogador'': '''uman'''
'''Lugri''': Uman is a jealous keeper of magic. He shares only fragments of his knowledge with the mortals. To be strong one must take, not wait to be given, with Gods like that!. ''Jogador'': '''elements'''
'''Lugri''': The Elements are Tibia, Sula, Air and Fire. ''Jogador'': '''suon'''
'''Lugri''': Suon is one of the suns of our world. He gives his light mindlessly to the weak and the strong alike. ''Jogador'': '''crunor'''
'''Lugri''': Crunor is the God of nature, of plants and trees ... and plants and trees are there to be stomped upon and burnt! ''Jogador'': '''nornur'''
'''Lugri''': Nornur claims to be a God of Fate without even understanding the ways of fate at all. ''Jogador'': '''bastesh'''
'''Lugri''': Bastesh is so afraid that she hides in the depth of the seas. ''Jogador'': '''kirok'''
'''Lugri''': Kirok, the mad one, is the patron of scientists and jesters, more a nuisance than a god. ''Jogador'': '''toth'''
'''Lugri''': Toth is just the undertaker for the other 'gods of good'. ''Jogador'': '''banor'''
'''Lugri''': Banor isn't a God at all, merely one of their tools. Is it not stupidity to worship a tool? ''Jogador'': '''tibia'''
'''Lugri''': The world of Tibia is there to be taken by the strongest. When the time is right, it will fall like an overripe plum... ''Jogador'': '''sula'''
'''Lugri''': Sula is just the mindless elemental power of water. ''Jogador'': '''air '''
'''Lugri''': Air is just a mindless elemental force. ''Jogador'': '''fire '''
'''Lugri''': Fire is just a mindless elemental force. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Lugri''': Leave now, ''Jogador''. The gods of darkness will watch your soul! }}

| buysell = não | buys = | sells = | falas = ''Jogador'': '''Hi'''
'''An Old Dragonlord''': AHHH MUSHRRROOOMSSS! NOW MY PAIN WILL BE EASSSED FOR A WHILE! TAKE THISS AND LEAVE THE DRAGONSSS' CEMETERY AT ONCE!
''Jogador:'' ''''''
'''An Old Dragonlord:''' LEAVE THE DRAGONS' CEMETERY AT ONCE!

''Jogador'': '''Hi'''
'''An Old Dragonlord:''' You dare to approach me, tiny mortal?
''Jogador'': '''Tamoril'''
'''An Old Dragonlord:''' You will find him in Yalahar. And now get lost!
'Jogador'': '''The First Dragon'''
'''An Old Dragonlord:''' He who you call the first is not unknown to me. He is still alive and at a remote place, far away from humanity. But I won't talk about him with the likes of you. Perhaps Tamoril will be more kind. ...

''Jogador:'' '''bye'''

}}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.title: A Sweaty Cyclops
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = A Sweaty Cyclops | job = Ferreiro | npcclass = Gigantes | npcsprite = Cyclops | city = Ab'Dendriel | subarea = Ab'Dendriel City | location = [[Ab'Dendriel City]] ({{Mapa|32698,31677,2:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 6.2 | notes = O Sweaty Cyclops é um dos ferreiros de Ab'Dendriel. Ele mora em uma torre ao nordeste do depot que é acessível passando uma pequena caverna de rotworms. Entre os cyclopses, é conhecido como ''Bencthyclthrtrprr''; mas algumas pessoas o chamam de ''Big Ben''. Você pode encontrá-lo passando por uma caverna subterrânea e com ele você pode negociar certas armas, mas ele não aceitará itens que não sejam os que está procurando. Ele tem a aparência de um cyclops, e seus pais viveram aqui antes de os elfos começarem a colonizar o local. Ele é um forjador de metais, assim sabe muito sobre o aço e os seus tipos: Mesh Kaha Rogh, Za'Kalortith, Uth'Byth, Uth'Morc, Uth'Amon, Uth'Maer, Uth'Doon e Zatragil.

* Para negociar com ele, é necessário completar a [[The Sweaty Cyclops Quest]]. Após a conclusão, ele passará a forjar metais e itens para você. * Em algumas ocasiões, a troca de 1 [[Soul Orb]] pode resultar em 6 [[Infernal Bolt]]s em vez de 3. Quando isso acontece, ele menciona que fez um ótimo trabalho e que você receberá o dobro de bolts.

| buysell = sim | buys = Nada. | sells = {{Trades/Sell | Piece of Royal Steel | Piece of Draconian Steel | Piece of Hell Steel | Huge Chunk of Crude Iron | Infernal Bolt}} | falas = (nota: palavras sublinhadas são erros de ortografia e pode ser corrigida pela Cipsoft) ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''A Sweaty Cyclops:''' Hum Humm! Welcume here lil' ''Jogador''.
''Jogador:'' '''Job''' ou '''Here'''
'''A Sweaty Cyclops:''' I am smith.
''Jogador:'' '''Smith'''
'''A Sweaty Cyclops:''' Working steel is my profession.
''Jogador:'' '''Steel'''
'''A Sweaty Cyclops:''' Many kinds of. Some I forge. But not ancient steel.
''Jogador:'' '''Forge'''
'''A Sweaty Cyclops:''' Me can forge equipment back to steel. Like Za'Ralator, Uth'Kean, Uth'Lokr, Uth'Prta.
''Jogador:'' '''Za'Ralator'''
'''A Sweaty Cyclops:''' Hellsteel is. Cursed and evil. Dangerous to work with. Me can make from evil helmet. Li'l one want to trade?
''Jogador:'' '''Uth'Kean'''
'''A Sweaty Cyclops:''' Very noble. Shiny. Me like. But breaks so fast. Me can make from shiny armour. Li'l one want to trade?
''Jogador:'' '''Uth'Lokr'''
'''A Sweaty Cyclops:''' Firy steel it is. Need green ones' breath to melt. Or red even better. Me can make from shield. Li'l one want to trade?
''Jogador:'' '''Uth'Prta'''
'''A Sweaty Cyclops:''' Good iron is. Me friends use it much for fight. Me can make from weapon. Li'l one want to trade?
''Jogador:'' '''Ancient steel'''
'''A Sweaty Cyclops:''' Very old. Like Mesh Kaha Rogh, Za'Kalortith, Uth'Byth, Uth'Morc, Uth'Amon, Uth'Maer, Uth'Doon, and Zatragil.
''Jogador:'' '''Mesh Kaha Rogh'''
'''A Sweaty Cyclops:''' Steel that is singing when forged. No one knows where find today.
''Jogador:'' '''Za'Kalortith'''
'''A Sweaty Cyclops:''' It's evil. Demon iron is. No good cyclops goes where you can find and need evil flame to melt.
''Jogador:'' '''Uth'Byth'''
'''A Sweaty Cyclops:''' Not good to make stuff off. Bad steel it is. But eating magic, so useful is.
''Jogador:'' '''Uth'Morc'''
'''A Sweaty Cyclops:''' Li'l ones it thieves' steel call sometimes. It's dark and making not much noise.
''Jogador:'' '''Uth'Amon'''
'''A Sweaty Cyclops:''' Brightsteel is. Much art made with it. Sorcerers too lazy and afraid to enchant much.
''Jogador:'' '''Uth'Maer'''
'''A Sweaty Cyclops:''' Heartiron from heart of big old mountain, found very deep. Li'l li'l ones fiercely defend. Not wanting to have it used for stuff but holy stuff.
''Jogador:'' '''Uth'Doon'''
'''A Sweaty Cyclops:''' It's high steel called. Only li'l li'l ones know how make.
''Jogador:'' '''Zatragil'''
'''A Sweaty Cyclops:''' Most ancients use dream silver for different stuff. Now ancients most gone. Most not know about.
''Jogador:'' '''Amulet'''
'''A Sweaty Cyclops:''' Big Ben no has it more! When you also no have it, you have lost mighty, mighty amulet! Stupid li'l one!
''Jogador:'' '''Minotaurs'''
'''A Sweaty Cyclops:''' They were friend with me parents. Long before elves here, they often made visit. No longer come here.
''Jogador:'' '''Elves'''
'''A Sweaty Cyclops:''' Me not fight them, they not fight me.
''Jogador:'' '''Orcs'''
'''A Sweaty Cyclops:''' Silly ones. Not talk much. Always screaming and hitting.
''Jogador:'' '''[[Ab'Dendriel]]'''
'''A Sweaty Cyclops:''' Me parents live here before town was. Me not care about lil' ones.
''Jogador:'' '''Lil' lil'''' ou '''dwarfs'''
'''A Sweaty Cyclops:''' Lil' lil' ones are so fun. We often chat.
''Jogador:'' '''Tibia'''
'''A Sweaty Cyclops:''' One day I'll go and look.
''Jogador:'' '''[[Teshial]]''' ou '''[[Cenath]]'''
'''A Sweaty Cyclops:''' Is one of elven family or such thing. Me not understand lil' ones and their busisness.
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''
'''A Sweaty Cyclops:''' I called Bencthyclthrtrprr by me people. Lil' ones me call Big Ben.
''Jogador:'' '''God'''
'''A Sweaty Cyclops:''' You shut up. Me not want to hear.
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
'''A Sweaty Cyclops:''' Good bye lil' one.
''Jogador:'' '''Warlord Sword'''
'''A Sweaty Cyclops:''' Do li'l one want to trade a warlord sword?
''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''
'''A Sweaty Cyclops:''' You not have stuff me want for.
''Jogador:'' '''Serpent Sword'''
'''A Sweaty Cyclops:''' Do li'l one want to trade a serpent sword?
''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''
'''A Sweaty Cyclops:''' You not have stuff me want for.
''Jogador:'' '''Fire Sword'''
'''A Sweaty Cyclops:''' Do li'l one want to trade a fire sword?
''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''
'''A Sweaty Cyclops:''' You not have stuff me want for.
''Jogador:'' '''The Big Old One'''
'''A Sweaty Cyclops:''' Mountain in south. Li'l li'l ones living there.
''Jogador:'' '''Cyclops'''
'''A Sweaty Cyclops:''' Me people not live here much. Most are far away.
''Jogador:'' '''Humans'''
'''A Sweaty Cyclops:''' Always asking me for stuff they can't afford.
''Jogador:'' '''Melt'''
'''A Sweaty Cyclops:''' Can melt gold ingot for li'l one. You want?
''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''
'''A Sweaty Cyclops:''' Li'l one has no gold ingot to melt.
}}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.title: Amarie
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Amarie | job = Bibliotecário | npcclass = Humanóides | npcsprite = Elf | city = Ab'Dendriel | subarea = Ab'Dendriel City | location = [[Ab'Dendriel City]] ({{Mapa|32689,31658,6:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.5 | notes =

* Faz parte da [[The Scatterbrained Sorcerer Quest]].

 | buysell = não | falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == '''Amarie:''' Amarie: Please leave me alone... I have to study. == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador:'' '''hi''''''
'''Amarie:''' I really have to study, I’m sorry. Please leave me alone with my books. ''Jogador:'' '''dwarf'''
'''Amarie:''' Oh, those coarse barbarians! ''Jogador:'' '''job'''
'''Amarie:''' I’m a scholar. I believe that the ultimate aim in life is the pursuit of perfect knowledge through study. ''Jogador:'' '''ab’dendriel'''
'''Amarie:''' It’s pretty here with all these trees and flowers. ''Jogador:'' '''mission'''
'''Amarie:''' Mission? You should read more books. Take that as your mission. ''Jogador:'' '''dating'''
'''Amarie:''' Well… maybe there is a chance for me to find love, after all… ''Jogador:'' '''name'''
'''Amarie:''' My name is Amarie Leafdancer. ''Jogador:'' '''interesting'''
'''Amarie:''' Yes, interesting, isn’t it? I could read about them all day. ''Jogador:'' '''book'''
'''Amarie:''' Do you like books, too? I really think there’s nothing better than a good book and a cup of bug milk to relax. ''Jogador:'' '''study'''
'''Amarie:''' Oh, you’re interested in what I study? Really? That’s unusual. Well, it’s about the… no wait. I don’t want to bore you. Are you really interested? :''Jogador:'' '''yes'''
:'''Amarie:''' Wow. Okay… it’s about the… well… social interaction of milkbugs in their m… mating season. ''Jogador:'' '''bug milk'''
'''Amarie:''' It’s really sweet and nutritious. You should try it while you’re in Ab’Dendriel. ''Jogador:'' '''care'''
'''Amarie:''' Sigh… so caring, yes. Sometimes I dream of…. ah .. forget what I said. ''Jogador:'' '''dream'''
'''Amarie:''' What do I dream of? I think… no one has asked me that for a long time. In my favourite book it says… oh, but it isn’t really interesting. ''Jogador:'' '''book'''
'''Amarie:''' My favourite book… is an erm… poetry book. Which I shouldn’t waste my study time on, but… poetry can also be meaningful. ''Jogador:'' '''meaningful'''
'''Amarie:''' Meaningful like… it really touches something deep inside your heart and that just makes perfect sense to you. ''Jogador:'' '''deep'''
'''Amarie:''' I… don’t know how I can explain that better. ''Jogador:'' '''heart'''
'''Amarie:''' No, no, that’s getting far too personal… ''Jogador:'' '''sense'''
'''Amarie:''' I… don’t know how I can explain that better. ''Jogador:'' '''poetry'''
'''Amarie:''' Would you like me to… re… recite some poetry? :''Jogador:'' '''yes'''
:'''Amarie:''' Really… okay. I’ll tell you my favourite. Maybe you’ll like it too… It’s an elven poem, but I’ll translate it for you. Here goes: …
:'''Amarie:''' ‘Alas, her pale face up in the starry sky …
:'''Amarie:''' Flaunting a light that is not hers …
:'''Amarie:''' Lost in reverie to dance with the fervid sun …
:'''Amarie:''' Yet knowing that this day will never dawn …
:'''Amarie:''' For with the dawn she fades …
:'''Amarie:''' And only when darkness engulfs her …
:'''Amarie:''' Will her light shine the brightest.’ …
:'''Amarie:''' So… what do you think? Did you like the poem? :''Jogador:'' '''yes'''
:'''Amarie:''' Oh, do you really mean it? That’s so nice, finally someone who understands me. Maybe you will understand my dreams as well. Or… I’m getting carried away. My dreams are a little confusing. …
:'''Amarie:''' And I don’t think there’s a chance that I’ll ever find what I’m really looking for. I guess I shall have to resign myself to a long, lonely life without love… ''Jogador:'' '''love'''
'''Amarie:''' Love? Hah… you don’t know me. I’m really not good at this stuff. Or what is it you’re implying? ''Jogador:'' '''dating'''
'''Amarie:''' Well… maybe there is a chance for me to find love, after all… ''Jogador:'' '''bye''' / '''asha thrazi'''
'''Amarie:''' Asha Thrazi. }}

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Guide Edna | job = Guia | city = Yalahar | subarea = Yalahar Centre | location = [[Yalahar Centre]] ({{Mapa|32805,31269,6:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.4 | buysell = não | notes = Ajuda os jogadores iniciantes a se locomover pela cidade e fornece informações adicionais sobre a cidade e o Tibia. A partir do [[updates/9.8|Updates 9.8]] passou a marcar no mapa do jogo os principais pontos da cidade.

* Diga: '''Hi - Map - Yes''' para ter os principais pontos da cidade marcados em seu mapa. * Diga: '''Hi - Information - Status - Change''' - e keyword especifica para saber o status de uma [[World Change]]. * Diga: '''Hi - Depot - Yes''' para ter seu personagem levado ao depot (apenas até o level 9). * [[Arquivo:Achievement.gif|link=]] Ao falar com todos os NPCs Guias para marcar o seu mapa, você receberá o achievemet '''"{{Achievement|Territorial}}"'''

| falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == '''Guide Edna''': Need some help finding your way through Yalahar? Let me assist you.
'''Guide Edna''': Talk to me if you need directions. Meow.
'''Guide Edna''': Yes, I'm the guide. Yes, I can talk. Trust me, cats usually know the way around best.
'''Guide Edna''': Free escort to the depot for newcomers!
'''Guide Edna''': Meow, is this your first visit to Yalahar? I can show you around!
'''Guide Edna''': Want to know the status of all the world changes? Ask me. == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Guide Edna''': Meow, welcome to Yalahar, ''Jogador''! Even though I might not look like it, I can give you information and a map guide. Need some? ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Guide Edna''': Well, when I was still a human, I was called Eduania, the Great Witch - with capitals letters, mind you. But ever since my spell went wrong, I'm just Edna. ''Jogador'': '''job'''
'''Guide Edna''': I'm the only feline guide in Tibia. I might not have fingers anymore, but with my paw I can still mark important locations on your map and give you some information about the town and the world status. ''Jogador'': '''information'''
'''Guide Edna''': Currently, I can tell you all about the town, its temple, the bank, shops, spell trainers, the depot and the different quarters, as well as about the world status. ''Jogador'': '''town'''
'''Guide Edna''': Yalahar is a very old city of gigantic size, consisting of a city centre and eight quarters. The beings that are closest to be called rulers of the city are the Yalahari. ''Jogador'': '''temple'''
'''Guide Edna''': The temple is just south west of here. Actually, it's a temple raft and the priestess is somewhat... meow... you'll see what I mean. ''Jogador'': '''bank'''
'''Guide Edna''': Our bank clerk Znozel is somewhat... special. You can find him north of this harbour and then to the right, past the tavern. ''Jogador'': '''shops'''
'''Guide Edna''': You can buy weapons, armor, tools, gems, magical equipment, furniture, spells and food here. ''Jogador'': '''spell trainers'''
'''Guide Edna''': Hm, I would teach you, but I guess I should keep my paws off spells for a while. Try Tamoril, north east of the magician quarter. Remember, dragons that spit fire don't bite. Hehe. ''Jogador'': '''depot'''
'''Guide Edna''': The depot is a place where you can safely store your belongings. You are also protected against attacks there. I escort newcomers there, but it's just north of here. ''Jogador'': '''quarters'''
'''Guide Edna''': We are currently south of the inner city. Outside its walls, you can find eight city quarters, arranged like slices of a cake around the centre. ...
'''Guide Edna''': There is the former trade quarter, the foreigner quarter, the arena quarter, the alchemist quarter, the cemetery quarter, the magician quarter, the sunken quarter and the factory quarter. ''Jogador'': '''world status'''
'''Guide Edna''': If you'd like to know the status of this world just say the keyword for a world change. ''Jogador'': '''weapons / armor'''
'''Guide Edna''': We are so lucky that dwarfs are responsible for weapons and armors here. They are, as you probably know, the finest craftsmen you can imagine. The shop is just north of the post office. ''Jogador'': '''tools'''
'''Guide Edna''': General goods like ropes and shovels can be bought in Gree Dee's store in the shop tower, just north of the depot. ''Jogador'': '''gems'''
'''Guide Edna''': You can buy gems and jewellery on the lowest floor of the shop tower. Just north of the depot. ''Jogador'': '''magical / potion / runes'''
'''Guide Edna''': Chuckles sells magical equipment like runes and potions. I'm not sure if he is really as harmless as he claims, but well, he gets the job done. Shop tower, north of the depot. ''Jogador'': '''furniture'''
'''Guide Edna''': Dorbin's furniture store is to the left of the shop tower, close to the depot. ''Jogador'': '''food'''
'''Guide Edna''': Soilance, north of the depot, sells meat and the like. Serafin, whose shop is in the eastern part of the city, sells fruits and vegetables. ''Jogador'': '''map'''
'''Guide Edna''': Meow, should I make some pawprints for locations like the depot, bank and shops on your map? :''Jogador'': '''no'''
:'''Guide Edna''': Meow, nothing wrong about exploring the town on your own. Let me know if you need something! :''Jogador'': '''yes'''
:'''Guide Edna''': Meow. ''Jogador'': '''guards'''
'''Guide Edna''': Yalahar employs many guards to keep watch in front of and in between the city quarters. None of the quarters is a safe zone, terrible things happen there. ''Jogador'': '''augur'''
'''Guide Edna''': They are basically the henchmen of the Yalahari. In case you are looking for work, you should look for an Augur. ''Jogador'': '''keyword / change'''
'''Guide Edna''': Valid keywords are: Horestis, Mage Tower, Master's Voice, Swamp Fever, Thornfire, Twisted Waters, Awash, Steamship, Horses, Overhunting, Demon War, Sea Serpent, Deepling or Hive. ''Jogador'': '''meow'''
'''Guide Edna''': Meow, very funny. I try not to do it, but sometimes it just slips out of my mouth. ''Jogador'': '''ammunition / bow / distance / goods / stuff'''
'''Guide Edna''': There's something suspicious about Vincent and his past, I tell you. You can find his distance weapon store on top of the shop tower, just north of the depot. ''Jogador'': '''blessing'''
'''Guide Edna''': Blessings reduce the death penalty, meaning that if you should die, you will lose less experience, fewer skill points and fewer to no items, if you have all five blessings. ''Jogador'': '''buy / sell / equipment / offer'''
'''Guide Edna''': Meow, do I look like I have pockets? I could tell you about the shops in town though, or about the former trade quarter. ''Jogador'': '''escort'''
'''Guide Edna''': Meow, I think you can manage the way on your own, it's just to the north , down the stairs and to the left. If you need marks on your map, let me know. ''Jogador'': '''harbour'''
'''Guide Edna''': That's where we are standing right now. Captain Karith of Yalahar might need to be convinced to sail to other cities, though, so don't be surprised. ''Jogador'': '''mission / quest'''
'''Guide Edna''': Sorry, but right now you already received one or more blessings. In order to start this mission you shouldn't have received one. Please return if this is the case. Farewell. ''Jogador'': '''post'''
'''Guide Edna''': Redward is our local postman. Meow... you will get used to him. Teehee. You can find him north of this harbour and then to the right, past the tavern. ''Jogador'': '''time'''
'''Guide Edna''': It's ''horas'' right now. But I can give you more valuable information than that! ''Jogador'': '''tool'''
'''Guide Edna''': General goods like ropes and shovels can be bought in Gree Dee's store in the shop tower, just north of the depot. ''Jogador'': '''train'''
'''Guide Edna''': Are you looking for the training statues? They're just over the depot, up the stairs! I can mark them on your map. ''Jogador'': '''yalahar / city'''
'''Guide Edna''': Yalahar is a very old city of gigantic size, consisting of a city centre and eight quarters. The beings that are closest to be called rulers of the city are the Yalahari. ''Jogador'': '''yalahari'''
'''Guide Edna''': Ordinary people and cats like you and me hardly ever see one of them. They have sealed themselves off in their towers. There are a lot of guards and Augur, though. ''Jogador'': '''trade quarter'''
'''Guide Edna''': The former trade quarter in the South was once the flourishing marketplace of Yalahar. Nowadays it is completely overrun by smugglers and criminals, although, ruled by some sort of kingpin. ''Jogador'': '''foreigner quarter'''
'''Guide Edna''': That quarter is just left of here. It's a melting pot of different races. Don't expect to receive a warm welcome there. ''Jogador'': '''arena quarter'''
'''Guide Edna''': Meow, ever since all the animals broke out of the zoo and the gladiators started to behave strangely, this is no place for recreation anymore. It's to the west. ''Jogador'': '''alchemist quarter'''
'''Guide Edna''': The alchemists in the North-west experimented with dangerous and weird things, which eventually led to a gigantic explosion that ruined and contaminated the whole quarter. My fur always itches when I return from there. ''Jogador'': '''cemetery quarter'''
'''Guide Edna''': Don't expect to see a holy place of peace. The large cathedral is used for forbidden rituals only, and the graveyard is overrun by undead. It's in the North. ''Jogador'': '''magician quarter'''
'''Guide Edna''': The north-eastern quarter is home to many talented magicians. Some friendly, some... not so friendly. They try their best to keep their quarter intact and the academy running. ''Jogador'': '''sunken quarter'''
'''Guide Edna''': That's a tragedy... one of Yalahar's quarters, the one to the east, grew so big, that one day it just broke down and fell into the ocean. So many people died... ...
'''Guide Edna''': If you are interested in the whole story, you should go to the monument place to the east of the city and talk to Tarak. He's a great storyteller. ''Jogador'': '''factory quarter'''
'''Guide Edna''': The old factory is to the south-east. All sorts of things used to be manufactured there, but nowadays most magic machines are destroyed. ''Jogador'': '''''palavra aleatória'''''
'''Guide Edna''': Sorry, I don't have anything to tell you about that topic. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Guide Edna''': Enjoy your stay in Yalahar, ''Jogador''. Meow. }}

''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''</br>
'''Loui:''' BEWARE! Beware of that hole!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hole'''</br>
'''Loui:''' While looking for something - which I forgot - I found that hole. I went down, even though I had no torch. And then I heard THEM! There must be dozens!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Them'''</br>
'''Loui:''' They were so many, EVERYWHERE! I could barely escape alive. I have no clue what THEY were but one more second down there and I'd have been dead!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Story'''</br>
'''Loui:''' The good thing is that those horrible rats stay mostly in town. The bad thing is that they do so because of bigger monsters that would devour them outside.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Blueberrie'''</br>
'''Loui:''' Was it...? Yes, I might have looked for blueberries as I foolishly entered this unholy hole.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Gods'''</br>
'''Loui:''' They created Tibia and all lifeforms.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''King'''</br>
'''Loui:''' Pah, king! He should do something about this hole!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''</br>
'''Loui:''' I'm a monk. I wanted to do something here, but I forgot what it was when I fell in that hole.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Life'''</br>
'''Loui:''' The gods blessed Tibia with abundant forms of life.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''</br>
'''Loui:''' My name is Loui.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Heal'''</br>
'''Loui:''' Sorry I am out of mana and ingredients, please visit [[Cipfried]] in the town.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Time'''</br>
'''Loui:''' I have no idea how long I've been in this hole. It seemed like an eternity!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Tibia'''</br>
'''Loui:''' Everything around us, that is Tibia.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Monk'''</br>
'''Loui:''' I am a humble servant of the gods.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Money'''</br>
'''Loui:''' I'm penniless and poor as becomes a humble monk like me.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Quest'''</br>
'''Loui:''' I have no quests but to stay away from that hole and I recommend you to do the same.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Rats'''</br>
'''Loui:''' The good thing is that those horrible rats stay mostly in town. The bad thing is that they do so because of bigger monsters that would devour them outside.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Rabbits'''</br>
'''Loui:''' Then, they must be magic wielding beasts using creature illusion! Good thing you escaped.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Monsters'''</br>
'''Loui:''' There must be an army of them, just down this hole..</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Rookgaard'''</br>
'''Loui:''' This is the place where everything starts.</br>

'''Loui:''' Most adventurers take their first steps there.</br>

'''Loui:''' He owns a shop in town.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Amber'''</br>

'''Loui:''' He's a farmer.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Hyacinth'''</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Lee'Delle'''</br>
'''Loui:''' She owns a shop in town.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Lily'''</br>
'''Loui:''' She owns a shop in town.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Loui'''</br>
'''Loui:''' Waaaah! Don't shock me like that!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Norma'''</br>
'''Loui:''' She owns a bar in town.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Obi'''</br>
'''Loui:''' He owns a shop in town.</br>

'''Loui:''' Young and inexperienced he is.</br>

'''Loui:''' He has his own monsters, I believe.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Seymour'''</br>

'''Loui:''' The oracle! Yes! You should get off this island as fast as you can!</br>

'''Loui:''' I'm sure he has never seen monsters like those in this hole before.</br>

== Frases Espontâneas ==
'''Bashira''': Welcome to Ab'Dendriel's store for general goods.

== Palavras-Chave ==
''Jogador:'' '''Hi''' / '''Ashari'''</br>
'''Bashira:''' Ashari, ''Jogador''.

''Jogador:'' '''Name'''</br>
'''Bashira:''' I'm Bashira Darkmark.

''Jogador:'' '''Job'''</br>
'''Bashira:''' I sell various equipment and buy some stuff. Ask me for a trade if you're interested.

''Jogador:'' '''Equipment''' / '''Goods'''</br>
'''Bashira:''' I sell shovels, picks, scythes, bags, ropes, backpacks, plates, cups, scrolls, parchments, documents, watches, various sources of light, fishing rods and worms.

''Jogador:'' '''Light'''</br>
'''Bashira:''' I sell torches, candelabra, and oil.

''Jogador:'' '''Time'''</br>
'''Bashira:''' Buy a watch.

''Jogador:'' '''Roderick'''</br>
'''Bashira:''' His presence here is a waste of space and talking to or even about him a waste of time.

''Jogador:'' '''Olrik'''</br>
'''Bashira:''' He's quite amusing for a human.

''Jogador:'' '''Thais'''</br>
'''Bashira:''' The people of Thais boast about their mighty kingdom, but eventually their short lives will doom everything they build.

''Jogador:'' '''Venore'''</br>
'''Bashira:''' Their merchants have no patience, and all too fast, they lose their masks of friendliness.

''Jogador:'' '''Carlin'''</br>
'''Bashira:''' Carlin has some capable fighters, although they lack the grace of an elf.

''Jogador:'' '''Cenath'''</br>
'''Bashira:''' Their magic is almost as impressive as their ego.

''Jogador:'' '''Kuridai'''</br>
'''Bashira:''' Without us and our tools, nothing would work in this town.

''Jogador:'' '''Deraisim'''</br>
'''Bashira:''' Useless leaf-eaters.

''Jogador:'' '''Abdaisim'''</br>
'''Bashira:''' They left. Perhaps we should do that, too.

''Jogador:'' '''Teshial'''</br>
'''Bashira:''' A stupid Cenath myth.

''Jogador:'' '''Food'''</br>
'''Bashira:''' I'm not dealing with food.

''Jogador:'' '''Ferumbras'''</br>
'''Bashira:''' He may scare the tree dwellers or the bigmouths, but not the Kuridai.

''Jogador:'' '''Crunor'''</br>
'''Bashira:''' One god of many. They are all alike and of no use.

''Jogador:'' '''Elves'''</br>
'''Bashira:''' That's our race.

''Jogador:'' '''Dwarfs'''</br>
'''Bashira:''' They have some talent in mining and smithing.

''Jogador:'' '''Humans'''</br>
'''Bashira:''' They have nothing to give us.

''Jogador:'' '''Troll'''</br>
'''Bashira:''' They are lazy and clumsy. We should use dwarfs instead.

''Jogador:'' '''Offer''' / '''Stuff''' / '''Buy'''</br>
'''Bashira:''' My inventory of general goods is large, ask me for a trade to take a look.

''Jogador:'' '''Bye''' / '''Asha thrazi'''</br>
'''Bashira:''' Asha Thrazi, ''Jogador''.
}}

''Jogador'': '''buy''' / '''sell''' / '''offer''' / '''food''' / '''goods'''</br>
'''Brasith''': I sell corncobs, cherries, grapes, melons, pumpkins, bananas, strawberries, and carrots. I also sell juice squeezers to make fruit juice. If you like to see my offers, ask me for a trade.

''Jogador'': '''time'''</br>
'''Brasith''': Sorry, I can't help you.

''Jogador'': '''roderick'''</br>
'''Brasith''': His house is out of place in our city which is built in accordance with nature.

''Jogador'': '''olrik'''</br>
'''Brasith''': This poor human seems to think he can become an elf by spending time with us.

''Jogador'': '''thais'''</br>
'''Brasith''': I heard only terrible stories about that city.

''Jogador'': '''venore'''</br>
'''Brasith''': Their traders seem suspiciously friendly. I don't trust them.

''Jogador'': '''carlin'''</br>
'''Brasith''': The humans of Carlin at least try to live in harmony with nature.

''Jogador'': '''cenath'''</br>
'''Brasith''': The Cenath forgot as much as they had learned. I doubt they find the wisdom they are looking for without the things they neglected in their pursuit of knowledge.

''Jogador'': '''kuridai'''</br>
'''Brasith''': The Kuridai left the true path and don't see their mistake. Their way of living may have been suitable in the past, but if they don't come back to us, their path will lead into darkness.

''Jogador'': '''deraisim'''</br>
'''Brasith''': We still have much to learn but we are on the correct path at least.

''Jogador'': '''abdaisim'''</br>
'''Brasith''': The Abdaisim are on the true way of our race, maybe even closer than we are. But by abandoning the other elves, they harm themselves more than they realise.

''Jogador'': '''teshial'''</br>
'''Brasith''': They're lost. If they still exist, they are alone in the cold and the darkness.

''Jogador'': '''plant''' / '''tree'''</br>
'''Brasith''': Life takes many forms. Plants are a very basic form of life. Their simplicity makes them close to the core of nature.

''Jogador'': '''forest'''</br>
'''Brasith''': The beauty of a forest is easily missed by the unobservant.

''Jogador'': '''field'''</br>
'''Brasith''': With the growth of a community comes the need to 'use' nature rather than to 'flow' with nature. This is sad but necessary.

''Jogador'': '''ferumbras'''</br>
'''Brasith''': He thinks that he's incredibly powerful, but he only owns the mindless power of destruction.

''Jogador'': '''crunor'''</br>
'''Brasith''': We abandoned the gods a long time ago. Shortly after, they abandoned us.

''Jogador'': '''elf''' / '''elves'''</br>
'''Brasith''': Sadly, our race lacks unity. And the differences we face will grow and grow until eventually there is no race left.

''Jogador'': '''dwarf'''</br>
'''Brasith''': They work deep in the earth and claim to have lots of knowledge about it. Still, all they know are minerals, they know nothing about the life it stands for.

''Jogador'': '''human'''</br>
'''Brasith''': They are so many, so aimless, so divided. They have chosen a path I wouldn't want for my own race.

''Jogador'': '''troll'''</br>
'''Brasith''': I don't claim to understand these creatures but sometimes they are more close to the roots than we are.

''Jogador'': '''bye''' / '''asha thrazi'''</br>
'''Brasith''': Asha Thrazi.
}}

| buysell = não | buys = Nada. | sells = Nada. | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Ceiron''' Always nice to meet a fellow druid, ''Jogador''.
''Jogador:'' '''Ceiron's Waterskin'''

''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''

pages.title: Dreadeye
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Dreadeye | job = Roleplay | npcclass = Criaturas Mágicas | npcsprite = Braindeath | city = Ab'Dendriel | subarea = Hellgate | location = [[Hellgate]] ({{Mapa|32801,31572,14:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.5 | buysell = não | buys = Nada. | sells = Nada. | notes = Dreadeye foi exilado e está aprontando algo muito diabólico.

* Faz parte da [[Shadows of Yalahar Quest]].

| falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Dreadeye:''' Ah, a visitor to intimidate. Splendid!
''Jogador:'' '''Intimidate'''
'''Dreadeye:''' An amusing question in its own, naive way. Let me put it this way: I have become an outcast, and am no longer free to move about my own city. ...
'''Dreadeye:''' However, despite their limitations, my kind still regard me as useful. I can do .. things they can't or won't do. So I am of value to them. ...
'''Dreadeye:''' I have gained magnificent insights into things lesser bonelords could only dream of at the price of losing touch with concepts common amongst my kin. An insignificant price to pay for the riches I have gained! ...
'''Dreadeye:''' This makes me valuable .. for the moment. They come to me in secrecy to ask for my guidance in their petty schemes. ...
'''Dreadeye:''' They need my genius for help and that makes them less inclined to get rid of me. If the incompetent fools mess up and things go horribly wrong then they have a scapegoat to blame - me. ...
'''Dreadeye:''' However, I am just biding my time. One of these days, they will come for me .. and I'll be gone.
''Jogador:'' '''Bonelord'''
'''Dreadeye:''' You only know my race from the remnants that are scattered through this world. These remnants are nothing when compared with those bonelords who grasped the world by its throat in the glorious days of our dominance! ...
'''Dreadeye:''' We were the rulers, the ultimate masters. Fate and the Gods betrayed us. Stole what was rightfully ours. But we have survived. We are still here. What once was ours will become ours again. ...
'''Dreadeye:''' We just have to wait. Patience is our power.
''Jogador:'' '''Language'''
'''Dreadeye:''' Only true bonelords can understand our language. Even I in my... changed state have a hard time understanding even the simple parts of our writings and some parts of it are completely alien to me now. ...
'''Dreadeye:''' You, human, will never understand our language as you will never understand our ways.
''Jogador:'' '''City'''
'''Dreadeye:''' This city was built by enslaved corpses and souls. It oozes pain and despair. Just how my people like it. Sadly, it is only a pale memory of the past. ...
'''Dreadeye:''' In ancient times our cities were symphonies of agony, choruses of lost souls. Ah, the marvels of long gone times. How pitiable, that we lack the resources to enslave your puny race to sculpt something as glorious as the cities of the past. ...
'''Dreadeye:''' But, our time will come again! We merely need to wait. When the time comes, we will be ready. ...
'''Dreadeye:''' All it needs is a well timed push in the right place, human, and we will retake our rightful place and the agonised screams of your kind will be music in our ears!
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''
'''Dreadeye:''' Be grateful that you can't even hope to grasp the concept behind my name. When I was more... active and had dealings with your race, captured specimens referred to me in your language as 'dreadeye'. ...
'''Dreadeye:''' While they still had the ability to speak, that is. That will have to suffice.
''Jogador:'' '''Telas'''
'''Dreadeye:''' He is a desperate fool, turning to me for guidance, for those who deal with us pay a high price - they serve us as undead slaves for eternity, muhaha! ...
'''Dreadeye:''' And a lucky fool for I have my reasons to oblige his request.
''Jogador:'' '''Golem'''
'''Dreadeye:''' Ah yes, the issue of golems. I know. Much of the knowledge on this subject that my race have... acquired over the centuries is at my disposal. ...
'''Dreadeye:''' And I am disposed to share it. Ah, I guess you are surprised, mortal? Well there are... issues you cannot possibly hope to understand with your limited mind. Actually I can hardly comprehend them myself. ...
'''Dreadeye:''' But my madness brings certain insights. There is no need to understand, there is only the need to do what has to be done. I will make sure one of my messengers delivers Telas the information he requires. ...
'''Dreadeye:''' I hope he does not scare easily.
''Jogador:'' '''Yalahari'''
'''Dreadeye:''' A vain and elusive race. Powerful enough to defy the Gods... so they thought. Now their power is gone, their race declined. They exist still, broken, bereft of any true power. ...
'''Dreadeye:''' They are as good as dead. With our expertise in necromancy, we recognize the signs of death when we see them. Unlike us bonelords they will never rise again.
''Jogador:'' '''Necromancy'''
'''Dreadeye:''' What you understand under the term necromancy is only the tip of the iceberg compared to what we are doing, puny human. We are the masters of souls. ...
'''Dreadeye:''' Creators, shapers, masters. Ours is a complete realm beyond your understanding. Our knowledge borders the realms of apotheosis and it is only a matter of time until the final step is taken.
''Jogador:'' '''Apotheosis'''
'''Dreadeye:''' You could not hope to understand it anyway. But we were close. So close that the Gods struck down our empire and our race. But we survived. We are still here. And our time will come. You can't delay the inevitable.
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
'''Dreadeye:''' Bye. Think twice before you return here. }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Edala | job = Abençoador | npcclass = Humanóides | npcsprite = Elf Arcanist | city = Ab'Dendriel | subarea = Ab'Dendriel Surroundings | location = [[Ab'Dendriel|Ab'Dendriel Surroundings]] ({{mapa|32697,31718,7:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 7.2 | notes = Vende uma das [[Blessing|bênçãos]] disponíveis no Tibia.
'''Veja também:''' [[Blessings]].

* Ele lhe dará um [[Diapason]] se você tocar diariamente uma [[Lyre]] e falar '''Hi''' próximo ele durante 7 dias. Todos os dias o NPC irá reagir de uma forma diferente, até ficar cansado e lhe dar o item. Cada jogador pode obter somente 01 Diapason e deve respeitar o '''intervalo mínimo de 24 horas''' para tocar a Lyre ou não receberá a recompensa.

| buysell = sim | buys = Nada. | sells = {{Trades/Sell | The Fire of the Suns}} | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi.''' (primeiro dia)
'''Edala:''' Ashari, ''Jogador''. How... nice to see a human taking interest in a beautiful art such as music.
''Jogador:'' '''Hi.''' (segundo dia)
'''Edala:''' Ashari, ''Jogador''... that sound was.. interesting.
''Jogador:'' '''Hi.''' (terceiro dia)
'''Edala:''' Ashari, ''Jogador''. You've made some... progress playing the lyre, haven't you..? I want to believe you have.
''Jogador:'' '''Hi.''' (quarto dia)
'''Edala:''' ''Jogador''. My regular visitor. I certainly... appreciate your efforts to entertain me, but let me assure you, I'm quite comfortable up here by myself. Alone. In silence.
''Jogador:'' '''Hi.''' (quinto dia)
'''Edala:''' Ashari, ''Jogador''. I'm starting to feel a little sorry... for your lyre. Being forced to produce such noise must be a tragic fate.
''Jogador:'' '''Hi.''' (sexto dia)
'''Edala:''' ''Jogador''! You're driving me insane! I beg you, take your lyre away from this sacred and peaceful place.
''Jogador:'' '''Hi.''' (sétimo dia)
'''Edala:''' AAAARGH! ''Jogador''! My ears! I'd prefer listening to drunken dwarves rambling all day to the sound of your lyre! Please, at least get it tuned. Here, you can have this elvish diapason.
''Jogador:'' '''Diapason.'''
'''Edala:''' This item has magical abilities. We elves use it to tune our instruments so they create the most silvery, delicate song. It might have other uses, but I wouldn't know about that.
}}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

==== Elves ====
''Jogador:'' '''Elves'''</br>
'''Elathriel:''' My people are divided in castes in these times, until they comprehend that only the way of the Kuridai can save us all.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Cenath'''</br>
'''Elathriel:''' Arrogant bastards, but they wield quite powerful magics.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Teshial'''</br>
'''Elathriel:''' Dreamers are of no practical use. I don't mourn their demise.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Deraisim'''</br>
'''Elathriel:''' Confused cowards. With all their skill they still tend to hide and run. What a waste.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Kuridai'''</br>
'''Elathriel:''' We are the heart of the elven society. We forge, we build, and we don't allow our people to be pushed around.</br>
==== Outros ====

''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''</br>
'''Elathriel:''' Be greeted ''Jogador''.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Army'''</br>
'''Elathriel:''' It's one of the more useful concepts we can learn from the other races.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Door'''</br>
'''Elathriel:''' For safety we keep the door to the hellgate locked all times. I have the keys to open it when needed.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hellgate'''</br>
'''Elathriel:''' It was here among other structures, like the depot tower, before our people came here. It's secured by a sealed door.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Key'''</br>
'''Elathriel:''' If you are that curious, do you want to buy a key for 5000 gold? Don't blame me if you get sucked in.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''No'''</br>
'''Elathriel:''' Believe me, it's better for you that way.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''King'''</br>
'''Elathriel:''' It's hard for some of my people to grasp the true concept of a strong leader.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Magic'''</br>
'''Elathriel:''' I mastered some spells of battle.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''</br>
'''Elathriel:''' Not that I like to talk to you, but I am Elathriel Shadowslayer.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Tibianus''' / '''Eloise'''</br>
'''Elathriel:''' A human weakling, not much more.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Time'''</br>
'''Elathriel:''' I couldn't care less.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Druids'''</br>
'''Elathriel:''' Druids' magic is to peaceful for my taste.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Sorcerers'''</br>
'''Elathriel:''' I have seen human sorcerers doing some impressive things ... before they died.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Dwarfs'''</br>
'''Elathriel:''' We might use the shelter earth and hills provide us, but their obsession for metal is a waste of time.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Trolls'''</br>
'''Elathriel:''' Like all inferior races they can be at least used for something good. The other castes are just jealous about our use of them.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Excalibug'''</br>
'''Elathriel:''' I still doubt it exists.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Ferumbras'''</br>
'''Elathriel:''' Even if he'd walk through the town above the other castes won't see the necessity to follow OUR way.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''</br>
'''Elathriel:''' Asha Thrazi, stranger.
}}<noinclude>[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]</noinclude>

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Maealil | job = Sacerdote | job2 = Curador | job3 = Druid Guild Leader | job4 = Paladin Guild Leader | npcclass = Humanóides | npcsprite = Elf Arcanist | city = Ab'Dendriel | subarea = Ab'Dendriel City | location = [[Ab'Dendriel City]] ({{Mapa|32732,31634,7:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 6.2 | notes = Maealil está no templo ajudando aventureiros. Ele oferece cura, restaurando sua vida para até 65 [[hp]], além de remover os efeitos de [[poison|envenenamento]], [[fire|queimadura]] e [[energy|eletrificação]]. Também era responsável por ensinar [[magias]] para [[Druids]] e [[Paladins]].

A partir do update '''15.22''', lançado em '''27 de janeiro de 2026''', não é mais possível comprar magias com este NPC. A CipSoft removeu a interação com a palavra '''"spell"''' e a funcionalidade de compra de magias, já que elas passaram a ser aprendidas automaticamente assim que o jogador atinge o nível necessário.

* Você pode conseguir uma pedra especial falando '''Hi - Adventurer's Stone - Yes''' para este NPC. * Se você usar uma [[Adventurer's Stone]] dentro de um [[templo]], será teleportado para uma pequena ilha da [[Adventurers' Guild]].
