pages.title: Lynda
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List ={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Lynda | job = Sacerdote | job2 = Casamenteiro | job3 = Curador | city = Thais | subarea = Thais City | location = [[Thais City]] ({{Mapa|32330,32200,7:2|aqui}}). | implemented = Pré-6.0 | notes = Ela realiza [[Newly Wed Outfits Quest|casamentos]] de personagens do Tibia.
Lynda é uma [[NPC Sacerdote|sacerdote de grande panteão]]. Ela é uma empregada dos deuses do bem e toma cuidado com os deuses do mal. Ela sabe muito sobre os [[God|Deuses Tibianos]].
Antes de se tornar uma [[NPC Sacerdote|sacerdote]], ela ganhou a competição Miss Tibia três vezes consecutivas (como [[Gregor]] disse). Ela é desejada por todos em Thais.

* Você pode conseguir uma pedra especial falando '''Hi - Adventurer's Stone - Yes''' para este NPC.

| buysell = não | falas = (nota: palavras sublinhadas são erros de ortografia e pode ser corrigida pela Cipsoft) ==== Palavras-Chave Gerais ==== ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Lynda:''' Welcome in the name of the gods, pilgrim ''Jogador''!
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
'''Lynda:''' I am a priest of the great pantheon.
''Jogador:'' '''King'''
'''Lynda:''' King Tibianus is our benevolent sovereign.
''Jogador:'' '''Life'''
'''Lynda:''' Life is a gift of the gods, honor life and don't destroy it.
''Jogador:'' '''Mission''' ou '''quest'''
'''Lynda:''' It is my mission to spread knowledge about the gods.
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''
'''Lynda:''' My name is Lynda. And the spirits tell me that you are ''Jogador''.
''Jogador:'' '''Tibia'''
'''Lynda:''' The world of Tibia is the creation of the gods.
''Jogador:'' '''Time'''
'''Lynda:''' Now, it is 0:00 am.
''Jogador:'' '''Monsters'''
'''Lynda:''' They are creatures of the gods of evil!
''Jogador:'' '''Fire'''
'''Lynda:''' Fire is one of the primal elemental forces, sometimes worshipped by tribal shamans.
''Jogador:'' '''Air'''
'''Lynda:''' Air is one of the primal elemental forces, sometimes worshipped by tribal shamans.
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
'''Lynda:''' Good bye, ''Jogador''. May the gods guard you, my child!
=== Sins === ''Jogador:'' '''Sins'''
'''Lynda:''' Do you wish to confess your sins, my child?
''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''
'''Lynda:''' So tell me, what shadows your soul, my child.
''Jogador:'' I killed a deer ''(ou o que quiser dizer)''
'''Lynda:''' Meditate on that and pray for your soul.
=== Doação === ''Jogador:'' '''Donation'''
'''Lynda:''' Do you want to make a donation?
''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''
'''Lynda:''' May the gods bless you!
==== Os Deuses do Bem ==== ''Jogador:'' '''Gods'''
'''Lynda:''' The gods of good guard us and guide us, the gods of evil want to destroy us and steal our souls!
''Jogador:'' '''The gods of good'''
'''Lynda:''' The gods we call the good ones are Fardos, Uman, the Elements, Suon, Crunor, Nornur, Bastesh, Kirok, Toth, and Banor.
''Jogador:'' '''Fardos'''
'''Lynda:''' Fardos is the creator, the great obsever. He is our caretaker.
''Jogador:'' '''Uman'''
'''Lynda:''' Uman is the positive aspect of magic. He brings us the secrets of the arcane arts.
''Jogador:'' '''Suon'''
'''Lynda:''' Suon is the lifebringing sun. He observes the creation with love.
''Jogador:'' '''Crunor'''
'''Lynda:''' Crunor, the great tree, is the father of all plantlife. He is a prominent god for many druids.
''Jogador:'' '''Nornur'''
'''Lynda:''' Nornur is the mysterious god of fate. Who knows if he is its creator or just a chronist?
''Jogador:'' '''Bastesh'''
'''Lynda:''' Bastesh, the deep one, is the goddess of the sea and its creatures.
''Jogador:'' '''Kirok'''
'''Lynda:''' Kirok, the mad one, is the god of scientists and jesters.
''Jogador:'' '''Toth'''
'''Lynda:''' Toth, lord of death, is the keper of the souls, the guardian of the afterlife.
''Jogador:'' '''Banor'''
'''Lynda:''' Banor, the heavenly warrior, is the patron of all fighters against evil. He is the gift of the gods to inspire humanity.
==== Os Deuses do Mal ==== ''Jogador:'' '''Gods of evil'''
'''Lynda:''' The goods we call the evil ones are Zathroth, Fafnar, Brog, Urgith, and the Archdemons!
''Jogador:'' '''Zathroth'''
'''Lynda:''' Zathroth is the destructive aspect of magic. He is the deceiver and the thief of souls.
''Jogador:'' '''Fafnar'''
'''Lynda:''' Fafnar is the scorching sun. She observes the creation with hate and jealousy.
''Jogador:'' '''Brog'''
'''Lynda:''' Brog, the raging one, is the great destroyer. The berserk of darkness.
''Jogador:'' '''Urgith'''
'''Lynda:''' The bonemaster Urgith is the lord of the undead and keeper of the damned souls.
''Jogador:'' '''The Archdemons'''
'''Lynda:''' The demons are followers of Zathroth. The cruelest are known as the ruthless seven.
''Jogador:'' '''Ruthless Seven'''
'''Lynda:''' I dont want to talk about that subject!
''Jogador:'' '''Ferumbras'''
'''Lynda:''' He is a favourite of the Gods of Evil and one of their Champions. He will have his come uppance one day. }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Marvik | job = Druid Guild Leader | city = Thais | subarea = Thais City | location = [[Thais City]] ({{Mapa|32444,32214,8:2|aqui}}). | implemented = Pré-6.0 | notes = Ele é o líder da guild de [[Druids]] em Thais.
A partir do update 15.22 do dia 27 de janeiro de 2026 não é mais possível comprar magias com esse NPC pois a CipSoft removeu a interação com a palavra "Spell", e a função de comprar magias, visto que agora as magias passaram a ser adicionadas automaticamente assim que o players chega ao nível necessário. | buysell = sim | buys = Nada. | sells = {{Ensina | Apprentice's Strike | Chill Out | Creature Illusion | Cure Poison | Disintegrate Rune | Find Person | Food (Spell) | Great Light | Ice Wave | Intense Healing | Invisible | Light | Light Healing | Magic Patch | Magic Shield | Mud Attack | Paralyze | Summon Creature | Terra Wave | Ultimate Healing}} '''Magias para fazer runas:''' {{Ensina | Avalanche Rune | Chameleon Rune | Convince Creature | Cure Poison Rune | Destroy Field | Energy Field Rune | Energy Wall | Explosion | Fire Bomb | Fire Field Rune | Fire Wall | Heavy Magic Missile | Intense Healing Rune | Light Magic Missile | Poison Field Rune | Poison Wall | Stalagmite Rune | Ultimate Healing Rune}} | falas = (nota: palavras sublinhadas são erros de ortografia e pode ser corrigida pela Cipsoft) ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Marvik:''' Welcome to my cave, ''Jogador''. How may I help you?
''Jogador:'' '''Army'''
'''Marvik:''' I don't care about armies.
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
'''Marvik:''' I am the chief druid. I am responsible for all members.
''Jogador:'' '''Druid'''
'''Marvik:''' I am a druid. Druids concentrate their magic on defence, healing, and nature.
''Jogador:'' '''Magic''' / '''Power'''
'''Marvik:''' Everyone who joins the Druids has the opportunity to learn many magic spells.
''Jogador:'' '''Spells'''
'''Marvik:''' Sorry, I only sell spells to druids.
''Jogador:'' '''Members'''
'''Marvik:''' Our members use their magic power to protect their life and the life of other creatures.
''Jogador:'' '''Ng''' / '''Tibianus'''
'''Marvik:''' Kings come and go.
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''
'''Marvik:''' I am Marvik. Probably you heard from me.
''Jogador:'' '''Marvik'''
'''Marvik:''' Marvik is my name, so what?
''Jogador:'' '''Time'''
'''Marvik:''' Eh, I haven't seen daylight for a long time. So, don't ask me, what time it is.
''Jogador:'' '''Sorcerers'''
'''Marvik:''' Sorcerers are very aggressive. They use their power for fighting and killing.
==== Deuses e Lendas ==== ''Jogador:'' '''Excalibug'''
'''Marvik:''' Even in my visions, I couldn't get any enlightenment about the whereabouts of this weapon of legend.
''Jogador:'' '''Ferumbras'''
'''Marvik:''' A misguided follower of evil.
''Jogador:'' '''Crunor'''
'''Marvik:''' Crunor, the eternal tree, is more than nature. Even more as the sum of each part of nature.
==== NPCs em Thais ==== ''Jogador:'' '''Baxter'''
'''Marvik:''' I don't know him.
''Jogador:'' '''Bozo'''
'''Marvik:''' I don't like his kind of humour.
''Jogador:'' '''Donald McRonald'''
'''Marvik:''' The McRonalds are true believers.
''Jogador:'' '''Elane'''
'''Marvik:''' Paladins are quite proud of their magic but lack the understandig of the powers they wield.
''Jogador:'' '''Frodo'''
'''Marvik:''' A little more seriousity would suite him well.
''Jogador:'' '''Gorn'''
'''Marvik:''' A shopkeeper.
''Jogador:'' '''Gregor'''
'''Marvik:''' Warriors are the main recipients of our healing powers.
''Jogador:'' '''Harkath Bloodblade'''
'''Marvik:''' I understand, he's a warrior of some kind.
''Jogador:'' '''Lynda'''
'''Marvik:''' Though she focuses not only on Crunor, she is an enlightened person.
''Jogador:'' '''Muriel'''
'''Marvik:''' So much power and so little philosophy ... a dangerous combination indeed.
''Jogador:'' '''Oswald'''
'''Marvik:''' He saws the seeds of evil through spreading rumours.
''Jogador:'' '''Quentin'''
'''Marvik:''' He is a great healer.
''Jogador:'' '''Sam'''
'''Marvik:''' An armourer.
''Jogador:'' '''Lugri'''
'''Marvik:''' A misguided soul who lost the path in the darkness.
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
'''Marvik:''' Farewell.
}}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.title: Muriel
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Muriel | job = Sorcerer Guild Leader | city = Thais | subarea = Thais City | location = [[Thais City]] ({{Mapa|32295,32263,7:1|aqui}}). | implemented = Pré-6.0 | notes = Em seu shop, existem alguns pisos que só permitem que [[Sorcerers]] passem por eles.
A partir do update 15.22 do dia 27 de janeiro de 2026 não é mais possível comprar magias com esse NPC pois a CipSoft removeu a interação com a palavra "Spell", e a função de comprar magias, visto que agora as magias passaram a ser adicionadas automaticamente assim que o players chega ao nível necessário.
Ele costumava vender [[Fireball]] antes do [[Updates/8.1|update de inverno 2007]], depois da atualização, [[Fireball]] tornou-se premium. Além disso, em um quadro negro está escrito que você pode comprar um [[Spellbook]], basta pedir a ele e poderá comprar por 160gps.
'''Muriel''' escreveu os seguintes livros: * [[Famous Necromancers (Book)|Famosos Necromancers]] * [[Famous Necromants (Book)|Famosos Necromants]] * [[How to Create Spellbooks (Book)|Como criar Spellbooks]] * [[How to Manipulate Runes (Book)|Como manipular Runas]] * [[The Secrets of Rune Magic (Book)|Os segredos de Runa Magica]] * [[What Runes are Made Of (Book)|De que as runa são feitas]] Ele é mencionado em uma carta que era para ser enviado a ele, mas o remetente morreu em [[Plains of Havoc]].

* Faz parte da [[Festive Outfits Quest]].

| buysell = não | buys = Nada. | sells = Nada. | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Muriel:''' Greetings, ''Jogador''! Looking for wisdom and power, eh?
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
'''Muriel:''' I am the second sorcerer. I am selling spellbooks, let me know if you're interested.
''Jogador:'' '''Sorcerer'''
'''Muriel:''' A sorcerer spends his lifetime studying spells to gain power.
''Jogador:'' '''Power'''
'''Muriel:''' Of course, power is the most important thing in the universe.
''Jogador:'' '''King''' / '''Tibianus'''
'''Muriel:''' The king is a patron of the arcane arts.
''Jogador:'' '''Army''' / '''General'''
'''Muriel:'''We supply the army with some sorcerer recruits now and then...
''Jogador:'' '''Ancestors'''
'''Muriel:'''There have been many generations of sorcerers in the past. Today, a lot of people want to join us.
''Jogador:'' '''Arcian'''
'''Muriel:''' Arcian was a childhood friend of mine. We studied the art of sorcery together but later, our ways parted ...
'''Muriel:''' Whereas I stayed here to instruct young new sorcerers, he devoted his life to his own studies ...
'''Muriel:''' Since his experiments tended to become a bit dangerous and he wanted to further explore a magic phenomenon he discovered in the Plains of Havoc anyway, he moved there and took his wife and his two assistants with him ...
'''Muriel:''' We stayed in contact for a while and he maintained a one-way teleporter to the academy. As I was missing any message from him for some time, I travelled to the plains to learn what might have happened ...
'''Muriel:''' I found the house overrun by ghouls, and no living soul. I have to assume that those ghouls have killed them and dragged everyone in their lairs. I left as soon as I could ...
'''Muriel:''' I wouldn't have wanted to see what they've done to my old friend. It's a sad story indeed.
''Jogador:'' '''Laira'''
'''Muriel:''' Laira was the wife of my childhood friend Arcian. She was a warm and caring person. I hope she had not to suffer for long as ... she was killed by the undead. Sorry, I don't want to speak about that matter anymore.
''Jogador:'' '''Porgol'''
'''Muriel:''' Porgol was a quite bright student, although a bit overambitious. I was surprised when he agreed to accompany my friend Arcian to the Plains of Havoc to support him in his studies ...
'''Muriel:''' I was quite sure he'd rather study at the Edron academy instead. But sometimes people surprise one in a positive way. All the more it is tragic he found his death in this assault of undead on Arcian's house.
''Jogador:'' '''Pits of Inferno'''
'''Muriel:''' They are rumoured to be hidden somewhere in the Plains of Havoc, far to the east.
''Jogador:'' '''Explorer Society''' / '''Inscription'''
'''Muriel:''' I heard that a member of the Explorer Society was in fact searching for the First Dragon. What a foolish endeavour - please excuse this comment. A romantic idea and a brave venture but seriously: the First Dragon. It is just a myth! ...
'''Muriel:''' However the explorer found an ancient inscription underneath the city of Thais. Reportedly he discovered it in the small cave where the first time ever a dragon was sighted on Tibia.
''Jogador:'' '''Excalibug'''
'''Muriel:'''The enchantments on this weapon must be awesome.
''Jogador:'' '''Cave'''
'''Muriel:''' I don't know exactly where it is. Someone told me you have to pass some tunnels full of orcs, somewhere underneath the king's castle. But that might be just gossip.
''Jogador:'' '''First Dragon'''
'''Muriel:''' The dragon was ancient beyond compare. Eventually even he had to succumb to old age and flew to the dragon cemetery to die there. Or so it is told.
''Jogador:'' '''News'''
'''Muriel:''' Our guild is working on a new spell, but I won't give away any details yet.
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''
'''Muriel:''' You may call me Muriel.
''Jogador:'' '''Spell'''
'''Muriel:''' Sorry, I only sell spells to sorcerers. ''(se o jogador não for sorcerer)''
'''Muriel:''' I'd love to help you, but I'm now in retirement, fortunately. I finally have more time to gain even more power. ''(se o jogador for sorcerer)''
''Jogador:'' '''Time'''
'''Muriel:''' Time is unimportant.
''Jogador:'' '''Ferumbras'''
'''Muriel:''' I wonder how he actually got these awesome powers.
''Jogador:'' '''Bozo'''
'''Muriel:''' He's not a jester but a poor joke himself.
''Jogador:'' '''Elane'''
'''Muriel:''' She is quite proud of her puny magic tricks.
''Jogador:'' '''Frodo'''
'''Muriel:''' A bar is no place that suits a scholar like me.
''Jogador:'' '''Gregor'''
'''Muriel:''' Knights! Childs with swords. Not worth of any attention.
''Jogador:'' '''Lungelen'''
'''Muriel:''' She keeps the whole wisdom of our ancestors and leads our guild.
''Jogador:'' '''Lynda'''
'''Muriel:''' Pretty and compentent.
''Jogador:'' '''McRonald'''
'''Muriel:''' Simple farmers.
''Jogador:'' '''Muriel'''
'''Muriel:''' I don't like jokes about my name!
''Jogador:'' '''Quentin'''

pages.title: Abran Ironeye
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Abran Ironeye | job = Herói | npcclass = Humanos | npcsprite = Hero | city = Venore | subarea = Venore City | location = [[Venore City|Venore City - Iron House]] ({{Mapa|32907,32117,5:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 7.1 | notes = Abran é um guerreiro que administra a Ironhouse, onde seus empregados forjam, consertam e vendem armas e armaduras. Seja cuidadoso perguntando para ele sobre o olho de ferro e [[Teddy Bear]]s. Abran Ironeye gostaria de ser o verdadeiro rei-guerreiro em Thais. A independência de Carlin é uma prova da fraqueza de Thais. Ele reza para [[Banor]]. | buysell = não | buys = | sells = | falas = ''Jogador'': '''Hi'''
[[Abran Ironeye]]: Hail, ''Jogador''!
''Jogador'': '''name'''
[[Abran Ironeye]]: I am Abran Ironeye.
''Jogador'': '''Ironeye'''
[[Abran Ironeye]]: I don't care if you like it or not. Stop staring at it!
''Jogador'': '''Job'''
[[Abran Ironeye]]: I am a busy man. I run the Ironhouse.
''Jogador'': '''Ironhouse'''
[[Abran Ironeye]]: What do you think? Here weapons and armor are forged, repaired, and sold.
''Jogador'': '''Forged / warehouse'''
[[Abran Ironeye]]: My Ironhouse is more than a warehouse..
''Jogador'': '''Excalibug'''
[[Abran Ironeye]]: If someone would bring me that weapon I could reshape the realm... and reward this hero beyond his dreams.
''Jogador'': '''Teddy'''
[[Abran Ironeye]]: I don't know anything about a teddy... and if you are smart you shouldn't either...
''Jogador'': '''Tibia'''
[[Abran Ironeye]]: The world is ready for a significant change.
''Jogador'': '''[[Banor]]'''
[[Abran Ironeye]]: As a man that grows up needs no mommy, a warrior has to outgrow his need for gods.
''Jogador'': '''King''' / '''Tibianus'''
[[Abran Ironeye]]: I would like to see a true warrior-king in Thais... like in the old days. But who knows, perhaps one day the tides of fate will bring such a man to power. Who knows...
''Jogador'': '''Thais'''
[[Abran Ironeye]]: Thais has outlived its usefulness since years. Its star is sinking.
''Jogador'': '''Carlin'''
[[Abran Ironeye]]: Their independence is a proof for the weakness of Thais.
''Jogador'': '''army'''
[[Abran Ironeye]]: Such a great tool wasted for garrison duties, a shame.
''Jogador'': '''Excalibug'''
[[Abran Ironeye]]: If someone would bring me that weapon I could reshape the realm... and reward this hero beyond his imagination.
''Jogador'': '''Ferumbras'''
[[Abran Ironeye]]: Quite a challenge, but his bets for power were made without the finesse of a true warrior.
''Jogador'': '''finesse'''
[[Abran Ironeye]]: I won't give away my tricks, learn your own.
''Jogador'': '''tax'''
[[Abran Ironeye]]: The taxing keeps the Thaian kingdom alive, but it also might break its neck one day.
''Jogador'': '''time'''
[[Abran Ironeye]]: You should know that on your own!
''Jogador'': '''gambling'''
[[Abran Ironeye]]: I trust only in skill, not luck.
''Jogador'': '''Bye'''
[[Abran Ironeye]]: You are dismissed. }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.title: Alwin
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Alwin | job = Guarda | npcclass = Humanos | npcsprite = Knight | city = Venore | subarea = Venore City | location = [[Venore City]] ({{Mapa|32876,32126,6:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 7.1 | notes = Ele protege a cidade de Venore contra o ataque de criaturas do pântano. Alwin dá curtas informações sobre a cidade e os pântanos. E a coisa mais importante! "Não tente dizer qualquer palavrão para ele! Ou ele ataca e queima você! (queimaduras mais rápido do que fogo normal)". | buysell = não | falas = ''Jogador'': '''Hello'''
Alwin: LONG LIVE THE KING! ''Jogador'': '''how are you?'''
Alwin: That's classified information! ''Jogador'': '''Job'''
Alwin: I am a protector of the people of Venore. ''Jogador'': '''Venore'''
Alwin: The harbour is to the north, the weapon market in the south, the general market to the west, and the bank to the east. You will find other shops and the [[Venore#Hard_Rock_Tavern|Hard Rock Tavern]] in the center. ''Jogador'': '''King'''
Alwin: Tibianus III is our beloved king! He rules over Venore from far away Thais. ''Jogador'': '''Tibianus'''
Alwin: Tibianus III is our beloved king! ''Jogador'': '''Swamp'''
Alwin: The swamp is a dangerous place and full of monsters, not to mention all those swampelves living at shadowthorn, amazons, and swamptrolls. ''Jogador'': '''Monsters'''
Alwin: The swamp is full of nasty snakes and there's a dragon breeding ground somewhere in the swamps. ''Jogador'': '''Amazons'''
Alwin: They are the best example for the results of the Carlin madness. ''Jogador'': '''Swamptroll'''
Alwin: This hideous creatures are even more ugly than the normal trolls. They are treacherous and use several poisons. ''Jogador'': '''Swampelves'''
Alwin: Those elves hide in the swamps and are trying to kill all humans in this area. ''Jogador'': '''Guard / Army / Secret Police'''
Alwin: This information is confidential. ''Jogador'': '''Dogs of war'''
Alwin: They are our rolemodells. ''Jogador'': '''Silver guards.'''
Alwin: Only the best of the best serve as silver guards. ''Jogador'': '''Battlegroups'''
Alwin: I doubt you have the security clearance to ask that. ''Jogador'': '''Knights of Noodles'''
Alwin: Every guard dreams of becoming one of them one day. ''Jogador'': '''news'''
Alwin: Look for the Hard Rock Tavern to learn the latest news. ''Jogador'': '''Sell / Buy'''
Alwin: Ask the merchants of the city. There are more than enough
''Jogador'': '''Red Guard'''
Alwin: We of the red guard are the special forces and town guards. ''Jogador'': '''Castle'''
The castle is in Thais, the crown of the kingdom. ''Jogador'': '''city'''
Alwin: This city, a member of the Thaian kingdom, is under the protection of the Thaian army. ''Jogador'': '''Bye'''
Alwin: LONG LIVE THE KING! }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.title: Oswald
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}}
| name        = Oswald
| job         = Roleplay
| city        = Thais
| subarea     = Thais City
| location    = [[Thais City]] ({{Mapa|32379,32221,7:2|aqui}}).
| implemented = Pré-6.0
| buysell     = não
| buys        = 
| sells       = 
| notes       = Oswald é o assistente do ilustre [[Durin]]. Ele deve prevenir que as pessoas não incomodem Durin e é bastante vago em suas explicações. Boatos dizem que Durin controlou as ações de Ferumbras por um bom tempo. Oswald espalha falsos rumores, e é um pouco detestado pelos outros cidadãos de Thais.
| falas       = 
''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''</br>
'''Oswald:''' Oh, hello ''Jogador''. What is it?</br>
''Jogador:'' '''News'''</br>
'''Oswald:''' '''Oswald:''' You know a rumour? TELL ME! TELL ME! TELL ME!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Aruda'''</br>
'''Oswald:''' She's a little witch, trust me. She used to be the girlfriend of this evil Partos some time ago.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''</br>
'''Oswald:''' Oh, hello ''Jogador''. What is it?</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Gods'''</br>
'''Oswald:''' I think the gods are too busy to care about us mortals, hmm... that makes me feel godlike, too.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Job''' / '''Important'''</br>
'''Oswald:''' I am honored to be the assistant of the great, the illustrious, the magnificent Durin!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Assistant'''</br>
'''Oswald:''' I have a job of great responsibility, mostly I keep annoying persons away from my boss.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Annoying'''</br>
'''Oswald:''' You better don't ask, you wouldn't like the answer.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''King'''</br>
'''Oswald:''' Ah, yes, yes, hail to King Tibianus! Long live the king and so on...</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Magic'''</br>
'''Oswald:''' I overheard a conversation of officials, that magic will be forbidden soon.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''</br>
'''Oswald:''' My name is Oswald, but let's proceed, I am a very busy man.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Sell'''</br>
'''Oswald:''' Hey, I am not a shopkeeper, I am an important man!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Time'''</br>
'''Oswald:''' It is nearly tea time, so please hurry!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Weapon'''</br>
'''Oswald:''' It's rumoured that Sam does not forge all weapons himself, but buys them from his cousin, who is married to a cyclops.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Dungeon'''</br>
'''Oswald:''' If you want to see dungeons just don't pay your taxes.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Excalibug'''</br>
'''Oswald:''' It's beyond all doubt that certain sinister elements in our city have certain knowledge about this myth.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Necromants Nectar'''</br>
'''Oswald:''' You are not the first one to ask about that. Am I the only one that preferes wine to such disgusting stuff?</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Benjamin'''</br>
'''Oswald:''' What do you expect from ex-soldiers? He is nuts! Hacked on the head far too often.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Bozo'''</br>
'''Oswald:''' Isn't he the artist formerly known as the prince?</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Chester Kahs'''</br>
'''Oswald:''' I never found any rumour concerning him, isn't that odd?</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Elane'''</br>
'''Oswald:''' They say she killed over a dozen husbands already.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Gamel'''</br>
'''Oswald:''' This man lives in the darkness like a rat and is also as handsome as one of them. He surely is up to no good and often consorts with sinister strangers.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Sinister strangers'''</br>
'''Oswald:''' Just last week a one eyed man, who had a room at Frodo's, met him in the middle of the night.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Gorn'''</br>
'''Oswald:''' He sells his scrolls far too expensive.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Gregor'''</br>
'''Oswald:''' I was told he lost a body part or two in duels... if you know what I mean.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Muriel'''</br>
'''Oswald:''' He is rumoured to summon kinky demons to... well you know.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Rumours'''</br>
'''Oswald:''' You know a rumour? TELL ME! TELL ME! TELL ME!</br>
''Jogador:'' ''aNything''</br>
'''Oswald:''' Fascinating! Absolutely fascinating!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Quentin'''</br>
'''Oswald:''' I heard he was a ladies' man in younger days. In our days he is rumoured to wear women clothes now and then.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Sam'''</br>
'''Oswald:''' A simple shopkeeper with minor intelligence.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Goshnar'''</br>
'''Oswald:''' They say he isn't truly dead. He was... or is a necromant after all.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Lugri'''</br>
'''Oswald:''' Some say he is Ferumbras in disguise.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Partos'''</br>
'''Oswald:''' What a shame. He claimed to be the king of thiefs and was caught stealing some fruit.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Durin'''</br>
'''Oswald:''' Just between you and me, he can be quite a tyrant.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Monsters'''</br>
'''Oswald:''' AHHHH!!! WHERE??? WHERE???</br></br>
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''</br>
'''Oswald:''' Finally!</br>
}}<noinclude>[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]</noinclude>

pages.title: A Prisoner
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = A Prisoner | job = Criminoso | npcclass = Humanos | npcsprite = Mage | city = Thais | subarea = Mintwallin | location = [[Mintwallin]] ({{Mapa|32393,32139,13:2|aqui}}). | implemented = Pré-6.0 | notes = O primeiro humano a chegar na cidade dos Minotauros, conhecida como Mintwallin. Ele foi preso por que Markwin não consegue entender o que ele fala. Ele nunca será solto. Para falar com ele é preciso obter a chave da prisão: [[Key 3620]]. Para vender [[Blank Rune]] é necessário digitar sell blank rune, ironicamente o npc diz que pagará 50.000 gp por cada, mas acaba pagando 10 gp.

* Faz parte da [[Mad Mage Room Quest]]. * Faz parte da [[The Paradox Tower Quest]].

| buysell = sim | buys = {{Trades/Buy |Blank Rune, 10}} | sells = | falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == Não possui. == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''A Prisoner''': Huh? What? I can see! Wow! A non-mino. Did they capture you as well? ''Jogador'': '''capture'''
'''A Prisoner''': Yes, they capture people. I guess that's their job. ''Jogador'': '''job'''
'''A Prisoner''': Job? JOB? Hey man - I am in prison! But you know - once upon a time - I was a powerful mage! A mage ... come to think of it .., what is that - a mage? ''Jogador'': '''time'''
'''A Prisoner''': Better save time than comitting a crime. I am a poet and I know it! ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''A Prisoner''': My name is - um... hang on? I knew it yesterday, didn't I? Doesn't matter! ''Jogador'': '''monster'''/ '''home''' / '''conjure'''
'''A Prisoner''': Yeah! There are many monsters guarding my home. Only the bravest hero will be able to slay them! ''Jogador'': '''mino'''
'''A Prisoner''': They are trying to capture me! Or hang on! Haven't they already captured me? Hmmm - I will have to think about this. ''Jogador'': '''sorcerer'''
'''A Prisoner''': I am the mightiest sorcerer from here to there! Yeah! ''Jogador'': '''mad mage'''
'''A Prisoner''': Hey! That's me! You got it! Thanks mate - now I remember my name! ''Jogador'': '''books'''
'''A Prisoner''': I have many books in my home. But only powerful people can read them. I bet you will only see three dots after the headline! Hehehe! Hahaha! Excellent! ''Jogador'': '''escape'''
'''A Prisoner''': How could I escape? They only give me rotten food here. I can´t regain my powers because I have no mana! ''Jogador'': '''labyrinth''' / '''way'''
'''A Prisoner''': It´s easy to find your way through it! Just follow the pools of mud. Hehe - useful hint, isn´t it? ''Jogador'': '''sell rune'''
'''A Prisoner''': You want to sell me blank runes! I will give you 50000 gold for each rune! Interested? :''Jogador'': '''yes'''
:'''A Prisoner''': Ok. Take my money. I can summon new money anytime - hehehe. ''Jogador'': '''karl'''
'''A Prisoner''': Tataah! ''Jogador'': '''markwin'''
'''A Prisoner''': He is the worst of them all! He is the king of the minos! May he burn in hell! ''Jogador'': '''demons'''
'''A Prisoner''': The only monster I cannot conjure. But soon I will be powerful enough! ''Jogador'': '''apples'''
'''A Prisoner''': Apples! Real apples! Man I love them! Can I have one? Oh please say yes! ''Jogador'': '''power'''
'''A Prisoner''': Power. Hmmm. Once while we were crossing the mountains together a man named Aureus said to me that parcels are equal to power. Any idea what that meant? ''Jogador'': '''key'''
'''A Prisoner''': Sure I have the key! Hehehe! Perhaps I will give it to you. IF you can solve my riddle. ''Jogador'': '''riddle'''
'''A Prisoner''': Great riddle, isn´t it? If you can tell me the correct answer, I will give you something. Hehehe! ''Jogador'': '''PD-D-KS-P-PD'''
'''A Prisoner''': Hurray! For that I will give you my key for - hmm - let´s say ... some apples. Interested? :''Jogador'': '''yes'''
:'''A Prisoner''': Mnjam - excellent apples. Now - about that key. You are sure want it? :''Jogador'': '''yes'''
:'''A Prisoner''': Really, really? :''Jogador'': '''yes'''
:'''A Prisoner''': Really, really, really, really? :''Jogador'': '''yes'''
:'''A Prisoner''': Then take it and get happy - or die, hehe. ''Jogador'': '''something'''
'''A Prisoner''': No! I won't tell you. Shame coz it would be useful for you - hehehe. ''Jogador'': '''palkar'''
'''A Prisoner''': He is the leader of the outcasts. I hope he will never conquer the city of Mintwallin. That would be the end of me! ''Jogador'': '''numbers''' / '''mathemagic'''
'''A Prisoner''': My surreal numbers are based on astonishing facts. Are you interested in learning the secret of mathemagics? ''Jogador'': '''bye''' ''(pegando a chave)''
'''A Prisoner''': Good bye! Don't forget about the secrets of mathemagics. ''Jogador'': '''bye''' ''(sem pegar a chave)''
'''A Prisoner''': Next time we should talk about my surreal numbers. }}

pages.title: Quentin
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Quentin | job = Monge | job2 = Sacerdote | job3 = Curador | npcclass = Humanos | npcsprite = Monk | city = Thais | subarea = Thais City | location = [[Thais City]] ({{Mapa|32369,32241,7:2|aqui}}). | implemented = Pré-6.0 | notes = Quentin mora no Templo de Thais. Ele pode curar você caso esteja envenenado, queimado ou eletrificado.

* Você pode conseguir uma pedra especial falando '''Hi - Adventurer's Stone - Yes''' para este NPC. * Se você usar uma [[Adventurer's Stone]] dentro de templo, você será teleportado para pequena ilha da [[Adventurers' Guild]].

| buysell = não | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Quentin:''' Welcome, adventurer ''Jogador''! If you are new in Tibia, ask me for help.
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''
'''Quentin:''' My name is Quentin.
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
'''Quentin:''' Job? I have no job. I just live for the gods of Tibia.
''Jogador:'' '''Tibia'''
'''Quentin:''' That is where we are. The world of Tibia. Admire its beauty.
''Jogador:'' '''King'''
'''Quentin:''' Our king resides in the castle to the west.
''Jogador:'' '''Help'''
'''Quentin:''' First you should try to get some gold to buy better equipment.
''Jogador:'' '''Gods'''
'''Quentin:''' They created Tibia and all life on it.
''Jogador:'' '''Life'''
'''Quentin:''' On Tibia there are many forms of life. There are plants and people and monsters.
''Jogador:'' '''Plant'''
'''Quentin:''' Just walk around, you will see grass, trees, and bushes.
''Jogador:'' '''People'''
'''Quentin:'''I am a simple monk. I just know Sam, Frodo, and Gorn. They all live in the main street to the north.
''Jogador:'' '''Army'''
'''Quentin:'''I don't know much about the Tibian army. Ask general Harkath Bloodblade about that.
''Jogador:'' '''General'''
'''Quentin:''' Harkath Bloodblade is his name.
''Jogador:'' '''Excalibug'''
'''Quentin:'''Legends tell us that that Excalibug is a gift of the gods. Banor used in his battles. They say it was passed on to one of his followers.
''Jogador:'' '''News'''
'''Quentin:'''Sorry, I know nothing new. Please ask Frodo about that topic.
''Jogador:'' '''Monster'''
'''Quentin:''' There are really too many of them in Tibia. But who am I to challenge the wisdom of the gods?
''Jogador:'' '''Help'''
'''Quentin:'''You do not need any healing right now.
(caso esteja envenenado) '''Quentin:'''You are poisoned, my child. Let me soothe your pain.
''Jogador:'' '''Quest/Task/ What to do'''
'''Quentin:'''First you should try to get some gold to buy better equipment.
''Jogador:'' '''Money/Gold'''
'''Quentin:'''If you need money you should slay monsters and take their gold. Look for spiders and rats.
''Jogador:'' '''Spider'''
'''Quentin:'''There are spiders' nests beyond our city near Gorn's shop and at the McRonalds' farm in the east.
''Jogador:'' '''Rat'''
'''Quentin:''' There are sewers underneath the city. They say these sewers are brimming with rats.
''Jogador:'' '''Sewer'''
'''Quentin:''' You can enter the sewers thorugh a sewer grate. But watch out. There are many rats. And don't forget to bring a torch.
''Jogador:'' '''Equipment'''
'''Quentin:'''First you should buy a bag or backpack. That way your hands will be free to hold a weapon and a shield.
''Jogador:'' '''Fight/Slay'''
'''Quentin:''' Take a weapon into your hand and select a target. If you are wounded you should eat some food to heal your wounds.
''Jogador:'' '''Eat/Food'''
'''Quentin:''' If you would like to heal your wounds you should eat some food. Frodo sells excellent meals. But if you are very weak you can also come to me. I will heal you.
''Jogador:'' '''Time'''
'''Quentin:'''Now, it is XX:XX. Ask Gorn for a watch, if you need one.
''Jogador:'' '''Gorn'''
'''Quentin:''' He is selling equipment. If you still have no backpack you should go and ask him for one.
''Jogador:'' '''Sam'''
'''Quentin:''' He is our blacksmith. He sells weapons and armour.
''Jogador:'' '''Frodo'''
'''Quentin:''' He is the owner of Frodo's Hut, the tavern north of this temple.
''Jogador:'' '''Elane'''
'''Quentin:''' She is the leader of the local Paladins' guild.
''Jogador:'' '''Muriel'''
'''Quentin:''' Muriel is a famous sorcerer. He is the keeper of arcane secrets that are known only to few mortals.
''Jogador:'' '''Gregor'''
'''Quentin:''' The leader of the Knights' guild is a man of few words.
''Jogador:'' '''Marvik'''
'''Quentin:''' I admire the healing skills of Marvik.
''Jogador:'' '''King'''
'''Quentin:''' Our king resides in the castle to the west.
''Jogador:'' '''Lynda'''
'''Quentin:''' She is a highly competent priest.
''Jogador:'' '''Harkath'''
'''Quentin:''' A hard man but his heart is in the right place.
''Jogador:'' '''Ferumbras'''
'''Quentin:''' Hush! Do not mention the Evil One in these walls.
''Jogador:'' '''Bozo'''
'''Quentin:''' He is the king's jester, but he believes himself to be the king of fools.
''Jogador:'' '''Baxter'''
'''Quentin:''' He is the guard of the royal castle.
''Jogador:'' '''Oswald'''
'''Quentin:''' This man is spreading horrible rumours all the time.
''Jogador:'' '''Herry / Mcronald / Donald'''
'''Quentin:''' The McRonalds run the local farm.
''Jogador:'' '''Lugri'''
'''Quentin:''' Please do not mention the fallen one.
''Jogador:'' '''Eclesius'''
'''Quentin:''' I hope I won't become that forgetful when I'm old. But he is a good man, although I don't know him very well.
}}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.title: Robin
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}}
| name        = Robin
| job         = Arqueiro
| city        = Thais
| subarea     = Thais City
| location    = [[Thais City]] ({{Mapa|32289,32252,6:2|aqui}}).
| implemented = Pré-6.0
| notes       = Robin é o Chefe dos Caçadores do King Tibianus III, assim como também foi para o rei Xenom. Ele já é um homem idoso e não tem muitos amigos vivos.
| buysell     = não
| buys        = 
| sells       = 
| falas       = __NOTOC__
== Frases Espontâneas ==
Não possui.

== Palavras-Chave ==
''Jogador:'' '''hi'''</br>
'''Robin:''' Ah, a visitor. Greetings ''Jogador''!

''Jogador:'' '''job''' / '''visitor'''</br>
'''Robin:''' I am the Chief Huntsman of Thais.

''Jogador:'' '''name'''</br>
'''Robin:''' I am Robin. Some call me Rob, others Woody.

''Jogador:'' '''king'''</br>
'''Robin:''' I am his Master of the Hunt as I was his father's Master of the Hunt.

''Jogador:'' '''ferumbras'''</br>
'''Robin:''' A misguided follower of evil.

''Jogador:'' '''time'''</br>
'''Robin:''' Time... it's running that fast when you are as old as me.

''Jogador:'' '''army''' / '''general'''</br>
'''Robin:''' These kids call themselves an army... In the old times we had a REAL army, I tell ya...

''Jogador:'' '''news'''</br>
'''Robin:''' News? In the woods I learn nothing of importance to the world.

''Jogador:'' '''crunor'''</br>
'''Robin:''' Crunor gives and takes. That is his way. As long as we don't hunt more than we need, we are at balance with Crunor.

''Jogador:'' '''excalibug'''</br>
'''Robin:''' I don't like swords in general.

''Jogador:'' '''quentin'''</br>
'''Robin:''' My buddy Quentin is getting old, too. Things were different in our youth.

''Jogador:'' '''oswald'''</br>
'''Robin:''' Oh, what a charming young man. He's often here asking me about my youth and the people I met in my life.

''Jogador:'' '''elane'''</br>
'''Robin:''' A master, or better mistress, of the bow. But with her big feet she just chases all game away.

''Jogador:'' '''lugri'''</br>
'''Robin:''' Can you imagine his father was such a fine guy? A shame what his son has become.

''Jogador:'' '''gorn'''</br>
'''Robin:''' Sells a lot of useful stuff, that guy. I remember the days when we were so poor that we could not afford anything the former owner offered.

''Jogador:'' '''sam'''</br>
'''Robin:''' I have not much use for heavy armor.

''Jogador:'' '''baxter'''</br>
'''Robin:''' I hardly know him.

''Jogador:'' '''marvik''' / '''druid'''</br>
'''Robin:''' Druids have their ways with nature, but they would rather cuddle a bear than hunt it.

''Jogador:'' '''bozo'''</br>
'''Robin:''' Such guys don't live long. The grandfather of our king had a new jester every season.

''Jogador:'' '''lynda'''</br>
'''Robin:''' So young and so beautiful! She makes even an old man as me... um... feel a bit younger again.

''Jogador:'' '''harkath bloodblade'''</br>
'''Robin:''' Another one of a few friends of my youth who's still left.

''Jogador:'' '''gregor'''</br>
'''Robin:''' Can you imagine this youngster handling a guild? Ah, come on.

''Jogador:'' '''eclesius'''</br>
'''Robin:''' I meet him often at Frodo's. He's a fine fellow, but he always tells me the same stories because he forgets that he already told them to me.

''Jogador:'' '''mcronald'''</br>
'''Robin:''' The farmers are fine fellows.

''Jogador:'' '''bye'''</br>
'''Robin:''' Farewell, ''Jogador''.
}}

'''Tim, The Guard''': I am busy. Please ask the citizens for news. ''Jogador'': '''''palavra ofensiva'''''

'''Tim, The Guard''': LONG LIVE THE KING!
|}}

| implemented = Pré-6.0
| notes       = Ele é o xerife da [[Prisão de Thais]]. Ele é [[Alusões|uma alusão]] a um famoso xerife norte-americano.

''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''</br>
'''Wyat:''' Salutations!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''</br>
'''Wyat:''' I am the sheriff of the Thaian territory.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''God'''</br>
'''Wyat:''' I am follower of Banor.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Banor'''</br>
'''Wyat:''' He is the patron of justice and bravery.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''King'''</br>
'''Wyat:''' HAIL TO KING TIBIANUS!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Mission''' / '''Quest'''</br>
'''Wyat:''' Look up our 'Tibia's most wanted' lists.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Apon''' / '''Sam'''</br>
'''Wyat:''' Sam, the Thaian smith, is a man of great diligence. Whenever in need of weapons or armor, just ask him.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Castle'''</br>
'''Wyat:''' The castle should be relatively safe from criminal transgressions.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Criminal'''</br>
'''Wyat:''' Our enemies are numerous and not all are obvious.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''City'''</br>
'''Wyat:''' The city is not as bad as some people might claim, but we certainly have our problems here.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Problems'''</br>
'''Wyat:''' We will handle each problem with care.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Benjamin'''</br>
'''Wyat:''' The poor fool lost his mind some years ago. It's a good thing they gave him a job in the post office.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Bozo'''</br>
'''Wyat:''' He's so funny, I could listen to his jokes for hours.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Elane'''</br>
'''Wyat:''' A woman of great skill and courage. No one deserves the title of a Grandmaster of the Paladins more then her.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Gorn'''</br>
'''Wyat:''' He was a rowdy in his youth, but now he's a fine citizen as far as I can tell.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''</br>
'''Wyat:''' LONG LIVE THE KING!</br>
}}<noinclude>[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]</noinclude>

pages.wikitext:

pages.title: Demon Mother
pages.wikitext:
{{Event}}{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Demon Mother | job = Roleplay | city = Venore | subarea = Jakundaf Desert | location = [[Jakundaf Desert]] ({{mapa|32637,32127,7:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.7 | notes =

* Ela aparece durante o evento [[Demon's Lullaby]].

 | buysell = não | buys = | sells = | falas =__NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == '''Demon Mother''': Oh no. Not again!
'''Demon Mother''': Where is this brat again?
'''Demon Mother''': You need a serious beating.
'''Demon Mother''': I want some days off. == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Demon Mother''': Greetings, meatbag. Speak quick, my patience is short. ----- === Sobre Demon Mother: === ''Jogador'': '''job''' / '''patience'''
'''Demon Mother''': I'm the mother of thousands of demons. If you think they are a pain when they are grown up, you haven't met the young ones. And particularly the babies can be bothersome. ...
'''Demon Mother''': I desperately need a few days off or I cannot guarantee for anything! ''Jogador'': '''babies'''
'''Demon Mother''': My little darlings are somewhat tiresome sometimes. And there are hundreds of them. Even I need a rest from time to time. Some time for myself. Do you have any idea for how long I didn't have had my horns done? ...
'''Demon Mother''': And it's not easy for a single demon mother to meet an evil guy. As soon as they hear you have a few hundred children at home, they teleport into another dimension! ...
'''Demon Mother''': Even demon mothers want to relax now and then, have a bath in the lava pits and listen to the screams of some tortured souls. ...
'''Demon Mother''': And I am not the kind of mother that let's her little demons watch the torture pits the whole day. I expect from them to do something creative and evil on their own. ...
'''Demon Mother''': I won't drop them into some foreign dimension to take care of their own like other demon mothers do. ...
'''Demon Mother''': Of course a torn off head will regrow in a few days but I'm old-fashioned and don't like to see my little darlings suffer. ...
'''Demon Mother''': This is where you come in! I entrust this world to take care for my little darlings for a while! ''Jogador'': '''pacifier'''
'''Demon Mother''': Ah, well. My kids sometimes like it rough. To calm them, I usually slap something hard on their head. Hey, don't give me that look, we are demons after all. ----- === Sobre o evento: === ''Jogador'': '''challenge'''
'''Demon Mother''': I need some of you mortals to care for some of my children. They are only demon babies so it shouldn't be too hard, even for such limited creatures as you are. ...
'''Demon Mother''': I'll hand you one of my babies and you'll take care of it. You can only care for one baby at a time. ...
'''Demon Mother''': Demon babies are moody and spoilt. Each few hours it will request something from you and you will have to fulfil its wishes to keep it happy. It will let you know what it wants. ...
'''Demon Mother''': Do whatever pleases the baby to satisfy it for a few hours. If you comply with its wishes often enough, it will become cheery. It might take a few days and don't think it's easy. ...
'''Demon Mother''': Some of the baby's wishes might be exotic and others outright dangerous. But that is the fate of babysitters since the dawn of time. ...
'''Demon Mother''': Bring my darlings back to me as soon as they are cheery. This phase will last for a while and it will be easy for me to keep an eye on them. ...
'''Demon Mother''': If enough of your people help me and bring me my cheery darlings, I will be pleased and your world will be rewarded. ...
'''Demon Mother''': If you fail though .. well, let's say you will not like this alternative. I can become really mean if I am mad and most demons owe me something! ...
'''Demon Mother''': So are you up to this? ''Jogador'': '''yes'''
'''Demon Mother''': Uh ... Uhm ... Really? Fabulous! Here we go! Take care! It is now bound to YOU, so don't try to swap it with another baby. My magic will prevent that and return it to you! ''Jogador'': '''babysitters'''
'''Demon Mother''': You did surprisingly well in handling my little darling. I might have use for your nanny skills another time. ''(Se você já tiver feito isso)''
'''Demon Mother''': Are you ready to take care of one of my little darlings for a while? ''Jogador'': '''yes'''
'''Demon Mother''': Hey! I already gave you one of my children! If you have failed to take care of it, it will find me. And then I'll find YOU! ''Jogador'': '''no'''
'''Demon Mother''': Though I feel like tearing you apart, I can't even blame you. Still, if your world fails, I will make you suffer! ''Jogador'': '''pleased baby''' ''(Entregando o ''demon infant'')''
'''Demon Mother''': Are you here to bring one of my little darlings back to me? ''Jogador'': '''yes'''
'''Demon Mother''': Brilliant! Your world might actually avert my wrath. We will see. ----- === Outras Palavras-Chave: === ''Jogador'': '''demon'''
'''Demon Mother''': We are creatures of power and knowledge. We are more diverse than you mortals will ever comprehend. The knowledge and wisdom we have gained in our long lives are paling your fleeting vision of what you think is the world. ''Jogador'': '''zathroth'''
'''Demon Mother''': Do you really think I have time to think about gods? I have hardly time for a spontaneous prayer that Zathroth may give me some spare time! ...
'''Demon Mother''': But I guess he is too busy and can't answer those prayers, so I take the matter into my own hands, just like mothers usually do. ''Jogador'': '''pits of inferno'''
'''Demon Mother''': I forbid my children to play there. With all those good-doers questing there, they might get hurt. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Demon Mother''': }}

pages.title: Basilisk
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Basilisk | job = Roleplay | npcclass = Répteis | npcsprite = Snake | city = Kazordoon | subarea = Kazordoon Underground | location = [[Kazordoon Underground]] ({{mapa|32640,31944,15:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 6.1 | notes = Há muitos rumores sobre este NPC. Você pode ler mais sobre ela na [[Bibliotecas de Kazordoon City#Halls of Sorcery|biblioteca de Kazordoon]]. É impossível alcançar diretamente o Basilisk porque até hoje não há uma maneira conhecida de se chegar até sua sala. Algumas pessoas diziam que era parte de uma desconhecida quest do [[Thunder Hammer]], enquanto outras diziam que fazia parte de uma quest do [[Great Axe]]. Esses rumores são muito antigos. Hoje está consolidado que ambos os itens são loot raros de bosses.
Com relação a história (lore) do jogo, no passado a quantidade de informações sobre basiliscos era quase inexistente, sendo apenas em Kazordoon o único local com referência a criatura deste tipo. Isso mudou com o passar do tempo e a chegada de updates (bem distantes um do outro), onde a Cipsoft adicionou: *NPCs [[Malech]] e [[Shortsighted Dwarf]] - Esses falam especificamente sobre o basilisco preso. *Livro [[Famous Knights: Sir Necaran (Book)|Famous Knights: Sir Necaran]] - Fala sobre a importância da criatura no passado. *Criatura [[Dragolisk]] - A história no site oficial a coloca como uma criatura de igual importância com basiliscos. Houve também um update que trouxe o lendário [[Gryphon|grifo]] e graças a mitologia dos livros de Harry Potter, muitos especulavam que a criatura poderia ser relacionada aos basiliscos, porém o que está escrito na história no site oficial não confirmou esta relação entre esses seres lendários. Após ser descartada, surgiu outra especulação associando a criatura com a também lendária fênix, mas a criatura nunca foi implementada no jogo. Atualmente é considerado por muitos que a história do jogo relacionada a raça do basilisco e não a criatura presa estejam sendo adicionadas e integrado a lore do jogo ao poucos. Já a criatura presa se tornou um dos mistérios que persistem até hoje. {{Veja|Locais Inalcançáveis}} | buysell = não | buys = | sells = }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

== Frases Espontâneas ==
'''Bezil''': Hey Nezil, let's go to the Jolly Axeman Tavern after business is done.

== Palavras-Chave ==
''Jogador'': '''hi'''</br>
'''Bezil''': Are you talking to me, ''Jogador''?

''Jogador'': '''hi bezil'''</br>
'''Bezil''': Hiho, Bezil at your service, ''Jogador''. We sell equipment of all kinds.

''Jogador'': '''job'''</br>
'''Bezil''': We sell equipment of all kind. Is there anything you need?

''Jogador'': '''equipment''' /  '''goods''' /  '''stuff''' /  '''offer'''</br>
'''Bezil''': As you can see, we offer quite a lot, such as torches, shovels and the like. Ask me for a trade to have a look.

''Jogador'': '''name'''</br>
'''Bezil''': I'm Bezil Coinbiter. Me and my bro' Nezil are selling stuff, ye' know?

''Jogador'': '''dwarf'''</br>
'''Bezil''': My people is as old and sturdy as the stone of the mountain we live in.

''Jogador'': '''nezil'''</br>
'''Bezil''': He's my bro'.

''Jogador'': '''kazordoon'''</br>
'''Bezil''': Our city is well-fortified. In ancient days, the trail to Kazordoon was a well-kept secret and hardly any stranger found his way here ...</br>
'''Bezil''': Today, we welcome visitors, but we're still on guard and ready to defend our gates.

''Jogador'': '''ab'dendriel'''</br>
'''Bezil''': I laughed so hard when I saw that so-called city. Imagine, they live in trees with all these squirrels around ...</br>
'''Bezil''': I couldn't stand it to be molested by this climbing and hopping pest that steals my lunch ...</br>
'''Bezil''': But I guess the squirrels are more patient with elves than I'd be.

''Jogador'': '''thais'''</br>
'''Bezil''': I wouldn't feel comfortable to live so exposed and in the open, but like an old dwarfish saying goes: Every beard grows different.

''Jogador'': '''carlin'''</br>
'''Bezil''': I still need to visit that town one day. I guess it's not much fun to visit a city that forbids to drink alcohol, though ...</br>
'''Bezil''': Thinking about it, I never heard of a dwarf travelling there.

''Jogador'': '''venore'''</br>
'''Bezil''': You can't dig a hole without a Venorean showing up trying to exploit it.

''Jogador'': '''beard'''</br>
'''Bezil''': Fake beards of any kind are quite fashionable nowadays. Almost every dwarven woman wears one in public ...</br>
'''Bezil''': Sadly we are out of stock right now

''Jogador'': '''darama'''</br>
'''Bezil''': There is sand, and there is jungle. Either way, you lose.

''Jogador'': '''mines'''</br>
'''Bezil''': The mines are a topic to which most dwarfs react quite sensitive. The miners are quite anxious to keep everyone away from the mines they claim for themselves ...</br>
'''Bezil''': It is not unusual that people get hurt or killed down there in the mines.

''Jogador'': '''deposit'''</br>
'''Bezil''': I will give you 5 gold for every empty vial. Ok?

''Jogador'': '''food'''</br>
'''Bezil''': You better visit the Jolly Axeman Tavern for that.

''Jogador'': '''trade'''</br>
'''Bezil''': Of course, just browse through our wares. By the way, there's a deposit of 5 gold on empty vials.

''Jogador'': '''bye'''</br>
'''Bezil''': Good bye, ''Jogador''.
}}

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Ferus | job = Casamenteiro | city = Kazordoon | subarea = Kazordoon City | location = [[Kazordoon City]] ({{Mapa|32650,31911,11:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.5 | notes = Ele é o guardião da capela de Fogo e Terra e realiza [[Newly Wed Outfits Quest|casamento]]s de personagens do Tibia. | buysell = não | buys = n/a | sells = n/a | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Ferus:''' Welcome to my Chapel of Fire and Earth, ''Jogador''.
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
'''Ferus:''' I'm the keeper of this chapel and can bind loving souls in the holy ceremony of marriage.
''Jogador:'' '''Ceremony / Marriage'''
'''Ferus:''' If you wish to initiate a marriage ceremony, the to-be-betrothed - that is you two lovebirds! - need to hand me a blank wedding ring and a box with a wedding outfit. ''Jogador'', can you give me these items now?
''Jogador:'' '''No'''
'''Ferus:''' Not to sound like a material dwarf, but rules are rules. Without the items there won't be any wedding. I'm a traditionalist! Better go to a jeweller and see the tailor in Venore before people consider you cheap!
''Jogador:'' '''Ring'''
'''Ferus:''' You can buy wedding rings from many jewellers. I recommend Carina in Venore though, since the tailor in Venore also has wedding outfits in stock.
''Jogador:'' '''Fire'''
'''Ferus:''' The life-giving and life-destroying force of nature. You need warmth to survive, but get too much of it and you'll burn. That's how it is with many things.
''Jogador:'' '''Earth'''
'''Ferus:''' The nurturing and grounding force of nature. Supporting, carrying, feeding. What more could we ask for?
''Jogador:'' '''Geomancer'''
'''Ferus:''' They worship the elemental forces of the earth.
''Jogador:'' '''Technomancer'''
'''Ferus:''' Technomancers can be quite helpful if you have technical problems with your machinary.
''Jogador:'' '''Kazordoon'''
'''Ferus:''' My home, my family.
''Jogador:'' '''Emperor'''
'''Ferus:''' The Hall of the Emperor is in the upper levels of Kazordoon. Quite far away from here, thus I'm glad we have this ore wagon system whenever I'm given an audience. My legs aren't what they once were.
}}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Ormuhn | job = Knight Guild Leader | city = Southern Darama | subarea = Ankrahmun | location = [[Ankrahmun]] ({{Mapa|33159,32809,5:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 7.3 | notes = Ele é o mestre da arena, responsável por supervisionar todos os desafios realizados neste local e por treinar verdadeiros lutadores. Também era responsável por ensinar magias para [[Knights]].

A partir do update '''15.22''', lançado em '''27 de janeiro de 2026''', não é mais possível comprar magias com este NPC. A CipSoft removeu a interação com a palavra '''"spell"''' e a funcionalidade de compra de magias, já que elas passaram a ser aprendidas automaticamente assim que o jogador atinge o nível necessário. | buysell = não | buys = Nada. | sells = Nada. | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Ormuhn:''' Be mourned pilgrim in flesh, . Looking for knight spells?
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
'''Ormuhn:''' I am the arena master. I supervise all challenges that take place in this arena and train true fighters.
''Jogador:'' '''Arena'''
'''Ormuhn:''' If you wish to test your mortal Akh you are at the right place.
''Jogador:'' '''Akh'''
'''Ormuhn:''' As far as I know this is what you would call your body. Ask a priest for further information.
''Jogador:'' '''Temple'''
'''Ormuhn:''' The temple takes care of your Uthun. In this arena we challenge your Akh.
''Jogador:'' '''Pharaoh'''
'''Ormuhn:''' The pharaoh, our mighty leader, is an unliving god.
''Jogador:'' '''Scarab '''
'''Ormuhn:''' Scarabs might be sacred, but they are also a challenge. If you are able to overcome one of them, its spirit will forgive you. The everlasting sand will grant him rebirth anyway.
''Jogador:'' '''Darama'''
'''Ormuhn:''' This continent will be the first to prosper under the guidance of our pharaoh.
''Jogador:'' '''Undeath'''
'''Ormuhn:''' We are the chosen ones.
''Jogador:'' '''Chosen Ones'''
'''Ormuhn:''' I am one of the chosen. To become like me you have to serve the pharaoh and his temple faithfully.
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
'''Ormuhn:''' May enlightenment be your path, ''Jogador''. }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.title: Rahkem
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Rahkem | job = Druid Guild Leader | job2 = Curador | job3 = Sacerdote | city = Southern Darama | subarea = Ankrahmun | location = [[Ankrahmun]] ({{Mapa|33195,32851,7:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 7.3 | notes = Diz-se que o templo é o lugar onde nós lamentamos a nossa existência mortal. Nossa carne é a nossa fraqueza e nossa maldição, a isca para todos os ensaios e atribulações dos falsos deuses soltos no mundo. Ele ensinava magias para [[Druid]]s.
A partir do update 15.22 do dia 27 de janeiro de 2026 não é mais possível comprar magias com esse NPC pois a CipSoft removeu a interação com a palavra "Spell", e a função de comprar magias, visto que agora as magias passaram a ser adicionadas automaticamente assim que o players chega ao nível necessário.

* Faz parte da [[The Blessed Stake Quest]], uma das [[Friends and Traders Quest]].

| buysell = sim | buys = Nada. | sells = '''Magias''' {{Ensina | Apprentice's Strike | Chill Out | Creature Illusion | Cure Bleeding | Cure Burning | Cure Electrification | Cure Poison | Energy Strike | Envenom | Find Person | Flame Strike | Food (Spell) | Great Light | Haste | Heal Friend | Ice Strike | Ice Wave | Intense Healing | Invisible | Levitate | Light | Light Healing | Magic Patch | Magic Rope | Magic Shield | Mass Healing | Mud Attack | Physical Strike | Strong Haste | Strong Ice Strike | Strong Ice Wave | Strong Terra Strike | Summon Creature | Summon Grovebeast | Terra Strike | Terra Wave | Ultimate Healing | Ultimate Light}} '''Magias para fazer runas''' {{Ensina | Animate Dead Rune | Avalanche Rune | Chameleon Rune | Convince Creature Rune | Cure Poison Rune | Destroy Field Rune | Disintegrate Rune | Energy Field Rune | Energy Wall Rune | Explosion Rune | Fire Bomb Rune | Fire Field Rune | Fire Wall Rune | Heavy Magic Missile Rune | Icicle Rune | Intense Healing Rune | Light Magic Missile Rune | Paralyse Rune | Poison Bomb Rune | Poison Field Rune | Poison Wall Rune | Soulfire Rune | Stalagmite Rune | Stone Shower Rune | Ultimate Healing Rune}} | falas = ''JogadOr'': '''hi'''
'''Rahkem:''' Be mourned pilgrim in flesh. How can I help you, ? I'm a healer and also teach druid spells.
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
'''Rahkem:''' I am a humble preacher of the true revelation in the temple of the mourned flesh. I heal and teach magic spells to those who are spiritual enough.
''Jogador:'' '''Temple'''
'''Rahkem:''' Here we mourn our mortal existence. Our flesh is our weakness and our curse, the bait for all the trials and tribulations the false gods let loose on the world.
''Jogador:'' '''Mourned''' ou '''Mourn'''
'''Rahkem:''' We mortals are all to be mourned for our prison of flesh. Only through loyal servitude to the pharaoh, praised be his existence, may we escape this prison and find our true destiny.
''Jogador:'' '''Pharaoh'''
'''Rahkem:''' Our immortal ruler, may he be blessed, is the keeper of our enlightenment and our saviour.
''Jogador:'' '''False Gods'''
'''Rahkem:''' The so-called gods are just the weakest of their kind. They are pitiful remnants from the terrible godswar between the elder gods which tore the universe apart.
''Jogador:'' '''Godswar'''
'''Rahkem:''' In ancient times the elder gods waged war upon each other. Those that call themselves gods today were the lowest of their minions. When the last of the true gods died the great suffering began.
''Jogador:'' '''Great Suffering'''
'''Rahkem:''' The universe is dying. Death placed his mark on everything. Only the pharaoh can grant us freedom from mortality and open up the path of true ascension to us.
''Jogador:'' '''Ascension'''
'''Rahkem:''' The sentient beings are all that is left of the essence of the elder gods. We can awake the dormant powers that slumber in us all. But ascension is a thorny path to follow.
''Jogador:'' '''Thorny Path'''
'''Rahkem:''' Our mortal shells make us vulnerable to the temptations of the false gods. Only by leaving our mortality behind, we can study the true path of ascension. The balance of Akh'rah Uthun has to be changed to our favour.
''Jogador:'' '''Mortality'''
'''Rahkem:''' Mortality is our prison. It makes us vulnerable to the temptations of the false gods.
''Jogador:'' '''Akh'rah Uthun'''
'''Rahkem:''' The Akh'rah Uthun is the unity of the Akh, our body, the Rah, our soul and the Uthun, our memories and experiences.
''Jogador:'' '''Akh'''
'''Rahkem:''' Your flesh is traitorous and weak. The pharaoh grants the power to conquer death to those who serve him well. Once they have entered this state of being neither dead nor alive they are ready to enter the path of ascension.
''Jogador:'' '''Rah'''
'''Rahkem:''' The Rah is the ultimate treasure. The false gods need the stolen Rah to sustain their usurped powers.
''Jogador:'' '''Uthun'''
'''Rahkem:''' The memory is what makes our personality. It is what defines us ... and its utterly worthless to the gods. For this reason destroy it to harvest our Rah.
''Jogador:'' '''Arena'''
'''Rahkem:''' The arena is a fitting place to test your mortal shell and to feed the power of the Rah and the Uthun.
''Jogador:'' '''Palace'''
'''Rahkem:''' The residence of our immortal king is a temple in its own right because it is the home of a true god.
''Jogador:'' '''Scarabs'''
'''Rahkem:''' The eternal burrowers are the keepers of all the secrets their kind has unearthed in countless aeons.
''Jogador:'' '''Daraman'''
'''Rahkem:''' The continent was named after Daraman, the prophet during the reign of Ashmunrah. The new pharaoh acknowledged the power that is in names and did not change the name when he acceded to the throne.
''Jogador:'' '''Ashmunrah'''
'''Rahkem:''' The foolish old pharaoh withheld knowledge and power from his son, knowing that he would surpass him in every aspect. But in his infinite mercy his son granted him the chance to ascend.
''Jogador:'' '''Undeath'''
'''Rahkem:''' Undeath is freedom from mortal needs. It is the first obvious step to divinity.
''Jogador:'' '''Kazordoon'''
'''Rahkem:''' The dwarves suffered, but they have drawn wrong conclusions. If they do not listen to the revelations of our immortal pharaoh, pain and grief will prove to be better teachers this time.
''Jogador:'' '''Tibia'''
'''Rahkem:''' It is likely that our world is a part of one of the dead true gods or one of their manifestations that somehow escaped destruction. We must assume this is all that is left of the original universe.
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
'''Rahkem:''' May enlightenment be your path, ''Jogador''. }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Tothdral | job = Sorcerer Guild Leader | job2 = Astrólogo | city = Southern Darama | subarea = Ankrahmun | location = [[Ankrahmun]] ({{Mapa|33147,32865,7:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 7.3 | notes = Tothdral é localizado na biblioteca da [[Serpentine Tower]]. Ele ensinava magias para [[Sorcerer]]s.
A partir do update 15.22 do dia 27 de janeiro de 2026 não é mais possível comprar magias com esse NPC pois a CipSoft removeu a interação com a palavra "Spell", e a função de comprar magias, visto que agora as magias passaram a ser adicionadas automaticamente assim que o players chega ao nível necessário. | buysell = sim | buys = {{Trades/Buy | Black Hood | Book of Necromantic Rituals | Book of Prayers | Broken Key Ring | Broken Ring of Ending | Cultish Mask | Cultish Robe | Cultish Symbol | Dark Rosary | Elvish Talisman | Flask of Embalming Fluid | Strange Symbol | Unholy Bone | Witch Broom}} | sells = '''Magias''' {{Ensina | Apprentice's Strike | Buzz | Creature Illusion | Cure Poison | Curse | Death Strike | Electrify | Energy Beam | Energy Strike | Energy Wave | Find Person | Fire Wave | Flame Strike | Great Energy Beam | Great Light | Haste | Ice Strike | Ignite | Intense Healing | Invisible | Levitate | Light | Light Healing | Lightning | Magic Patch | Magic Rope | Magic Shield | Scorch | Strong Energy Strike | Strong Flame Strike | Strong Haste | Summon Creature | Summon Thundergiant | Terra Strike | Ultimate Healing}} '''Magias para fazer runas''' {{Ensina | Destroy Field Rune | Disintegrate Rune | Energy Bomb Rune | Energy Field Rune | Energy Wall Rune | Explosion Rune | Fire Field Rune | Fire Wall Rune | Fireball Rune | Firebomb Rune | Great Fireball Rune | Heavy Magic Missile Rune | Light Magic Missile Rune | Magic Wall Rune | Poison Field Rune | Poison Wall Rune | Soulfire Rune | Stalagmite Rune | Sudden Death Rune | Thunderstorm Rune}} | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Ankrahmun'''
'''Tothdral:''' This city is as old as the sands that surround it, and it is built on previous settlements that date back even further in time.Perhaps only the wise scarabs know the full story of this place.
''Jogador:'' '''Scarabs '''
'''Tothdral:''' If you know how to listen to them they will reveal ancient secrets to you.
''Jogador:'' '''Carlin''' / '''Venore''' / '''Thais''' / '''Edron'''
'''Tothdral:''' Those cities that bow to the false gods will fall prey to their treacherous greed sooner or later.
''Jogador:'' '''Ab'Dendriel''' / '''Elves'''
'''Tothdral:''' Elves are nothing but idle riff-raff. They embrace the vain amusements of physical pleasure. Eternal damnation will be their lot.
''Jogador:'' '''Kazordoon''' / '''Dwarves'''
'''Tothdral:''' The dwarves should have learned their lessons, but these boneheaded fools still don't see there is only one way to escape the false gods' grasp.
''Jogador:'' '''Darashia'''
'''Tothdral:''' Their foolishness is great, but perhaps they still can be saved. If only they listened and accepted the next step to ascension.
''Jogador:'' '''Ascension'''
'''Tothdral:''' The essence of the true gods is omnipresent in the universe. We all share this divine heritage, for every single one of uscarries the divine spark inside him. This is the reason we all have a chance to ascend to godhood, too.
''Jogador:'' '''False gods'''
'''Tothdral:''' The self-styled gods were nothing but minor servants of the true gods. They steal the soul of any mortal foolish enoughto believe in them. They plan to use the stolen souls to ascend to true godhood.
''Jogador:'' '''Akh'rah Uthun'''
'''Tothdral:''' The Akh'rah Uthun is the trinity of existence, the three that are one. The Akh, the shell, the Rah, the source of power, andthe Uthun, our consciousness, form this union.
''Jogador:'' '''Akh'''
'''Tothdral:''' The Akh is a tool. As long as it is alive it is a burden and source of weakness, but if you ascend to undeath it becomes auseful tool that can be used to work towards greater ends.
''Jogador:'' '''Rah'''
'''Tothdral:''' The Rah is what the ignorant might call the soul. But it's more than that. It is the divine spark in all of us, the source ofenergy that keeps us alive.
''Jogador:'' '''Uthun'''
'''Tothdral:''' The Uthun is the part of the trinity that is easiest to form. It consists of our recollections of the past and of our thoughts.It is that which determines who we are in this world and it gives us guidance throughout our existence.
''Jogador:'' '''Tibia'''
'''Tothdral:''' This world is only a shadow of the worlds that have been. That was long ago, before the true gods fought each other in the godwars and the false gods rose to claim their heritage.
''Jogador:'' '''Darama'''
'''Tothdral:''' This continent is mostly free from the servants of the false gods. Those who live here may hope to become worthy one dayof the first steps towards ascension.
''Jogador:'' '''Undead'''
'''Tothdral:''' Undeath is an improvement. It is the gateway to goals that are nobler than eating, drinking or other fulfilments of trivialphysical needs..
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
'''Tothdral:''' I am the foremost astrologer and supreme magus of this city.
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''
'''Tothdral:''' My name is Tothdral. They call me 'The Seeker Beyond the Grave'.
''Jogador:'' '''They steal the soul of any mortal foolish enough to believe in them. They plan to use the stolen souls to ascend to true godhood.''' / '''The False Gods'''
'''Tothdral:''' The false gods harvest the souls of the dead to secure their stolen powers and status.
''Jogador:'' '''Pharaoh'''
'''Tothdral:''' The immortal pharaoh is our god and our example. He alone holds the secrets that will save us all from the greedy grasp ofthe false gods.
''Jogador:'' '''Time'''
'''Tothdral:''' Time is your problem. It is no longer mine.
''Jogador:'' '''Mortality'''
'''Tothdral:''' Mortality is your curse. When you are worthy the burden of mortality will be taken from your shoulders.
''Jogador:'' '''Temple'''
'''Tothdral:''' Our temple is a centre of spirituality and learning. The temple and the serpentine tower work hand in hand for the good of all people, whether they are alive or undead.
''Jogador:'' '''Arena'''
'''Tothdral:''' The arena is a suitable distraction for the Uthun of the mortals. It might even serve as a place for them to prove their worth. If they pass the test they may be freed of their mortal shells.
''Jogador:'' '''Palace'''
'''Tothdral:''' The residence of the pharaoh should be worshipped just as the pharaoh is worshipped. Don't enter until you have business there.
''Jogador:'' '''Mourn'''
'''Tothdral:''' The dead mourn the living because they are weak and excluded from ascension.
''Jogador:'' '''Godswar'''
'''Tothdral:''' This war brought about the end of the true universe. That which is left now is but a shadow of former glories, a bleak remainder of what once was. The true gods perished and their essence was dispersed throughout the remaining universe.
''Jogador:'' '''Great suffering'''
'''Tothdral:'''The great suffering is a phase of steady decline that will end eventually in void and emptiness unless some divine power such as our pharaoh will reverse it. Mend your ways and follow him! Perhaps you will be chosen to join him in his noble struggle.
''Jogador:'' '''Spell'''
'''Tothdral:''' No more lessons from me, I'm afraid. The retirement is now calling, it's finally time for me to enjoy a little peace from your incivility ..
}}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]
