''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''</br>
'''Ashtamor:''' Welcome, ''Jogador'', wanderer between the worlds.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''</br>
'''Ashtamor:''' I consider myself as a guide, a guardian over the souls who transcend the border to another world.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Souls'''</br>
'''Ashtamor:''' The essence of life. Source of your very self. While the body is in space and time, the ''soul'' exists in time only.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Time'''</br>
'''Ashtamor:''' It's ''time'' now, but the true question is: How much time is left?</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''</br>
'''Ashtamor:''' What is a ''name'' worth in your eyes? And more important: Does the choice of your ''name'' decide your further fate? Perhaps we will never know.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Venore'''</br>
'''Ashtamor:''' You come to this world naked, and leave it this way, so there's no need to hold back your money, especially not in a place like ''Venore''.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Help'''</br>
'''Ashtamor:''' What help might I offer you except guidance? Would you like me to help you transcend the border to the afterlife?</br>
''Jogador:'' '''King'''</br>
'''Ashtamor:''' ''Kings'', queens ... I've seen them come and go. Everything fades, even the glory and wealth of the richest.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Birth'''</br>
'''Ashtamor:''' ''Birth'' might be the beginning but death is certainly not the end.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Death / Another World'''</br>
'''Ashtamor:''' Does it mean anything than losing your weak physical shell? And isn't the true power in the universe rather mental than physical?</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Monsters'''</br>
'''Ashtamor:''' Oh yes, ''monsters'' can grant you a passage to the afterlife also, but it's not a comfortable trip. <chuckles></br>
''Jogador:'' '''Gods'''</br>
'''Ashtamor:''' Once you leave your mortal shell, you'll become one with the gods.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Body'''</br>
'''Ashtamor:''' Is the mind an emination of ''body'', or the body an invention by the mind?</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Offer'''</br>
'''Ashtamor:''' I'm ''offering'' vases and amphoras, the perfect vessel for all kinds of dusty remains. Ask me for a trade if you're interested.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Life'''</br>
'''Ashtamor:''' Life is nothing but a pre-stage for the eternity of death.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Afterlife'''</br>
'''Ashtamor:''' No one really knows what awaits us beyond. Although there are some old stories about the Netherworld.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Netherworld'''</br>
'''Ashtamor:''' It is the place where the dead end up. Some sages believe, that it is located below the world of the living. ....</br>
'''Ashtamor:''' Personally, I think it rather lies within another dimension so that terms like above or beneath are inappropriate to describe it. There are some rumours that the descent to the Netherworld is difficult yet possible for those still living.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Fire'''</br>
'''Ashtamor:''' The purging force of fire ... it helps to free souls and its smoke helps them to find their way to another world.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Trade'''</br>
'''Ashtamor:''' Yes, it's a wise idea not to leave the choice of your future vessel to chance. Have a look. (''Abre o trade do NPC'')</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''</br>
'''Ashtamor:''' See you again ... sooner or later, more or less alive.
}}<noinclude>[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]</noinclude>

pages.title: Asrak
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Asrak | job = Knight Guild Leader | job2 = Paladin Guild Leader | npcclass = Humanóides | npcsprite = Minotaur Guard | city = Venore | subarea = Venore City | location = [[Venore City|Venore City - Fighting Pits]] ({{Mapa|32929,32074,11:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 7.1 | notes = Asrak Ironhoof (''Casco de Aço'') é o superintendente das arenas de luta da '''Hard Rock Tavern''' e responsável pelo treinamento de gladiadores. Ele conhece profundamente o [[Mooh'Tah]], um caminho para alcançar a perfeição como guerreiro. Também era responsável por ensinar [[magias]] para [[Knights]] e [[Paladins]].

A partir do update '''15.22''', lançado em '''27 de janeiro de 2026''', não é mais possível comprar magias com este NPC. A CipSoft removeu a interação com a palavra '''"spell"''' e a funcionalidade de compra de magias, já que elas passaram a ser aprendidas automaticamente assim que o jogador atinge o nível necessário. | buysell = não | buys = Nada. | sells = Nada. | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Asrak:''' I welcome you, ''Jogador''!
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
'''Asrak:''' I am the overseer of the pits and the trainer of the gladiators.
''Jogador:'' '''Gladiators'''
'''Asrak:''' Those wannabe fighters are weak and most of them are unable to comprehend a higher concept like the Mooh'Tah.
''Jogador:'' '''Help'''
'''Asrak:''' I teach worthy warriors the way of the knight.
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''
'''Asrak:''' I am known as Asrak the Ironhoof.
''Jogador:'' '''Time'''
'''Asrak:''' It is 0:00 pm.
''Jogador:'' '''King''' / '''tibianus'''
'''Asrak:''' I pledge no allegiance to any king, be it human or minotaurean.
''Jogador:'' '''Army'''
'''Asrak:''' Your human army might be big, but without skills. They are only sheep to be slaughtered.
''Jogador:'' '''Spell'''
'''Asrak:''' Sorry, I only teach spells to knights and paladins.
''Jogador:'' '''Dungeon'''
'''Asrak:''' The dungeons of your desires and fears are the only ones you really should fear and those you really have to conquer.
''Jogador:'' '''Gods'''
'''Asrak:''' By them we were imbued with the rage that almost costed our existence. By them we were used as pawns in wars that were not ours.
''Jogador:'' '''Monsters'''
'''Asrak:''' Inferior creatures of rage, driven by their primitive urges. Only worthy to be noticed to test one's skills.
''Jogador:'' '''Ferumbras'''
'''Asrak:''' To rely on magic is like to cheat fate. All cheaters will find their just punishment one day, and so will he.
''Jogador:'' '''Excalibug'''
'''Asrak:''' If it's truly a weapon to slay gods it might be worth to be sought for.
''Jogador:'' '''Venore'''
'''Asrak:''' The city pays me well and those undisciplined gladiators need my skills and guidance badly.
''Jogador:'' '''Mintwallin'''
'''Asrak:''' The city is only a shadow of what we could have accomplished without that curse of rage that the gods bestowed upon us. === Mooh'Tah === ''Jogador:'' '''Minotaur'''
'''Asrak:''' In the ancient wars we lost much because of the rage. The one good thing is we lost our trust in the gods, too.
''Jogador:'' '''Rage'''
'''Asrak:''' Rage is the legacy of [[Brog]], the beast. To overcome it is our primal goal. The Mooh'Tah is our only hope of salvation and perfection.
''Jogador:'' '''Mooh'tah'''
'''Asrak:''' The Mooh'Tah teaches us control. It provides you with weapon, armor, and shield. It teaches you harmony and focus.
''Jogador:'' '''Harmony'''
'''Asrak:''' There is an elegant harmony in every thing done right. If you feel the harmony of an action you can sing its song.
''Jogador:'' '''Song'''
'''Asrak:''' Each harmonic action has it own song. If you can sing it, you are in harmony with that action. This is where the minotaurean battlesongs come from.
''Jogador:'' '''Battlesongs'''
'''Asrak:''' Each Mooh'Tah master focuses his skills on the harmony of battle. He is one with the song that he's singing with his voice or at least his heart.
''Jogador:'' '''Weapon'''
'''Asrak:''' Make your will your weapon, and your enemies will perish.
''Jogador:'' '''Armor'''
'''Asrak:''' Courage is the only armor that shields you against rage and fear, the greatest dangers you will have to face.
''Jogador:'' '''Shield'''
'''Asrak:''' Your confidence shall be your shield. Nothing can penetrate that defence. No emotion will let you lose your focus.
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
'''Asrak:''' May your path be as straight as an arrow.
''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Asrak:''' I welcome you, ''Jogador''!
'''Asrak:''' May your path be as straight as an arrow. }} [[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

== Frases Espontâneas ==
Não possui.

== Palavras-Chave ==
''Jogador'': '''hi'''</br>
'''Dabui''': Daraman's blessings! Welcome to Darashia.

''Jogador'': '''job'''</br>
'''Dabui''': I am a protector of the people of Darashia.

''Jogador'': '''news'''</br>
'''Dabui''': The evil of Drefia is strong these days.

''Jogador'': '''caliph''' / '''kazzan'''</br>
'''Dabui''': Our leader is enlightened by Daraman, thrice praised be his name!

''Jogador'': '''darashia'''</br>
'''Dabui''': This city is lovely Darashia, pearl of Darama.

''Jogador'': '''darama'''</br>
'''Dabui''': Darashia is the heart of Darama. In the northeast, across the Devourer, there is the dark pyramid. In the west, across the Plague Spike, are the cursed ruins of Drefia.

''Jogador'': '''devourer'''</br>
'''Dabui''': The great desert devoured many of the first pilgrims. We learned the ways of the devourer and thus conquered it.

''Jogador'': '''pyramid'''</br>
'''Dabui''': The minotaurs took shelter in the ancient pyramid, which our people avoid for the dark powers that might be present there.

''Jogador'': '''plague spike'''</br>
'''Dabui''': Mountain of Poison, Scorpions Rock, it's known by many names. It's to the west of Darashia.

''Jogador'': '''drefia'''</br>
'''Dabui''': The ruins of Drefia in the far west are the hideout of the vile necromancer cult that once corrupted this city.

''Jogador'': '''pilgrimage'''</br>
'''Dabui''': Darama led his people on a pilgrimage to the holy lands of Darama to escape temptations and distractions.

''Jogador'': '''daraman'''</br>
'''Dabui''': The ancient prophet brought our people here from a place long forgotten.

''Jogador'': '''buy''' / '''sell'''</br>
'''Dabui''': Go to the bazaar in the middle of the town.

''Jogador'': '''amulet'''</br>
'''Dabui''': Ishina sells amulets and other valuables at the market place!

''Jogador'': '''guard'''</br>
'''Dabui''': This information is confidential.

''Jogador'': '''''palavra ofensiva'''''</br>
'''Dabui''': Take this! (burning effect, 5 turnos de 10 hitpoints)

''Jogador'': '''bye'''</br>
'''Dabui''': Daraman's blessings!
}}

pages.title: Kasmir
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Kasmir | job = Sacerdote | job2 = Curador | city = Northern Darama | subarea = Darashia | location = [[Darashia]] ({{Mapa|33213,32453,1:1|aqui}}). | implemented = 6.97 | notes = Kasmir mora no templo de Darashia, observando aventureiros e oferecendo cura para veneno, fogo e energia. Ele tem um vasto conhecimento sobre os deuses e pode contar um pouco sobre eles.

* Você pode conseguir uma pedra especial falando '''Hi - Adventurer's Stone - Yes''' para este NPC. * Se você usar uma [[Adventurer's Stone]] dentro de [[templo]], você será teleportado para pequena ilha da [[Adventurers' Guild]]. * Faz parte da [[The Blessed Stake Quest]], uma das [[Friends and Traders Quest]].

| buysell = não | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Kasmir:''' May Daraman enlighten you ''Jogador''!
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
'''Kasmir:''' I am a chosen of Daraman.
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''
'''Kasmir:''' Kasmir Ibn Darasir.
''Jogador:'' '''Caliph'''
'''Kasmir:''' The caliph is heavily involved in the affairs in the world, but one has to make this sacrifice for the welfare of all.
''Jogador:'' '''Daraman'''
'''Kasmir:''' Daraman travelled the world and learned the secrets of the ancients. At last he learned the secret of ascension and founded his philosophy.
''Jogador:'' '''Darama'''
'''Kasmir:''' This land is harsh and challenging. It's far away from temptations and delusions. Here Daraman's people can concentrate on themselves.
''Jogador:'' '''Ascension'''
'''Kasmir:''' Daraman had a vision that all mortals are able to ascend to heaven, becoming celestial beings.
''Jogador:'' '''Celestial Beings'''
'''Kasmir:''' By enhancing one's soul a mortal can ascend to heaven. If you are not prepared to ascend, you are bound to this world by reincarnation.
''Jogador:'' '''Reincarnation'''
'''Kasmir:''' If your soul is not strong and purified, you will not ascend but return to life on death, even losing strength in the process.
''Jogador:'' '''Life'''
'''Kasmir:''' Life is divine though not without flaws.
''Jogador:'' '''Philosophy'''
'''Kasmir:''' Daraman led his followers to this promised land to follow his teachings. It was named Darama after him later.
''Jogador:'' '''Necromancers'''
'''Kasmir:''' Undeath is even worse than reincarnation. Those souls are nothing but a rotting mockery of a soul on the path of ascension.
''Jogador:'' '''Quest'''
'''Kasmir:''' Your quest should be to prepare your soul for ascension.
''Jogador:'' '''Urgith'''
'''Kasmir:''' The bonemaster is strong in the ruins of Drefia. There you can test the braveness of your soul ... or lose it to his minions.
''Jogador:'' '''Soul'''
'''Kasmir:''' The soul was made by the gods and therefore is divine. So by enhancing its divinity it can become more like the image of its creators.
''Jogador:'' '''Banor'''
'''Kasmir:''' Banor is the very proof that ascension is possible.
''Jogador:'' '''Gods'''
'''Kasmir:''' The gods are in heaven and far away. You are here. So concentrate on your soul and take care for it on your own.
''Jogador:'' '''Excalibug'''
'''Kasmir:''' Your greed for such items can easily corrupt your soul.
''Jogador:'' '''Koshei'''
'''Kasmir:''' My grandfather knew him and he always lowered his voice when he spoke his name. I don't know many things about this strange fellow but ...
'''Kasmir:''' ...wait, now I remember. My grandfather said something about an amulet with great power. Rumour says that it shattered and that one of the four pieces killed Koshei. ...
'''Kasmir:''' Actually noone knows if that is true or not.
''Jogador:'' '''Ferumbras'''
'''Kasmir:''' His soul is corrupted beyond any hope for ascension.
''Jogador:'' '''Ruthless Seven'''
'''Kasmir:''' They are soulless and therefore without true power in the end.
''Jogador:'' '''Sells'''
'''Kasmir:''' Go to the bazaar if you are interested in worldly wealth.
''Jogador:'' '''Uman'''
'''Kasmir:''' Uman is the positive aspect of magic. His powers flow through each Tibian, making us his children.
''Jogador:'' '''Zathroth'''
'''Kasmir:''' Zathroth is the corruptor of souls who does not want mortals to ascend and become more like him.
''Jogador:'' '''Fardos'''
'''Kasmir:''' Fardos is the creator. It was his work that we possess divine souls.
''Jogador:'' '''News'''
'''Kasmir:''' Don't look for news when you don't know the past.
''Jogador:'' '''Tibiasula'''
'''Kasmir:''' The world is only a portal the gods created to allow our ascension to heaven.
''Jogador:'' '''Brog'''
'''Kasmir:''' Brog's hot blood is in our veins, tempting us and distracting us from improvement of our souls.
''Jogador:'' '''Kirok'''
'''Kasmir:''' Kirok is called the mad one. He gifted us with the creativity to achive our ascension.
''Jogador:'' '''Toth'''
'''Kasmir:''' Toth is the final judge. The unworthy are condemened to reincarnation.
''Jogador:'' '''Suon'''
'''Kasmir:''' Suon is the sun. He watches our ascension.
''Jogador:'' '''Fafnar'''
'''Kasmir:''' Fafnar is a test for our endurance and dilligence.
''Jogador:'' '''Crunor'''
'''Kasmir:''' Crunor is the force of life and part of our all being.
''Jogador:'' '''Nornur'''
'''Kasmir:''' Nornur is the mysterious god of fate. Daraman taught us that he is the judge who allows ascension.
''Jogador:'' '''Bastesh'''
'''Kasmir:''' Bastesh is the goddess of the seas, and deep as the see is our soul, indeed.
''Jogador:'' '''Sula'''
'''Kasmir:''' Sula is the raw force of water.
''Jogador:'' '''Air'''
'''Kasmir:''' Air is without true mind and meaning.
''Jogador:'' how are you?
'''Kasmir:''' Thank you, I'm fine and my soul is strong.
''Jogador:'' donation
'''Kasmir:''' Do you want to make a donation?
''Jogador:'' yes
'''Kasmir:''' May Daraman guide your quest for ascension.
''Jogador:'' sins
'''Kasmir:''' Do you whish to confess your sins?
''Jogador:'' yes
'''Kasmir:''' So what does trouble your soul, pilgrim?
''Jogador:'' (Fale qualquer coisa)
'''Kasmir:''' Meditate on that and try harder to improve soul.
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
'''Kasmir:''' Good bye, ''Jogador''. May Daraman's all-seeing eye watch your travels! }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.title: Kazzan
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Kazzan | job = Califa | city = Northern Darama | subarea = Darashia | location = [[Darashia]] ({{mapa|33233,32389,6:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 6.97 | notes = Kazzan é o Califa (líder) da cidade de Darashia. Ele é o líder social e espiritual das pessoas e é o seguidor dos ensinamentos de Daraman. Na sua juventude era um guerreiro, e lutou nas batalhas contra os inimigos de Drefia. Seu nome completo é ''Kazzan Ibn Gadral''.

* Faz parte da [[The Djinn War Quest]] * Faz parte da [[What a Foolish Quest]].

| buysell = não | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''hi'''
''Kazzan:'' Feel welcome in the lands of the children of the enlightened Daraman, Jogador.
''Jogador:'' '''name'''
''Kazzan:'' I am Kazzan Ibn Gadral, caliph of Darama.
''Jogador:'' '''lands / job'''
''Kazzan:'' I am the caliph of the children of Daraman. It is my privilege and mission to ensure their safety.
''Jogador:'' '''how are you'''
''Kazzan:'' I am fine, thank you.
''Jogador:'' '''Caliph'''
''Kazzan:'' A caliph is a leader of his people, just like a king.
''Jogador:'' '''Daraman'''
''Kazzan:'' Daraman led our ancestors to the continent Darashia to live a life of simplicity and meditation.
''Jogador:'' '''mission / quest'''
''Kazzan:'' There is nothing you can do for me right now but thank you for offering your help.
''Jogador:'' '''King / Thais / Tibianus'''
''Kazzan:'' Tibianus is the shepherd of the lost souls of the so called Thaian empire.
''Jogador:'' '''army / guard'''
''Kazzan:'' Our people are well prepared to fight for their land and their souls.
''Jogador:'' '''enemy / enemies'''
''Kazzan:'' The necromancers of Drefia fell under the wrath of the djinns once. If they challenge us again, they might lose more than a city.
''Jogador:'' '''Drefia'''
''Kazzan:'' When the djinns destroyed the better part of the unholy town in their wrath, the brotherhood hid like worms in the sand.
''Jogador:'' '''brotherhood'''
''Kazzan:'' The Brotherhood of Bones came here fleeing some war on the continent. They corrupted the settlers of the Thaian colony with ease.
''Jogador:'' '''minotaur'''
''Kazzan:'' The minotaurs are another test we have to endure. They inhabit the pyramid which is taboo for our people, as Daraman taught us.
''Jogador:'' '''taboo'''
''Kazzan:'' Daraman knew our souls might get corrupted by the things hidden there.
''Jogador:'' '''god'''
''Kazzan:'' The gods are powerful but it's ultimately up to us to work on our souls' ascension.
''Jogador:'' '''Kazordoon / dwarf'''
''Kazzan:'' We have lost contact with the dwarven people of Kazordoon.
''Jogador:'' '''Carlin'''
''Kazzan:'' We keep in touch with the queen, but we have not taken sides in the conflict of Carlin and Thais ... yet.
''Jogador:'' '''excalibug'''
''Kazzan:'' Once a djinn claimed to have seen it in a dream. I guess it's just that, some dream of a supernatural creature.
''Jogador:'' '''bye'''
''Kazzan:'' May your soul flourish, Player.
''Kazzan:'' May your soul flourish.
}}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}}
| name        = Samir
| job         = Criminoso
| city        = Northern Darama
| subarea     = Drefia, Kha'zeel Mountains
| location    = [[Kha'zeel Mountains]] ({{Mapa|33028,32416,4:2|aqui}}).
| implemented = 7.8
| notes       = Esse eremita vive no topo das montanhas de Drefia ({{mapa|33092,32450,7:2|aqui}}). Já foi um assassino no passado, mas se arrependeu e hoje em dia vive isolado do mundo, como forma de punição. Ele dá instruções de como obter o [[Assassin Outfits]].
| buysell     = não
| sells       =
| buys        =
| falas       = 
''Jogador:'' '''Life'''</br>
'''Samir:''' You would not want to lead such a life, believe me. And I simply refuse to take anyone as my apprentice anymore.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''</br>
'''Samir:''' I don't have a job anymore. Long time ago, I used to be an assassin... but that is a dark chapter of my past. Nowadays I'm a simple hermit.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hermit'''</br>
'''Samir:''' That is the life I chose now. My sins can't be made undone, but my life in solitude is my self-imposed punishment.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Assassin'''</br>
'''Samir:''' It is true - I once made a living from... well, putting people away who made others feel uncomfortable. It is not an easy life.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Apprentice'''</br>
'''Samir:''' No way. I am old and weary. If you really want to throw your life away and become an assassin, go bother Atrad, Vescu or Erayo and try not to get killed.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Atrad'''</br>
'''Samir:''' The red death. As far as I know, he hides somewhere on the Forbidden Islands. Usually he prefers hot places, which fits his temper.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Vescu'''</br>
'''Samir:''' The green death. I think the last time I heard about him, he roamed Tiquanda. In his spare time he prefers jungle surroundings, which matches his confused mind.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Erayo'''</br>
'''Samir:''' The blue death. If he isn't on a killing spree, he loves places with a lot of water, such as the Laguna Islands. He is a quiet one, but don't underestimate him.
}}<noinclude>[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]</noinclude>

pages.title: Christoph
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Christoph | job = Guarda | city = Venore | subarea = Venore City | location = [[Venore City]] ({{Mapa|32882,32032,6:1|aqui}}). | implemented = 7.1 | notes = Ele protege a cidade de Venore contra o ataque de criaturas do pântano. | buysell = não | buys = | sells = | falas = ''Jogador'': '''Hello'''
Christoph: LONG LIVE THE KING!
''Jogador'': '''King / Tibianus'''
Christoph: Tibianus III is our beloved king! He rules over Venore from far away Thais.
''Jogador'': '''Venore'''
Christoph: The harbour is to the north, the weapon market in the south, the general market to the west, and the bank to the east. You will find other shops and the Hard Rock Tavern in the centre.
''Jogador'': '''Job'''
Christoph: I am a protector of the people of Venore.
''Jogador'': '''Swamp'''
Christoph: The swamp is a dangerous place and full of monsters, not to mention all those swampelves living at shadowthorn, amazons, and swamptrolls.
''Jogador'': '''monsters'''
Christoph: The swamp is full of nasty snakes and there's a dragon breeding ground somewhere in the swamps.
''Jogador'': '''swamptrolls'''
Christoph: This hideous creatures are even more ugly than the normal trolls. They are treacherous and use several poisons.
''Jogador'': '''swampelves'''
Christoph: Those elves hide in the swamps and are trying to kill all humans in this area.
''Jogador'': '''amazons'''
Christoph: They are the best example for the results of the Carlin madness.
''Jogador'': '''Guard / Army / Secret Police'''
Christoph: This information is confidential.
''Jogador'': '''Guard / Army / Secret Police'''
Christoph: This information is confidential.
''Jogador'': '''Dogs of war'''
Christoph: They are our rolemodells.
''Jogador'': '''Silver guards.'''
Christoph: Only the best of the best serve as silver guards.
''Jogador'': '''Battlegroups'''
Christoph: I doubt you have the security clearance to ask that.
''Jogador'': '''Red Guard'''
Christoph: We of the red guard are the special forces and town guards.
''Jogador'': '''Knights of Noodles'''
Christoph: Every guard dreams of becoming one of them one day.
''Jogador'': '''news'''
Christoph: Look for the Hard Rock Tavern to learn the latest news.
''Jogador'': '''Sell / Buy'''
Christoph: Ask the merchants of the city. There are more than enough
''Jogador'': '''Castle'''
Christoph: The castle is in Thais, the crown of the kingdom.
''Jogador'': '''city'''
Christoph: This city, a member of the Thaian kingdom, is under the protection of the Thaian army.
''Jogador'': '''Bye'''
Christoph: LONG LIVE THE KING!
}}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

| buysell = sim | buys = Nada. | sells = {{Trades/Sell | Parcel | Letter | Label}} | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Dove:''' Be greeted, noble ''Jogador'' and welcome to the post offce.
''Jogador:'' '''Office''' / '''Job'''
'''Dove:''' I am responsible for this post office. If you have questions about the mail system or the depots, just ask me.
''Jogador:'' '''Mail''' / '''Mailboxes''' / '''Help'''
'''Dove:''' With our mail system you can send letters and parcels to other Tibians. I can either explain how letters and parcels work or sell them to you if you ask me for a trde.
''Jogador:'' '''Letter'''
'''Dove:''' If you want to buy a letter, ask me for a trade. Or do you want me to explain how letters wrk?
''Jogador:'' '''Explain'''
'''Dove:''' With a letter you can send a message to another Tibian's depot. If you want to send it to 'Ben' in Thais, use the letter - so that a form opens - and write 'Ben' in the first line. Write your message below that....
'''Dove:''' Then drag your letter on one of the blue mailboxes here to sendit.
''Jogador:'' '''Depot'''
'''Dove:''' Each major city has at least one depot. Just step in front of one of the lockers and you can store items inside. Your mail will also arrive there. It doesn't matter which depot you stored it in - you can retrieve all your items from any depot in any cty!
''Jogador:'' '''Parcels'''
'''Dove:''' If you want to buy a parcel, ask me for a trade. Or do you want me to explain how parcels wrk?
''Jogador:'' '''Explain'''
'''Dove:''' In a parcel you can send items to another Tibian's depot. Put your items into the parcel and also place a completed label with the name of the receiver inside. Then drag your parcel on one of the blue mailboxes here to sendit.
''Jogador:'' '''Label'''
'''Dove:''' If you want to buy a label, ask me for a trade. Or do you want me to explain how labels wrk?
''Jogador:'' '''Explain'''
'''Dove:''' Including a label in your parcel is important. Imagine you want to send it to 'Ben' in Thais. Use the label - so that a form opens - and write 'Ben' in the first line. Check the spelling and put it in your parcel!...
'''Dove:''' Then drag your parcel on one of the blue mailboxes here to sendit.
''Jogador:'' '''Receiver'''
'''Dove:''' Well, the receiver - or addressee - is the person you want to send mail to. Always make sure to enter his or her name correcly.
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''
'''Dove:''' My name is Dve.
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
'''Dove:''' Come back soon, noble ''Jogador''. }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

''Jogador:'' '''Time'''</br>
'''Xed:''' I don't know, maybe what you really need is a watch.
''Jogador:'' '''Weapon'''</br>
'''Xed:''' My offers are bows, crossbows and ammunition. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a trade.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Xed'''</br>
'''Xed:''' Yeah, nice name, eh?</br>
''Jogador:'' '''dungeon'''</br>
'''Xed:''' Oh, they are all over. You never see more of them than in Kaz, though</br>
''Jogador:'' '''kaz'''</br>
'''Xed:''' Oh, that's short for Kazordoon.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''general'''</br>
'''Xed:''' You must be talking of the great general Benjamin. He saved the kingdom from ferumbras you know.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''hurt'''</br>
'''Xed:''' Go to a priest. I am sure they will fix you up.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''monsters'''</br>
'''Xed:''' Yeah, these awful beasts. They live in the swamps near the city and in dark dungeons.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''news'''</br>
'''Xed:''' Some people say Ferumbras isn't really dead. Crazy kids!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''army'''</br>
'''Xed:''' We supply the archers of the army with distance fighting weapons.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''amazons'''</br>
'''Xed:''' They are a band or tribe of strange women that have nothing in common with civilized men like me.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Abran Ironeye'''</br>
'''Xed:''' He is the owner of this market, although - just between you and me - I'm not so sure he's honest.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Honest'''</br>
'''Xed:''' Well, I overheard the boss discussing some shady deals with a man in a black cloak.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Shady Deals'''</br>
'''Xed:''' Something about a sword only great warlords can use and a rare distance fighting item.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Rare Distance'''</br>
'''Xed:''' Yes, but I believe this is nothing but lies seeing that there are only a few distance fighting weapons.
}}<noinclude>[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]</noinclude>

pages.title: Hugo
pages.wikitext:
{{DASH|img=desambig|''Esta página é sobre o NPC, para a criatura, veja [[Hugo (Demonbunny)]].''}}{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Hugo | job = Comerciante | city = Venore | subarea = Venore City | location = [[Venore City|Venore City - Dress for Success]] ({{Mapa|32951,32104,5:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 7.1 | notes = Hugo administra a ''Dress for Success''. Ele é chamado de Chefe Hugo, embora o seu verdadeiro nome é Oscar Savage, que ele mudou, porque Hugo é mais másculo. Ele faz [[Postman Quest|uniformes]]. Chefe Hugo (seu nome completo) é claramente uma [[Alusões#Hugo Boss|alusão]] da famosa marca Hugo Boss.

* Faz parte da [[Beggar Outfits Quest]]. * Faz parte da [[The Postman Missions Quest]].

| buysell = não | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Hugo:''' Be greeted, ''Jogador'' and welcome to the 'wearhouse'!
''Jogador:'' '''Welcome / Job'''
'''Hugo:''' I am tailor and designer extraordinaire. Well, rather a designer. I leave most of the actual tailoring to my assistants.
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''
'''Hugo:''' I am known as Hugo Chief.
''Jogador:'' '''Time'''
'''Hugo:''' Sorry, a watch would ruin my stylish outfit.
''Jogador:'' '''News'''
'''Hugo:''' Ask my apprentice Kalvin about our new collection.
''Jogador:'' '''Uniform'''
'''Hugo:''' I don't get it, what uniforms you are talking about?
''Jogador:'' '''Hugo'''
'''Hugo:''' Well it's not my real name. I took it because people think it's grand and manly. I hate people doubting my manhood for being a tailor, you know.
''Jogador:'' '''Real name'''
'''Hugo:''' Uhm, well, it's Oscar Savage, but who can become famous - especially as an artist - with a name like that, I ask you?
''Jogador:'' '''Outfit'''
'''Hugo:''' I guess my vision wasn't that grand after all. I hope there are still people who enjoy it.
''Jogador:'' '''Warehouse'''
'''Hugo:''' I would call it a 'wearhouse'.
''Jogador:'' '''Thais'''
'''Hugo:''' Thais is kind of a fashion hell. If there was an award for the most ugly citizens, it would go to Thais.
''Jogador:'' '''Carlin'''
'''Hugo:''' Women should know better than to hide in ugly armour. Like all followers of ugliness they will be punished one day.
''Jogador:'' '''Tibia / ugliness / punished'''
'''Hugo:''' A world filled with ugly dressed people needs the skills of a fashion hero.
''Jogador:'' '''Fashion hero'''
'''Hugo:''' One day Captain Catwalk will punish all crimes to fashion and bring all ugly people to justice.
''Jogador:'' '''Captain Catwalk'''
'''Hugo:''' He's a supermodel! No one knows his secret identity!
''Jogador:'' '''Supermodel'''
'''Hugo:''' A model with incredible superpowers. Do you think they call them supermodels for nothing?
''Jogador:'' '''King / Tibianus'''
'''Hugo:''' He does not care much about us, we don't care much about him. I consider that a fair deal.
''Jogador:'' '''Tax'''
'''Hugo:''' I don't care about such mundane things like 'taxes'.
''Jogador:'' '''Privilege'''
'''Hugo:''' The city was granted a few privileges by the king. I can't even tell which. They don't affect me that much.
''Jogador:'' '''Gambling'''
'''Hugo:''' I too love to gamble now and then in the Hard Rock tavern.
''Jogador:'' '''Army'''
'''Hugo:''' I think they should not wear that ugly armour in town. I will see to assure that will be changed soon.
''Jogador:'' '''Ferumbras'''
'''Hugo:''' The ferumbras-bad-ass-fashion is incredibly outdated since years.
''Jogador:'' '''Excalibug'''
'''Hugo:''' I don't care for such fairytales.
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
'''Hugo:''' Good bye, ''Jogador'' }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.title: Zebron
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Zebron | job = Apostador | city = Venore | subarea = Venore City | location = [[Venore City|Venore City - Hard Rock Tavern]] ({{Mapa|32929,32072,9:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 7.1 | notes = Ele anda ao redor da taverna e oferece um jogo de dados. Você pode apostar de 1 a 99 [[gp]]s e, se os dados caírem no número 6, você obtém 5 vezes a sua aposta. Você também pode apostar 100 [[gp]]s com a chance de ganhar um [[die]]. Similar ao principal, se os dados caírem no número 6, você ganha os dados. Ele tem um primo chamado [[Hugo]]. | buysell = não | buys = | sells = | falas = ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
Zebron: Greetings, high roller. So you care for a game, ''Player''?
''Jogador'': '''job'''
Zebron: Oh, I am just sitting around here and gamble now and then.
''Jogador'': '''name'''
Zebron: I am known as Zebron.
''Jogador'': '''time'''
Zebron: It is exactly 0:00 am.
''Jogador'': '''king'''
Zebron: Ah, our beloved king! Bless him for the gambling licence of Venore.
''Jogador'': '''Tibia'''
Zebron: What would I need more than that what I can get right here?
''Jogador'': '''army'''
Zebron: Hehe, they spent a good part of their salary here in the tavern.
''Jogador'': '''tavern / here'''
Zebron: It's a fine place to be around, isn't it?
''Jogador'': '''game''' ou '''gamble''' ou '''dice'''
Zebron: So you care for a civilized game of dice?
''Jogador'': '''swamp''' ou '''amazons'''
Zebron: Bah, always the same chitchat. Swampelves this and amazons that ... blah blah.
''Jogador'': '''Excalibug'''
Zebron: I would not bet that anyone will ever find it.
''Jogador'': '''Carlin'''
Zebron: Carlin, the beerless ... what a shame.
''Jogador'': '''Thais'''
Zebron: Thais is a bit too conservative for me.
''Jogador'': '''Venore'''
Zebron: Aaaah, Venore, Venore, what a wonderful town. Especially for someone with love for gambling like me.
''Jogador'': '''Hugo'''
Zebron: I had a cousin named Hugo, why do you ask?
''Jogador'': '''licence'''
Zebron: I don't care much for that law stuff, but as far as I know those Venore merchants got a royal gambling licence for the city.
''Jogador'': '''bye'''
Zebron: Hey, you can't leave. Luck is smiling on you. I can feel it!
''Jogador'': '''Love / Kiss'''
Zebron: Ah, love is the most exciting game of all. I've learnt a few tricks of this game, too and I might share them with someone worthy.
''Jogador'': '''hi'''
Zebron: Greetings, high roller. So you care for a game, ''Player''?
Zebron: Hey, you can't leave. Luck is smiling on you. I can feel it! }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.title: Yberius
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Yberius | job = Monge | job2 = Sacerdote | job3 = Curador | npcclass = Humanos | npcsprite = Monk | city = Venore | subarea = Venore City | location = [[Venore City]] ({{Mapa|32959,32075,7:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 7.1 | notes = Yberius mora no Templo de Venore, observando aventureiros e oferecendo cura para [[poison|envenenamento]], [[fire|queimaduras]] ou [[energy|eletrizado]]. Ele pode ajudar você - algumas dicas sobre vida, criaturas, dinheiro e equipamento.

* Você pode conseguir uma pedra especial falando '''Hi - Adventurer's Stone - Yes''' para este NPC. * Se você usar uma [[Adventurer's Stone]] dentro de templo, você será teleportado para pequena ilha da [[Adventurers' Guild]].

| buysell = não | falas = ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
Yberius: Welcome, young ''Jogador''! If you are new in Tibia, ask me for help.
''Jogador'': '''gods'''
Yberius: They are the creators of Tibia and all life on it.
''Jogador'': '''Tibia'''
Yberius: It's the world of Tibia.
''Jogador'': '''life'''
Yberius: There are the plants, the citizens, and the monsters.
''Jogador'': '''plants'''
Yberius: Crunor, the god of plants and fertility, watches over all plants, small and big.
''Jogador'': '''citizens'''
Yberius: Just walk around and meet them. Chat and learn about them.
''Jogador'': '''monsters'''
Yberius: Even they have their part in the bigger scheme. Even if it eludes us mere mortals.
''Jogador'': '''help'''
Yberius: Earn some gold and upgrade your equipment.
''Jogador'': '''gold''' ou '''money'''
Yberius: If you need money, you have to slay monsters and take their gold. Look for swamptrolls in the swamps. But be careful. They use poisoned weapons.
''Jogador'': '''equipment'''
Yberius: First you should buy a machete. You will need it in the swamps. And better don't explore without a shovel and a rope.
''Jogador'': '''name'''
Yberius: I am Brother Yberius.
''Jogador'': '''time'''
Yberius: Now, it is 8:01 pm. Ask Shiantis for a watch, if you need one.
''Jogador'': '''king'''
Yberius: The king resides in the far away city of Thais.
''Jogador'': '''army'''
Yberius: The royal army is here to protect us.
''Jogador'': '''quest'''
Yberius: Earn some gold and upgrade your equipment.
''Jogador'': '''heal'''
Yberius: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the pilgrimage of ashes.
''Jogador'': '''ashes'''
Yberius: Whenever you receive a lethal wound your lifeforce is damaged. With every single of the five blessings you have this damage will be reduced.
''Jogador'': '''blessing'''
Yberius: There are five different blessings available in five sacred places. These blessings are: the spiritual shielding, the spark of the phoenix, the embrace of tibia, the fire of the suns and the wisdom of solitude.
''Jogador'': '''Ferumbras'''
Yberius: The gods only know what this spawn of darkness might be up to.
''Jogador'': '''Excalibug'''
Yberius: This blasphemous weapon has to be destroyed.
''Jogador'': '''Eat'''
Yberius: If you want to heal your wounds, buy something to eat or hunt some small game. If you are very weak just ask me to heal you.
''Jogador'': '''Wisdom / Solitude'''
Yberius: I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
''Jogador'': '''Spark / Phoenix'''
Yberius: I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
''Jogador'': '''Suns / Fire'''
Yberius: I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
''Jogador'': '''Embrace'''
Yberius: I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
''Jogador'': '''Spiritual'''
Yberius: I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
''Jogador'': '''Enhanced'''
Yberius: It is said that one enhanced blessing, the 'heart of the mountain', has been lost in the icy wastes of Svargrond. Find a nomad far to the west of these barren lands, hiding in the cold there, slightly above ground. ...
Yberius: It is also said that a mysterious djinn, bound to an existence of slavery, lies buried somewhere beneath the northern Tiquanda jungle. I cannot confirm whether this tale is true but if you find him, you shall also find the 'blood of the mountain'.
''Jogador'': '''bye'''
Yberius: May the gods bless you, ''Player''!
''Jogador'': '''hi'''
Yberius: Welcome, young ''Player''! If you are new in Tibia, ask me for help.
Yberius: Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free. }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.wikitext:

| notes       = Vladruc Urghain administra o The Magic Bazar. Ele adora [[blood|sangue]] mas odeia [[Garlic Necklace|alho]]. Ele não gosta de [[Vampire|vampiros]] também.
| buysell     = não
| buys        = 
| sells       = 
| falas       = __NOTOC__
== Frases Espontâneas ==
Não possui.

== Palavras-Chave ==
''Jogador'': '''hi'''</br>
'''Vladruc''': I am Vladruc Urghain and welcome you, ''Jogador'', to my house.</br>
'''Vladruc''': Chhhh ... Sorry, I'm busy. <cough> ''(se você possuir ou equipar um garlic necklace, a conversa é encerrada)''

''Jogador'': '''house''' / '''job'''</br>
'''Vladruc''': I am a humble merchant of little importance to the beautiful Venore.

''Jogador'': '''venore'''</br>
'''Vladruc''': Our ways are not your ways, and there shall be to you many strange things.

''Jogador'': '''name'''</br>
'''Vladruc''': I am Vladruc Urghain. Welcome to my house!

''Jogador'': '''monster'''</br>
'''Vladruc''': Oh yes, the children of the night … you dwellers in the city cannot enter into the feelings of the hunter.

''Jogador'': '''ferumbras'''</br>
'''Vladruc''': You think he is of ancient evil? Little you know about ancientness or evilness.

''Jogador'': '''excalibug'''</br>
'''Vladruc''': A terrifying weapon if it does exist at all.

''Jogador'': '''coffin'''</br>
'''Vladruc''': The final resting place for all of us, isn’t it?

''Jogador'': '''thais'''</br>
'''Vladruc''': adly, only through books have I come to know your great Thais, and to know her is to love her.

''Jogador'': '''books'''</br>
'''Vladruc''': These companions have been good friends and teachers to me.

''Jogador'': '''tibia'''</br>
'''Vladruc''': What a wonderful world we do live in … so full of life.

''Jogador'': '''blood'''</br>
'''Vladruc''': I like blood … only the color, that is, of course … <chuckles>

''Jogador'': '''vampire'''</br>
'''Vladruc''': Please don’t talk about such creatures. You are scaring me.

''Jogador'': '''necromancer'''</br>
'''Vladruc''': Death is the final frontier. Necromancers boldly go, where no one has gone before.

''Jogador'': '''magic'''</br>
'''Vladruc''': Magic is a tool to be mastered.

''Jogador'': '''undead'''</br>
'''Vladruc''': It is not dead, which can eternal lie, and in strange aeons, even death may die.

''Jogador'': '''king'''</br>
'''Vladruc''': I am of noble blood myself. I have been master so long that none other should be master of me.

''Jogador'': '''time'''</br>
'''Vladruc''': It is ''horas''.

''Jogador'': '''dungeon'''</br>
'''Vladruc''': Such lovely places, unjustly shunned by the people.

''Jogador'': '''help'''</br>
'''Vladruc''': I am sorry, but I can’t be of much assistance to you.

''Jogador'': '''adventure'''</br>
'''Vladruc''': The time I sought out adventure is long gone indeed.

''Jogador'': '''alchemy'''</br>
'''Vladruc''': You can buy some potions downstairs.

''Jogador'': '''spells'''</br>
'''Vladruc''': I know a spell or two. You might want to buy some spells downstairs in the market.

''Jogador'': '''market''' / '''shop'''</br>
'''Vladruc''': Ah, feel free to browse and buy in my humble shop below.

''Jogador'': '''army'''</br>
'''Vladruc''': The Thaian garrison serves its purpose very well.

''Jogador'': '''news'''</br>
'''Vladruc''': I am a reclusive person and learn little of the local gossip of the peasants.

''Jogador'': '''offer'''</br>
'''Vladruc''': Please check my humble market downstairs for the wares that are offered.

''Jogador'': '''thank you''' / '''thanks'''</br>
'''Vladruc''': That’s nothing worth to be mentioned.

''Jogador'': '''bye'''</br>
'''Vladruc''': Go safely ''Jogador'', and leave something of the happiness you bring!
}}

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Wyda | job = Bruxa | job2 = Roleplay | city = Venore | subarea = Green Claw Swamp | location = [[Green Claw Swamp]] ({{Mapa|32726,31980,6:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 7.1 | notes = Ela fugiu do acampamento de soldados no norte de Carlin e chegou aos pântanos de Venore. Aqui ela vive na solidão embora não tao longe de witches e bonelords. Mesma aparência que uma Witch. Um livro na [[Isle of the Kings]] menciona ela como uma seguidora de [[Zathroth]], e que ela faz poções para seus subordinados.

* Ela precisa de um [[Blood Herb]] para sua poções e esta disposta a oferecer [[Witchesbroom]] por ele, e com sorte você poderá adquirir um [[Torn Teddy]] durante o Mini World Change [[Mini_World_Changes#Bored_Witch|Bored Witch]]. * [[Arquivo:achievement.gif|link=]] Após conseguir o doll, você receberá o achievement '''"{{achievement|Torn Treasures}}"'''

| buysell = não | buys = | sells = | falas =__NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == Não possui. == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Wyda''': Wyda: What? Talking to me, ''Jogador''? ''Jogador'': '''hi''' ''(versão alternativa)''
'''Wyda''': What? A mundane talking to me? Amusing. ''Jogador'': '''hello'''
'''Wyda''': Good day, ''Jogador''. ----- === Sobre Wyda: === ''Jogador'': '''job''' / '''profession'''
'''Wyda''': I am a witch. Didn't you notice? ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Wyda''': My name is Wyda, and what's yours? ''Jogador'': '''my name is ''seu nome'''''
'''Wyda''': Nice to meet you. ''Jogador'': '''sister''' / '''witches'''
'''Wyda''': Some sisters of mine are having a meeting nearby. Don't disturb them, or they will get angry and attack you. ''Jogador'': '''witch'''
'''Wyda''': Aye, I'm a witch. ''Jogador'': '''mother'''
'''Wyda''': Of course my mother was also a witch! ----- === Locais e Cidades: === ''Jogador'': '''thais'''
'''Wyda''': I've heard stories about that city. It's nowhere near here, that's all I can tell you about it. ''Jogador'': '''stories'''
'''Wyda''': Thais is an overcrowded place inhabited by brutal murderers. At least that's what I've been told. ''Jogador'': '''kazordoon'''
'''Wyda''': Isn't that the name of the little bearded fellows' town? ''Jogador'': '''carlin'''
'''Wyda''': Carlin is a beautiful town, but far from here. Do you live there? ''Jogador'': '''i live in ''qualquer cidade'''''
'''Wyda''': That's nice. ''Jogador'': '''plains of havoc'''
'''Wyda''': Many tales exist about the so-called Plains of Havoc. It seems to be a dangerous place. ''Jogador'': '''tibia'''
'''Wyda''': Tibia is the name of our continent. ----- === Criaturas: === ''Jogador'': '''hunter'''
'''Wyda''': To the east, there is a little settlement of hunters. They are cruel humans who attack everything they see. ''Jogador'': '''giant spider'''
'''Wyda''': Yes, there is such a thing in the east, on a small island. It's very powerful. ''Jogador'': '''bonelord'''
'''Wyda''': Bonelords? Strange creatures that have mysterious magical abilities. ''Jogador'': '''slime'''
'''Wyda''': There's lots of slime around. It is said that they live from the swamp water. ''Jogador'': '''black knight'''
'''Wyda''': A black knight? Black is the colour of witches, why would a knight wear black? ----- === Outras Palavras-Chave: === ''Jogador'': '''sorcerer'''
'''Wyda''': Sorcerers have forgotten about the root of all beings: nature. ''Jogador'': '''paladin'''
'''Wyda''': Paladins can use bows, but no brains. ''Jogador'': '''knight'''
'''Wyda''': Knights succumb to the blindness of rage and the desire for violence and blood. ''Jogador'': '''druid'''
'''Wyda''': Druids are mostly fine people. I'm always happy when I meet one. After all, they are often a bit less prejudiced against my profession. ''Jogador'': '''tibianus''' / '''ferumbras'''
'''Wyda''': Haha, that's a stupid name. Who's that? ''Jogador'': '''bridge'''
'''Wyda''': There's a bridge to the west, but it's guarded by dwarfs. ''Jogador'': '''dwarf''' / '''dwarves''' / '''little fellows'''
'''Wyda''': The little bearded fellows have a town somewhere to the north-west. ''Jogador'': '''queen'''
'''Wyda''': Eloise is the queen of Carlin. I don't care much about royals as long as they don't try to tax me. ''Jogador'': '''king'''
'''Wyda''': There are too many royals on this continent if you ask me... ''Jogador'': '''time'''
'''Wyda''': I think it is the fourth year after Queen Eloise's crowning, but I cannot tell you date or time. ''Jogador'': '''evil'''
'''Wyda''': Evilness doesn't scare me. ''Jogador'': '''help'''
'''Wyda''': I can only help with knowledge. About what do you want me to tell you something? ''Jogador'': '''buy''' / '''offer'''
'''Wyda''': I'm currently not selling anything. ''Jogador'': '''sell'''
'''Wyda''': There's nothing I need right now, thanks. ''Jogador'': '''key'''
'''Wyda''': I keep my keys where they belong - in my pocket. ''Jogador'': '''monster''' / '''creature'''
'''Wyda''': Many creatures live in, around and beneath the swamp. Be careful! ''Jogador'': '''swamp'''
'''Wyda''': Be careful of the swamp water, it's poisonous! ''Jogador'': '''herbs'''
'''Wyda''': The swamp is home to a wide variety of herbs, but the most famous is the blood herb. ''Jogador'': '''nature'''
'''Wyda''': There are many swamp plants, mushrooms and herbs around here. ''Jogador'': '''plant'''
'''Wyda''': There are many kinds of swamp plants, some can be used for potions, some not. ''Jogador'': '''potion''' / '''secret''' / '''recipe'''
'''Wyda''': The recipe of the potions is one of the witches' secrets! ''Jogador'': '''mushroom'''
'''Wyda''': Mushrooms taste good and are useful for potions. ''Jogador'': '''heal'''
'''Wyda''': I don't have any healing potions available right now. ''Jogador'': '''god'''
'''Wyda''': I believe that nature itself is God. ''Jogador'': '''magic''' / '''spell'''
'''Wyda''': The magic of the witches is one of our secrets! ''Jogador'': '''granny weatherwax''' / '''nanny ogg'''
'''Wyda''': I think I've heard that name before... ''Jogador'': '''voodoo'''
'''Wyda''': I don't practice such nonsense, that's just a rumour. ''Jogador'': '''coffin'''
'''Wyda''': That's none of your business. ''Jogador'': '''gold''' / '''platinum'''
'''Wyda''': Money means nothing to me. ''Jogador'': '''cookie'''
'''Wyda''': I bake cookies now and then in my spare time. ''Jogador'': '''orange'''
'''Wyda''': I love exotic fruits. I import oranges from the south sometimes, but that's very expensive. ''Jogador'': '''broom'''
'''Wyda''': What about it? ''Jogador'': '''fly broom'''
'''Wyda''': Haha, no... where did you get that idea? I use it to sweep my platform. ''Jogador'': '''platform'''
'''Wyda''': This platform and house were built by my mother, long ago. ''Jogador'': '''crystal ball'''
'''Wyda''': It's a magical item that only witches can use. ''Jogador'': '''earthquake'''
'''Wyda''': The earth in this region shakes now and then. Foolish people think that this is because the gods are angry. ''Jogador'': '''become a witch'''
'''Wyda''': You're a MAN! ''(se você for homem)'' ''Jogador'': '''man'''
'''Wyda''': There are only female witches. ''Jogador'': '''wand'''
'''Wyda''': I use a wooden wand. Why are you asking? ''Jogador'': '''power wand'''
'''Wyda''': The power of the wand can only be used by witches. ''Jogador'': '''quest'''
'''Wyda''': A quest? Well, if you're so keen on doing me a favour... Why don't you try to find a blood herb? ''Jogador'': '''blood herb'''
'''Wyda''': The blood herb is very rare. This plant would be very useful for me but I don't know any accessible places where it can be found. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Wyda''': Good luck on your journeys, ''Jogador''. ----- === Durante a Mini World Change Bored Witch: === ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Wyda''': I'm bored! Bored bored bored! Nothing ever happens here! ''Jogador'': '''job''' / '''profession'''
'''Wyda''': I think witches these days are underpaid. Who needs a witch anyway? ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Wyda''': You should know me after all these years! ''Jogador'': '''sister''' / '''witches'''
'''Wyda''': Some sisters of mine are having a meeting nearby. Don't disturb them, or they will get angry and attack you. ''Jogador'': '''giant spider'''
'''Wyda''': Oooooh why are you asking? *whistles* ''Jogador'': '''dwarf''' / '''dwarves''' / '''little fellows'''
'''Wyda''': They surely have something to compensate for. ''Jogador'': '''time'''
'''Wyda''': It's about time SOMETHING HAPPENED HERE! ''Jogador'': '''help'''
'''Wyda''': Help's not in store today. Sorry. Mwihihihi. ''Jogador'': '''monster''' / '''creature'''
'''Wyda''': Many creatures live in, around, and beneath the swamp. Be careful... MWIHIHIHIHIHI. ''Jogador'': '''magic''' / '''spell'''
'''Wyda''': I want to invent a new spell. I just need a good idea. ''Jogador'': '''crystal ball'''
'''Wyda''': Let me take a look... ah, yes, you'll have a good day. Or maybe a bad one. Doesn't really say it clearly. ''Jogador'': '''quest'''
'''Wyda''': To be honest, I'm drowning in blood herbs by now. ''Jogador'': '''blood herb'''
'''Wyda''': To be honest, I'm drowning in blood herbs by now. But if it helps you, well yes.. I guess I could use another blood herb... ''Jogador'': '''blood herb''' ''(tendo uma blood herb na sua backpack)''
'''Wyda''': Arrr... here we go again.... do you have a #$*§# blood herb for me? :''Jogador'': '''no'''
:'''Wyda''': Arrr... here we go again.... do you have a #$*§# blood herb for me? :''Jogador'': '''yes''' ''(recebendo uma witchesbroom)''
:'''Wyda''': Thank you -SOOO- much! No, I really mean it! Really! Here, let me give you a reward... :''Jogador'': '''yes''' ''(recebendo um torn teddy)''
:'''Wyda''': Thank you -SOOO- much! No, I really mean it! Really! Ah, you know what, you can have this old thing... ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Wyda''': NO! Don't go! I need someone to entertain me! }}

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}}
| name        = Talesia
| job         = Comerciante
| city        = Venore
| subarea     = Venore City
| location    = [[Venore City|Venore City - Crunor's Finest Warehouse]] ({{Mapa|32979,32033,5:2|aqui}}).
| implemented = 7.1
| notes       = Talesia administra a Crunor's Finest Warehouse. Ela não é amigável com Thais ou King Tibianus por causa dos impostos que ela (e outros comerciantes de Venore) têm de pagar para eles. Ela sabe muito sobre os privilégios de Venore - Em Venore é permitido comerciar com qualquer outra pessoa dentro do reino Thais ou de fora, aqui não há governador de Thaian, e Venore é a única cidade com licença de apostas em jogos.
| buysell     = não
| buys        = 
| sells       = 
| falas       = 
''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''</br>
'''Talesia:''' Salutation, ''Jogador''!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''</br>
'''Talesia:''' I am a the owner of Crunor's Finest Warehouse of course.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''</br>
'''Talesia:''' I am Talesia De'Mir, owner of Crunor's Finest Warehouse.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Time'''</br>
'''Talesia:''' It's 1:25 am right now.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''King''' / '''Tibianus'''</br>
'''Talesia:''' We pay this man enough to live here undisturbed of major interventions.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Tibia'''</br>
'''Talesia:''' The world is a treasure chest for those of knowledge and skill.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Army'''</br>
'''Talesia:''' At least they are useful, but we pay enough taxes to supply the entire Thaian army.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Taxes'''</br>
'''Talesia:''' Venore is the major tax payer in the whole realm. So we more than deserve the privileges the king granted us.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Privileges'''</br>
'''Talesia:''' We are alowed to trade with anyone, Thaian subject or not, have no Thaian noble as governor, and own the exclusive gambling license.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Gambling'''</br>
'''Talesia:''' I don't care much about it, though others profit greatly.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Ferumbras'''</br>
'''Talesia:''' I hope he is aware that his enemies live elsewhere.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Excalibug'''</br>
'''Talesia:''' I am contend with my familysword meloncutter.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Carlin'''</br>
'''Talesia:''' They are a bit problematic as business partners, but their independence from [[Thais]] is... interesting.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Thais'''</br>
'''Talesia:''' I hope they live well from our taxes...</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Crunor'''</br>
'''Talesia:''' A god worth to worship. At least he gives something useful back to the faithful.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Warehouse'''</br>
'''Talesia:''' My warehouse is only one of many. We merchants hold this city together and lead it to prosperity.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''</br>
'''Talesia:''' Fare thee well.
''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''</br>
'''Talesia:''' Salutation, ''Jogador''!</br>
'''Talesia:''' Fare thee well.
}}<noinclude>[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]</noinclude>

Líquidos vendidos em mugs {{Trades/Sell | Beer | Bread, 4 | Cheese, 6 | Cookie, 5 | Ham, 8 | Lemonade | Meat, 5 | Water (Líquido) | Wine}} | falas = ''jogador'': '''hi'''
Urkalio: Welcome to the pits of the Hard Rock Tavern, ''Jogador''.
''jogador'': '''job'''
Urkalio: I am responsible for the Hard Rock Pits Tavern.
''jogador'': '''name'''
Urkalio: I am Urkalio.
''jogador'': '''time'''
Urkalio: No clue, it's equally dark down here at any time.
''jogador'': '''king''' ou '''Tibianus'''
Urkalio: Down here everyone is king as far as where his weapons reach.
''jogador'': '''Tibia'''
Urkalio: Sooner or later everyone comes here, so why bother to travel.
''jogador'': '''buy'''
Urkalio: I sell food and drinks for the hungry and thirsty.
''jogador'': '''food'''
Urkalio: I have cookies, bread, cheese, ham, and meat.
''jogador'': '''Excalibug'''
Urkalio: I would love to see that weapon in a fight.
''jogador'': '''Ferumbras'''
Urkalio: THAT would be some attraction down here.
''jogador'': '''Fighting Pits'''
Urkalio: Choose your enemies with care.
''jogador'': '''Carlin'''
Urkalio: I don't care about their 'independence war'.
''jogador'': '''Thais'''
Urkalio: Such a boring city. I wonder why anyone would live there.
''jogador'': '''Asrak'''
Urkalio: He's the best. To be the man, you'll have to beat the minotaur, so to say. Not that you could provoke him to a fight at all.
''jogador'': '''Maria'''
Urkalio: She's kind of my boss.
''jogador'': '''bye'''
Urkalio: Have a good fight, ''Player''.
''jogador'': '''hi'''
Urkalio: Welcome to the pits of the Hard Rock Tavern, ''Player''.
Urkalio: We're some hasty one, aren't we? }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.title: Kalvin
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}}
| name        = Kalvin
| job         = Roleplay
| city        = Venore
| subarea     = Venore City
| location    = [[Venore City|Venore City - Dress for Success]] ({{Mapa|32943,32109,5:2|aqui}}).
| implemented = 7.8
| notes       = Ele fala sobre os novos trajes e addons de premium account, -A coleção de verão-. Aprendiz de [[Hugo]]. Seu nome é uma alusão à Calvin Klein, um conhecido estilista americano.
| buysell     = não
| buys        = 
| sells       =
| falas       = 
''Jogador:'' '''hi'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' Be greeted, ''Jogador''! If you need information about outfits, I'm your man.'''</br>
''Jogador:'' '''job'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' I'm an apprentice of Hugo. My current task is to inform everyone about our summer collection.'''</br>
''Jogador:'' '''name'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' My name is Kalvin.'''</br>
''Jogador:'' '''hugo'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' I hope that one day I will have grand visions, too.'''</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Irmana'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' <blushes> Such a beautiful and charming lady.'''</br>
''Jogador:'' '''bye'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' Good bye, ''Jogador''.'''</br>
''Jogador:'' '''outfit'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' Ah, I know all about the newest panoply of patterns! We have quite a few free outfits, several premium outfits, and an ever-growing range of quest outfits.'''</br>
''Jogador:'' '''free outfit'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' Well, we have the traditional knight outfit, the hunter outfit, the mage outfit and the citizen outfit. And, provided you find a partner, there is a newly wed outfit, too.'''</br>
''Jogador:'' '''premium outfit'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' Premium outfits are only available to characters on a premium account. They include the nobleman outfit, the summoner outfit, the warrior outfit, the barbarian outfit, the wizard outfit, the oriental outfit and the druid outfit.'''</br>
''Jogador:'' '''quest outfit'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' Quest outfits require certain tasks to be fulfilled before the outfit becomes accessible. Those quests are only available for premium customers. ...'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' Currently, we have the following outfits: pirate, assassin, afflicted, beggar, deepling, warmaster, wayfarer, insectoid, crystal warlord, norseman ...'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' As well as the elementalist, shaman, soil guardian, jester, demon, demon hunter, yalaharian, cave explorer, nightmare knight, brotherhood of bones, makeshift warrior and battlemage. ...'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' As well as the discoverer, the fire-fighter, the ancient aucar, the decaying defender, the rootwalker, the dreamwarden, the falconer, the festive outfit, the glooth engineer, the percht raider or the poltergeist outfit. ...'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' But also the rascoohan outfit, the revenant, the riftwarrior outfit, the dreamwarrior outfit, the hand of inquisition outfit and the fiend slayer outfit.'''</br>
''Jogador:'' '''addons'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' Addons are usually accessories. Each outfit has two addons which can be worn only together with this outfit. All addons have to be earned through quests.'''</br>
''Jogador:'' '''quest'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' Many addon quests require that a number of ingredients are collected.'''</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Ingredients'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' Most ingredients can be obtained by killing specific monsters. For example, if you are asked for dragon scales, don't go slaying rotworms.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Dragon scales'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' Ah, that is just one example of the many possible ingredients. You can, for example, also create leather by skinning some dead creatures or even turn them into dust.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Leather / skinning'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' Sometimes, minotaurs might carry this leather with them, but if you have an obsidian knife, you can also use it on the fresh corpse. Maybe you will obtain leather.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Obsidian knife'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' An obsidian knife is one of the sharpest knives in Tibia, but too fragile to make a really useful weapon. Maybe the dwarfs know more about it.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''knight'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' If you spend your time fighting monsters and need that little extra protection, this well-armored outfit is great for you. Addons are usually awarded by knight guilds.'''</br>
''Jogador:'' '''citizen'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' Your basic starter outfit - simple, but practical. If you are looking to earn addons for this outfit, you should walk around Thais and look for citizens wearing a hat or a backpack.'''</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Newly wed'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' Pick a wedding partner and time and this outfit can be yours! Snow-white silk and lace for the glowing bride, including a veil and blossom circlet for that most special day. ...</br>
'''Kalvin:''' For the groom, a fine black frock-coat with brazen buttons, and white silk knee socks to lead your lady to the altar in style.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''warrior'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' The lighter version of the knight outfit is great if you want to save stamina and maintain agility. Addons are usually awarded by knight guilds.'''</br>
''Jogador:'' '''barbarian'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' This outfit stands for raw power, battle cries and lack of manners. I heard that there are a few barbarians living near Northport. They might just be able to provide fitting addons.'''</br>
''Jogador:'' '''nobleman'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' One of our finest pieces. If you have the money and wish to show how wealthy and noble you are, this is the outfit for you. We also create addons especially for you, right here.'''</br>
''Jogador:'' '''hunter'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' A light and comfortable ranger outfit which every paladin simply loves to wear. If you are looking to earn addons for this outfit, a good place to start would be the paladin guild in Thais.'''</br>
''Jogador:'' '''mage'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' Great for wise old male mages as well as for pretty enchantresses. If you are looking to earn addons, ladies should take a stroll in Port Hope, whereas elders should explore the Dark Cathedral.'''</br>
''Jogador:'' '''summoner'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' Great for young mages and ladies who love witchcraft. If you are looking to earn addons, gentlemen should take a stroll in Port Hope, whereas ladies should explore the Dark Cathedral.'''</br>
''Jogador:'' '''wizard'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' Are you feeling evil today? This outfit is fitting for mages pursuing the dark side of sorcery. Shunned by the magic academy of Edron, you might find wizards hiding near Thais.'''</br>
''Jogador:'' '''oriental'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' This comfortable, yet fashionable outfit will create the romantic mood of Thousand and One Nights. A good place to look around for addons are Darama and Ankrahmun, of course.'''</br>
''Jogador:'' '''druid'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' Nature-loving and peaceful druids might like this outfit, especially the beastlike addons. I heard there is a druid living near Ab'Dendriel, who might be able to provide fitting addons.'''</br>
''Jogador:'' '''pirate'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' Yo ho ho and a bottle of rum! If you love the pirate way of life and sneer at landlubbers, this might be the right outfit for you. Pirates are said to roam the Shattered Isles...'''</br>
''Jogador:'' '''assassin'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' Mysterious and lethal, assassins are hard to find and almost impossible to befriend. I know of one assassin hiding away on the Daramian Plague Spire. If you are lucky, he won't kill you.'''</br>
''Jogador:'' '''beggar'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' Ah, Hugo is working on designing this look. He might need some inspiration, so if you have some time to spare, don't hesitate to contribute some ideas to him.'''</br>
''Jogador:'' '''norseman'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' This cosy outfit will keep you warm in the deepest winters. The inhabitants of Svargrond use it to travel around their frozen islands.'''</br>
''Jogador:'' '''shaman'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' If you have seen everything and worn every look, this outfit will put the icing on your cake. Maybe you can earn it by becoming the apprentice of a shaman... or voodoo priest.'''</br>
''Jogador:'' '''jester'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' YYou really want to look like a jester?? Well, then you should go visit Bozo. Maybe you are foolish enough to join his newly founded fools guild. As a rule, you will find him at the castle in Thais.'''</br>
''Jogador:'' '''demon hunter'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' I think the members of the inquisition award this outfit to their members when they have reached a certain rank. They hide somewhere under Thais.'''</br>
''Jogador:'' '''yalaharian'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' The people travel to Yalahar and come back with these fancy clothings. One of them told me that the Edron Academy is sending people to this ancient city.'''</br>
''Jogador:'' '''nightmare'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' This noble order vanished a long time ago. They were once located at the Plains of Havoc. Maybe you can find some hints about their remains if you go there. But be careful, it is a very dangerous area!'''</br>
''Jogador:'' '''brotherhood of bones'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' They were the followers of Goshnar, the king of necromancy. They fought the Nightmare Knights without knowing any limits. It might be a foolish thing to look for them but if you are interested, the Plains of Havoc are a good start.'''</br>
''Jogador:'' '''afflicted'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' I heard it is the latest rage for all feverish citizens. Dropped by genuinely afflicted and specially tailored to your every need. Visit the swamp city of Venore if you fancy gaining this outfit.'''</br>
''Jogador:'' '''elementalist'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' With invisible air patterns and arcane sigils, it radiates that the wearer has the powers of the elements at his disposal. I believe you have to face a rogue mage near Edron to earn it'''</br>
''Jogador:'' '''wayfarer'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' The practical garb for a hero against draconic evil in Eastern Zao who must travel far and wide, and wields a swift and just blade. To obtain the Wayfarer Outfit, contact Zalamon in Zao and help him in his endeavours.'''</br>
''Jogador:'' '''warmaster'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' Styled after the exotic armors of the Lizardmen in the lands of faraway Zao. I heard you might get your hands on one if you help the dwarves establishing a mining base there'''</br>
''Jogador:'' '''deepling'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' I have never laid eyes on one of those before. Notice the strage set of scale armor, crafted by long lost creatures of the deep. But beware, it is said that it has a life of its own - treat it carefully.'''</br>
''Jogador:'' '''insectoid'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' Quite a buzz around this one, but you don't need a wasp waist to wear it! Comes with a mandible epaulette addon - Word is they wear this at the grey beach area, where they are fighting the insectoid hive.'''</br>
''Jogador:'' '''crystal warlord'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' A true warrior's attire! A striking armor and cloak, adorned with obsidian and crystals. You might want to visit the gnomes at Kazordoon if you wish to acquire this outfit. The hard part will be to earn their trust though.'''</br>
''Jogador:'' '''soil guardian'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' Sometimes, the reclusive gnomes grant a dedicated helper the privilege to wear a special outfit like this one: the Soil Guardian. The riches of the Earth are shadowed out in the mushroom decor and the berg crystals embroidered. ...'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' You might want to visit the gnomes at Kazordoon if you fancy this outfit. The hard part will be to earn their trust though.'''</br>
''Jogador:'' '''discoverer'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' If you are interested in travelling and discovering the world of Tibia, this might be the perfect outfit for you. ...'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' Whether you are visiting the dry Daramian deserts, the icy mountains of Hrodmir or the deep Tiquandan jungle, you will always be well prepared for every encounter and adventure.'''</br>
''Jogador:'' '''cave explorer'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' The practical attire for all who venture deep into the heart of the earth and a gnome's best friend: the cave explorer outfit! ...'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' Handcrafted and awarded exclusively by the gnomes in the Spike to those who braved the dangers of the place and earned their gratitude.'''</br>
''Jogador:'' '''illuminator'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' Illumination is a fine art. Only masters of this craft receive this outfit. I've heard they're awarded in the Ivory Towers of Edron.'''</br>
''Jogador:'' '''formal dress'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' In this dress you will be every party's eyecatcher. It's really vintage, though. Perhaps you should use a time machine to get one.'''</br>
''Jogador:'' '''ancient aucar'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' Fighting like a proud ancient warrior of a lost culture like that surely requires a fitting attire. ...'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' The only way must be to challenge such a warrior in the flesh, but that sounds impossible to me.'''</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Makeshift'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' Necessity is the mother of invention! For most of us this is just trash, but combined in the right way it will become a more than veritable equipment. Look at the corym! They show us how it works!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Battlemage'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' Battlemages know how to combine arcane knowledge with wielding a sword. They often explore secret and dangerous sites of hidden or forgotten knowledge.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''fire-fighter'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' If you want to become a hero by fighting raging flames you need to be dressed appropriately. ...</br>
'''Kalvin:''' This special outfit is rumored to be achieved by assisting the challenger expedition in Gnomprona - wherever that might be.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''decaying'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' The dark power of rot and decay may have been harvested by mighty beings throughout time and space but only true mastery will grant you the right to wear an outfit like that.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Rootwalker'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' Being one with a botanical being would require the will to live and feel the plant through and through, like a transformation from within.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Dreamwarden'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' As a dream warden, there is nothing you can't vanquish. Dreams, nightmares and illusions can't scare you anymore. Go to Roshamuul, if you desire such an outfit and search for it there.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Falconer'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' Don't let you Hunting Tasks Points go to waste, collect them of them and trade them in for an outfit worthy only for the most elite hunters.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Festive'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' If you want to wear those clothes, you have to meet the legendary First Dragon - and survive. That would be a reason to celebrate for sure.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Glooth engineer'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' The Rathleton Magistrate rewards people dedicated to their city with this outfit. If you can avert a dire threat for the city, it might be yours to wear.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''percht'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' Walking through the cold, icy darkness of winter as a denizen of frost... is this your thing? ...</br>
'''Kalvin:''' Then find and confront the percht during the twilight around the time the year is nearing its end.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Poltergeist'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' With this angst-inducing vestment you are able to wander around Tibia and scare many an unsuspecting wayfarer. But you have to defeat the dreaded Pale Worm first.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''rascoohan'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' There is an island named Rascacoon, and there you might find this outfit. Of course, you have to receive the Rascoohans' permission to wear it. Try to honour them with special gifts.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''revenant'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' If you defeat the manifestation of Goshnar's evil traits by fighting your way through beasts you didn't even want to imagine ... then you might also look the part.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''riftwarrior'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' Go through hell. Seven times. Defeat the demons. Countless times. Put an end to Ferumbras' claims to ascendancy, once and for all. Then you may call yourself a rift warrior and dress appropriately</br>
''Jogador:'' '''dreamwarrior'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' Dream Warriors defend the Dream Courts against unwanted intruders, be it from the real world or from the Nightmare Realms. Only rarely the dream elves grant the right to wear it to outsiders.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''hand of inquisition'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' The Inquisition grants this outfit only to their most trusted agents.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''fiend slayer'''</br>
'''Kalvin:''' There are rumours about an ancient keep were such an outfit might be acquired through heroic deeds.</br>
}}<noinclude>[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]</noinclude>

pages.title: Leeland
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Leeland | job = Comerciante | city = Venore | subarea = Venore City | location = [[Venore City|Venore City - Useful Things Warehouse]] ({{Mapa|32883,32082,5:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 7.1 | notes = Leeland Slim administra a Useful Things Warehouse. | buysell = não | buys = | sells = | falas = ''Jogador'': '''hi / hello / hail'''
Leeland: Greetings, ''Jogador''! Please don't interrupt me for too long! ''Jogador'': '''name'''
Leeland: My name is Slim, Leeland Slim. ''Jogador'': '''job / interrupt'''
Leeland: I am the owner of the Useful Things Warehouse. ''Jogador'': '''warehouse'''
Leeland: I offer many things. Actually I am sure you will find something you have desired for a long time. ''Jogador'': '''tibia'''
Leeland: I have seen most of it. And I like it. ''Jogador'': '''king / Tibianus'''
Leeland: Do I hear envy in your voice? Is it that you realy want? To be ... king? Well, one never knows ... perhaps you find something royal in my warehouse. ''Jogador'': '''Ferumbras'''
Leeland: Ah, Ferumbras. I remember selling him torches for his first adventures as if it was yesterday. ''Jogador'': '''Thais'''
Leeland: Perhaps one day I'll settle in Thais again. I love the city's potential. ''Jogador'': '''Carlin'''
Leeland: I was there some time ago. I exchanged ideas with some important people there and even could sell them something that furthered their cause. ''Jogador'': '''time'''
Leeland: So it is a watch you need? Make sure to buy one downstairs. ''Jogador'': '''news'''
Leeland: I would love to have the time to chat and exchange gossip, but sadly business always comes first, you know? ''Jogador'': '''taxes'''
Leeland: Taxes are a necessary evil, people say. I like that. ''Jogador'': '''privilege'''
Leeland: Privileges have to be paid for. The one way ... or the other. ''Jogador'': '''army'''
Leeland: Your question suggests you are interested in military? I'm sure you'll find something interesting in my warehouse. ''Jogador'': '''gambling'''
Leeland: I just love bets and gambling. It inspires people doing such interesting things. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
Leeland: Good bye, ''Player''. Make sure to visit my shop. }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Livielle | job = Comerciante de Alimentos | city = Venore | subarea = Venore City | location = [[Venore City|Venore City - Crunor's Finest Warehouse]] ({{Mapa|32982,32036,6:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 7.1 | notes = Ela negocia alimentos exóticos. Livielle trabalha na Crunor's Finest Warehouse. Ela é francesa. | buysell = sim | buys = Nada. | sells = {{Trades/Sell | Banana, 5 | Blueberry | Carrot, 3 | Cherry, 1 | Corncob | Grapes | Juice Squeezer | Lemon | Mango, 10 | Melon, 10 | Orange, 10 | Potato | Pumpkin | Sample of Venorean Spice | Strawberry, 2 | White Mushroom, 10}} | falas = ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
Livielle: Bienvenue, ''Player''! My fruits will complete the icing on your cake.
''Jogador'': '''help'''
Livielle: Oh, for sure will my fruits 'elp you driving off all these nasty diseases and strengthen your immune system!
''Jogador'': '''job'''
Livielle: Alors, guess what my job might be, standing 'ere in the middle of all these juicy exotic fruits?
''Jogador'': '''name''' (Perguntado por um personagem feminino)
Livielle: I'm Livielle Delacroix, madame.
''Jogador'': '''time'''
Livielle: Time is 3:34 am now.
''Jogador'': '''buy'''
Livielle: What's your favorite flavour today? I offer all sorts of exotic fruits.
''Jogador'': '''fruits'''
Livielle: I offer you bananas, melons, pumpkins, white mushrooms, oranges, strawberries, and blueberries.
''Jogador'': '''strawberries'''
Livielle: Do you want to buy a strawberry for 2 gold?
''Jogador'': '''no'''
Livielle: You should really prefer my fruits over all this fat meat offered elsewhere. They keep you lithe and lissom.
''Jogador'': '''bye'''
Livielle: Bon appétit, and come back soon for your daily dose of vitamins!
''Jogador'': '''hi'''
Livielle: Bienvenue, ''Player''! My fruits will complete the icing on your cake.
Livielle: Aww, I don't even deserve a farewell? }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]
