pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Maria | job = Comerciante de Alimentos | city = Venore | subarea = Venore City | location = [[Venore City|Venore City - Hard Rock Tavern]] ({{Mapa|32911,32081,9:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 7.1 | notes = Maria administra a Hard Rock Tavern que fica dois andares abaixo do depot central de Venore.

* Os [[Coloured Egg]]s só podem ser comprados durante o evento [[Spring Into Life]].

| buysell = sim | buys = Nada. | sells = {{Trades/Sell | Beer | Bread, 4 | Cheese, 6 | Cookie, 5 | Egg, 2 | Ham, 8 | Lemonade | Meat, 5 | Tomato, 5 | Valentine's Cake, 100 | Water (Líquido) | Wine}} Somente durante um [[Eventos e Festividades#Eventos durante o ano|evento]] {{Trades/Sell | Coloured Egg (Blue) | Coloured Egg (Green) | Coloured Egg (Purple) | Coloured Egg (Red) | Coloured Egg (Yellow)}} | falas = ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
Maria: The Hard Rock Tavern greets you, ''Player''.
''Jogador'': '''job''' ou '''tavern'''
Maria: I am running this upper part of the Hard Rock Tavern.
''Jogador'': '''upper part'''
Maria: Yes, that's here. Below is the Fighting Pits for those fighters that use the Fighting Pits.
''Jogador'': '''Fighting Pits'''
Maria: Well, they do a lot of fighting down there.
''Jogador'': '''name'''
Maria: I am Maria.
''Jogador'': '''king'''
Maria: In Venore, everyone is a king ... until he runs out of luck or money.
''Jogador'': '''Tibia'''
Maria: In the long run it's money that rules everything in Tibia.
''Jogador'': '''buy'''
Maria: Food and drinks as much as you can pay for.
''Jogador'': '''army'''
Maria: Good fighters need good entertainment. That's what they get here.
''Jogador'': '''amazons'''
Maria: I can only hope those wild women don't scare away more customers than come here in order to fight against them.
''Jogador'': '''Ferumbras'''
Maria: I think he's more a Thaian problem.
''Jogador'': '''Excalibug'''
Maria: I'd rather have a stainless steel cooking pan than such a knife.
''Jogador'': '''Carlin'''
Maria: As far as the merchants say it's economically unimportant.
''Jogador'': '''Thais'''
Maria: It's a shame that this lousy city is the heart of the kingdom.
''Jogador'': '''Maria'''
Maria: Yes, I am Maria, Maria Corona.
''Jogador'': '''bye'''
Maria: Good bye, ''Player''. Tell your friends about us and visit us again.
''Jogador'': '''hi'''
Maria: The Hard Rock Tavern greets you, ''Jogador''.
Maria: Visit us again. }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

''jogador'': '''Hi'''</br>

{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Rodney | job = Comerciante de Alimentos | city = Venore | subarea = Venore City | location = [[Venore City|Venore City - Crunor's Finest Warehouse]] ({{Mapa|32970,32041,6:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 7.1 | notes = Rodney trabalha na Crunor's Finest Warehouse. | buysell = sim | buys = Nada. | sells = {{Trades/Sell | Cherry | Grapes | Pear | Plum | Raspberry | Red Apple | Sample of Venorean Spice}} | falas = ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
Rodney: Greetings, ''Player''. Can I help you?
''Jogador'': '''job'''
Rodney: I sell some local fruits.
''Jogador'': '''name'''
Rodney: My name is Rodney.
''Jogador'': '''time'''
Rodney: It is 0:00 pm right now.
''Jogador'': '''King''' / '''Tibianus'''
Rodney: King Tibianus! May the gods bless him!
''Jogador'': '''Tibia'''
Rodney: I have seen only little of it.
''Jogador'': '''buy'''
Rodney: I can offer some of the local fruits.
''Jogador'': '''army'''
Rodney: I am glad that the Thaian garrison is here to protect us.
''Jogador'': '''amazons'''
Rodney: Rumour goes that some amazons, who where banished from Carlin, took refuge near the swamps.
''Jogador'': '''Ferumbras'''
Rodney: Sounds like the name of a foreign soup to me.
''Jogador'': '''Excalibug'''
Rodney: What is that? Is it tasty?

Rodney: Our climate is quite rough, so we can only grow wheat here, but no fruits.
''Jogador'': '''Thais'''
Rodney: The Thaian protectorate serves our beloved [[Venore]] well.
''Jogador'': '''fruits'''
Rodney: I have apples, cherries, grapes, and pears. What would you like?
''Jogador'': '''bye'''
23:43 Rodney: Good bye, ''Player''.

pages.title: Angelina
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Angelina | job = Sacerdote | job2 = Criminoso | job3 = Outfitter | npcclass = Humanos | npcsprite = Citizen | city = Venore | subarea = Dark Cathedral | location = [[Dark Cathedral]] ({{Mapa|32632,32401,10:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 7.6 | notes = Ela vive em uma pequena cela com a porta trancada. Você precisará encontrar a [[Key 5050]] para ter acesso a sua cela. Caso você fique preso na cela, ela pode teleportar você para fora.

* Faz parte da [[Mage Outfits Quest]]. * Faz parte da [[Summoner Outfits Quest]].

| buysell = não | buys = | sells = | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Angelina:''' The gods must be praised that I am finally saved. I do not have many worldly possessions, but please accept a small reward, do you?
''Jogador:'' '''Saved'''
'''Angelina:''' I'm a priestess and I travelled here to learn about that order of the humble path I heard about. ...
'''Angelina:''' But when I started my investigations, this false monk Lorbas thought that I was suspicious and so he ordered his minions to take me as prisoner.
''Jogador:'' '''Humble Path'''
'''Angelina:''' There are no records about the foundation of this order, and it is unknown where its 'monks' come from. Yet, travellers told us that they are living near the remains of the dark cathedral.
''Jogador:'' '''Monk'''
'''Angelina:''' I learnt that these monks are impostors that use false promises to lure unwary ones into the arms of their strange cult which seems to have more political than religious agendas.
''Jogador:'' '''Prisoner'''
'''Angelina:''' I think Lorbas liked the idea to 'convert' me to their twisted cult and saw it as a test for their leaders. Now that the magic symbols are turned off, I will gather my strength within some hours and teleport to safety.
''Jogador:'' '''Cathedral'''
'''Angelina:''' The cathedral was meant to be a centre of piety and believe. A prayer to the gods that had become solid. ...
'''Angelina:''' The construction works started at the height of the order of the Nightmare Knights, right after they had won a major battle near the place where the cathedral was to be built. ...
'''Angelina:''' The cathedral was meant to become a monument of the victory of good over evil. ...
'''Angelina:''' Sadly it was just not meant to be. ...
'''Angelina:''' As the cathedral was nearly finished, most of the monks had already moved in and even a small town for all the workers and suppliers had established itself. ...
'''Angelina:''' But then the structure was struck by an earthquake and the work of two generations was destroyed. ...
'''Angelina:''' Later the dwarven constructors explained that this was caused by volcanic activities and a massive cave-in. ...
'''Angelina:''' Since the gods did not interfere and the setting was close to the notorious Pits of Inferno, it was assumed that this was the work of secret demonic powers.
''Jogador:'' '''Cult'''
'''Angelina:''' The cult is secretly looking for the unsatisfied, disgruntled and poor. Its members promise such sad individuals wealth, revenge and a cause. ...
'''Angelina:''' They lure them into the cells of their cult. Here they learn how to undermine the authorities of their cities. They are trained as thieves, spies and smugglers first. ...
'''Angelina:''' Those who prove themselves as the most promising candidates are recruited to a special hidden circle. There they learn the dark arts of poisoning and murder, or elocution and agitation to become assassins and recruiters for the cult. ...
'''Angelina:''' I know nothing about their agenda but I am quite sure there has to be some higher power behind all of this.
''Jogador:'' '''Teleport/door/help'''
'''Angelina:''' I'm still gathering my strength for a teleport home, but some power already has returned. Do you wish to be teleported out of this cell?
''Jogador:'' '''Gods'''
'''Angelina:''' I'd love to discuss the teachings of the gods with you but this is neither the time nor the place.
''Jogador:'' '''Power'''
'''Angelina:''' I've no idea who is the mastermind behind all this, but it seems too big and too well organised to be the work of only a handful of false monks.
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
'''Angelina:''' I'm a priestess and I travelled here to learn about that order of the humble path I heard about. ...
'''Angelina:''' But when I started my investigations, this false monk Lorbas thought that I was suspicious and so he ordered his minions to take me as prisoner.
''Jogador:'' '''Reward'''
'''Angelina:''' Did you talk to my friend Lynda in Thais already? Greet her from me. She will be glad to hear about my safety.
''Jogador:'' '''Thais'''
'''Angelina:''' Many see Thais as a fallen city but it is only the loudness of an ugly minority that gives people this impression.
''Jogador:'' '''King'''
'''Angelina:''' The king is a wise ruler but his realm is large and we all need to work hard to make the world a better place.
''Jogador:'' '''Elfs''' / '''Ab'Dendriel'''
'''Angelina:''' The elves have lost their balance and identity. In this unstable state they can easily be misled or might draw the wrong conclusions.
''Jogador:'' '''Dwarfs''' / '''Kazordoon'''
'''Angelina:''' The dwarves carry bitterness and pain in their souls. But it is them that have forgotten about the gods and not the other way around.
''Jogador:'' '''Venore'''
'''Angelina:''' Sadly the trade barons care more about wealth than the gods.
''Jogador:'' '''Carlin'''
'''Angelina:''' The druids have their own way to interpret the gods' will and this has to be respected.
''Jogador:'' '''Edron'''
'''Angelina:''' The downfall of some of the most noble knights there should serve us as a warning to stay on guard for the evil that wants to lure us on the wrong path.
''Jogador:'' '''Tibia'''
'''Angelina:''' We all have to help to make this world a better place.
''Jogador:'' '''Ferumbras'''
'''Angelina:''' He is only one of the many servants of the evil. Eventually he will fall but there will be others to take his place.
''Jogador:'' '''Excalibug'''
'''Angelina:''' One day this weapon will be unearthed and then it will be wielded against the servants of the evil.
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
'''Angelina:''' May the gods bless you.
}}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}}
| name        = Lorbas

''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''</br>
Lorbas: Be greeted, dear traveller ''Jogador''. What brings you here?</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Here / Job'''</br>
Lorbas: I am just a humble monk and responsible for maintaining this little outpost that is left over from our grand order.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Grand Order'''</br>
Lorbas: Our order was once the greatest and richest in the whole known world. Kings, traders and knights of various orders were our supporters, and the gods smiled upon us ... or at least that's what we thought until the day of doom.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Day Of Doom'''</br>
Lorbas: On the day of doom, our dream of building the greatest and most opulent cathedral was shattered.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Shattered'''</br>
Lorbas: The cathedral was already high and impressive, and the order had started to move in although there was still much left to be done. Then the great earthquake came.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Cathedral'''</br>
Lorbas: What was once planned as the most impressive cathedral of all times lies now in ruins. ...</br>
Lorbas: All that the earthquake has left over is a heap of rubble. The ruins are cursed and everybody who dares to go there will draw the ire of heaven on himself. ...</br>
Lorbas: All those that travel there are infested with bad luck. But only few have returned from this treacherous ground. Noxious fumes are killing intruders almost unnoticed. ...</br>
Lorbas: Crumbling structures might kill you instantly. ...</br>
Lorbas: Those who survive the dangers of nature will face the soul-eating ghosts of those who have died in the catastrophe. ...</br>
Lorbas: It's not worth to go there, there are no riches or treasures left in the ruins, the gold of our order melted away in funding the cathedral's construction. ...</br>
Lorbas: I urge you to stay away from the cursed ground and the ruins. For the safety of your body and your soul, keep away from there.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Earthquake'''</br>
Lorbas: Some say it was just the unstable ground or volcanic activity, some even claim it was the work of demons, but we know it was the will of the gods to punish our vanity.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Vanity'''</br>
Lorbas: In our vanity we thought that we could impress the gods with our money and show piety by building them a monument. ...</br>
Lorbas: We were wrong, and the gods punished us by sending the worst earthquake that mankind has seen. ...</br>
Lorbas: Its ground motions could still be felt in Thais, and as the dust settled, only little remained of that what we had built. ...</br>
Lorbas: Most members of our order were dead, others turned mad or lost faith. We are all that is left from our glorious order.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Gods'''</br>
Lorbas: I am not worthy to speak about the gods.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Monk'''</br>
Lorbas: We monks of the humble path feel that we are not worthy to spread the word of the gods. We live in humility and poverty to serve the gods. Most of us have vowed an oath of silence, and I humbly took the burden to become the spokesperson.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Dark Monk/assassin'''</br>
Lorbas: I know nothing about that topic. If you would excuse me, I have things to attend to. ''(deixa de conversa)''</br>

''Jogador:'' '''King'''</br>
Lorbas: The king is a worldly ruler, and we don't burden ourselves with worldly concerns anymore.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Ferumbras'''</br>
Lorbas: He will discover where his path will lead him to. But no matter how ruthless he is, even he stays away from the ruins of the cathedral.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Excalibug'''</br>
Lorbas: It is rumoured to be hidden somewhere beneath Edron.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Time'''</br>
Lorbas: I own no watch and only a small number of other worldly possessions.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Venore'''</br>
Lorbas: The gracious tradesmen from Venore send us provisions from time to time.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Thais'''</br>
Lorbas: Thais is far and we have little contact with the kingdom's capital.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Edron'''</br>
Lorbas: I hope the knightly order there fares better than our own.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Carlin'''</br>
Lorbas: We have no relations with that town.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Ab'dendriel''' / '''Elves''' / '''Elfs'''</br>
Lorbas: They will have to learn on their own.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Kazordoon / Dwarves / Dwarfs'''</br>
Lorbas: The dwarves are far from being humble. At least this ancient folk knows that there is nothing to gain in the cathedral's ruins and their treasure hunters stay away from there.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Darama'''</br>
Lorbas: Another continent that has to be seen as a present of the gods to us.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Darashia'''</br>
Lorbas: I will not judge those people.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Ankrahmun'''</br>
Lorbas: I am not the right person to discuss this subject.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Tibia'''</br>
Lorbas: The world is in the hand of the gods.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Bye / Farewell'''</br>
Lorbas: Accept my sincere good wishes, ''Jogador''.

}}<noinclude>[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]</noinclude>

''Jogador'': '''Hi'''</br>
'''Snake Eye:''' Hi ''Jogador''. Come in and have a drink.</br>
''Jogador'': '''God'''</br>
'''Snake Eye:''' The Gods of Tibia! What a crap! It's all superstition!</br>
''Jogador'': '''Job'''</br>
'''Snake Eye:''' Well, I'm the boss of this tavern.</br>
''Jogador'': '''Tavern'''</br>
'''Snake Eye:''' It's a great tavern. No closing time. No problems with kings or other rulers. Best place in Tibia.</br>
''Jogador'': '''Name'''</br>
'''Snake Eye:''' I'm Snake Eye.</br>
''Jogador'': '''Tibia'''</br>
'''Snake Eye:''' There's already too much order in Tibia. We don't need kings or whatever.</br>
''Jogador'': '''Time'''</br>
'''Snake Eye:''' Go and get a watch.</br>
''Jogador'': '''Camp'''</br>
'''Snake Eye:''' Well, the real wild warriors don't live here. They hide in the woods.</br>
''Jogador'': '''Woods'''</br>
'''Snake Eye:''' It's the best place to live. By the way, there's an old wild warrior building to the southwest. It might be interesting for you.</br>
''Jogador'': '''Wild Warrior'''</br>
'''Snake Eye:''' There are a lot of wild warriors around. They built this camp.</br>
''Jogador'': '''Ab'dendriel'''</br>
'''Snake Eye:''' I've never been there. I don't like the elves anyway.</br>
''Jogador'': '''Carlin'''</br>
'''Snake Eye:''' I've never been there. Don't know anything about it.</br>
''Jogador'': '''Edron'''</br>
'''Snake Eye:''' That's a place for wealthy toffs!</br>
''Jogador'': '''Kazordoon'''</br>
'''Snake Eye:''' Kazordoon is alright. Except the dwarfs. I don't like them. But the mountains are a good place. Been there once.</br>
''Jogador'': '''Thais'''</br>
'''Snake Eye:''' In the beginning, it was a nice encampment. Now it's an overcrowded, polluted city. I hate it!</br>
''Jogador'': '''Snake Eye'''</br>
'''Snake Eye:''' Well, I had a dispute with a snake once. And the snake won. Bit my left eye out. Therefore, Snake Eye.</br>
''Jogador'': '''Cip'''</br>
'''Snake Eye:''' Cip sux!</br>
''Jogador'': '''H.l.'''</br>
'''Snake Eye:''' He is a wild warrior. Nobody knows his real name. We just call im H.L. You can find him in the small armory shop.</br>
''Jogador'': '''Water'''</br>
'''Snake Eye:''' Water is for free. Do you want some?</br>
''Jogador'': '''Yes'''</br>
'''Snake Eye:''' Here.</br>
''Jogador'': '''Bye'''</br>
'''Snake Eye:''' Bye.

{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Simon The Beggar | job = Criminoso | job2 = Mendigo | city = Thais | subarea = Fibula | location = [[Fibula]] ({{mapa|32186,32470,7:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 5.0 | buysell = sim | buys = Nada. | sells = {{Trades/Sell | Shovel,50 | Key 3940}} | notes = A chave não aparece na janela de trade do NPC, é necessário dialogar com ele para obtê-la.

| falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == '''Simon The Beggar''': Alms! Alms for the poor!
'''Simon The Beggar''': I need help! Please help me!
'''Simon The Beggar''': Sir, Ma'am, have a gold coin to spare? == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Simon The Beggar''': Hello ''Jogador''. I am a poor man. Please help me. ''Jogador'': '''job'''
'''Simon The Beggar''': I have no job. I am a beggar. ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Simon The Beggar''': My name is Simon. I am a very poor man. ''Jogador'': '''beggar'''
'''Simon The Beggar''': I have no gold and no job, so I am a beggar. ''Jogador'': '''simon'''
'''Simon The Beggar''': I am Simon. The poorest human all over the continent. ''Jogador'': '''dermot'''
'''Simon The Beggar''': The magistrate of the village. I heard he is selling something for the Fibula Dungeon. ''Jogador'': '''timur'''
'''Simon The Beggar''': I hate Timur. He is too expensive. But sometimes I find maces and hatchets. Timur is buying these items. ''Jogador'': '''fibula'''
'''Simon The Beggar''': I hate Fibula. Too many wolves are here. ''Jogador'': '''tibia'''
'''Simon The Beggar''': Hehe, do you have a shovel? I can sell you a shovel if you want to return to Tibia. ''Jogador'': '''village'''
'''Simon The Beggar''': To the north is the village Fibula. A very small village. ''Jogador'': '''dungeon'''
'''Simon The Beggar''': I heard a lot about the Fibula Dungeon. But I never was there. ''Jogador'': '''shovel'''
'''Simon The Beggar''': Do you want to buy a shovel for 50 gold? ''Jogador'': '''help'''
'''Simon The Beggar''': I need gold. Can you spend me 100 gold pieces? ''Jogador'': '''no'''
'''Simon The Beggar''': Hmm, maybe next time. ''Jogador'': '''gold'''

'''Simon The Beggar''': There is a large sea-monster outside. I think there is no gritty captain to sail in this quarter. ''Jogador'': '''monster'''

'''Simon The Beggar''': I know that terrible monster. It killed the fishers on the isle on north. ''Jogador'': '''minotaurs'''
'''Simon The Beggar''': Very rich monsters. But they are too strong for me. However, there are even stronger monsters. ''Jogador'': '''wolf'''
'''Simon The Beggar''': Please kill them ... ALL. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Simon The Beggar''': Have a nice day. }}

pages.title: Aneus
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Aneus | job = Roleplay | npcclass = Humanos | npcsprite = Hunter | city = Carlin | subarea = Fields of Glory | location = [[Fields of Glory]] ({{Mapa|32429,31669,7:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 6.2 | notes = Ele é um historiador que conta sobre Carlin e a [[Carlin#Red Legion|Legião Vermelha]]. | buysell = não | buys = | sells = | falas = (nota: palavras sublinhadas são erros de ortografia e pode ser corrigida pela Cipsoft) ''Jogador'': '''Hi'''
Aneus: Greetings adventurer ''Jogador''. What leads you to me? ''Jogador'': '''Story'''
Aneus: Ok, sit down and listen. Back in the early days, one of the ancestors ... ''Jogador'': '''m'''
Aneus: ... of our king Tibianus III wanted to build the best city in whole of Tibia. ''Jogador'': '''City'''
Aneus: The works on this new city began and the king sent his best ... ''Jogador'': '''m'''
Aneus: ... Soldiers to protect the workers from orcs and to make them WORK HARDER. ''Jogador'': '''Soldiers'''
Aneus: It was the elite of the whole army. They were called the Red Legion (also known as the bloody legion). ''Jogador'': '''Orcs'''
Aneus: The orcs attacked the workers from time to time and so they disturbed the works on the city. ''Jogador'': '''Works'''
Aneus: The development of the city was fine. Also a giant castle was build ... ''Jogador'': '''m'''
Aneus: ... northeast of the city. But more and more workers started to rebel because of the bad conditions. ''Jogador'': '''Rebel'''
Aneus: All rebels were brought to the giant castle. Guarded by the Red Legion, ... ''Jogador'': '''m'''
Aneus: ... they had to work and live in even worser conditions. Also some friends of the king's sister were brought there. ''Jogador'': '''Friends'''
Aneus: The king's sister was pretty upset about the situation there but her brother ... ''Jogador'': '''m'''
Aneus: ... didn't want to do anything about this matter. So she made a PLAN to destroy the Red Legion for their cruelty forever. ''Jogador'': '''Cruelty'''
Aneus: The soldiers treated the workers like slaves. ''Jogador'': '''Plan'''
Aneus: She ordered her loyal druids and hunters to disguise themselves ... ''Jogador'': '''m'''
Aneus: ... as orcs from the near ISLAND and to ATTACK the Red Legion by night over and over again. ''Jogador'': '''Island'''
Aneus: The General of the Red Legion became very angry about these attacks and after some months he STROKE back! ''Jogador'': '''Stroke'''
Aneus: Most of the Red Legion went to the island by night. The orcs ... ''Jogador'': '''m'''
Aneus: ... were not prepared and the Red Legion killed hundreds of orcs ... ''Jogador'': '''m'''
Aneus: ... with nearly no loss. After they were satisfied they WALKED BACK to the castle. ''Jogador'': '''Walked back'''
Aneus: It is said that the orcish shamans cursed the Red Legion. ''Jogador'': '''m'''
Aneus: Nobody knows. But one third of the soldiers died by a disease on the way back. ''Jogador'': '''m'''
Aneus: And the orcs wanted to take revenge, and after some days they stroke back! ''Jogador'': '''m'''
Aneus: The orcs and many allied cyclopses and minotaurs from all ... ''Jogador'': '''m'''
Aneus: ... over Tibia came to avenge their friends, and they killed nearly all ... ''Jogador'': '''m'''
Aneus: ... workers and soldiers in the castle. The HELP of the king's sister came too late. ''Jogador'': '''Help'''
Aneus: She tried to rescue the workers but it was too late. The orcs ... ''Jogador'': '''m'''
Aneus: ... started immediately to attack her troops, too. Her royal troops ... ''Jogador'': '''m'''
Aneus: ... went back to the city. A trick saved the city from destruction. ''Jogador'': '''Destruction'''
Aneus: They used the same trick as against the Red Legion and the orcs ... ''Jogador'': '''m'''
Aneus: ... started to fight their non-orcish-allies. After a bloody long fight ... ''Jogador'': '''m'''
Aneus: ... the orcs went back to their cities. The city of Carlin was rescued. ''Jogador'': '''m'''
Aneus: Since then, a woman has always been ruling over Carlin and this statue ... ''Jogador'': '''m'''
Aneus: ... was made to remind us of their great tactics against the orcs ... ''Jogador'': '''m'''
Aneus: ... and the Red Legion. So that was the story of Carlin and these Fields of Glory. I hope you liked it. *He smiles* ''Jogador'': '''Bye'''
Aneus: Good bye and take care of you! }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.title: Costello
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Costello | job = Monge | npcclass = Humanos | npcsprite = Monk | city = Carlin | subarea = Isle of the Kings | location = [[Isle of the Kings]] ({{mapa|32177,31936,7:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 7.2 | notes = Ele é o abade do White Raven Monastery construído na ilha. Se você for à área restrita, será considerado um criminoso e deverá pagar fiança ([[gold]]) para sair da ilha. Diga "crime" e a quantia será cobrada (dependendo do seu level).

* Faz parte da [[The White Raven Monastery Quest]]. * Fale sobre "Brother Fugio" e ele permitirá que você desça às criptas.

| buysell = não | buys = | sells = | falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == Não possui. == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Costello''': Welcome, ''Jogador''! Feel free to tell me what brings you here. ''Jogador'': '''job'''
'''Costello''': I’m the abbot of the White Raven Monastery on the Isle of the Kings. ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Costello''': My name is Costello. ''Jogador'': '''isle'''
'''Costello''': We founded our monastery to guard the royal tombs and to gather wisdom and knowledge. ''Jogador'': '''wisdom'''
'''Costello''': You may enter the library upstairs. Don’t go any further upstairs, though, as this area is reserved for members of our order. ''Jogador'': '''tibia'''
'''Costello''': That’s the name of our world and its major continent. ''Jogador'': '''god'''
'''Costello''': They created Tibia and all life on it. ''Jogador'': '''life'''
'''Costello''': There are many different life forms in our world: plants, citizens, and monsters. ''Jogador'': '''plant'''
'''Costello''': Just walk around, you’ll see grass, trees, bushes and beautiful flowers. ''Jogador'': '''white raven'''
'''Costello''': The legend tells us of a white raven which led the ship of the first monk of our order here. He discovered this isle and the caves beneath it. ''Jogador'': '''order'''
'''Costello''': We founded our monastery to guard the royal tombs and to gather wisdom and knowledge. ''Jogador'': '''caves'''
'''Costello''': Anselm, the first monk of our order, discovered them while looking for a suitable burial place for his king. ''Jogador'': '''anselm'''
'''Costello''': He was a humble and pious man, and he was chosen by the royal family of Thais to find a resting place for their dead. ''Jogador'': '''king'''
'''Costello''': The deceased leaders of the Thaian empire rest beneath this monastery in tombs and crypts. ''Jogador'': '''knowledge'''
'''Costello''': You may enter the library upstairs. Don’t go any further upstairs, though, as this area is reserved for members of our order. ''Jogador'': '''passage'''
'''Costello''': I was informed you have won the trust of the fisher Windtrouser so your passage should be granted. ''Jogador'': '''ferumbras'''
'''Costello''': Don’t mention this servant of evil here. ''Jogador'': '''excalibug'''
'''Costello''': Sadly we have only little knowledge about this topic. ''Jogador'': '''news'''
'''Costello''': Sorry, we rarely hear anything new here. ''Jogador'': '''monster'''
'''Costello''': There are really too many of them in Tibia. But who are we to question the wisdom of the gods? ''Jogador'': '''diary'''
'''Costello''': Thank you again for handing me that diary. ''Jogador'': '''heal'''
'''Costello''': You aren’t looking that bad. Sorry, I can’t help you ''Jogador'': '''holy water'''
'''Costello''': The holy water from our monastery is very special but no one knows why. Once their was a man who burnt himself by touching it. Later it turned out that he had killed several people. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Costello''': Good bye, ''Jogador''! }}

pages.title: Adrenius
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Adrenius | job = Sacerdote | npcclass = Humanos | npcsprite = Necromancer | city = Venore | subarea = Jakundaf Desert | location = [[Jakundaf Desert]] ({{mapa|32660,32112,8:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 6.1 | buysell = não | notes = Adrenius é um sacerdote de [[Fafnar]]. Escreveu o livro "[[Dangers of Adventures Critique Adrenius (Book)|Review of Netlios Opus]]" por estar muito irritado com os livros de [[Netlios]]. Antes da Desert Dungeon Quest ser completamente revelada, este NPC foi uma parte importante do quebra-cabeça.
{{clear}}

* Faz parte da [[Desert Dungeon Quest]].

| buys = | sells = | falas = {{TOC left}} {{clear}} === Palavras-Chave Gerais === ''Jogador'': '''Hi'''
[[Adrenius]]: Hello, ''Jogador''! What can I do for you?
''Jogador'': '''Name'''
[[Adrenius]]: My name is Adrenius.
''Jogador'': '''Job'''
[[Adrenius]]: I'm a priest of Fafnar.
''Jogador'': '''Excalibug'''
[[Adrenius]]: What's that? You start annoying me.
''Jogador'': '''No'''
[[Adrenius]]: Oh. So once again I am proved right.
''Jogador'': '''Fight'''
[[Adrenius]]: Leave me alone. I don't want to fight.
''Jogador'': '''King'''
[[Adrenius]]: Who needs a king? I don't.
''Jogador'': '''Priestess'''
[[Adrenius]]: I live a solitary life here to meditate and contemplate..
''Jogador'': '''Secret'''
[[Adrenius]]: Secrets ... What do you mean?
''Jogador'': '''Sword'''
[[Adrenius]]: Swords? Don't you have something else to do?
''Jogador'': '''Treasure'''
[[Adrenius]]: Treasures? What is a treasure for you?
''Jogador'': '''Weapon'''
[[Adrenius]]: Who needs weapons? I never had and i never will have weapons - what for?
=== Biblioteca === ''Jogador'': '''Library'''
[[Adrenius]]: I heard of the library, but I never was very interested in it.
''Jogador'': '''Book'''
[[Adrenius]]: Read books, it increases your intelligence and, furthermore, it's a great source of inspiration!
=== Cidades === ''Jogador'': '''Ankrahmu'''
[[Adrenius]]: Fafnar may burn this city of evil. Its heretical inhabitants and their blasphemous leader are an insult to the gods. Beware! The day of reckoning is at hand!
''Jogador'': '''Carlin'''
[[Adrenius]]: Carlin? Don't you mean Thais?
''Jogador'': '''Darashia'''
[[Adrenius]]: Even after the death of this swindler Daraman, the descendants of his followers cling to his ignorant teachings.
''Jogador'': '''Daraman'''
[[Adrenius]]: The Daramian deserts are much more impressive than this one. Sadly the continent is run over by heretics of all sorts ...
[[Adrenius]]: Darashia is inhabited by the misguided followers of the so-called prophet Daraman, and Ankrahmun is a melting pot of mad and undeath worshippers.
''Jogador'': '''Desert'''
[[Adrenius]]: Sand, sand and again sand. Sand all over. Yes, I'd say: it's truly a desert!
''Jogador'': '''Tower'''
[[Adrenius]]: The tower was built and inhabited by the great sage Jakundaf himself. It's a shame that it can be rented nowadays. People have no respect for the past!
''Jogador'': '''Thais'''
[[Adrenius]]: Yyyyess. Yes, it's the capital city of Tibia I think.
=== Deuses === ''Jogador'': '''God'''
[[Adrenius]]: Fafnar is the greatest among the gods.
''Jogador'': '''Fafnar'''
[[Adrenius]]: Fafnar is the stronger one of the two suns above our world.
''Jogador'': '''Suon'''
[[Adrenius]]: Suon is the misguided sibling of the great Fafnar. Suon's light turns pale compared to the brightness of Fafnar.
=== Filosofia === ''Jogador'': '''Door'''
[[Adrenius]]: Who needs doors? Free your mind!
''Jogador'': '''Time'''
[[Adrenius]]: Time? What is time? A word? A thing? An object?
''Jogador'': '''Offer'''
[[Adrenius]]: I can offer you religion and mysticism.
== Desert Dungeon Quest == Ele testará seu conhecimento sobre os livros que escreveu por 500 gps. Se você falar "yes" e não tiver 500 gps com você, ele jogará fogo em você, tirando 10 hp/turno em um total de 450.
Se você passar no teste você vai ganhar a [[Key 4023|chave 4023]].
''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
[[Adrenius]]: Hello, ''Jogador''! What can I do for you?
''Jogador:'' '''Netlios'''
[[Adrenius]]: That fool! His book is nothing but a hoax! At least I believe that. Or did you find an answer to my questions?
''Jogador'': '''Qualquer palavra'''
[[Adrenius]]: You can't even say 'yes' or 'no'. You are not worth talking to me!
''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''
[[Adrenius]]: By the way, I'd like a donation for my temple. Are 500 gold pieces ok?
''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''
[[Adrenius]]: Thank you very much. Now, name me the first person in alphabetical order, his age, his fate, and how long he was on his journeys!
''Jogador:'' '''Anaso, 41, attacked by mother-bear, 117 days'''
[[Adrenius]]: Hmmm, maybe. What can you tell me about the second 'adventurer'?
''Jogador:'' '''Elaeus, 39, attacked by dragon, 100 days'''
[[Adrenius]]: Yes, that might be true. What did you find out about the third man?
''Jogador:'' '''Gadinius, 42, stepped in fire, 83 days'''
[[Adrenius]]: Correct again! Hmmmm... I doubt you know anything about the fourth person!
''Jogador:'' '''Heso, 40, attacked by troll, 66 days'''
[[Adrenius]]: Yes! Really, how did you figure that out? I bet you don't know anything about the last adventurer!
''Jogador:'' '''Hestus, 38, drank poison, 134 days'''
[[Adrenius]]: That's right! Why didn't I see it? It's obvious, Netlios was right, and his stories are great! Wait, I'll give you something! ''Jogador'': '''Bye'''
[[Adrenius]]: Good bye. }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.title: Hagor
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Hagor | job = Aventureiro | city = Venore | subarea = Jakundaf Desert | location = [[Jakundaf Desert]] ({{mapa|32655,32152,10:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 6.1 | notes = Hagor é um explorador e viajante. Quer explorar todo o Tibia e descobrir seus segredos. Chama-se de "velho caçador". Hagor sabe muito sobre o deserto, e menciona seu nome - o deserto de Jakundaf.

Hagor dá a [[Key 4022]] se você der um [[roll]] para ele. ''Transcrições'' ''Jogador:'' hi
'''Hagor:''' Greetings, adventurer ''Jogador''. What leads you to me?
''Jogador:'' '''Morrin'''
'''Hagor:''' Ah, I remember that man. We made a deal, guess about what.
''Jogador:'' '''Key'''
'''Hagor:''' Right! We can make the same deal if you give a fresh delicious roll. Do you have any?
''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''
'''Hagor:''' Oh, fine! Here you are.

 | buysell = não | buys = | sells = | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''hi'''
'''Hagor:''' Greetings, adventurer ''Jogador''. What leads you to me?
''Jogador:'' '''door'''
'''Hagor:''' Which door are you talking about? If it is locked, maybe you should try to find a key for it!
''Jogador:'' '''book'''
'''Hagor:''' Yes, I really can recommend reading books. It might help you find what you are looking for!
''Jogador:'' '''job'''
'''Hagor:''' I travel through the lands of Tibia and now Jakundaf Desert since years.
''Jogador:'' '''king'''
'''Hagor:''' Tibianus is our king. To be honest, I didn't hear much of him till now.
''Jogador:'' '''library'''
'''Hagor:''' There is a library in here, right. I assume you are talking about this library. It's locked, as far as I know. But somewhere there has to be a key... maybe the librarian knows more?
''Jogador:'' '''name'''
'''Hagor:''' My name is Hagor, the old hunter.
''Jogador:'' '''offer'''
'''Hagor:''' Go ahead. I don't sell or buy anything!
''Jogador:'' '''secret'''
'''Hagor:''' There are many secrets. But I fear, I can't tell you much about them. They are also secret to me...
''Jogador:'' '''Tibia'''
'''Hagor:''' The gods made this world full of fascinating secrets and I will search them till my end.
''Jogador:'' '''weapon'''
'''Hagor:''' Weapons? Do you have some? You better know how to use them!
''Jogador:'' '''sword'''
'''Hagor:''' Do you mean any sword in particular? Or just any sword?
''Jogador:'' '''treasure'''
'''Hagor:''' Someone told me - I can't remember who it was - that there was a treasure hidden nearby.
''Jogador:'' '''Excalibug'''
'''Hagor:''' I heared rumours that there is a sword called so. I don't know if it exists.
''Jogador:'' '''Carlin'''
'''Hagor:''' Is this the city to the north? I heard rumours about it.
''Jogador:'' '''Desert'''
'''Hagor:''' Yes, it's big, isn't it?
''Jogador:'' '''Morrin'''
'''Hagor:''' Ah, I remember that man. We made a deal, guess about what.
''Jogador:'' '''time'''
'''Hagor:''' Time has no meaning to me.
''Jogador:'' '''god'''
'''Hagor:''' There are a lot of gods we believe in. Maybe you should check out different books to find out something about them.
''Jogador:'' '''help'''
'''Hagor:''' I'd really like to help you. Could you specify your request?
''Jogador:'' '''roll'''
'''Hagor:''' Oh, yes, I love them!
''Jogador:'' '''bye'''
'''Hagor:''' Good bye. }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.title: Nemal
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Nemal | job = Roleplay | city = Venore | subarea = Jakundaf Desert | location = [[Jakundaf Desert]] ({{mapa|32617,32108,10:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 6.1 | buysell = não | buys = | sells = | notes = Nemal é cego. Por isso não pode ler ou escrever. Seu pai sabia Gharonk, uma língua muito estranha.

Nemal te dá a [[Key 4037]] como recompensa por ajudar ele trazendo itens para uma poção encontrada em um livro da [[Biblioteca da Desert Dungeon]]. * 01 [[Roll]] * 01 [[Flour]] * 01 [[Lump of Dough]] * 01 [[Red Rose]] * 01 [[Cherry]] ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Nemal:''' Hello. How are you? Maybe you can help me: Do my shoes have the same colour?
''Jogador:'' '''Potion of Regained Vision'''
'''Nemal:''' I heard of a potion of regained vision ... but I can't remember how to make it! Maybe you can help me. Do you know something about it?
''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''
'''Nemal:''' So, did you bring the ingredients with you, stranger?
''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''
'''Nemal:''' You seem to have them with you. Can you tell me, how many minutes I have to cook them?
''Jogador:'' '''31'''
'''Nemal:''' Ah. It seems to work. But what are the words I have to speak?
''Jogador:'' '''Nalus Murtu'''
'''Nemal:''' Thank you! NALUS MURTUUU! ... I can see again! To show you, how grateful I am, I'll give you a key. Be wise when using it. I can't tell you, where it matches, but ... take good care, it is useless without mental powers!

 | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Nemal:''' Hello. How are you? Maybe you can help me: Do my shoes have the same colour?
''Jogador:'' '''Book'''
'''Nemal:''' I can't read. I've never learned it.
''Jogador:'' '''Blind'''
'''Nemal:''' Yes, I seem to be blind. But I am not sure - maybe the dungeons are too dark!
''Jogador:'' '''Door'''
'''Nemal:''' Closed doors need keys. What a pity keys are not lying around like rubbish!
''Jogador:'' '''God'''
'''Nemal:''' I don't believe in gods, but a lot of people do. I never saw a god, why should I trust in someone I never met?
''Jogador:'' '''Gharonk'''
'''Nemal:''' My father knew this language.
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
'''Nemal:''' I have no job. I'm a wanderer.
''Jogador:'' '''King'''
'''Nemal:''' King...king...yes, there is one. I still can remember the time when we had an other king. What was his name again?
''Jogador:'' '''Library'''
'''Nemal:''' I can't read or write. What use would I have of a library?
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''
'''Nemal:''' My name is Nemal.
''Jogador:'' '''Offer'''
'''Nemal:''' I don't sell things. If you really need somthing, better walk straight to one of the towns or ask another adventurer.
''Jogador:'' '''Secret'''
'''Nemal:''' Secrets should remain secret. No need of making them public.
''Jogador:'' '''Time'''
'''Nemal:''' I had a watch. It was nice, but I can't see the hands anymore.
''Jogador:'' '''Weapon'''
'''Nemal:''' I always have weapons with me. You never know what's behind the next corner.
''Jogador:'' '''Sword'''
'''Nemal:''' I have a sword. It's very sharp. But I don't give it away, you never know.
''Jogador:'' '''Dungeons''' / '''Treasure'''
'''Nemal:''' You can find some treasures here - some are bigger, some are smaller, some are of true value, some are of materialistic value.
''Jogador:'' '''Excalibug'''
'''Nemal:''' I heard the name, but I don't trust rumours.
''Jogador:'' '''Carlin'''
'''Nemal:''' Aaaahh, Carlin, yes. I know this town. Strange graveyard there, isn't it?
''Jogador:'' '''Desert'''
'''Nemal:''' Desert? Where is one?
''Jogador:'' '''Thais'''
'''Nemal:''' Yes, I used to live there a while ago. Nice town.
''Jogador:'' '''Qualquer Palavra Que O Npc Não Reconheça.'''
'''Nemal:''' Oh no, not again.
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
'''Nemal:''' Farewell!
}}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.title: Boveas
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Boveas | job = Pesquisador | npcclass = Humanóides | npcsprite = Minotaur | city = Thais | subarea = Mintwallin | location = [[Mintwallin]] ({{Mapa|32431,32091,15:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.5 | notes =

* Faz parte da [[Shadows of Yalahar Quest]].

 | buysell = não | buys = | sells = | falas = ''Jogador'': '''Hi'''
[[Boveas]]: Hi! I hope you're not going to kill me!
''Jogador'': '''hope''' ou '''job'''
[[Boveas]]: I studied the art of magic for many years, but it's a bit abstract for a man with my hands on attitude to life. ...
[[Boveas]]: So I decided to find some kind of niche for my studies. It was then I came upon the idea of studying the magic of other races. ...
[[Boveas]]: Unfortunately, that proved to be far too much for one person. After careful consideration I decided to concentrate my efforts on the secrets of minotaur magic. ...
[[Boveas]]: It didn't take me long to become fascinated with the whole race and I wanted to learn more about them. ...
[[Boveas]]: I have invested a considerable amount of resources in setting up this ruse to infiltrate this city. ...
[[Boveas]]: During my time here I have not only learned a lot about the magic of the minotaurs, but I have also found out some intriguing facts about their culture. And there is still so much for me to discover! Thrilling.
''Jogador'': '''minotaur '''
[[Boveas]]: Minotaurs are absolutely fascinating! Their culture, their philosophy, their everyday life. All of it is full of surprises and there is so much to learn. ...
[[Boveas]]: Whenever I think I have learned all there is to be learnt they surprise me with something new, inspiring me to extend my field work to gain even deeper insights into their fascinating culture. ...
[[Boveas]]: I think I will have to continue my work here for years to come. My only regret is that lunch is limited to grass. What I wouldn't give for some good old Edron ham! .
''Jogador'': '''infiltrate ''' ou '''disguise '''
[[Boveas]]: Believe me, it wasn't easy to create this disguise. I employed the finest leather workers of Tibia to sew it together while I was studying the behaviour of cows on some of the farms. ...
[[Boveas]]: Admittedly the research was a waste of time as minotaurs have very little in common with cows. And the cow suit does get a peculiar smell after a while. However, you live and learn, don't you?
''Jogador'': '''city '''
[[Boveas]]: Sadly, Mintwalin is only a shadow of what it could have been. The minotaurs were hiding from numerous foes when they built this city. They had to use what was at their disposal. ...
[[Boveas]]: Given that, the city is something they can be proud of. They had so few resources and they were forced to adapt much of their magic. Their magic specialised in war spells and they had to refocus onto a kind of supply magic to make everyday life work ...
[[Boveas]]: The first time I came here I actually wondered whether the minotaurs might actually be more civilized then we are. The more time I spend here, the more this seems to me to be the case. ...
[[Boveas]]: The minotaurean civilisation rivals our own and it is tragic that we are bitter enemies.
''Jogador'': '''culture '''
[[Boveas]]: There are some similarities between the minotaurean culture and our own but there are also huge differences. ...
[[Boveas]]: The most important difference is perhaps that much of their culture evolved to help them deal with their rage, their inner beast. But there are other differences of course, some subtle, some prominent. ...
[[Boveas]]: But I am not going to spill the beans! As soon as my field work has been completed I am going to write a book! ...
[[Boveas]]: If you are truly interested in minotaurean lore and secrets you should really look forward to that book. ...
[[Boveas]]: I have not decided on a title yet but I just know it will be a best seller - so you are bound to hear about it on the Tibian grapevine! Once it is released, of course.
''Jogador'': '''work '''
[[Boveas]]: I'm a scientist. But unlike my bookish colleagues I prefer to be out in the field, living the research, not just reading it. That's why I came here, to learn first hand about the minotaurs, their civilisation, their society.
''Jogador'': '''name '''
[[Boveas]]: Oh, I'm sorry. I forgot to introduce myself. Tends to happen when I'm scared that some bloodthirsty adventurer is going to kill me on account of my cunning disguise. My name is Boveas.
''Jogador'': '''Markwin '''
[[Boveas]]: The King of the minotaurs is actually not all that different from other sovereigns. At least, he seems to be confronted with similar challenges and issues just like any leader of a nation.
''Jogador'': '''bye '''
[[Boveas]]: Good bye, . }} [[Categoria:NPCs Minotauro]] [[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.title: Markwin
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Markwin | job = Rei | city = Thais | subarea = Mintwallin | location = [[Mintwallin]] ({{Mapa|32417,32149,15:1|aqui}}). | implemented = Pré-6.0 | notes = Markwin é o rei dos minotauros em Mintwallin. '''Cuidado''' na primeira vez que você for falar '''Hi''' para ele, pois ele irá sumonar 02 [[Minotaur Guard]]s, 02 [[Minotaur Mage]]s e 04 [[Minotaur Archer]]s. Você pode falar com ele fora de sua sala, assim você pode evitar as criaturas quando ocorrer o spawn.

* Faz parte da [[The Postman Missions Quest]]. * Faz parte da [[What a Foolish Quest]].

| buysell = não | falas = ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
[[Markwin]]: Oh its you again. What do you want, hornless messenger?
''Jogador'': '''job'''
[[Markwin]]: I am the king of all minotaurs. I have been the king for more than 320 years.
''Jogador'': '''king'''
[[Markwin]]: I am the real king!
''Jogador'': '''Mintwallin'''
[[Markwin]]: The former glorious city lies in the dirt. It is my home. I founded it about 180 years ago, when we found this lovely place.
''Jogador'': '''place'''
[[Markwin]]: Na! You will have to find it yourself!
''Jogador'': '''prisoner'''
[[Markwin]]: He is totally mad. I don't know how he could find the way through the labyrinth. I arrested him in the prison.
''Jogador'': '''human'''
[[Markwin]]: I hate them all. Minotaurs have no own spelling, so I used the speech of the humans. Once I was a prisoner of them. Since then I hate them - and since then I can speak and write in their language.
''Jogador'': '''time'''
[[Markwin]]: Don't ask me such stupid questions. My time is over right now.
''Jogador'': '''Palkar'''
[[Markwin]]: He is the leader of the outcast. In former times he was my best warrior, but now he is my worst enemy.
''Jogador'': '''secret laboratory'''
[[Markwin]]: Hehe - you will never find a way to enter it. The outcast stole the key. You are too weak to conquer it. HARHARHAR.
''Jogador'': '''outcasts'''
[[Markwin]]: Those are no minos any longer. They left the city and killed their brothers. And they stole the key to my secret lab.
''Jogador'': '''key'''
[[Markwin]]: There are many keys. The outcast stole the key to our secret lab! They should burn!
''Jogador'': '''enter'''
[[Markwin]]: To enter the laboratory is pretty difficult.
''Jogador'': '''enter the laboratory'''
[[Markwin]]: First of all you will need a second fellow to help you.
''Jogador'': '''second fellow'''
[[Markwin]]: Yeah - he has to step on a special tile and an entrance will appear at a very poisonous place!
''Jogador'': '''second'''
[[Markwin]]: After you entered the first area you will need the key from the outcasts.
''Jogador'': '''poisonous place'''
[[Markwin]]: Na! You will have to find it yourself!
''Jogador'': '''demon'''
[[Markwin]]: He was the beginning of our end. He is mighty and powerful. He killed many brave minos and after his arrival we weren't able to go up to the surface.
''Jogador'': '''milk'''
[[Markwin]]: No! I won't tell you the powers of our milk!
''Jogador'': '''chronicle / books'''
[[Markwin]]: I am one of the minotaurs that are able to write. So I wrote most of the history of my beloved city Mintwallin in some books.
arkwin: I would like to see the ''Jogador'': '''sun'''
[[Markwin]]: I would like to see the light of the sun again, but you will probably kill me. Go away! ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
[[Markwin]]: Hm ... good bye. }} [[Categoria:NPCs Minotauro]] [[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

| buysell = sim | buys = Nada. | sells = {{Trades/Sell | Key 3142}} | falas = ''Jogador (Knight)'': '''Hi'''
'''Skjaar''': Another creature who believes thinks physical strength is more important than wisdom! Why are you disturbing me?
''Jogador (Paladin)'': '''Hi'''
'''Skjaar''': Neither strong enough to be a knight nor wise enough to be a real mage. You like it easy, don't you? Why are you disturbing me?
''Jogador'': '''Job''' / '''Disturbing''' / '''Need''' / '''Help'''
'''Skjaar''': Once I was the master of all mages, but now I only protect this crypt.
''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Skjaar''': I am Skjaar the Mage, master of all spells.
''Jogador'': '''Door'''
'''Skjaar''': This door seals a crypt.
''Jogador'': '''Crypt'''
'''Skjaar''': Here lies my master. Only his closest followers may enter.
''Jogador'': '''Master'''
'''Skjaar''': If you are one of his followers, you need not ask about him, for you will know. And if you aren't, you are not worthy anyway!
''Jogador'': '''Time'''
'''Skjaar''': To those who have lived for a thousand years time holds no more terror.
''Jogador'': '''Castle'''

'''Skjaar''': Farewell, ''Jogador''!

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}}
| name        = A Bearded Woman
| job         = Ator
| npcclass    = Humanos
| npcsprite   = Nobleman
| city        = Carlin
| subarea     = Northport Pirate Caves
| location    = [[Northport Pirate Caves]] ({{Mapa|32593,31614,10:2|aqui}}).
| implemented = 8.5
| notes       = É dito que este NPC faz parte de uma quest. Ela atuou para o capitão pirata Kid como a Princesa Lumelia, mas de fato é um homem.
| buysell     = não
| falas       = __NOTOC__
== Frases Espontâneas ==
'''A Bearded Woman:''' I am not a princess, I am an actor!</br>
'''A Bearded Woman:''' GET ME OUT OF HERE!</br>
'''A Bearded Woman:''' I am NOT Princess Lumelia, you fools!</br>
'''A Bearded Woman:''' I am not even a woman, you fools!</br>
'''A Bearded Woman:''' I am a MAN! Get me out you drunken fools!</br>
'''A Bearded Woman:''' If I ever get out of here, I'll kill you all! All of you!</br>
'''A Bearded Woman:''' Get me out! It was all part of the plan, you fools!

== Palavras-Chave ==
''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''</br>
'''A Bearded Woman:''' GET ME OUT OF HERE! NOW!

''Jogador:'' '''Job''' / '''Out'''</br>
'''A Bearded Woman:''' I am a great and famous actor! Not a princess, at all. I was only PRETENDING to be a princess. But try explaining that to those stupid pirates.

''Jogador:'' '''Name'''</br>
'''A Bearded Woman:''' How dare you? I left to rot in this dirty cell and you have nothing better to do than chit chat?

''Jogador:'' '''Cell'''</br>
'''A Bearded Woman:''' If you find some way to release me I might even let you live as reward! So you’d better do your best or I’ll kill you!

''Jogador:'' '''Rot'''</br>
'''A Bearded Woman:''' YOU .. YOU .. You are as good as dead! I will get you! Do you hear me? I will have your head! On a platter!

''Jogador:'' '''Princess'''</br>
'''A Bearded Woman:''' Me playing a princess was just part of a cunning plan we had.

''Jogador:'' '''Plan'''</br>
'''A Bearded Woman:''' It was all captain Kid’s idea. You see, he hated his name and planned to become known by the name captain Kidnap. …</br>
'''A Bearded Woman:''' All he needed was someone famous to kidnap. …</br>
'''A Bearded Woman:''' Given his men’s dismal lack of talent and intelligence that would have been quite a feat. …</br>
'''A Bearded Woman:''' We knew each other from a few scams we did together in the past, so he contacted me. …</br>
'''A Bearded Woman:''' I was to impersonate the famous Princess Lumelia. You know, the one everyone was looking for. …</br>
'''A Bearded Woman:''' That would show his men and the other pirates what a great kidnapper he was. …</br>
'''A Bearded Woman:''' He promised me that I would become his second in command and lead a wonderful life of plundering, robbing and pillaging. …</br>
'''A Bearded Woman:''' So I agreed to impersonate the Princess for a while and it worked fine at first. …</br>
'''A Bearded Woman:''' He returned with me dressed as the Princess from a raid on his own and was instantaneously the hero of the day for his men. …</br>
'''A Bearded Woman:''' Things went bad when they decided to have a victory party. …</br>
'''A Bearded Woman:''' As far as I could make out from the mumblings of the pirates, Kid lost the key to my cell while relieving himself in the underground river. …</br>
'''A Bearded Woman:''' The fool decided to dive after it .. never to be seen again. …</br>
'''A Bearded Woman:''' When I found out about Kid’s demise I tried to convince the pirates it was a hoax, but they just won’t believe me!</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Captain'''</br>
'''A Bearded Woman:''' Ah kidnapping is so much fun. That is, if you’re not on the receiving end. …</br>
'''A Bearded Woman:''' It’s easy money and you have a chance to frighten and torture someone who can’t fight back!

''Jogador:'' '''Kidnap'''</br>
'''A Bearded Woman:''' I’d have been a much better captain then Kid was. I played several captains on stage and I was good! …</br>
'''A Bearded Woman:''' Where Kid longed for the appreciation of his men, I would rule by fear and with an iron fist!

''Jogador:'' '''Kid'''</br>
'''A Bearded Woman:''' He was always a fool with a heart too soft to become a feared pirate.

''Jogador:'' '''Stage''' / '''Actor'''</br>
'''A Bearded Woman:''' Stage acting was a waste of my immense talent. Not only am I a born leader, my talent is more profitable when it is used for conning people.

''Jogador:'' '''Scams'''</br>
'''A Bearded Woman:''' The more stupid the people are, the easier it is to con them. …</br>
'''A Bearded Woman:''' And the poorer they are the less means they have to get revenge. Har Har! …</br>
'''A Bearded Woman:''' So I make sure I ruin those I scam. Then they have other things to worry about than getting revenge on me.

''Jogador:'' '''Key'''</br>
'''A Bearded Woman:''' The key was lost in the underground river and has probably washed into the seven seas by now! …</br>
'''A Bearded Woman:''' If that stupid Kid hadn’t been so obsessed with kidnapping he’d not have sold his ship to buy the most expensive and complicated locks for his cells!

''Jogador:'' '''Plundering'''</br>
'''A Bearded Woman:''' As long as we stick to undefended coastal towns we can make an easy fortune. Har Har! …</br>
'''A Bearded Woman:''' As soon as I get out of here I’ll finally become a pirate captain on my own. I don’t need Captain Kid!

''Jogador:'' '''Pirate'''</br>
'''A Bearded Woman:''' In a just world, I would be captain of a grand ship, …</br>
'''A Bearded Woman:''' those pirates out there would now be my minions, and we would brave the seas and become the terror of the coastal towns! …</br>
'''A Bearded Woman:''' If only our plan had worked!

''Jogador:'' '''Ship'''</br>
'''A Bearded Woman:''' Captain Kid sold his ship to buy pointless things like those insanely expensive locks for the cell doors. …</br>
'''A Bearded Woman:''' He said the canoes would do for a while. …</br>
'''A Bearded Woman:''' I got the impression he was not overly sad to part with the ship because he was known to suffer a lot from seasickness.

''Jogador:'' '''Reward'''</br>
'''A Bearded Woman:''' You obviously don’t know who it is you are talking to! I will become the most feared pirate ever and you dare to ask me for a reward?

''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''</br>
'''A Bearded Woman:''' Get me out now or I’ll kill you!
}}

{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}}
| name        = Graubart
| job         = Capitão de Navios
| npcclass    = Humanos
| npcsprite   = Citizen
| city        = Carlin
| subarea     = Northport
| location    = [[Northport]] ({{mapa|32489,31622,7:2|aqui}}).
| implemented = 6.2
| notes       = Graubart é um comerciante e capitão do ''Seahawk'', mas ele não está trabalhando no momento. Ele é muito arrogante, diz que embora Bruno sendo um bom marinheiro, ele não é tão bom quanto ele.
| buysell     = não
| buys        = 
| sells       = 
| falas       = 
''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''</br>
'''Graubart:''' Ahoi, young man ''Jogador''. Looking for work on my ship?</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''</br>
'''Graubart:'''My name is Graubart, captain of the great SeaHawk!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Ship''' / '''SeaHawk'''</br>
'''Graubart:''' Ah, my whole proud: My ship named SeaHawk. We rode out so many stormy nights together. I think I couldn't live without it.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''</br>
'''Graubart:''' I'm a merchant. I sail all over the world with my ship and trade with many different races!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Merchant'''</br>
'''Graubart:''' A merchant is someone who trades goods with other people and tries to make a little profit. *laughs*</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Races'''</br>
'''Graubart:''' You know; elves, dwarfs, lizardmen, minotaurs and many others.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Water'''</br>
'''Graubart:''' Sorry, sold out.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Marlene'''</br>
'''Graubart:''' Pssst. *He looks if Marlene is near. After he is sure that she is not near him he starts to speak.* <Press m for more></br>
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''</br>
'''Graubart:''' Good bye and don't forget me!

pages.title: Marlene
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Marlene | job = Roleplay | npcclass = Humanos | npcsprite = Citizen | city = Carlin | subarea = Northport | location = [[Northport]] ({{Mapa|32483,31622,7:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 6.2 | notes = Ela conta histórias sobre a vila. | buysell = não | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi''' / '''Hello'''
'''Marlene:''' Ahhh, welcome Player! Say, have you already heard the latest news about the seamonster, Aneus, or the rumours in this area?
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''
'''Marlene:''' My name is Marlene.
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
'''Marlene:''' I'm Bruno's wife. Besides: Have you already heard the latest news about the seamonster, Aneus, or the rumours in this area?
''Jogador:'' '''Bruno'''
'''Marlene:''' Bruno is a wonderful husband. But he is seldom at home. *looks a little bit sad*
''Jogador:'' '''Graubart'''
'''Marlene:''' Ah, old Graubart. A very nice person. But he is strange. He always is busy when I want to talk to him. *lost in thoughts*
''Jogador:'' '''Seamonster'''
'''Marlene:''' Only some days ago I was at the docks late in the night and was looking for my husband's ship when suddenly a known noise appeared near the docks. ...
'''Marlene:''' I know this noise very well because it is the noise of a ship sailing very fast. I searched the horizon in hope to see my husbands ship. ...
'''Marlene:''' But instead of a ship I saw a huge shape far away. It was like a big snake swimming in the sea. ...
'''Marlene:''' I couldn't see it clearly because of the fog but I think I saw two lava-red eyes glowing in the nightly fog. ...
'''Marlene:''' I ran into the house and hoped that my husband would arrive safely from fishing. And after one hour he finally arrived. ...
'''Marlene:''' I told him about what I saw but he didn't believe me because he never saw anything like that in all the years before. But you believe me right? Go and convince yourself. ...
'''Marlene:''' Just go to the docks at exactly midnight and be very quiet. Look at the horizon and maybe you will hear and see it, too!
''Jogador:'' '''Aneus'''
'''Marlene:''' A very nice person. He has a great story to tell with big fights and much magic. Just ask him for his story. ...
'''Marlene:''' I heard that he came from far, far away. He must have seen soooo many countries, cities, different races. ...
'''Marlene:''' He must have collected so much wisdom. *sigh* I wish I could also travel around the world. ...
'''Marlene:''' I would try to visit as many cities and meet as many beings as possible. Who knows what strange races I will meet? ...
'''Marlene:''' Maybe I can also find a lovely new dress for me. I have been looking for one for months now but never found a good one. Maybe... *keeps on babbling*
''Jogador:'' '''Rumours'''
'''Marlene:''' Well, I heard about evil beings living in a dungeon below us. So once I tried to find them and went down the hole far to the southwest. ...
'''Marlene:''' I'm pretty curious, you know. *smiles* So I took the coat of invisibility from my husband and went down there. At first I only found some spiders, snakes, and wolves. ...
'''Marlene:''' But after some time I found a ladder to a deeper level of the dungeon but I didn't dare to go down there because I heard many voices. ...
'''Marlene:''' The voices were very strange and I ran back to my house because they were very loud and very angry. I hope they will never get the idea to attack the surface beings. ...
'''Marlene:''' I heard they are almighty and have incredible powers! I already packed our stuff for an emergency escape. You never know. Maybe they plan to conquer the whole world. ...
'''Marlene:''' I bet that they look very ugly. Most mighty monsters look very ugly. Hmm, you seem to be very strong. Maybe you can go deeper and explore the area. But be careful, please. ...
'''Marlene:''' I heard that they can kill humans with only one hit! And that they have magic abilities twenty times stronger than the mightiest sorcerer in our world.
''Jogador:'' '''Thank you'''
'''Marlene:''' My pleasure, I always enjoy sharing interesting stories.
''Jogador:'' '''Bye''' / '''Farewell'''
'''Marlene:''' Good bye and come again for another small talk! *waves* }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

H.L.: Hmmm. I buy weapons, armor, and other stuff. What do you want, ''Player''?
''Jogador'': '''buy'''
H.L.: I don't have anything to offer, but I buy almost everything. Wanna trade?
''Jogador'': '''Job'''
H.L.: I buy all kinds of armory and weapons.
''Jogador'': '''Name'''
H.L.: Won't tell you.
''Jogador'': '''Thais'''
H.L.: Ha! Thais. I lived there once. You know, I was in the royal army. But what they're fighting for... it's all wrong. I deserted.
''Jogador'': '''Royal Army'''
H.L.: You get an excellent fighter training in the army. But they are fighting for the wrong cause.
''Jogador'': '''Cause'''
H.L.: I don't really want to talk about it.
''Jogador'': '''Talk'''
H.L.: About what? I have no time for this, now move along.
''Jogador'': '''Qualquer palavra após ter falado Talk'''
H.L.: Didn't I already tell you to go? If you don't have anything important to say, leave me alone.
''Jogador'': '''King'''
H.L.: They should hang him...
''Jogador'': '''Wild Warrior'''
H.L.: Yeah. I'm a wild warrior. Well, to be honest, I was. I left them. Some of them became too aggressive. Simply attacking everyone for no reason is not good.
''Jogador'': '''Tibia'''
H.L.: Well, at least there's one place worth visiting in Tibia. Here!
''Jogador'': '''Ab'Dendriel'''
H.L.: Elves... I hate them.
''Jogador'': '''Kazordoon''' ou '''[[Dwarfs]]'''
H.L.: Dwarfs are good people. I like them.
''Jogador'': '''Edron'''
H.L.: Might be a good place to live. But the people are too Thais friendly for my taste.
''Jogador'': '''Snake Eye'''
H.L.: He the boss of that tavern. He's alright.
''Jogador'': '''Women'''
H.L.: Women are not good for fighting. I don't need them. I don't trade with them. And I don't like them. }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.title: A Ghostly Knight
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = A Ghostly Knight | job = Guarda | job2 = Fantasma | npcclass = Humanos | npcsprite = Warrior | city = Venore | subarea = Pits of Inferno | location = [[Pits of Inferno]] ({{mapa|32854,32327,11:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 7.9 | notes = Conta algumas belas histórias. | buysell = não | buys = n/a | sells = n/a | falas = ''Jogador'': '''hi '''
[[A Ghostly Knight]]: Failed. I have ... '''''failed'''''.
''Jogador'': '''failed '''
[[A Ghostly Knight]]: The pits. We have sealed the pits. We have '''''concealed''''' the way.
''Jogador'': '''concealed ou pits of inferno'''
[[A Ghostly Knight]]: I cannot ... tell you. I died ... long ago ... But I still remember my '''''duties'''''.
''Jogador'': '''duties '''
[[A Ghostly Knight]]: My duties are the only thing death had left me. I have no remembrance of my mortal days ... perhaps with one '''''exception'''''.
''Jogador'': '''exception '''
[[A Ghostly Knight]]: I remember there used to be something I liked. '''''Grapes'''''! Delicious juicy grapes! What a joy it is to even remember.
''Jogador'': '''grapes'''
[[A Ghostly Knight]]: You would not have some grapes for me, would you?
''Jogador'': '''no''' (Respondendo a pergunta com um "Não")
[[A Ghostly Knight]]: It does not matter. It is only a faint memory anyway.
[[A Ghostly Knight]]: You would not have some grapes for me, would you?
''Jogador'': '''yes ''' (Se você diz "sim" e não tem uvas)
[[A Ghostly Knight]]: No, you don't have any with you. That is a shame...
''Jogador'': '''yes ''' (Se você diz "sim" e tem uvas)
[[A Ghostly Knight]]: Oh, thank you! Thank you! Why, to know such delight! It is almost as if I could taste them again ... almost ...
[[A Ghostly Knight]]: Listen, mortal. There is so much I forgot, but I remember that the passage is hidden. It can only be revealed through luck or careful exploration ...
[[A Ghostly Knight]]: One of you must stay here and watch while the others explore every spot of the caverns ahead ...
[[A Ghostly Knight]]: There are so many ... hidden switches. I can't remember where. But ... they will open the path.
''Jogador'': '''bye '''
[[A Ghostly Knight]]: Loneliness ... again.
}}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.title: A Ghostly Sage
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = A Ghostly Sage | job = Roleplay | job2 = Fantasma | npcclass = Humanos | npcsprite = Mage | city = Venore | subarea = Pits of Inferno | location = [[Pits of Inferno]] ({{mapa|32829,32246,10:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 7.9 | notes =

* Faz parte da [[The Pits of Inferno Quest]]. * Você pode falar com ele para sair de Pits of Inferno dizendo ''Hi'', ''Exit'' ou ''Help'', ''Yes''. Ele te transportará para um local, ({{mapa|32835,32275,9:5|aqui}}). Neste local há dois buracos, o buraco ao norte te leva a uma caverna com slimes, ({{mapa|32797,32249,9:5|aqui}}) que te leva a Plains of Havoc. O buraco do sul te leva novamente para a pits of inferno. * Ele parece estar interessado em fazer uma troca por algo que você geralmente não levaria à Pits of Inferno. É uma [[God Flower]]. Depois de dar para ele, ele irá dizer-lhe uma dica sobre como obter a [[Key 3700]] necessária para entrar na sala de recompensas.

| buysell = não | buys = | sells = | falas = ''Jogador'': '''hi '''
[[A Ghostly Sage]]: Ah, I feel a mortal walks these ancient halls again. Pardon me, I barely noticed you. I am so lost in my '''''thoughts'''''.
''Jogador'': '''thoughts '''
[[A Ghostly Sage]]: I have to fulfill my '''''duties'''''.
''Jogador'': '''duties '''
[[A Ghostly Sage]]: We sealed the doors to the inner sanctum using magic to make sure only the right '''''keys''''' could open them.
''Jogador'': '''keys '''
[[A Ghostly Sage]]: The keys were lost, probably forever. Of course, I could search the spirit world for clues, but then ... who cares about keys? ...
[[A Ghostly Sage]]: I rather spend my time reflecting about the philosophical nature of beauty. *sigh* If I only had a '''''god''''' '''''flower'''''. It is so hard to find a start without a sample.
''Jogador'': '''god flower '''
[[A Ghostly Sage]]: Do you have a god flower for me?
''Jogador'': '''yes '''
[[A Ghostly Sage]]: Oh, how beautiful! Yes, this will definitely assist my studies ... It is amazing how much I seem to have forgotten. Well, I have talked to other spirits about that key ...
[[A Ghostly Sage]]: It seems the last remaining key was taken from a slain knight by a cyclops ...
[[A Ghostly Sage]]: However, the cyclopses eventually lost the key themselves. I think it is legitimate to conclude that you may find a hint concerning the key's whereabouts in the cyclopses' lair.
''Jogador'': '''nightmares knights '''
[[A Ghostly Sage]]: A yes, the Nightmare Knights and the Pits of Inferno. I vaguely remember these insignificant concepts ...
[[A Ghostly Sage]]: Ever since I died I have struggled to keep my superior mind intact by pursuing advanced metaphysical philosophy, but I do remember things about the time when we built this complex and locked its secrets and treasures away.
''Jogador'': '''complex '''
[[A Ghostly Sage]]: We sealed the doors to the inner sanctum using magic to make sure only the right '''''keys''''' could open them.
''Jogador'': '''name '''
[[A Ghostly Sage]]: My name... it was so long since I last heard it... it seems to be erased from my memory.
''Jogador'': '''job '''
[[A Ghostly Sage]]: I have to fulfil my '''''duties'''''.
''Jogador'': '''help '''
[[A Ghostly Sage]]: Are you stuck here...? Do you want me to bring you out of these cursed halls?
''Jogador'': '''yes ''' (respondendo sim)
[[A Ghostly Sage]]: So be it. Travel well.
''Jogador'': '''no ''' (respondendo não)
[[A Ghostly Sage]]: Then stay here.
''Jogador'': '''pits of inferno '''
[[A Ghostly Sage]]: A yes, the Nightmare Knights and the Pits of Inferno. I vaguely remember these insignificant concepts ...
[[A Ghostly Sage]]: Ever since I died I have struggled to keep my superior mind intact by pursuing advanced metaphysical philosophy, but I do remember things about the time when we built this complex and locked its secrets and treasures away.
''Jogador'': '''bye '''
[[A Ghostly Sage]]: So where was I ... ? }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.title: Oldrak
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Oldrak | job = Monge | job2 = Comerciante de Itens Mágicos | city = Venore | subarea = Plains of Havoc | location = [[Plains of Havoc]] ({{mapa|32816,32263,6:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 7.1 | notes = Um monk que vive no templo dedicado aos Nightmare Knights em Plains of Havoc. | buysell = sim | buys = Nada. | sells = {{Trades/Sell | The Holy Tible | Hallowed Axe}}

* Faz parte da [[The Demon Oak Quest]]. * Faz parte da [[The Paradox Tower Quest]]. * Concede permissão para que você pegue uma nova [[The Holy Tible]], mediante pagamento de 1000 gold coins.

| falas = {{TOC left}} {{clear}} === Palavras-Chave Gerais === ''Jogador'': '''Hi'''
'''Oldrak''': Welcome ''Jogador''! Rarely I can welcome visitors in these days.
''Jogador'': '''Name'''
'''Oldrak''': My name is Oldrak.
''Jogador'': '''Job''' / '''Visitors'''
'''Oldrak''': I guard this humble temple as a monument for the order of the Nightmare Knights.
''Jogador'': '''Excalibug'''
'''Oldrak''': A weapon of myth and legend. It was lost in ancient times ... perhaps lost forever.
''Jogador'': '''Tibia'''
'''Oldrak''': That's where we are. The world of Tibia.
''Jogador'': '''Time'''
'''Oldrak''': Now, it's ''hora atual dentro do jogo''.
''Jogador'': '''Undead''' / '''Unlife'''
'''Oldrak''': Beware the foul undead!
''Jogador'': '''Tible''' (Caso não tenha pego a [[The Holy Tible|Tible]] ou já tenha pedido uma nova)
'''Oldrak''': Tibles are the various holy books of Tibia. They are a prized possession for every pious pilgrim. You may find one under the guidance of the gods. If you ever lose it, I might be able to help you.
''Jogador'': '''Tible''' (Caso já tenha pego a [[The Holy Tible|Tible]] e peça uma nova)
'''Oldrak''': If you've lost your precious Tible, I can ask the gods for guidance on how to find another one. But it will require a donation of 1,000 gold. Do you want me to help you?
:''Jogador'': '''Yes'''
:'''Oldrak''': Thank you. I sense the gods wish you to travel south. A new Tible will await you at the same place where you found the last one.
''Jogador'': '''Mission / quest'''
'''Oldrak''': I'm a monk. Worldly belongings are of no interest to me. Therefore I have nothing to do for an adventurer.
''Jogador'': '''Bye / farewell'''
'''Oldrak''': Good bye, ''Jogador''!
=== Deuses === ''Jogador'': '''Gods'''
'''Oldrak''': They created Tibia and all life on it ... and unlife, too.
=== Plains of Havoc === ''Jogador'': '''Plains of Havoc / Fair Plains'''
'''Oldrak''': Before these battles were fought here, they were called the Fair Plains.
''Jogador'': '''Nightmare Knights'''
'''Oldrak''': This ancient order was created by a circle of wise humans who were called 'The Dreamers'. The order became extinct a long time ago.
''Jogador'': '''Extinct'''
'''Oldrak''': Many died in the battles against evil, some went mad, unable to stand their nightmares any longer. Others were seduced by the powers of darkness.
''Jogador'': '''Dreamers'''
'''Oldrak''': They learnt the ancient art of dreamwalking from some friendly elves.
''Jogador'': '''Dreamwalking'''
'''Oldrak''': While the elvish dreamwalkers experienced bright and happy dreams, the humans strangely had dreams about dark omens.
''Jogador'': '''Dark Omen'''
'''Oldrak''': They dreamt of doom, destruction, talked to dead and tormented souls, and gained unwanted insight into the schemes of darkness.
''Jogador'': '''Goshnar'''
'''Oldrak''': He was the greatest necromant who ever cursed our land with the steps of his feet. He was defeated by the Nightmare Knights.
''Jogador'': '''Necromants Nectar'''
'''Oldrak''': There are many rumours about the Pits of Inferno, which are also known as Nightmare Pits. Even if I knew any of these secrets, I wouldn't tell you.
''Jogador'': '''Ruthless Seven'''
'''Oldrak''': The Ruthless Seven - Banor help me - have their domain deep under the Plains of Havoc. I don't even dare to speak out their names.
''Jogador'': '''Schemes of Darkness'''
'''Oldrak''': They figured out how to interpret their dark dreams and so were able to foresee the plans of the dark gods and their minions.
''Jogador'': '''Plans of the Dark Gods'''
'''Oldrak''': Using this knowledge, they formed an order to thwart these plans. As they battled their nightmares as brave as knights, they decided to name their order 'Nightmare Knights'.
''Jogador'': '''monster'''
'''Oldrak''': These plains are not safe for ordinary travellers. It takes heroes to survive here.
''Jogador'': '''Cursed land / recent developments'''
'''Oldrak''': This area in the South from which all life has vanished really worries me. If you find out more about it, let me know. Maybe I can help you.
''Jogador'': '''infested area / circle / demon oak'''
'''Oldrak''': How do you know? Did you go into the infested area?
:''Jogador'': '''yes'''
:'''Oldrak''': I don't believe a word of it! How rude to lie to a monk!
:''Jogador'': '''no'''
:'''Oldrak''': What a pity! Let me know when you managed to get in there. Maybe I can help you when we know what we are dealing with.
== The Paradox Tower Quest == ''Jogador'': '''Hugo'''
'''Oldrak''': Ah, the curse of the [[Plains of Havoc]], the hidden beast, the unbeatable foe. I've been living here for years and I'm sure this is only a myth.
''Jogador'': '''Myth''' (COMEÇA A QUEST [[The Paradox Tower Quest]])
'''Oldrak''': There are many tales about the fearsome Hugo. It's said it's an abnormality, accidentally created by Yenny the Gentle. It's half demon, half something else and people say it's still alive after all these years.
''Jogador'': '''Yenny the Gentle'''
'''Oldrak''': Yenny, known as the Gentle, was one of the most powerful wielders of magic in ancient times. She was known throughout the world for her mercy and kindness.
}}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]
