pages.wikitext:
{{DASH|Esta é a NPC encontrada no '''Dream Realm''', se você procura a NPC de mesmo nome localizada em '''Ghostlands''', veja a página [[A Ghostly Woman]]. }}{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = A Ghostly Woman (Dream Realm) | job = Roleplay | job2 = Fantasma | npcclass = Humanos | npcsprite = Nobleman | city = Venore | subarea = Dream Realm | location = [[Dream Realm]] ({{mapa|32835,32288,14:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 7.9 | notes = Ela era uma antigo membro da ordem dos Nightmare Knights. Ela está com frio e quer uma [[Boots|bota]].

* Faz parte da [[Dreamer's Challenge Quest]]. * Ao dar as botas que podem ser encontradas na sala para ela, ela dá dicas para a solução de um dos desafios da quest. * Você pode acessar a sala aonde a npc está mesmo após ter concluído a quest, porém você irá refazer as partes iniciais da quest gastando itens.

| buysell = não | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
[[A Ghostly Woman]]: I feel you. I hear your thoughts. You are ... alive...
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
[[A Ghostly Woman]]: Once I was alive too. I was a member of the order of the nightmare knights. Now I am but a shadow who walks these cold halls.
''Jogador:'' '''Alive'''
[[A Ghostly Woman]]: Once I was alive too. I was a member of the order of the nightmare knights. Now I am but a shadow who walks these cold halls.
''Jogador:'' '''Nightmare knights'''
[[A Ghostly Woman]]: We lost ... perhaps everything is lost. Perhaps there never will be any new knights of our order.
''Jogador:'' '''Knights / Order'''
[[A Ghostly Woman]]: Only those who passed the tests of the dream challenge would be able to become nightmare knights.
''Jogador:'' '''Tests / Dream challenge'''
[[A Ghostly Woman]]: These halls are only a decoy to distract the inattentive. The true way is hidden well.
''Jogador:'' '''True way / hidden well'''
[[A Ghostly Woman]]: There is a secret .. but no ... I can hardly remember ... and I can't tell you anyway ... But ... perhaps ... It is so cold here ... If you gave me some ordinary boots that might give me some warmth I would give you a hint.
''Jogador:'' '''Boots'''
[[A Ghostly Woman]]: Do you have a pair of boots for me?
''Jogador:'' '''Yes''' (Se você não têm as botas).
[[A Ghostly Woman]]: No ... you don't. Still so cold ... so cold
''Jogador:'' '''Yes''' (Se você têm as botas).
[[A Ghostly Woman]]: Oh thank you. Perhaps this will give me some comfort. It is that cold since I am dead ... for so long ...
[[A Ghostly Woman]]: All I can give you is a little hint though: Not me but only the lost heroes can show you the way; and though it's only a game, it might change what will happen.
''Jogador:'' '''Bye / farewell'''
[[A Ghostly Woman]]: Alone ... so alone. So cold.
}}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.title: The Dream Master
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = The Dream Master | job = Dream Master | city = Venore | subarea = Dream Realm | location = [[Dream Realm]] ({{mapa|32844,32232,14:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 7.9 | notes =

* Faz parte da [[Dreamer's Challenge Quest]]. * Você deve completar a quest para poder acessar este NPC no Dream Realm. Após se aliar a ordem dos [[Nightmare Knights]], ele te dará missões e pode informar sobre seus privilégios e seu rank na ordem. * Ele só comprará [[Soul Orb]]s, caso você tenha o rank "Novice" na ordem. As [[Demonic Essence]]s, ele só comprará caso você tenha o rank "Lord Protector" na ordem dos [[Nightmare Knights]].

[[Categoria:NPCs Liberados por Quest]] | buysell = sim | buys = {{Trades/Buy | Soul Orb | Demonic Essence}} | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
[[The Dream Master]]: Be greeted, visitor.
''Jogador:'' '''Visitor / Nightmare Knights'''
[[The Dream Master]]: Although the Nightmare Knights are still remembered by the people for their valorous fight against demons and the undead hordes they were more of a spiritual order rather than a fighting one.
''Jogador:'' '''Spiritual'''
[[The Dream Master]]: A strong spirit is what constitutes a true warrior. Armed with a firm belief in his philosophy, he wins a battle by using his mind rather than his body, which is only a lesser tool ...
[[The Dream Master]]: In the end your body is all but a crumbling shell that you leave behind. Our familiarity with dreams makes it much easier to understand this concept since in the world of dreams your body follows the will of the mind ...
[[The Dream Master]]: The conscious mind shapes the matter of the dreams. Only those who can prove themselves in their dreams posses the strength of mind that is necessary to become one of us ...
[[The Dream Master]]: Still a strong mind does not necessarily grant strong morals as our failures in the past have shown.
''Jogador:'' '''Failures'''
[[The Dream Master]]: When our dreams tell us about the possible future they are never bright. This is why we refer to ourselves as the Nightmare Knights ...
[[The Dream Master]]: If someone whose faith is not enough strong to overcome such seemingly overwhelming evil, he may succumb to despair or even worse might become convinced that evil is the superior force ...
[[The Dream Master]]: A few of our members have choosen to abandon our teachings, including some we considered our most noble and wise members. Ironically, they have failed even worse on the dark side which they supposed to be so superior.
''Jogador:'' '''Dreams'''
[[The Dream Master]]: You must neither overestimate the importance of dreams nor underestimate it. Dreams can be your guide. If you are are skilled in the art of dreaming they might even give you a glimpse of things to come ...
[[The Dream Master]]: Yet remember that it is ultimately in your hands to decide what to do. The dreams are but a hint.
''Jogador:'' '''Abandon / Goshnar'''
[[The Dream Master]]: Goshnar is a tragic figure. While he was one of us he tried to fight evil in such a desperate way that he never managed not live up to his own expectations ...
[[The Dream Master]]: While trying to understand his enemy, to make out their strengthes and weaknesses he became more and more like them ...
[[The Dream Master]]: In the end he switched sides and took the robe of the necromancer king. His quick ascension in the ranks of the Brotherhood of Bones was unheard of. He appeared to have an aura of power and invincibility ...
[[The Dream Master]]: But though he united most of the Brotherhood under his banner and allied himself with demons he ultimately failed. ...
[[The Dream Master]]: His failure was a typical lesson of the ultimate failure of evil. His spirit was already broken when he joined the ranks of the evil hordes ...
[[The Dream Master]]: He succumbed to the seemingly easy way as did his allies. They lived in the hell they had created on their own ...
[[The Dream Master]]: Surrounded by treacherous allies, always fearing betrayal, always in need to prove themselves, never being able to show any weakness without someone trying to seize upon that opportunity ...
[[The Dream Master]]: A Nightmare Knight would hold his ground in a battle against impossible odds just to cover the retreat of his friends ...
[[The Dream Master]]: A member of the Brotherhood does try to run if the tide of battle seems to turn against him, since he can safely assume that the others will run too and those who run last will be those who suffer most ...
[[The Dream Master]]: This is why they ultimately failed. Their failure did not save our own order though.
''Jogador:'' '''Order'''
[[The Dream Master]]: The Nightmare Knights are almost extinct now, and as far as I know I am the only teacher that is left. But you might be right and its time to accept new disciples ...
[[The Dream Master]]: After all you have passed the Dream Challenge to reach this place, which used to be the process of initiation in the past ...
[[The Dream Master]]: So I ask you: do you wish to become a member of the ancient order of the Nightmare Knights, ''Jogador''?
:''Jogador:'' '''No'''
:[[The Dream Master]]: Your decision is humble and possibly wise.
:''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''
:[[The Dream Master]]: Please know that your decision is irrevocable. You will abandon the opportunity to join any order whose doctrine is in contrast to our own ...
:[[The Dream Master]]: Do you still want to join our order?
::''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''
::[[The Dream Master]]: So I welcome you as the latest member of the order of the Nightmare Knights. You entered this place as a stranger, but you will leave this place as a friend ...
::[[The Dream Master]]: You can always ask me about your current rank and about the privileges the ranks grant to those who hold them.
''Jogador:'' '''Undead'''
[[The Dream Master]]: It is humanity and community that ultimately defines us. The undead know nothing of either. They are stripped of everything but their selfishness and call upon themselves one of the worst curses of all, the curse of loneliness.
''Jogador:'' '''Community'''
[[The Dream Master]]: The community gives us hold and strength. And we give the community hold and strength in return. We don't live alone and as a community we are one ...
[[The Dream Master]]: By caring for others we care for ourself. Not only because we might need others, too, one day but also because helping others without expecting a reward cleanses our soul from greed and selfishness ...
[[The Dream Master]]: These are the poisons that turn our better selves into something less, something small, ugly and self-centred.
''Jogador:'' '''Brotherhood'''
[[The Dream Master]]: The Brotherhood embraces hate and selfishness and pursues the illusion of power. They think only the fittest may survive. But they don't see that we are not individuals but a community ...
[[The Dream Master]]: The best fighter may be ill-suited to tend the wounds of those in need and even the most helpless person can make somebody else smile or love them, thus enriching their lives ...
[[The Dream Master]]: The Brotherhood thinks they are free because they only pursue their own goals without morals or remorse, but they don't see they have become slaves to their greed and lost everything of importance on their way.
''Jogador:'' '''Power'''
[[The Dream Master]]: There is no power. Nowhere ever. There is only responsibility. To think about responsibility as power is already the first step into the wrong direction.
''Jogador:'' '''Ruthless Seven'''
[[The Dream Master]]: They are mighty individuals that survived for aeons in the merciless society of demons. This alone is proof enough of how dangerous they are ...
[[The Dream Master]]: I believe they attained their status by mimicking a tool of their enemies: their own flawed version of a community. By forming an alliance they gained strength ...
[[The Dream Master]]: It put an example other demons followed with more or less success ...
[[The Dream Master]]: But they cannot truly understand the concept of helping each other, so in the long run their alliance is doomed to fail. They will end up devouring each other, for they cannot stand the thought that others may wield power, too ...
[[The Dream Master]]: But then, we are mere mortals and this day might be far away. So we will have to deal with them either way. ...
[[The Dream Master]]: Still it is possible that one of them can be attacked without the six others interfering on his behalf, since this, after all, is the way of demonkind.
''Jogador:'' '''Soul orb'''
[[The Dream Master]]: Soul orbs are the demons' substitute for true souls. They are powerful magic devices. It is said there are cyclopses who know how to forge weapons from soul orbs. I also buy them, so if you want to get rid of them, ask me for a trade.
''Jogador:'' '''Ferumbras'''
[[The Dream Master]]: He is the enemy of all living things. He lost all humanity long ago, and that which is left is nothing but burning hatred for everyone and everything ...
[[The Dream Master]]: Although he can be defeated, he will only truly die when he recognises the mockery his life has turned into.
''Jogador:'' '''Demonic essence'''
[[The Dream Master]]: Demonic essence can be looted from most demonic beings. The pits of inferno are full of such creatures.
''Jogador:'' '''Pits of Inferno'''
[[The Dream Master]]: We managed to seal and contain the evil power of this place for at least a while. It was obvious that we could not stop these forces forever ...
[[The Dream Master]]: But then, we had to do our best for as long as we could. And so we did. Those who perished have given their best in the interest of all living beings.
''Jogador:'' '''Necromancy'''
[[The Dream Master]]: Necromancy is like a disease that spreads through your soul. By studying the dark art you learn to perceive life and death in a different unhealthy way. Both become tools you use as it pleases you ...
[[The Dream Master]]: You lose your respect for life and death alike. In the end you have abandoned all that is worth living for. You will end off in a dark, decaying world of your own making ...
[[The Dream Master]]: You will have minions and masters, but no friends. You will know power and submission, but no fulfilment.
''Jogador:'' '''Bye / farewell'''
[[The Dream Master]]: Good bye. May the gods watch over your path.
}}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = The Orc King | job = Rei | city = Ulderek | subarea = Ulderek's Rock | location = [[Ulderek's Rock]] ({{mapa|32982,31731,9:5|aqui}}). | implemented = 6.1 | notes = Ele é o rei dos Orcs e está amaldiçoado a ter a aparência de um Defiler por causa de um Djinn. * Faz parte da [[The Djinn War Quest]]. Ele entrega uma cópia da [[Gemmed Lamp]] utilizada na quest. * Faz parte da [[What a Foolish Quest]]. Ele recebe um [[Cookie]] do NPC [[Bozo]] durante a quest.

| buysell = não | buys = | sells = | falas = ''Jogador'': '''hi '''
[[The Orc King]]: Harrrrk! You think you are strong now? You shall never escape my wrath! I am '''''immortal'''''!
''Jogador'': '''immortal ''' ou '''name'''
[[The Orc King]]: I am Charkahn the Slayer! The immortal father of the '''''orcs''''' and master of this '''''hive'''''.
''Jogador'': '''orcs '''
[[The Orc King]]: The orcs are the bearers of Blogs rage. This makes us the ultimate fighters and the most powerful of all races.
''Jogador'': '''hive '''
[[The Orc King]]: I can sense the presence and the feelings of my underlings and '''''minions'''''. I embrace the rage of the horde.
''Jogador'': '''minions '''
[[The Orc King]]: The orcish horde of this hive is under my control. I sense their emotions and their needs and provide them with the leadership they need to focus their '''''hate''''' and rage.
''Jogador'': '''hate '''
[[The Orc King]]: Hate and rage are the true blessings of '''''Blog''''', since they are powerful weapons. They give the hive strength. I provide them with '''''direction''''' and focus.
''Jogador'': '''blog '''
[[The Orc King]]: The Raging One blessed us with his burning hate. We are truly his children and therefore '''''divine'''''.
''Jogador'': '''direction '''
[[The Orc King]]: To conquer, to destroy and to dominate. Orcs are born to rule the '''''world'''''.
''Jogador'': '''divine '''
[[The Orc King]]: The orcs are the bearers of Blogs rage. This makes us the ultimate fighters and the most powerful of all races.
''Jogador'': '''world '''
[[The Orc King]]: One day I will rule the world, even when turned into a '''''slime'''''.
''Jogador'': '''slime '''
[[The Orc King]]: Pah! Don't mock me, mortal! This shape is a curse which the evil '''''djinn''''' bestowed upon me!
''Jogador'': '''djinn '''
[[The Orc King]]: This cursed djinn king! I set him free from an enchanted '''''lamp''''', and he '''''cheated''''' me!
''Jogador'': '''lamp '''
[[The Orc King]]: For Eons he was trapped in an enchanted lamp by some ancient race. Now he's free to roam the world again. Although he cheated me I appreciate what he and his brethren will do to this world, now it's the time of the Djinn again!
''Jogador'': '''cheated '''
[[The Orc King]]: Because I freed him he granted me three wishes. He was true to his word in the first two '''''wishes'''''.
''Jogador'': '''wishes '''
[[The Orc King]]: He built this fortress over Uldrek's grave within a single night. Also, he granted me my second wish and gave me immortality. Test it and try to kill me if you want. Har Har!
''Jogador'': '''third w '''
[[The Orc King]]: I wished to father more healthy and fertile children as any orc has ever done. But the djinn cheated me and made me a slime! Then he laughed at me and left for his abandoned fortress in the '''''Deathwish''''' Mountains.
''Jogador'': '''third wish '''
[[The Orc King]]: He built this fortress over Uldrek's grave within a single night. Also, he granted me my second wish and gave me immortality. Test it and try to kill me if you want. Har Har!
''Jogador'': '''deathwish '''
[[The Orc King]]: His ancient fortress on Darama was deserted as the evil Djinn fled this world after his imprisonment. Now the time has come for the evil Djinns to return to their master although this will certainly awaken the '''''good''''' '''''Djinn''''' too.
''Jogador'': '''good djinn '''
[[The Orc King]]: I will not share anything more about that topic with you '''''paleskins'''''.
''Jogador'': '''paleskins '''
[[The Orc King]]: You are as ugly as maggots, although not quite as as tasty.
''Jogador'': '''bye '''
[[The Orc King]]: We will meet again. }} [[Categoria:NPCs Orc]] [[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Ruprecht | job = Ajudante do Papai Noel | job2 = Comerciante de Itens Especiais | npcclass = Humanos | npcsprite = Beggar | city = Carlin | subarea = Vega | location = [[Vega|Ice Islands - Vega]] ({{Mapa|31952,31720,7:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 7.9 | notes = Se você falar: '''Santa Claus''', ele vai contar uma história muito interessante pra você. No [[Updates/10.30|Update 10.30]] foram adicionados novos itens natalinos para serem trocados por [[Christmas Token]]s.

Para trocar os Christmas Token, é necessário falar '''Turn in'''.

'''Ruprecht:''' Bem, ele não gosta que fiquem contando sua história por ai... mas mesmo assim eu conto! Há muito, muito tempo atrás, Noel não passava de um pequeno anão insaciável. Um real pão duro, eu digo mesmo... Ele era muito mais insaciável do que um anão comum. Ele não emprestava nada, nem mesmo a mais barata das coisas que ele tivesse... Um dia uma mulher foi até sua casa e lhe pediu um copo de água... Naturalmente ele recusou e zombou de sua ingenuidade. Mas o que ele não sabia era que a mulher parecia ser algum tipo de fada poderosa ou uma deusa disfarçada... E assim foi feito, a mulher jogou uma maldição no velho, forçando-o a compartilhar toda sua fortuna com quem ele encontrasse... Noel ficou horrorizado. Ele não conseguia enfiar na cabeça o fato de ter que compartilhar quase tudo que tinha com todos. Então ele se escondeu. Ele se escondeu nos lugares mais remotos do mundo, mas o tempo acabou fazendo com que alguém o encontrasse e a maldição o fez compartilhar sua riqueza... E sabe de uma coisa? O velho começou a gostar disso! Ele viu a alegria que seus presentes trouxeram, e ele começou a abrir seu coração de pedra... Foi assim que ele aprendeu que, desta maneira, seu dinheiro dava mais alegria e prazer do que nunca! Com os anos ele transformou isso em um jogo. Ele se esconde em vários lugares para presentear aqueles que o acharem... Mas uma vez a cada ano, em um dia muito especial onde acontece o aniversário de sua maldição, ele sai e leva presente para todos, especialmente às crianças... Bem, essa é a história dele... Não, isso não é uma lágrima nos meus olhos. É o vento, você sabe.

{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Murim | job = Banqueiro | job2 = Carteiro | city = Zao | subarea = Farmine | location = [[Farmine]] ({{mapa|33013,31494,10:5|aqui}}). | buysell = sim | implemented = 8.54 | notes = Murim possui um banco em Farmine. Ele troca [[Gold Coin]]s, [[Platinum Coin]]s e [[Crystal Coin]]s. Você pode depositar, tirar, transferir dinheiro e checar o balanço de sua conta.

* Ao concluir a [[The Postman Missions Quest]] você receberá um desconto. Parcels custarão apenas 10 [[gp]]s e letters apenas 5 [[gp]]s.

 | buys =
Nada. | sells = {{Trades/Sell |Label |Letter |Parcel}} | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
[[Murim]]: Hello and welcome to the Farmine bank and post office, ''Player''!
''Jogador:'' '''Farmine'''
[[Murim]]: A promising project for Kazordoon.
''Jogador:'' '''Kazordoon'''
[[Murim]]: I hope this new project lets Kazordoon prosper. Half of my family is involved in Farmine one way or another. If things turn out well, we will earn a hefty sum of money.
''Jogador:'' '''Mission'''
[[Murim]]: My only mission is to keep this little office running.
''Jogador:'' '''Excalibug'''
[[Murim]]: A weapon of pure power - or a weapon of pure imagination. Who knows?
''Jogador:'' '''Dwarf'''
[[Murim]]: Ah, my proud brothers and sisters. Only dwarfs could succeed with such an immense tunnelling project.
''Jogador:'' '''Ongulf'''
[[Murim]]: Now he is one-of-a-kind and a born leader.
''Jogador:'' '''Esrik'''
[[Murim]]: If he only stopped bugging Ongulf about resources. We've already spent too much money on things that yield no immediate profit. ...
[[Murim]]: But in the end, only profit will convince the imperial mining guild to continue their support.
''Jogador:'' '''Mining Guild'''
[[Murim]]: It took my three weeks with almost no sleep to do all the paperwork for my business permission, but it was worth it! ...
[[Murim]]: The guild is sticking to the old traditions and that is a good thing for sure.
''Jogador:'' '''Elves'''
[[Murim]]: Luckily we're far away from them.
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
[[Murim]]: Bye.
|}} [[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Swolt | job = Comerciante de Alimentos | city = Zao | subarea = Farmine | location = [[Farmine]] ({{mapa|32994,31541,10:1|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.54 | notes =

* Faz parte da [[Tomes of Knowledge Quest]].

 | buysell = sim | sells = {{Trades/Sell | Beer;Mug of Beer | Bread, 4 | Cheese, 6 | Ham, 8 | Meat, 5 | Water (Líquido);Mug of Water}} Depois de entregar 4 [[Tome of Knowledge|Tomes]] {{Trades/Sell | Rice Ball}} | buys = {{Trades/Buy | Bunch of Ripe Rice | Ectoplasmic Sushi | Terramite Eggs}} | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
[[Swolt]]: Hello.
''Jogador:'' '''Farmine'''
[[Swolt]]: The Farmine project is a spark of hope for the whole dwarvenhood. The resources here might lead the dwarfs to a new golden age.
''Jogador:'' '''Kazordoon'''
[[Swolt]]:: h, home sweet home! Though I don't mind being here for a while, my heart still belongs to Kazordoon. ...
[[Swolt]]: In a few decades, I'll certainly return there and hand over this tavern to someone else.
''Jogador:'' '''Tavern'''
[[Swolt]]: Every dwarf needs some relaxation now and then. This is the place where the miners come to share stories about home and hear news about the latest events like the giant beaver rodeos.
''Jogador:'' '''Giant Beaver Rodeos'''
[[Swolt]]: If you need to ask, you don't need to know.
''Jogador:'' '''Excalibug'''
[[Swolt]]: The cousin of my mother's neighbour knows someone who claims to have seen a strange guy in the Kazordoon tavern. He was wearing a dark cloak and beneath it he hid a weapon that might have been Excalibug.
''Jogador:'' '''Orcs'''
[[Swolt]]: If the orcs come here to kill us, we will be prepared! They will pay heavily for every attack.
''Jogador:'' '''Minotaurs'''
[[Swolt]]: It wouldn't surprise me if there were another minotaur city somewhere on this continent. They are a pest.
''Jogador:'' '''Lizards'''
[[Swolt]]: Dragonkin! You can't expect anything good from dragons and the likes of them.
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
[[Swolt]]: Bye. |}} [[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Pompan | job = Comerciante | job2 = Comerciante de Ferramentas | city = Zao | subarea = Farmine | location = [[Farmine]] ({{Mapa|33036,31544,10:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.54 | notes =

[[Categoria:NPCs Liberados por Quest]] | buysell = sim | sells = {{Trades/Sell | Backpack, 20 | Bag, 5 | Basket | Bucket | Candlestick | Closed Trap | Crowbar | Expedition Backpack | Expedition Bag | Fishing Rod, 150 | Lamp | Pick | Rope | Scythe, 50 | Shovel, 50 | Torch | Watch | Worm}} Após entregar 01 [[Tome of Knowledge|tome]] {{Trades/Sell | Arrow | Blue Quiver | Bolt | Bow,400 | Crossbow | Crystalline Arrow | Dragon Tapestry | Drill Bolt | Earth Arrow | Envenomed Arrow | Flaming Arrow | Flash Arrow | Onyx Arrow | Piercing Bolt | Power Bolt | Prismatic Bolt | Quiver | Red Quiver | Royal Spear | Shiver Arrow | Sniper Arrow | Spear | Tarsal Arrow | Throwing Star | Vortex Bolt}} Após entregar 02 [[Tome of Knowledge|tomes]] {{Trades/Sell | Minotaur Backpack}} Após entregar 05 [[Tome of Knowledge|tomes]] {{Trades/Sell | Dragon Backpack}} | buys = {{Trades/Buy | Closed Trap | Crowbar | Fishing Rod | Inkwell | Mirror | Pick | Rope | Scythe | Shovel | Sickle | Watch}} Após entregar 01 [[Tome of Knowledge|tome]] {{Trades/Buy | Bow,100 | Corrupted Flag | Crossbow,120 | High Guard Flag | Legionnaire Flags | Zaogun Flag}} | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Pompan:''' Hello.
''Jogador:'' '''Ongulf'''
'''Pompan:''' He can be quite stubborn sometimes but I see why they chose him to head this venture. ...
'''Pompan:''' If you've ever talked to dwarfs, you'll recognise that he is an rather open-minded and flexible fellow.
''Jogador:'' '''Orcs'''
'''Pompan:''' Of course they are dangerous. But we all know: Orcs can die, can't they? And speaking of that, they might have stolen some interesting stuff from these lizardmen that could be of some value for someone with an exotic taste.
''Jogador:'' '''Humans'''
'''Pompan:''' They are neglectable as they have nothing to offer. They live in horrible primitive conditions, but we are not here for charity work. As long as they don't have anything interesting to offer, we will simply ignore them.
''Jogador:'' '''Lizards'''
'''Pompan:''' They are an incredible threat. At the moment, they are occupied with the orcs. But once they are done with the orcs, who will be next? They might even plan to conquer human civilisation... ...
'''Pompan:''' I agree with my superiors that a preventative strike will be the best solution. The lizards' cities are rich and the land offers plentiful resources that would easily cover the costs of a war.
''Jogador:'' '''Venore'''

Also selling fresh fish! == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Pemaret''': Greetings, young man. Looking for a passage or some fish, ''Jogador''? ''Jogador'': '''fish'''
'''Pemaret''': My fish is of the finest quality you could find. Ask me for a trade to check for yourself. ''Jogador'': '''job'''
'''Pemaret''': I'm a fisherman and I take along people to Edron. You can also buy some fresh fish. ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Pemaret''': My name is Pemaret, the fisherman. ''Jogador'': '''boat''' / '''ship'''
'''Pemaret''': My boat is ready to bring you to Edron. ''Jogador'': '''sea'''
'''Pemaret''': I love to sail on the seas of Tibia. ''Jogador'': '''shimmer''' / '''swimmer'''
'''Pemaret''': Now that's a special one. Where did you hear about it? I would be interested, you know... Well, this fish is extremely rare and cannot be found in normal, clean freshwater. ...
'''Pemaret''': If you want to catch one, you will have to look for a really dirty lake. If you were able to catch one however, this would be a very versatile haul. ...
'''Pemaret''': It is said that, in combination with certain magical or non-magical items, this fish somehow... changes his looks and gains a completely new purpose. I heard of someone making a weapon out of it! ...
'''Pemaret''': Hey, don't look at me like that. It... it's just a tale what do I know. ...
'''Pemaret''': Anyway, I heard of people using flintstones, the hair and wax of strange creatures I never saw before, an eye of a foreign sea beast and some kind of old, broken ring. ''Jogador'': '''cormaya''' / '''isle'''
'''Pemaret''': It's a lovely and peaceful isle. Did you already visit the nice sandy beach? ''Jogador'': '''edron'''
'''Pemaret''': Do you want to get to Edron for 10 gold? ''Jogador'': '''eremo''' / '''sage'''
'''Pemaret''': Oh, you know the good old sage Eremo. I can bring you to his little island. Do you want me to do that? ''Jogador'': '''tibia'''
'''Pemaret''': I love to sail on the seas of Tibia. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Pemaret''': Good bye, ''Jogador''. You are welcome. }}

'''Yoem''': Hello ''Jogador''! Do you need some equipment for your house?
''Jogador'': '''Name'''
'''Yoem''': My name is Yoem. I sell furniture and equipment.
''Jogador'': '''Job'''
'''Yoem''': Have you moved to a new home? I'm the specialist for equipping it.
''Jogador'': '''Daniel Steelsoul'''
'''Yoem''': Yes, I know him since we were small children. He's a brave and virtuous man.
== The Grimvale Quest == === The Curse Spreads === '''Missão: Ajudando Cormaya'''
''Jogador'': '''Curse'''
'''Yoem''': Yes, the Curse of the Full Moon has reached Cormaya, too. More and more people are affected but something is really strange: Some of them weren't bitten by were-beasts. So far we thought this is the only way to be infected. ...
'''Yoem''': But now it's obvious that there has to be another way. If you ask me: I guess it's the ground water. Someone has to enter the caverns underneath Cormaya and investigate. ...
'''Yoem''': In the east of the island there are tunnels where we often spot were-beasts at night. Perhaps you should start there.
'''Após realizar a missão.''' ''Jogador'': '''Curse'''
'''Yoem''': So I was right, it is the ground water! Please try to reverse this contamination. Unfortunately, I don't know anything about magic or arcane matters. But you could ask somebody at the Magic Academy of Edron.
'''Missão: Purificando a Origem do Mal''' '''Após realizar a missão.''' ''Jogador'': '''Curse'''
'''Yoem''': You succeeded! Thank you very much for your help, my friend. Please return to Edron and tell Daniel Steelsoul about it, he will be interested in this outcome, too.
''Jogador'': '''Bye'''
'''Yoem''': Good bye, ''Jogador''. }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

'''Rabaz''': Ah, a customer! Please feel free to browse my wares, ''Jogador''. ''Jogador'': '''job'''
'''Rabaz''': I was sent by the Edron academy to help the kingdom’s dwarven allies with magical supplies. You have no idea what an enormous logistic problem this poses. …
'''Rabaz''': Actually, I had no idea either. Supplies are short and dwarfs are stubborn. This combination works not too well, you know? The dwarfs are not too supportive towards my efforts and my main customers are adventurers like you. …
'''Rabaz''': I’m not sure if this is what the academy leaders had in mind with their help, so I wouldn’t be too surprised if they would pull off the support and abandon this shop. …
'''Rabaz''': Only time will tell how things develop. For now, they are content with this status quo. ''Jogador'': '''wares''' / '''offer''' / '''buy''' / '''sell''' / '''stuff''' / '''equipment''' / '''goods'''
'''Rabaz''': I’m selling spirit, health and mana potions, runes, wands, rods and spellbooks. If you’d like to see all of my offers, ask me for a trade. ''Jogador'': '''wand'''
'''Rabaz''': Wands can be wielded by sorcerers only and have a certain level requirement. There are eight different wands, would you like to hear about them? ''Jogador'': '''rod'''
'''Rabaz''': Rods can be wielded by druids only and have a certain level requirement. There are eight different rods, would you like to hear about them? ''Jogador'': '''farmine'''
'''Rabaz''': I really hope those dwarfs know what they are doing. I feel not too comfortable with a few tons of stone over my head. …
'''Rabaz''': If the dwarfs are not cautious, the whole mountain might come down on us. ''Jogador'': '''ongulf'''
'''Rabaz''': He is quite loud for such a short person. Sometimes you might be scared if he’s talking to you at that volume, but I guess in the course of time, you’ll get accustomed to that. ''Jogador'': '''excalibug'''
'''Rabaz''': Adventurers constantly come up with some stories and half-truths about this weapon. For instance, some claim the weapon has been found and was taken away by the gods. …
'''Rabaz''': This, however, is based on a completely unrelated story of Tibia’s history. After all these years it’s quite hard to figure out what is fact and what is myth. ''Jogador'': '''trade'''
'''Rabaz''': Have a look. But perhaps you just want to see my potions, wands or runes? ''Jogador'': '''academy'''
'''Rabaz''': The academy has quite a reputation in the fields of knowledge and research. ''Jogador'': '''mines'''
'''Rabaz''': Those dwarfs are so obsessed with mines. You could spend some weeks just learning their different words for mines and the difference in their meaning. …
'''Rabaz''': To me ‘mine’ only translates to ‘dark and damp cave’. ''Jogador'': '''mining guild'''
'''Rabaz''': You have no idea how stubborn the officials of this guild are. If I should ever again think of my superiors back in Edron as stubborn and inflexible, someone should slap me in the face. ''Jogador'': '''caves'''
'''Rabaz''': Well, you can carve a room into some cave and even decorate it. To me it’s still a cave. …
'''Rabaz''': The thought of having tons of stone and rock above me, just waiting to come crushing down on me, is not very encouraging. ''Jogador'': '''deposit'''
'''Rabaz''': Well, you could ask me for a trade to deposit your flasks, but you can also do it old style. I will pay you 5 gold for every empty vial and potion flask. Ok? ''Jogador'': '''fluid'''
'''Rabaz''': Sorry, we removed the old life and mana fluids from our assortment. However, we offer health, spirit and mana potions in up to four sizes, just ask me for a trade. ''Jogador'': '''kazordoon'''
'''Rabaz''': A town only dwarfs can love. No daylight at all. The smell of earth and fire everywhere. Well, actually it’s like here but a bit cleaner . ''Jogador'': '''botany'''
'''Rabaz''': Ah yes, my new passion. It is pure fascination that led me to write a book about plants. Via my great almanach of botany I will bring the diversity and beauty of plants nearer to everyone in Tibia. ''Jogador'': '''almanach'''
'''Rabaz''': The book I am currently writing delves into the world of plants. It will cover every plant found in Tibia, including an appendix with newly discovered species in Zao such as the strange corrupted and deformed growths found within its borders. …
'''Rabaz''': While visibly corrupted, these plants have their own very special beauty every botanist or lover of nature will surely comprehend. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Rabaz''': Good bye. }}

pages.title: Prezil
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Prezil | sprite = Dwarf Geomancer | job = Sacerdote | city = Zao | subarea = Farmine | location = [[Farmine]] ({{mapa|33028,31522,11:2|aqui}}). | buysell = não | implemented = 8.54 | notes =

* Você pode conseguir uma pedra especial falando '''Hi - Adventurer's stone - Yes''' para este NPC. * Se você usar uma [[Adventurer's Stone]] dentro de templo, você será teleportado para pequena ilha da [[Adventurers' Guild]].

| falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
[[Prezil]]: Welcome, adventurer ''Jogador''! What brings you here?
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''
[[Prezil]]: I'm Prezil.
''Jogador:'' '''Here''' Ou '''Job'''
[[Prezil]]: Building the '''temple''' is progressing slowly, but steadily. It's not all about setting up statues, you know - you also need to pray to the right spirits and channel the energies that flow through this mountain.
''Jogador:'' '''Temple'''
[[Prezil]]: This temple has a slow start but we dwarfs are patient like stone. One day, this temple might become an important place, particularly when thinking of the sickness of this land.
''Jogador:'' '''Land''' Ou '''Zao''' Ou '''Sickness'''
[[Prezil]]: There is a force of corruption at work in this land. It is not the destruction caused by humanoids but something else. ...
[[Prezil]]: It's like a hidden plague. Something that takes away the strength of earth and life itself. ...
[[Prezil]]: I have no idea what it is or what its source might be, but its presence haunts me even in my dreams.
''Jogador:'' '''Dragons'''
[[Prezil]]: Dragons that rule over an empire of minions are an alarming turn of events. I never heard that dragons did something like this before. ...
[[Prezil]]: Those changes confuse me but we will adapt in the course of time.
''Jogador:'' '''Lizards'''
[[Prezil]]: It's obvious that a new path often leads to new enemies. Now that the path has been chosen, we'll have to cope with the problem.
''Jogador:'' '''Orcs'''
[[Prezil]]: Orcs are a known threat - an enemy we know all too well. At least we know how to handle them. However, their strange alliance with the minotaurs is something that we've only noticed now.
''Jogador:'' '''Minotaurs'''
[[Prezil]]: We'll see if they keep their word. We'll see if they hold the reigns of the orcish horde. And we'll see how long they will survive in this savage land at all.
''Jogador:'' '''Earth'''
[[Prezil]]: The embrace of the earth is strong here. I can feel ancient powers running just like veins of ore run through a mountain. ...
[[Prezil]]: But I also sense a '''sickness''' that is spreading. Something unhealthy winds its way through the streams of power in this land. ...
[[Prezil]]: It is not very strong here, but I can feel its source far in the north. ...
[[Prezil]]: I'm able to ward it off our base for now, but it will become stronger and stronger with each year passing.
''Jogador:'' '''Fire'''
[[Prezil]]: I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
[[Prezil]]: Farewell, ''Jogador''! |}}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.title: Ongulf
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Ongulf | job = Líder de Expedição | city = Zao | subarea = Farmine | location = [[Farmine]] ({{Mapa|33016,31535,10:1|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.54 | buysell = não | notes = Ele é o líder dos anões que estão trabalhando noite e dia para aumentar a expansão da Farmine. Ele precisa de ajuda para encontrar o caminho de saída das montanhas.

* Faz parte da [[The New Frontier Quest]].

| falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
[[Ongulf]]: Hello.
''Jogador:'' '''Dwarf'''
[[Ongulf]]: You humans often think of us [[dwarfs]] as a shorter version of yourself. As a matter of fact we are quite different. ...
[[Ongulf]]: You'd have a hard time to understand our society and personality, and of course each dwarf is different just like there are no two rocks alike. Members of our race still have much in common, and we even have some things in common with humans. ...
[[Ongulf]]: You have to find out yourself which things. Form your own opinion and have a mind of your own.
''Jogador:'' '''Humans'''
[[Ongulf]]: Well, considering the sheer number of humans, it wouldn't surprise me if we encountered some humans in this new land. They are primitive but at least not hostile. ...
[[Ongulf]]: Maybe we can settle some mutual agreement of help in some way.
''Jogador:'' '''Project'''
[[Ongulf]]: Well, it's a long story but you really should listen to understand what is going on here. You can also hear a short version of the story, but then don't blame me if you mess something up due to your undwarfish impatience. ...
[[Ongulf]]: So what would you like to hear, the long story or the short version?
''Jogador:'' '''Long'''
[[Ongulf]]: After centuries the resources beneath and around the Big Old One became alarmingly short. Some decades ago, the imperial mining guild financed a project to search and establish new mines far away from Kazordoon. ...
[[Ongulf]]: After several tries with mixed success, the project of the technomancers proved the most successful. Their steamships studied and mapped the great underwater rivers deep beneath the earth. ...
[[Ongulf]]: With the help of certain apparatuses, they tracked deposits of ore and compiled ship routes to reach them. These mining bases had some obvious advantages and disadvantages. ...
[[Ongulf]]: The suitable spots had no connection to the surface. On the one hand, this meant that the new mines were safe from most kinds of beasts. On the other hand, it meant that all food and material had to be brought there by ship. ...
[[Ongulf]]: Special, heavy ships were built to carry ore and supplies back and forth. The only limitation for such bases had been the range of the steamships. ...
[[Ongulf]]: Recently, the technomancers with the help of the temples of fire and earth made some crucial discoveries that allowed the ships to extend their cruising range almost limitlessly. ...
[[Ongulf]]: The survey ships of the technomancers were once again sent out to find new, promising resources. ...
[[Ongulf]]: Sadly some of the ships never returned and others only found minor deposits of ore, not worth the effort. But one of the ships made some groundbreaking discovery - a cave that had a connection to the surface. ...
[[Ongulf]]: As far as the explorers could tell, the area had been unknown to dwarfhood and mankind so far. ...
[[Ongulf]]: What was more, the said cave system had an abundance of rare ores. The imperial mining guild agreed to fund a new project and to name it 'project far far away'. ...
[[Ongulf]]: Don't look at me, I'm not the one who came up with that name! Those technomancers are such an imaginative bunch. But where have we been? Oh, yes, the new project! ...
[[Ongulf]]: Well, some ships were sent to establish a first base. ...
[[Ongulf]]: It became painfully obvious that the number of workers needed there could not easily be supplied by the ships alone. Also such a base would require an amount of money, expertise and manpower that the guild could not provide. ...
[[Ongulf]]: We would need help and additional resources. That's were you come into play. If you are interested, let's talk about possible missions.
''Jogador:'' '''Orcs'''
[[Ongulf]]: The orcs out there make me nervous but at least for now they seem to be kept at bay by their minotaur masters.
''Jogador:'' '''Minotaurs'''
[[Ongulf]]: I am still surprised by the role the minotaurs are playing in this land. I wouldn't consider them allies but in this strange new land, they are the closest thing to allies we have for now.
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
[[Ongulf]]: Bye.
|}}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

 | falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == Não possui. == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Maritima''': Oh hello, visitor from the dry land. ''Jogador'': '''job''' / '''visitor'''
'''Maritima''': I'm a mermaid. I sing songs and play with the fishes. ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Maritima''': I'm Maritima. ''Jogador'': '''fishes'''
'''Maritima''': Fishes are my friends. I really hate that the quara treat them so badly. ''Jogador'': '''quara'''
'''Maritima''': The quara in this area are a strange race that seeks inner perfection rather than a physical one. ...
'''Maritima''': Considering that they are quara, they are rather peaceful as long no one enters their territory. ...
'''Maritima''': However, recently the quara got mad because their area is flooded with toxic sewage from the city. If you could inform someone about it, they might stop the sewage and the quara could return to their own business. ''Jogador'': '''yalahar'''
'''Maritima''': I've only seen the city from afar. ''Jogador'': '''yalahari'''
'''Maritima''': Some centuries ago, the Yalahari used to visit the bottom of the ocean. Then all of a sudden, their visits ended. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Maritima''': Use your knowledge wisely, ''Jogador''. }}

pages.title: Xorlosh
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Xorlosh | job = Mineiro | city = Yalahar | subarea = Beregar, Beregar Mines | location = [[Beregar Mines]] ({{mapa|32613,31499,14:2|aqui}}). | buysell = não | implemented = 8.4 | notes = Ele cuida do elevador de mineração e outras questões mecânicas em Beregar.

* Faz parte da [[The Hidden City of Beregar Quest]].

| falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == '''Xorlosh''': I'll never get it working again.
'''Xorlosh''': Sigh! I need to get that elevator working! == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Xorlosh''': Who are you? Are you a genius in mechanics? You don't look like one. ''Jogador'': '''job'''
'''Xorlosh''': Best mechanic in town. ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Xorlosh''': My name is Xorlosh and I'm the best mechanic here at Beregar! ''Jogador'': '''beer'''
'''Xorlosh''': Go ask Grombur, he always has a cask at his side. ''Jogador'': '''beregar'''
'''Xorlosh''': Our great citadel is a masterpiece of dwarven workmanship. I'm afraid only dwarfs are allowed to enter the deeper parts of the city. ''Jogador'': '''book'''
'''Xorlosh''': The book about tunnelling is in the library which is located in the north eastern wing of Beregar city. ''Jogador'': '''busy''' / '''elevator'''
'''Xorlosh''': Some son of a rotworm put WAY too much stuff in this elevator and now it's broken. I could do with some help to fix it. ''Jogador'': '''frafnar'''
'''Xorlosh''': To be honest....he goes on and on and on about his romantic issues. It's getting annoying. ''Jogador'': '''gear wheels'''
'''Xorlosh''': They are crooked. I could do with some help to fix them. ''Jogador'': '''grombur'''
'''Xorlosh''': He's not a bad guy. He knows how to drink, he's strong and... well, he's a dwarf like me and y... err... just like me. ''Jogador'': '''mechanic'''
'''Xorlosh''': I'd love to chat with you about the high art of mechanics but I'm too busy. ''Jogador'': '''mine'''
'''Xorlosh''': It's a crystal mine. Very rare crystals can be found here. We mine them and produce all kind of precious things out of them. Well, not me. I'm too clumsy for that kind of work so they promoted me to a guard! ...
'''Xorlosh''': I'm a good guard, no one without permission is allowed to enter. ''Jogador'': '''mission''' / '''quest'''
'''Xorlosh''': Hehe, they don't expect me to be done so quickly, so I PRETEND I'm not ready yet. Hrhrhrhr. ''Jogador'': '''rehal'''
'''Xorlosh''': He's a great emperor. You'll find him on his throne in the citadel. ''Jogador'': '''rerun'''
'''Xorlosh''': Haven't seen him for a while. Maybe he's in one of the mines. ''Jogador'': '''tunnel''' / '''emperor''' / '''problem'''
'''Xorlosh''': There should be a book in our library about tunnelling. I don't have that much time to talk to you about that. ...
'''Xorlosh''': If you want to have some information, you'll just have to find that book. If you need some equipment, go ask Harog. You'll find the library in the north eastern wing of Beregar city. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Xorlosh''': Alright, back to work. }}

pages.title: Tehlim
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} 
| name        = Tehlim
| job         = Roleplay
| city        = Yalahar
| subarea     = Beregar, Beregar Mines
| location    = [[Beregar Mines]] ({{Mapa|32728,31420,14:2|aqui}}).
| implemented = 8.5
| buysell     = não
| notes       = Ele é o cozinheiro de uma expedição. O único que não foi pego pelos trolls.
| falas       = __NOTOC__
== Frases Espontâneas ==
'''Tehlim''': They must be rescued!</br>
'''Tehlim''': Oh no, no, NO! Whatever shall I do?

== Palavras-Chave ==
''Jogador'': '''hi'''</br>
'''Tehlim''': Hello. I'm so glad someone has found me. Did you meet THEM?!

''Jogador'': '''job''' / '''work'''</br>
'''Tehlim''': I'm the cook for the expedition party. The only one who didn't get cought by those.... those MONSTERS.

''Jogador'': '''name'''</br>
'''Tehlim''': They call me Tehlim Madtreat. I can make a meal from almost anything.

''Jogador'': '''ab'dendriel''' / '''carlin''' / '''venore''' / '''thais''' / '''darama''' / '''darashia''' / '''folda''' / '''vega''' / '''senja''' / '''ice islands'''</br>
'''Tehlim''': The only place I know is Beregar. My home.

''Jogador'': '''alone''' / '''other'''</br>
'''Tehlim''': The other members of the expedition have either been killed or imprisoned by the trolls.

''Jogador'': '''attack''' / '''they''' / '''them'''</br>
'''Tehlim''': We were attacked by some sort of assassin trolls or something. They came over us like a storm and in the blink of an eye it was over... everyone was either killed or captured.

''Jogador'': '''beer'''</br>
'''Tehlim''': I could do with one right now.

''Jogador'': '''buy''' / '''sell'''</br>
'''Tehlim''': What kind of rescue party are you?! I neither have wares to sell nor do I want to buy something.

''Jogador'': '''captain'''</br>
'''Tehlim''': Ships have captains. Dwarfs usually don't have ships so we don't have captains. Smart, huh?

''Jogador'': '''dwarf'''</br>
'''Tehlim''': I won't tell you the secret of our success. No!

''Jogador'': '''fish''' / '''water''' / '''ship'''</br>
'''Tehlim''': I hate ships! I hate water! I hate fish! So let's talk about something different.

''Jogador'': '''food''' / '''meal''' / '''inventions''' / '''inventors'''</br>
'''Tehlim''': I am famous for having invented the most amazing meal ever known to dwarven kind! I call it 'hangman's relish'. I am not going to tell you the recipe, buuuut it contains lots of brown ale, special mushrooms and ground soapstone. Delicious!

''Jogador'': '''kazordoon'''</br>
'''Tehlim''': Uhh yes, I heard the stories about the lost tribe. Really interesting. There are rumours that they used these old tunnels around here when they left Beregar.

''Jogador'': '''mine'''</br>
'''Tehlim''': This part of the mine was abandoned a long time ago. There are no crystals left. The expedition had the task to check for new veins of crystal... but before we could find one, THEY found us.

''Jogador'': '''mission''' / '''quest'''</br>
'''Tehlim''': I have nothing more for you to do. You could keep me company, if you wanted to. We could cook something, play a game or.... mock some trolls. Hrhrhrhrhr.

''Jogador'': '''rehal'''</br>
'''Tehlim''': His son Rehon was with us. I don't know if he survived the troll attack.

''Jogador'': '''rehon'''</br>
'''Tehlim''': You have to search the area for him. If he's still alive then rescue him... if not... you'll have to be the one to tell his father. I'm sorry.

''Jogador'': '''technomancer'''</br>
'''Tehlim''': Ahhh, forget technomancers, pyromancers are way better. Never seen one, huh? Figures. They are kind of shy.

''Jogador'': '''tibia'''</br>
'''Tehlim''': Beregar is our world. We don't want to be drawn in to any of your kind's conflicts.

''Jogador'': '''troll'''</br>
'''Tehlim''': Their hideout must be somewhere in the ore wagon tunnels. If you want to help me find Rehon and the others just ask me for a mission.

''Jogador'': '''what'''</br>
'''Tehlim''': The expedition had the task to check for new veins of crystal....but before we could find one, THEY found us. Those trolls are.... different.

''Jogador'': '''yalahar'''</br>
'''Tehlim''': Wasn't that destroyed ages ago? Whatever, it makes no difference to me.

''Jogador'': '''bye'''</br>
'''Tehlim''': See you soon, right?
}}

pages.title: Rehon
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Rehon | job = Roleplay | city = Yalahar | subarea = Beregar, Beregar Mines | location = [[Beregar Mines]] ({{mapa|32760,31376,15:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.5 | buysell = sim | buys = Nada. | notes = Filho do [[Emperor Rehal|Imperador Rehal]].

* Faz parte da [[The Hidden City of Beregar Quest]].

| sells = {{Ensina | Bruise Bane | Light | Wound Cleansing | Find Person | Great Light | Cure Poison}} | falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == '''Rehon''': Will I ever get out of here?
'''Rehon''': It's about time someone showed up! Maybe you are more chatty than my skinny friend here!
'''Rehon''': Hey skeleton, my friend, what do you think? == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi''' / '''hiho'''
'''Rehon''': Hello, my friend. ''Jogador'': '''job'''
'''Rehon''': Me and my expedition party were supposed to find new crystal veins here in the old mine tunnels. ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Rehon''': I'm Rehon, son of Rehal. Don't be afraid, I don't bite. ''Jogador'': '''ab'dendriel''' / '''ankrahmun''' / '''carlin''' / '''thais''' / '''venore''' / '''darashia''' / '''svargrond''' / '''port hope''' / '''liberty bay''' / '''edron'''
'''Rehon''': I have never visited one of your cities. Once you have seen Beregar, you don't need to go anywhere else. ''Jogador'': '''beregar'''
'''Rehon''': Lovely, huh? The shady lights, the smell of iron and stone. Ahhh, it's time I got back there. ''Jogador'': '''bolfona'''
'''Rehon''': Don't mess with her - you'll lose. I promise. ''Jogador'': '''drog'''
'''Rehon''': He's a drunkard but a good worker... at least when he's drunk. ''Jogador'': '''dwarf''' / '''expedition''' / '''member''' / '''other''' / '''rest'''
'''Rehon''': I can't be completely sure, but I don't believe anyone else survived the troll attacks. ''Jogador'': '''frafnar'''
'''Rehon''': Oh well, he's kind of..... strange, but basically he's alright. I heard he likes Bolfona . ''Jogador'': '''grombur'''
'''Rehon''': He's on the right way to become the drunkard of the year. ''Jogador'': '''harog'''
'''Rehon''': Hah! When you find out how he makes his money you'll laugh! He sells rotworm urine as rust remover and earns a fortune with it. Muahahahahaha! ''Jogador'': '''hero'''
'''Rehon''': You're kiddin' me.... just get me out of here! ''Jogador'': '''knight'''
'''Rehon''': All dwarfs know how to fight. There is no need to have a special vocation for that. ''Jogador'': '''nokmir'''
'''Rehon''': He's a really good soul. Whenever you're in trouble Nokmir will help you. He covered up for me soooo many times when I was little. ''Jogador'': '''poem'''
'''Rehon''': Get me out of here NOW!! And don't you dare to complain about the rhyme! ''Jogador'': '''rehal'''
'''Rehon''': He's a wise emperor and a good father but I can't imagine being an emperor myself. ''Jogador'': '''rescue'''
'''Rehon''': By the Gods, it's about time someone showed up to rescue me. ''Jogador'': '''spell'''
'''Rehon''': Sorry, I don't teach spells for your vocation. ''Jogador'': '''spellbook'''
'''Rehon''': Do I look like a sorcerer? ''Jogador'': '''tehlim'''
'''Rehon''': Tehlim is alive?!? Well, at least he won't starve down in the tunnels. Hehehehe. ''Jogador'': '''tibia'''
'''Rehon''': The stone we walk on, the air we breathe... or in this case, the rubbish and the stench that surrounds us. ''Jogador'': '''time'''
'''Rehon''': It's time to leave this filthy place. ''Jogador'': '''troll'''
'''Rehon''': I have never seen such well-trained trolls. I wonder if there is a conspiracy behind that. ''Jogador'': '''vocation'''
'''Rehon''': I'd say I'm an explorer and adventurer. Always in trouble. Hehehehe. ''Jogador'': '''xorlosh'''
'''Rehon''': He has a talent for repairing things. He wasn't trained in that but he has a feel for it instinctively, you know what I mean? I can't really explain how he does what he does. ''Jogador'': '''yalahar'''
'''Rehon''': Those Yalaharians are crazy. Good for nothing but trouble. I prefer to stay in Beregar. ''Jogador'': '''farewell'''
'''Rehon''': Don't leave me to rot down here. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Rehon''': Leave without me. I'll sneak out on my own. }}

pages.title: Emperor Rehal
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Emperor Rehal | job = Imperador | city = Yalahar | subarea = Beregar | location = [[Beregar]] ({{mapa|32583,31402,8:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.4 | notes = Emperor Rehal é o líder da cidade oculta de Beregar. Cumprimente-o falando "Hail Emperor" ou então ele irá ignorá-lo. Se você o xingar, seus guardas irão te atacar, te deixando com 1 ponto de vida. Você também pode comprar uma promoção para sua vocação com ele a partir de 20,000 gps.

* Faz parte da [[The Hidden City of Beregar Quest]].

| buysell = sim | buys = Nada. | sells = {{Trades/Sell |Vocation Promotion }} | falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == Não possui. == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hail emperor''' / '''salutations emperor''' / '''hello emperor'''
'''Emperor Rehal''': May Fire and Earth bless you, stranger. What leads you to Beregar, the dwarven city? ''Jogador'': '''job'''
'''Emperor Rehal''': I'm the Emperor of the Dwarfs of Beregar. ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Emperor Rehal''': I'm Emperor Rehal, Son of Fire and Earth. ''Jogador'': '''age'''
'''Emperor Rehal''': Believe me. I'm OLD. ''Jogador'': '''castle'''
'''Emperor Rehal''': Our castle is the mountain above our heads. ''Jogador'': '''cave''' / '''treasure''' / '''dragon'''
'''Emperor Rehal''': There's a legend about a dragon lord so greedy that he continued his dire existence even after his death in order to guard his ill-gotten gains. The legend says that he guards a treasure of enormous value. ''Jogador'': '''dungeons'''
'''Emperor Rehal''': Do you mean that big cave under Beregar? Be careful down there, you won't find anything there except for horror and death. ''Jogador'': '''help'''
'''Emperor Rehal''': I'm afraid you have come to the wrong place to ask for help. ''Jogador'': '''heroes'''
'''Emperor Rehal''': There have been many heroes among the dwarfs, and there always will be. ''Jogador'': '''monsters'''
'''Emperor Rehal''': Every dwarf receives basic training in combat skills. Be careful down in the mines. They may mistake you for a monster. ''Jogador'': '''sell'''
'''Emperor Rehal''': Feel free to give it a try, but I'm afraid you'll have problems getting equipment here. My people are not used to your kind and may act dismissively. ''Jogador'': '''tibia''' / '''lands'''
'''Emperor Rehal''': For us citizens of Beregar, this mountain and this city are all that matters. ''Jogador'': '''beregar'''
'''Emperor Rehal''': You won't be allowed to enter the main parts of Beregar. The city is divided into three parts. We have two living quarters for the two different tribes, and one community quarter. ...
'''Emperor Rehal''': Unfortunately, one of the living quarters is abandoned as one of the tribes left Beregar when Tibia was still young. ''Jogador'': '''citizen'''
'''Emperor Rehal''': Sorry, only dwarfs born and bred in Beregar are allowed to call themselves citizens. ''Jogador'': '''guild'''
'''Emperor Rehal''': Our guild halls are not accessible for anyone other than the inhabitants of Beregar. ''Jogador'': '''kazordoon'''
'''Emperor Rehal''': So the lost tribe found itself a new home. This is good news indeed. ''Jogador'': '''news'''
'''Emperor Rehal''': Not many people have visited Beregar these past years, so news is....let's say....scarce. ''Jogador'': '''worries'''
'''Emperor Rehal''': In the early years of Tibia, there were two tribes in Beregar. A conflict between the tribes led to one of the tribes leaving Beregar for good. ''Jogador'': '''conflict'''
'''Emperor Rehal''': I'm afraid you have to be a dwarf to truly understand what the conflict was about. ''Jogador'': '''father'''
'''Emperor Rehal''': My father was Ransar Crystalvein. It was he who discovered the huge deposit of crystals in the eastern mine. ''Jogador'': '''army'''
'''Emperor Rehal''': We neither have nor need an army. ''Jogador'': '''justice'''
'''Emperor Rehal''': Well, justice is a tricky thing. Can one be just to everybody at once, and if not, to whom should one be just? ''Jogador'': '''order''' / '''chaos'''
'''Emperor Rehal''': Chaos cannot exist without order but the reverse is also true, order cannot exist without chaos. ''Jogador'': '''time'''
'''Emperor Rehal''': Your kind has a different perception of time to us. When a dwarf tells you that something may not take too long, it will probably take much longer than you expected. ''Jogador'': '''druid'''
'''Emperor Rehal''': Not a very common profession among dwarfs. ''Jogador'': '''knight'''
'''Emperor Rehal''': Our guards are well trained but I wouldn't call them 'knights'. ''Jogador'': '''paladin'''
'''Emperor Rehal''': We prefer fighting with an axe in our hands. ''Jogador'': '''sorcerer'''
'''Emperor Rehal''': Among us dwarfs, you'll find Masters of Earth, the so called geomancers, and Masters of Fire, the pyromancers. ''Jogador'': '''elves'''
'''Emperor Rehal''': Hmm, I've heard of them but I've never seen or talked to one. I don't think they would like to be deep down in the belly of a mountain. ''Jogador'': '''nokmir'''
'''Emperor Rehal''': I always liked him and I still can't believe that he really stole that ring. ''Jogador'': '''grombur'''
'''Emperor Rehal''': He's very ambitious and always volunteers for the long shifts. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Emperor Rehal''': Farewell, ''Jogador''! }}

pages.title: Pythius The Rotten
pages.wikitext:
{{DASH|''Esta página é sobre o '''NPC''' Pythius The Rotten, se você quer a criatura, veja [[Pythius The Rotten (Criatura)]]''.}}{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Pythius The Rotten | job = Guarda | city = Yalahar | subarea = Dragon Lair (Fenrock) | location = [[Dragon Lair (Fenrock)|Fenrock Dragon Lair]] ({{mapa|32589,31407,15:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.4 | buysell = não | notes = Pythius The Rotten é um Undead Dragon vivendo nas cavernas de Beregar. Ele afirma ter obtido o seu tesouro quando a civilização de Yalahar começou a decair.

* Faz parte da [[The Hidden City of Beregar Quest]]. * Para entrar no local de caça, diga: '''Hi - Offer - Yes - Golden Mug'''. Arquivo:Pythiustreasure.jpg|Pythius The Rotten guardando seu tesouro.

| falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == '''Pythius the Rotten''': COME CLOSER, MY FRIEND! == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Pythius the Rotten''': I AWAITED YOU! ''Jogador'': '''job'''
'''Pythius the Rotten''': INTERESTING QUESTION. WHAT IS MY JOB? I'D SAY I'M AN AMBASSADOR OF GREED! ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Pythius the Rotten''': ONCE I WAS PYTHIUS THE IGNITER, BUT NOWADAYS PEOPLE CALL ME PYTHIUS THE ROTTEN. ''Jogador'': '''awaited'''
'''Pythius the Rotten''': I HAVE A MISSION FOR YOU BUT YOU NEED TO DIE FIRST AND RETURN AS AN UNDEAD CREATURE. COME BACK TO ME WHEN YOU ACHIEVED THIS GOAL. ''Jogador'': '''undead'''
'''Pythius the Rotten''': BOON AND BANE. I HAVE CHOSEN THIS LIFE VOLUNTARILY AND NEVER REGRETTED IT. MY TREASURE IS GROWING BIGGER EACH DAY. ''Jogador'': '''dwarf'''
'''Pythius the Rotten''': THEY LEAVE ME ALONE AND I LEAVE THEM ALONE.....WELL, EXCEPT THIS ONE OLD DWARF WHO TUMBLED INTO MY CAVE LAST WEEK. HE SEEMED TO BE OLD. I BET HE DIDN'T EVEN SEE WHAT KILLED HIM. HAHAHAHA!! ''Jogador'': '''beregar''' / '''kazordoon'''
'''Pythius the Rotten''': DWARVES. THEY HIDE UNDER THEIR MOUNTAINS AND THINK THEY ARE SAFE THERE. ''Jogador'': '''dragon'''
'''Pythius the Rotten''': OUR RACE BECAME WEAK OVER THE TIME. I MADE A STEP INTO A BRIGHT FUTURE THAT I'D RECOMMEND TO EVERY OTHER DRAGON. NOWADAYS THEY ARE JUST FATSTOCK. I ABOMINATE THEM!! ''Jogador'': '''yalahar'''
'''Pythius the Rotten''': I HAVE SEEN THE GLANCE OF THIS CITY BACK IN THE DAYS AND I WATCHED THEM DOING THEIR RESEARCH. IT WAS FUNNY TO SEE THAT THEY COULDN'T HANDLE WHAT THEY EVOKED. I TOOK THEIR TREASURES AFTER THEY SLAUGHTERED THEMSELVES. HAHAHA! ''Jogador'': '''human'''
'''Pythius the Rotten''': FLESHY LITTLE BEINGS. I LIKE THEIR GREED! HOW ABOUT YOUR GREED? ARE YOU INTERESTED IN SOMETHING OUT OF MY TREASURE? ''Jogador'': '''axe''' / '''sword''' / '''club''' / '''weapon'''
'''Pythius the Rotten''': THERE IS NO WEAPON IN TIBIA THAT COULD HARM ME. ''Jogador'': '''knight'''
'''Pythius the Rotten''': WONDERFUL, WOULD YOU BE SO KIND AND SCRAPE OFF THAT PIECE OF FLESH FROM MY TOE! MUAHAHAHA!! ''Jogador'': '''druid''' / '''sorcerer'''
'''Pythius the Rotten''': SHOOT AT ME WHATEVER YOU WANT AND WAKE ME UP WHEN YOU ARE DONE. ''Jogador'': '''paladin'''
'''Pythius the Rotten''': CAN I BORROW AN ARROW OR BOLT FROM YOU? THERE IS A NASTY LITTLE PIECE OF DWARF STUCK BETWEEN MY TEETH! ''Jogador'': '''kill you'''
'''Pythius the Rotten''': DON'T KNOW IF YOU REALISED BUT YOU CAN'T KILL ME. I'M ALREADY DEAD.....AND BE CAREFUL HOW YOU TALK TO ME, OTHERWISE I MAY KILL YOU! ''Jogador'': '''carlin'''
'''Pythius the Rotten''': AHHHHH, THE BATTLE OF CARLIN. I CAN STILL SMELL THE BLOOD. ORK BLOOD, HUMAN BLOOD.....WHAT A FEAST. I GET HUNGRY WHEN I THINK OF THOSE DAYS. ''Jogador'': '''thais'''
'''Pythius the Rotten''': THE HOME OF YOUR LITTLE KINGS. HOW PATHETIC. ''Jogador'': '''transfer'''
'''Pythius the Rotten''': HAVE YOU SEEN THESE LEGENDARY ITEMS BACK THERE? WHO COULD REFUSE THE CHANCE OF OBTAINING ONE?!? SO WHAT IS YOUR ANSWER? ''Jogador'': '''dead'''
'''Pythius the Rotten''': I COULD PUT AN END TO YOUR ABSURD LITTLE LIFE. YOU'D SERVE ME AFTER DEATH AND YOU MAY HAVE SOMETHING OUT OF MY TREASURE. ''Jogador'': '''exchange'''
'''Pythius the Rotten''': EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY TREASURE. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!! ''Jogador'': '''greed'''
'''Pythius the Rotten''': NEVER UNDERESTIMATE THE POWER OF GREED. PEOPLE KILL OUT OF GREED, THEY GAIN POWER BECAUSE OF GREED AND SOME EVEN CONTINUE THEIR LIVES AFTER DEATH BECAUSE OF GREED. ''Jogador'': '''king'''
'''Pythius the Rotten''': I'VE SEEN MANY KINGS COME AND GO. THEY ALL THINK THEY RULE TIBIA BUT HAVE NO IDEA....HAHAHAHA!! ''Jogador'': '''how'''
'''Pythius the Rotten''': THIS IS MY SECRET AND WILL NEVER, EVER BE REVEALED TO A LIVING BEING. ''Jogador'': '''offer'''
'''Pythius the Rotten''': I GRANT YOU ACCESS TO THE DUNGEON IN THE NORTH. YOU'LL FIND SOME OF MY LIVING BROTHERS THERE....BUT.....EVERY TIME YOU WANT TO ENTER YOU HAVE TO GIVE ME SOMETHING PRECIOUS. ALRIGHT? ''Jogador'': '''tibia'''
'''Pythius the Rotten''': I'VE SEEN THIS WHOLE CONTINENT, EVEN THOSE PLACES YOU DON'T KNOW THEY EXIST. I FOUGHT WARS FOR DIFFERENT RACES AND I HAVE SEEN CIVILISATIONS RISE AND FALL. ''Jogador'': '''mission'''
'''Pythius the Rotten''': I HAVE A MISSION FOR YOU BUT YOU NEED TO DIE FIRST AND RETURN AS AN UNDEAD CREATURE. COME BACK TO ME WHEN YOU ACHIEVED THIS GOAL. ''Jogador'': '''treasure'''
'''Pythius the Rotten''': LIKE MY TREASURE? WANNA PICK SOMETHING OUT OF IT? :''Jogador'': '''yes'''
:'''Pythius the Rotten''': HAHAHA, WHO WOULD SAY SOMETHING ELSE?....BUT....NOTHING'S FOR FREE AND SO WASN'T THE TREASURE BEHIND ME. ...
:'''Pythius the Rotten''': BRING ME SOMETHING VALUABLE IN EXCHANGE. SOMETHING YOU THINK I'D LIKE AND THEN.....HAHAHAHA......WE CAN CONTINUE OUR SMALL CONVERSATION.
:'''Pythius the Rotten''': EVERYTHING YOU CARRY WITH YOU CAN ALSO BE FOUND IN MY TREASURE. BRING ME SOMETHING I DON'T OWN!!! :''Jogador'': '''''palavra aleatória'''''
:'''Pythius the Rotten''': HAVE YOU SEEN THESE LEGENDARY ITEMS BACK THERE? WHO COULD REFUSE THE CHANCE OF OBTAINING ONE?!? SO WHAT IS YOUR ANSWER? ''Jogador'': '''offer'''
'''Pythius the Rotten''': I GRANT YOU ACCESS TO THE DUNGEON IN THE NORTH. YOU'LL FIND SOME OF MY LIVING BROTHERS THERE....BUT.....EVERY TIME YOU WANT TO ENTER YOU HAVE TO GIVE ME SOMETHING PRECIOUS. ALRIGHT? :''Jogador'': '''yes'''
:'''Pythius the Rotten''': AS YOU WISH. WHAT DO YOU HAVE TO OFFER? ::''Jogador'': '''golden mug'''
::'''Pythius the Rotten''': I LIKE THAT AND GRANT YOU ACCESS TO THE DUNGEON IN THE NORTH FOR THE NEXT FEW MINUTES. COME BACK ANYTIME AND BRING ME MORE TREASURES. ::''Jogador'': '''''palavra aleatória'''''
::'''Pythius the Rotten''': THIS IS NOT WORTH BEING PART OF MY TREASURE! BRING ME SOMETHING ELSE. ''Jogador'': '''dragon scale legs'''

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Nokmir | job = Guarda | city = Yalahar | subarea = Beregar, Beregar Mines | location = [[Beregar Mines]] ({{Mapa|32607,31491,14:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.4 | buysell = não | notes = Ele guarda a mina norte de Beregar.

* Faz parte da [[The Hidden City of Beregar Quest]].

| falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == Não possui. == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Nokmir''': You are....kind of tall! Hello. What brings you here? ''Jogador'': '''job''' / '''here'''
'''Nokmir''': I guard the entrance to the northern part of the mine. ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Nokmir''': My name is Nokmir. ''Jogador'': '''mine'''
'''Nokmir''': It's a crystal mine. Nothing special, at least not for a dwarf. ''Jogador'': '''dwarf'''
'''Nokmir''': Yes, I'm a dwarf and you are standing in the crystal mines of Beregar. ''Jogador'': '''beregar''' / '''city'''
'''Nokmir''': Yes, these are the crystal mines of Beregar. The city itself is just above. Just go up the stairs south of here and you're almost there. ''Jogador'': '''emperor rehal'''
'''Nokmir''': He's a good emperor but I doubt he is wise enough to see the truth behind that false accusation against me. If just someone would find out the truth about that whole mess. ''Jogador'': '''grombur'''
'''Nokmir''': Sooner or later, his drinking will get him into trouble. I promise. ''Jogador'': '''frafnar'''
'''Nokmir''': I try to stay away from him, he really annoys me with his 'I'm sooooo in love' chitchat. ''Jogador'': '''xorlosh'''
'''Nokmir''': He is a genius in mechanical issues. You find him south of here at the elevator. ''Jogador'': '''beer'''
'''Nokmir''': I don't drink beer at work anymore. It just causes trouble. ''Jogador'': '''rerun'''
'''Nokmir''': I heard that Emperor Rehal imprisoned him. I never thought that he would be able to do such a malicious act. ''Jogador'': '''ring'''
'''Nokmir''': I doubt Rerun will need it in prison. ''Jogador'': '''help''' / '''mission'''
'''Nokmir''': You've already helped me soooo much. I wouldn't dare bothering you again. ''Jogador'': '''what''' / '''where'''
'''Nokmir''': You are in the mines of Beregar. Made your way through the lava cave, huh? Not bad. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Nokmir''': Bye. Enjoy your stay here in Beregar. }}

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Grombur | job = Guarda | city = Yalahar | subarea = Beregar, Beregar Mines | location = [[Beregar Mines]] ({{mapa|32611,31514,14:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.4 | buysell = não | notes = Ele guarda as mina sul de Beregar.

* Faz parte da [[The Hidden City of Beregar Quest]].

| falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == '''Grombur''': Darn! How could I get more beer without leaving my post?
'''Grombur''': What shall we do with the drunken dwaharf! Lalala! == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Grombur''': STOP RIGHT THERE!..... Oh, just a human. What's up big guy? Why do you disturb me? ''Jogador'': '''job'''
'''Grombur''': I AM GROMBUR GOLDTOOTH, GUARD OF THIS MINE HERE! No one is allowed to enter. ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Grombur''': You haven't heard anything about me yet?! I aehhhhhhohoh........sorry....I AM GROMBUR GOLDTOOTH, GUARD OF THIS MINE HERE!...Impressive, huh? ''Jogador'': '''beer'''
'''Grombur''': THAT is a problem....I tell you. My shift lasts for 48 hours and no one cares about my thirst. That's such a shame! The barrel over there is already empty and I still have 37 hours to go. ''Jogador'': '''beregar'''
'''Grombur''': Congrats on finding it! We don't get many visitors here. ''Jogador'': '''disturb'''
'''Grombur''': I AM GROMBUR GOLDTOOTH, GUARD OF THIS MINE HERE! No one is allowed to enter. ''Jogador'': '''dwarv''' / '''dwarf'''
'''Grombur''': Down here! Yes, here. I'm a dwarf. ''Jogador'': '''enter''' / '''permission'''
'''Grombur''': I already told you that you may enter, and now leave me with my cask........ahhhh. ''Jogador'': '''frafnar'''
'''Grombur''': What a wimp! 'Bolfona here, Bolfona there!'. ''Jogador'': '''guard'''
'''Grombur''': I love this job. No threat on this side of the door, and everyday I find someone stupid enough to bring me beer, hrhrhrhr. ''Jogador'': '''mine'''
'''Grombur''': It's a crystal mine. Very rare crystals can be found here. We mine them and produce all kind of precious things out of them. Well, not me. I'm too clumsy for this kind of work so, they PROMOTED me to a guard! ...
'''Grombur''': I'm a good guard, no one without permission is allowed to enter. ''Jogador'': '''mission''' / '''quest'''
'''Grombur''': No more trouble for me, no more work for you. Leave me alone with my cask. ''Jogador'': '''nokmir'''
'''Grombur''': He is guarding the entrance to the northern mine if you're looking for him. ''Jogador'': '''promot'''
'''Grombur''': Every year the most honoured dwarf gets promoted. I for myself are not keen on being promoted. I prefer sitting here with my cask of beer. ''Jogador'': '''rehal'''
'''Grombur''': I don't mind who sits on that throne as long as I have enough to drink. ''Jogador'': '''rerun'''
'''Grombur''': I'm sure he's still drunk after THAT amount of beer he drank yesterday. ''Jogador'': '''ring'''
'''Grombur''': Oh well, I liked Nokmir. He used to be a good dwarf until that day on which he stole the ring from Rerun. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Grombur''': See ya....and don't sneak up on me next time. }}

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Frafnar | job = Guarda | city = Yalahar | subarea = Beregar, Beregar Mines | location = [[Beregar Mines]] ({{mapa|32586,31500,14:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.4 | buysell = não | notes = Ele guarda a mina oeste de Beregar.

* Faz parte da [[The Hidden City of Beregar Quest]].

| falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == '''Frafnar''': You're so beautiful like a gold vein that...makes me insane...ARGHH..NO
'''Frafnar''': My sweet chocolate pie, why don't you come by? UAHAHA, I'm so untalented!
'''Frafnar''': ...I love you like the most beautiful crystal I own....nonono == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Frafnar''': Don't you see that I'm trying to write a poem? So what's the matter? ''Jogador'': '''job'''
'''Frafnar''': I guard the entrance to the western part of the mine. ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Frafnar''': I'm Frafnar and I guard the entrance to the western part of the mine. ''Jogador'': '''beer'''
'''Frafnar''': I don't drink any beer until Bolfona agrees to drink one with me....or two. ''Jogador'': '''beregar'''
'''Frafnar''': The citadel under the mountain. How poetic! Maybe I could use that in my poem for Bolfona. ''Jogador'': '''bolfona'''
'''Frafnar''': She is sooooo beautiful, so feminine, so elegant. You'll find her in the tavern of Beregar. ''Jogador'': '''deeper mines'''
'''Frafnar''': They have been closed for ages. We dug too deep and woke up some ancient evil. ''Jogador'': '''dwarf''' / '''dwarv'''
'''Frafnar''': We may be small, but you better don't underestimate us. ''Jogador'': '''eastern wing'''
'''Frafnar''': From there the deeper parts of the city can be reached. Too bad for you that only dwarfs may enter there. ''Jogador'': '''mine'''
'''Frafnar''': It's a crystal mine. You know, long corridors, rails, ore wagons and....surprise...CRYSTALS. ''Jogador'': '''grombur'''
'''Frafnar''': He always stares on Bolfona. If he touches her ONE time, I promise I ..... Calm down Frafnar! Breathe deeply! Nothing happened. ''Jogador'': '''mission''' / '''quest'''
'''Frafnar''': Are you in love, too? Just asking because I also tend to forget things just seconds after they have been told me. ''Jogador'': '''nokmir'''
'''Frafnar''': Have you heard the news? He has stolen Rerun's ring. ''Jogador'': '''northern wing'''
'''Frafnar''': The emperor and his staff live there. ''Jogador'': '''poem'''
'''Frafnar''': I'm writing it for Bolfona. I'm rather a shy dwarf, you know. ''Jogador'': '''write'''
'''Frafnar''': I'm writing it for Bolfona. I'm rather a shy dwarf, you know. Don't dare to go to her and tell her about my feelings, but maybe you could help me. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Frafnar''': Yeye, I won't miss you! }}

'''Bolfona''': YES, I'm female. Got a problem with that?!?
'''Bolfona''': Come on guys, have a drink.
'''Bolfona''': Here's your beer, Drog! == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Bolfona''': Are you talking to me? Well, go on chatting but don't expect an answer. ''Jogador'': '''job'''
'''Bolfona''': I'm standing behind the counter in a tavern. What do you think I'm doing? ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Bolfona''': Who are you that you are interested in a dwarf woman?!? Pick someone of your own kind. ''Jogador'': '''beer''' / '''chocolate cake'''
'''Bolfona''': Did you hear something about old Borre? Haven't seen him for a while. ''Jogador'': '''beregar''' / '''rehal'''
'''Bolfona''': These 20 hour shifts kill me. ''Jogador'': '''buy''' / '''shop'''
'''Bolfona''': If you pay for it, no problem. ''Jogador'': '''chatting''' / '''tavern'''
'''Bolfona''': I am not sure if I'd like to trade with you. ''Jogador'': '''druid''' / '''sell'''
'''Bolfona''': I told you 1000 times, it's because of the mushrooms. They grow faster and so the flavour of the mushroom beer is better! ''Jogador'': '''dwarf''' / '''emperor'''
'''Bolfona''': Guys, I have a good one. Do you know the term for a foolish, tall being that roams through Beregar? ....It's a HUMAN! Hahahaha! ''Jogador'': '''food''' / '''meat'''
'''Bolfona''': Have you heard the rumours about that other dwarven city? ''Jogador'': '''grombur'''
'''Bolfona''': I'll give a good thrashing to the next lucky dwarf who spills beer on my counter. Understand?! ''Jogador'': '''ham''' / '''paladin'''
'''Bolfona''': Bad?!? It was your 13th beer today!!! ''Jogador'': '''kazordoon''' / '''quest'''
'''Bolfona''': Hey Drog, have you been in the mines when that rotworm attack took place? ''Jogador'': '''knight''' / '''sorcerer'''
'''Bolfona''': You still owe me 2000 gold from our last game. ''Jogador'': '''woman''' / '''female'''
'''Bolfona''': I THINK YOU NEED A GOOD SPANK FROM A WOMAN, HUH?! ''Jogador'': '''man''' / '''male'''
'''Bolfona''': WHAT DID YOU JUST SAY?!? ''Jogador'': '''mine''' / '''offer'''
'''Bolfona''': Drog, your next beer is on its way! ''Jogador'': '''trade'''
'''Bolfona''': Oh well, you don't seem to be THAT bad. What do you want? ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Bolfona''': Good news! }}
