| notes       = Baltim é o supervisor do posto avançado do acampamento Smuggler em nome de [[Venore]].
| falas       = 
''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''</br>
[[Baltim]]: Hi there. I hope you're here to trade and not to waste my time.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''</br>
[[Baltim]]: I am the overseer of this little outpost. You probably had already some encounters with my men. Hehe. Serves those cut-throats right if you taught them some manners.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''</br>
[[Baltim]]: I'm Baltim, not that it would be of your concern.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Trade'''</br>
[[Baltim]]: Of course, just browse through my wares.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Equipment'''</br>
[[Baltim]]: I don't sell wares, but ask me for a trade if you have an offer for me.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Venore'''</br>
[[Baltim]]: I wonder if things were better if Venore ran the mining operations.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Dwarf'''</br>
[[Baltim]]: It seems even the dwarfs know better than to try their luck here.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Thais'''</br>
[[Baltim]]: Thais has no affairs here.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Mines'''</br>
[[Baltim]]: The mines are not at our disposal for now but also here we have enough to plunder for a while.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Plunder'''</br>
[[Baltim]]: I don't mind if the people of Svargrond convict us of hunting seals. We earn good money with it.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Carlin'''</br>
[[Baltim]]: Carlin lost interest in this place quite fast.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Port Hope'''</br>
[[Baltim]]: I'd love an assignment in Port Hope, on the other hand, here I can make my own decisions.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Leader'''</br>
[[Baltim]]: I'm in charge here on behalf of Venore.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Edron'''</br>
[[Baltim]]: We should rather concentrate on Edron than wasting our time here and freezing our toes off. But who listens to me?</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Svargrond'''</br>
[[Baltim]]: I hate that place and I would love to burn down that whole settlement.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Raiders'''</br>
[[Baltim]]: One barbarian is as worse as the other if you ask me.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Barbarians'''</br>
[[Baltim]]: Those barbarians will regret the day they turned our offers down.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Elf'''</br>
[[Baltim]]: The elves are of no great help here. They prefer to stay in warmer climates.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Ferumbras'''</br>
[[Baltim]]: His appearances are good for business.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Excalibug'''</br>
[[Baltim]]: A myth the locals probably enjoy.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''King Or Queen'''</br>
[[Baltim]]: I couldn't care less for kings and queens. Here I'm the king as long as I can pay the guys and keep them suspicious of each other.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''God'''</br>
[[Baltim]]: This place is godforsaken.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''</br>
[[Baltim]]: Bye.
}}

| falas       = 
''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''</br>
[[Zora]]: Ah, look what the north wind blew here. Hope you're up to some business.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Business'''</br>
[[Zora]]:  I am overseeing some of our operations here. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a trade.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Trade'''</br>
[[Zora]]:  About time someone is interested in my wares. Footballs have to be purchased separately.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Footballs '''</br>
[[Zora]]:  Do you want to buy a football for 111 gold?</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''</br>
[[Zora]]:  Here you go.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''No'''</br>
[[Zora]]:  Oh, but it's fun to play!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''</br>
[[Zora]]:  I am overseeing some of our operations here. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a trade.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''</br>
[[Zora]]:  I am known as Zora and just for your information, there is no longer a bounty on my head.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Bounty'''</br>
[[Zora]]:  I was ... kind of wild in my youth.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Equipment'''</br>
[[Zora]]:  Now you're talking my language. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a trade.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Leader'''</br>
[[Zora]]:  That ruffian Baltim and me are leading this little operation.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Venore'''</br>
[[Zora]]:  Venore will recognise my efforts here and I am sure I'll get a promotion soon.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Dwarf'''</br>
[[Zora]]:  We thought about manipulating some dwarfs to clear the mines for us. On the other hand, this would not be very effective as the dwarfs would not give up the mines either and are allied with Thais.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Mines'''</br>
[[Zora]]:  The mines are still a problem. Those raiders make it impossible to do something about the mines.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Raiders'''</br>
[[Zora]]:  TThey somewhat remind me of the men I sailed with in my youth. Still they are enemies and I ordered our men to kill them on sight.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Enemies'''</br>
[[Zora]]:  We have many enemies but they lack brains and brawn to challenge our operations.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Thais'''</br>
[[Zora]]:  Well ... Thais is far away.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''King'''</br>
[[Zora]]:  Not even the king's arm reaches this place.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Carlin'''</br>
[[Zora]]:  Carlin is a thorn in our side. A little one but a thorn nonetheless.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Queen'''</br>
[[Zora]]:  Soon enough, the little queen in Carlin will lose the last influence she is still having in this area.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Port Hope'''</br>
[[Zora]]:  Business is growing awfully slow there. We should really assign someone with some talent to improve our influence over there.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Edron'''</br>
[[Zora]]:  If things progress well here, my next command might bring me to Edron.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Svargrond'''</br>
[[Zora]]:  If I had more ships and men, I'd take over that town in one surprise attack. But the way things are now, this would be a waste of resources. Well, our base here is sufficient for now.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Barbarians'''</br>
[[Zora]]:  It's a sad thing that our people are split. With each year that is passing, we drift further apart from each other.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Elf'''</br>
[[Zora]]:  They are a bit too friendly with Carlin for my taste. Fortunately, they don't show up here too often.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Ferumbras'''</br>
[[Zora]]:  He is more a problem in the South.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Excalibug'''</br>
[[Zora]]:  Looking for that weapon seems quite unprofitable.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''God'''</br>
[[Zora]]:  Leave the gods alone and they won't bother you.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Mission'''</br>
[[Zora]]:  Buy something or leave. Don't bother me!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''</br>
[[Zora]]:  Come back when you're up to some business, ''Jogador''.
}}<noinclude>[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]</noinclude>

== Frases Espontâneas ==
'''Beatrice''': Selling general goods and paperware! Come to my shop!

== Palavras-Chave ==
''Jogador'': '''hi'''</br>
'''Beatrice''': Hello, hiho, and ashari ''Jogador''. Looking forward to trade with you.

''Jogador'': '''job'''</br>
'''Beatrice''': I'm selling all kind of useful equipment.

''Jogador'': '''equipment''' / '''goods'''</br>
'''Beatrice''': My inventory of general goods and paperware is large, ask me for a trade to take a look.

''Jogador'': '''name'''</br>
'''Beatrice''': I'm called Beatrice.

''Jogador'': '''news''' / '''rumors'''</br>
'''Beatrice''': There are always rumors about the dangers in the far north of Edron.

''Jogador'': '''time'''</br>
'''Beatrice''': It's ''horas'' right now.

''Jogador'': '''ferumbras'''</br>
'''Beatrice''': I vaguely remember that name.

''Jogador'': '''excalibug'''</br>
'''Beatrice''': That's just a myth like the screwdriver of Kurik or the endless casket of mana potions.

''Jogador'': '''king''' / '''tibianus'''</br>
'''Beatrice''': I've seen him once. What a handsome man!

''Jogador'': '''army'''</br>
'''Beatrice''': I supply them with some basic stuff.

''Jogador'': '''thais'''</br>
'''Beatrice''': We are no longer in need for supplies from there.

''Jogador'': '''tibia'''</br>
'''Beatrice''': I don't like travelling much. I prefer to live in the safety of our city.

''Jogador'': '''carlin'''</br>
'''Beatrice''': Even though they rebelled against our king, the city is supposed to be very lovely.

''Jogador'': '''edron'''</br>
'''Beatrice''': It's the best place to live at.

''Jogador'': '''bye'''</br>
'''Beatrice''': See you later, ''Jogador''.
|}}

{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Chrystal | job = Carteiro | city = Edron | subarea = Edron Castle | location = [[Edron Castle]] ({{Mapa|33174,31812,7:1|aqui}}). | implemented = 6.4 | notes =

| buysell = sim | buys = Nada. | sells = {{Trades/Sell |Parcel |Letter |Label}} | falas =__NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == '''Chrystal''': Welcome to the post office!
'''Chrystal''': Don't forget to include a label in your parcel!
'''Chrystal''': If you need help with letters or parcels, just ask me. I can explain everything.
'''Chrystal''': No, no, no, there IS no parcel bug, I'm telling you! == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Chrystal''': At your service ''Jogador'' and welcome to the post office. ''Jogador'': '''job'''
'''Chrystal''': I'm responsible for this post office. Just ask for our offers. ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Chrystal''': My name is Chrystal. ''Jogador'': '''tibia'''
'''Chrystal''': Our post system spans the entire known world. ''Jogador'': '''thais''' / '''carlin''' / '''kazordoon''' / '''ab'dendriel'''
'''Chrystal''': We deliver letters and parcels even there. ''Jogador'': '''edron'''
'''Chrystal''': Our post system even delivers letters and parcels to and from this isle. ''Jogador'': '''king''' / '''tibianus'''
'''Chrystal''': Hail to the king! ''Jogador'': '''army'''
'''Chrystal''': The army ensures the safety of the traderoutes and of our mail system. ''Jogador'': '''ferumbras'''
'''Chrystal''': I bet he never gets any letters. ''Jogador'': '''excalibug'''
'''Chrystal''': Better ask knights about that. ''Jogador'': '''news''' / '''rumors'''
'''Chrystal''': Sorry, that's postal secret. ''Jogador'': '''kevin''' / '''postner'''
'''Chrystal''': Mr. Postner is the leader of our guild and the most prominent postofficer in the whole land. ''Jogador'': '''postmasters guild'''
'''Chrystal''': Yes, our guild is the lifeblood of the tibia cominity so to say. ''Jogador'': '''join'''
'''Chrystal''': You can apply to join only at our headquarter. ''Jogador'': '''headquarter'''
'''Chrystal''': You can find it on the road from Thais to Kazordoon. ''Jogador'': '''time'''
'''Chrystal''': It is ''horas'' right now. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Chrystal''': Who is next? |}}

''Jogador'': '''carlin'''</br>
'''Rudolph''': Oh, these women ... oh, go away.

''Jogador'': '''edron'''</br>
'''Rudolph''': Oh, what a lovely city it is.

''Jogador'': '''bye'''</br>
'''Rudolph''': Oh, good bye.

'''Willard''': Selling weapons, ammunition and armor. Special offers only available here, have a look!

== Palavras-Chave ==
''Jogador'': '''hi''' / '''hello'''</br>
'''Willard''': Greetings and Banor be with you, ''Jogador''! May I interest you in a trade for weapons, ammunition or armor?

''Jogador'': '''job'''</br>
'''Willard''': I am the blacksmith of castle Bloodrock.

''Jogador'': '''name'''</br>
'''Willard''': I am Willard, the smith.

''Jogador'': '''news''' / '''rumors'''</br>
'''Willard''': Rumors are too sinister things that a true warrior would care for them.

''Jogador'': '''weapon''' / '''armor''' / '''ware'''</br>
'''Willard''': My offers are weapons, ammunition, armors, helmets, legs, and shields. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a trade.

''Jogador'': '''ammunition'''</br>
'''Willard''': I sell all sorts of arrows for bows and different bolts for crossbows. Ask me for a trade if you're interested to see my wares.

''Jogador'': '''edron'''</br>
'''Willard''': Edron is a fine city to live in.

''Jogador'': '''carlin'''</br>
'''Willard''': If the king sees the time is right, he will certainly start a campaign to reclaim what belongs to Thais.

''Jogador'': '''thais'''</br>
'''Willard''': A fine city, but I love the peace of Edron more.

''Jogador'': '''tibia'''</br>
'''Willard''': It's my dream that one day the whole world will profit from the Thaian governance.

''Jogador'': '''king''' / '''tibianus'''</br>
'''Willard''': Hail to the King! He's our benevolent protector.

''Jogador'': '''army'''</br>
'''Willard''': I supply them with all they need.

''Jogador'': '''ferumbras'''</br>
'''Willard''': I would be honored if it's one of my blades that one day delivers him his punishment.

''Jogador'': '''excalibug'''</br>
'''Willard''': Adventurers search for this blade all over the world. Even here.

''Jogador'': '''time'''</br>
'''Willard''': Now it is ''horas''.

''Jogador'': '''bye'''</br>
'''Willard''': Farewell, ''Jogador''.
|}}

'''Fiona''': The Edron academy is always in need of magical ingredients!

== Palavras-Chave ==
''Jogador'': '''hi'''</br>
'''Fiona''': Good day, ''Jogador''. I hope you bring a lot of magical ingredients with you.

''Jogador'': '''magical ingredients'''</br>
'''Fiona''': Oof, there are too many to list. Magical ingredients can sometimes be found when you defeat a monster, for example bat wings. I buy many of these things if you don't want to use them for quests, just ask me for a trade.

''Jogador'': '''name'''</br>

'''Fiona''': I never wear a watch. I dislike the pressure it gives me.

''Jogador'': '''news'''</br>
'''Fiona''': Well, I stocked my wares up a bit.

''Jogador'': '''ferumbras'''</br>
'''Fiona''': He fascinates me. I've heard that they found his hideout... I'm very curious what will happen.

''Jogador'': '''tibia'''</br>
'''Fiona''': Not the ideal place to raise your children in, but still a world with its own charm.

''Jogador'': '''edron'''</br>

''Jogador'': '''steel'''</br>

'''James''': I am too poor to afford a watch.

* Faz parte da [[The Elemental Spheres Quest]]. * Só é possível negociar com ele após completar a [[The Elemental Spheres Quest]].

[[Categoria:NPCs Liberados por Quest]] | falas =__NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == '''Arkulius''': Oh my! Alverus!! Did you really...?!?! I have to recalculate it to make sure that I made no mistake.
'''Arkulius''': ...the arithmetical paradox has the same value in a metaphysical way, then...
'''Arkulius''': Yes, that's it! The elementary particle are corresponding to the... the ... UNBELIEVEABLE!!!
'''Arkulius''': ...the minimum square deviation could cause a dislocation, in a matter of fact...
'''Arkulius''':
'''Arkulius''': ...it could be possible to bring the sphere to a destination where... == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi''' ''(o NPC responde aleatoriamente de diferentes maneiras)''
1. '''Arkulius''': ...if my calculations are correct, I will be able to revive... Arrgghh!! What do you want?
2. '''Arkulius''': ...if the expected constant is higher than... Hmmm, who are you?? What do you want?
3. '''Arkulius''': ...then I could transform a spell to bend... How can anyone expect me to work under these conditions?? What do you want? ''Jogador'': '''want''' / '''job'''
'''Arkulius''': How dare you asking me this?!? I'm Arkulius - Master of Elements, the HEADMASTER of this academy!! ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Arkulius''': I'm Arkulius - Master of Elements, the headmaster of this academy. ''Jogador'': '''time'''
'''Arkulius''': Time is an illusion and completely irrelevant to me. ''Jogador'': '''thanks''' / '''thank you'''
'''Arkulius''': You're welcome. Are you leaving now? Hopefully . ''Jogador'': '''element'''
'''Arkulius''': The doctrine of elementalism is a very complex topic. Only the eldest may understand what it's all about. My dear friend Alverus took it way too far. ''Jogador'': '''alverus'''
'''Arkulius''': It happened while he carried out an experiment concerning the creation of the elemental shrines. I still get goose bumps just by thinking of it. ...
'''Arkulius''': You need to know about the process of creating an elemental shrine to understand it completely, but I don't want to go into detail now. ...
'''Arkulius''': Anyway, his spell had a different outcome than he had planned. He accidentally created an Ice Overlord, pure living elemental ice, who froze him in a blink of an eye. ''Jogador'': '''overlord'''
'''Arkulius''': We presumed their existence all these years but we were never able to prove it. Well, ironically my friend Alverus provided results by letting himself transform into a block of ice that can't be disenchanted. ''Jogador'': '''shrine'''
'''Arkulius''': The creation of the elemental shrines is a really complex matter. They are actually nodes, locations where the matching elemental sphere is very close. ...
'''Arkulius''': The shrine itself is like a portal between our world and the elemental sphere and enables us to use the elemental energy emerging from it. ''Jogador'': '''sphere'''
'''Arkulius''': There are five spheres we know of: ice, fire, earth, energy and spirit. .... Hmmm, should I ask or not?....The heck with it! Now that you know about the spheres ...
'''Arkulius''': I found a way to visit them. It's VERY dangerous and there is a decent chance that you won't come back BUT if you succeed you'll write history!!! Ask me about that mission if you're interested. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Arkulius''': At last! Good things come to those who wait. |}}

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Telas | job = Cientista | job2 = Inventor | city = Edron | subarea = Stonehome | location = [[Stonehome]] ({{Mapa|33275,31801,6:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.5 | buysell = sim | buys = {{Trades/Buy | Ancient Stone | Battle Stone | Broken Gladiator Shield | Coal | Crystal of Balance | Crystal of Focus | Crystal Pedestal | Crystal of Power | Crystalline Spikes | Flintstone | Gear Crystal | Gear Wheel | Huge Chunk of Crude Iron | Magma Clump | Metal Spike | Piece of Draconian Steel | Piece of Hell Steel | Piece of Hellfire Armor | Piece of Royal Steel | Pulverized Ore | Shiny Stone | Stone Nose | Sulphurous Stone | Vein of Ore | War Crystal}} | notes = Telas precisa da ajuda de aventureiros para construir um novo golem. Se você falar "crystal pedestal" ele vai comprar todos os pedestais que estiverem na sua backpack.

* Faz parte da [[Shadows of Yalahar Quest]].

[[Categoria:NPCs Liberados por Quest]] | falas =__NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == ''Fora do laboratório'':
'''Telas''': I'm so close.
'''Telas''': So much to be done.
'''Telas''': If I could only get that one to work. ''Dentro do laboratório'':
'''Telas''': We did it!
'''Telas''': Incredible!
'''Telas''': I can't believe it! Success at last! == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Telas''': Hello! Sorry I’m a bit busy. ----- === Sobre Telas: === ''Jogador'': '''job'''
'''Telas''': As you know I’m a scientist, specialising in the field of creating golems. That is my mission so to say. ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Telas''': My name is Telas. ''Jogador'': '''busy'''
'''Telas''': I guess, my job is my passion. ----- === Sobre NPC's: === ''Jogador'': '''king''' / '''tibianus'''
'''Telas''': I think a king’s job should be to keep things running and not to pursue his own ambitions. ''Jogador'': '''milos'''
'''Telas''': He is a genius when it comes to theories. He has written some of the greatest scientific texts I have ever read. Although not all of his suppositions are based on empirical evidence, some of his theories are revolutionary. ...
'''Telas''': He should be more than happy to have some of his theories put into practice and I have no doubt that he will share his research with me quite willingly. ----- === Locais e Cidades: === ''Jogador'': '''yalahar'''
'''Telas''': The city itself deeply affects me for many different reasons. …
'''Telas''': For one, the wonders and the technology to be found in the city fill me with awe. …
'''Telas''': And then I am filled with sadness for the decline of their technology and the loss of their knowledge that is palpable everywhere in the city. ''Jogador'': '''kazordoon'''
'''Telas''': Kazordoon is the capital city of the dwarves. It is hidden in a huge mountain on the route between Thais and Ab'Dendriel. I think there is a street or a path that takes you there from Thais. ...
'''Telas''': As soon as you cross a huge bridge to the north and find yourself standing in front of a mountain, you're there. ''Jogador'': '''thais'''
'''Telas''': In my opinion, Thais is far too political. All that kingdom and empire stuff serves to entertain the upper classes. …
'''Telas''': It doesn’t change anything for the common man and is all about accumulating power and wealth for the powerful and wealthy. ''Jogador'': '''carlin'''
'''Telas''': Although the city of Carlin has some rivalry with Thais it can be reached from most major harbours by ship. ''Jogador'': '''edron'''
'''Telas''': I came here to study at the academy for a while. …
'''Telas''': I grew curious about the northern ruins and for a long time hoped that I’d be allowed to lead an expedition there. …
'''Telas''': This came to a halt of course when the criminals and fallen knights took over the ruins. …
'''Telas''': Since then I have shifted my focus to creating golems. ''Jogador'': '''ruins'''
'''Telas''': The northern ruins are probably the remains of one of the extinct races that preceded humanity during the God Wars …
'''Telas''': There are numerous ruins all over the world that tell the silent tales of the rise and the fall of their architects. …
'''Telas''': For instance, adventurers discovered subterranean ruins in the Ghostlands. …
'''Telas''': The remains of the bonelord civilisation are one of the most notable remnants of such ancient races. …
'''Telas''': All over the world you can still see the black pyramids which were typical bonelord structures. Some are still inhabited by a small population of bonelords. …
'''Telas''': We can only estimate how many races might been wiped out without a trace. …
'''Telas''': However, the ruins in the north are certainly one such relic of the past and that is probably why those renegade knights went there. …
'''Telas''': Whoever finds out how to unlock their secrets and make use of them stands to gain considerable wealth and power. ''Jogador'': '''academy'''
'''Telas''': The academy holds a wealth of knowledge in many fields. Unfortunately, magic has become far too important in my opinion. …
'''Telas''': It’s a pity that other fields are shunned by researchers. …
'''Telas''': It makes it quite hard for anyone interested in different fields of science to find appropriate reference material. …
'''Telas''': The magicians who lock themselves up in ivory towers, far removed from the ordinary people, is an apt metaphor for how distanced magic has become from everyday life. …
'''Telas''': I think a breakthrough coming from the area of independent research might serve as a wake up call for the academy’s board. ''Jogador'': '''laboratory'''
'''Telas''': My main laboratory in the cellar is stuffed with sophisticated gadgets and gizmos. …
'''Telas''': I don’t like having visitors down there and honestly, I don’t find the time to tidy it up, so it’s quite a mess. …
'''Telas''': When we manage to assemble a golem I will invite you downstairs for the activation. …
'''Telas''': It would be a shame to let you assist me and then exclude you from the moment itself. ----- === Raças: === ''Jogador'': '''yalahari'''
'''Telas''': The Yalahari are a race of contrasts. Though admittedly it’s probably better to regard the Yalahari of the past and the Yalahari of today as two completely different races. …
'''Telas''': In the past the Yalahari were reclusive but brilliant. You can still see all the marvels of their city and all the knowledge in different fields of science that they must have possessed. …
'''Telas''': Then, at some point in their history something must have happened, causing a shift in their society. …
'''Telas''': Science stopped progressing and was gradually forgotten. No new wonders were built and the old ones slowly fell into decay. …
'''Telas''': It seems that over the course of generations, the Yalahari increasingly lost touch with their own inventions. …
'''Telas''': We can only speculate what might have happened. …
'''Telas''': I, for my part, think that scientific knowledge was probably exclusive to a small group of Yalaharian elite. …
'''Telas''': I have seen with my own eyes that one quarter of their city was devastated by an explosion and another sunk into the sea because of an earthquake. …
'''Telas''': My theory is that the scientific elite perished along with one of these quarters, thus leading to the downfall of the Yalaharian civilisation. …
'''Telas''': The Yalahari of today are quite reclusive and don’t like visitors in their inner sanctum – as I learnt the hard way. …
'''Telas''': I used a lot of influence and wealth to gain admittance to their inner city. Unfortunately, they quickly cast me out because they found me too curious. ''Jogador'': '''golem'''
'''Telas''': The term golem is a bit too broad to describe the actual diversity of these beings. …
'''Telas''': Roughly speaking, most golems are based on an element which is concentrated until it gains a semblance of sentience. …
'''Telas''': The element that is concentrated can be changed to get a different kind of golem. …
'''Telas''': The ‘element’ does not necessarily have to be earth, fire, water or air but, purely theoretically, concentrations of other matter are possible. …
'''Telas''': It is still under debate whether most of the other concentrations of matter could be traced back to one of the core elements. …
'''Telas''': Since this science is still in its infancy there is a lot to be specified and researched. ''Jogador'': '''elf'''
'''Telas''': Because elves look similar to humans, it is easy to forget that they are completely different. …
'''Telas''': They are their own race with their own morals and values. …
'''Telas''': Most misunderstandings between humans and elves arise from the fact that humans just assume that elves think like themselves. …
'''Telas''': However, the elves are not a scientifically inclined people, so there is little in their culture that would interest me personally. …
'''Telas''': Some colleagues of mine at the academy took an interest in elven sorcery though. You might ask there for more information. ''Jogador'': '''dwarf'''
'''Telas''': I honestly admire the dwarfs for their craftsmanship. Admittedly, they are a bit tight lipped about their secrets, but who can blame them for that? ...
'''Telas''': Their technomancers are special though. I would love to converse with them about science and mechanics but as an outsider there is little chance for me to learn anything from them. ...
'''Telas''': Luckily, there are some rare exceptions to the rule. But that's a different story. ''Jogador'': '''bonelord'''
'''Telas''': The bonelords are a race fighting extinction. …
'''Telas''': Unlike other elder races they have proved themselves to be more resilient, but as far as I can tell, they are only postponing the inevitable. …
'''Telas''': How ironical it is that the bonelords refuse to admit that they are on the brink of extinction. You would have thought that their skills in necromancy would have given them some insight into their situation. ----- === Outras Palavras-Chave: === ''Jogador'': '''element'''
'''Telas''': So far, science has recognized four elements: water, fire, air and earth. It is speculated that there are more elements in existence, such as lightning, magic, life and unlife. ''Jogador'': '''science'''
'''Telas''': Many people actually mean magic when they say ‘science’. But there are so many other fields to be explored. …
'''Telas''': The more mundane sciences hold many secrets of their own and can be profoundly rewarding for a researcher. ''Jogador'': '''earth'''
'''Telas''': Earth is a rather basic element for golem construction. Earth golems can be created without much effort and are quite common. ''Jogador'': '''water'''
'''Telas''': Water can sometimes be concentrated by using its ice form as a base. …
'''Telas''': Although concentrating water is not as problematic as with most of the other elements, it is difficult to keep the concentrated water stable for an extended period of time. ''Jogador'': '''fire'''
'''Telas''': The brute force of fire makes it dangerous to contain and difficult to concentrate without risk of an explosion. ''Jogador'': '''air'''
'''Telas''': Air is elusive and the techniques to concentrate it are exceptionatly complicated. ''Jogador'': '''lightning'''
'''Telas''': Lightning is still an unexplained phenomenon. Some assume it is an element in its own right, others claim it is the product of opposing elements. …
'''Telas''': Others suggest it belongs to the element of magic and finally there are those who claim that lightning is a Godly element. ''Jogador'': '''magic'''
'''Telas''': Magic is a fascinating field, both in terms of theory and practice. Unfortunately, with all the manpower and resources that have been put into that area, other areas have been somewhat neglected …
'''Telas''': When confronted with a problem people have grown used to turning to magic for a solution. We’ll never know how many inventions might have been discovered if there weren’t already a spell for everything. ''Jogador'': '''life'''
'''Telas''': Life, as an element, is rather speculative. …
'''Telas''': Some argue that we are a form of concentrated life and therefore would qualify as life golems. …
'''Telas''': This is an intriguing concept and when I am done with my current research I will probably give that a closer look. ''Jogador'': '''unlife'''
'''Telas''': Well there are necromantic golems. ...
'''Telas''': That alone is seen as proof by many people although it is dangerously simplified. Still, this subject bears scientific analysis. ''Jogador'': '''spell'''
'''Telas''': Spells have a tendency to make things easy. Too easy for my taste. People stop thinking for themselves if they have a spell for each and every occasion at hand. …
'''Telas''': All the bookish knowledge of a studied master does not make up for the practical experience of an ordinary man who has to solve his problems by original thinking. ''Jogador'': '''gods'''
'''Telas''': I admit I have little use for the Gods in my own life. I like to think that I make my own decisions. …
'''Telas''': I really can’t understand devout believers who follow the doctrines of a God, or rather, his priests and subordinate their life to the agenda of some heavenly power. …
'''Telas''': If the stories of the God Wars are true, then I am not sure I feel comfortable with the idea of being some kind of a weapon and not an individual. ''Jogador'': '''gods war'''
'''Telas''': Well, we all know that the Gods fight over creation. We’re supposed to help them in some way, aren’t we? …
'''Telas''': I have to admit, I find it impossible to regard my life merely as a means to further that war for one side or the other. …
'''Telas''': On the other hand, we should probably be thankful that we are not involved in an all out war. …
'''Telas''': Still, I try to avoid dwelling on this. It is disturbing to be constantly faced with the possibility of war breaking out. ''Jogador'': '''research'''
'''Telas''': I have focused my research on the creation of golems. While this does involve a lot of magic, it also requires a wide range of knowledge in the other fields of science as well. ''Jogador'': '''necromancy'''
'''Telas''': Necromancy is referred to as one of the dark arts. Even from a scientific point of view, I can’t deny that this holds a grain of truth. …
'''Telas''': Through dabbling with necromancy, one is exposed to certain unhealthy thoughts that can easily corrupt a man. …
'''Telas''': So I only study the theory behind the creation of necromantic golems. …
'''Telas''': It is an interesting topic but, as I said, it requires some questionable assumptions and a willingness to cross certain boundaries a human shouldn’t ever cross for his own good. ''Jogador'': '''mission'''
'''Telas''': After all this effort we have made it, my friend! I can’t figure out why the golem is behaving so strangely. I can only assume the experimental head was not completely indoctrinated with all the usual golem routines …
'''Telas''': But that might even prove helpful. I will try to teach the golem what he needs to know, but it will take some time. Feel free to visit whenever you like if you want to hear about my progress. …
'''Telas''': By the way, I could also need certain rare metals and crystals for my experiments. Just in case you have any of those I need, ask me for a trade to exchange them for good money! ''Jogador'': '''mission''' / '''golem''' (no laboratório)
'''Telas''': Admittedly, I am at a bit of a loss as to specifying exactly what it is that we have created here. It is a functional golem and it is working. …
'''Telas''': On the other hand, it seems odd and a bit self-preoccupied. It’s almost as if it had some kind of sentience. …
'''Telas''': It’s even more of a marvel than I had hoped for! Absolutely fascinating! I will run a series of tests and .. and .. there is so much to be done. …
'''Telas''': It seems my work has only just begun! ''Jogador'': '''trade'''
'''Telas''': Seen any of those metals, stones or crystals? I’ll happily buy them! I also buy crystal pedestals. ''Jogador'': '''crystal pedestals'''
'''Telas''': Well you don’t have any, but in case you find some, let me know! ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Telas''': Good bye, ''Jogador''. |}}

== Frases Espontâneas ==

== Palavras-Chave ==
''Jogador'': '''hi'''</br>
'''Eliza''': Welcome, ''Jogador''. If you're interested in spells to support your party, I can be your teacher.

''Jogador'': '''spell'''</br>
'''Eliza''': I'm sorry to tell you, but I'm no longer allowed to teach you spells due to my retirement.

''Jogador'': '''teacher''' / '''job'''</br>
'''Eliza''': I used to be a teacher for party spells. But these days are now over, since I can now finally retire.

''Jogador'': '''name'''</br>
'''Eliza''': My name is Eliza.

''Jogador'': '''time'''</br>
'''Eliza''': It's ''horas''.

''Jogador'': '''news''' / '''rumours'''</br>
'''Eliza''': Well, the new spells we recently discovered could prove to be quite valuable. Time will tell.

''Jogador'': '''king''' / '''tibianus'''</br>
'''Eliza''': The king is a quite impressive man. Even though his deeds are often criticised, I'm sure that he only wants the best for Tibia.

''Jogador'': '''edron'''</br>
'''Eliza''': Talented magicians gather in these towers and work together in researching spells. That's why the most powerful spells are only taught in Edron.

''Jogador'': '''thais'''</br>
'''Eliza''': I've only been to Thais once or twice. I prefer a quieter place to live and study.

''Jogador'': '''carlin'''</br>
'''Eliza''': I don't like the attitude of the women there. They are all a little trigger-happy, if you know what I mean.

''Jogador'': '''tibia'''</br>
'''Eliza''': People call me pessimistic, but I think this world will go down the drain sooner or later.

''Jogador'': '''party'''</br>
'''Eliza''': Having a party is a good thing. You can kill much stronger monsters than when you're on your own.

''Jogador'': '''curse''' / '''moon''' / '''were'''</br>
'''Eliza''': I have no idea, I’m sorry. You could ask Fiona or Zoltan, though.

''Jogador'': '''bye'''</br>
'''Eliza''': Goodbye, ''Jogador''.
|}}

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Gundralph | job = Roleplay | city = Edron | subarea = Noodles Academy of Modern Magic | location = [[Noodles Academy of Modern Magic|Noodles Academy]] ({{Mapa|33266,31849,5:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 6.4 | notes = Vendia magias especiais para [[Druid]]s e [[Sorcerer]]s.
A partir do update 15.22 do dia 27 de janeiro de 2026 não é mais possível comprar magias com esse NPC pois a CipSoft removeu a interação com a palavra "Spell", e a função de comprar magias, visto que agora as magias passaram a ser adicionadas automaticamente assim que o players chega ao nível necessário. | buysell = sim | buys = Nada. | sells = Nada. | falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == '''Gundralph''': Utevo vis lux! == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Gundralph''': Oh, be welcome ''Jogador''. You look like you're interested in the world of magic. ''Jogador'': '''spell''' ''(se for knight)''
'''Gundralph''': Sorry, but we had a slight restructuring of spell lessons in order to be able to focus better on one group of students. You should go and see whether Puffels and Zoltan are still teaching you spells. ''Jogador'': '''spell''' ''(se for sorcerer ou druid)''
'''Gundralph''': I used to train young casters like you... but the magic flows differently now. You'll understand it sooner than later. ''Jogador'': '''job'''
'''Gundralph''': I used to be a teacher for some powerful spells. ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Gundralph''': They call me Gundralph. ''Jogador'': '''news''' / '''rumors'''
'''Gundralph''': I have heard nothing of intrest lately, sorry. ''Jogador'': '''time'''
'''Gundralph''': Let me see, it's ''horas''. ''Jogador'': '''ferumbras'''
'''Gundralph''': How low can a sorcerer go. ''Jogador'': '''excalibug'''
'''Gundralph''': An awesome weapon if it exists. ''Jogador'': '''king''' / '''tibianus'''
'''Gundralph''': Unfortunately, I never met King Tibianus III in person. ''Jogador'': '''army'''
'''Gundralph''': They live in the castle to the west. ''Jogador'': '''thais'''
'''Gundralph''': I see Thais as a lost course. ''Jogador'': '''tibia'''
'''Gundralph''': The world is so big and we have only so little time to travel. ''Jogador'': '''carlin'''
'''Gundralph''': Carlin is a fine place for druids. ''Jogador'': '''edron'''
'''Gundralph''': Sciences are thriving on this isle. ''Jogador'': '''spellbook'''
'''Gundralph''': Please ask the stationer in the west tower for that. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Gundralph''': Goodbye, ''Jogador''! |}}

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Puffels | job = Roleplay | city = Edron | subarea = Noodles Academy of Modern Magic | location = [[Noodles Academy of Modern Magic|Noodles Academy]] ({{Mapa|33270,31848,8:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 6.4 | notes = Puffels era um instrutor de magias para Knights. Ele tem a aparência de um rat.
A partir do update 15.22 do dia 27 de janeiro de 2026 não é mais possível comprar magias com esse NPC, visto que agora as magias passaram a ser adicionadas automaticamente assim que o players chega ao nível necessário. | buysell = não | buys = Nada. | sells = Nada. | falas =__NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == Não possui. == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Puffels''': Yeah, another fool disturbing me, what a joy. ''Jogador'': '''disturbing''' / '''job'''
'''Puffels''': Well, I used to teach some fools. However these day are now finally over! Where was the cheese wheel again? ''Jogador'': '''spell''' / '''job'''
'''Puffels''': Not really. Due to some new &#&$*# academy rules I'm not allowed to teach anyone now. Me! .. ah, whatever. Better than having to only teach knights, I tell you! ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Puffels''': I am Magister Puffels, any problem with that? ''Jogador'': '''news'''
'''Puffels''': I heard in Thais the new brand of cheese was... uhm... ''Jogador'': '''hugo'''
'''Puffels''': Hugo? I heared it was an accident that created this beast. ''Jogador'': '''beast'''
'''Puffels''': I don't know more about it. ''Jogador'': '''edron'''
'''Puffels''': Sciences are thriving on this isle. ''Jogador'': '''carlin'''
'''Puffels''': I don't care about some remote cities. ''Jogador'': '''thais'''
'''Puffels''': I was there once, almost died. The fools there mistook me for an ordinary rat, can you believe that!? ''Jogador'': '''tibia'''
'''Puffels''': Bah, the whole Tibia can &#&$*# my #$&*! ''Jogador'': '''king''' / '''tibianus'''
'''Puffels''': I give nothing for kings, queens... or other people at all. ''Jogador'': '''army'''
'''Puffels''': Fine army that is. Half of them have already deserted. ''Jogador'': '''ferumbras'''
'''Puffels''': The day will come even he makes a fatal casting mistake... I know what I am talking about. ''Jogador'': '''excalibug'''
'''Puffels''': I have no use for such stuff. ''Jogador'': '''time'''
'''Puffels''': Where might I hide a watch, you fool? ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Puffels''': Whatever. |}}

pages.title: Zoltan
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Zoltan | job = Roleplay | city = Edron | subarea = Noodles Academy of Modern Magic | location = [[Noodles Academy of Modern Magic|Noodles Academy]] ({{Mapa|33268,31849,4:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 6.4 | notes = Ele pode lhe contar uma historia sobre o '''Ferumbras'''.

* Só será possível conversar com o Zoltan sobre o '''Ferumbras''' caso já tenha tentando entrar na Ferumbras' Citadel em [[Kharos]]. * Você precisa falar '''Hi - Permission''' para ele, você pode entrar na citadel por 500 [[gp]]s, note que você só ganha a permissão caso já tenha chegado na entrada do lugar. Ele também pode dar o Sorcerer Hat addon se você entregar um [[Ferumbras' Hat]].

| buysell = não | buys = Nada. | sells = Nada. | falas =__NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == Não possui. == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Zoltan''': Welcome ''Jogador'', student of the arcane arts. I teach the fiercest spells available. ''Jogador'': '''job'''
'''Zoltan''': I was once a teacher of the most powerful spells in Tibia. That time has come to an end. ''Jogador'': '''spells'''
'''Zoltan''': I was once a master of the arcane arts, but I've left the teaching behind. Nowadays I focus more an collecting wisdom and exploring the world we live in. ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Zoltan''': I am known in this world as Zoltan. ''Jogador'': '''news''' / '''rumors'''
'''Zoltan''': I have no time for chit chat. ''Jogador'': '''time'''
'''Zoltan''': It's ''horas''. ''Jogador'': '''excalibug'''
'''Zoltan''': You will need no weapon if you manipulate the essence of magic. ''Jogador'': '''king''' / '''tibianus'''
'''Zoltan''': King Tibianus III was the founder of our academy. ''Jogador'': '''army'''
'''Zoltan''': They rely too much on their brawn instead of their brain. ''Jogador'': '''thais'''
'''Zoltan''': Thais is a place of barbary. ''Jogador'': '''tibia'''
'''Zoltan''': There is still much left to be explored in this world. ''Jogador'': '''carlin'''
'''Zoltan''': Carlin's druids waste the influence they have in enviromentalism. ''Jogador'': '''edron'''
'''Zoltan''': Sciences are thriving on this isle. ''Jogador'': '''eremo'''
'''Zoltan''': He is an old and wise man that has seen a lot of Tibia. He is also one of the best magicians. Visit him on his little island. ''Jogador'': '''visit'''
'''Zoltan''': You should visit Eremo on his little island. Just ask Pemaret on Cormaya for passage. ''Jogador'': '''yenny'''
'''Zoltan''': Yenny? Which Yenny? That is a common name. ''Jogador'': '''yenny the gentle'''
'''Zoltan''': Ah, Yenny the Gentle was one of the founders of the druid order called Crunor's Caress, that has been originated in her hometown Carlin. ''Jogador'': '''crunor caress'''
'''Zoltan''': I am quite busy, ask another time! ''Jogador'': '''spellbook'''
'''Zoltan''': Don't bother me with that. Ask in the shops for it. ''Jogador'': '''orshabaal'''
'''Zoltan''': Orshabaal is one of the demon lords in service of the Ruthless Seven. His raids on our isle Edron are already legendary and usually end up with numerous casualties. ''Jogador'': '''ferumbras''' (''antes de ir a Kharos'')
'''Zoltan''': I see no reason to discuss this matter with you. ''Jogador'': '''ferumbras''' (''depois de ir a Kharos'')
'''Zoltan''': I see, you managed to reach Kharos, the harbinger isle, and discovered the gates to Ferumbras' citadel, and now you are here full of questions. Are you ready to listen? ''Jogador'': '''yes'''
'''Zoltan''': So know that destroying the mortal shell of the being called Ferumbras was the best we were able to achieve with our combined efforts in the past. ...
'''Zoltan''': He was destroyed not only once but several times. Eventually we were able to figure out the secret of his seeming immortality. ...
'''Zoltan''': On one of the most remote islands of the Shattered Isles, he built a citadel with demonic aid right around a powerful magical nexus. ...
'''Zoltan''': The only reason for the whole complex was to establish a point of return into our world. Whenever he is slain, his soul retreats to some demonic dimension to regain enough strength to re-enter the world. ...
'''Zoltan''': We were not able to destroy his citadel, this unholy construct. To make matters worse, the nexus makes it easy for demons of all kind to pass into our world. ...
'''Zoltan''': The best thing we could do was to seal the citadel and to install a device that will alarm us whenever Ferumbras tries to re-enter our world. ...
'''Zoltan''': We grant heroes like you the permission to pass our seals and enter Ferumbras' citadel. ...
'''Zoltan''': Just ask for the permission if you are ready to go there. Be warned that the citadel is no holiday place though. You will encounter large amounts of demons and traps that scare off most adventurers. ...
'''Zoltan''': On the other hand, WHEN Ferumbras re-enters the world we need heroes like you to face him on his very own ground before he can escape. ...
'''Zoltan''': His return is not very likely but it can happen each and every day. If you should manage to defeat him, bring a proof of his death here and you will be rewarded. ''Jogador'': '''permission'''
'''Zoltan''': The attuning to our seals is a costly process and it will grant you access to the citadel ONLY ONCE. Each time you want to enter, you will need a new attuning. Are you willing to pay 500 gold pieces to become attuned to the seal of the citadel? ''Jogador'': '''yes'''
'''Zoltan''': SO BE IT! ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Zoltan''': Use your knowledge wisely, ''Jogador''. |}}

pages.title: Albert
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}}
| name        = Albert
| job         = Curador
| npcclass    = Humanos
| npcsprite   = Mage
| city        = Edron
| subarea     = Stonehome
| location    = [[Stonehome]] ({{Mapa|33314,31764,7:2|aqui}}).
| implemented = 6.4
| buysell     = não
| buys        = 
| sells       = 
| notes       = Seu nome completo é Albert Fibulanian. Sua família vive na ilha de Fibula. Um dia, ele foi enviado a Thais para aprender a arte de curar.
| falas     =__NOTOC__
== Frases Espontâneas ==
Não possui.

== Palavras-Chave ==
''Jogador'': '''hi'''</br>
'''Albert''': Welcome in my humble hut, ''Jogador''. If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you.

''Jogador'': '''job'''</br>
'''Albert''': I'm a healer.

''Jogador'': '''name'''</br>
'''Albert''': My Name is Albert Fibulanian.

''Jogador'': '''heal'''</br>
'''Albert''': You aren't looking really bad. Sorry, I can't help you.

''Jogador'': '''tibia'''</br>
'''Albert''': Tibia is a world big enough for everyone. I wish people would realize that.

''Jogador'': '''thais''' / '''edron''' / '''humble hut'''</br>
'''Albert''': The sinful city of Thais is a monument of corruption and murder. I am glad I left for Edron and thank the gods every day for this isle.

''Jogador'': '''god'''</br>
'''Albert''': The gods of good take care of us.

''Jogador'': '''king''' / '''tibianus'''</br>
'''Albert''': The king does much to enhance the life of his people, but he could do more.

''Jogador'': '''army''' / '''banor'''</br>
'''Albert''': I dream of times which see no need for armies or warriors.

''Jogador'': '''ferumbras'''</br>
'''Albert''': The fallen one is a perfect example where evil leads us to.

''Jogador'': '''excalibug'''</br>
'''Albert''': It's only another instrument of pain and destruction.

''Jogador'': '''news'''</br>
'''Albert''': I have only news about weather, taxes, and harvests. I heared nothing that might interest a traveller like you.

''Jogador'': '''daniel'''</br>
'''Albert''': I healed his wounds, but nothing can heal his soul after the betrayal of some of his knightly brethren.

''Jogador'': '''betrayal'''</br>
'''Albert''': Oh better ask the knights about that issue. I know only little about that tragic story. Some knights betrayed their order and joined some sinister cult in the northern ruins.

''Jogador'': '''kaine'''</br>
'''Albert''': Another victim of his own ambitions. I mourn for his soul.

''Jogador'': '''fibula'''</br>
'''Albert''': My family used to live on the isle of Fibula. At this time it wasn't overrun by soldiers of fortune. Later, I was sent to Thais to learn the art of healing, while my family was amongst the first settlers of Edron.

''Jogador'': '''time'''</br>
'''Albert''': Now, it is ''horas''.

''Jogador'': '''bye'''</br>
'''Albert''': Good bye, ''Jogador''!
|}}

pages.title: Amanda
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Amanda | job = Sacerdote | job2 = Curador | npcclass = Humanos | npcsprite = Mage | city = Edron | subarea = Edron Castle | location = [[Edron Castle]] ({{Mapa|33215,31815,8:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 6.4 | buysell = não | notes = É a sacerdote do templo de Edron.

* Faz parte da [[Rest in Hallowed Ground Quest]]. * Você pode conseguir uma pedra especial falando '''Hi - Adventurer's Stone - Yes''' para este NPC. * Se você usar uma [[Adventurer's Stone]] dentro de templo, você será teleportado para pequena ilha da [[Adventurers' Guild]].

 | falas =__NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == Não possui. == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Amanda''': Welcome to the temple of Banor's blood ''Jogador''. If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you. ''Jogador'': '''job''' / '''temple'''
'''Amanda''': I'm a humble nun that came to Edron to help. ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Amanda''': I'm sister Amanda. ''Jogador'': '''news'''
'''Amanda''': Sorry, I rarely have time to chat. ''Jogador'': '''time'''
'''Amanda''': Now, it is ''horas''. ''Jogador'': '''ferumbras'''
'''Amanda''': He is a pawn of evil. ''Jogador'': '''excalibug'''
'''Amanda''': Only a being loyal to Banor will wield this blade. ''Jogador'': '''king''' / '''tibianus'''
'''Amanda''': Our king is a religious man - a shining example. ''Jogador'': '''army''' / '''banor'''
'''Amanda''': Our army lives in accordance with the ideals of the god Banor. ''Jogador'': '''edron'''
'''Amanda''': Edron is in grave danger. I arrived here too late to witness the events myself, but I will share everything with you that I've heard ...
'''Amanda''': A false priestess seduced some knights to abandon their noble cause and to free some prisoners. Then they headed to some ruins in the North where they practice a dark cult and consort with demons. ''Jogador'': '''ruins'''
'''Amanda''': The ruins are probably older than humankind. We have to assume it's a place of dark power. The recent appearances of the fiend Orshabaal hint that the Ruthless Seven are somehow involved. ''Jogador'': '''orshabaal'''
'''Amanda''': The taint he spreads on the land is unbearable. This creature has to be destroyed once and for all. ''Jogador'': '''ruthless seven'''
'''Amanda''': I'm not sure if they even exist. Demons usually don't form such partnerships. ''Jogador'': '''demons'''
'''Amanda''': It takes heroes to defeat demons! ''Jogador'': '''heroes'''
'''Amanda''': Heroes gain equipment and experience by fulfilling dangerous quests. ''Jogador'': '''tibia'''
'''Amanda''': That's our world. ''Jogador'': '''thais'''
'''Amanda''': We can expect little help from Thais in these troubled days. We need some heroes to help us with these sinister things going on here. ''Jogador'': '''god'''
'''Amanda''': They created the world and all life on it. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Amanda''': Farewell, ''Jogador''! |}}

pages.title: Avar Tar
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Avar Tar | job = Herói | npcclass = Humanos | npcsprite = Hero | city = Edron | subarea = Stonehome | location = [[Stonehome]] ({{Mapa|33249,31768,7:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 6.4 | buysell = não | buys = | sells = | notes = É um herói em uma quest para o [[King Tibianus]]. Ele tem informações sobre: a [[Excalibug]], [[Ruthless Seven]] e a [[Pits of Inferno]].

* Faz parte da [[Demon Outfits Quest]]. * Faz parte da [[What a Foolish Quest]].

| falas = Avar Tar: Greetings, traveller ''Player''!
''jogador'': '''name'''
Avar Tar: I'm Avar Tar, slayer of monsters, saviour of princesses, and defender of the weak.
''jogador'': '''job'''
Avar Tar: I'm a professional [[hero]].
''jogador'': '''hero'''
Avar Tar: I think I'm the greatest hero in Tibia, but my humility forbids me to make an issue out of it.
''jogador'': '''tibia'''
Avar Tar: I've seen it all and done it all ... at least twice.
''jogador'': '''time'''
Avar Tar: It's 9:45 am right now.
''jogador'': '''ferumbras'''
Avar Tar: I fought him several times, sometimes he killed me, sometimes I killed him. I'd say we are even right now, but I'm getting better and more powerful each day.
''jogador'': '''excalibug'''
Avar Tar: I am sure it's hidden in a vault of the Nightmare Knights beneath the Plains of Havoc. I'm planning an expedition to go there and to rout out the Ruthless Seven, but I have to save the world first.
''jogador'': '''ruthless seven'''
Avar Tar: Oh come on. Let the noobs take care of them. Call me if they are fourteen or so.
''jogador'': '''quest''' ou '''King Tibianus'''
Avar Tar: I'm on a quest for the Thaian king ... as usual.
''jogador'': '''Sword of Fury'''
Avar Tar: Ah, my trusty old sword. I left it on Rookgaard years ago when I left for the main continent.
''jogador'': '''rookgaard'''
Avar Tar: Rookgaard is full of memories of my first heroic accomplishments ...
Avar Tar: I heard that after all these years, the Minotaur Mage there refuses to leave his room as he is still afraid of me.
''jogador'': '''bonelord language'''
Avar Tar: 29639 46781! 9063376290 3222011 677 80322429 67538 14805394, 6880326 677 63378129 337011 72683 149630 4378! 453 639 578300 986372 2953639! I know it's rather short, but still, this poem I like best.
''jogador'': '''thais'''
Avar Tar: If I had time, I would restore peace in this once proud city, but there's too much to do before I can start that quest.
''jogador'': '''carlin'''
Avar Tar: I saved the women there once or twice.
''jogador'': '''magic'''
Avar Tar: I had to master the magic of all 4 vocations for one of the quests.
''jogador'': '''news'''
Avar Tar: There is a great evil lurking beneath this isle ... and beneath the Plains of Havoc, and in the ancient necropolis, and beneath the Ghostlands ... well basically everywhere.
''jogador'': '''demons'''
Avar Tar: Demons know and fear my name! It's not always easy to be a hero, you know?
''jogador'': '''bye'''
Avar Tar: See you later, ''Player''.
|}}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

== Frases Espontâneas ==
'''Captain Seahorse''': Passages to Thais, Carlin, Ab'Dendriel, Venore, Port Hope, Ankrahmun, Liberty Bay, Oramond, Cormaya, Gray Island and Krailos.

== Palavras-Chave ==
''Jogador'': '''hi'''</br>
'''Captain Seahorse''': Welcome on board, Sir ''Jogador''. Where can I sail you today?

''Jogador'': '''sail''' / '''passage''' / '''trip''' / '''go''' / '''town''' / '''destination'''</br>
'''Captain Seahorse''': Where do you want to go? To Thais, Carlin, Ab'Dendriel, Venore, Port Hope, Ankrahmun, Liberty Bay or the isle Cormaya? I could also bring you to Gray Island, Oramond, Krailos - or to Travora - a place between the worlds.

''Jogador'': '''job''' / '''captain'''</br>
'''Captain Seahorse''': I'm the captain of this sailing ship.

''Jogador'': '''name'''</br>
'''Captain Seahorse''': My name is Captain Seahorse from the Royal Tibia Line.

''Jogador'': '''ship''' / '''tibia''' / '''route''' / '''line''' / '''company'''</br>
'''Captain Seahorse''': The Royal Tibia Line connects all seaside towns of Tibia.

''Jogador'': '''edron'''</br>
'''Captain Seahorse''': This is Edron. Where do you want to go?

'''Captain Seahorse''': I'm sorry, but we don't serve the routes to the Ice Islands.

''Jogador'': '''passenger'''</br>
'''Captain Seahorse''': We would like to welcome you on board.

''Jogador'': '''good'''</br>
'''Captain Seahorse''': We can transport everything you want.

''Jogador'': '''darashia'''</br>
'''Captain Seahorse''': I'm not sailing there. This route is afflicted by a ghost ship! However, I heard that Captain Fearless sails there from Venore.

''Jogador'': '''darama'''</br>
'''Captain Seahorse''': The only cities on Darama I travel to are Ankrahmun, and Port Hope.

''Jogador'': '''ghost'''</br>
'''Captain Seahorse''': Many people who sailed to Darashia never returned because they were attacked by a ghost ship! I'll never sail there!

''Jogador'': '''bye'''</br>
'''Captain Seahorse''': Good bye. Recommend us if you were satisfied with our service.
|}}

pages.title: Daniel Steelsoul
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Daniel Steelsoul | job = Herói | city = Edron | subarea = Edron Castle | location = [[Edron Castle]] ({{Mapa|33190,31796,7:1|aqui}}). | implemented = 6.4 | buysell = não | buys = | sells = | notes = Governador de Edron, escolhido por [[King Tibianus|Tibianus III]] para administrar e proteger a ilha. É líder da ordem de Banor. Se você xingar ele, ele ira queimá-lo (causando 100 de dano).

* Faz parte da [[Against the Spider Cult Quest]]. * Faz parte da [[Edron City Quest]]. * Faz parte da [[Grimvale Quest]].

| falas = {{TOC left}} {{clear}} === Palavras-Chave Gerais === ''Jogador'': '''Hi'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': Greetings and Banor with you, ''Jogador''!
''Jogador'': '''Name'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': I am Sir Daniel Steelsoul of the Sacred Order of Banor's Blood.
''Jogador'': '''Job''' / '''Within Us'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': I am the governor of this isle, Edron, and grandmaster of the Knights of Banor's Blood.
''Jogador'': '''Castle'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': The castle was built on elder foundations we found on this isle.
''Jogador'': '''Enemy'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': Evil challenges the forces of good in any shape. Be it the claws of vicious monsters or the seductive dark secrets of rotten power.
''Jogador'': '''Excalibug'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': With this weapon in my hand, I would teach the servants of darkness the true meaning of the word fear.
''Jogador'': '''Monsters'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': We cleansed the south of any major enemy, but watch out while travelling the north.
''Jogador'': '''Sell'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': Are you suggesting I am corruptible?
''Jogador'': '''Yes'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': Take this!
''Jogador'': '''Weapon'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': Look for Willard, our local blacksmith.
=== Cidades === ''Jogador'': '''Carlin'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': I belong to a sacred order and don't care about mundane politics.
''Jogador'': '''Colony'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': With the Thaian army bound to other duties, our order was entrusted to secure the area. We defeated the evil minotaurs living right here and cleansed the isle of their unholy presence.
''Jogador'': '''Cormaya'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': It is a peaceful isle next to Edron with a nice village. You should visit the wonderful garden there.
''Jogador'': '''Edron'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': This isle is rumored to have been the home of a powerful ancient race which became extinct before the corpsewars. It was up to King Tibianus III to reclaim it for humanity and to found this colony.
''Jogador'': '''Kazordoon'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': Now and then a dwarf comes to this isle. Most behave secretive about their reason to come here. As far as I can tell, they are looking for some dwarfish artifact which was lost in ancient times.
=== Cult === ''Jogador'': '''Kaine'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': He was my second in command. After learning about the forbidden ruins, he, the priestess Agaltha, and their followers freed the criminals we brought here as workers and headed to the north.
''Jogador'': '''Agaltha'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': She was beautiful but seemed cold hearted. She spoke little to me, preferred the company of Kaine.
''Jogador'': '''Ruins'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': An ancient taboo forbids to enter the northern ruins.
''Jogador'': '''Taboo'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': We thought it was only superstition and no one bothered that Kaine and his friends went there to hunt servants of evil that might have hidden there. So we did not notice the dark cult they started.
''Jogador'': '''Cult'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': We know only little about them. Kaine and his fallen knights were joined by criminals and remaining forces of darkness that escaped us. They were joined by some ominous dark monks.
''Jogador'': '''Monks'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': We don't know if they came here or already hid in the ruins when we arrived. Maybe they seduced Kaine or Agaltha, maybe they were theirs for years.
''Jogador'': '''Noodles Academy'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': After the treason of Kaine, we observe these mages closely. If even a knight falls prey to the seduction of the forbidden ruins, no one can tell how easy some of these mystics might betray his people.
=== Deuses === ''Jogador'': '''Brog'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': The rotten cyclops worship the raging giant of hell.
''Jogador'': '''Zathroth'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': Do not mention the name of the cursed one!
=== Order of Banor's Blood === ''Jogador'': '''Army'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': The army protects the Thaian realm. The order of the Knights of Banor's Blood supports them with all our skills.
''Jogador'': '''Banor's Blood'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': We believe that the blood of Banor runs through the veins of all humans. Therefore, we are responsible to live up to Banors standards and not to stain his legacy with sinful acts.
''Jogador'': '''Bravery''' / '''Honour''' / '''Piety'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': Only those who live a life of bravery, honour, and piety may join our sacred order.
''Jogador'': '''Join'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': You may join the order of Banor's blood if you prove your honour.
=== Order of the Falcon === ''Jogador'': '''Falcon'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': The Order of the Falcon inhabited an impressive stronghold here in Edron. It lies dormant ever since the disappearance of the order and is unlikely to ever be used again. ...
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': Not many even go near the thing, especially during the night. They told stories about weird lights at the tower after midnight since I was a child. I never saw any myself, naturally.
=== Pessoas === ''Jogador'': '''Amanda'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': I think this nun might be a bit young for this position, but I won't question the decisions of the church of Banor's Blood.
''Jogador'': '''Banor'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': His spirit and blood are within us. Honour this fact or be cast into hell.
''Jogador'': '''Benjamin'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': He and his men fought against Ferumbras somewhere in the north of this isle, long before there were even plans of a colony. Only old Ben returned alive from the battle, but his mind was broken.
''Jogador'': '''Eremo'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': Eremo is a very wise man. I visit him sometimes on his little island near Edron. Just ask a fisherman for a passage.
''Jogador'': '''Fisherman'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': Pemaret is a fisherman on Cormaya.
''Jogador'': '''Falk'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': A promising young fellow.
''Jogador'': '''Ferumbras'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': He searched something in the north of the isle years ago. Probably he needed something from the forbidden ruins. He was chased and fought by the troops of general Benjamin.
''Jogador'': '''General'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': Harkath Bloodblade declined the governorship because he's needed more in Thais.
''Jogador'': '''Mirabell'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': I hardly find the time to visit the tavern.
''Jogador'': '''Willard'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': When he was young, Willard served in the royal army.
=== Raças === ''Jogador'': '''Minotaur'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': The minotaurs, though evil, were worthy opponents. After the treason of the man who is now known as Kaine Kinslayer, we lack the manpower to crush their cyclopean allies, too.
''Jogador'': '''Cyclopean''' / '''Cyclopolis'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': They live in an underground city, known as Cyclopolis in the north of the isle. Constantly forging weapons for the servants of darkness.
== The Grimvale Quest == === The Curse Spreads === ''Jogador'': '''Maeryn'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': You could call her the protector of Grimvale. When she was a girl she lived in Edron with her parents, thus I know her from my days of childhood. Later she moved to Grimvale but now and again she used to visit Edron. ...
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': But lately I haven't seen her all too often. I guess the unsettling occurrences on Grimvale demand all of her attention.
''Jogador'': '''Grimvale'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': Grimvale is a small island in the north-east of Edron. Its few inhabitants live quite out of the world but for a long time it was a peaceful place. However, this might have changed lately.
''Jogador'': '''Unsettling''' / '''Changed'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': Rumour has it that some of the inhabitants are affected by were-sickness. And yes, I believe it. Not because I am of a facile nature, no. Rather because there are strange things happening right here on Edron that teach me better.
''Jogador'': '''Strange'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': With each full moon monsters are roaming the woods. They look like badgers and foxes who are transforming into humans. Unfortunately it's the other way round: Peaceful citizens transform into feral beasts as soon as the moon is full.
''Jogador'': '''Curse''' / '''Moon''' / '''Were'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': Yes, recently we have a major problem here on Edron. Strange proceedings are troubling me as well as the common citizens. With each full moon, monsters are roaming the woods - monsters that we only knew from tales until now. ...
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': They look like badgers and foxes who are transforming into humans. Unfortunately, it's the other way round: Peaceful citizens transform into feral beasts as soon as the moon is full. ...
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': Some hunters even claim that they have spotted monstrous humanoid boars, wolves and bears. I know what is going on on Grimvale so I sent a messenger to Maeryn. She confirmed what I already feared: Those creatures are were-beasts. ...
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': The so-called Curse of the Full Moon is spreading and reached Edron. I asked Maeryn for help but she has plenty of trouble on Grimvale and can't leave the island. ...
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': Do you know something about this curse and - even more important - would you be willing to help us? ''Jogador'': '''Yes'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': I'm very relieved to hear that. The most important thing right now is to cure the curse of as many affected people as possible. Maeryn already told me that the purple nightshade is able to revert the effects of lycanthropy. ...
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': We tried this but it worked only partially. Strangely, we were able to cure the people living outside the town in the more rural parts of Edron. But there are also some affected people in the town itself and the nightshade doesn't have any effect....
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': I'm neither a sage nor a magician. But I'm the one who is supposed to find a solution for this problem. Please pay a visit to the Magic Academy of Edron. Perhaps one of the mages there can help you.
'''Missão: Purificando a Origem do Mal'''
''Jogador'': '''Curse'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': I'm very happy that you could help the people of Cormaya. May Banor bless you. But I have one last request: The were-beasts are led by alpha leaders. ...
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': Please seek out the subterranean caves of the lycanthropes on Edron and Cormaya and kill the alpha leader of each kind of were-beast, five altogether. This should weaken them enough to hold them at bay for quite a while.
'''Após a realizar a missão.''' ''Jogador'': '''Curse'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': You defeated the five alpha leaders! Well done, this should weaken them enough to hold them at bay for quite a while. Please take this pendant in return, it may be of use for you. ...
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': The were-sickness won't disappear completely but it will be easier for us now. At least I hope so! Yesterday a travelling salesman told me that he spotted a feral creature in the Darama desert that looked like half man and half lion. ...
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': Banor grant that this is just unfounded gossip and that the curse didn't spread further. Well, I guess, we will find out soon. Edron, for the time being, is a safer place now, thanks to you.
'''Após a conclusão da quest. Antes do [[Summer Update 2020|Update 12.40]]''' ''Jogador'': '''Curse''' / '''Moon''' / '''Were'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': Thank you again for your assistance, ''Jogador''! The Curse of the Full Moon still exists on Edron. But thanks to your heroic deeds we can keep it within certain bounds. At least I hope so! ...
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': Yesterday a travelling salesman told me that he spotted a feral creature in the Darama desert that looked like half man and half lion. Banor grant that this is just unfounded gossip and that the curse didn't spread further. ...
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': Well, I guess, we will find out soon. Edron, for the time being, is a safer place now, thanks to you.
'''Após a conclusão da quest. Depois do [[Summer Update 2020|Update 12.40]]''' === An Ancient Feud === ''Jogador'': '''Lion'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': Lately I heard rumours about the curse. That it has spread to the Darama Desert and that the lions there could also be were-creatures. Do you want to get to the bottom of it? ''Jogador'': '''Yes'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': Then please travel to Darashia and search for a man called Domizian. He lives in a house at the harbour. I know him for many years, he's a trustworthy friend. ...
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': I'm sure, he can tell you more about the curse in the Darama Desert.
''Jogador'': '''Bye'''
'''Daniel Steelsoul''': PRAISE TO [[Banor|BANOR]]!
|}} [[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

| notes       = Um guarda que protege o portão norte do castelo de Edron. Ele fornece informações sobre localização, incluindo locais de caça. 
| falas       =__NOTOC__
== Frases Espontâneas ==
Não possui.

== Palavras-Chave ==
''Jogador'': '''hi'''</br>
'''Falk''': LONG LIVE KING TIBIANUS! Welcome to the isle of Edron!

-----

=== Outras Palavras-Chave: ===
''Jogador'': '''job'''</br>
'''Falk''': I'm the Edron harbour guard. I protect Edron castle and inform visitors about this building and Edron itself.

''Jogador'': '''name'''</br>
'''Falk''': I'm Lieutenant Falk.

''Jogador'': '''news'''</br>
'''Falk''': Sorry, that's confidential.

''Jogador'': '''isle''' / '''edron'''</br>
'''Falk''': The mysterious isle has many secrets and sights outside the castle. The areas of interest are in the west, the southwest, the north, and the northwest.

''Jogador'': '''castle'''</br>
'''Falk''': The Edron castle is the home of many shops, a tavern, a bank, a depot, a post office and the temple of Banor's blood.

''Jogador'': '''subject'''</br>
'''Falk''': We all live under the benevolent guidance of our king.

''Jogador'': '''shop'''</br>
'''Falk''': The shops are on the eastern side of the castle. Upstairs you'll find a tailor, a blacksmith, and an equipment store.

''Jogador'': '''how are you'''</br>
'''Falk''': I'm well prepared for my duty.

''Jogador'': '''sell'''</br>
'''Falk''': Visit the shopkeepers to buy their fine wares.

''Jogador'': '''leader''' / '''king'''</br>
'''Falk''': LONG LIVE THE KING!

''Jogador'': '''army'''</br>
'''Falk''': The local army consists only of the Knights of Banor's Blood.

''Jogador'': '''tavern'''</br>
'''Falk''': The tavern is called the Horn of Plenty, and it's located upstairs in the southwest corner of the castle.

''Jogador'': '''bank'''</br>
'''Falk''': You'll find the bank in the southwest of the castle. Look for Ebenizer, you can't miss him.

''Jogador'': '''post'''</br>
'''Falk''': The post office, run by the lovely Chrystal is in the southwest corner of the castle, near the Royal Bank.

''Jogador'': '''temple''' / '''citizen'''</br>
'''Falk''': The temple can be found underground, in the southeast corner of the castle. There you can become a citizen of Edron.

''Jogador'': '''southwest'''</br>
'''Falk''': There are rumours of orc buildings in the southeast. They say some daring fellows found a passage to this area in an old cavern beneath the Edron flats.

''Jogador'': '''northwest'''</br>
'''Falk''': Don't even think about going there. Renegade Knights of Banor's Blood went there to unearth forbidden secrets in an ancient ruin.

''Jogador'': '''north'''</br>
'''Falk''': In the north, there is an ancient city of cyclopses, called the cyclopolis. They are wary of us, but trade with servants of evil from any known race.

''Jogador'': '''west'''</br>
'''Falk''': There are rumours of two tribes of minor monsters who battle each other for dominance over the area. Not worth to crawl the sewers to get there.

''Jogador'': '''city'''</br>
'''Falk''': In the city there is a furniture store and a jeweller. The Noodles Academy and the cemetery are outside.

''Jogador'': '''academy'''</br>
'''Falk''': The Noodles Academy of the magic arts is in the east of Edron city.

''Jogador'': '''work'''</br>
'''Falk''': Explore the isle and destroy any enemy forces encountered. The honor shall be your reward.

''Jogador'': '''cemetery'''</br>
'''Falk''': The cemetery is north of the hamlet of Stonehome, which is at the east coast, northeast of Edron city. The cemetary is rumoured to be haunted.

''Jogador'': '''battlegroup'''</br>
'''Falk''': There are the Dogs of War, the Red Guards, and the Silver Guards.

''Jogador'': '''bye'''</br>
'''Falk''': LONG LIVE THE KING!

-----

=== Atualizações: ===
''Antes do Patch 13.34.14810''</br>

''Jogador'': '''city'''</br>
'''Falk''': In the city there is a furniture store and a jeweller. The Noodles Academy and the cemetary are outside.

''Jogador'': '''cemetery'''</br>
'''Falk''': The cemetery is north of the hamlet of Stonehome, which is at the east coast, northeast of Edron city. The cemetary is rumoured to be haunted.
