pages.title: Milos
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Milos | job = Cientista | city = Edron | subarea = Noodles Academy of Modern Magic | location = [[Noodles Academy of Modern Magic|Noodles Academy]] ({{Mapa|33259,31825,3:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.5 | buysell = não | buys = | sells = | notes =

* Faz parte da [[Grimvale Quest]]. * Faz parte da [[Shadows of Yalahar Quest]]. * Ele também pode transformar uma [[Stone of Wisdom]] ou uma [[Stone of Insight]] em experiência conforme o nível do jogador.

 | falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == '''Milos''': What a fascinating idea! == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Milos''': Oh hello. I hardly noticed you. I'm afraid I am a bit distracted at the moment. ----- === Sobre Milos: === ''Jogador'': '''job''' / '''distracted'''
'''Milos''': I'm a magician and a theoretical scientist. That is, I am of course a real scientist, not a scientist in theory, but I concentrate more on theories than on practice. ...
'''Milos''': What I mean is, I do more reading and corresponding with other scientists - not exactly the fast lane to fame and fortune, granted, but it satisfies my humble desires. ''Jogador'': '''theory'''
'''Milos''': Theories are my lifeblood, so to speak. Practice doesn't interest me in the same way. To be honest, I am easily frightened and I lose heart quickly. Theories are more forgiving. ...
'''Milos''': I feel more comfortable with numbers and formulas and such. I like the safety of a laboratory and taking my time to develop my ideas. And of course I like the company of books more than the company of men. Sorry, no offence meant. ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Milos''': My name is Milos. Milos of the Edron Academy. Nice to meet you. ----- === Sobre NPC's: === ''Jogador'': '''edowir'''
'''Milos''': He is a very enigmatic person. His wisdom is unrivaled and his intentions are good. Although some people occasionally complain that he only imparts the bare minimum of information that they need. ...
'''Milos''': He always leaves you with the feeling that he knows much more than he is willing to tell. Some even claim he is a chosen of Uman. ''Jogador'': '''telas'''
'''Milos''': He is a great and generous man. I owe him so much. I will never be able to even remotely make it up to him. ----- === Locais e Cidades: === ''Jogador'': '''academy'''
'''Milos''': The academy is a place of learning. We could do with a bigger library, of course. If the White Raven Monastery weren't so far away I would consider going there for the privilege of seeing all those magnificent books. ...
'''Milos''': But the cream of Tibian academics, professors and researchers are all based here, so we do have the greatest living knowledge base in the world. ''Jogador'': '''white raven'''
'''Milos''': The monastery contains the greatest collection of books in the known world. They own books from every field of knowledge, philosophy and art ...
'''Milos''': As far as I am aware, there is not much order in the collection though. The monks are ony collectors of books. They unfortunately lack the skills to catalogue them. Even if they read them I doubt they would understand them. ...
'''Milos''': This makes researching there somewhat tedious and time consuming, but if you ever have to research a topic I would suggest starting there. ''Jogador'': '''yalahar'''
'''Milos''': I am still waiting for a good book about Yalahar. Preferably with some drawings. That would be so interesting. ----- === Outras Palavras-Chave: === ''Jogador'': '''knowledge'''
'''Milos''': Knowledge is essential to everything. How can anyone make a decision without knowledge? The more you know, the better you can decide. Our Academy is one of the world's greatest hoards of knowledge. ...
'''Milos''': Another, especially in the fields of books is the White Raven Monastery. The single most knowledgeable person in Tibia is, in my opinion, the sage Edowir in the Whiteflower Temple. ''Jogador'': '''uman'''
'''Milos''': Uman is the God of Knowledge who furthers society and stands for the greater good. He is the patron of research and progress. ''Jogador'': '''zathroth'''
'''Milos''': Zathroth is represents the quest for knowledge in order to gain power. He stands for those who seek to gain knowledge regardless of its cost, and for progress for the sake of progress alone. ''Jogador'': '''brew'''
'''Milos''': You have to distil the crimson nightshade first. You can use the alchemical devices in Sinclair's laboratory, here in the Academy. Then you have to add the silver and gold powder, in this order! At last you add the Shadow Bite Berries. ''Jogador'': '''crimson'''
'''Milos''': This is a very rare subspecies of the purple nightshade. It grows exclusively on the small island Grimvale, and even there it is anything but common. In fact, it is so rare, it didn't even have a scientific name as of yet. ...
'''Milos''': So, with becoming modesty, I called it 'solanum coccinea'. ''Jogador'': '''curse''' / '''moon''' / '''werewolf'''
'''Milos''': We scholars call it the were-sickness or the Curse of the Full Moon, but whether it is a disease or a curse is still unclear. Some claim it is similar to a contagious malady, others take the view that it is a curse in the classical magical sense. ''Jogador'': '''enhanced''' / '''potion'''
'''Milos''': Just have a look at my notes. The required components are listed there. ''Jogador'': '''ley'''
'''Milos''': Most Tibian cultures have some knowledge about those straight lines that run across the landscape, connecting both, natural and sacred sites. Some also call them 'fairy paths' or 'spirit lines'. ...
'''Milos''': As far as I know, in Zao they are called 'dragon lines'. Markers connecting the ley lines can be mounds, cairns, standing stones, stone circles, ponds, wells, shrines, temples or cross-roads. ''Jogador'': '''dust''' / '''powder'''
'''Milos''': If you have some gold or silver nuggets, grind them into dust. We have a gem grinder here in the Academy which you can use. ''Jogador'': '''gold''' / '''silver'''
'''Milos''': The metal has to be in an unprocessed state. Coins or jewellery won't do it. The best bet is to go to a mine and dig up some of the required metal. ...
'''Milos''': Deep underneath the Venorean swamps are tunnels where you might find what you are searching for. But beware of the Corym there and be sure to take a pick with you! ''Jogador'': '''yalahari'''
'''Milos''': I have read some reports about the Yalahari and they sound extremely interesting. Sadly, information about the Yalahari is rather rare due to the fact that they are so elusive. ''Jogador'': '''golem'''
'''Milos''': I am more into theories then into practice but I have come up with several very solid theories that may be invaluable to Telas, if they work in practice ...
'''Milos''': I would not go as far as to say that I have reinvented how golems can be constructed but I think some of my approaches are quite unique. Even by disproving some of my ideas Telas stands to gain some significant insights into his chosen field of study. ...
'''Milos''': I am only too pleased that my theories are being applied in such a useful way! ''Jogador'': '''stone of insight''' (''durante o evento'' The Rise of Devovorga)
'''Milos''': A stone of insight! As theoretical scientist and magician I'm highly interested in researching this particular artefact. In exchange, I'd share some of my knowledge with you. ...
'''Milos''': Would you like to trade a stone of insight for ''experiência'' experience? ''Jogador'': '''yes'''
'''Milos''': Thank you! This is a great step for magical science. ''Jogador'': '''stone of insight''' (''fora do evento'' The Rise of Devovorga)
'''Milos''': Ah well. This matter was taken out of our hands for now. The inquisition insisted to control the collection of these stones and by royal decree they were granted the exclusive right to do so. ...
'''Milos''': As a simple scientist I'm not in a position to question such decision, as hard as it might hit my researches. For now I can not trade any of the stones. You will have to wait for another opportunity. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Milos''': Good bye. }}

| buysell = não | buys = | sells = | falas =__NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == '''Pino''': Feel the wind in your hair during one of my carpet rides! == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Pino''': Greetings, traveller ''Jogador''. Where do you want me to fly you? ''Jogador'': '''job''' / '''service''' / '''fly'''
'''Pino''': I'm a carpet pilot. I can give you a passage to many places. ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Pino''': Pino at your service. ''Jogador'': '''time'''
'''Pino''': It's ''horas'' right now. ''Jogador'': '''passage''' / '''transport''' / '''ride''' / '''trip'''
'''Pino''': I can fly you to Darashia on Darama, to Svargrond on Hrodmir, to Kazordoon, to Zao, to the Femor Hills or to Issavi if you like. Where do you want to go? ''Jogador'': '''tibia'''
'''Pino''': What a wonderful world, especially if you look down on it. ''Jogador'': '''darashia''' / '''darama'''
'''Pino''': Do you seek a ride to Darashia on Darama for 30 gold? ''Jogador'': '''svargrond'''
'''Pino''': Do you seek a ride to Svargrond for 50 gold? ''Jogador'': '''kazordoon'''
'''Pino''': Do you seek a ride to Kazordoon, for 60 gold? ''Jogador'': '''zao''' / '''farmine'''
'''Pino''': Do you seek a ride to Zao, near Farmine, for 50 gold? ''Jogador'': '''femor''' / '''hill'''
'''Pino''': Do you seek a ride to the Femor Hills for 50 gold? ''Jogador'': '''femur'''
'''Pino''': You are probably talking about the FEMOR hills. ''Jogador'': '''issavi'''
'''Pino''': Do you seek a ride to Issavi for 90 gold? ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Pino''': Good bye! |}}

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Shoddy Beggar | job = Mendigo | city = Edron | subarea = Edron Castle | location = [[Edron Castle]] ({{Mapa|33157,31817,7:1|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.54 | buysell = não | notes = * Faz parte da [[Sea of Light Quest]]. | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
Shoddy Beggar: What do you want? Listen to the old madman? If you have nothing to spare, leave me alone.
''Jogador:'' '''name'''
Shoddy Beggar: My name is... not of your concern.
''Jogador:'' '''job'''
Shoddy Beggar: Are you kidding me? Do I look like a... well, we'd better change the topic.
''Jogador:'' '''time'''
Shoddy Beggar: Must be about 11:38 am.
''Jogador:'' '''king'''
Shoddy Beggar: Tibianus? What is a king measured against a scientist? What is wealth measured against wisdom?
''Jogador:'' '''edron'''
Shoddy Beggar: I thought this was the city of knowledge, arts and exploration. Instead I found this academy full of... *mumbles*
''Jogador:'' '''sea'''
Shoddy Beggar: Ah, the sea of light... we are surrounded by it. It holds the secrets of our very existence, the meaning of - ah you wouldn't even understand.
''Jogador:'' '''astronomer or Spectulus'''
Shoddy Beggar: Pah, he thinks he knows what holds the world together - in fact he's just as clueless as the rest of the academy. *mumbles*
''Jogador:'' '''excalibug'''
Shoddy Beggar: I heard about the legend, but I don't know how much of it is actually true.
''Jogador:'' '''bye'''
Shoddy Beggar: Yes, whatever. }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Ortheus | job = Mendigo | city = Yalahar | subarea = Yalahar Magician Quarter | location = [[Yalahar Magician Quarter]] ({{mapa|32875,31086,6:1|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.4 | buysell = não | buys = | sells = | notes = Não se sabe sua função, ele apenas pede para você entregar um [[Tea|Mug of Tea]], mas você não ganha nada em troca.

* Faz parte da [[Blood Brothers Quest]].

| falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == Não possui. == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Ortheus''': What's your business here with the magicians, ''Jogador''? ''Jogador'': '''job'''
'''Ortheus''': Hm, good question. Maybe old, wise man? ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Ortheus''': I'm used to being called old man. Simple as that. ''Jogador'': '''magicians'''
'''Ortheus''': I can't imagine a better place to live. ''Jogador'': '''live'''
'''Ortheus''': Though the city has seen better days, the quality of life is still much better than in most other cities. ''Jogador'': '''vampire'''
'''Ortheus''': I don't know what you're talking about. ''Jogador'': '''blood'''
'''Ortheus''': Yes, it's a bit messy down there. Sorry. ''Jogador'': '''julius'''
'''Ortheus''': Doesn't ring a bell. ''Jogador'': '''armenius'''
'''Ortheus''': He rarely comes here. ''Jogador'': '''maris'''
'''Ortheus''': A man of the seas. ''Jogador'': '''lisander'''
'''Ortheus''': He used to visit me for a chat, but ever since that new tavern opened I haven't seen him much anymore. ''Jogador'': '''serafin'''
'''Ortheus''': He sometimes delivers fruit and vegetables to this quarter. ''Jogador'': '''cookie'''
'''Ortheus''': It'd be better for you to leave now. ''Jogador'': '''yalahar'''
'''Ortheus''': Though the city has seen better days, the quality of life is still much better than in most other cities. ''Jogador'': '''quarter'''
'''Ortheus''': I can't imagine a better place to live ''Jogador'': '''alori mort'''
'''Ortheus''': Whatever that's supposed to mean. ''Jogador'': '''reward'''
'''Ortheus''': I don't have anything that I could give you as a reward. Guess you aren't so selfless after all, huh? ''Jogador'': '''augur'''
'''Ortheus''': They try to protect the city and do a decent job. Well - no, a poor job, I mean a poor job. ''Jogador'': '''mission''' / '''quest'''
'''Ortheus''': You can bring me a mug of tea if you want to. ''Jogador'': '''tea'''
'''Ortheus''': Have you actually brought me a mug of tea?? :''Jogador'': '''yes'''
:'''Ortheus''': Wow. These polite young adventurers nowadays. Thank you. :''Jogador'': '''yes'''
:'''Ortheus''': Hmmm, you don't have tea with you. :''Jogador'': '''no'''
:'''Ortheus''': What a pity. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Ortheus''': Good bye. }}

pages.title: Tereban
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Tereban | job = Roleplay | city = Edron | subarea = Edron Castle | location = [[Edron Castle]] ({{Mapa|33166,31808,6:1|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.6 | notes = Ele tem quatro filhos. Eles nasceram no mesmo dia e hora, e cada um deles escolheu uma vocação diferente.

* Faz parte da [[A Father's Burden Quest]]. * Faz parte da [[Threatened Dreams Quest]].

| buysell = não | sells = | falas =__NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == '''Tereban''': Sigh. == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Tereban''': Greetings, friend. Good you are showing up. ----- === Sobre Tereban: === ''Jogador'': '''job''' / '''showing up'''
'''Tereban''': My family owns some land here as well as two ships. I have overseers for that though. This allows me to spend my time reading and dabbling in poetry. ...
'''Tereban''': But considering the circumstances right now, I'm just a troubled father with a mission too hard to accomplish for me. ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Tereban''': My name is Tereban. ''Jogador'': '''father''' / '''sons'''
'''Tereban''': My sons are quite independent. Even though I had preferred that they stayed at home longer, they decided to leave to make their careers in the great guilds. ...
'''Tereban''': It was probably only for their best to start their training at an early age, but I miss them badly. I am sure they will become something great in their vocations, but I have always been proud of them anyway. ''Jogador'': '''wife'''
'''Tereban''': My wife was a high-ranking member of the Explorer Society. Some years ago her ship was lost in a storm. I still haven't given up to hope for her return, even though I know it is not rational. ----- === Vocações: === ''Jogador'': '''druid'''
'''Tereban''': My son Vestus trains to become a druid. He has a kind heart and great love for animals and nature, so it’s probably just .. uhm natural for him to become one. ...
'''Tereban''': He was always somewhat of a loner but as far as I heard he found quite a lot of like-minded friends among the other students and is quite happy. ''Jogador'': '''sorcerer'''
'''Tereban''': Melvin has always been as curious as his mother. He shared her and my love for books but did neither like travels nor poetry. ...
'''Tereban''': He is so analytic and inquisitive. I have to admit there are times I cannot follow what he is talking about. He will become a great sorcerer. ''Jogador'': '''paladin'''
'''Tereban''': Yelloran loved hunting already as a kid. He had a keen eye and quickly discarded what he called ‘kid bows’ to try out the real ones.
'''Tereban''': His first bow was almost twice as big as him and he hardly had the strength to pull its string at first. But that changed soon enough and now I hear he is one of the best marksmen in his class. ''Jogador'': '''knight'''
'''Tereban''': My son Tereman has always loved stories about brave knights rescuing beautiful princesses. Of all my sons he is probably the bravest, so it suits him well to become a knight.
'''Tereban''': He has always been so dedicated to become a great knight one day, I sometimes had to stop him so he would get some needed rest. ----- === Outras Palavras-Chave: === ''Jogador'': '''shield'''
'''Tereban''': A sturdy shield is a knight's best friend. I want my son to be protected as good as possible. For the shield we need something that the dwarfs call 'old iron'. ...
'''Tereban''': You can find it in the deepest reaches of the dwarfish mines of Kazordoon but as far as I've heard, the dwarfs do not welcome visitors, so watch out. ....
'''Tereban''': We also need some scales of a dragon. The catch is, not any dragon will do. If the dragon is too old, its scales can't be treated by the craftsman, if it is too young, the scales will not provide the necessary protection. ...
'''Tereban''': The good thing is that the craftsman learnt about a dragon that lives in the caves somewhere north of Thais. For its unusual scales it is called Glitterscale. It sounded like you'd know when you see it. ''Jogador'': '''rod'''
'''Tereban''': The most crucial part of a rod are its enchantment. But I have taken care of that. The thing is that an enchantment has to meet certain conditions to work correctly. ...
'''Tereban''': So we need a special root that can be found under that ape city Banuta as the body of the rod and a special crystal. One was apparently buried in the tomb of some high-ranking official of Ankrahmun. ...
'''Tereban''': Although his tomb is hidden by the sand, it is rumoured to be somewhere east of the city. ''Jogador'': '''bow'''
'''Tereban''': For the bow we need some exquisite wood which can be found in one of the barbarian camps of Hrodmir. It seems the barbarians cut down the only useful tree there and hid its wood. ...
'''Tereban''': We also need a sinew. The craftsman insisted that only the sinew of an ancient wyvern named Heoni will be acceptable. You will find the beast in the mountain caves of Edron, along with others of its kind. ''Jogador'': '''robe'''
'''Tereban''': First we need some of the finest silk the world has to offer. Travel into the depths of the spider caves in Zao and look there for some suitable silk. ...
'''Tereban''': Then we need some spectral cloth. I fear the only place to find such a piece of cloth are the burial chambers of the Isle of the Kings, deep beneath the White Raven Monastery. ''Jogador'': '''poetry'''
'''Tereban''': I'm not good enough to find a publisher but it is still fun to write poems for myself. ''Jogador'': '''poems'''
'''Tereban''': I like to keep my poems private. ''Jogador'': '''sinew'''
'''Tereban''': Your bravery earned us this excellent sinew. ''Jogador'': '''wood'''
'''Tereban''': The wood you have found is just what we needed. ''Jogador'': '''cloth'''
'''Tereban''': Thanks to your efforts we have a suitable piece of spectral cloth. ''Jogador'': '''silk'''
'''Tereban''': The silk you have brought me is exquisite indeed. ''Jogador'': '''crystal'''
'''Tereban''': The crystal you have found is absolutely flawless. You did a great job indeed. ''Jogador'': '''root'''
'''Tereban''': It is even recognisable for me that the root you gave me is filled with magic. ''Jogador'': '''iron'''
'''Tereban''': The iron that you’ve found will make an ideal base for a shield. ''Jogador'': '''scale'''
'''Tereban''': Only someone as daring as you could slay the beast to get the necessary scales. ''Jogador'': '''cloak'''
'''Tereban''': I already told you everything I know. ''Jogador'': '''craftsmen'''
'''Tereban''': I hired the finest craftsmen available to create the birthday presents for my sons. ''Jogador'': '''birthday'''
'''Tereban''': It will be a great party with my sons, all their friends, and relatives that we haven’t seen here for several years. ''Jogador'': '''party'''
'''Tereban''': I arranged the meal, some music, fireworks, and even jesters and acrobats. It will be a party people will still talk about in years. ''Jogador'': '''feather''' / '''maiden'''
'''Tereban''': I already told you everything I know. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Tereban''': Farewell. |}}

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Ursula | job = Roleplay | city = Edron | subarea = Noodles Academy of Modern Magic | location = [[Noodles Academy of Modern Magic|Noodles Academy]] ({{Mapa|33270,31849,7:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 6.4 | notes = Ursula vendia magias para [[paladin]]s. Ela é uma bruxa.
A partir do update 15.22 do dia 27 de janeiro de 2026 não é mais possível comprar magias com esse NPC, visto que agora as magias passaram a ser adicionadas automaticamente assim que o players chega ao nível necessário. | buysell = não | buys = Nada. | sells = Nada. | falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == Não possui. == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Ursula''': Howdy ''Jogador''. I'm a spell teacher of the Edron academy. ''Jogador'': '''spell''' ''(se for knight)''
'''Ursula''': I am sorry, ''Jogador'', I no longer teach any spells at all. Some of us spell trainer went into retirement together. ''Jogador'': '''job'''
'''Ursula''': I used to teach some spells for paladins. Now I can finally focus more on experiemts and science. ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Ursula''': I am Ursula. ''Jogador'': '''news''' / '''rumors'''
'''Ursula''': I heard about things you never would believe. Please come back when I have more time to chat. ''Jogador'': '''edron'''
'''Ursula''': Sciences are thriving on this isle. ''Jogador'': '''carlin'''
'''Ursula''': They should have been more careful with this town, before they lost it. ''Jogador'': '''thais'''
'''Ursula''': Ah, yes, I remember my time there, old Muriel teaching me the basics. ''Jogador'': '''tibia'''
'''Ursula''': Isn't it a fine world we live in. ''Jogador'': '''king''' / '''tibianus'''
'''Ursula''': The king spent a lot of money for our library. ''Jogador'': '''army'''
'''Ursula''': I would prefer an army of spellcasters, but they are ok. ''Jogador'': '''ferumbras'''
'''Ursula''': Ah, come on, he can't be that poweful and evil as all say. ''Jogador'': '''excalibug'''
'''Ursula''': A myth born out of some knights' inferiority complex. ''Jogador'': '''time'''
'''Ursula''': Sorry, I don't own a watch. ''Jogador'': '''spellbook'''
'''Ursula''': I'm sorry, but I don't have one. Ask Thomas in the west tower about that. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Ursula''': Bye, ''Jogador''. }}

== Frases Espontâneas ==
'''Clyde''': Sit down, have a drink and relax!

== Palavras-Chave ==
''Jogador'': '''hi'''</br>
'''Clyde''': Greetings, dear customer. Have a drink and some food.

''Jogador'': '''job'''</br>
'''Clyde''': I’m your host, I run this tavern.

''Jogador'': '''name'''</br>
'''Clyde''': I’m Clyde, your host.

''Jogador'': '''trade'''</br>
'''Clyde''': Sure, browse through my offers.

''Jogador'': '''buy''' / '''sell''' / '''offer''' / '''stuff''' / '''goods''' / '''equipment''' / '''ware'''</br>
'''Clyde''': Food and drinks as much as you can pay for. If you like to see my offers, ask me for a trade.

''Jogador'': '''special'''</br>
'''Clyde''': Hm, we are widely known for the wood we export. But we are truly famous for the ivory of the elephant tusks.

''Jogador'': '''drink'''</br>
'''Clyde''': Do you want beer, wine, lemonade, or water? Ask me for a trade to make your choice.

''Jogador'': '''food'''</br>
'''Clyde''': We offer cookies, bread, cheese, ham, and meat, as well as eggs and tomatoes. If you like to see my offers, ask me for a trade.

''Jogador'': '''jungle'''</br>
'''Clyde''': This forest is no ordinary forest. It’s more like a force of nature, like a river or even a storm.

''Jogador'': '''excalibug'''</br>
'''Clyde''': The rumours I overheard did not mention this continent as one of its hiding places.

''Jogador'': '''time'''</br>
'''Clyde''': Don’t worry about the time. Take a seat, have a drink. Time runs differently in Port Hope.

''Jogador'': ''''''</br>
'''Clyde''': 

''Jogador'': '''ferumbras'''</br>
'''Clyde''': This incarnation of evil seems to concentrate his efforts on Thais and its surroundings, but who knows what comes next into the mind of this madman?

''Jogador'': '''king'''</br>
'''Clyde''': I wish the king would be a bit more concerned about this colony. I’m convinced with a few more resources we could improve Port Hope a lot.

''Jogador'': '''thais'''</br>
'''Clyde''': Sadly, Thais is far away and you will notice that in many places. You’ll find out about this yourself, so let’s talk about something else please.

''Jogador'': '''carlin'''</br>
'''Clyde''': I know only little about Carlin, and nobody cares about it here.

''Jogador'': '''ankrahmun'''</br>
'''Clyde''': If I were you, I’d stay as far away from this town as possible. It is ruled by an undead abomination and its inhabitants worship death.

''Jogador'': '''darashia'''</br>
'''Clyde''': I was there quite often, using the flying carpet. It’s quite different from other towns I’ve seen, but surely worth a trip.

''Jogador'': '''kazordoon'''</br>
'''Clyde''': If you want to learn something about Kazordoon, you should talk to our local dwarfs.

''Jogador'': '''venore'''</br>
'''Clyde''': It’s not always easy to deal with those Venorean tradesmen. I have to admit they don’t show any interest in my area of business. Just between you and me, my friend, sometimes they give me shivers.

''Jogador'': '''edron'''</br>
'''Clyde''': When I started business here, I was hoping for a second Edron. I have not shed my hope, yet. After all, this place is called Port Hope, isn’t it?

''Jogador'': '''darama'''</br>
'''Clyde''': It’s a continent full of extremes – the jungle in the humid West, and the desert in the dry East.

''Jogador'': '''tibia'''</br>
'''Clyde''': I’ve seen only little of this world. Probably you should tell me something about the world, and not the other way around.

''Jogador'': '''ab’dendriel'''</br>
'''Clyde''': Sadly it is next to nothing that I know about the elves and their city.

''Jogador'': '''elfs''' / '''elves'''</br>
'''Clyde''': Sadly it is next to nothing that I know about the elves and their city.

''Jogador'': '''dworcs'''</br>
'''Clyde''': The dworcs live in the South in an underground network consisting of caves. They use poisoned weapons and love to build all kind of traps. You don’t want to know the fate of those that have been trapped, believe me.</br>
'''Clyde''': I wish the king would be a bit more concerned about this colony. I’m convinced with a few more resources we could improve Port Hope a lot.

''Jogador'': '''dwarfs''' / '''dwarves'''</br>
'''Clyde''': There was a handful of dwarfs that came here when the colony was founded. They were looking for treasures and gold as far as I know. After some argument, a bunch of them left. They headed into the jungle and were never seen again.

''Jogador'': '''lizard'''</br>
'''Clyde''': The lizards are hostile to us. They probably see no big difference between us and the ape people.

''Jogador'': '''apes'''</br>
'''Clyde''': They seem to live in the depth of the jungle in ruins that show the markings of the lizard folk. I wonder if they now try to conquer our city, too.

''Jogador'': '''bye'''</br>
'''Clyde''': Good bye, do visit us again.
}}

| falas =__NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == '''Wyrdin''': If the semi-planar matter correlates with the mana enriched hyperflux ..
'''Wyrdin''': Typical - you can never find a hero when you need one!
'''Wyrdin''': So where was I again?
'''Wyrdin''': If I were to subtract the divergence of the supraplasmatic coefficient ..
'''Wyrdin''': The classic theorem of inductive regeneration disproves the assumption of parallel distortion of astral fluctuation ..
'''Wyrdin''': Could the bonelord language be the invention of some madman?
'''Wyrdin''': The curse algorithm of triplex shadowing has to be two times higher than an overcharged nanoquorx on the peripheral .. == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Wyrdin''': Hello, what brings you here? ''Jogador'': '''job''' / '''here'''
'''Wyrdin''': I'm responsible for compiling new knowledge for our academy. In this position I often assign missions to daring adventurers. ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Wyrdin''': I'm Wyrdin, researcher and librarian. ''Jogador'': '''time'''
'''Wyrdin''': It's ''horas'' right now. ''Jogador'': '''edron'''
'''Wyrdin''': There is still much that needs to be done before Edron can be called a peaceful place, and I'm convinced there are still many secrets hidden here that need to be unearthed. ''Jogador'': '''king'''
'''Wyrdin''': The king is an avid supporter of science. ''Jogador'': '''thais'''
'''Wyrdin''': Thais is way too loud and distracting for carrying out decent research. ''Jogador'': '''excalibug'''
'''Wyrdin''': Sorry, this is not my area of expertise. I believe it is better to be quiet if you know nothing of what you are talking about. ''Jogador'': '''academy'''
'''Wyrdin''': The academy is the foremost facility of research and study in the kingdom. Nothing in the known world rivals the amount of knowledge we've accumulated here. Only the library of the White Raven Monastery comes close. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Wyrdin''': Good luck on your travels, ''Jogador''. |}}

| falas       = 
''Jogador'': '''Hi'''</br>
'''Rosemarie:''' Greetings and nature's blessing, traveller!</br>
''Jogador'': '''Name'''</br>
'''Rosemarie:''' I'm Rosemarie the dryad, and just like my name is linked to flowers, my whole existence is connected to the life of plants.</br>
''Jogador'': '''Ankrahmun / Darashia'''</br>
'''Rosemarie:''' It has its charm but the more plants I have around me the better I feel.</br>
''Jogador'': '''Ab'Dendriel'''</br>
'''Rosemarie:''' The elves found the perfect balance between living from the plants and living with the plants. They should be role models for every living being.</br>
''Jogador'': '''Blessing / Job'''</br>
'''Rosemarie:''' I'm here to celebrate life. I will stay with you mortals for a while. I exchange [[seed]]s, which you might have found on your adventures, for flowerpots with rare seedlings.</br>
''Jogador'': '''Carlin'''</br>
'''Rosemarie:''' I prefer to stay outside of towns but this spot here is tolerable.</br>
''Jogador'': '''Crunor'''</br>
'''Rosemarie:''' The bringer of life and fertility is worshipped by all dryads.</br>
''Jogador'': '''Dryad'''</br>
'''Rosemarie:''' Dryads are the daughters of Crunor and the protectors of plant life. Sadly, most of my sisters are quite aggressive on their mission.</br>
''Jogador'': '''Dwarfs'''</br>
'''Rosemarie:''' I accept every way of life but this of the dwarfs is not mine. Without sunlight, I would shrivel within days like a plant.</br>
''Jogador'': '''Flower'''</br>
'''Rosemarie:''' Flowers are one of the most beautiful gifts that Crunor blessed us with. They are very delicate creatures and must be treated with utmost care.</br>
''Jogador'': '''Jungle'''</br>
'''Rosemarie:''' I love to stroll around in the jungle. The diversity of plants is fantastic there and even the poisonous spit nettle remains calm if it feels the unconditional love for all plants in your heart.</br>
''Jogador'': '''King'''</br>
'''Rosemarie:''' For me, the trees in the jungle of Tiquanda are the kings. Oh, you mean the Tibian king? I'm not interested in human bureaucracy.</br>
''Jogador'': '''Mission'''</br>
'''Rosemarie:''' Many dryads consider almost everything that is no plant as a threat to plants and the forests ...</br>
'''Rosemarie:''' Humans that lumber our forests to build their wooden caves and the strange things they use to cross the seas are especially threatening.</br>
''Jogador'': '''Offer'''</br>
'''Rosemarie:''' If you bring me 5 seeds, I'll give you a flowerpot with a rare seedling. With good care and a little love, it will grow into a beautiful plant.</br>
''Jogador'': '''Plant'''</br>
'''Rosemarie:''' You will have to water it regularly, then it will flourish and grow. There are several stages of growth that your plant has to pass ...</br>
'''Rosemarie:''' With good care and luck, it will grow into the next stage until it finally becomes a fully blooming flower. ...</br>
'''Rosemarie:''' Of course plants won't grow in the darkness of a depot box. On the other hand, it won't dry out there either ...</br>
'''Rosemarie:''' So if you know you can't take care of your plant for a longer time, it might be a good idea to store it into your depot box.</br>
''Jogador'': '''Port Hope'''</br>
'''Rosemarie:''' I love to stroll around in the jungle. The diversity of plants is fantastic there and even the poisonous spit nettle remains calm if it feels the unconditional love for all plants in your heart.</br>
''Jogador'': '''Queen'''</br>
'''Rosemarie:''' The griffinclaw is the queen among the plants.</br>
''Jogador'': '''Thais / Venore / Edron / Liberty Bay'''</br>
'''Rosemarie:''' I prefer to stay outside of towns to enjoy the nature around me.</br>
''Jogador'': '''Bye'''</br>
'''Rosemarie:''' Farewell.</br>

=== Trocando [[Flower Pot]]s ===
''Jogador'': '''Seed'''</br>
'''Rosemarie:''' Each seed is like a baby to us dryads. For every 5 seeds you bring me, I'll reward you with a flowerpot that contains a seedling that might flourish into a rare and beautiful plant if you care for it. ...</br>
'''Rosemarie:''' Do you have any seeds that you would like to exchange?</br>
''Jogador'': '''Yes'''</br>
'''Rosemarie:''' Here, I planted this little baby in a flowerpot for you. Don't forget to water it regularity - buy a watering can somewhere!
}}<noinclude>[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]</noinclude>

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Uso | job = Knight Guild Leader | city = Tiquanda | subarea = Port Hope | location = [[Port Hope]] ({{Mapa|32579,32756,8:1|aqui}}). | implemented = 7.5 | notes = Ele é o chefe de uma pequena exploração mineira em [[Port Hope]]. Em seu tempo livre, treina [[Knights]] para manter suas habilidades afiadas.

A partir do update '''15.22''', lançado em '''27 de janeiro de 2026''', não é mais possível comprar magias com este NPC. A CipSoft removeu a interação com a palavra '''"spell"''' e a funcionalidade de compra de magias, já que elas passaram a ser aprendidas automaticamente assim que o jogador atinge o nível necessário. | buysell = não | buys = Nada. | sells = Nada. | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Uso:''' Hiho ''Player''. Looking for a knight trainer? I'm your man.
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''
'''Uso:''' I'm called Uso Oredigger, son of the Flame from the Dragoneaters.
''Jogador:'' '''Trainer''' ou '''Job'''
'''Uso:''' I'm the head of a little mining operation here and I train knights and teach them spells in my spare time to prevent my old body from rusting.
''Jogador:'' '''Gold'''
'''Uso:''' There IS gold out there. Lots of it! I can feel it in my old bones.
''Jogador:'' '''Spells'''
'''Uso:''' I can teach you healing spells, attack spells, support spells and summon spells. What kind of spell do you wish to learn? You can also tell me for which level you would like to learn a spell, if you prefer that.
''Jogador:'' '''Kazordoon'''
'''Uso:''' We dwarfs call it our home since the dawn of time. I miss Kazordoon a lot, but gold is more important. After I have made a fortune here, I will return home and might settle down.
''Jogador:'' '''Dwarfs'''
'''Uso:''' We are a proud race. Dwarfs are strong and fearless. We can even survive in this forsaken jungle, jawoll.
''Jogador:'' '''Carlin''' ou '''Thais''' ou '''Edron''' ou '''Venore'''
'''Uso:''' To me one human is just as good as the other. I don't care what city they are from.
''Jogador:'' '''Ab'Dendriel'''
'''Uso:''' That's just a bunch of trees but no city.
''Jogador:'' '''Elves'''
'''Uso:''' I wonder why we see so few elves over here. Those tree people should love this cursed jungle, but even they stay away.
''Jogador:'' '''King'''
'''Uso:''' Human kings are not of interest for me.
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
'''Uso:''' So long.
}}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

== Frases Espontâneas ==

== Palavras-Chave ==
''Jogador'': '''hi'''</br>
'''Clark''': Hello, ''Jogador''. Please don’t interrupt me for too long!

''Jogador'': '''job''' / '''interrupt'''</br>
'''Clark''': I’m the captain of the guards and responsible for upholding law and order in the colony.

''Jogador'': '''name'''</br>
'''Clark''': My name is Clark.

''Jogador'': '''guards'''</br>
'''Clark''': The guards of Port Hope are led by Lord Seamus, a nobleman from Thais.

''Jogador'': '''seamus'''</br>
'''Clark''': He is ill and I’m in charge of upholding the law now.

''Jogador'': '''dwarf'''</br>
'''Clark''': Dwarfs are impressive fighters. The Venoreans talked about hiring some of them as mercenaries to help us out.

''Jogador'': '''lizard'''</br>
'''Clark''': They don’t pose a real threat to us.

''Jogador'': '''apes'''</br>
'''Clark''': Rest assured we’ll handle this problem.

''Jogador'': '''dworcs'''</br>
'''Clark''': They fear our power and hide in some caves.

''Jogador'': '''ferumbras'''</br>
'''Clark''': He is the enemy number one of the kingdom and all good people.

''Jogador'': '''excalibug'''</br>
'''Clark''': I heard the knights of Edron hide it somewhere instead of using it for the good of the country.

''Jogador'': '''king'''</br>
'''Clark''': Our king can be proud of this colony.

''Jogador'': '''jungle'''</br>
'''Clark''': The jungle is our first and foremost enemy.

''Jogador'': '''time'''</br>
'''Clark''': It is ''horas'' right now.

''Jogador'': '''thais'''</br>
'''Clark''': Thais is a big city but if we do well enough here, Port Hope might one day rival its size.

''Jogador'': '''venore'''</br>
'''Clark''': The Venoreans are fine and generous people. It’s a good thing that they put all this effort into this colony. I don’t know what we would do if it weren’t for them.

''Jogador'': '''carlin'''</br>
'''Clark''': It’s a shame that those women still get away with their independence. Friends told me that too many of Thais’s resources are wasted in useless projects, and the army is too weak to claim back our belongings.

''Jogador'': '''ab'dendriel''' / '''elves'''</br>
'''Clark''': My guess is that those elves are secretly allied with Carlin. I wouldn’t trust an elf if I met one.

''Jogador'': '''kazordoon'''</br>
'''Clark''': As long as the dwarfs stay there, it’s alright for me to let them have this ugly piece of rock.

''Jogador'': '''edron'''</br>
'''Clark''': The knights of Edron are somewhat arrogant. They keep the resources of the isle all to themselves instead of sharing them.

''Jogador'': '''darashia'''</br>
'''Clark''': A village of harmless cultists. They pose no real threat and could easily be integrated into the Thaian realm.

''Jogador'': '''ankrahmun'''</br>
'''Clark''': This city is a threat to Thais’s domination of Darama. Unfortunately, we are too weak to handle this threat.

''Jogador'': '''darama'''</br>
'''Clark''': This continent will be ours one day.

''Jogador'': '''tibia'''</br>
'''Clark''': I guess a good part of the world is under Thaian rule.

''Jogador'': '''bye'''</br>
'''Clark''': Goodbye, ''Jogador''.
}}

== Frases Espontâneas ==

== Palavras-Chave ==
''Jogador'': '''hi'''</br>
'''Chantalle''': Hello. What brings you here?

''Jogador'': '''job''' / '''here'''</br>
'''Chantalle''': I’m a trader and I sell gems, jewellery and goblets. Just ask me for my offers.

''Jogador'': '''name'''</br>
'''Chantalle''': My name is Chantalle.

''Jogador'': '''buy''' / '''offer''' / '''equipment''' / '''goods''' / '''sell''' / '''stuff''' / '''ware'''</br>
'''Chantalle''': I sell gems and goblets. If you’d like to see my offers, ask me for a trade.

''Jogador'': '''key''' / '''fish'''</br>
'''Chantalle''': What? You lost the key? Well… Lucky for you I made a copy. Do not lose it again!

''Jogador'': '''kiss'''</br>
'''Chantalle''': I’d rather kiss a pig.

''Jogador'': '''cult'''</br>
'''Chantalle''':  I don’t know anything about a cult. On the other hand, I wouldn’t be too surprised if this fish smelling natives, that are up to no good anyway, would have some horrible cult.

''Jogador'': '''voodoo'''</br>
'''Chantalle''': Isn’t that the name of the governor’s daughter’s dog?

''Jogador'': '''explorer society'''</br>
'''Chantalle''': I don’t understand why someone would want to go to some dirty corners of the world or crawl through dusty dungeons. Phew.

''Jogador'': '''gem'''</br>
'''Chantalle''': You can buy and sell small diamonds, sapphires, rubies, emeralds and amethysts or sell topazes.

''Jogador'': '''goblet'''</br>
'''Chantalle''': Ah, our newest import! We have golden goblets, silver goblets and bronze goblets. All of them have space for a hand-written dedication.

''Jogador'': '''horrible'''</br>
'''Chantalle''': Yes, horrible. Isn’t it?

''Jogador'': '''jewel'''</br>
'''Chantalle''': Currently you can purchase wedding rings, golden amulets, and ruby necklaces. We also buy gold ingots.

''Jogador'': '''native'''</br>
'''Chantalle''': The natives had almost massacred themselves before we arrived to rescue them. And what to we get in return? Now they want to massacre us instead! These horrible people.

''Jogador'': '''pearl'''</br>
'''Chantalle''': There are white and black pearls you can buy or sell, as well as giant green and brown pearls which you can sell.

''Jogador'': '''pirate'''</br>
'''Chantalle''': Pirates are scary. Mr. Loveless tries hard to get the army to do more against these horrible pirates. Unfortunately the army people are rather reluctant and always find some excuse for their inactivity.

''Jogador'': '''plantation'''</br>
'''Chantalle''': I better don’t think about all those dirty people that work on the plantations, else I could no longer enjoy my sugared tea. Imagine that their ugly dirty hands have touched this sugar.

''Jogador'': '''quara'''</br>
'''Chantalle''': These horrible fishmen even haunt me in my dreams! I’m sure the natives are in league with them. It’s no coincidence that they both smell alike.

''Jogador'': '''rum'''</br>
'''Chantalle''': It tastes horrible. I can’t understand what people like about it.

''Jogador'': '''sugar'''</br>
'''Chantalle''': Sugar is quite important as far as I understand it.

''Jogador'': '''time'''</br>
'''Chantalle''': Currently it is ''horas''.

''Jogador'': '''talon'''</br>
'''Chantalle''': We don’t trade with them.

''Jogador'': '''trade'''</br>
'''Chantalle''': Here, take a look.

''Jogador'': '''governor'''</br>
'''Chantalle''': The governor is a fine and polite man. I think he even likes me a bit. <giggles> Sad enough that people who like him or Mr. Loveless are rare here.

''Jogador'': '''king'''</br>
'''Chantalle''': The king must be a very special man. I think he’s handsome and tall.

''Jogador'': '''isolde'''</br>
'''Chantalle''': She thinks she is better than everyone else. But I know that a good part of her so-called noble family lives in Carlin, imagine!

''Jogador'': '''loveless''' / '''theodore'''</br>
'''Chantalle''': You can say that Mr. Loveless is kind of an ambassador of Venore. He is very important and I run his business here. He’s a good friend of the local governor and back in Venore he’s an important figure of the trade association.

''Jogador'': '''raymond striker'''</br>
'''Chantalle''': That is one of those horrible cutthroats that lead the pirates.

''Jogador'': '''tristan'''</br>
'''Chantalle''': Quite handsome and what a well-trained body he has. I can’t imagine what he sees in this colourless and pale Isolde.

''Jogador'': '''ferumbras'''</br>
'''Chantalle''': He’s some evil sorcerer. Sorcerers are horrible people anyway.

''Jogador'': '''wyrmslicer'''</br>
'''Chantalle''': He’s handsome, yet a bit old. And sadly you’ll never get rich being in the army. It’s a shame but for these reasons he probably will never be able to find an accomplished woman.

''Jogador'': '''charlotta'''</br>
'''Chantalle''': It’s the name of a scary old hag that the natives sometimes call if they are sick. Why don’t they just buy some medicine or call for a healer? Silly people.

''Jogador'': '''chondur'''</br>
'''Chantalle''': Who might that be? Probably one of these horrible natives.

''Jogador'': '''eleonore'''</br>
'''Chantalle''': She’s a bit younger than me and a bit jealous that I and her father get along with each other so well.

''Jogador'': '''liberty bay'''</br>
'''Chantalle''': What a horrible, horrible little town. Have you seen those huts some people live in? How can they stand this? Silly people. And that stench! Everything and everyone that is native smells like fish! Horrible, I say it’s just horrible!

''Jogador'': '''thais'''</br>
'''Chantalle''': Thais must be a wonderful place. Almost comparable to Venore as far as I can tell.

''Jogador'': '''bye'''</br>
'''Chantalle''': Farewell.
}}

pages.wikitext:

| notes       = Admiral Wyrmsclicer é o almirante da frota Thaiana e comandante das forças militares e da [[Liberty Bay Fortress]]. Ele acha que pode demorar algum tempo, mas com a orientação de Liberty Bay irá florescer e prosperar.
| buysell     = não
| buys        =
| sells       =
| falas       = __NOTOC__
== Frases Espontâneas ==
Não possui.

== Palavras-Chave ==
''Jogador'': '''hi'''</br>
'''Admiral Wyrmslicer''': Greetings, ''Jogador''. Have you anything to report?

-----

=== Sobre Admiral Wyrmslicer: ===

''Jogador'': '''job'''</br>
'''Admiral Wyrmslicer''': I am admiral of the Thaian fleet and commander of this fort and the local military.

''Jogador'': '''wyrmslicer'''</br>
'''Admiral Wyrmslicer''': My family is respected for many deeds of heroism. There is a well-known dragon slayer in our bloodline which earned us that name of honour.

-----

=== Sobre NPC's: ===
''Jogador'': '''theodore''' / '''loveless'''</br>
'''Admiral Wyrmslicer''': Mr. Loveless has a sharp and quick mind. If he were no trader, he would have made a great officer.

''Jogador'': '''king'''</br>
'''Admiral Wyrmslicer''': LONG LIVE THE KING!

''Jogador'': '''isolde'''</br>
'''Admiral Wyrmslicer''': Competent and efficient. I give nothing about ugly rumours, and she never, ever, betrayed the trust put into her.

''Jogador'': '''governor'''</br>
'''Admiral Wyrmslicer''': The governor is a fine man, and I do my best to support him in all his efforts.

''Jogador'': '''eleonore'''</br>
'''Admiral Wyrmslicer''': This young lady truly graces Liberty Bay with her presence. It is always a pleasure to meet her.

''Jogador'': '''chondur'''</br>
'''Admiral Wyrmslicer''': I heard about that man. For some people he is some kind of father figure. If he should ever misuse that, we will take a closer look at him.

''Jogador'': '''charlotta'''</br>
'''Admiral Wyrmslicer''': I believe she is this old healer in town. I don’t think she is happy with our presence here but she did nothing yet that would justify to arrest her.

''Jogador'': '''tristan'''</br>
'''Admiral Wyrmslicer''': A fine knight indeed. I am very pleased with his efforts.

''Jogador'': '''raymond striker'''</br>
'''Admiral Wyrmslicer''': Captain Striker is one of the more cunning pirates. Up to now, he managed to escape but sooner or later he will run out of luck.

-----

=== Locais e Cidades: ===
''Jogador'': '''thais'''</br>
'''Admiral Wyrmslicer''': Thais is of course the crown of our kingdom and the place our hearts will belong to forever.

''Jogador'': '''liberty bay'''</br>
'''Admiral Wyrmslicer''': It might take some time, but with our guidance the city will flourish and prosper.

''Jogador'': '''carlin'''</br>
'''Admiral Wyrmslicer''': Sooner or later Carlin will be nothing more than a footnote in history. Look at the size of our kingdom and compare it with Carlin …</br>
'''Admiral Wyrmslicer''': One day they will accept that it is better to rejoin the kingdom and to combine our efforts and resources for the good of all.

''Jogador'': '''venore'''</br>
'''Admiral Wyrmslicer''': The efforts Venore put into this city are admirable. It’s only fair that they gain a certain profit from that.

-----

=== Outras Palavras-Chave: ===
''Jogador'': '''excalibug'''</br>
'''Admiral Wyrmslicer''': Excalibug is an inspiring myth, but after all, only a myth.

''Jogador'': '''explorer society'''</br>
'''Admiral Wyrmslicer''': We welcome the representatives of the society here and will do our best to support them.

''Jogador'': '''ferumbras'''</br>
'''Admiral Wyrmslicer''': I am not familiar with witchcraft and sorcery. Perhaps you should ask someone else.

''Jogador'': '''report'''</br>
'''Admiral Wyrmslicer''': I heard enough of the gossip and superstitions. I am fed up with that nonsense!

''Jogador'': '''gossip'''</br>
'''Admiral Wyrmslicer''': Spare me the nonsense that people made up, like sinister cultists, quara infiltrators, pirate hideouts voodoo curses and whatnot! …</br>
'''Admiral Wyrmslicer''': I’ve heard it all, and it is completely rubbish and a waste of my time! We have everything firmly under control. And to ensure this, I warn you not to talk to the townspeople about such issues!

''Jogador'': '''cult'''</br>
'''Admiral Wyrmslicer''': The talks about the cult are getting tiresome. There is no such thing. It is only another superstition here.

''Jogador'': '''quara'''</br>
'''Admiral Wyrmslicer''': The quara are treacherous foes who don’t fight with common tactics. This and the security of the seas, to which they can withdraw, make it difficult to handle them properly.

''Jogador'': '''pirates'''</br>
'''Admiral Wyrmslicer''': Pirates are vermin and we will wipe them from the map wherever they raise their ugly heads.

''Jogador'': '''voodoo'''</br>
'''Admiral Wyrmslicer''': Superstition! We have real sorcerers and none of them uses such prankish trickery.

''Jogador'': '''sugar'''</br>
'''Admiral Wyrmslicer''': We need the sugar. We will ensure with everything that is at our command that the supply of sugar is kept up.

''Jogador'': '''rum'''</br>
'''Admiral Wyrmslicer''': Rum can be just as good for morale as it can be bad. It has to be administered with care.

''Jogador'': '''plantations'''</br>
'''Admiral Wyrmslicer''': There is always trouble at the plantations, either with the rotworms or with drunken or rebellious workers.

''Jogador'': '''natives'''</br>
'''Admiral Wyrmslicer''': I don’t want to hear talks about ‘natives’ or such. We are all subjects of his majesty, the King of Thais.

''Jogador'': '''bye'''</br>
'''Admiral Wyrmslicer''': Good bye ''Jogador'', you may leave.
}}

pages.title: Marcus
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Marcus | job = Guarda | city = Vandura | subarea = Liberty Bay | location = [[Liberty Bay]] ({{Mapa|32320,32863,7:1|aqui}}). | implemented = 7.8 | buysell = não | buys = | sells = | notes = Marcus é quem cuida da carga no porto de Liberty Bay.
Se você perguntar sobre piratas ele irá dizer:
Eu matei meu companheiro pirata na minha juventude. São marinheiros que dão um mau nome. Nada mais do que bandidos.
Se você perguntar sobre Eleonore ele irá dizer:
A pequena princesa do governador, é? Tão multa e importante para se preocupar com pessoas normais. Por que haveremos de nos preocupar com ela? | falas = ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
Marcus: Ahoi. What is your business in the harbour? ''Jogador'': '''job''' ou '''harbour'''
Marcus: I keep an eye on the cargo here in the harbour. ''Jogador'': '''here'''
Marcus: If people would mind their own business, the city could be a better place. ''Jogador'': '''pirates'''
Marcus: I killed my share of pirates in my youth. Dogs that give sailors a bad name. Nothing more than bandits. ''Jogador'': '''eleonore'''
Marcus: The governor's little princess, eh? Too fine and important to care about us ordinary people of course. Why should we care about her? ''Jogador'': '''governor'''
Marcus: The governor does his job I guess. ''Jogador'': '''king'''
Marcus: The king lives far away and appears like a fairy tale over here. ''Jogador'': '''Thais'''
Marcus: Go away with that Thais. I've been there and I've seen it. Not impressive at all. ''Jogador'': '''Carlin'''
Marcus: A horrible town for a sailor. Imagine a town without alcohol, ruled by women! I guess if you are a pirate or some other dog, your afterlife starts in Carlin. ''Jogador'': '''Venore'''
Marcus: They build fine ships in this town. That's the best I can say about it. If you do not have enough money, you are nothing in Venore. ''Jogador'': '''Liberty Bay'''
Marcus: If people would mind their own business, the city could be a better place. ''Jogador'': '''Raymond Striker'''
Marcus: Just another lousy pirate, although a quite daring and successful one. ''Jogador'': '''Chondur'''
Marcus: He is just some old man about which the townspeople are talking now and then. Who cares. ''Jogador'': '''Ferumbras'''
03:07 Marcus: Although he's dead, they say that he is the father of all klabautermen. ''Jogador'': '''Klabautermen'''
Marcus: A klabauterman is some sort of imp that lives on ships and plays quite evil and sometimes lethal pranks on those who annoy him or don't buy his sympathy with little gifts. ''Jogador'': '''Quaras'''
Marcus: The quara are one of the most murderous threats that the sea gave birth too. I would rather face a giant sea serpent than a horde of quara ... Marcus: In the case of a sea serpent you know at least that you'll end up devoured, but who knows what the quara will do to you. ''Jogador'': '''Excalibug'''
Marcus: I swear I have seen it in the bay just outside of Liberty Bay, deep in the ocean. I was ... uhm catching some fresh air after a night of rum and card games. I looked over the railing into the sea and suddenly I saw that sword in a heap of gold and jewels. ''Jogador'': '''Bye'''
Marcus: Bye. |}}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.title: Theodore Loveless
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Theodore Loveless | job = Porta-voz | city = Vandura | subarea = Liberty Bay | location = [[Liberty Bay]] ({{Mapa|32363,32785,6:1|aqui}}). | implemented = 7.8 | notes = Theodore Loveless é o porta-voz de [[Venore]], ele parece ter ódio. | buysell = não | buys = | sells = | falas = ''Jogador'': '''Hi'''
Theodore Loveless: Greetings, dear visitor.
''Jogador'': '''Job'''
Theodore Loveless: I am honoured to humbly serve as the spokesman of the Venorean trading companies.
''Jogador'': '''Venore'''
Theodore Loveless: Venore has become an impressive little point of trade for wares from all over the world. The steady work pays off and brings us a modest state of luxury ... We have learnt much from our big brother Thais which we admire and where we are still searching for guidance.
''Jogador'': '''Liberty Bay'''
Theodore Loveless: We put great hope in this settlement. The Venorean traders invested much money in the growth of that community here ... We have to see that the little profit we make will be enough to cover our expenses in the remote future ... But we are happy that our money could help to bring peace and to civilise the natives here ... Thais finally brought order to the locals that were torn from fightings and hunger before our arrival.
''Jogador'': '''Thais'''
Theodore Loveless: Thais is such a lovely city. The bustling centre of civilisation. The world has to thank Thais for so many things.
''Jogador'': '''Sugar'''
Theodore Loveless: Sugar is money. Sugar is business. It's as easy as that.
''Jogador'': '''Ferumbras'''
Theodore Loveless: I heard he has some relation to these isles. To learn more about it, you probably talk to the mage from Edron that resides in a tower here in the city.
''Jogador'': '''King'''
Theodore Loveless: The king has again proven his great wisdom. The way how he allowed to settle the affairs in Liberty Bays was more than smart ... The trust he has put in the governor, the local military and the help from Venore begins slowly to pay off ... People have work and something to do. The number of fights decreased to the brawls between drunks that are usual for seaports ... As soon as we have the pirates eliminated, we can lower many of the restrictions we had to enforce for the safety of all.
''Jogador'': '''Governor'''
Theodore Loveless: Governor Silverhand is such a fine person. He does so much for the city and receives so little in return. I hope we can cheer him up now and then. That's the least we can do for this great man that sacrifices himself for the good of his people.
''Jogador'': '''Companies'''
Theodore Loveless: Ah, my young friend, you have no idea how many companies have some sort of interest in seeing this settlement prosper.
''Jogador'': '''Pirates'''
Theodore Loveless: The pirates are all what is left from the warlords that once terrorised this region. Now that peace and the protection of Liberty Bay byour military moves in, their days are numbered ... One day, hopefully in the near future, the sea will be just as safe as this isle.
''Jogador'': '''Isolde'''
Theodore Loveless: I must admit I am a bit suspicious of this young lady. As far as I know she was not overly fond of the Thaian nobility. Add her strong family ties to this rebel townCarlin and you begin to wonder what that woman is up to. All of a sudden she accepted a mission for the nobility that she did not acknowledge before? And this unholy influence on this poor young Tristan whom she seduced with her beauty. I must admit, I am concerned.
''Jogador'': '''Tristan'''
Theodore Loveless: What a fine young man. I just wonder what brought him here in the first place. Of course I don't believe into rumours that he left a sick wife and 3 childrensomewhere to begin a new life here. That is probably just made up by those that are jealous of him.
''Jogador'': '''Admiral Wyrmslicer'''
Theodore Loveless: Even the mentionable efforts of this great admiral could not stop the pirates yet. But he will not rest until the last one of this scum will hang for the glory of Thais.
''Jogador'': '''Raymond Striker'''
Theodore Loveless: This notorious pirate and cutthroat has killed more men, women and children than the last epidemic we had here in the slums ... He is known as ruthless warlord who sacrifices even his own men to ensure his escape. Sooner or later some hero will rise and slay him.
''Jogador'': '''Voodoo'''
Theodore Loveless: Call it like you want. It is just another form of magic ... The only difference to the more common magic is that they are rather revert to cheap tricks, poison and superstition.
''Jogador'': '''Charlotta'''
Theodore Loveless: This ugly hag is known as witch and poison brewer. Sadly she is too clever and the citizens too fearful, so the guards could not arrest her yet ... Given she's only a minor nuisance though, it is not that urgent.
''Jogador'': '''Chondur'''
Theodore Loveless: Chondur was a charismatic leader amongst the settlers that used to lived here. His greed for land and power made him to one of the warlords that were responsible for all those fights and cruelty between the settlers ... It was for warlords like him that we had to intervene for the good of the people. I heard he is still around and uses his magic to lure superstitious followers under his banner.
''Jogador'': '''Settlement'''
Theodore Loveless: We put great hope in this settlement. The Venorean traders invested much money in the growth of that community here ... We have to see that the little profit we make will be enough to cover our expenses in the remote future ... But we are happy that our money could help to bring peace and to civilise the natives here ... Thais finally brought order to the locals that were torn from fightings and hunger before our arrival.
''Jogador'': '''Eleonore Silverhand'''
Theodore Loveless: Miss Eleonore is so charming, so beautiful. Her strong will and her independence poses surely a great challenge to every man who wants to marry her. But one look into her beautiful eyes and you will see that she is worth the effort. Perhaps one day I might be allowed to take that challenge ... who knows. |}}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''</br>
[[Janz]]: Welcome to my shop of wonderful carpentry and furniture.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''</br>
[[Janz]]: My name is Janz.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''</br>
[[Janz]]: I am selling furniture.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Furniture''' ou '''Offer'''</br>
[[Janz]]: Well, as you can see, I sell furniture. Ask me for a trade if you're interested to see my wares.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Gods'''</br>
[[Janz]]: We have little use of your southern gods.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Druid'''</br>
[[Janz]]: The druids are shamans from Carlin.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Shaman'''</br>
[[Janz]]: The shamans are great seers and healers.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Ferumbras'''</br>
[[Janz]]: That's some evil spirit the people of the south are fearing.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Excalibug'''</br>
[[Janz]]: A weapon that would make woodcutting easy.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''News'''</br>
[[Janz]]: Nothing exciting has happened lately.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Carlin'''</br>
[[Janz]]: I visited Carlin once and I was very impressed. They used less wood then I'd expected but it was a marvellous town.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Edron'''</br>
[[Janz]]: From the tales I heard, it expect it to be a bit like Everspring.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Everspring'''</br>
[[Janz]]: I heard this is some spot in the South which is similar to the place that expects one in the afterlife.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Port Hope'''</br>
[[Janz]]: I heard they used much wood, too, to build that town.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Svargrond'''</br>
[[Janz]]: If it were not for the wood we've gotten from Carlin, the city would for sure look less impressive.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Thais'''</br>
[[Janz]]: I heard Thais is even bigger than Carlin.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Venore'''</br>
[[Janz]]: The people of Carlin are somewhat bothered by Venore.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Dwarf'''</br>
[[Janz]]: I heard they are fine woodcutters.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Elf'''</br>
[[Janz]]: I heard their city is made of living trees! Imagine!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Chakoya'''</br>
[[Janz]]: The chakoyas are real. My grandfather got killed by them.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Yeti'''</br>
[[Janz]]: They are rather rare.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Dragon'''</br>
[[Janz]]: The dragons usually stay in their areas, so we have little trouble with them.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Jarl'''</br>
[[Janz]]: Our jarl is a fine man. I named a cupboard after him.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Barbarians'''</br>
[[Janz]]: I am proud to be a barbarian, even though a civilised one of course.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Raiders'''</br>
[[Janz]]: They are just greedy for all we have accomplished.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Cult'''</br>
[[Janz]]: I don't even understand what that means.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Mines'''</br>
[[Janz]]: The mines are somewhere in the mountains. In the early days of our city, many people from Carlin used to work there.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Chyll'''</br>
[[Janz]]: Father north wind knows best.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Nibelor'''</br>
[[Janz]]: Most shamans live there.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Years Of Serpents'''</br>
[[Janz]]: That have been hard years in which we were cut off from our main wood supply. Gladly wood does not suffer much in our climate.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''How Are You?'''</br>
[[Janz]]: It could be worse I guess.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''</br>
[[Janz]]: Good bye.
}}<noinclude>[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]</noinclude>

pages.title: Lurik
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Lurik | job = Representante da Explorer Society | city = Hrodmir | subarea = Svargrond | location = [[Svargrond]] ({{Mapa|32319,31135,7:1|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.0 | buysell = sim | buys = Nada. | sells = {{Trades/Sell |Orichalcum Pearl}} | notes = Lurik é um dos poucos habitantes que ganhou a confiança do Jarl [[Sven]], e assim como alguns dos cidadãos de Svargrond irá pedir uma tarefa para Sven e para representar [[Svargrond]] na [[Explorer Society]] para Lurik.

* Faz parte da [[The Explorer Society Quest]]. * Faz parte da [[The Ice Islands Quest]].

| falas = == Palavras-Chave Gerais == ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
[[Lurik]]: Welcome to the explorer society headquarter of Svargrond, ''Jogador''!
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''
[[Lurik]]: My name is Lurik. Odd enough you ask though. People hardly do that nowadays. I feel as if my name was painted above my head or something.
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
[[Lurik]]: I am the explorer's society. I just love it to be at the frontier of all known lands.
''Jogador:'' '''King''' ou '''Queen'''
[[Lurik]]: No kings or queens rule these remote lands.
''Jogador:'' '''Gods'''
[[Lurik]]: We know of father Chyll and his freezing breath. We care little for other gods. It is foolish to meddle with beings that are so powerful ...
[[Lurik]]: We leave it to the druids and shamans to handle such affairs.
''Jogador:'' '''Ferumbras'''
[[Lurik]]: Even here we heard about this powerful man. Travellers from the south only dare to whisper his name.
''Jogador:'' '''Excalibug'''
[[Lurik]]: On the campfire, there are numerous tales about this weapon. It's told that it has been missing since ages ...
[[Lurik]]: In my opinion, the power and fame of a weapon shouldn't exceed the power and fame of it's wielder. And I have not heard of any hero whose fame would surpass that of excalibug.
''Jogador:'' '''News'''
[[Lurik]]: At this remote spot, news are old news. Did you hear that quara attacked Liberty Bay?
''Jogador:'' '''How Are You?'''
[[Lurik]]: I am fine. Thank you. There is a bit less work here than I had expected but I am sure we will have some intriguing discoveries just waiting for us.
''Jogador:'' '''Dwarf'''
[[Lurik]]: I met some of those little people in the past. Considering our experience with the chakoyas, we don't underestimate someone just for its look. And those dwarfs proved indeed to be powerful, courageous and enduring.
''Jogador:'' '''Elf'''
[[Lurik]]: Some time ago, a few elves came here but they could not stand the cold and so they left pretty soon. Most likely it was Nibelor in which they have been interested.
''Jogador:'' '''Rumours'''
[[Lurik]]: Maybe you already heard that we send our dead with a boat on their last journey. A rumour came to my ear that many of the corpses stranded on the small island of Helheim where they walk around as UNDEADS. I wonder if this is true. == Explorer's Society == ''Jogador:'' '''Explorer's Society'''
[[Lurik]]: Our noble society is dedicated to explore the unknown. No location is too remote for our members to travel there ...
[[Lurik]]: No beast is too wild to be hunted. No treasure buried too deep to be unearthed ...
[[Lurik]]: Only the most dedicated and fearless adventurers may join our ranks.
''Jogador:'' '''join''' ''(Já um membro)''
[[Lurik]]: But you are already a member, ''Jogador''.
''Jogador:'' '''rank''' ''(rank)''
[[Lurik]]: You are a novice of the explorer's society.
''Jogador:'' '''Badge'''
[[Lurik]]: You have no special badge earned yet.
''Jogador:'' '''Mission'''
[[Lurik]]: Sorry, I have no mission available. == Svargrond == ''Jogador:'' '''City'''
[[Lurik]]: This city has seen much in the few days of its existence. At first it was a little trading spot where ships form Carlin landed. Later it became a deposit for ore that has been mined in the mountains ...
[[Lurik]]: Then local people joined the traders from Carlin and supplied them with fish, furs and meat ...
[[Lurik]]: Soon it became a small settlement and the locals, fascinated with the abundance of wood the traders brought with them, begun to build houses ...
[[Lurik]]: It became a centre of conflict when some barbarians decided it was wrong to settle in a town and later on struggled to survive when the contact to Carlin was lost for decades ...
[[Lurik]]: Today, the city got a little boost by the presence of foreigners here. But only the future will tell what the fate of this city will be.
''Jogador:'' '''Druids''' ou '''Shamans'''
[[Lurik]]: Most shaman and druids of our people live on the sacred isle Nibelor. There, they divine the future, calm the wrath of father Chyll and prepare the dead for their last travel to the lands of Everspring.
''Jogador:'' '''Nibelor'''
[[Lurik]]: Nibelor has always been a sacred place for our people. The druids and shamans live there.
''Jogador:'' '''Everspring'''
[[Lurik]]: Everspring is the realm of the dead. It is a place of peace and harmony where those who boldly braved the challenges of life dwell for eternity and share stories at the campfires after a hunt ...
[[Lurik]]: Every true barbarian that is properly brought into afterlife will join the great hunt in Everspring where the animals are fat and have the thickest furs.
''Jogador:'' '''Cult'''
[[Lurik]]: I don't care what people who come here believe in. If they provoke father Chyll, he will take care of them on his own. If their gods prove to be more powerful than Chyll, they might deserve to live.
''Jogador:'' '''Jarl'''
[[Lurik]]: The jarl is a kind of chieftain of the local people here. If you haven't done yet, talk to him. If you want to be accepted by the people here, you will have to ask the jarl for the barbarian test.
''Jogador:'' '''Barbarian'''
[[Lurik]]: A true barbarian is something special among our people. Everyone who wants to become a barbarian will have to pass the barbarian test.
''Jogador:'' '''Barbarian Test'''
[[Lurik]]: All of our juveniles have to take the barbarian test to become a true member of our community. Foreigners who manage to master the test might become honorary barbarians and gain the respect of our people.
''Jogador:'' '''People'''
[[Lurik]]: The people here seem to be a bit uncivilised on the first glance. Rest rest assured that they are hospitable and generous if you earn their respect in some way.
''Jogador:'' '''Raiders'''
[[Lurik]]: Those barbarian who did oppose the building of this settlements call themselves raiders. They consist of some major and minor clans. ...
[[Lurik]]: It's said that they are lead by a shaman woman, who has celebrated her 100th birthday a long time ago, but I am not sure how believable such records are.
''Jogador:'' '''Mines'''
[[Lurik]]: A long time ago when the trade with Carlin was flourishing, people actually worked in the mines. During the years of the serpents, the mines had been abandoned. ...
[[Lurik]]: Later, the raiders took shelter there, although they blame us for living in a fortified city ...
[[Lurik]]: Now, the traders of Carlin are back but some other foreigners seem to have claimed the mines from the raiders ...
[[Lurik]]: It's neither our business nor would we have the manpower to help them to recapture the mines. Also, if they do not have the strength to get the mines back on their own, they don't deserve them anyway.
''Jogador:'' '''Years Of Serpents'''
[[Lurik]]: It was an astonishing phenomenon. For decades, sea serpents made it impossible to reach these northern isles by ship ...
[[Lurik]]: The most puzzling part of this event is probably the fact that sea serpents usually prefer a southern climate ...
[[Lurik]]: However, almost over night the sea serpents seemed to be gone and the contact between Carlin and the isles here could finally be reestablished.
''Jogador:'' '''Chakoya'''
[[Lurik]]: It's a shame I still have not seen a living chakoya. I could examine some dead specimen though and I have seen some of their victims ...
[[Lurik]]: It's hard to believe that such a small creature is such a terrible threat but for all I can tell they are indeed quite dangerous.
''Jogador:'' '''Yeti'''
[[Lurik]]: The yetis are mythical beasts. Only few that encountered those creatures lived to tell the tale. The chakoyas worship them as divine beings, although they have no real relations to them, as far as we can tell. == Cidades == ''Jogador:'' '''Carlin'''
[[Lurik]]: We are friends of the Carliners. Still we don't allow their politics to influence our way to handle things here.
''Jogador:'' '''Edron'''
[[Lurik]]: We have heard only little about this far away place.
''Jogador:'' '''Venore'''
[[Lurik]]: We did not allow them to stay here. This had nothing to do with our friendship with Carlin but for the way they handled things and their harmful approach to go hunting.
''Jogador:'' '''Thais'''
[[Lurik]]: We understand that our friends from Carlin are wary with the realm ruled by Thais but this is not of our concern.
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
[[Lurik]]: Good bye. Come back soon with exciting stories about your travels. |}}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''</br>
[[Hawkyr]]: Hello fellow hunter. Are you looking for paladin spells? I'm your man.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''</br>
[[Hawkyr]]: I am Hawkyr the hunter.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''</br>
[[Hawkyr]]: I am a hunter and bowyer. If you need some training, I am the man you want to see.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Mission''' ou '''Task'''</br>
[[Hawkyr]]: Sorry, I don't have anything to do for you.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''King'''</br>
[[Hawkyr]]: In our lands, the most successful hunter is the king. Be it beast or man.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Queen'''</br>
[[Hawkyr]]: In our lands, the most successful huntress is the queen. Be it beast or woman.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Gods'''</br>
[[Hawkyr]]: The gods of the south seem to have little influence here.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Spells'''</br>
[[Hawkyr]]: Sorry, I don't teach spells for your vocation.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Druid''' ou '''Shaman'''</br>
[[Hawkyr]]: They know the ways of spirits and nature. You can learn a lot from them just by listening. Still, you can always learn a lot if you're listening well to what nature tells you.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Ferumbras'''</br>
[[Hawkyr]]: Better ask the Southerners about that one.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Excalibug'''</br>
[[Hawkyr]]: A weapon hardly useful for a hunter.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''News'''</br>
[[Hawkyr]]: The wolves are very hungry lately.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Carlin'''</br>
[[Hawkyr]]: I don't think I'd like that place and it's not only that this is not my marked territory.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Edron''' ou '''Port Hope'''</br>
[[Hawkyr]]: Only foreigners talk about that place now and then.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Svargrond'''</br>
[[Hawkyr]]: I admire the safety of the burrow and the closeness of the pack. It's a good thing to have a lair to which you can withdraw to lick your wounds.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Thais'''</br>
[[Hawkyr]]: Thais is some far away city.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Venore'''</br>
[[Hawkyr]]: Carlin and Venore seem to live in some sort of rivalry.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Dwarf'''</br>
[[Hawkyr]]: Most dwarfs I've seen seem to lack the stealthiness to become a good hunter.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Elf'''</br>
[[Hawkyr]]: Elves are good hunters. Even I was able to learn something from the elves that came here. I am thinking about visiting their city some day.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Chakoya'''</br>
[[Hawkyr]]: The chakoya are ferocious hunters. They don't only kill out of hunger, they love the carnage they are causing.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Yeti'''</br>
[[Hawkyr]]: Yetis are rare but they do exist. Everyone that has been hunting in the frozen wastes for some time can share stories of their sightings.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Dragon'''</br>
[[Hawkyr]]: It's not easy to hunt dragons. Suddenly, a hunter might become the hunted in their lairs.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Cult'''</br>
[[Hawkyr]]: I don't know anything about it.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Barbarian'''</br>
[[Hawkyr]]: Being a barbarian means to be one with nature and its instincts.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Raiders'''</br>
[[Hawkyr]]: Their packs are not of our kin anymore. They left our pack. We will see how they prosper. They have nothing to expect from us except for cold steel in their hearts.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Mines'''</br>
[[Hawkyr]]: As far as I have understood it, they are of some importance for the people of Carlin.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Chyll'''</br>
[[Hawkyr]]: Father north wind knows best.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Nibelor'''</br>
[[Hawkyr]]: An isle on which the shamans live.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Years Of Serpents'''</br>
[[Hawkyr]]: I wonder if even bigger hunter have driven them away.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''How Are You?'''</br>
[[Hawkyr]]: I only feel alive when I'm on a hunt. But even I need some time to rest and regain strength.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''</br>
[[Hawkyr]]: Good hunting, ''Jogador''.
|}}<noinclude>[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]</noinclude>

[[Romir]]: Greetings, traveller. I'm a magical trader and trainer for sorcerer spells. How may I help you?
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''
[[Romir]]: I am known as Romir.
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
[[Romir]]: I guess one could call me a hermit. I am a bit new to this hermit business though and I have to admit I enjoy some company now and then. I also earn some money by teaching spells to those in search of knowledge.
''Jogador:'' '''Trader'''
[[Romir]]: Of course, just browse through my wares. Or do you want to look only at potions, wands or runes?
''Jogador:'' '''Potions'''
[[Romir]]: Have a look. You can also look at wands or runes.
''Jogador:'' '''Wands'''
[[Romir]]: Have a look. You can also look at potions or runes.
''Jogador:'' '''Runes'''
[[Romir]]: Have a look. You can also look at wands or potions.
''Jogador:'' '''Spells'''
[[Romir]]: Okay, then just browse through all of my wares.
''Jogador:'' '''News'''
[[Romir]]: If I cared about news, I hadn't chosen this remote spot to settle down.
''Jogador:'' '''Yeti'''
[[Romir]]: The most yetis have been seen further south. Of course only because they are much more easily overlooked in the rugged mountains and huge snow plains here.
''Jogador:'' '''Cult'''
[[Romir]]: There something sinister going on and I am quite sure this cult you just mentioned is somehow connected to it.
''Jogador:'' '''Dwarfs'''
[[Romir]]: Dwarfs are quite settled. Even if the mines were recaptured, I doubt that we would see more than a handful of dwarfs here..
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
[[Romir]]: Good bye. }} [[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]
