pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Thorwulf | job = Knight Guild Leader | city = Hrodmir | subarea = Svargrond | location = [[Svargrond]] ({{Mapa|32262,31091,6:1|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.0 | buysell = não | buys = Nada. | sells = Nada. | notes = Ele era responsável por ensinar [[magias]] para [[Knights]].

A partir do update '''15.22''', lançado em '''27 de janeiro de 2026''', não é mais possível comprar magias com este NPC. A CipSoft removeu a interação com a palavra '''"spell"''' e a funcionalidade de compra de magias, já que elas passaram a ser aprendidas automaticamente assim que o jogador atinge o nível necessário. | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
[[Thorwulf]]: Hi ''Jogador''.
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''
Thorwulf: I am Thorwulf, slayer of dragons, giants and yetis.
''Jogador:'' '''Dragon'''
Thorwulf: The dragons of these lands are fierce as a blizzard and lethal as the silent cold and the howling snow storm alike.
''Jogador:'' '''Yeti'''
Thorwulf: The yetis are powerful and cunning foes. It takes the right bait to lure them out of their hiding places.
''Jogador:'' '''Bait'''
Thorwulf: I won't tell. Never ever. Find out on your own.
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
Thorwulf: I am an expert fighter and I can teach a true warrior in the arts of war.
''Jogador:'' '''Mission''' ou '''task'''
Thorwulf: I don't have anything to do for you.
''Jogador:'' '''King'''
Thorwulf: How can someone who never proved himself as a warrior lead people into a battle?
''Jogador:'' '''Queen'''
Thorwulf: The people from [[Carlin]] seem to respect their queen. Though, I can't understand why. She is hardly a warrior.
''Jogador:'' '''Gods'''
Thorwulf: I couldn't care less for gods. Every true warrior creates his own fortune.
''Jogador:'' '''Spells'''
Thorwulf: Sorry, I don't teach spells for your vocation.
''Jogador:'' '''Druids'''
Thorwulf: As far as I understood it, druids are like our shamans. I know enough magic to defeat my opponents on my own. So I have only little use for such spell casters
''Jogador:'' '''Shamans'''
Thorwulf: All they are doing is talking to the spirits the whole day. My enemies, however, are of flesh and blood and I can handle them on my own.
''Jogador:'' '''Ferumbras'''
Thorwulf: Bah, to know that he is a sorcerer means to know that he is a coward.
''Jogador:'' '''Excalibug'''
Thorwulf: A true warrior will kill his opponents with a rusty knife. There is no need for a mighty weapon. Where is the honour if the weapon is more powerful than its wielder?
''Jogador:'' '''News'''
Thorwulf: There are no news ... yet. But I can smell blood and steel in the air. I can feel it, there is going to be a battle soon.
''Jogador:'' '''Carlin'''
Thorwulf: I care little for the people from Carlin. All of them are so weak and timid. I could not care less for their concerns. If they want something to be done, they will have to do it on their own.
''Jogador:'' '''Edron''' ou '''port Hope'''
Thorwulf: Some far away place the people of Carlin talk about now and then.
''Jogador:'' '''Svargrond'''
Thorwulf: I hate it to wait here for our enemies to arrive. I'd rather go out and wage war in their camps and lairs.
''Jogador:'' '''Thais'''
Thorwulf: Thais is not better than Carlin.
''Jogador:'' '''Venore'''
Thorwulf: For all I know, they are schemers and liars. That means they are even worse than the other southerners.
''Jogador:'' '''Dwarf'''
Thorwulf: I haven't seen many of them around here.
''Jogador:'' '''Elf'''
Thorwulf: The elves that came here were quite skilled with a bow. I respect that in a way, still it takes little courage to shoot something from afar.
''Jogador:'' '''Chakoya'''
Thorwulf: The chakoyas are small but their teeth can shred a man's arm into pieces. Their strength lies in their number as well as in ambushes on unwary or sleeping persons.
''Jogador:'' '''Cult'''
Thorwulf: I don't care about cults.
''Jogador:'' '''Jarl'''
Thorwulf: Our jarl has grown old. I honour him for his deeds in the past but I wonder if a younger leader wouldn't be better now. He could lead us into glorious battles with the raiders.
''Jogador:'' '''Raiders'''
Thorwulf: Their cowardly tactics are a shame for every true barbarian, so is their obedience to a witch. They are not even worthy opponents.
''Jogador:'' '''Barbarian'''
Thorwulf: Most people have forgotten that being a true barbarian means to be a fearless fighter.
''Jogador:'' '''Mines'''
Thorwulf: Those Carliners seem to care about those mines, but they don't have the guts to recapture them. Pathetic.
''Jogador:'' '''Chyll'''
Thorwulf: The wind that has seen all battles and that puts an icy blanket over the battlefields.
''Jogador:'' '''Nibelor'''
Thorwulf: A boring piece of ice and rock on which only shamans live.
''Jogador:'' '''Years of Serpents'''
Thorwulf: Men are not supposed to travel the seas. So I don't care if these giant serpents ever existed or if they had only been an excuse for cowards.
''Jogador:'' '''How are you?'''
Thorwulf: As long as I am not fighting, I am bored.
''Jogador:'' '''Rumours'''
Thorwulf: A few years ago there was an arena fighter named Alrik. He managed to win the Warlord title three times in a row. He was Svargrond's greatest hero and all of a sudden he was gone and never seen again. ... Thorwulf: Even his sculpture disappeared. The people say Chyll took him directly to Everspring where he could live a king's life as a reward.
''Jogador:'' '''Coward'''
Thorwulf: You talked to Robert, did you? I think I scared him pretty well! Hehehe!
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
Thorwulf: Bye ''Jogador''. |}}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''</br>
[[Bertha]]: Greetings ''Jogador''. Looking for a trade, I hope. Business is not going well.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Svargrond'''</br>
[[Bertha]]: These barbarians are still adapting to the city life but they do quite well I guess. They still lack interest in real trading and ... let's say they are a bit limited in their horizon.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Thais'''</br>
[[Bertha]]: I guess whole Thais is laughing at the failure of our operations.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Carlin'''</br>
[[Bertha]]: Carlin expects wonders of me. However, as long as they don't send some considerable help, they can wait until moss is growing in their hair.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Edron'''</br>
[[Bertha]]: They promised me these frozen lands could become for Carlin what Edron is for Thais. What a cruel joke.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Dwarves'''</br>
[[Bertha]]: Sadly I could not win many dwarfs for our mining operations. They are probably afraid of Thais's reaction if it becomes known that they are helping us.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Elf'''</br>
[[Bertha]]: The elves are of no great help. They do little to convince the spiritual leaders of the barbarians to help me.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Book'''</br>
[[Bertha]]: My inventory of general goods and paperware is large, ask me for a trade to take a look.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Magic'''</br>
[[Bertha]]: Ask a sorcerer or druid about that.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Yeti'''</br>
[[Bertha]]: Another senseless tale of superstitious natives.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Cult'''</br>
[[Bertha]]: Well, we heard of some strangers that travelled through this city. Not exchanging many words with the people here. The locals claim they headed straight to our old mines ...</br>
[[Bertha]]: As far as I can tell though not much has changed at the mines. Our scouts are still attacked or even killed. So I assume the strangers were either killed or they are friends of the raiders ...</br>
[[Bertha]]: I have no clue what has happened and I don't have the resources to find out.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Chakoya'''</br>
[[Bertha]]: I think these chakoyas are only a tale to scare the local kids.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Barbarian'''</br>
[[Bertha]]: All this cold seems to have frozen the brains of those people to solid ice.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Weapon'''</br>
[[Bertha]]: Robert sells that. Go and ask him about that.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Robert'''</br>
[[Bertha]]: You can buy general goods from me. For weapons and armor you rather see my assistant Robert at the arena in the mountains to the west.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Equipment'''</br>
[[Bertha]]: My inventory of general goods and paperware is large, ask me for a trade to take a look.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Jarl'''</br>
[[Bertha]]: The jarl here is of no great help. Our equipment and wood is welcome but we get little profit out of these deals.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Raiders'''</br>
[[Bertha]]: Their presence is bad enough. The fact that they occupied the mines and that they hate us non-natives of this frozen rock makes things only worse.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Mines'''</br>
[[Bertha]]: The mines are actually [[Carlin]]'s property. If only the queen were sending soldiers, to get them back from this rabble. Venore is probably planning to take over these mines just as we are talking.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Shaman'''</br>
[[Bertha]]: That's how the local druids call themselves.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Chyll'''</br>
[[Bertha]]: That seems to be a god that the locals worship.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Nibelor'''</br>
[[Bertha]]: Nibelor is an isle on which the local druids dwell.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Years Of Serpents'''</br>
[[Bertha]]: What a horrible threat those beasts have been. But if they hadn't vanished all of a sudden, we would never have stranded here.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''</br>
[[Bertha]]: I'm Bertha from Carlin.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''</br>
[[Bertha]]: I'm a trader by profession but here you could also call me the ambassador of Carlin. However, there is little I can do about our problems, and support from Carlin is virtually non-existent.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Mission''' ou '''Task'''</br>
[[Bertha]]: Unless you can change the whole situation here, I don't have anything to do for you.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''King'''</br>
[[Bertha]]: The pompous king of Thais might be involved in the take-over of our mines.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Gods'''</br>
[[Bertha]]: The gods seem to be far away in this corner of the world.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Magic'''</br>
[[Bertha]]: Ask a sorcerer or druid about that.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Druids'''</br>
[[Bertha]]: The druids of Carlin have quite good connections to the local druids here.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Ferumbras'''</br>
[[Bertha]]: Well, HE would only be needed to make things worse over here.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Excalibug'''</br>
[[Bertha]]: I toyed with the idea to spread the rumour that Excalibug might be hidden in the mines. I think if enough adventurers were lured into the mines, they might drive out the ones that occupy them now ...</br>
[[Bertha]]: So do me a favour, when somebody asks about Excalibug, tell them it's down there in those mines.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Rumours'''</br>
[[Bertha]]: I have confirmed information that Excalibug lies deep in the mines. If you manage to find it, you would be the biggest hero and everybody would know your name! ...</br>
[[Bertha]]: Imagine that: King '''Jogador''', who found Excalibug and saved the world !!! Sounds good, huh??</br>
''Jogador:'' '''News'''</br>
[[Bertha]]: News? Are you mocking me? Almost any news would be good news. As long as it concerns Carlin's affairs, nothing seems to change for the better.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Offer'''</br>
[[Bertha]]: My inventory of general goods and paperware is large, ask me for a trade to take a look.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''How Are You?'''</br>
[[Bertha]]: It could definitely be better but thanks for asking. I hope you're fine yourself.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''</br>
[[Bertha]]: Bye ''Jogador''.
|}}<noinclude>[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]</noinclude>

''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''</br>
[[Jessica]]: Greetings stranger. Let me know if you want to trade gems or jewellery. I am also the local bank contact.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''</br>
[[Jessica]]: My name is [[Jessica]].</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''</br>
[[Jessica]]: I sell jewellery and serve as the local bank contact.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Jewellery'''</br>
[[Jessica]]: Currently you can purchase Wedding Rings, Golden Amulets, and Ruby Necklaces. We also buy Gold Ingots.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Bank'''</br>
[[Jessica]]: We can change money for you. You can also access your bank account.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Bored'''</br>
[[Jessica]]: Okay okay, no need to be rude! It seems you are already know everything.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Money'''</br>
[[Jessica]]: We can change money for you. You can also access your bank account.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Advanced'''</br>
[[Jessica]]: Renting a house has never been this easy. Simply make a bid for an auction. We will check immediately if you have enough money ...</br>
[[Jessica]]: Please keep in mind that the sum you have used to bid will be unavailable unless somebody places a higher bid. Once you have acquired a house the rent will be charged automatically from your bank account every month.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Mission''' ou '''task'''</br>
[[Jessica]]: I don't have anything to do for you.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''King'''</br>
[[Jessica]]: The king in Thais works for the Venorean trade barons. I can't imagine what sinister ideas they might implant into his mind right now.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Gods'''</br>
[[Jessica]]: The gods only help those who help themselves.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Druid'''</br>
[[Jessica]]: We had hardly any assistance from the druids here. I think that's more than suspicious ...</br>
[[Jessica]]: There might be some agent from Venore who has been infiltrated into their ranks. It is also possible that these treehuggers were bribed with a handful of acorns. Who knows!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Ferumbras'''</br>
[[Jessica]]: There are enough heroes around to take care of those obvious threats.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Edron'''</br>
[[Jessica]]: All Thaian colonies are in the firm grip of the schemes of Venorean trade barons.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Svargrond'''</br>
[[Jessica]]: This wannabe city full of hardly civilised barbarians is a dangerous mixture. It takes little for the Venorean agents to cause havoc here.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Venore'''</br>
[[Jessica]]: The trade barons are the worst enemies one can have. They have their hidden agents everywhere and murder and treachery are natural to them.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Dwarf'''</br>
[[Jessica]]: There is a mine but no dwarfs. What do they know what we don't, I ask you? I am convinced they know that Venore will make anyone suffer that is trying to claim these mines.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Elf'''</br>
[[Jessica]]: The elves are not interested in our problems at all.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Chakoya'''</br>
[[Jessica]]: We have never ever seen one here. Instead of talking about far-off chakoyas, they should concentrate on REAL threats like the Venoreans.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Yeti'''</br>
[[Jessica]]: There are no yetis. That's just another story to draw off our attention from what is really happening.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Cult'''</br>
[[Jessica]]: Spare me with that cult stories. This was no cult but some Venorean agents who were heading to their hired barbarians which had occupied our mines.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Talons'''</br>
[[Jessica]]: We don't trade with them.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Jarl'''</br>
[[Jessica]]: The local chieftain does nothing to help us. It would be so easy for him to drive those other barbarians away from the mines. I suspect he was bribed to remain inactive by agents of Venore.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Barbarians'''</br>
[[Jessica]]: Those are simple people. Sadly, they have been influenced by others.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Mines'''</br>
[[Jessica]]: How convenient for Venore that we lost control over the mines. And isn't it also convenient for Venore that Carlin seems to lack interest to recapture the mines. I'd say that smells like conspiracy.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Shamans'''</br>
[[Jessica]]: I can't say that I trust these fellows.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Chyll'''</br>
[[Jessica]]: That belongs to some superstitious belief of the locals.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Nibelor'''</br>
[[Jessica]]: Some mysterious isle which was hardly seen by any outsider. I wonder what's happening there in all that secrecy.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Years Of Serpents'''</br>
[[Jessica]]: The sea serpents were surely the work of Venore. They are the only ones that are unscrupulous enough to execute such a plan. Their disappearance was just part of some conspiracy to lure us here for some reason ...</br>
[[Jessica]]: I am only wondering how the Venoreans managed to lure that many serpents to the north.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''How Are You?'''</br>
[[Jessica]]: I am fine. Odd that you ask though ... I hope you are not up to something.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''News'''</br>
[[Jessica]]: There are no news. I think that's quite suspicious.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Rumours'''</br>
[[Jessica]]: I heard the jarl opened a head hunt on the Venorans. As this is a secret, you have to use the keyword “blubber” to gain his trust in that case. He promised 1000 gold for every dead Venorean hunter.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''</br>
[[Jessica]]: Good bye.
|}}<noinclude>[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]</noinclude>

| notes       = Robert não gosta de seu trabalho e deseja [[Bertha]], sua superior, ele quer trabalhar em outra profissão ou voltar para sua casa em [[Carlin]].
| falas       = 
''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''</br>
[[Robert]]: Hello, ''Jogador''! Nice to see you, welcome to my weapon shop.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''</br>
[[Robert]]: My name is Robert.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''</br>
[[Robert]]: I am responsible for the trade with weapons and armor here in the arena. I constantly beg my superior Bertha to give me some other job or, even better, to send me back to Carlin but the cold seems to have frozen her heart.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Weapon'''</br>
[[Robert]]: I have many weapons to offer, including bows, crossbows and ammunition. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a trade.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Armor'''</br>
[[Robert]]: I am selling leather, chain, and brass armor. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a trade.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Legs'''</br>
[[Robert]]: I am selling chain legs. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a trade.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Mission''' ou '''task'''</br>
[[Robert]]: No, I don't have anything to do for you.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''King'''</br>
[[Robert]]: I heard they have a king in Thais.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Queen'''</br>
[[Robert]]: If only our beloved queen would know what dangers we have to face here. I am sure she would call us back to the safety of Carlin.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Gods'''</br>
[[Robert]]: I daily pray to the gods to protect me from harm. I still believe in a wonder to come which will get me back to Carlin.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Druids'''</br>
[[Robert]]: If there were some more druids around with all their awesome healing powers, I'd feel more comfortable.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Shamans'''</br>
[[Robert]]: They are the local witch doctors. I'd rather wait for the rare visit of a druid from Carlin than to put my life in the hands of one of those people.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Ferumbras'''</br>
[[Robert]]: Shush! Don't speak that name aloud. It might call him here.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Excalibug'''</br>
[[Robert]]: Sorry, I think we are out of stock.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''News'''</br>
[[Robert]]: The good news are: I got not killed by some drunken barbarian or unskilled axe thrower. The bad news are: I am still stranded here.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Offer'''</br>
[[Robert]]: My offers are weapons, ammunition, armors, helmets, legs, and shields. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Carlin'''</br>
[[Robert]]: Oh sweet Carlin, when will I see you again?</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Edron'''</br>
[[Robert]]: Edron is in the other end of the world. I wish I were there.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Port Hope'''</br>
[[Robert]]: Port Hope and its cannibal orcs is almost as bad as Svargrond.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Thais'''</br>
[[Robert]]: Even Thais could not be worse than this frozen hell hole here.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Venore'''</br>
[[Robert]]: Jessica says they have agents everywhere. I wonder if they try to kill me to hinder our trade here ...</br>
[[Robert]]: Since the day I spoke with Jessica, I sleep under my bed, just to be on the safe side.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Svargrond'''</br>
[[Robert]]: Sure it looks peaceful, but to be honest, those wild barbarians are scary.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Dwarf'''</br>
[[Robert]]: You know, I thought dwarfs were rude drunkards. However, that was before I met the people here.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Elf'''</br>
[[Robert]]: Elves are strange creatures. I heard each of them can cast spells and curses. Every time an elf is looking in my direction, it gives me shivers.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Chakoya'''</br>
[[Robert]]: For all I heard, the palisades won't stop them when they come at night to kidnap sleeping people and to eat them alive.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Yeti'''</br>
[[Robert]]: Yetis are huge, but perfectly camouflaged in the snow. They attack out of nowhere and before you can scream you are dead.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Cult'''</br>
[[Robert]]: I don't know what you mean.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Jarl'''</br>
[[Robert]]: The local jarl is a fine man, measured by local standards that is. Still he can't bring me back from the dead when some of the barbarians go berserk and kill me.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Raiders'''</br>
[[Robert]]: The raiders are even wilder and, well ... more barbaric than the local barbarians. Can you imagine?!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Mines'''</br>
[[Robert]]: The mines are lost. If only the people in Carlin were to accept that and call us back.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Chyll'''</br>
[[Robert]]: That is some spirit the barbarians seem to fear.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Nibelor'''</br>
[[Robert]]: It's a haunted isle where the shamans call spirits and such to our world.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Years Of Serpents'''</br>
[[Robert]]: If those sea serpents had not vanished, I could still sit in the warm and safe Carlin. Cursed serpents.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''How Are You?'''</br>
[[Robert]]: Oh, don't even ask.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Rumours'''</br>
[[Robert]]: Have you talked to Thorwulf yet?? Be careful, I heard that he killed an experienced fighter in one hit just because he was called a coward after rejecting a challenge. I myself don't even dare to look in his eyes.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''</br>
[[Robert]]: Good bye, ''Jogador''.
}}<noinclude>[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]</noinclude>

| falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
[[Nelly]]: Hello ''Jogador'', What can I do for you? I'm working for the post office, but I also trade with important potions, runes and other magical equipment.
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''
[[Nelly]]: I am Nelly ... Any special reason you ask?
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
[[Nelly]]: I am working for the local post office. I also happen to have some recently imported potions and runes to sell for a very special price.
''Jogador:'' '''Mission''' ou '''Task'''
[[Nelly]]: I don't have anything to do for you. Not even for me. What a boring place!
''Jogador:'' '''King'''
[[Nelly]]: I wonder if the king in Thais even knows that this post office exists.
''Jogador:'' '''Druids'''
[[Nelly]]: Druids of Carlin come here now and then to meet with the local shaman.
''Jogador:'' '''Shamans'''
[[Nelly]]: Just another name for the same magic users as usual. Probably spying on unsuspecting people like all those magic guys do.
''Jogador:'' '''Gods'''
[[Nelly]]: This place is godforsaken.
''Jogador:'' '''City'''
[[Nelly]]: The depots you can send parcels or letters to are in the following cities: Ab'Dendriel, Ankrahmun, Carlin, Darashia, Edron, Kazordoon, Liberty Bay, Port Hope, Svargrond, Thais and Venore.
''Jogador:'' '''Ferumbras'''
[[Nelly]]: May his name be cursed.
''Jogador:'' '''Excalibug'''
[[Nelly]]: A myth the locals probably enjoy.
''Jogador:'' '''News'''
[[Nelly]]: As if anything you'd get to hear, could be considered new.
''Jogador:'' '''Carlin'''
[[Nelly]]: Carlin lost interest in this place quite fast.
''Jogador:'' '''Edron'''
[[Nelly]]: What are you suggesting? What do you know ... No, you can't know anything at all. Just forget it.
''Jogador:'' '''Svargrond'''
[[Nelly]]: Yes, that's Svargrond. Welcome to the end of the world.
''Jogador:'' '''Thais'''
[[Nelly]]: Thais has no affairs here.
''Jogador:'' '''Venore'''
[[Nelly]]: I wonder if things were better if Venore ran the mining operations.
''Jogador:'' '''Dwarf'''
[[Nelly]]: It seems even the dwarfs know better than to try their luck here.
''Jogador:'' '''Elf'''
[[Nelly]]: The elves are of no great help here. They prefer to stay in warmer climates.
''Jogador:'' '''Potion'''
[[Nelly]]: We offer health, spirit and mana potions in up to four sizes: normal, strong, great and ultimate. Ask me for a {trade} to see my offers.
''Jogador:'' '''Yeti'''
[[Nelly]]: The locals have so many superstitions, who can tell what's the truth and what is a myth.
''Jogador:'' '''Chakoya'''
[[Nelly]]: Those chakoyas are hopefully just a local myth.
''Jogador:'' '''Cult'''
[[Nelly]]: There were several strange people passing through the city some months ago. As far as I heard, they headed to the west and probably died in the cold.
''Jogador:'' '''Jarl'''
[[Nelly]]: The local authority and the first man here. He seems quite reasonable for a northman to me.
''Jogador:'' '''Barbarian'''
[[Nelly]]: Those barbarians are just ruffians with no manners.
''Jogador:'' '''Raiders'''
[[Nelly]]: Who cares, I would not be that stupid to leave this frozen town anyway.
''Jogador:'' '''Mines'''
[[Nelly]]: The loss of the mines doomed this place to complete insignificance.
''Jogador:'' '''Chyll'''
[[Nelly]]: I think that's how the natives call the wind.
''Jogador:'' '''Nibelor'''
[[Nelly]]: I am not sure if it's a real place. Perhaps it's only some myth. Who knows or cares?
''Jogador:'' '''Years Of Serpents'''
[[Nelly]]: If only these sea serpents had never disappeared.
''Jogador:'' '''How Are You?'''
[[Nelly]]: What do you know that makes you asking??
''Jogador:'' '''Rumours'''
[[Nelly]]: That guy from the Carlin Trading Syndicate told me that he knows a guy in Carlin who heard that the postman was talking to a customer about Svargrond and that he would like to work here! ...
Nelly: Do you know what that means ??? I could finally leave this cursed ice block for good!!
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
[[Nelly]]: Good bye, ''Jogador''. == Sobre o Sistema de Correio == ''Jogador:'' '''Sell''' ou '''Offer'''
[[Nelly]]: I sell parcels, letters, health potions, mana potions and runes.
''Jogador:'' '''Post''' ou '''Mailbox'''
[[Nelly]]: With our mail system you can send letters and parcels to other Tibians. I can give you detailed information or sell letters and parcels to you if you ask me for a trade.
''Jogador:'' '''Letter'''
[[Nelly]]: If you want to buy a letter, ask me for a trade. Or do you want me to explain how letters work?
''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''
[[Nelly]]: With a letter you can send a message to another Tibian's depot. If you want to send it to 'Ben' in 'Thais', use the letter - so that a form opens - and write 'Ben' in the first line and 'Thais' in the second line. Write your message below that. ...
''Jogador:'' '''Information'''
[[Nelly]]: I can explain the mail system to you, or how parcels and letters work. If you want to buy something, ask me for a trade. }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

{{DASH|img=desambig|''Esta é a página do NPC '''Armenius''', para a criatura com o mesmo nome, veja [[Armenius (Criatura)]].''}}{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Armenius | job = Comerciante de Alimentos | npcclass = Humanos | npcsprite = Nobleman | city = Yalahar | subarea = Yalahar Trade Quarter | location = [[Yalahar Trade Quarter]] ({{Mapa|32859,31325,7:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.4 | buysell = sim | buys = | sells = {{Trades/Sell | Beer;Mug of Beer, 3 | Bread, 4 | Cheese, 6 | Egg, 2 | Ham, 8 | Meat, 5 | Rum; Mug of Rum | Tomato | Wine;Mug of Wine, 4}} | notes = Ele não está muito "feliz" em falar com você, é apenas um ''barman''.

* Faz parte da [[Blood Brothers Quest]].

| falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == Não possui. == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Armenius''': Ah, an adventurer. Be greeted and have a seat. How may I serve you? ''Jogador'': '''job'''
'''Armenius''': That’s not a serious question, is it? I’m running a bar. Duh. Are you interested in my offers? ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Armenius''': Don’t you know that when you know a person’s name, you hold some power over that person? ''Jogador'': '''armenius'''
'''Armenius''': Uh huh. Scary, you can read the name on my bar. ''Jogador'': '''food'''
'''Armenius''': We offer bread, cheese, ham, and meat, as well as eggs and tomatoes. Ask for a trade if you want to have a look. ''Jogador'': '''drink'''
'''Armenius''': I got beer, wine and some imported rum. ''Jogador'': '''offers'''
'''Armenius''': Didn’t your mama teach you? Ask for a trade if you want to see what my bar has to offer. ''Jogador'': '''trade'''
'''Armenius''': Sure. ''Jogador'': '''blood'''
'''Armenius''': If you want blood, go kill a pig. ''Jogador'': '''vampire'''
'''Armenius''': Why would you ask that? I give you a hint – don’t meddle in affairs you haven’t the slightest idea about. ''Jogador'': '''yalahar'''
'''Armenius''': Fine place for me right now. Lots of… supplies. ''Jogador'': '''alori mort'''
'''Armenius''': Go away, little fly. ''Jogador'': '''cookies'''
'''Armenius''': It’d be better for you to leave now. ''Jogador'': '''quarter'''
'''Armenius''': This quarter might look a little run-down, but I prefer that to the shallow golden glory of the inner city. ''Jogador'': '''julius'''
'''Armenius''': Oh, don’t talk about him. Little Mr. Know-it-all, he is. ''Jogador'': '''serafin'''
'''Armenius''': Isn’t that the fruit guy? Yes, I’ve seen him. ''Jogador'': '''ortheus'''
'''Armenius''': Don’t see him often. He basically lives on the opposite side of the city. ''Jogador'': '''lisander'''
'''Armenius''': He prefers to visit a nobler tavern than mine. Pff. ''Jogador'': '''maris'''
'''Armenius''': A former pirate I think. ''Jogador'': '''augur'''
'''Armenius''': Unimportant gofers. ''Jogador'': '''mr west'''
'''Armenius''': He's not a bad person, even from my point of view. Lots of criminals find shelter in this quarter, which means more people who come and visit my bar. ''Jogador'': '''''palavra aleatória'''''
'''Armenius''': You know, actually I don’t feel like chatting with you much. Sorry, kid. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Armenius''': Good bye. }}

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Barry | job = Guarda | npcclass = Humanos | npcsprite = Knight | city = Yalahar | subarea = Yalahar Magician Quarter, Yalahar Sunken Quarter | location = Entre o [[Yalahar Magician Quarter]] e o [[Yalahar Sunken Quarter]] ({{Mapa|32884,31159,7:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.4 | buysell = não | notes = Diga '''pass''' e o destino para passar por esse portão.

* Faz parte da [[In Service of Yalahar Quest]].

| falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == '''Barry''': I wish my shift would end. == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Barry''': Hello. Unless you have official business here or want to pass the gate, please move on. ''Jogador'': '''job''' / '''official'''
'''Barry''': I'm a sergeant of the Yalaharian Guard Force. ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Barry''': I'm called Barry. ''Jogador'': '''augur'''
'''Barry''': They were appointed by the Yalahari to execute supervising and controlling tasks. ''Jogador'': '''mission'''
'''Barry''': Excuse me? I'm not sure which mission you are talking about, just tell me what you want from me. ''Jogador'': '''pass''' / '''gate'''
'''Barry''': Do you want to pass the gate? Are you going to the magician or the sunken quarter? :''Jogador'': '''magician'''
:'''Barry''': Just stay on the main road and you should be safe. :''Jogador'': '''sunken'''
:'''Barry''': While you're there, consider having a chat with Tarak. He's a good guy. ''Jogador'': '''quarter'''
'''Barry''': We have eight quarters plus the centre, and each of them is like an own microcosm. ''Jogador'': '''yalahar'''
'''Barry''': I actually like the city. There's so much going on in all those small streets and corners, it's really entertaining. ''Jogador'': '''island'''
'''Barry''': Neither Captain Karith nor Captain Cookie are sailing to the outer islands. I haven't found anyone yet to bring me there. ''Jogador'': '''mistrock'''
'''Barry''': Mistrock? Yes, maybe that's the name. I'm not sure. ''Jogador'': '''fenrock'''
'''Barry''': Yes, you're right. People are calling that snowy island Fenrock. ''Jogador'': '''vengoth'''
'''Barry''': I heard about Vengoth, but not much. ''Jogador'': '''alchemist quarter'''
'''Barry''': I'd be careful if I went there. Some people have never come back, and those who did are ill in one or the other way. ''Jogador'': '''arena quarter'''
'''Barry''': A lot of trouble has been coming from that quarter lately. It seems that the former fighters and gladiators have changed in most unexpected ways. ''Jogador'': '''sunken quarter'''
'''Barry''': You know, I was guarding this gate here at the time the southern quarter collapsed. It's something I'll never be able to erase from my mind. ''Jogador'': '''cemetery quarter'''
'''Barry''': You will not be able to attend any religious ceremonies in that quarter, that's a fact. Better stay away. ''Jogador'': '''factory quarter'''
'''Barry''': The old factory is just south of here. The machines and worker golems are not really functioning anymore, but you still hear their operating sounds. ''Jogador'': '''foreign quarter'''
'''Barry''': I'm glad I don't have to do shifts there. It's interesting, but there are constantly fights going on. ''Jogador'': '''magician quarter'''
'''Barry''': A quarter full of talented magicians, illustrious figures and dangerous magical creatures. The latter cause most of the problems in this quarter. ''Jogador'': '''trade quarter'''
'''Barry''': Mr. West is not as bad as some people make him look like. He's a bit like 'steal from the rich to give it to the poor', in my opinion. ''Jogador'': '''''palavra aleatória'''''
'''Barry''': This is of no importance to me right now. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Barry''': Goodbye citizen! }}

pages.title: Bruce
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Bruce | job = Guarda | npcclass = Humanos | npcsprite = Knight | city = Yalahar | subarea = Yalahar Alchemist Quarter, Yalahar Cemetery Quarter | location = Entre o [[Yalahar Alchemist Quarter]] e [[Yalahar Cemetery Quarter]] ({{Mapa|32741,31114,7:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.4 | buysell = não | notes = Diga '''pass''' e o destino para ir através de seu portão.

* Faz parte da [[In Service of Yalahar Quest]].

 | falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == '''Bruce''': I wish my shift would end. == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Bruce''': Hello. Unless you have official business here or want to pass the gate, please move on. ''Jogador'': '''job''' / '''official'''
'''Bruce''': Master Sergeant of the Yalaharian Guard Force, sir. ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Bruce''': My name is Bruce. ''Jogador'': '''augur'''
'''Bruce''': They are our supervisors. ''Jogador'': '''mission'''
'''Bruce''': What is that mission you are talking about? ''Jogador'': '''pass''' / '''gate'''
'''Bruce''': Should I let you pass the gate? Are you headed for the alchemist or the cemetery quarter? :''Jogador'': '''alchemist'''
:'''Bruce''': Don't stay there for too long. The quarter is badly contaminated. :''Jogador'': '''cemetery'''
:'''Bruce''': Be careful in there. Those graves and crypts are far from sacred. ''Jogador'': '''quarter'''
'''Bruce''': Our guards protect the gates between all eight quarters. ''Jogador'': '''yalahar'''
'''Bruce''': I will protect this city with my life. ''Jogador'': '''island'''
'''Bruce''': Which island are you talking about? Mistrock, Fenrock or Vengoth? ''Jogador'': '''mistrock'''
'''Bruce''': No one knows what this island is really called, but the people stick with 'mistrock' due to it being covered in mist. ''Jogador'': '''fenrock'''
'''Bruce''': It's a snowy island to the west. ''Jogador'': '''vengoth'''
'''Bruce''': One day the vampires on Vengoth will become a big threat. We should expect the worst from that place. ''Jogador'': '''alchemist quarter'''
'''Bruce''': There has been a huge explosion due to some unknown experiments. Ever since then, the quarter is contaminated. ''Jogador'': '''arena quarter'''
'''Bruce''': This used to be a great recreation area with a zoo and a lively arena. ''Jogador'': '''sunken quarter'''
'''Bruce''': The quarter collapsed into the ocean. ''Jogador'': '''cemetery quarter'''
'''Bruce''': This is the quarter to the east. Don't expect any worshippers of our Tibian gods though. ''Jogador'': '''factory quarter'''
'''Bruce''': Those old and malfunctioning machines could pose a threat to civilians. ''Jogador'': '''foreign quarter'''
'''Bruce''': New inhabitants are arriving daily, and most will be stuck in the foreigners' quarter forever. ''Jogador'': '''magician quarter'''
'''Bruce''': I have huge respect for those highly educated magicians living there and dealing with the other magical creatures each day. ''Jogador'': '''trade quarter'''
'''Bruce''': I think it's an outrage that this quarter is controlled by criminals. ''Jogador'': '''''palavra aleatória'''''
'''Bruce''': I have nothing to say about that topic. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Bruce''': Goodbye citizen! }}

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}}
| name        = Captain Cookie 
| job         = Capitão de Navios
| city        = Yalahar
| subarea     = Yalahar Centre
| location    = [[Yalahar Centre]] ({{mapa|32803,31272,6:10|aqui}}).

| buys        =  
| sells       =  
| notes       = Ele leva você até [[Liberty Bay]] por 400 [[gp]]. 
| falas       = __NOTOC__
== Frases Espontâneas ==
Não possui.

== Palavras-Chave ==
''Jogador'': '''hi'''</br>
'''Captain Cookie''': Greetings, daring adventurer. If you need a passage, let me know.

''Jogador'': '''job'''</br>
'''Captain Cookie''': Until I finally discover the cockaigne, I'll work as a captain of this ship for the explorer's society.

''Jogador'': '''vampire'''</br>
'''Captain Cookie''': Well, if I was a vampire I guess I'd want all the blood I could get too. So I can't really blame them. Guess they have found their land of blood and honey already.

''Jogador'': '''honey'''</br>
'''Captain Cookie''': There is little in the world that cannot be improved with honey! I even use honey to style my hair!

''Jogador'': '''sweets'''</br>
'''Captain Cookie''': Sweets are the greatest creation of the gods ever!

''Jogador'': '''explorers society'''</br>
'''Captain Cookie''': Isn't it obvious? They are explorers! If someone else but me should ever discover the cockaigne, it will be them! So I'm staying with them!

''Jogador'': '''chocolate'''</br>
'''Captain Cookie''': I just love chocolate! And honeyed chocolate I like the most!

''Jogador'': '''blood crystal'''</br>
'''Captain Cookie''': That doesn't sound really tasty.

''Jogador'': '''cockaigne'''</br>
'''Captain Cookie''': When I heard the story about the cockaigne as a kid, I just knew it must be the truth. A land of milk and honey must exist, and one day I'll find it!

''Jogador'': '''food'''</br>
'''Captain Cookie''': I can't help it, I love sweets of any kind!

''Jogador'': '''palimuth'''</br>
'''Captain Cookie''': I don't know much about him. He welcomed me to the city and was quite polite.

''Jogador'': '''ship'''</br>
'''Captain Cookie''': I always dreamt about a ship made of sweets. But honestly I think I could not resist to taste it and would probably shipwreck it.

''Jogador'': '''sugar'''</br>
'''Captain Cookie''': Yummy, the mother of all sweets!

''Jogador'': '''ocean'''</br>
'''Captain Cookie''': I sometimes wonder why the gods did not make the ocean taste like lemonade. I guess if they did, it would have been drunken dry already.

''Jogador'': '''kick''' ''(o NPC te expulsa do barco)''</br>
'''Captain Cookie''': Get off my raft!

''Jogador'': '''yalahar'''</br>
'''Captain Cookie''': I travelled here, hoping to find the cockaigne. Imagine my disappointment when I discovered I was wrong.

''Jogador'': '''yalahari'''</br>
'''Captain Cookie''': I wonder what kind of sweets they might prefer.

''Jogador'': '''liberty bay''' / '''passage'''</br>
'''Captain Cookie''': I can bring you to our base in Liberty Bay for 400 gold. Is that what you want?

:''Jogador'': '''no'''</br>
:'''Captain Cookie''': Maybe another time.

''Jogador'': '''oramond'''</br>
'''Captain Cookie''': Well, this is a strange region of Tibia. All that green slime there ... That's not to my taste.

''Jogador'': '''svargrond'''</br>
'''Captain Cookie''': Go away. Everything there tastes salty or oily. They use all their honey to produce mead. What a waste!

''Jogador'': '''roshamuul'''</br>
'''Captain Cookie''': That's an island east of Darashia. Full of old ruins and unholy, demonic creatures. Brrr.

''Jogador'': '''darama'''</br>
'''Captain Cookie''': Darama is a strange continent. I traveled there a long time ago in search of the cockaigne.

''Jogador'': '''ab'dendriel'''</br>
'''Captain Cookie''': Hmm, cookies with sweetened bug milk are so delicious.

''Jogador'': '''venore'''</br>
'''Captain Cookie''': Venore's sweets are exclusive and incredibly expensive. Once, I spent my whole wage on a night full of cookies and candies.

''Jogador'': '''carlin'''</br>
'''Captain Cookie''': They have a decent assortment of sweets there.

''Jogador'': '''thais'''</br>
'''Captain Cookie''': Thais is rather dull and uninteresting when it comes to sweets.

''Jogador'': '''kazordoon'''</br>
'''Captain Cookie''': Dwarfish sweets taste oddly. And most sorts contain alcohol.

''Jogador'': '''ankrahmun'''</br>
'''Captain Cookie''': A horrible place. You have no idea how fast chocolate is melting there!

''Jogador'': '''darashia'''</br>
'''Captain Cookie''': The heat there lets chocolate melt quickly, but their candies made of sand wasp honey are something I could die for!

''Jogador'': '''farmine'''</br>
'''Captain Cookie''': The dwarves and their odd cave systems ...

''Jogador'': '''zao'''</br>
'''Captain Cookie''': Zao is a continent south-east of Yalahar. Many lizards live there ... Creepy, I tell you!

''Jogador'': '''krailos'''</br>
'''Captain Cookie''': Krailos is a faraway grassland, inhabited by savage ogres.

''Jogador'': '''issavi'''</br>
'''Captain Cookie''': A really big city on the continent Kilmaresh. Its architecture is almost as impressive as Yalahar's. The creatures there, even more so.

''Jogador'': '''bye'''</br>
'''Captain Cookie''': Good bye.
}}

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Chuckles | job = Comerciante de Itens Mágicos | city = Yalahar | subarea = Yalahar Centre | location = [[Yalahar Centre]] ({{Mapa|32789,31236,5:1|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.4 | notes = Este NPC tem a aparência de um [[Lich]]. | buysell = sim | buys = {{Trades/Buy | Empty Potion Flask (Small) | Empty Potion Flask (Medium) | Empty Potion Flask (Large) | Spellwand | Vial}}
| sells = {{Trades/Sell | Avalanche Rune | Blank Rune | Chameleon Rune | Convince Creature Rune | Cure Poison Rune | Destroy Field Rune | Energy Field Rune | Energy Wall Rune | Durable Exercise Rod | Durable Exercise Wand | Exercise Rod | Exercise Wand | Explosion Rune | Fire Bomb Rune | Fire Field Rune | Fire Wall Rune | Great Fireball Rune | Great Health Potion | Great Mana Potion | Great Spirit Potion | Hailstorm Rod | Health Potion | Heavy Magic Missile Rune | Intense Healing Rune | Lasting Exercise Rod | Lasting Exercise Wand | Light Magic Missile Rune | Mana Potion | Moonlight Rod | Necrotic Rod | Northwind Rod | Poison Field Rune | Poison Wall Rune | Snakebite Rod | Spellbook | Spellbook of the Novice | Springsprout Rod | Stalagmite Rune | Strong Health Potion | Strong Mana Potion | Sudden Death Rune | Supreme Health Potion | Terra Rod | The Scorcher | The Chiller | Ultimate Health Potion | Ultimate Healing Rune | Ultimate Mana Potion | Ultimate Spirit Potion | Underworld Rod | Wand of Cosmic Energy | Wand of Decay | Wand of Draconia | Wand of Dragonbreath | Wand of Inferno | Wand of Starstorm | Wand of Voodoo | Wand of Vortex}} | falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == '''Chuckles''': !
'''Chuckles''': If they only knew.
'''Chuckles''': My old bones feel a storm approaching. == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Chuckles''': Come in if you are not here to burn me. I am just doing my job. ''Jogador'': '''job'''
'''Chuckles''': Let’s get over with it. Just ask for my offers! ''Jogador'': '''offer''' / '''stuff''' / '''ware''' / '''buy''' / '''sell''' / '''equipment''' / '''goods'''
'''Chuckles''': I’m selling spirit, health and mana potions, runes, wands, rods and spellbooks. If you’d like to see my offers, ask me for a trade. ''Jogador'': '''potions'''
'''Chuckles''': My potions are powerful, but please excuse if they taste a bit odd. My seasoning abilities are somewhat limited. ''Jogador'': '''trade'''
'''Chuckles''': Of course, just browse through my wares. Or do you want to look only at potions, wands or runes? ''Jogador'': '''lich'''
'''Chuckles''': Ah, come on, our bad reputation results only from a few black sheep among us liches. Honestly! ! ''Jogador'': '''yalahar'''
'''Chuckles''': The city is impressive. In its current state it even has an aura of undeath. ''Jogador'': '''yalahari'''
'''Chuckles''': I wonder if they are as powerful as they pretend to be. Who knows, perhaps one day we’ll find out. ''Jogador'': '''vampire'''
'''Chuckles''': One of my best customers happens to be one. Just kidding. ''Jogador'': '''blood crystal'''
'''Chuckles''': Oooh, you’re playing with fire. ''Jogador'': '''cookie'''
'''Chuckles''': Excuse me? ''Jogador'': '''alchemist quarter'''
'''Chuckles''': Oh my, something must have gone really wrong. ''Jogador'': '''foreign quarter'''
'''Chuckles''': I wouldn’t worry about them. Sooner or later, they’ve all killed each other. ''Jogador'': '''arena quarter'''
'''Chuckles''': I wonder what they’re all worried about. There is still a lot of slaughter and roaming beasts and such. The only thing that has changed is the entry fee. ''Jogador'': '''sunken quarter'''
'''Chuckles''': It must have been affected by a significant case of bad luck. ''Jogador'': '''magician quarter'''
'''Chuckles''': Oh come on! They’re just kids. All they want to do is play. ''Jogador'': '''factory quarter'''
'''Chuckles''': I just hope these factories will not drive me out of business one day. ''Jogador'': '''trade quarter'''
'''Chuckles''': Looks like every other Tibian city. ''Jogador'': '''rods'''
'''Chuckles''': Rods can be wielded by druids only and have a certain level requirement. There are eight different rods, would you like to hear about them? ''Jogador'': '''wand'''
'''Chuckles''': Wands can be wielded by sorcerers only and have a certain level requirement. There are eight different wands, would you like to hear about them? ''Jogador'': '''rune'''
'''Chuckles''': I’m selling spirit, health and mana potions, runes, wands, rods and spellbooks. If you’d like to see my offers, ask me for a trade. ''Jogador'': '''magic'''
'''Chuckles''': Magic is nothing but a tool that comes in different shapes. ''Jogador'': '''deposit''' / '''vial'''
'''Chuckles''': Well, you could ask me for a trade to deposit your flasks, but you can also do it old style. I will pay you 5 gold for every empty vial and potion flask. Ok? :''Jogador'': '''no'''
:'''Chuckles''': Hmm, but please keep Tibia litter free. :''Jogador'': '''yes'''
:'''Chuckles''': Here you are ... ''quantidade'' gold. ''Jogador'': '''fluid'''
'''Chuckles''': Sorry, we removed the old life and mana fluids from our assortment. However, we offer health, spirit and mana potions in up to four sizes, just ask me for a trade. ''Jogador'': '''undead'''
'''Chuckles''': I prefer to refer to this state as biologically challenged. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Chuckles''': Feel free to return – alive or as an ingredient. }}

== Frases Espontâneas ==
'''Dorbin''': Hey, need some furniture for your house? Come to my shop!

== Palavras-Chave ==
''Jogador'': '''hi'''</br>
'''Dorbin''': Hello, ''Jogador''! Welcome to my furniture store. I hope you are interested in a trade!

''Jogador'': '''name'''</br>
'''Dorbin''': I’m Dorbin.

''Jogador'': '''job'''</br>
'''Dorbin''': I sell furniture. We own this store in the third generation.

''Jogador'': '''yalahar'''</br>
'''Dorbin''': The city looks like a mess but new furniture here and there would work wonders, believe me.

''Jogador'': '''trade'''</br>
'''Dorbin''': Have a look. Most furniture comes in handy kits. Just use them in your house to assemble the furniture. Do you want to see only a certain type of furniture?

''Jogador'': '''type'''</br>
'''Dorbin''': I have beds, chairs, containers, decoration, flowers, instruments, pillows, pottery, statues, tapestries and tables. Which of those would you like to see?

''Jogador'': '''vampire'''</br>
'''Dorbin''': Well, sigh. It’s not funny to live in a city that is under frequent attack by vampires.

''Jogador'': '''yalahari'''</br>
'''Dorbin''': They are too elitist to buy my wares. I doubt they find any better quality, though.

''Jogador'': '''offer''' / '''goods''' / '''ware''' / '''stuff''' / '''equipment''' / '''buy''' / '''sell''' / '''furniture'''</br>
'''Dorbin''': Well, as you can see, we sell furniture. Ask me for a trade if you’re interested.

''Jogador'': '''orc'''</br>
'''Dorbin''': Ah you noticed my little helper? Well, if you train them at a young age, they are quite helpful. Still, I have to keep an eye on him. Until now his use outweighed the stuff he has smashed.

''Jogador'': '''alchemist quarter'''</br>
'''Dorbin''': It was probably just luck that those mad alchemists did not blow up the whole city.

''Jogador'': '''arena quarter'''</br>
'''Dorbin''': As if it had not been bad enough that this quarter was run over by madmen, these madmen were armed to the teeth.

''Jogador'': '''foreign quarter'''</br>
'''Dorbin''': One day, these monsters will unite and attack us.

''Jogador'': '''sunken quarter'''</br>
'''Dorbin''': For a while flotsam was quite popular as decor, but by now there are only a few pieces left.

''Jogador'': '''magician quarter'''</br>
'''Dorbin''': I don’t want to deal with these strange guys wearing robes.

''Jogador'': '''factory quarter'''</br>
'''Dorbin''': I doubt that any factory could replace the carpentry skill me and my assistants have acquired.

''Jogador'': '''blood crystal'''</br>
'''Dorbin''': I agree, that would be a nice decoration object. Unfortunately I don’t sell them.

''Jogador'': '''cookies'''</br>
'''Dorbin''': You can toss some cookies to my little helper over there. But don’t stick your finger in.

''Jogador'': '''news'''</br>
'''Dorbin''': I just reduced all prices drastically.

''Jogador'': '''palimuth'''</br>
'''Dorbin''': He seems to be quite nice and reasonable.

''Jogador'': '''time'''</br>
'''Dorbin''': It is ''horas''.

''Jogador'': '''bye'''</br>
'''Dorbin''': Good bye, ''Jogador''.
}}

pages.title: Ethan
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}}
| name        = Ethan 
| job         = Paladin Guild Leader 
| city        = Yalahar
| subarea     = Yalahar Centre
| location    = [[Yalahar Magician Quarter]] ({{mapa|32881,31078,7:5|aqui}}).
| implemented = 8.4 
| notes       = A partir do update '''15.22''', lançado em '''27 de janeiro de 2026''', não é mais possível comprar magias com este NPC. A CipSoft removeu a interação com a palavra '''"spell"''' e a funcionalidade de compra de magias, já que elas passaram a ser aprendidas automaticamente ao atingir o nível necessário.
| buysell     = não
| buys        = Nada. 
| sells       = nada.
| falas       = __NOTOC__
== Frases Espontâneas ==
Não possui.

== Palavras-Chave ==
''Jogador'': '''hi'''</br>
'''Ethan''': Welcome to the paladin guild, ''Jogador''! How can I help you?

''Jogador'': '''job''' / '''guild'''</br>
'''Ethan''': I train young paladins the art of our vocation, and an art it is without doubt. I was already teaching paladins before you were even born.

''Jogador'': '''name'''</br>
'''Ethan''': I'm Ethan.

''Jogador'': '''art'''</br>
'''Ethan''': Of course it is also the knowledge of spells.

''Jogador'': '''spells'''</br>
'''Ethan''': Sorry, I don't teach spells for your vocation.

''Jogador'': '''vocation'''</br>
'''Ethan''': Your vocation is your profession. There are four vocations in Tibia: paladins, knights, sorcerers, and druids.

''Jogador'': '''druid'''</br>
'''Ethan''': Their tranquil ways have preserved much of their ancient philosophy. I appreciate that.

''Jogador'': '''sorcerer'''</br>
'''Ethan''': Sorcerers have always been power-hungry maniacs, and that hasn't changed much over the years.

''Jogador'': '''knight'''</br>
'''Ethan''': The decline in knighthood seems even worse than the decline in our vocation.

''Jogador'': '''paladin'''</br>
'''Ethan''': What you call a paladin these days is a pale shadow of the paladins of old times. I expect my pupils to become role models and heroes, not selfish cowards.

''Jogador'': '''news'''</br>
'''Ethan''': For an old man like me everything sounds like old news.

''Jogador'': '''yalahar'''</br>
'''Ethan''': This city has seen better days.

''Jogador'': '''blood crystal'''</br>
'''Ethan''': Tamara mentioned it sometime ago.

''Jogador'': '''yalahari'''</br>
'''Ethan''': I hardly see any of them at all. I doubt that they care much about the things going on here. Else the city wouldn't be the mess it is.

''Jogador'': '''member'''</br>
'''Ethan''': Every paladin profits from his vocation. It has many advantages to be a paladin.

''Jogador'': '''excalibug'''</br>
'''Ethan''': It might be a myth, but as long as it inspires people to great deeds, it should be retold.

''Jogador'': '''time'''</br>
'''Ethan''': If you are as old as I am, you don't care about time anymore.

''Jogador'': '''magic'''</br>
'''Ethan''': Magic is a weapon like any other. If it is wielded by a fool, it can be disastrous.

''Jogador'': '''cookie'''</br>
'''Ethan''': I've just had dinner, but thanks.

''Jogador'': '''weapons'''</br>
'''Ethan''': A paladin has to be true like his aim. A good bow and a sure hand is not enough to bring down an enemy. It also takes a pure heart and an iron will.

''Jogador'': '''vampire'''</br>
'''Ethan''': The stories of vampires are always filled with romance and drama. I hope I live long enough to see then end of Yalahar's vampire story.

''Jogador'': '''advantage'''</br>
'''Ethan''': We will help you to improve your skills. Besides, I offer spells for paladins.

''Jogador'': '''old'''</br>
'''Ethan''': I'm 101 years old, but I don't consider myself as too old.

''Jogador'': '''king''' / '''tibianus'''</br>
'''Ethan''': I don't even remember who was king at the time I left Thais.

''Jogador'': '''missile'''</br>
'''Ethan''': Paladins are the best missile fighters in Tibia!

''Jogador'': '''palimuth'''</br>
'''Ethan''': He seems like a fine man to me. A man that cares about his city and his people. This is something quite rare these days.

''Jogador'': '''profit'''</br>
'''Ethan''': We will help you to improve your skills. Besides, I offer spells for paladins.

''Jogador'': '''skills'''</br>
'''Ethan''': Paladins are great warriors and magicians. Moreover, we are excellent missile fighters. Many people in Tibia want to join us.

''Jogador'': '''spellbook'''</br>
'''Ethan''': In a spellbook, your spells are listed. You will find the pronunciation of each spell in there. If you want to buy one, visit Xodet in the magic shop.

''Jogador'': '''warrior'''</br>
'''Ethan''': Of course, we aren't as strong as knights, but no druid or sorcerer will ever defeat a paladin with a sword.

''Jogador'': '''bye'''</br>
'''Ethan''': Bye, ''Jogador''.
}}

== Frases Espontâneas ==
'''Gree Dee''': Come and buy at a cheap rate!</br>
'''Gree Dee''': Prepare well for your next adventure! Buy my wares!</br>
'''Gree Dee''': Buy my wares!</br>
'''Gree Dee''': FEEL FREE TO BUY MY ITEMS!

== Palavras-Chave ==
''Jogador'': '''hi'''</br>
'''Gree Dee''': Be greeted esteemed customer with a full purse!

''Jogador'': '''job''' / '''customer'''</br>
'''Gree Dee''': I sell general equipment. Just ask me for a trade.

''Jogador'': '''trade'''</br>
'''Gree Dee''': You will not believe how cheap my items are.

''Jogador'': '''al dee'''</br>
'''Gree Dee''': My foolish brother thinks he'll get rich by selling equipment to some inexperienced paupers, but I know better!

''Jogador'': '''buy''' / '''offer'''</br>
'''Gree Dee''': Just ask me for a trade.

''Jogador'': '''stuff''' / '''wares'''</br>
'''Gree Dee''': It's almost as if I were handing them out for free. Just ask me for a trade.

''Jogador'': '''vampire'''</br>
'''Gree Dee''': Uhm, unfortunately I just ran out of garlic necklaces. But I heard they help.

''Jogador'': '''cookie'''</br>
'''Gree Dee''': I'm not interested in trading my wares for cookies.

''Jogador'': '''blood crystal'''</br>
'''Gree Dee''': If I had one, I could charge a fortune for it... <gets a dreamy look>

''Jogador'': '''shop'''</br>
'''Gree Dee''': My shop will be famous soon enough. With all the dangers that are around this city, adventurers have to resupply constantly!

''Jogador'': '''yalahar'''</br>
'''Gree Dee''': The city is a virtual gold mine. People from all over the world come here to explore and to get rich ...</br>
'''Gree Dee''': So they have much money to spend on supplies!

''Jogador'': '''yalahari'''</br>
'''Gree Dee''': They aren't worse than other nobles or officials. To be precise, they are so uninterested in our affairs that I prefer them to other city officials.

''Jogador'': '''trade quarter'''</br>
'''Gree Dee''': Mr. West is a honest man, that's for sure. You'll never hear me saying something bad about Mr. West.

''Jogador'': '''magician quarter'''</br>
'''Gree Dee''': The surviving magicians there seem to rely on resources they get by themselves. What a shame!

''Jogador'': '''alchemist quarter'''</br>
'''Gree Dee''': If they ever rebuild that city, I really hope to participate in this venture in some way.

''Jogador'': '''sunken quarter'''</br>
'''Gree Dee''': If you find some treasures down there, I might be interested in doing business with you.

''Jogador'': '''foreign quarter'''</br>
'''Gree Dee''': I tried to convince them of the quality of human wares, but without success.

''Jogador'': '''factory quarter'''</br>
'''Gree Dee''': I think the Yalahari should leave the factories inactive. They'd only ruin honest people's profit.

''Jogador'': '''arena quarter'''</br>
'''Gree Dee''': I wonder where these gladiators get their supplies from? I wouldn't mind to sell them some decent equipment.

''Jogador'': '''bye'''</br>
'''Gree Dee''': You really should have bought some extra stuff, just in case.}}

{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = A Restless Soul | job = Roleplay | npcclass = Mortos-Vivos | npcsprite = Ghost | city = Hrodmir | subarea = Formorgar Mines | location = [[Formorgar Mines]] ({{mapa|32258,31100,10:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.0 | notes = A alma de Tylaf, um aprendiz de [[Hjaern]], torturado pelos cultistas.

'''A Restless Soul''': Ahhhh! At last someone that can listen to my story! ''Jogador'': '''Story'''
'''A Restless Soul''': I was captured and tortured to death by the cultists here. They worship a being that they call Ghazbaran …

pages.title: Captain Breezelda
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Captain Breezelda | job = Capitão de Navios | city = Hrodmir | subarea = Svargrond | location = [[Svargrond]] ({{Mapa|32341,31107,6:1|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.0 | buysell = não | buys = | sells = | notes = Ela é a capitã do navio de [[Svargrond]]. Ela vai levá-lo para os seguintes locais:
* [[Carlin]] 110 [[gp]] * [[Venore]] 150 [[gp]] * [[Thais]] 180 [[gp]] Tendo a posição de ''Grand Postman'' na [[The Postman Missions Quest|The Postman Quest]] lhe dará um desconto de 10 [[gp]] em cada viagem. | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
[[Captain Breezelda]]: Hello ''Jogador''. Where do you want to sail?
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
[[Captain Breezelda]]: I'm the captain of this ship.
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''
[[Captain Breezelda]]: My name is Breezelda.
''Jogador:'' '''King'''
[[Captain Breezelda]]: I don't care much about politics.
''Jogador:'' '''Druids'''
[[Captain Breezelda]]: If you are looking for a druid, try your luck in Carlin.
''Jogador:'' '''Gods'''
[[Captain Breezelda]]: The gods help those who take care of their own fate.
''Jogador:'' '''Ferumbras'''
[[Captain Breezelda]]: I heard he reappeared somewhere in the South.
''Jogador:'' '''Excalibug'''
Better ask in a tavern about such tales.
''Jogador:'' '''Yeti'''
[[Captain Breezelda]]: The locals claim that it exists.
''Jogador:'' '''Chakoya'''
[[Captain Breezelda]]: I've never seen one.
''Jogador:'' '''Cult'''
[[Captain Breezelda]]: I don't spy on my passengers.
''Jogador:'' '''Jarl'''
Look for Sven the Younger.
''Jogador:'' '''Barbarian'''
[[Captain Breezelda]]: At least they usually don't talk too much.
''Jogador:'' '''Raiders'''
[[Captain Breezelda]]: They are no sailors so the ship is safe.
''Jogador:'' '''Chyll'''
[[Captain Breezelda]]: I believe that's how the locals call the north wind.
''Jogador:'' '''Rumours'''
[[Captain Breezelda]]: Last week a ship sunk between Svargrond and Carlin. Rumour has it that a ship's kobold was the reason for it.
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
[[Captain Breezelda]]: Bye. }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

| notes       = Eirik é um Barbarian. Ele protege a cidade de perigos. Fale com ele sobre a cidade e alguma loja que ele fala para onde você deve ir.
| falas       = 
''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''</br>
[[Eirik]]: LONG LIVE JARL SVEN, THE YOUNGER!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''</br>
[[Eirik]]: I AM A BARBARIAN! Names are of no concern during work!! If somebody is calling for help, I will come.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''</br>
[[Eirik]]: It's my duty to protect Svargrond and its citizens.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Mission'''</br>
[[Eirik]]: The shamans still have something to do for you. You should go to Nibelor and talk to them if you haven't been there for a while.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Nibelor'''</br>
[[Eirik]]: It's a sacred place for us! Our shamans live there. Ask Iskan if you want to go there.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Iskan'''</br>
[[Eirik]]: He is the leader of the dog sled. Last time I saw him he was with his dogs on the shelf ice north of the harbour.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Shelf'''</br>
[[Eirik]]: West of Svargrond is the Fimbul Ice Shelf, Nibelor and Grimlund are embedded in shelf ice, and in the north of Hrodmir are several small shelf ice fields.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Fimbul'''</br>
[[Eirik]]: Fimbul Shelf is the name of the big shelf ice west of Svargrond. A good spot to go ice fishing.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Grimlund'''</br>
[[Eirik]]: Stay away from there! It's the home of the chakoyas.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hrodmir'''</br>
[[Eirik]]: This big, icy rock you're standing at right now. The raiders live in the middle and south of the big Formorgar Glacier.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Sled'''</br>
[[Eirik]]: You can ask Iskan to bring you with his dog sled to Nibelor.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Magic'''</br>
[[Eirik]]: I heard Nelly talking about runes and fluids. Ask her.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Spells'''</br>
[[Eirik]]: That is a little too general. For what kind of profession do you need spells?</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Druids'''</br>
[[Eirik]]: You have to look for Hjaern.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Sorcerers'''</br>
[[Eirik]]: You have to look for Romir.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Knights'''</br>
[[Eirik]]: You have to look for Thorwulf.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Paladins'''</br>
[[Eirik]]: You have to look for Hawkyr.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''City'''</br>
[[Eirik]]: Svargrond is the only city here. Do you want to know where to find a shop,a trainer for a profession or a guildhall?</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Shop'''</br>
[[Eirik]]: Near the harbour you find the equipment shop, the branch of the explorer's society as well as the post office and the bank. ...</br>
[[Eirik]]: Right-hand of the depot, which is in the centre of Svargrond, you find the furniture store ...</br>
[[Eirik]]: All weapon and armor traders linger at the arena in the North and the tavern is to the west.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Ferumbras'''</br>
[[Eirik]]: Wait, wait! Don't say a word, it's, it's ...</br>
[[Eirik]]: that very small guy with the hairy feet? No?</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Excalibug'''</br>
[[Eirik]]: I would love to have that legendary weapon. If you find it, bring it to me!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''News'''</br>
[[Eirik]]: I am busy. Please ask the citizens for news.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Foreigners'''</br>
[[Eirik]]: Let me think .......... Yes there have been a bunch of strange looking guys passing Svargrond and heading for the old mines. It somehow reminded me of a cult.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''</br>
[[Eirik]]: MAY YOUR WEAPON ALWAYS BE SHARP!
}}<noinclude>[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]</noinclude>
