''Jogador:'' '''News'''</br>
[[Fynn]]: I am busy. Please ask the citizens for news.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Foreigners'''</br>
[[Fynn]]: Let me think .......... Yes there have been a bunch of strange looking guys passing Svargrond and heading for the old mines. It somehow reminded me of a cult.</br>

}}<noinclude>[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]</noinclude>

pages.title: Halvar
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}}
| name        = Halvar
| job         = Líder
| city        = Hrodmir
| subarea     = Svargrond
| location    = [[Svargrond]] ({{Mapa|32230,31097,7:1|aqui}}). 
| implemented = 8.0
| buysell     = não
| buys        = 
| sells       =
| notes       = Ele é o cobrador da arena de [[Svargrond]]. Se você quiser participar da arena, você deve falar com ele. Ele cobra 1,000 [[gp]] pela dificuldade greenhorn, 5,000 [[gp]] pela dificuldade scrapper e 10,000 [[gp]] pela dificuldade warlord. Ele somente permite a entrada na arena se você completar as três primeiras missões da [[The Ice Islands Quest]].
| falas       = 
== Palavras-Chave Gerais ==
''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''</br>
[[Halvar]]: Hello competitor! Do you want to '''fight''' in the arena or shall I explain the '''rules''' first?</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''</br>
[[Halvar]]: My job is to explain about the rules and to get the fee from the competitors.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Mission'''</br>
[[Halvar]]: Well I would rather call it an 'Ultimate Challenge' than a mission.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Name ou King ou Queen ou Gods ou Ferumbras ou Excalibug ou News ou Druids ou Shamans ou Carlin ou Edron ou Port Hope ou Svargrond ou Thais ou Venore ou Dwarf ou Elf ou Dragon ou Yeti ou Chakoya ou Cult ou Bait ou Jarl ou Barbarian ou Raiders ou Mines ou Chyll ou Nibelor ou Banor ou Years Of Serpents ou How Are You?'''</br>
[[Halvar]]: I have no time to talk and you should FIGHT instead of wasting your time here!</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''</br>
[[Halvar]]: Bye.

== Arena - General ==
''Jogador:'' '''Death ou Backpack ou Die'''</br>
[[Halvar]]: It would be better not to die! In every pit there is an emergency exit to the south. If you die in a pit... well... your corpse and backpack are gone, so enter at your own risk.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Potion'''</br>
[[Halvar]]: Like I said: Everything is allowed. Go in, kill monsters and try not to get killed by your own.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Weapon'''</br>
[[Halvar]]: You can use whatever you want but be aware that you might lose items and your backpack if you die.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Rules'''</br>
[[Halvar]]: What do you want to know? Something about the three different '''difficulties''', the '''general''' rules or the '''prices'''? Maybe you also want to know what happens when you '''die'''?</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Fee ou Prices'''</br>
[[Halvar]]: The fee depends on the difficulty you choose. If you are a Greenhorn you have to pay 1000 gold, as a Scrapper you have to pay 5000 gold and as a Warlord the participation fee is 10000 gold. ...</br>
[[Halvar]]: Each competitor who manages to win all ten pits will win the arena goblet and an unique item appropriate to your difficulty level.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''General'''</br>
[[Halvar]]: First you pay me the participation fee according to the difficulty you choose. This will grant you access to the door near me. ...</br>
[[Halvar]]: In the next room there you will find three teleporters. They all lead to the first pit, which you can enter as soon as there is no battle going on there anymore. ...</br>
[[Halvar]]: Beware though - when you enter the pit there is no turning back and the fight will start immediately! ...</br>
[[Halvar]]: Should you notice that you have overestimated your abilities, you can run for your life and flee through the teleporter to the south of the pit. ...</br>
[[Halvar]]: However, no real barbarian would run from a fight, right? When you successfully killed your opponent, a teleporter will appear to the west that brings you to the next pit. ...</br>
[[Halvar]]: If there is still a fight going on in the pit you would proceed to, there will be a red shrine stone placed instead. ...</br>
[[Halvar]]: As soon as the warrior in the next pit leaves the area, the red shrine stone will change into a teleporter. ...</br>
[[Halvar]]: However if that warrior died, you have to walk in front of the red shrine stone to create a teleporter. ...</br>
[[Halvar]]: There is a time limit of six to seven minutes to finish each pit. When the flame of life in the upper left corner is starting to wane, you have exactly one minute left to proceed to the next room. ...</br>
[[Halvar]]: If you take longer to kill the monster and leave the room you will be kicked out dishonourably.

== Arena - Dificuldades ==
''Jogador:'' '''Difficulties'''</br>
[[Halvar]]: There are three difficulties: Greenhorn, Scrapper and Warlord. On each challenge you will be confronted with ten monsters increasing in strength. ...</br>
[[Halvar]]: Besides the glory and honour you will earn we have unique awards for those who manage to pass the arena completely.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Warlord'''</br>
[[Halvar]]: Only the strongest among us will take this challenge. The fee is 10000 gold. If you pass that I promise you the respect of all citizens here. You will be a hero!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Scrapper'''</br>
[[Halvar]]: The most common difficulty for us. The fee is 5000 gold. So if you are experienced in fighting middle class monsters this is your challenge!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Greenhorn'''</br>
[[Halvar]]: That is the easiest way in our arena. The fee is 1000 gold. We were setting this up for of our children to challenge some easy monsters and train them for the future.

== Luta ==
''Jogador:'' '''Arena ou Fight ou Challenge ou Pit'''</br>
[[Halvar]]: So you agree to the rules and want to participate in the challenge? Which difficulty do you choose, Greenhorn, Scrapper or Warlord?</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Qualquer Palavra'''</br>
[[Halvar]]: Then not. Get away and don't waste my time!
|}}<noinclude>[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]</noinclude>

pages.title: Iskan
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Iskan | job = Musher | city = Hrodmir | subarea = Svargrond | location = [[Svargrond]] ({{Mapa|32301,31085,7:1|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.0 | buysell = não | buys = | sells = | notes = Você só pode falar com ele se você completar as três primeiras missões de uma quest. Iskan pode transportar você para [[Nibelor]] se você atender o seu pedido. Lembre-se de não matar [[Husky|Huskies]] ou você sera punido.

* Faz parte da [[The Ice Islands Quest]].

| falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
[[Iskan]]: HAIL to the Warlord of the arena! ''Jogador'', Hero of Svargrond! What can I do for you?
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''
[[Iskan]]: I am Iskan.
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
[[Iskan]]: I run the dog sled service from this city to Nibelor.
''Jogador:'' '''Nibelor'''
[[Iskan]]: I can bring you to Nibelor with the sled if you want to. Just ask for a passage.
''Jogador:'' '''Passage'''
[[Iskan]]: So, do you want a passage to Nibelor my friend?
''Jogador:'' '''Gods'''
[[Iskan]]: In my whole long life, I've not seen any sign of those gods the people of the south are constantly talking about.
''Jogador:'' '''King''' ou '''Queen'''
[[Iskan]]: We don't need any kings or queens. Am I right, boys? Yeah, I am.
''Jogador:'' '''Chakoya'''
[[Iskan]]: Nasty little beasts. Me and the boys had quite some bloody encounters with them on the ice.
''Jogador:'' '''Yeti'''
[[Iskan]]: The yeti is real and dangerous.
''Jogador:'' '''Ferumbras'''
[[Iskan]]: Easy, boys! Don't mention that name again. Makes the boys nuts, ye know?
''Jogador:'' '''Svargrond'''
[[Iskan]]: This city seems to be growing every day. First, there have been only a few huts and now ... look around, houses everywhere.
''Jogador:'' '''Excalibug'''
[[Iskan]]: Yeah, where could it be. That's the question.
''Jogador:'' '''Chyll'''
[[Iskan]]: The icy father. We know him all too well, am I right boys? He has claimed so many old friends in all those years. So many.
''Jogador:'' '''Rumours'''
[[Iskan]]: I heard something about a ship crashing in the shelf ice between Nibelor and Grimlund. If I were you, I wouldn't go to chakoya terrain. It's pretty dangerous.
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
[[Iskan]]: Farewell, Warlord of the arena, ''Jogador'', Hero of Svargrond! }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.title: Sirik
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}}
| name        = Sirik
| job         = Guarda
| city        = Hrodmir
| subarea     = Svargrond
| location    = [[Svargrond]] ({{Mapa|32322,31117,7:1|aqui}}).
| implemented = 8.0
| buysell     = não
| notes       = Sirik é um bárbaro. Ele protege a cidade de perigos. Fale com ele sobre a cidade e alguma loja que ele fala para onde você deve ir.
| falas       = 
''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''</br>
[[Sirik]]: LONG LIVE JARL SVEN, THE YOUNGER!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''</br>
[[Sirik]]: I AM A BARBARIAN! Names are of no concern during work!! If somebody is calling for help, I will come.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''</br>
[[Sirik]]: It's my duty to protect Svargrond and its citizens.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Mission'''</br>
[[Sirik]]: The shamans still have something to do for you. You should go to Nibelor and talk to them if you haven't been there for a while.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Nibelor'''</br>
[[Sirik]]: It's a sacred place for us! Our shamans live there. Ask Iskan if you want to go there.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Iskan'''</br>
[[Sirik]]: He is the leader of the dog sled. Last time I saw him he was with his dogs on the shelf ice north of the harbour.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Shelf'''</br>
[[Sirik]]: West of Svargrond is the Fimbul Ice Shelf, Nibelor and Grimlund are embedded in shelf ice, and in the north of Hrodmir are several small shelf ice fields.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Fimbul'''</br>
[[Sirik]]: Fimbul Shelf is the name of the big shelf ice west of Svargrond. A good spot to go ice fishing.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Grimlund'''</br>
[[Sirik]]: Stay away from there! It's the home of the chakoyas.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hrodmir'''</br>
[[Sirik]]: This big, icy rock you're standing at right now. The raiders live in the middle and south of the big Formorgar glacier.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Sled'''</br>
[[Sirik]]: You can ask Iskan to bring you with his Dog Sled to Nibelor.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Magic''' Ou '''fruids'''</br>
[[Sirik]]: I heard Nelly talking about runes and fluids. Ask her.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Nelly'''</br>
[[Sirik]]: She is the post office clerk. Follow the moaning and you will find her.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Spells'''</br>
[[Sirik]]: That is a little too general. For what kind of profession do you need spells?</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Paladin'''</br>
[[Sirik]]: You have to look for Hawkyr.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hawkyr'''</br>
[[Sirik]]: He is the paladin trainer. You find him near the arena.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Knight'''</br>
[[Sirik]]: You have to look for Thorwulf.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Thorwulf'''</br>
[[Sirik]]: He is the trainer for knights. You find him near the arena.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Sorcerers'''</br>
[[Sirik]]: You have to look for Romir.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Romir'''</br>
[[Sirik]]: He is an old hermit who lives in a hut on the elevated plain north of Svargrond . He is some kind of male witch, you know what I mean? ...</br>
[[Sirik]]: He knows magic and all that. Maybe he teaches his knowledge to others.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Nor'''</br>
[[Sirik]]: Mhmmm, Nor? Nobody with that name lives here in Svargrond. Maybe he is one of the southerners that came here.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Druids'''</br>
[[Sirik]]: You have to look for Hjaern.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hjaern'''</br>
[[Sirik]]: He is one of our shamans and trainer for druids. He lives on Nibelor.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Trainer'''</br>
[[Sirik]]: The guild masters for paladins and knights are at the arena, the shamans on Nibelor surely can teach druids new things ...</br>
[[Sirik]]: and Romir the old hermit who lives in a cave north of Svargrond may have some knowledge concerning magic.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''City'''</br>
[[Sirik]]: Svargrond is the only city here. Do you want to know where to find a shop, a trainer for a profession or a guildhall?</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Guildhall'''</br>
[[Sirik]]: In the city you will find three guildhalls. Frost Manor is on top of the cliff ...</br>
[[Sirik]]: Crystal Glance is north of the depot at the street which leads to the arena and Mammoth Belly is to the south, near the furrier quarter.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Arena'''</br>
[[Sirik]]: If you think you are strong enough, then try to fight there. You have to challenge waves of monsters that get stronger and stronger. ...</br>
[[Sirik]]: The entrance to the arena is a stairway north of the town, left of the town gate.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Ferumbras'''</br>
[[Sirik]]: Wait, wait! Don't say a word, it's, it's ...</br>
[[Sirik]]: that very small guy with the hairy feet? No?</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Excalibug'''</br>
[[Sirik]]: I would love to have that legendary weapon. If you find it, bring it to me!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''News'''</br>
[[Sirik]]: I am busy. Please ask the citizens for news.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Foreigner'''</br>
[[Sirik]]: Let me think .......... Yes there have been a bunch of strange looking guys passing Svargrond and heading for the old mines. It somehow reminded me of a cult.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''</br>
[[Sirik]]: MAY YOUR WEAPON ALWAYS BE SHARP!
|}}<noinclude>[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]</noinclude>

pages.title: Sven
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Sven | job = Líder | city = Hrodmir | subarea = Svargrond | location = [[Svargrond]] ({{Mapa|32204,31154,7:1|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.0 | buysell = não | notes = Sven é o líder do povo de [[Svargrond]]. Ele é o atual [[Líderes_do_Tibia#Jarls|Jarl]], o que significa que os clans de bárbaros de Svargrond o elegeram. Ele não está muito interessado em acolher estranhos na cidade, por este motivo ele pode lhe pedir para fazer algumas tarefas antes de você ser aceito como um verdadeiro bárbaro. | falas = {{TOC left}} {{clear}} === Palavras-chave Gerais === ''Jogador'': '''Hi'''
'''Sven''': Be greeted, ''Jogador''!
''Jogador'': '''Name'''
'''Sven''': I am Sven the Younger. My father, Sven the Elder has been missing in the ice waste since I was young. But unless one of our people is buried properly, we assume that he is still in the realm of the living ...
'''Sven''': Therefore, I am still known as 'the Younger', even though I have grown old.
''Jogador'': '''Job'''
'''Sven''': I am the jarl of my people. It's an honour and I am very proud of it.
''Jogador'': '''People'''
'''Sven''': Our people are simple and honest. We don't like the scheming ways of the city dwellers that live on the main continent.
''Jogador'': '''Jarl'''
'''Sven''': I am more than just the spokesman and highest judge among my people. I don't raise taxes, and when the clans feel that it is necessary, I will be replaced by another jarl.
''Jogador'': '''King''' / '''Queen'''
'''Sven''': We don't need any kings and queens here. Being the jarl of my people, I see that the laws are followed.
''Jogador'': '''Ferumbras'''
'''Sven''': Even here we heard about this powerful man. Travellers from the south only dare to whisper his name.
''Jogador'': '''Excalibug'''
'''Sven''': On the campfire, there are numerous tales about this weapon. It's told that it has been missing since ages ...
'''Sven''': In my opinion, the power and fame of a weapon shouldn't exceed the power and fame of it's wielder. And I have not heard of any hero whose fame would surpass that of excalibug.
''Jogador'': '''Barbarian'''
'''Sven''': A true barbarian is something special among our people. Everyone who wants to become a barbarian will have to pass the barbarian test.
''Jogador'': '''Join'''
'''Sven''': You might become an honorary barbarian if you manage to pass the barbarian test.
''Jogador'': '''Mission''' / '''Test''' / '''Mammoths'''
'''Sven''': You have braved all three tests and are now an honorary barbarian.
''Jogador'': '''News'''
'''Sven''': There is something evil going on. I have it in my bones.
''Jogador'': '''How are you?''' / '''Bones'''
'''Sven''': There is something in the air that worries me. A great evil is threatening all of us ...
'''Sven''': I might not have the gift of dreams that foresee the future like my mother did, but I seem to have inherited some of her gift nonetheless. Sometimes I just feel that something is about to happen ...
'''Sven''': And this time it's something sinister and evil that threatens us all.
''Jogador'': '''Santa Claus'''
'''Sven''': We heard that this mythical dwarf lives somewhere on the southern [[Ice Islands]].
=== História de Svargrond === ''Jogador'': '''City'''
'''Sven''': Our people lived as nomads some generations ago. The contact with [[Carlin]] taught us another way of living ...
'''Sven''': We did not like everything about it but we are not stupid. We have seen the many advantages ...
'''Sven''': If you cannot adapt to this land, you are dead and so we adapted to it and built this city. When the contact to Carlin got lost during the years of the serpents, we kept this city alive ...
Sven: And we survived, even though the raiders did their best to make us fail.
''Jogador'': '''Years of Serpents'''
'''Sven''': For more than two generations no ship had reached our shores because the giant sea serpents attacked and sank most ships that tried to travel here ...
'''Sven''': Not long ago the sea serpents disappeared as suddenly as they had come. Now ships visit us again on a regular base.
''Jogador'': '''Raiders'''
'''Sven''': In the past, all barbarian tribes roamed the lands of Chyll as nomads. When the Carliners came here and the trade flourished, we used the resources to build this permanent settlement ...
'''Sven''': Some of our people claimed that it was wrong to settle down and to abandon the ancient ways. A female shaman rose in the ranks of those who opposed the erection of a settlement ...
'''Sven''': She gathered all those who were not content, who did not want any foreign influence and who refused to learn ...
'''Sven''': They tried to destroy everything our ancestors had built, but with the help of the Carliners they were stopped and driven away. Now they still roam the land and attack everyone they see ...
'''Sven''': They became the raiders, our worst enemy. Nowadays, there are three larger tribes that often build camps in the South of our land ...
'''Sven''': And after all those years, surviving several generations, this [[Yakchal|female shaman]] is still their leader.
''Jogador'': '''Mines'''
'''Sven''': A long time ago when the trade with Carlin was flourishing, people actually worked in the mines. ...
'''Sven''': During the years of the serpents, the mines had been abandoned. Later, the raiders took shelter there, although they blame us for living in a fortified city ...
'''Sven''': Now, the traders of Carlin are back but some other foreigners seem to have claimed the mines from the raiders ...
'''Sven''': It's neither our business nor would we have the manpower to help them to recapture the mines. Also, if they do not have the strength to get the mines back on their own, they don't deserve them anyway.
=== Chyll === ''Jogador'': '''Gods'''
'''Sven''': We know of father Chyll and his freezing breath. We care little for other gods. It is foolish to meddle with beings that are so powerful ...
'''Sven''': We leave it to the druids and shamans to handle such affairs.
''Jogador'': '''Chyll'''
'''Sven''': Father north wind is called Chyll by our people. He is an unforgiving hunter. He knows no mercy with the weak ...
'''Sven''': Chyll is a harsh god and the best you can do is to avoid his attention. Only the shamans and druids deal with him.
''Jogador'': '''Druids''' / '''Shamans'''
'''Sven''': Most shaman and druids of our people live on the sacred isle Nibelor. There, they divine the future, calm the wrath of father Chyll and prepare the dead for their last travel to the lands of Everspring.
''Jogador'': '''Nibelor'''
'''Sven''': Nibelor has always been a sacred place for our people. The druids and shamans live there.
''Jogador'': '''Everspring'''
'''Sven''': Everspring is the realm of the dead. It is a place of peace and harmony where those who boldly braved the challenges of life dwell for eternity and share stories at the campfires after a hunt ...
'''Sven''': Every true barbarian that is properly brought into afterlife will join the great hunt in Everspring where the animals are fat and have the thickest furs.
''Jogador'': '''Cults'''
'''Sven''': I don't care what people who come here believe in. If they provoke father Chyll, he will take care of them on his own. If their gods prove to be more powerful than Chyll, they might deserve to live.
=== Cidades === ''Jogador'': '''Carlin'''
'''Sven''': We are friends of the Carliners. Still we don't allow their politics to influence our way to handle things here.
''Jogador'': '''Edron'''
'''Sven''': We have heard only little about this far away place.
''Jogador'': '''Thais'''
'''Sven''': We understand that our friends from Carlin are wary with the realm ruled by Thais but this is not of our concern.
''Jogador'': '''Venore'''
'''Sven''': We did not allow them to stay here. This had nothing to do with our friendship with Carlin but for the way they handled things and their harmful approach to go hunting.
=== Raças === ''Jogador'': '''Chakoyas'''
'''Sven''': The chakoyas are neither beast nor man. Yet, they share the worst and more dangerous traits of both of them. Their small and furry appearance can be very misleading at first glance ...
'''Sven''': But as soon as you've seen a pack of chakoyas literally shredding a mammoth into pieces with their claws and teeth, all misconceptions will be gone.
''Jogador'': '''Yeti'''
'''Sven''': The yetis are mythical beasts. Only few that encountered those creatures lived to tell the tale. The chakoyas worship them as divine beings, although they have no real relations to them as far as we can tell.
''Jogador'': '''Dwarfs'''
'''Sven''': I met some of those little people in the past. Considering our experience with the chakoyas, we don't underestimate someone just for its look. And those dwarfs proved indeed to be powerful, courageous and enduring.
''Jogador'': '''Elves'''
'''Sven''': Some time ago, a few elves came here but they could not stand the cold and so they left pretty soon. Most likely it was Nibelor in which they have been interested.
''Jogador'': '''Bye'''
'''Sven''': May wind and weather be with you, ''Jogador''. }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.title: Iriana
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Iriana | job = Comerciante de Equipamentos | city = Yalahar | subarea = Yalahar Trade Quarter | location = [[Yalahar Trade Quarter]] ({{Mapa|32849,31300,7:1|aqui}}). | buysell = sim | buys = Nada. | sells = {{Trades/Sell | Backpack, 10 | Bag,5 | Fishing Rod,150 | Worm}} | implemented = 8.4 | notes =

* Faz parte da [[Top of the City Quest]].

| falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == '''Iriana''': Pilferer! Thief!!
'''Iriana''': Help! Stop that thief! == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Iriana''': Are you here to help me? That masked guy has stolen my complete daily earnings! Ask me for a quest if you are willing to help me. ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Iriana''': My name is Iriana and my family lives here in Yalahar since the early days. ''Jogador'': '''job'''
'''Iriana''': I'm selling fishing equipment. You know, this isn't only the trade quarter. Most people here earn their bread and butter on the sea with a fishing rod in their hands. ''Jogador'': '''trade'''
'''Iriana''': Take a look. ''Jogador'': '''yalahar'''
'''Iriana''': You can still see the brilliance of this city in its centre. It's a pity that the slow decay of the other quarters persists. ''Jogador'': '''centre'''
'''Iriana''': It's the domicile of the Yalahari who created this city after the God Wars. Today, the Yalahari try to let the city shine in its former brilliancy again. ''Jogador'': '''quarters'''
'''Iriana''': The city once had 8 quarters excluding the centre. Right now you are in the former trade quarter, east of it you find the factory quarter. Further to the north-east you find the quarter known as the sunken quarter ...
'''Iriana''': followed by the magician quarter. Then you have the most northern quarter, known as the cemetery quarter, and west of that you find the former alchemist quarter. The most western quarter is the former zoo and arena quarter ...
'''Iriana''': and last but not least there is the foreigner quarter. If you want to know more about one of the single quarters, just ask me about it. ''Jogador'': '''trade quarter'''
'''Iriana''': It's all controlled by the trade baron. Stay out of his business, or you'll regret it, I promise. ''Jogador'': '''factory'''
'''Iriana''': Not much is known about the things going on there, or what has been produced in these factories. From time to time, the Yalahari 'appoint' inhabitants to work for them there but none of them was ever seen again. ''Jogador'': '''sunken'''
'''Iriana''': It used to be a high society residential quarter, but as you probably realised, the city grew larger than the landmass on which it had been erected. So the quarter just broke off and sunk into the sea. That happened a very long time ago. ''Jogador'': '''magician'''
'''Iriana''': Nowadays, the magician quarter is the home of all magic using races. You find different races using various kinds of magic in this quarter. It can be quite dangerous there depending on which part of the quarter you enter. ''Jogador'': '''zoo'''
'''Iriana''': Back in the days, the Yalahari caught all kinds of animals just for their own pleasure. After their disappearance, the animals escaped. They are on the loose in this quarter ever since. ''Jogador'': '''arena'''
'''Iriana''': In the centre of the Zoo quarter, you'll find a huge arena. Once gladiators have been battling each other to amuse the Yalahari. The most skilful of them survived and are still there. ''Jogador'': '''cemetery'''
'''Iriana''': The whole quarter is sealed up. Undead creatures took over a long time time ago. It's a mess! ''Jogador'': '''alchemist'''
'''Iriana''': I doubt that a single alchemist survived the catastrophe. There was a huge explosion which caused a chain reaction. Nowadays, it's an infested and burnt down quarter in which it is more likely to meet a mutant than a human. ''Jogador'': '''foreigner'''
'''Iriana''': The quarter west of the waterway is nowadays inhabited by various races. It used to be a residential area, but almost got completely destroyed after the downfall of Yalahar. Only the harbour promenade still contains the original buildings. ...
'''Iriana''': The other parts of the quarter have been rebuilt by the newly arrived races. For this reason, you find all those different building styles there. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Iriana''': Bye bye ''Jogador''. }}

| city        = Yalahar

| falas       = __NOTOC__
== Frases Espontâneas ==
'''Soilance''': Come in and buy my delicious meat!

== Palavras-Chave ==
''Jogador'': '''hi'''</br>
'''Soilance''': Hi, ''Jogador''. I assume you are here for a good old trade.

''Jogador'': '''job'''</br>
'''Soilance''': I supply this part of the city with meat.

''Jogador'': '''trade'''</br>
'''Soilance''': Of course, take a look at the great food I sell.

''Jogador'': '''rotworm'''</br>
'''Soilance''': They are .. uhm just there to get rid of the garbage. Don't pay them any attention.

''Jogador'': '''meat'''</br>
'''Soilance''': I .. import that meat from several sources which I cannot reveal for the safety of my small profit.

''Jogador'': '''palimuth'''</br>
'''Soilance''': He should care more about the city instead of harassing innocent traders like me.

''Jogador'': '''food'''</br>
'''Soilance''': I offer ham or meat. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a trade.

''Jogador'': '''ware''' / '''buy''' / '''sell''' / '''offer''' / '''stuff''' / '''goods'''</br>
'''Soilance''': I offer ham or meat. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a trade.

''Jogador'': '''vampire'''</br>
'''Soilance''': They are rather scary. I wish those attacks would stop.

''Jogador'': '''blood crystal'''</br>
'''Soilance''': No, haven't heard about that.

''Jogador'': '''cookies'''</br>
'''Soilance''': No, I don't sell cookies. And I don't want to buy any either. This is a MEAT store!

''Jogador'': '''yalahar'''</br>
'''Soilance''': The city has some severe problems. Thanks to me the supply of meat is a smaller problem, though.

''Jogador'': '''yalahari'''</br>
'''Soilance''': I haven't even seen one in my life.

''Jogador'': '''factory quarter'''</br>
'''Soilance''': The people there are way too poor to buy anything, so they better stay away from my store.

''Jogador'': '''alchemist quarter'''</br>
'''Soilance''': They shouldn't allow anyone to go there at all. If they do, they risk the spreading of the plague in the rest of the city.

''Jogador'': '''trade quarter'''</br>
'''Soilance''': I have an agreement with Mr. West which provides that I supply his people with meat.

''Jogador'': '''arena quarter'''</br>
'''Soilance''': The creatures in the arena are lean and their meat tastes stale. Nothing like the meat I'm selling!

''Jogador'': '''sunken quarter'''</br>
'''Soilance''': They used to fish there a lot, but fish seems to become quite rare lately. Luckily, I provide the city with delicious meat!

''Jogador'': '''magician quarter'''</br>
'''Soilance''': I heard nothing good about this quarter.

''Jogador'': '''foreign quarter'''</br>
'''Soilance''': Those barbaric monsters have no taste at all.

''Jogador'': '''trade quarter'''</br>
'''Soilance''': I have an agreement with Mr. West which provides that I supply his people with meat.

''Jogador'': '''bye'''</br>
'''Soilance''': You'll come back when you are hungry enough.
}}

pages.title: Julius
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Julius | job = Caçador de Vampiro | city = Yalahar | subarea = Yalahar Trade Quarter | location = [[Yalahar Trade Quarter]] ({{mapa|32831,31276,7:5|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.4 | buysell = sim | buys = {{Trades/Buy |Blood Preservation |Vampire Teeth}} | sells = | notes = Julius é um habitante de Yalahar. Ele teme que Yalahar está sob ameaça e precisa de sua ajuda.

* Faz parte da [[Blood Brothers Quest]].

| falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == Não possui. == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Julius''': Be greeted, adventurer ''Jogador''. Please excuse me if I appear distracted! ''Jogador'': '''job''' / '''distracted'''
'''Julius''': I come from a family of vampire hunters, but to be honest, I'm more into the theoretic part and strategic planning. ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Julius''': My name is Julius. ''Jogador'': '''vampire'''
'''Julius''': Our nightly blood-sucking visitors put the inhabitants of Yalahar in constant danger. ''Jogador'': '''yalahar'''
'''Julius''': A better name would be Gomorrah, if you ask me. ''Jogador'': '''storkus'''
'''Julius''': Storkus? Oh yes, I know him. A long time ago we used to hunt together... sometimes. ''Jogador'': '''time'''
'''Julius''': It's about time you showed the vampires that they should never bother the citizens again. ''Jogador'': '''trade'''
'''Julius''': I'll reward you for every pair of vampire teeth you bring me. ''Jogador'': '''news'''
'''Julius''': Another vampire raid last night. But then again, that's nothing new. ''Jogador'': '''thank'''
'''Julius''': Well, I should be the one to thank you I guess. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Julius''': Good bye, ''Jogador''. Never trust anyone. }}

pages.title: Redward
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Redward | job = Carteiro | city = Yalahar | subarea = Yalahar Centre | location = [[Yalahar Centre]] ({{mapa|32823,31251,6:5|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.4 | notes =

* Após completar a [[The Postman Missions Quest]], os [[Parcel]]s custarão somente 10 [[gp]] e [[letter]]s somente 5 [[gp]].

 | buysell = sim | buys = Nada. | sells = {{Trades/Sell |Parcel |Letter |Label}} | falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == '''Redward''': Are you looking at me!? == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Redward''': Hi there. Welcome to my humble post office. ''Jogador'': '''job'''
'''Redward''': Believe it or not, I'm the local post officer. Don't give me that look. It's a long story how I ended up with this job. ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Redward''': You may call me Redward. ''Jogador'': '''vampire'''
'''Redward''': I guess I don't look really appetising to them. Being a big red monster and all that has its advantages I guess. ''Jogador'': '''post'''
'''Redward''': With our mail system you can send letters and parcels to other Tibians. I can either explain how letters and parcels work or sell them to you if you ask me for a trade. ''Jogador'': '''trade'''
'''Redward''': Here. Don't forget that you need to buy a label too if you want to send a parcel. Always write the name of the receiver in the first line and make sure you entered it correctly. ''Jogador'': '''imp'''
'''Redward''': Now, don't be nervous, I'm just your average next door imp. ''Jogador'': '''cookies'''
'''Redward''': Have you seen my belly?? I'm on a diet. But thanks, kid. ''Jogador'': '''evil'''
'''Redward''': Ah well, sometimes I just can't help it. Then I must do something very evil, things like throwing around parcels who are labelled as fragile, and other stuff like that, you know? ''Jogador'': '''master'''
'''Redward''': Oh well. My master was a dark wizard, not like Ferumbras, more the wannabe type ...
'''Redward''': He was rather ambitious than competent, and he tended to blame me for all of his failures. Well, I have to admit I made fun of his mistakes quite often, and I might have spilled some of his spell ingredients now and then .. accidentally of course ...
'''Redward''': Still, that's no reason to lock me into a bottle and throw me into the sea. ''Jogador'': '''story'''
'''Redward''': To make a long story short: I left my master after a dispute, and after a long and perilous journey, I arrived at this city ...
'''Redward''': I quit being evil and became a postman. ''Jogador'': '''buy''' / '''equipment''' / '''offer''' / '''stuff''' / '''ware''' / '''goods''' / '''sell'''
'''Redward''': I sell parcels and letters. Ask me for a trade if you're interested. I can also explain how the mail system works. ''Jogador'': '''yalahar'''
'''Redward''': The city is kind of a melting pot when it comes to civilisations and races. Such a mixture becomes quickly explosive, though. This will turn out very interesting. ''Jogador'': '''yalahari'''
'''Redward''': Quite an arrogant bunch if you ask me. But at least they allow almost everyone to settle here. ''Jogador'': '''arena quarter'''
'''Redward''': It's really a shame that it's no longer possible to watch humans slaughter each other for the amusement of the masses. ''Jogador'': '''sunken quarter'''
'''Redward''': Too wet for my taste. ''Jogador'': '''factory quarter'''
'''Redward''': Ahh, all that noise and the smoke and the smell and the whining of working humans - it must have been terrific. ''Jogador'': '''foreign quarter'''
'''Redward''': Now those guys know how to party. ''Jogador'': '''magician quarter'''
'''Redward''': Humans that tamper with magic - that must end up in something funny. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Redward''': Bye for now, ''Jogador''. }}

pages.title: Lucius
pages.wikitext:
{{event}}{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Lucius | job = Lightbearer | city = div | subarea = Kazordoon, Temple of Light, Yalahar Magician Quarter | location = [[Kazordoon]] ({{mapa|32441,31848,12:2|aqui}}), [[Temple of Light]] ({{mapa|31972,32046,6:2|aqui}}) e [[Yalahar Magician Quarter]] ({{mapa|32891,31086,7:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.5 | notes = Somente aparece durante o [[Eventos e Festividades#Eventos durante o ano|evento]] que ocorre em novembro.

* Faz parte do evento [[The Lightbearer]].

| buysell = sim | buys =
Se o seu servidor tiver sucesso no evento: {{Trades/Buy |Midnight Shard}} | sells = Nada. | falas = Antes do início do evento: [[Lucius]]: Bring some light to the world in these dark days!
[[Lucius]]: It's the time of the year where we all need some light.
[[Lucius]]: Meet me tomorrow and you shall learn more.

Quando o evento começar:
[[Lucius]]: Greetings, ''Jogador''.
''Jogador'': '''name'''
[[Lucius]]: My name is Lucius.
''Jogador'': '''job'''
[[Lucius]]: Well, I use to call myself a 'lightbearer'. I provide magical '''torches''' to light fires at places where hellish creatures are trying to enter our world, thus fending them off.
''Jogador'': '''light''' ou '''lightbearer'''
[[Lucius]]: Let's not talk here. I prefer to meet you in the Temple of Light. Will you accompany me there now?
''Jogador'': '''yes'''
[[Lucius]]: Come join me in my room.
(Você será transportado ao Temple of Light)

No Temple of Light:
[[Lucius]]: Greetings, ''Jogador''! We have no time to waste. Let's talk about an urgent mission.
''Jogador'': '''mission'''
[[Lucius]]: This is the time of the year where demons try hardest to break through to our world. I try my best to keep them away by spiritually empowering those magical fire basins here in the Temple of Light. ...
[[Lucius]]: However, I cannot be everywhere at the same time, and there are ten spots all over Tibia where the layer between our world and the hellish world is especially thin. ...
[[Lucius]]: You need to travel to these places within a day after I gave you a magical torch. I summoned a lightbearer's basin there, similar to those here in the temple. ...
[[Lucius]]: You have to use the torch on a basin to power its light. Then it will have regain enough energy to burn brightly for another two hours. ...
[[Lucius]]: If you look at a basin, you can see how much energy there is still left. As long as all fire basins are burning, no creatures will be able to enter Tibia. ...
[[Lucius]]: However, when only one fire basin turns dark and disappears, powerful demons will be unleashed onto this world. ...
[[Lucius]]: You have to keep the fire burning for five days, and on the last day the demons will be so weakened that you can dispose of them easily when they come. ...
[[Lucius]]: I can give you only one torch which lasts for a day and will then disappear. Also, you can only use your torch ONCE on each basin. ...
[[Lucius]]: Thus you need to work together with your fellow Tibians, so that someone can always keep the fire basins burning, on each of the five days. ...
[[Lucius]]: I can either give you the torch now - but remember it will only last for a day - or hold onto it for you until your time to be a lightbearer has come. Do you want that torch right now?
''Jogador'': '''no'''
[[Lucius]]: Good, then wait for a while. But don't wait too long.
''Jogador'': '''yes'''
[[Lucius]]: Here is your torch, ''Jogador''. Please try to keep all ten '''spots''' burning, and remember you can only use your torch ONCE on each spot. ...
[[Lucius]]: And be careful - evil might send its minions there from time to time to keep you from lighting the basin.
''Jogador'': '''spots'''
[[Lucius]]: There are ten of these fire basins all over Tibia. Ask me for any number between '''one''' and '''ten''' to learn more about the location where it can be found.
''Jogador'': '''lightbearer'''
[[Lucius]]: This is the time of the year where demons try hardest to break through to our world. I try my best to keep them away by spiritually empowering those magical fire basins here in the Temple of Light. ...
[[Lucius]]: However, I cannot be everywhere at the same time, and there are ten '''spots''' all over Tibia where the layer between our world and the hellish world is especially thin. ...
[[Lucius]]: You need to travel to these places after I gave you a magical torch. I summoned a lightbearer's basin there, similar to those here in the temple. ...
[[Lucius]]: You have to use the torch on a basin to power its light. Then it will have regain enough energy to burn brightly for another two hours. ...
[[Lucius]]: If you look at a basin, you can see how much energy there is still left. As long as all fire basins are burning, no creatures will be able to enter Tibia. ...
[[Lucius]]: However, when only one fire basin turns dark and disappears, powerful demons will be unleashed onto this world. ...
[[Lucius]]: You have to keep the fire burning for five days, and on the last day the demons will be so weakened that you can dispose of them easily when they come. ...
[[Lucius]]: I can give you only one torch, and you can only use it ONCE on each basin. ...
[[Lucius]]: Thus you need to work together with your fellow Tibians, so that someone can always keep the fire basins burning, on each of the five days, on each of the ten spots.
''Jogador'': '''torches'''
[[Lucius]]: Those magical torches burn for much longer than normal torches. They will also protect you while you carry them. If you are willing to take on this '''mission''', let me know.
''Jogador'': '''spots'''
[[Lucius]]: There are ten of these fire basins all over Tibia. Ask me for any number between '''one''' and '''ten''' to learn more about the location where it can be found.
''Jogador'': '''one'''
[[Lucius]]: The first place might be somewhat hard to find... it is on the Formorgar Glacier on Svargrond.
''Jogador'': '''two'''
[[Lucius]]: The second place is in the Plains of Havoc near the Knightwatch Tower.
''Jogador'': '''three'''
[[Lucius]]: The third place is under the taboo area of Port Hope.
''Jogador'': '''four'''
[[Lucius]]: The fourth place is in the prison under Kazordoon.
''Jogador'': '''five'''
[[Lucius]]: The fifth place is on Ramoa, one of the Forbidden Islands close to Liberty Bay.
''Jogador'': '''six'''
[[Lucius]]: The sixth place is in the northern ruins of Edron, near the entrance to the demon lair.
''Jogador'': '''seven'''
[[Lucius]]: The seventh place is deep under Drefia, at the top of the pentagram.
''Jogador'': '''eight'''
[[Lucius]]: The eighth place is in the middle of Hellgate. It can be found close to a necromantic ritual place.
''Jogador'': '''nine'''
[[Lucius]]: The ninth place is not very dangerous to reach. It is near Ankrahmun, in the tomb that's covered with tar pits.
''Jogador'': '''ten'''
[[Lucius]]: The tenth place is quite close to here. Go to the area of the Magician Quarter where the earth is broken up and hellish creatures are crawling to the surface. ...
[[Lucius]]: Go one level down through one of the holes and search for the fire basin in this area.
''Jogador'': '''trade'''
[[Lucius]]: If you would like to trade any shards you might have for gold coins, just do so.
''Jogador'': '''bye'''
[[Lucius]]: Farewell and safe journeys, ''Jogador''. }} Categoria:NPC em Revisão

pages.title: Tamara
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Tamara | job = Druid Guild Leader | city = Yalahar | subarea = Yalahar Magician Quarter | location = [[Yalahar Magician Quarter]] ({{mapa|32894,31059,7:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.4 | notes = Tamara vendia magias para druids.
A partir do update 15.22 do dia 27 de janeiro de 2026 não é mais possível comprar magias com esse NPC pois a CipSoft removeu a interação com a palavra "Spell", e a função de comprar magias, visto que agora as magias passaram a ser adicionadas automaticamente assim que o players chega ao nível necessário. | buysell = sim | buys = Nada. | sells = {{Ensina | Apprentice's Strike | Avalanche Rune | Chameleon Rune | Convince Creature Rune | Creature Illusion | Cure Bleeding | Cure Burning | Cure Electrification | Cure Poison | Cure Poison Rune | Destroy Field Rune | Energy Field Rune | Energy Strike | Energy Wall Rune | Envenom | Explosion Rune | Find Person | Fire Bomb Rune | Fire Field Rune | Fire Wall Rune | Food (Spell) | Great Light | Haste | Heal Friend | Heavy Magic Missile Rune | Ice Wave | Intense Healing | Intense Healing Rune | Invisible | Levitate | Light | Light Healing | Light Magic Missile Rune | Magic Rope | Magic Shield | Mass Healing | Poison Field Rune | Poison Wall | Stalagmite Rune | Strong Haste | Strong Ice Strike | Strong Ice Wave | Strong Terra Strike | Summon Creature | Summon Grovebeast | Terra Strike | Terra Wave | Ultimate Healing | Ultimate Healing Rune | Ultimate Light}} | falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == Não possui. == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Tamara''': Welcome to my little place, ''Jogador''. How may I help you? ''Jogador'': '''job'''
'''Tamara''': I'm a druid. I teach spells to other druids. ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Tamara''': I'm known as Tamara, though my friends also nickname me Tamera. ''Jogador'': '''spells'''
'''Tamara''': Sorry, I don't teach spells for your vocation. ''Jogador'': '''vocation'''
'''Tamara''': Your vocation is your profession. There are four vocations in Tibia: druids, paladins, knights, and sorcerers. ''Jogador'': '''druid'''
'''Tamara''': Druids are in close communion with nature. Some of them are also close to their inner beast. ''Jogador'': '''sorcerer'''
'''Tamara''': Sorcerers are very aggressive. They use their power to fight and to kill. ''Jogador'': '''knight'''
'''Tamara''': Their animalistic rage and their passion for battles are somewhat impressive. If they only understood the animal in them, they could gain much more power. ''Jogador'': '''paladin'''
'''Tamara''': They restrict themselves way too much. All this talk about holiness and divine will is pointless. Still, their devotion is admirable. ''Jogador'': '''time'''
'''Tamara''': Eh, I haven't seen daylight for a long time. So, don't ask me, what time it is. ''Jogador'': '''excalibug'''
'''Tamara''': Another weapon of destruction. I hope nobody will ever find it. ''Jogador'': '''ferumbras'''
'''Tamara''': I came here to get away from evil creatures like him, but here I've found other curses. ''Jogador'': '''cookies'''
'''Tamara''': Thank you honey, but I pass on that offer. ''Jogador'': '''palimuth'''
'''Tamara''': He is nothing than a puppy of its uncaring masters. ''Jogador'': '''vampire'''
'''Tamara''': Fortunately they never come here. ''Jogador'': '''blood crystal'''
'''Tamara''': Oh! That cursed stone! I know about it, but I can't tell you anything. Evil gems like that shouldn't be passed around, only a crazy fool would do that. ''Jogador'': '''magic''' / '''power'''
'''Tamara''': Everyone who becomes a druid has the opportunity to learn many magic spells. ''Jogador'': '''crunor'''
'''Tamara''': Crunor, the father of all trees, is a symbol of life. ''Jogador'': '''membership'''
'''Tamara''': Our members use their magic power to protect their life and the life of other creatures. ''Jogador'': '''news'''
'''Tamara''': News are of little value in a city that old. ''Jogador'': '''yalahar'''
'''Tamara''': The city is dying, I can feel it. Not only in a physical sense, but also in a spiritual one. ''Jogador'': '''yalahari'''
'''Tamara''': They have lost connection to their city, to their people, to the world. They are lost. ''Jogador'': '''alchemist quarter'''
'''Tamara''': The breath of life is no longer blowing over this quarter. The beast of the plaque is lurking in every shady corner, and no hunter can bring it down. ''Jogador'': '''foreign quarter'''
'''Tamara''': A scorpion will always be a scorpion. ''Jogador'': '''trade quarter'''
'''Tamara''': The pack is always looking for a leader. ''Jogador'': '''magician quarter'''
'''Tamara''': They thought they could tame magic, but magic devoured them. ''Jogador'': '''arena quarter'''
'''Tamara''': The gladiators are to some extent in touch with their inner beast. Still, sometimes they are the prey rather than the predator. ''Jogador'': '''sunken quarter'''
'''Tamara''': It is inevitable that mother nature will claim what was once hers. ''Jogador'': '''factory quarter'''
'''Tamara''': They tried to cage the forces of nature to have them work for them. Now the factories are silent and covered with dust. Those who thought to have mastered nature are gone, while nature is still here. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Tamara''': Farewell. }}

pages.title: Tamoril
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Tamoril | job = Sorcerer Guild Leader | job2 = Joalheiro | city = Yalahar | subarea = Yalahar Magician Quarter | location = [[Yalahar Magician Quarter]] ({{mapa|32911,31018,5:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.4 | notes = Tamoril trabalhava como vendedor de magia de sorcerers.
A partir do update 15.22 do dia 27 de janeiro de 2026 não é mais possível comprar magias com esse NPC pois a CipSoft removeu a interação com a palavra "Spell", e a função de comprar magias, visto que agora as magias passaram a ser adicionadas automaticamente assim que o players chega ao nível necessário. | buysell = sim | buys = {{Trades/Buy | Blue Gem | Golden Mug | Green Gem | Red Gem | Violet Gem | Yellow Gem}} | sells = {{Ensina | Animate Dead Rune | Apprentice's Strike | Creature Illusion | Cure Poison | Curse | Death Strike | Destroy Field | Disintegrate Rune | Electrify | Energy Beam | Energy Bomb | Energy Field Rune | Energy Strike | Energy Wall | Energy Wave | Explosion | Find Person | Fire Bomb | Fire Field Rune | Fire Wall | Fire Wave | Fireball | Flame Strike | Great Energy Beam | Great Fireball | Great Light | Haste | Heavy Magic Missile | Ice Strike | Ignite | Intense Healing | Invisible | Levitate | Light | Light Healing | Light Magic Missile | Lightning | Magic Rope | Magic Shield | Magic Wall | Poison Field Rune | Poison Wall | Soulfire | Stalagmite Rune | Strong Energy Strike | Strong Flame Strike | Strong Haste | Sudden Death | Summon Creature | Summon Thundergiant | Terra Strike | Thunderstorm | Ultimate Healing | Ultimate Light}} | falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == '''Tamoril''': FCHHHHH!
'''Tamoril''': GRRRRRRR!
'''Tamoril''': Come a little closer mortal. == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Tamoril''': Another pesky mortal who believes his gold outweighs his nutrition value. ''Jogador'': '''job'''
'''Tamoril''': I share some of my eternal knowledge of spells with you humans ... for a price of course. You should be grateful. ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Tamoril''': My real name is not pronounceable for a human. ''Jogador'': '''mortal''' / '''human'''
'''Tamoril''': You puny mortals are an annoyance. However, the little magic your simple minds are able to comprehend earns me enough money not to kill you. ''Jogador'': '''gold''' / '''money'''
'''Tamoril''': I share some of my eternal knowledge of spells with you humans ... for a price of course. You should be grateful. ''Jogador'': '''dragon'''
'''Tamoril''': Dragons are the most powerful creatures of the world. Every year, we gain more and more power. ...
'''Tamoril''': Hardly anyone of us dies of old age. Instead we find death by diseases brought to our race by you mortal pests, and countless of my younger brethren and sisters have been slaughtered by humans. ...
'''Tamoril''': Expect little from me mortal. And even for that little, you will have to pay dearly. ''Jogador'': '''magic'''
'''Tamoril''': What you call magic is only a pale shadow of real magic. The more you try, the more magic will retreat from you. ...
'''Tamoril''': To us dragons magic comes natural. It is a part of us, and not a tool we have to learn to control like you do. ''Jogador'': '''spells'''
'''Tamoril''': I can teach you rune spells and instant spells. What kind of spell do you wish to learn? You can also tell me for which level you would like to learn a spell, if you prefer that. ''Jogador'': '''gods''' / '''banor'''
'''Tamoril''': Gods are of no use for us dragons. One day, a dragon will become old and powerful enough to destroy all gods. Fear that day mortal, from then on the age of the dragons will have begun. ''Jogador'': '''blood crystal'''
'''Tamoril''': If I had one, I'd surely add it to my treasure and not give it to you. ''Jogador'': '''trade'''
'''Tamoril''': I usually prefer to plunder instead of a fair trade. However, I have enough gold and could use some more shiny valuables. ''Jogador'': '''rumours'''
'''Tamoril''': It is told that the First Dragon had four descendants, who became the ancestors of the four kinds of dragons we know in Tibia. They perhaps still have knowledge about the First Dragon's whereabouts - if one could find them. ''Jogador'': '''the first dragon'''
'''Tamoril''': The First Dragon? The first of all of us? The Son of Garsharak? I'm surprised you heard about him. It is such a long time that he wandered Tibia. Yet, there are some rumours. ''Jogador'': '''garsharak'''
'''Tamoril''': Brog the Raging Titan once released as much of a painful flame into the world as he could. The searing fire mixed with his rage, and from it rose Garsharak, the progenitor of all dragons. ...
'''Tamoril''': He sired the first dragon that wandered the world of Tibia and later a whole race of intelligent, giant lizards, a race that would eventually bring terror and chaos into the world. ''Jogador'': '''descendants'''
'''Tamoril''': The names of these four are Tazhadur, Kalyassa, Gelidrazah and Zorvorax. Not only were they the ancestors of all dragons after but also the primal representation of the draconic incitements. About whom do you want to learn more? ''Jogador'': '''tazhadur'''
'''Tamoril''': He was the firstborn among the four, the primal dragon, the kind so many of you know. He saw no advantage in choosing any special aspect or element. So he became the ancestor of all common dragons. These days he's hiding in a secret lair. ''Jogador'': '''kalyassa'''
'''Tamoril''': She was Tazhadur's younger sister, lofty and imperious. She declared herself a dragon empress and thus became the ancestress of all dragon lords. These days she's hiding in a secret lair ''Jogador'': '''gelidrazah'''
'''Tamoril''': She was also called the Frozen because she chose to inhabit the icy wastes in the north of Tibia, today known as Svargrond. She is the ancestress of the frost dragons. These days she's hiding in a secret lair ''Jogador'': '''zorvorax'''
'''Tamoril''': He was once a dragon of air and storm. But he chose undeath and transformed himself into an undead dragon. And thus all his children became undead monstrosities, too. These days he's hiding in a secret lair ''Jogador'': '''secret'''
'''Tamoril''': What didn't you understand about the word secret, little human? What do you want to do, if you know about these mighty dragons' abodes? Go there and look for a fight? ''Jogador'': '''descendants'''
'''Tamoril''': The names of these four are Tazhadur, Kalyassa, Gelidrazah and Zorvorax. Not only were they the ancestors of all dragons after but also the primal representation of the draconic incitements. About whom do you want to learn more? ''Jogador'': '''draconic incitements'''
'''Tamoril''': Each kind of dragon has its own incitement, an important aspect that impels them and occupies their mind. For the common dragons this is the lust for power, for the dragon lords the greed for treasures. ...
'''Tamoril''': The frost dragons' incitement is the thirst for knowledge and for the undead dragons it's the desire for life, as they regret their ancestor's mistake. ...
'''Tamoril''': These incitements are also a kind of trial that has to be undergone if one wants to find the First Dragon's four descendants. ''Jogador'': '''power'''
'''Tamoril''': The lust for power is connected to the urge to kill and the delight in bloodshed. This trial means to kill two hundred dragons. Only if you do this you will be able to enter Tazhadur's secret lair. ''Jogador'': '''treasures'''
'''Tamoril''': The greed for treasures is connected to the hoarding of gold and the seeking for gems. This trial means to find at least five ancient dragon hoards spread all over this world. Only if you do this you will be able to enter Kalyassa's secret lair. ''Jogador'': '''hoards'''
'''Tamoril''': If I knew where they are any efforts to find them would be futile. In this case the treasures would be here in my hoard. But no, unfortunately I don't know. I guess an old book about dragon hoards exists in some library. But I don't remember the place. ''Jogador'': '''knowledge'''
'''Tamoril''': The thirst for knowledge is connected to learning and the love for ancient myths. This trial means to answer some questions. I don't know anything about these questions. ...
'''Tamoril''': I assume you will learn more about them when you find the portal to the secret lair. Only if you can answer the questions you will be able to enter Gelidrazah's lair. ''Jogador'': '''life'''
'''Tamoril''': The desire for life is connected to the restlessness of undeath and the longing for days long lost. This trial means to visit three places connected to the power of living. Only if you do this you will be able to enter Zorvorax' secret lair. ''Jogador'': '''living'''
'''Tamoril''': I never thought about it, little human. Perhaps it could be something connected to the elves. Or a druidic site. Or maybe it is something symbolic. Like water in the desert, that kind of romantic stuff. ''Jogador'': '''find'''
'''Tamoril''': What do you want to do, if you know about these mighty dragons' abodes? Go there and look for a fight? :''Jogador'': '''no'''
:'''Tamoril''': Hrhrhr, I thought so, cowardly little human. (idle) :''Jogador'': '''yes'''
:'''Tamoril''': Good luck then. ''Jogador'': '''yalahar'''
'''Tamoril''': The city is dying. It is mortal just like you and for this reason, it is insignificant. I will still be around when this city is long forgotten. ''Jogador'': '''yalahari'''
'''Tamoril''': They are strange beings at best. If I had any interest in mortals, I might be curious. Regardless of what they claim, they smell of mortality. ''Jogador'': '''alchemist quarter'''
'''Tamoril''': I'm not surprised about the things that happened there. Humans are unable to handle the higher forces. ''Jogador'': '''magician quarter'''
'''Tamoril''': Another bunch of humans who dabbles in the arcane arts to become godlike beings. ''Jogador'': '''alchemist quarter'''
'''Tamoril''': I'm not surprised about the things that happened there. Humans are unable to handle the higher forces. ''Jogador'': '''factory quarter'''
'''Tamoril''': You humans are unable to live on your own. You rely on your little tools and protection. Your sheer inferiority makes me sick. ''Jogador'': '''sunken quarter'''
'''Tamoril''': That was only the beginning. I will be there when everything comes to an end. ''Jogador'': '''foreign quarter'''
'''Tamoril''': A museum of races who will sooner or later be wiped out. ''Jogador'': '''arena quarter'''
'''Tamoril''': Sometimes I fly there for some exercise. ''Jogador'': '''trade quarter'''
'''Tamoril''': I'm not interested in your human quarrels. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Tamoril''': Come back if you dare, ''Jogador''. }} [[Categoria:NPCs Dragão]]

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Zarak | job = Knight Guild Leader | city = Yalahar | subarea = Yalahar Foreigner Quarter | location = [[Yalahar Foreigner Quarter]] ({{mapa|32720,31291,7:5|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.4 | buysell = não | buys = Nada. | sells = Nada. | notes = Ensinava [[magias]] para [[Knights]].

A partir do update '''15.22''', lançado em '''27 de janeiro de 2026''', não é mais possível comprar magias com este NPC. A CipSoft removeu a interação com a palavra '''"spell"''' e a funcionalidade de compra de magias, já que elas passaram a ser aprendidas automaticamente assim que o jogador atinge o nível necessário. | falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == '''Zarak''': I sssmell humansss! == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Zarak''': Greetingsss, ''Jogador''. What do you want? ''Jogador'': '''job'''
'''Zarak''': I teach the artsss of the warrior. I know ssseveral ssspellsss I might ssshare with a worthy knight. ''Jogador'': '''vocation'''
'''Zarak''': Your vocation isss your professsion. There are four vocationsss in Tibia: knightsss, paladinsss, sssorcerersss, and druidsss. ''Jogador'': '''knight'''
'''Zarak''': What you clumsssy humannsss call fighting looksss asss akwardly asss a bear trying to catch a fly. True warriorsss fight with ssskill rather than with power. ''Jogador'': '''druid'''
'''Zarak''': They try to massster the powersss of nature, but they fail to sssee the sssnake in the grasss. ''Jogador'': '''sorcerer'''
'''Zarak''': They dabble with powersss far older than their art. One day thisss power will ssswallow them all. ''Jogador'': '''excalibug'''
'''Zarak''': The great ssserpent wouldn't allow that sssuch a weapon exisssted. ''Jogador'': '''magic'''
'''Zarak''': Magic isss a tool of the godsss. Only holy men are allowed to wield sssuch power. You humansss play way too freely with magic. ''Jogador'': '''news'''
'''Zarak''': A wind of change isss blowing in Yalahar. ''Jogador'': '''palimuth'''
'''Zarak''': Sssoft and without pride. The choice of a ssservant tellsss much about itsss massster. ''Jogador'': '''blood crystal'''
'''Zarak''': A true warrior doesssn't need jewellery. ''Jogador'': '''serpent'''
'''Zarak''': Your warm-blooded brain can't comprehend the waysss of the great ssserpent. ''Jogador'': '''spell'''
'''Zarak''': Sorry, I don't teach spells for your vocation. ''Jogador'': '''spellbook'''
'''Zarak''': In a ssspellbook, your ssspells are lisssted. You will find the pronunciation of each ssspell in there. ''Jogador'': '''tibia'''
'''Zarak''': The world is nothing but an egg of the great ssserpent. ''Jogador'': '''weapon'''
'''Zarak''': You sssoft ssskinsss rely too much on armor and weaponsss. A true warrior usssesss hisss whole body asss a weapon. ''Jogador'': '''yalahar'''
'''Zarak''': My people know a lot about lossst greatnesss. Ssstill, don't expect to sssee me mourning. ''Jogador'': '''yalahari'''
'''Zarak''': They can't hide under their rock forever. Asss sssoon asss they leave their shelter, the predatorsss will ssstrike. ''Jogador'': '''alchemist quarter'''
'''Zarak''': If you want to die by a plague, jussst go there! ''Jogador'': '''factory quarter'''
'''Zarak''': I don't mind that thisss ssstinking factoriesss are out of busssinesss. ''Jogador'': '''foreign quarter'''
'''Zarak''': What a foolish idea to open the city for the enemy! ''Jogador'': '''magician quarter'''
'''Zarak''': Sssoft ssskinned humansss are to obsssessed with magic. ''Jogador'': '''sunken quarter'''
'''Zarak''': Now the quara rule at a place which once belonged to the city. ''Jogador'': '''arena quarter'''
'''Zarak''': The gladiatorsss know to fight, but they don't know how to battle. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Zarak''': We'll meet again. }} [[Categoria:NPCs Lagarto]]

== Frases Espontâneas ==
'''Morpel''': Buy a weapon before your enemy does!</br>
'''Morpel''': <whispers> Morpel clean the shop, Morpel wash your hand .. stupid cyclops, jawoll!</br>
'''Morpel''': WEAPONS! ARMOR! HIGHEST QUALITY, JAWOLL!

== Palavras-Chave ==
''Jogador'': '''hi'''</br>
'''Morpel''': Hello! Welcome to my shop!

''Jogador'': '''job''' / '''shop'''</br>
'''Morpel''': I have an incredible assortment of weapons and armor for sale. Just ask me for a trade.

''Jogador'': '''blood crystal'''</br>
'''Morpel''': No, I don't sell that, sorry.

''Jogador'': '''cookie'''</br>
'''Morpel''': I'm only allowed to eat during my break.

''Jogador'': '''cyclops'''</br>
'''Morpel''': Uhm <whispers> just between you and me. That cyclops with this unpronounceable name is the owner of this store. I just do all the talking and trade ...</br>
'''Morpel''': I get a decent share of the profit though. It seems he is more interested in this smithing stuff than in getting rich.

''Jogador'': '''armor''' / '''buy''' / '''equipment''' / '''goods''' / '''helmet''' / '''legs''' / '''offer''' / '''sell''' / '''shield''' / '''stuff''' / '''trousers''' / '''ware''' / '''weapon'''</br>
'''Morpel''': My offers are weapons, armors, helmets, legs, and shields. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a trade.

''Jogador'': '''trade'''</br>
'''Morpel''': Of course, just browse through my wares.

''Jogador'': '''yalahar'''</br>
'''Morpel''': I guess for a city that does not consist of caves, it's ok.

''Jogador'': '''yalahari'''</br>
'''Morpel''': Can't say much about them. It's not like they would interact much with anyone from the outer city.

''Jogador'': '''sunken quarter'''</br>
'''Morpel''': We can only hope that this catastrophe was a one-time occurrence. We dwarfs live long enough to make it likely that I'm around when another part of the city might sink, jawoll.

''Jogador'': '''trade quarter'''</br>
'''Morpel''': Mr. West often buys weapons and armor for his men. I think that proves the quality of my wares.

''Jogador'': '''factory quarter'''</br>
'''Morpel''': The people in that quarter are desperate enough to attack any strangers. So if you are planning on going there, be well armed and prepared.

''Jogador'': '''foreign quarter'''</br>
'''Morpel''': I can't say I have the guts to pay this quarter a visit.

''Jogador'': '''magician quarter'''</br>
'''Morpel''': For me magic is just scary.

''Jogador'': '''alchemist quarter'''</br>
'''Morpel''': As a smith I know better than to underestimate the power of fire, jawoll. It seems the alchemists never learnt this lesson.

''Jogador'': '''arena quarter'''</br>
'''Morpel''': Now and then, one of the gladiators comes here to by some piece of equipment. Usually they simply use what they loot from slain visitors.

''Jogador'': '''bye'''</br>
'''Morpel''': You really should have bought some extra stuff, just in case.
}}

== Frases Espontâneas ==
'''Oiriz''': Gems and precious jewellery for sale!</br>
'''Oiriz''': <mumbles> My poor old bones. This weather is killing me!

== Palavras-Chave ==
''Jogador'': '''hi'''</br>
'''Oiriz''': Hi! How nice of you to visit my gem shop!

''Jogador'': '''name'''</br>
'''Oiriz''': I'm Oiriz Stonedigger.

''Jogador'': '''job'''</br>
'''Oiriz''': Selling only the finest jewels!

''Jogador'': '''kazordoon'''</br>
'''Oiriz''': Back home there was too much competition for an old dwarf like me. I prefer a peaceful life with enough time for my stuff.

''Jogador'': '''shop'''</br>
'''Oiriz''': It's a shame that I have to sell my precious gems to igno.. uhm customers who might not appreciate their value.

''Jogador'': '''sell''' / '''buy''' / '''offer''' / '''stuff''' / '''ware''' / '''equipment''' / '''goods'''</br>
'''Oiriz''': Well, I sell gems and goblets. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a trade.

''Jogador'': '''goblets'''</br>
'''Oiriz''': Ah, our newest import! We have golden goblets, silver goblets and bronze goblets. All of them have space for a hand-written dedication.

''Jogador'': '''vampire'''</br>
'''Oiriz''': I heard they appreciate beauty, even though they are beasts.

''Jogador'': '''gems'''</br>
'''Oiriz''': You can buy and sell small diamonds, sapphires, rubies, emeralds and amethysts or sell topazes.

''Jogador'': '''pearl'''</br>
'''Oiriz''': There are white and black pearls you can buy or sell, as well as giant green and brown pearls which you can sell.

''Jogador'': '''blood crystal'''</br>
'''Oiriz''': Haha, they are not meant to be owned by ordinary humans. Sorry, but no.

''Jogador'': '''cookies'''</br>
'''Oiriz''': I'm not a fan of sweets.

''Jogador'': '''jewel'''</br>
'''Oiriz''': Currently you can purchase wedding rings, golden amulets, and ruby necklaces. We also buy gold ingots.

''Jogador'': '''talon'''</br>
'''Oiriz''': We don't trade with them.

''Jogador'': '''trade'''</br>
'''Oiriz''': Here, take a look.

''Jogador'': '''yalahari'''</br>
'''Oiriz''': They are as rare as the most valuable gems. Yet, I can't say they are as much in demand as jewels.

''Jogador'': '''yalahar'''</br>
'''Oiriz''': This city has turned into an uncut diamond over the centuries. Perhaps one day someone will come and cut it.

''Jogador'': '''factory quarter'''</br>
'''Oiriz''': I guess the technomancers back in Kazordoon would love all those machines.

''Jogador'': '''alchemist quarter'''</br>
'''Oiriz''': Plagues and destruction hold this quarter in a firm grip. Not many of the people who went there looking for treasures have ever returned.

''Jogador'': '''magician quarter'''</br>
'''Oiriz''': Well, it seems those magicians really messed things up.

''Jogador'': '''trade quarter'''</br>
'''Oiriz''': Humans come, humans go. Considering the shortness of a human's life span, I wouldn't bother much about a crime lord in this quarter.

''Jogador'': '''foreign quarter'''</br>
'''Oiriz''': They have quite rough attitudes in this quarter. You'll only earn respect if you fight for it...

''Jogador'': '''sunken quarter'''</br>
'''Oiriz''': This quarter is way too wet as that any dwarf with some self-esteem would care about.

''Jogador'': '''arena quarter'''</br>
'''Oiriz''': Those gladiators have an even worse temper than a drunken dwarf. And a drunken dwarf has quite a bad temper, I tell you.

''Jogador'': '''bye'''</br>
'''Oiriz''': Good bye! Always remember where to buy the best gems and jewellery in the world!
}}

pages.title: Pugwah
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Pugwah | job = Comerciante de Alimentos | city = Yalahar | subarea = Yalahar Centre | location = [[Yalahar Centre]] ({{mapa|32809,31251,7:1|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.4 | buysell = sim | buys = Nada. | sells = {{Trades/Sell | Beer;Mug of Beer, 3 | Bread, 4 | Cheese, 6 | Ham, 8 | Lemonade;Mug of Lemonade | Meat, 5 | Water (Líquido);Mug of Water | Wine;Mug of Wine, 4}}Os líquidos são vendidos dentro de [[mug]]s. | notes = Pugwah é um [[Dworc Voodoomaster]] que garante o melhor alimento podres, para seus clientes.
Ele chegou em [[Yalahar]] através de uma tempestade em uma pequena canoa, após alguns dias à deriva, sobrevivendo bebendo água da chuva e comendo peixes, ele avistou a cidade de [[Yalahar]]. Assim que chegou, desejava comer todos os habitantes da cidade, no entanto, notou que era pequeno e estava sozinho, então, Pugwah começou a caçar ratos e vender ensopado aos moradoras da cidade. Logo, ele conseguiu comprar uma antiga casa e construiu a sua taverna. Ele encontrou o [[Menacing Mummy]] em uma caixa. | falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == '''Pugwah''': Food! Food! Best food in world from best cook in world! == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Pugwah''': Uh, a brave customer! Me happy to serve you delicious food and drinks. ''Jogador'': '''job'''
'''Pugwah''': Me great cook! Only ingredients most rotten find way in my stews! ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Pugwah''': Me Pugwah. ''Jogador'': '''dworc'''
'''Pugwah''': Me came here with little canoe. Great storm making bshhhh bshhh! Trying to drown little Pugwah! But no no! Pugwah row row row and escape! Then long long only water. ...
'''Pugwah''': But Pugwah have fishing rod. Many fish and drinking rain making Pugwah's stomach sick but then Pugwah seeing city! At first Pugwah wanting eat everyone in city but Pugwah small and lonely. ...
'''Pugwah''': But Pugwah also smart very much! Hunting rats and selling stew Pugwah become rich! Soon buy old house and making tavern! Every one comes and eats! Stupid people selling rotten stuff so cheap, Pugwah making fortune by cooking it! ''Jogador'': '''mummy'''
'''Pugwah''': Me find him in box with exquisite stinky old meat I ordered! ''Jogador'': '''yalahar'''
'''Pugwah''': Biiiiig city. Soooo many opportunity to find something rotten to make a stew or sausage! ''Jogador'': '''vampire'''
'''Pugwah''': Me bite back!! Pugwah swear! ''Jogador'': '''cookie'''
'''Pugwah''': No thanks. Me mummy says no take food from strangers. ''Jogador'': '''food'''
'''Pugwah''': Food has to be rotten to gain flavour! No need for expensive spices! ''Jogador'': '''drink''' / '''goods''' / '''ware''' / '''buy''' / '''sell''' / '''stuff''' / '''equipment'''
'''Pugwah''': Me offer bread, cheese, ham, or meat. And drinks. If you like? Ask Pugwah for trade. ''Jogador'': '''trade'''
'''Pugwah''': Good, good! Take look at yummy food good Pugwah sells. ''Jogador'': '''blood crystal'''
'''Pugwah''': Big red crystal. Some people talk about it in my tavern. But strange people those are! ''Jogador'': '''alchemist quarter'''
'''Pugwah''': I know people go there, come back green as dworc! ''Jogador'': '''trade quarter'''
'''Pugwah''': Big chieftain West there master is. ''Jogador'': '''factory quarter'''
'''Pugwah''': People there mean, I don't go there. Thinking they want to eat Pugwah. ''Jogador'': '''magician quarter'''
'''Pugwah''': Big bad voodoo they making. Stay away! Stay away! ''Jogador'': '''sunken quarter'''
'''Pugwah''': Now fish there live. ''Jogador'': '''arena quarter'''
'''Pugwah''': Good area for hunt. ''Jogador'': '''foreign quarter'''
'''Pugwah''': Lot of different people around in quarter. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Pugwah''': Coming back soon to taste me special meat, ''Jogador''. }}

pages.title: Serafin
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Serafin | job = Comerciante de Alimentos | city = Yalahar | subarea = Yalahar Centre | location = [[Yalahar Centre]] ({{mapa|32851,31209,7:1|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.4 | buysell = sim | buys = | sells = {{Trades/Sell | Aubergine | Banana, 5 | Blueberry | Carrot, 3 | Cherry | Corncob | Grapes | Juice Squeezer | Lemon | Mango, 10 | Melon, 10 | Orange, 10 | Potato | Pumpkin | Strawberry, 2 | White Mushroom, 10}} | notes = Vende frutas e vegetais.

* Faz parte da [[Blood Brothers Quest]].

| falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == Não possui. == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Serafin''': Welcome to my fruit and vegetable store, ''Jogador''! Ask me for a trade if you'd like to see my wares. ''Jogador'': '''job'''
'''Serafin''': Oh, I'm selling fruits and veggies as you can see. If you want to have a closer look, ask me for a trade. ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Serafin''': I'm Serafin, pleased to meet you. ''Jogador'': '''julius'''
'''Serafin''': I think that poor guy has serious trust issues... must be hard if you are obsessed with the idea that everyone is your enemy or a monster. ''Jogador'': '''armenius'''
'''Serafin''': I think he runs a bar in the former trade quarter. ''Jogador'': '''lisander'''
'''Serafin''': Oh yes, I see him often. Nice guy. ''Jogador'': '''maris'''
'''Serafin''': A man of the seas. ''Jogador'': '''ortheus'''
'''Serafin''': I like him, but unfortunately I don't have much time to chat with him anymore. ''Jogador'': '''trade'''
'''Serafin''': Oh, sure, take a look! ''Jogador'': '''vampire'''
'''Serafin''': I don't know what you're talking about. ''Jogador'': '''blood'''
'''Serafin''': This is a fruit store. No slaughterhouse. ''Jogador'': '''cookies'''
'''Serafin''': It'd be better for you to leave now. ''Jogador'': '''yalahar'''
'''Serafin''': Oh, this lovely city is a great place to live and to do business. ''Jogador'': '''quarter'''
'''Serafin''': Well, actually this is not a quarter but the city centre. ''Jogador'': '''garlic'''
'''Serafin''': I'm so sorry, but I don't sell garlic. ''Jogador'': '''alori mort'''
'''Serafin''': There's something about these words which makes me feel awkward. Or maybe it's you who causes that feeling. You better get lost. ''Jogador'': '''mission''' / '''quest'''
'''Serafin''': Sorry, but I already have a delivery boy. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Serafin''': Good bye, my dear customer. }}
