== Frases Espontâneas ==
'''Vincent''': Bows, crossbows and ammunition for sale.

== Palavras-Chave ==
''Jogador'': '''hi'''</br>
'''Vincent''': Hello, ''Jogador''. If you are interested in distance weapons or ammunition, ask me for a trade.

''Jogador'': '''job'''</br>
'''Vincent''': I sell things that make your life in the city safer. My bows, crossbows, and ammunition are the best you can get.

''Jogador'': '''name'''</br>
'''Vincent''': For you I'm Vincent. That will have to do.

''Jogador'': '''buy''' / '''sell''' / '''offer''' / '''stuff''' / '''goods''' / '''ware'''</br>
'''Vincent''': My offers are bows, crossbows and ammunition. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a trade.

''Jogador'': '''trade'''</br>
'''Vincent''': Of course, just browse through my wares.

''Jogador'': '''arrows'''</br>
'''Vincent''': I have normal arrows, sniper arrows, flaming arrows, shiver arrows, flash arrows, earth arrows and onyx arrows used with bows. Just ask me for a trade.

''Jogador'': '''bolt'''</br>
'''Vincent''': I have bolts, piercing bolts and power bolts used with crossbows.

''Jogador'': '''weapons'''</br>
'''Vincent''': What use does a sword, an axe, or a mace have when the guy you are fighting kills you with a few well-placed shots? Distance weapons are the better choice, I tell you!

''Jogador'': '''distance'''</br>
'''Vincent''': Well, I sell spears, bows, crossbows and ammunition for distance fighting. Ask me for a trade if you're interested to see my wares.

''Jogador'': '''bow'''</br>
'''Vincent''': I don't buy used bows. If you want to buy one, just ask me for a trade.

''Jogador'': '''crossbow'''</br>
'''Vincent''': I don't buy used crossbows. If you want to buy one, just ask me for a trade.

''Jogador'': '''blood crystal'''</br>
'''Vincent''': What's that supposed to be? Anyway, I don't sell it.

''Jogador'': '''fletcher'''</br>
'''Vincent''': I sell things that make your life in the city safer. My bows, crossbows, and ammunition are the best you can get.

''Jogador'': '''palimuth'''</br>
'''Vincent''': I don't want others to talk about me, and I also don't talk about others. Easiest way to stay out of trouble.

''Jogador'': '''cookie'''</br>
'''Vincent''': I don't trust strangers enough to take food from them.

''Jogador'': '''spear'''</br>
'''Vincent''': Yes, I sell spears. Ask me for a trade if you're interested to see my wares.

''Jogador'': '''vampire'''</br>
'''Vincent''': Why do you think I've built this defensive fortification?!

''Jogador'': '''yalahar'''</br>
'''Vincent''': In its golden age, this city must have been a joy for Kurik's eye. Even today you can still see some of its former glory here and there.

''Jogador'': '''yalahari'''</br>
'''Vincent''': They must have been great inventors in the past. Nowadays not much of that is left. I guess they were foolish enough to let things slide.

''Jogador'': '''bye'''</br>
'''Vincent''': Good bye.
}}

pages.title: Jimmy
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Jimmy | job = Criminoso | city = Yalahar | subarea = Yalahar Trade Quarter | location = [[Yalahar Trade Quarter]] ({{Mapa|32857,31382,6:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.4 | buysell = não | buys = | sells = | notes =

* Faz parte da [[Top of the City Quest]]. * Na primeira vez que você falar '''Hi''' ele irá convocar 03 [[Assassin]]s.

| falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == Não possui. == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi''' ''(na primeira vez que você falar com o NPC)''
'''Jimmy''': Get him!! ''Jogador'': '''hi''' ''(enquanto estiver fazendo a quest)''
'''Jimmy''': Not bad, not bad... why did you follow me? ''Jogador'': '''hi''' ''(após concluir a quest)''
'''Jimmy''': Hello my friend. What's up? ''Jogador'': '''job''' / '''follow'''
'''Jimmy''': Guess what? I'm a thief! ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Jimmy''': People call me Jimmy Swiftfinger. ''Jogador'': '''ninja'''
'''Jimmy''': What's that? Never heard of it. ''Jogador'': '''yalahar'''
'''Jimmy''': This city is a huge jail with its keepers in the middle. I've never seen its former brilliance so I rather see it in a negative light. ''Jogador'': '''yalahari'''
'''Jimmy''': I don't like them and I can't see how they should ever have managed to build a city like this. I mean, they were never able to organise that many people. ''Jogador'': '''dwarf'''
'''Jimmy''': Some dwarfs live in Yalahar but they are not very talkative. I have no clue where they came from. ''Jogador'': '''beregar'''
'''Jimmy''': Never heard of that. ''Jogador'': '''mistrock'''
'''Jimmy''': This island is weird. It's definitely no ordinary mist that covers the island most of the days. To me it looks more like....steam from a chimney. ''Jogador'': '''fenrock'''
'''Jimmy''': I've never been there because there is no reason to go. It is cold and the island is small and meagre. ''Jogador'': '''quest''' ''(após finalizar a quest)''
'''Jimmy''': We had a deal and I kept my word, so what do you want? You'd better leave now. ''Jogador'': '''assassin'''
'''Jimmy''': I don't kill people. ''Jogador'': '''alchemist quarter'''
'''Jimmy''': I was a little boy when the quarter blew up. It was a huge explosion and the stench was evil. No one made it out there alive. Every living being mutated into some monster. ''Jogador'': '''factory quarter'''
'''Jimmy''': What are they producing there anyway? Tell me if you find out. ''Jogador'': '''magic quarter'''
'''Jimmy''': I sneaked in once. You have to know that it is not allowed for 'normal' citizens like me to enter. They carry out dark experiments there, that's for sure. ''Jogador'': '''cemetery quarter'''
'''Jimmy''': No one knows what really happened there. The whole quarter is overrun with undead and demonic creatures. It's the work of the mages if you ask me. ''Jogador'': '''sunken quarter'''
'''Jimmy''': A smart person like you has surely seen that most of the city has grown larger than the island it was built on. The Yalahari built metal construction to enlarge the city. ...
'''Jimmy''': Well, in the case of the sunken quarter, it didn't work out. The whole quarter broke away and sunk into the sea. ''Jogador'': '''foreigner quarter'''
'''Jimmy''': The foreigner quarter is almost as shabby as the trade quarter. Be careful there or you might get in trouble. ''Jogador'': '''arena quarter'''
'''Jimmy''': I like the zoo quarter. I often go there and watch the animals. One advice, though: Stay away from the arena! The gladiators there are always up for a fight and there are rumours about some very strong undead gladiators deep down under the arena. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Jimmy''': Watch your back, ''Jogador''. }}

pages.title: Karith
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Karith | job = Capitão de Navios | city = Yalahar | subarea = Yalahar Centre | location = [[Yalahar Centre]] ({{mapa|32815,31278,5:5|aqui}}). | buysell = não | implemented = 8.4 | notes = Após conquistar sua confiança ele pode levar você para:
* [[Ab'Dendriel]] - 150 [[gp]] * [[Darashia]] - 200 [[gp]] * [[Venore]] - 175 [[gp]] * [[Ankrahmun]] - 220 [[gp]] * [[Port Hope]] - 250 [[gp]] * [[Thais]] - 190 [[gp]] * [[Liberty Bay]] - 265 [[gp]] * [[Carlin]] - 175 [[gp]] * [[Travora]] - 1,000 [[gp]]

* Para poder navegar com ele, você deve completar a missão ''Searoutes around Yalahar'' da [[In Service of Yalahar Quest]].

| falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == '''Karith''': This weather is killing me. If I only had enough money to retire. == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Karith''': Hello! Tell me what's on your mind. Time is money. ''Jogador'': '''mind''' / '''job'''
'''Karith''': I'm the captain of this ship. Now and then a Yalahari wants to make a trip around the isle. ...
'''Karith''': It's a special privilege, although a rare one. ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Karith''': I'm Karith. I don't belong to a caste any longer, and only serve the Yalahari. ''Jogador'': '''ship''' / '''sail''' / '''trip''' / '''destination''' / '''passage''' / '''go''' / '''town'''
'''Karith''': For the sake of profit, we established ship routes to Ab'Dendriel, Darashia, Venore, Ankrahmun, Port Hope, Thais, Liberty Bay and Carlin. I can also sail you to Travora, if you want. ''Jogador'': '''how are you'''
'''Karith''': I guess as soon as you are leaving, I'll be fine. ''Jogador'': '''excalibug'''
'''Karith''': I'm sure the Yalahari possess more powerful weapons than that. ''Jogador'': '''vampire'''
'''Karith''': I leave them in peace, they leave me in peace. Whatever. ''Jogador'': '''blood crystal'''
'''Karith''': I'm not interested in stuff like that. ''Jogador'': '''monster'''
'''Karith''': The power of the Yalahari will ward off all monsters. ''Jogador'': '''ferumbras'''
'''Karith''': I bet his power is nothing compared to the awesome might of the Yalahari. ''Jogador'': '''elf'''
'''Karith''': I've got no contact to other elves, my family came here a generation ago. ''Jogador'': '''dwarf'''
'''Karith''': Luckily, those little diggers are a rare sight here. ''Jogador'': '''god''' / '''banor''' / '''uman''' / '''zathroth'''
'''Karith''': Gods are useless at best and a danger at worst. ''Jogador'': '''rumor''' / '''rumour''' / '''news'''
'''Karith''': I'm too busy to bother about rumours. ''Jogador'': '''mission''' / '''task''' / '''quest'''
'''Karith''': I doubt that you can do anything that would be useful for me! ''Jogador'': '''yalahari'''
'''Karith''': The Yalahari are wiser and more powerful than you could ever imagine. You won't be able to understand the extent of their power. It's a pity there are only so few left. ''Jogador'': '''yalahar'''
'''Karith''': The city was a marvel to behold. It is certain that its ruin was caused by too many foreigners. ''Jogador'': '''ab'dendriel'''
'''Karith''': I must admit this bug milk is something special. The rich Yalahari might be quite fond of it. Do you want a passage to Ab'Dendriel for 150 gold? ''Jogador'': '''ankrahmun'''
'''Karith''': The Yalahari seem to be obsessed with conserving their dead, so I guess the embalming fluid will be a great success in Yalahar. Do you want a passage to Ankrahmun for 220 gold? ''Jogador'': '''carlin'''
'''Karith''': The evergreen flower pots are an amusing item that might find some customers here. Do you want a passage to Carlin for 175 gold? ''Jogador'': '''darashia'''
'''Karith''': Of course it is merely superstition that the darashian sand wasp honey brings back youth and vitality, but as long people pay a decent price, I couldn't care less. Do you want a passage to Darashia for 200 gold? ''Jogador'': '''thais'''
'''Karith''': Astonishing enough the royal satin seems to suit the exquisite taste of the Yalahari. Do you want a passage to Thais for 190 gold? ''Jogador'': '''liberty bay'''
'''Karith''': The rum of this city seems .. adequate for the taste of some inhabitants. Do you want a passage to Liberty Bay for 265 gold? ''Jogador'': '''venore'''
'''Karith''': The swamp spice will turn out very lucrative considering that it helps to make even the most disgusting dish taste good. Do you want a passage to Venore for 175 gold? ''Jogador'': '''port hope'''
'''Karith''': Ivory is highly prized by the artisans of the Yalahari. Do you want a passage to Port Hope for 250 gold? ''Jogador'': '''travora'''
'''Karith''': Travora is the place for the character world transfer, so if you travel there make sure you actually do want to change worlds. Do you want to purchase a new daily ticket for 1000 gold? ''Jogador'': '''svargrond'''
'''Karith''': I deny going there. It is way too cold there. ''Jogador'': '''kazordoon'''
'''Karith''': Even if they had a harbour, I can do without the company of dwarfs. ''Jogador'': '''edron'''
'''Karith''': This city is of no interest to us. ''Jogador'': '''krailos'''
'''Karith''': That's a faraway grassland, inhabited by savage ogres, as the word is. I won't sail there. ''Jogador'': '''issavi'''
'''Karith''': A beautiful city in a strange but fascinating land. I don't sail there, though. ''Jogador'': '''darama'''
'''Karith''': Darama is a continent, not a city! I guess that is what happens when someone has never seen a school from the inside. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Karith''': Good bye. }}

pages.title: Lisander
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Lisander | job = Roleplay | city = Yalahar | subarea = Yalahar Centre | location = [[Yalahar Centre]] ({{Mapa|32811,31239,7:1|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.4 | buysell = não | buys = | sells = | notes =

* Faz parte da [[Blood Brothers Quest]].

| falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == Não possui. == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Lisander''': I'd rather be left in peace. Keep it short. ''Jogador'': '''job''' / '''peace'''
'''Lisander''': Listen, I'm not a big small talker. Why don't you do us both a favour and leave me alone? ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Lisander''': Lisander. Couldn't say 'nice to meet you' though. Are you done? ''Jogador'': '''augur'''
'''Lisander''': They can be a pain in the neck. ''Jogador'': '''alori mort'''
'''Lisander''': Hold your tongue. ''Jogador'': '''blood'''
'''Lisander''': No, that's wine I'm drinking. ''Jogador'': '''vampire'''
'''Lisander''': Ooooh. Daaaaaaaangerous creatures of the night! If that's what you wanted to hear. ''Jogador'': '''cookie'''
'''Lisander''': It'd be better for you to leave now. ''Jogador'': '''mission''' / '''quest'''
'''Lisander''': Yes, I have one. Mission 1: Try to keep your mouth shut for at least two hours! ''Jogador'': '''yalahar'''
'''Lisander''': This city has a lot more to offer than other cities. ''Jogador'': '''quarter'''
'''Lisander''': I like it here, though that's obviously not a quarter. ''Jogador'': '''armenius'''
'''Lisander''': His bar is a little too dirty for my taste. ''Jogador'': '''ortheus'''
'''Lisander''': He's not the type to hang out in taverns, so I rarely see him. ''Jogador'': '''serafin'''
'''Lisander''': That guy should become a bit tougher. He's a little too mellow. ''Jogador'': '''julius'''
'''Lisander''': Nosy little wannabe. ''Jogador'': '''maris'''
'''Lisander''': Good man. ''Jogador'': '''''palavra aleatória'''''
'''Lisander''': ... ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Lisander''': Finally. }}

pages.title: Lorietta
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Lorietta | job = Sacerdote | city = Yalahar | subarea = Yalahar Centre | location = [[Yalahar Centre]] ({{Mapa|32787,31277,7:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.4 | buysell = não | notes = Lorietta reside no Templo Yalahar, ajudando os aventureiros, oferecendo cura até 65 de [[hp]] e pode curá-lo se estiver [[burning|queimado]], [[cursed|amaldiçoado]], [[dazzled|deslumbrado]], [[electrified|eletrificado]], [[freezing|paralisado]] ou [[poisoned|envenenado]]. Lorietta também é uma [[priestess]] ou Kurik, o santo padroeiro dos tolos, bobos, e inventores. Ela usa o [[Jester Outfits|Jester Outfit]].

* Você pode conseguir uma pedra especial falando '''Hi - Adventurer's Stone - Yes''' para este NPC. * Se você usar uma [[Adventurer's Stone]] dentro de [[templo]], você será teleportado para pequena ilha da [[Adventurers' Guild]].

| falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == '''Lorietta''': Lalalaaalalaa. == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Lorietta''': Hi there, ''Jogador''! What do you need? ''Jogador'': '''job''' / '''need'''
'''Lorietta''': I guess I'm the local priest! They said only a priest of Kurik would be crazy enough to try spreading the faith in this town. And I tell you what: They have been soooo right! ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Lorietta''': My name is Lorietta. But why do you ask? I knew your name without asking. Guess how! ''Jogador'': '''priest'''
'''Lorietta''': Oh, we heal people and ... and ... do other nice stuff. You know?! ''Jogador'': '''heal''' / '''help'''
'''Lorietta''': You do not need any healing right now. ''Jogador'': '''kurik'''
'''Lorietta''': Kurik is the patron saint of jesters, fools, and inventors. This might sound strange, but do you know any inventor that isn't also a fool to some extent, and don't you think jesters are quite inventive? ''Jogador'': '''yalahar'''
'''Lorietta''': In its golden age, this city must have been a joy for Kurik's eye. Even today you can still see some of its former glory here and there. ''Jogador'': '''yalahari'''
'''Lorietta''': They must have been great inventors in the past. Nowadays not much of that is left. I guess they were foolish enough to let things slide. ''Jogador'': '''vampire'''
'''Lorietta''': As long as I don't invite them into my temple I'll be fine. ''Jogador'': '''palimuth'''
'''Lorietta''': He's a bit too boring for my taste. ''Jogador'': '''tibia'''
'''Lorietta''': Tibia is quite big, isn't it? ''Jogador'': '''adventurer's stone'''
'''Lorietta''': Keep your adventurer's stone well. ''Jogador'': '''blood crystal'''
'''Lorietta''': Ehehehe! A blood crystal? You must be a fool looking for one. I like fools. Why don't you check the cultist hideout in the magician quarter? ''Jogador'': '''god'''
'''Lorietta''': The gods created all. ''Jogador'': '''life'''
'''Lorietta''': Life can be a cruel joke sometimes. ''Jogador'': '''people'''
'''Lorietta''': People come, people go. ''Jogador'': '''ashes''' / '''blessing'''
'''Lorietta''': Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five blessings you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced. ''Jogador'': '''blessings'''
'''Lorietta''': There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the spiritual shielding, the spark of the phoenix, the embrace of Tibia, the fire of the suns and the wisdom of solitude. Additionally, you can receive the twist of fate here. ...
'''Lorietta''': There are also two enhanced blessings for further reduction of experience loss. ''Jogador'': '''cookie'''
'''Lorietta''': Oh, nonono, but thank you! ''Jogador'': '''excalibug'''
'''Lorietta''': If I were a hero, I'd rather search for the screwdriver of Kurik. ''Jogador'': '''plant'''
'''Lorietta''': My preferred plant is salad. ''Jogador'': '''monster'''
'''Lorietta''': Hey! You are not a beauty yourself! ''Jogador'': '''news'''
'''Lorietta''': I'm only interested in new jokes, but I haven't heard any lately. ''Jogador'': '''sacred places'''
'''Lorietta''': Just ask in which of the five blessings you are interested in. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Lorietta''': Bye bye, ''Jogador''! }}

pages.title: Maris
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Maris | job = Capitão de Navios | city = Yalahar | subarea = Fenrock, Mistrock, Yalahar Foreigner Quarter | location = [[Fenrock]] ({{mapa|32562,31312,7:5|aqui}}), [[Mistrock]] ({{mapa|32638,31437,7:5|aqui}}) e [[Yalahar Foreigner Quarter]] ({{mapa|32648,31293,6:5|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.4 | buysell = não | notes = Transporta somente jogadores com [[Premium Time]]. Ele pode levar você para:
* [[Fenrock]]: 100 [[gp]] para [[Yalahar]], 50 [[gp]] para [[Mistrock]]. * [[Mistrock]]: 100 [[gp]] para [[Yalahar]], 100 [[gp]] para [[Fenrock]]. * [[Yalahar]]: 100 [[gp]] para [[Fenrock]] ou [[Mistrock]]. | falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == Não possui. == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Maris''': I hope you have a good reason to step near my ship, ''Jogador''. ----- === Em ambos os locais: === ''Jogador'': '''job'''
'''Maris''': I once sailed all seas of Tibia. No storm was too powerful and no sea too troubled for me and my ship. ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Maris''': I'm Maris Sharktooth. Arrr! - Well, I used to be. ''Jogador'': '''alori mort'''
'''Maris''': Stop mumbling and don't bug me. ''Jogador'': '''vampire'''
'''Maris''': I don't know what you're talking about. ''Jogador'': '''julius'''
'''Maris''': He sometimes sneaks around here. I have no idea what he's up to. ''Jogador'': '''serafin'''
'''Maris''': Such a polite little angel. Hahaha. ''Jogador'': '''armenius'''
'''Maris''': Good guy to have a drink with, if you know what I mean. ''Jogador'': '''ortheus'''
'''Maris''': He seems like a crazy old magician or something like that. Don't have much to do with him. ''Jogador'': '''lisander'''
'''Maris''': He used to hang out with Armenius and me, but nowadays he prefers to stay in the centre. ''Jogador'': '''augur'''
'''Maris''': They don't let me anchor my ship in the central harbour, so of course I'm not exactly fond of them. ''Jogador'': '''quarter'''
'''Maris''': Oh well, I stick with what I got. ''Jogador'': '''blood'''
'''Maris''': No, thanks. ''Jogador'': '''mission''' / '''quest'''
'''Maris''': Those days are over, kid. I don't hire for my crew anymore. ''Jogador'': '''cookie''' ''(o NPC encerra a conversa)''
'''Maris''': Get off! ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Maris''': Good bye. ----- === Em Yalahar: === ''Jogador'': '''yalahar'''
'''Maris''': I don't mind having ended up here. There are worse places. ''Jogador'': '''ship''' / '''passage''' / '''go''' / '''destination''' / '''trip''' / '''route'''
'''Maris''': There are two small islands west of Yalahar. I'm not sure if they have an official name but the people call the bigger one 'Mistrock' and the other one 'Fenrock'. ''Jogador'': '''fenrock'''
'''Maris''': Do I look like a ferryman?! Well... if I think about it, I could use some sailing practice. I can bring you to Fenrock for 100 gold. Agreed? ''Jogador'': '''mistrock'''
'''Maris''': Do I look like a ferryman?! Well... if I think about it, I could use some sailing practice. I can bring you to Mistrock for 100 gold. Agreed? ----- === Em Fenrock: === ''Jogador'': '''fenrock'''
'''Maris''': This island bears a secret. I can feel it. ''Jogador'': '''ship''' / '''passage''' / '''go''' / '''destination''' / '''trip''' / '''route'''
'''Maris''': Well, we haven't got many options here. It's either Mistrock or back to Yalahar. ''Jogador'': '''yalahar'''
'''Maris''': Back to Yalahar for 100 gold? ''Jogador'': '''mistrock'''
'''Maris''': To Mistrock for 100 gold? ----- === Em Mistrock: === ''Jogador'': '''mistrock'''
'''Maris''': Do you smell this? It's the smell of fire... the fire of a forge. Many people searched this rock here for a hidden path, but they haven't found anything. ...
'''Maris''': I'd search on Fenrock if I were you. Even though there's snow on the surface, it's still warm underground. There are often caves under fresh lava streams. ''Jogador'': '''ship''' / '''passage''' / '''go''' / '''destination''' / '''trip''' / '''route'''
'''Maris''': Well, we haven't got many options here. It's either Fenrock or back to Yalahar. ''Jogador'': '''yalahar'''
'''Maris''': Back to Yalahar for 100 gold? ''Jogador'': '''fenrock'''
'''Maris''': To Fenrock for 50 gold? }}

pages.title: Mr. West
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Mr. West | job = Barão | city = Yalahar | subarea = Yalahar Trade Quarter | location = [[Yalahar Trade Quarter]] ({{mapa|32772,31359,6:5|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.4 | buysell = não | buys = | sells = | notes = Ele é o líder não-oficial do Trade Quarter.

* Faz parte da [[In Service of Yalahar Quest]].

| falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == '''Mr. West''': I'll make them an offer they can't refuse. == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi''' ''(na primeira vez que você falar com o NPC)
'''Mr. West''': Wh .. What? How did you get here? Where are all the guards? You .. you could have killed me but yet you chose to talk? What a relief! ...
'''Mr. West''': So what brings you here my friend, if I might call you like that? ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Mr. West''': Hello. What brings you here? ''Jogador'': '''here''' / '''friend''' / '''want'''
'''Mr. West''': I guess you are here on a mission. ''Jogador'': '''azerus'''
'''Mr. West''': He seems astonishingly determined and focused for a Yalahari. Perhaps he is the first sign of a change of wind blowing in our city. Who knows if it will be for the better. ''Jogador'': '''cookies'''
'''Mr. West''': Uhm. That cookie smells kinda strange. Don't take it as an offence, but no. ''Jogador'': '''ab'dendriel'''
'''Mr. West''': I wouldn't trust a single elf, let alone a whole city of them. ''Jogador'': '''thais'''
'''Mr. West''': The word is that Thais is a dangerous place which you better do not visit unprepared. ''Jogador'': '''venore'''
'''Mr. West''': The trade barons know how to run a city, that's for sure. Unfortunately, they are greedier than it is good for them. I'm prepared to deal with their intrusion into my territory. ''Jogador'': '''kazordoon'''
'''Mr. West''': Those dwarfs know how to fortify a city. Perhaps one day, when I've earned enough money and have grown too old for the trouble in Yalahar, I will retire there. ''Jogador'': '''carlin'''
'''Mr. West''': The illusion of peace that this city is offering often distracts the attention from the dangers lurking there. ''Jogador'': '''palimuth'''
'''Mr. West''': He is a typical Yalahar official - always occupied with trying to stop the dam from breaking. After all these years, he still has not given up. That qualifies him either as an idealist or a fool. ''Jogador'': '''bandits'''
'''Mr. West''': All those royal bloodlines started with some kind of bandit anyhow. ''Jogador'': '''blood crystal'''
'''Mr. West''': Never heard of it. ''Jogador'': '''crime'''
'''Mr. West''': The city offers great possibilities as long as order is maintained in some way. ...
'''Mr. West''': It's easy to maintain order by using brute force but I see that as a necessary evil. My little empire developed out of my need for security in these times of turmoil. ...
'''Mr. West''': To establish some security, I had to establish a base of power first. To maintain this power, I had to gain money somehow. ...
'''Mr. West''': At this point I used my power to secure resources and to encourage trade. ...
'''Mr. West''': In fact I do nothing else than the kings. I collect taxes and use them to hire men that ensure the safety of the people. ''Jogador'': '''slum'''
'''Mr. West''': The people do their best to earn their living. Still, they are desperate. If it were not for me, they'd rob and murder each other. ''Jogador'': '''yalahar'''
'''Mr. West''': Yalahar is an oyster. Its treasure is waiting to be excavated by someone with the necessary determination. ''Jogador'': '''alchemist quarter'''
'''Mr. West''': I don't care much about what has happened there. All that matters to me is that the quarter is lost and poses a danger. ''Jogador'': '''arena quarter'''
'''Mr. West''': In fact the arena quarter is still useful for the city. It's a good food source, and I recruit some of my best men from the descendants of the gladiators. ''Jogador'': '''factory quarter'''
'''Mr. West''': There are still many people living there. Of course, I provide them with some of my services as well. ''Jogador'': '''magician quarter'''
'''Mr. West''': It's a shame. I'm convinced there are countless treasures hidden in those ruins. However, neither bribe nor threats get my men even close to this quarter. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Mr. West''': Good bye. }}

pages.title: Oliver
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Oliver | job = Guarda | city = Yalahar | subarea = Yalahar Factory Quarter, Yalahar Sunken Quarter | location = Entre o [[Yalahar Factory Quarter]] e o [[Yalahar Sunken Quarter]] ({{mapa|32894,31228,7:1|aqui}}). | buysell = não | implemented = 8.4 | notes = Diga '''pass''' e o destino para atravessar o portão.

* Faz parte da [[In Service of Yalahar Quest]].

| falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == '''Oliver''': I wish my shift would end. == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Oliver''': Hello. Unless you have official business here or want to pass the gate, please move on. ''Jogador'': '''job''' / '''official'''
'''Oliver''': I'm a proud sergeant of the Yalaharian Guard Force and at your service. ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Oliver''': I'm called Oliver. ''Jogador'': '''augur'''
'''Oliver''': Of all the Augur, I only know Palimuth in person. If I were you, I'd trust him. He's a good man and really cares about the citizens of Yalahar, not only about his own profit or status. People like him are rare. ''Jogador'': '''mission'''
'''Oliver''': I'd love to help you with your mission, but I'm not sure what you expect from me? Anything in particular? ''Jogador'': '''pass''' / '''gate'''
'''Oliver''': Do you want to pass the gate? Are you headed for the sunken or the factory quarter? :''Jogador'': '''sunken'''
:'''Oliver''': You should have a look at the monument. It's quite a sight. :''Jogador'': '''factory'''
:'''Oliver''': Be careful there. You never know when those machines get out of control - of whatever controls them. ''Jogador'': '''quarter'''
'''Oliver''': Now that's an interesting topic. Each quarter has its own stories and problems, and I could probably go on for hours and hours telling about my shifts there... ehmm... sorry, I tend to get carried away. ''Jogador'': '''yalahar'''
'''Oliver''': I could tell so many stories about what I experienced here in Yalahar ever since I arrived here around ten years ago. Still a young and eager soldier, fresh from the... ah no, that would lead too far. ''Jogador'': '''island'''
'''Oliver''': Yes, we have a few islands surrounding Yalahar. They are called Mistrock, Fenrock and Vengoth. ''Jogador'': '''mistrock'''
'''Oliver''': I heard the weirdest stories about Mistrock from all kind of people. I don't think it's an 'evil' island, even though it's shrouded in mist. Actually I heard something about dwarfs living there somewhere. ''Jogador'': '''fenrock'''
'''Oliver''': Fenrock is close to the western Ice Islands. That's why it's also rather cold there. I'm not sure if any captain sails there, but you might ask in the foreign quarter. ''Jogador'': '''vengoth'''
'''Oliver''': To be honest, nobody actually knows whether Vengoth is an 'island' as in 'small island'. I think people have only travelled to the western shore so far, and also came back rather fast. ''Jogador'': '''alchemist quarter'''
'''Oliver''': Oh dear, the poor alchemists who were working in that quarter when the big explosion happened! But well - some people say that it was caused by their very dangerous experiments... I wonder what they were playing with. ''Jogador'': '''arena quarter'''
'''Oliver''': When I was still a young boy I dreamt of fighting in the arena and facing huge beasts and powerful gladiators. But ever since the gladiators behave strangely, my dream has become unrealisable. ''Jogador'': '''sunken quarter'''
'''Oliver''': I think almost everyone in this city lost someone when the quarter collapsed into the ocean. I could tell you the full story, but then again that's Tarak's job. He's a ferryman in the sunken quarter. ''Jogador'': '''cemetery quarter'''
'''Oliver''': The ironic thing is that my mother is buried there. Well, she was buried there, that is. You might imagine my surprise and pain when I saw her... or rather her remains strolling around the city some night... ''Jogador'': '''factory quarter'''
'''Oliver''': One of my buddies used to work in the factory before the normal production of food, weapons and such was shut down. I don't know what keeps the machines and golems running - it must be a magical power source. ''Jogador'': '''foreign quarter'''
'''Oliver''': Once during one of my shifts in the foreign quarter, I had a really interesting conversation with a lizard about the differences between human and lizard fighting skills... I should write that down sometime. ''Jogador'': '''magician quarter'''
'''Oliver''': A long time ago, there was an incident with an old witch who was absolutely convinced that she was a cat. It was still funny when she was chasing rats... but then she almost fell off a roof. ''Jogador'': '''trade quarter'''
'''Oliver''': I've known Mr. West for a long time now and witnessed him establishing his small empire of bandits and criminals. It's quite impressive considering that this is all the work of one man, as crazy as he might be. ''Jogador'': '''''palavra aleatória'''''
'''Oliver''': I'll tell you that story another time, but not now. Sorry. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Oliver''': Goodbye citizen! }}

pages.title: Palimuth
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Palimuth | job = Profeta | city = Yalahar | subarea = Yalahar Centre | location = [[Yalahar Centre]] ({{mapa|32803,31223,7:5|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.4 | buysell = não | notes = Palimuth trabalha para os Yalahari ajudando nos serviços da cidade.

* Faz parte da [[In Service of Yalahar Quest]]. * Faz parte da [[Yalaharian Outfits Quest]].

| falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == Não possui. == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Palimuth''': Greetings. ''Jogador'': '''job''' / '''here'''
'''Palimuth''': I'm an Augur of the city of Yalahar. My special duty consists of coordinating the efforts to keep the city and its services running. ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Palimuth''': I'm Palimuth. Nice to meet you. ''Jogador'': '''efforts'''
'''Palimuth''': It is a somewhat futile mission but I won't give up. ''Jogador'': '''mission'''
'''Palimuth''': I'm afraid we have not seen the last chapter of Yalahar's drama but I don't have any more missions for you. ''Jogador'': '''vampire'''
'''Palimuth''': Yes, that is indeed a threat. Those raids, not knowing who to trust... unfortunately that matter lies not in my hands. ''Jogador'': '''addon'''
'''Palimuth''': There are no more addons available for you at this time. ''Jogador'': '''azerus'''
'''Palimuth''': Well, Azerus Vilus wasn't a high-ranking Yalahari in the past. Something must have happened which gained him so much power. ...
'''Palimuth''': Still, I can't imagine anybody that would entrust someone like Azerus with a position of power and responsibility. He was known as self-centred, greedy, and cruel towards his underlings. ...
'''Palimuth''': Not by chance people called him Azerus Vile behind his back. ''Jogador'': '''blood crystal'''
'''Palimuth''': What would you need a blood crystal for? Maybe a magician knows where to find one. ''Jogador'': '''cookies'''
'''Palimuth''': Uhm, no thanks. ''Jogador'': '''how are you'''
'''Palimuth''': I have to admit I'm a bit worried about the current state of our city. ''Jogador'': '''yalahar'''
'''Palimuth''': I'm a bit worried about our city's current state! ''Jogador'': '''yalahari'''
'''Palimuth''': The Yalahari are up to something strange and it does not bode well for the city of Yalahar! ''Jogador'': '''sunken quarter'''
'''Palimuth''': As if Yalahar had not already endured enough hardship, also nature seemed to have conspired to ruin the city. It was a great disaster when a large part of the city simply broke away. ''Jogador'': '''factory quarter'''
'''Palimuth''': The people there are rather desperate than evil. Still the quarter poses a danger, especially for strangers. ''Jogador'': '''foreign quarter'''
'''Palimuth''': Once, the Yalahari had the policy that their city is open for everyone who comes here in peace. Considering the situation in the foreign quarter today, they seem to have changed this policy. ...
'''Palimuth''': I can't blame them. Still, I wonder if there is no hope for a peaceful coexistence. ''Jogador'': '''trade quarter'''
'''Palimuth''': As annoying it might be for my superiors, the presence of Mr. West and his private army of bullies brings at least some sort of order for a great part of our townspeople. ''Jogador'': '''magician quarter'''
'''Palimuth''': The Yalahari seem to be quite interested in retaking this quarter. But all efforts ended in the loss of men, they could not even nearly replace. ''Jogador'': '''arena quarter'''
'''Palimuth''': We did little to retake the arena quarter. On the one hand, we lack the manpower, on the other hand, it turned into some sort of food resource for the city. ''Jogador'': '''alchemist quarter'''
'''Palimuth''': It's hard to tell what actually has happened there. ...
'''Palimuth''': According to the most prominent big bang theory, a devastating explosion laid waste most of the quarter and unleashed all kind of vile forces that made the quarter uninhabitable. ...
'''Palimuth''': Others claim that numerous experiments had gone wrong and that parts of the quarter had already been polluted. The great explosion was only a result of the previous disasters that had accumulated over time. ...
'''Palimuth''': This theory also claims that the explosion might actually have prevented the spreading of the plague to other parts of the city. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Palimuth''': Good bye, ''Jogador''. }}

pages.title: Peter
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Peter | job = Guarda | city = Yalahar | subarea = Yalahar Factory Quarter, Yalahar Trade Quarter | location = Entre o [[Yalahar Factory Quarter]] e o [[Yalahar Trade Quarter]] ({{mapa|32856,31302,7:1|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.4 | buysell = não | notes = Diga '''pass''' e o destino para atravessar o portão.

* Faz parte da [[In Service of Yalahar Quest]].

| falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == '''Peter''': I wish my shift would end. == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Peter''': Hello. Unless you have official business here or want to pass the gate, please move on. ''Jogador'': '''job''' / '''official'''
'''Peter''': Sergeant first class of the Yalaharian Guard Force. But I don't care about ranks and titles. ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Peter''': Peter. ''Jogador'': '''augur'''
'''Peter''': One day I will walk into the office of my superior and announce my resignment. Probably not long from now. ''Jogador'': '''mission'''
'''Peter''': Leave me alone with your 'mission' unless you have precise orders from my superiors. ''Jogador'': '''pass''' / '''gate'''
'''Peter''': Pass the gate? If it must be. Are you headed for the factory or the former trade quarter? :''Jogador'': '''factory'''
:'''Peter''': Be careful. Lots of wild and strange animals run around there. :''Jogador'': '''trade'''
:'''Peter''': Be on your guard. Some people are nice, some... aren't. ''Jogador'': '''quarter'''
'''Peter''': Count them yourself. ''Jogador'': '''yalahar'''
'''Peter''': You're here. So what? ''Jogador'': '''alchemist quarter'''
'''Peter''': There it's even more smelly than in the factory quarter. Smells a bit like rotten eggs. ''Jogador'': '''arena quarter'''
'''Peter''': You don't look as if you would last one second there. ''Jogador'': '''sunken quarter'''
'''Peter''': That quara brood should be extinguished. ''Jogador'': '''cemetery quarter'''
'''Peter''': Good idea. Go for a walk there. Preferably six feet down. ''Jogador'': '''factory quarter'''
'''Peter''': It's too noisy and smelly. ''Jogador'': '''foreign quarter'''
'''Peter''': Go there if you wanna get beaten up. ''Jogador'': '''magician quarter'''
'''Peter''': I can't stand those arrogant fools. ''Jogador'': '''trade quarter'''
'''Peter''': The leader of their pack is the biggest criminal among them all. ''Jogador'': '''''palavra aleatória'''''
'''Peter''': Listen, I don't get paid enough to chat with citizens. Move on. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Peter''': Goodbye citizen! }}

pages.title: Reed
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Reed | job = Guarda | city = Yalahar | subarea = Yalahar Cemetery Quarter, Yalahar Magician Quarter | location = Entre o [[Yalahar Cemetery Quarter]] e [[Yalahar Magician Quarter]] ({{mapa|32801,31104,7:1|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.4 | notes = Diga '''pass''' e o destino para ir através de seu portão.

* Parte da [[In Service of Yalahar Quest]].

| buysell = não | falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == '''Reed''': I wish my shift would end. == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Reed''': Hello. Unless you have official business here or want to pass the gate, please move on. ''Jogador'': '''job''' / '''official'''
'''Reed''': I'm a corporal of the Yalaharian Guard Force. ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Reed''': My name is Reed. ''Jogador'': '''augur'''
'''Reed''': I'm actually not allowed to talk about my superiors, but... something is fishy about them, too. ''Jogador'': '''mission'''
'''Reed''': Mission? I will not go on any mission for you. Or what do you want from me? ''Jogador'': '''pass''' / '''gate'''
'''Reed''': You want to pass the gate? Are you headed for the cemetery or the magician quarter? :''Jogador'': '''cemetery'''
:'''Reed''': Don't descend to any crypts, most importantly don't enter the large building. :''Jogador'': '''magician'''
:'''Reed''': Stay on the main road and don't go into any houses. That's my advice. ''Jogador'': '''quarter'''
'''Reed''': I really can't tell which quarter is the worst. ''Jogador'': '''yalahar'''
'''Reed''': This city contains so much evil that I fear one day it will explode and end up in chaos and darkness. ''Jogador'': '''island'''
'''Reed''': The outer islands are called Mistrock, Fenrock and Vengoth. ''Jogador'': '''mistrock'''
'''Reed''': I think some sinister and old force is hidden under all that mist. ''Jogador'': '''fenrock'''
'''Reed''': One day I went there and broke my arm by slipping on ice. ''Jogador'': '''vengoth'''
'''Reed''': I will never ever go there, and if I were sent there, I'd resign from the Guard Force. ''Jogador'': '''alchemist quarter'''
'''Reed''': If you stick your nose into that quarter, you will catch the disease and carry it with you for the rest of your life. I'm sure of that. ''Jogador'': '''arena quarter'''
'''Reed''': My little son was attacked by a mutated tiger in this quarter. He changed in a horrible way afterwards and I don't want to talk about it. ''Jogador'': '''sunken quarter'''
'''Reed''': It's a catastrophe. I used to live there and barely got away with my life when the quarter crashed into the ocean. ''Jogador'': '''cemetery quarter'''
'''Reed''': Nothing holy is coming out of this... strange church. At night the living dead come to me and cling to the iron bars. One day they will probably get me. ''Jogador'': '''factory quarter'''
'''Reed''': Did you see those giant... creatures walking in the factory quarter?? They could kill a human just by squeezing it between their claws! Arr! ''Jogador'': '''foreign quarter'''
'''Reed''': One day there will be a gigantic war between all the races in this quarter and it will devour the city. ''Jogador'': '''magician quarter'''
'''Reed''': Can you imagine how it feels for me to keep guard so close to all those insane mages, cultists and demonic creatures? Can you?! No, of course you can't! ''Jogador'': '''trade quarter'''
'''Reed''': I think Mr. West is planning to take over the whole city, if it hasn't been destroyed by war, contamination, monsters or greater evil by then. ''Jogador'': '''''palavra aleatória'''''
'''Reed''': It's nice talking to you, but honestly, you give me the creeps. So please decide what you want and move on. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Reed''': Goodbye citizen! }}

pages.title: Tamerin
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Tamerin | job = Mage | city = Yalahar | subarea = Yalahar Arena Quarter | location = [[Yalahar Arena Quarter]] ({{mapa|32659,31212,8:9|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.4 | buysell = não | buys = Nada | sells = Nada | notes = Ele é um criador. Ele é muito qualificado em um tipo especial de mágica para alterar animais que tenha capturado o interesse de Yalahari.

* Faz parte da [[In Service of Yalahar Quest]].

| falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == '''Tamerin''': Come here, kitty, kitty! == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Tamerin''': Hello, what brings you here? ''Jogador'': '''job''' / '''here'''
'''Tamerin''': I'm a humble druid, tending the animals. ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Tamerin''': I'm known as Tamerin. ''Jogador'': '''animal'''
'''Tamerin''': Animals don't lie and know no cruelty. ''Jogador'': '''yalahar'''
'''Tamerin''': The city is in its death throes. ''Jogador'': '''yalahari'''
'''Tamerin''': I'm not interested in city politics. ''Jogador'': '''time'''
'''Tamerin''': I have no use for a watch. ''Jogador'': '''gladiator'''
'''Tamerin''': Gladiators are merciless killers. ''Jogador'': '''arena'''
'''Tamerin''': It was an atrocity, and it's a good thing that it doesn't exist any longer. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Tamerin''': Good bye! }}

pages.title: Tarak
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Tarak | job = Balseiro | city = Yalahar | subarea = Yalahar Sunken Quarter | location = [[Yalahar Sunken Quarter]]: * Yalahar ({{mapa|32917,31199,7:2|aqui}}) * Monument Tower ({{mapa|32940,31182,7:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.4 | buysell = não | notes = * Ele pode te levar até a entrada da [[Yalahar Sunken Quarter]], conhecida como '''Monument Tower''', por 50 [[gp]] (por viagem). * Após o patch de 10 de março de 2026, passou a transportar também jogadores [[Free Account]]. | falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == '''Tarak''': Boat trips to the monument tower!
'''Tarak''': Listen to my story about the sunken quarter!
'''Tarak''': Want to explore the sunken quarter of Yalahar? I'm your man! == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Tarak''': Hi, ''Jogador''. Can I interest you in a trip to the monument tower? ''Jogador'': '''job'''
'''Tarak''': Well, actually I'm unemployed. But I make a little money by bringing tourists to the monument tower. ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Tarak''': I'm Tarak. I may look like a beggar, but I'd never ask for free stuff - I work for my money! At your service. ''Jogador'': '''monument tower'''
'''Tarak''': This tower is the most intact remaining part of the sunken quarter of Yalahar. From there, you can dive down to the sunken city. Want to travel there, just ask me for a passage. ''Jogador'': '''trip''' / '''destination''' / '''route''' / '''go''' / '''passage''' / '''sail'''
'''Tarak''': I can row you to the monument tower for 50 gold. Return trip included! You can only dive down with a helmet of the deep, though. Wanna go? ''Jogador'': '''sailor'''
'''Tarak''': No, I wouldn't consider myself a true sailor. But I know enough to bring you to the tower and back again safely. ''Jogador'': '''sunken quarter'''
'''Tarak''': Now that's some story. I've told it numerous times to tourists - , I mean, adventurers - but it still makes me shiver each time. ...
'''Tarak''': As you might have already noticed, Yalahar is huge. HUGE. The city has grown so much over the past centuries that eventually there was no space left for new buildings. ...
'''Tarak''': However, due to the constant flow of immigrants, the citizens just kept on building and building - either placing buildings on top of each other or trying to enhance the space with platforms on the water. ...
'''Tarak''': Then, a few decades ago, there was a day which I still remember vividly, because I was right in the middle of the whole disaster happening. ...
'''Tarak''': I just came back from the centre and was on the way to my house located in the east quarter - today situated several feet below us under the ocean surface. ...
'''Tarak''': Suddenly the earth was shaking and I heard a loud rumbling. I was still wondering what on earth was going on, or if we were under attack, when I saw the houses closest to the ocean collapse. ...
'''Tarak''': Just like that! The ground under them broke away and fell into the ocean, and then - imagine that - like a wave of destruction, terror rushed through the whole quarter. ...
'''Tarak''': I heard people screaming and more houses tumbling down, and immediately I rushed back to the centre, behind the solid city walls - even though they didn't seem so solid at that time, but it was the safest place I could get to. ...
'''Tarak''': From there I had to helplessly watch how the whole quarter fell apart. Large chunks of stone and earth collapsed into the ocean, and with them all of my belongings. ...
'''Tarak''': When the wave of destruction reached the wall separating the quarter from the other parts of the city, that wall also sunk into the ocean and must have worked as a barrier down there. ...
'''Tarak''': You can still see the top of the old wall sticking out of the water. After that last collapse, the destruction stopped all of a sudden. ...
'''Tarak''': Only a few people, among them myself as you can see, were able to survive the great downfall. The rest was buried under their houses, or drowned in the ocean. Such cruel fate... ...
'''Tarak''': Well, it took a while for me to recover from that incident, and afterwards I decided to show to adventurers what can happen when you foolishly overestimate your power. So let that be a lesson to you. ...
'''Tarak''': Now, it's up to you if you want to dive down to the remains of the sunken part of Yalahar. You need a Helmet of the Deep, though. And beware, quara have infested the area. ...
'''Tarak''': Maybe they were also involved into the great downfall. We will never know for sure, but I truly hope an incident like that won't repeat itself in Yalahar. ''Jogador'': '''tourist'''
'''Tarak''': Well, a nicer expression would be 'adventurers' I guess. ''Jogador'': '''adventurer'''
'''Tarak''': You know, the people back in the old days, those were real adventurers. ''Jogador'': '''time'''
'''Tarak''': My watch was stolen, unfortunately. ''Jogador'': '''yalahar'''
'''Tarak''': How strange a city you are... Yalahar. I guess I'll make a song out of that someday. I'm quite a talented musician, you know! ''Jogador'': '''king'''
'''Tarak''': Oh yes, I saw the king once, when I was still a youngster living in Thais. I think the nobles don't care about the common people. ''Jogador'': '''ab'dendriel'''
'''Tarak''': I've lived there for a short time before moving on to Yalahar. I never really got along with the elves, though. Can't stand people who think they are better than me. ''Jogador'': '''carlin'''
'''Tarak''': Carlin isn't as bad as people say, as long as you bring your own alcohol and can handle the women there. ''Jogador'': '''venore'''
'''Tarak''': I guess it would be hard to earn money there as a ferryman - the swamp is not passable by boat. ''Jogador'': '''thais'''
'''Tarak''': I grew up there, so I still have pleasant memories of it. ''Jogador'': '''edron'''
'''Tarak''': Edron is actually close by here. One day, I'll row there with my own hands. That's my goal. ''Jogador'': '''port hope'''
'''Tarak''': I know some people down there. Old Adall used to be a close friend of mine, but we lost contact over the years. Don't know if he even remembers me. ''Jogador'': '''ankrahmun'''
'''Tarak''': One day, I'd like to see the pyramids. The real, big pyramids I mean, not the small one we have in Yalahar. ''Jogador'': '''darashia'''
'''Tarak''': I've never been there, and to be honest, I'm not planning to. Nothing exciting about it. ''Jogador'': '''kazordoon'''
'''Tarak''': I like the dwarfs. They usually don't talk much, but still they are great drinking companions. ''Jogador'': '''svargrond'''
'''Tarak''': Yes, the barbarian settlement west of here. I went there once, but honestly, my old bones can't stand the cold. ''Jogador'': '''vengoth'''
'''Tarak''': Vengoth?? No, heck, I don't go near that cursed island. Maybe someone in the south quarters is brave enough, they have boats too, you know. ''Jogador'': '''ferumbras'''
'''Tarak''': Those stories don't scare me. Ferumbras' tower is said to be on an island to the far south-west. That's far away enough for me. ''Jogador'': '''tibia'''
'''Tarak''': Over the years, I've seen many things happening in Tibia, especially a lot of bad stuff. Somehow I managed not to get disillusioned, though, just seasoned. ''Jogador'': '''liberty bay'''
'''Tarak''': An old love of mine used to live there. I wonder how she's doing today. ''Jogador'': '''charlotta'''
'''Tarak''': Yes, in fact that's the name of my old love. You must be a good guesser. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Tarak''': Bye, ''Jogador''. Come back whenever you want to see the monument tower. }}

pages.title: Timothy
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Timothy | job = Representante da Explorer Society | city = Yalahar | subarea = Yalahar Centre | location = [[Yalahar Centre]] ({{mapa|32788,31227,7:1|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.4 | buysell = não | notes = Nenhuma.

* Faz parte da [[In Service of Yalahar Quest]].

| falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == '''Timothy''': So many discoveries to be made .. I hardly know where to start. == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Timothy''': Oh, hello! It's a pleasure to see a visitor from the continent. ''Jogador'': '''job''' / '''visitor'''
'''Timothy''': I work for the explorer's society as an information gatherer here in this newly discovered city. ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Timothy''': I'm Timothy of the explorer's society. ''Jogador'': '''society'''
'''Timothy''': As we are interested in many fields, it's no wonder that we are here. There are so many marvels to observe and so many things to discover. ...
'''Timothy''': It will take a lifetime to compile all that knowledge. If you are interested, you can assist me in this matter. ''Jogador'': '''assist'''
'''Timothy''': If you stumble upon an artefact from Yalahar's past, I'd certainly be interested in buying it from you. ...
'''Timothy''': These artefacts come in different shapes and sizes, but I'm sure you will recognise their importance. ''Jogador'': '''artefact'''
'''Timothy''': Do you have a real Yalahari artefact with you? :''Jogador'': '''no'''
:'''Timothy''': Oh, too bad. :''Jogador'': '''yes''' ''(se o jogador não possuir os itens)''
:'''Timothy''': Uhm, no sorry, whatever you think you have found, it is not a Yalahari artefact. ''Jogador'': '''city''' / '''yalahar'''
'''Timothy''': The city is still a marvel to behold. I can only slightly imagine how it must have looked in its prime. ...
'''Timothy''': It's a shame that all its glory vanished through the centuries. ''Jogador'': '''palimuth'''
'''Timothy''': He works as an Augur - a high ranking official of the city. He's responsible for assigning all available helpers to different tasks. ...
'''Timothy''': An ungrateful job considering what kind of helpers are at his disposal. There are many problems and the number of the hired helpers is small. ''Jogador'': '''cookies'''
'''Timothy''': Look, my friend, I'm only interested in ancient artefacts. Ancient cookies are not what I'm looking for. ''Jogador'': '''vampire'''
'''Timothy''': I've just started to research why the vampires attack Yalahar, but unfortunately I've not gotten very far yet. ''Jogador'': '''mission'''
'''Timothy''': Oh, didn't I mention it? A friend of mine, a local officer named Palimuth, needs some assistance. Maybe you are interested in this job! ''Jogador'': '''blood crystal'''
'''Timothy''': Oh yes, I heard about a gem like that. Nowadays they seem incredibly hard to acquire. The explorer's society doesn't own one, else I'd help you. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Timothy''': Good bye. }}

pages.title: Tony
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Tony | city = Yalahar | subarea = Yalahar Arena Quarter, Yalahar Foreigner Quarter | location = Entre a [[Yalahar Arena Quarter]] e o [[Yalahar Foreigner Quarter]] ({{mapa|32695,31256,7:1|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.4 | job = Guarda | notes = Diga '''pass''' e o destino para atravessar o portão.

* Faz parte da [[In Service of Yalahar Quest]].

| buysell = não | falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == '''Tony''': Please move on, nothing to see here. == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Tony''': Hello. Unless you have official business here or want to pass the gate, please move on. ''Jogador'': '''job''' / '''official'''
'''Tony''': Uhm, private first class of the Yalaharian Guard Force. ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Tony''': I'm Tony. ''Jogador'': '''augur'''
'''Tony''': They are also our superiors... but lower in rank than the Yalahari. ''Jogador'': '''mission'''
'''Tony''': Mission? Eh? I don't know anything about any mission. What do you want from me? ''Jogador'': '''pass''' / '''gate'''
'''Tony''': Uh, you want to pass the gate? Are you headed for the arena or the foreign quarter? :''Jogador'': '''arena'''
:'''Tony''': Be careful. Lots of wild and strange animals run around there. :''Jogador'': '''foreign'''
:'''Tony''': Be on your guard. Some people are nice, some... aren't. ''Jogador'': '''quarter'''
'''Tony''': Uhm, there are many quarters. I think... about eight. My duty is to guard the gate between the arena quarter and the... err... foreign quarter. ''Jogador'': '''yalahar'''
'''Tony''': This city has a lot of problems... ... and a few surrounding islands. ''Jogador'': '''island'''
'''Tony''': This city has a few surrounding islands... but no official ship route is going there. Mistrock... Fenrock... and err... Vengoth, as far as I know. ''Jogador'': '''mistrock'''
'''Tony''': That island is covered in mist. I've never been there. Someone in the foreign quarter told me something about it once... but I forgot what he said. ''Jogador'': '''fenrock'''
'''Tony''': I heard there's some snow there... I would love to go there some day. ''Jogador'': '''vengoth'''
'''Tony''': There are really bad rumours about this place. I don't want to find out if they are true. ''Jogador'': '''alchemist quarter'''
'''Tony''': Uhm... I'm glad I don't have to guard the gate between alchemist quarter and arena quarter. You know... all that acid and fume... can't be healthy. ''Jogador'': '''arena quarter'''
'''Tony''': That side of the gate can be a little scary... all those animal roaring at night... and the gladiators can be even worse. ''Jogador'': '''sunken quarter'''
'''Tony''': Mh... a really tragic story... a whole quarter of the city broke down and fell into the ocean. ''Jogador'': '''cemetery quarter'''
'''Tony''': Now that's spooky... undead roaming around at nighttime and sometimes even at daytime... I don't set a foot there if I don't have to. ''Jogador'': '''factory quarter'''
'''Tony''': Err... I have a rust allergy. It makes my nose tickle to go there. ''Jogador'': '''foreign quarter'''
'''Tony''': I think some people there are not bad at all. Sometimes they visit me at the gate and ask me how I am. ''Jogador'': '''magician quarter'''
'''Tony''': I don't like going there... and I think magicians consider themselves so wise and educated that they look down on normal people like you and me. ''Jogador'': '''trade quarter'''
'''Tony''': The former trade quarter is under the wing of Mr. West. He can be intimidating... ''Jogador'': '''''palavra aleatória'''''
'''Tony''': Sorry... but uhm... please move on, I actually shouldn't chat with you. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Tony''': Goodbye citizen! }}

pages.title: Yalahari (NPC)
pages.wikitext:
{{DASH|img=desambig|Este artigo se refere ao '''NPC''' Yalahari. Se esta não for a que você procura, veja: [[Yalahari|Yalahari (Desambiguação)]].}}{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Yalahari (NPC) | job = Roleplay | city = Yalahar | subarea = Yalahar Centre | location = [[Yalahar Centre]] ({{mapa|32801,31188,7:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.4 | buysell = não | notes = O governante de Yalahar, acompanhado de um [[Servant Golem]] e guardado por dois [[Golem Guardian]]s.

* Faz parte da [[In Service of Yalahar Quest]]. * Esse posto é primeiramente ocupado por Azerus Vilus, um dos verdadeiros Yalaharis que retornou. Após a sua morte, o posto fica para Tirak.

| falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == Não possui. == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Yalahari''': Greetings. ----- === Antes de finalizar as missões === ''Jogador'': '''job''' / '''disturb'''
'''Yalahari''': I'm a member of the Yalahar. I'm obliged to assist our helpers in their efforts to improve the life within our city. So from time to time I assign a mission to our helpers. ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Yalahari''': My Name is Azerus. ''Jogador'': '''how are you?'''
'''Yalahari''': I'm fine, thank you. ''Jogador'': '''blood crystal'''
'''Yalahari''': You shouldn't bother about such things. ''Jogador'': '''quest''' / '''task'''
'''Yalahari''': Since you have proven yourself as worthy, there might be more important missions to accomplish if you are interested. ''Jogador'': '''vampire'''
'''Yalahari''': I don't care about them. They are outside these walls. ''Jogador'': '''cookie'''
'''Yalahari''': There are more important matters to take care of. ''Jogador'': '''palimuth'''
'''Yalahari''': His lack of a vision for the city is typical for our helpers. Sadly all the responsibilities still rest solemnly on the shoulders of us - the Yalahari. ''Jogador'': '''yalahar'''
'''Yalahari''': Soon enough our city will once again become a beacon of hope! ''Jogador'': '''yalahari'''
'''Yalahari''': We are the masters of this city and see ourselves as benevolent caretakers of our citizens! ''Jogador'': '''foreign quarter'''
'''Yalahari''': We welcomed many foreigners to our city to share in our wealth. They did not value our generosity. Instead they introduced their own barbaric ways here. ...
'''Yalahari''': It was only a question of time until they waged war against each others and the city's officials. The only thing those creatures respect is power. ...
'''Yalahari''': In time, we will regain our power and get them back into line. ''Jogador'': '''arena quarter'''
'''Yalahari''': With only a little more authority, those gladiators had never dared to affront us. It is only a matter of time until we re-establish the power needed to enforce law and order in this quarter once again. ''Jogador'': '''alchemist quarter'''
'''Yalahari''': A shroud of pestilence and decay lies over this quarter. It is one of the major failures of the past to let that quarter deteriorate so badly. ''Jogador'': '''magician quarter'''
'''Yalahari''': This quarter is a good example for the failure of the policy to allow people to mind their own business. What should have become a centre of knowledge and learning, became a cauldron of chaos. ...
'''Yalahari''': Even now that several catastrophes have destroyed the quarter and the order there, scheming magicians plot to gain power at the expense of the city. ''Jogador'': '''sunken quarter'''
'''Yalahari''': We have to consider this quarter as lost. There is no hope left that it could be rebuilt in some way. ...
'''Yalahari''': On the peak of our power, we, the Yalahari, would have been able to re-establish this quarter. But much work has to be done until we ever reach such power again. ''Jogador'': '''factory quarter'''
'''Yalahari''': Most of the factories are no longer functional, and the unruly people living there don't make it easier to retake and repair them. ...
'''Yalahari''': As soon as the order has been restored in other parts of the city, we will be able to spent more resources in the rebuilding of the factories. ''Jogador'': '''trade quarter'''
'''Yalahari''': It is an affront to our authority that someone claims dominance over one of our territories. If we allowed such a behaviour, others would follow. It would not take long until we had to deal with several petty kings that question our might. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Yalahari''': Good bye, ''Jogador''. ----- === Após finalizar todas as missões === ''Jogador'': '''name''' ''(após concluir todas as missões)''
'''Yalahari''': I'm Tirak, the replacement of the recently vanished Azerus ''Jogador'': '''''palavra aleatória'''''
'''Yalahari''': I'm quite busy getting accustomed to my new duties, so please excuse me. }}

| notes       = Znozel é o dono do banco em [[Yalahar]]. Ele troca [[Gold Coin]]s, [[Platinum Coin]]s e [[Crystal Coin]]s. Você pode depositar, sacar, e transferir dinheiro, como também ver o saldo de sua conta.
| falas       = __NOTOC__
== Frases Espontâneas ==
'''Znozel''': Me take all gold! Good care! Give! Give!

== Palavras-Chave ==
''Jogador'': '''hi'''</br>
'''Znozel''': Hi there. Welcome to me gold storage called bank.

''Jogador'': '''name'''</br>
'''Znozel''': Me Znozel the great goblin banker!

''Jogador'': '''job'''</br>
'''Znozel''': Me great good banker! Me smart and honey .. no wait I mean horrible .. no, no honest I am! Yes, yes! Money give, give to honest goblin! Uhhh so shiny coins!

''Jogador'': '''vampire'''</br>
'''Znozel''': Where? WHERE?! HELP! Protect my gold!

''Jogador'': '''yalahari'''</br>
'''Znozel''': Taxes, taxes! Always government is harassing harmless little goblins!

''Jogador'': '''blood crystal'''</br>
'''Znozel''': Oooooooooh shiny shiny shiny shiny!! Give me!!

''Jogador'': '''cookie'''</br>
'''Znozel''': Me only take cookie if it's golden. Ehehehe.

''Jogador'': '''goblin'''</br>
'''Znozel''': Goblins not bankers usually. But great love everything shiny. Yes. Yes.

''Jogador'': '''bank'''</br>
'''Znozel''': Me do good job! Me honest goblin for sure! Me that honest other goblin call me mad! Imagine!

''Jogador'': '''bored'''</br>
'''Znozel''': Okay okay, no need to be rude! It seems you are already know everything.

''Jogador'': '''dragon'''</br>
'''Znozel''': Banker rule number one: Dragons are always served first!

''Jogador'': '''money'''</br>
'''Znozel''': Just give good goblin all your money. Me making us both rich. Trust! Trust!

''Jogador'': '''buy''' / '''sell''' / '''offer''' / '''do you have'''</br>
'''Znozel''': We can change money for you. You can also access your bank account or your guild account options.

''Jogador'': '''yalahar'''</br>
'''Znozel''': Me came here to plunder. Old banker hired me. When dragon eats banker for must waiting in line I taking over everything!

''Jogador'': '''alchemist quarter'''</br>
'''Znozel''': It gone BOOOM! Yes, yes! No good going there.

''Jogador'': '''arena quarter'''</br>
'''Znozel''': Big humans there are mean. Big beasts even worse!

''Jogador'': '''foreign quarter'''</br>
'''Znozel''': Others there only bully little goblins around.

''Jogador'': '''sunken quarter'''</br>
'''Znozel''': Me did not break it! Honest! Was broke as I came!

''Jogador'': '''magician quarter'''</br>
'''Znozel''': Spooky guys are not good for business.

''Jogador'': '''factory quarter'''</br>
'''Znozel''': Many humans there. Seldom come here to trade.

''Jogador'': '''trade quarter'''</br>
'''Znozel''': This West human not too bad is. He great trader, strong chieftain.

''Jogador'': '''bye'''</br>
'''Znozel''': Bye, bye. You gold safe at here, ''Jogador''. <snickers>!
}}

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Awareness of the Emperor | job = Imperador | npcclass = Mortos-Vivos | npcsprite = Undead Dragon | city = Zao | subarea = Razachai | location = [[Razachai]] ({{mapa|33063,31153,15:2|aqui}}). | buysell = não | sells = | implemented = 8.6 | notes =

* Faz parte da [[Wrath of the Emperor Quest]].

| falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Catastrophe'''
[[Awareness of the Emperor]]: I have to admit I figured out quite late what is happening. It seems we are both involved in a scheme of it who is known as the '''snake god''' rising to power. A process that could mean the end of the world as you know it. ''Jogador:'' '''Snake God'''
[[Awareness of the Emperor]]: I don't know what it is or was. But I heard that this thing tried to become a god in the past and was trapped in a state 'in between'. Its current plan seems to be to use my crystal matrix which I use to amplify my control over the dragon kings in a reverse way to '''steal''' the vital force of the '''dragons''', those bound to them, and even from the land itself. ''Jogador:'' '''Steal'''
[[Awareness of the Emperor]]: With this stolen power it hopes to become a true god. This would destroy the continent. Not only the continent's life would be drained, it would also damage its integrity and stability. The whole land would crumble and vanish in the sea. Such a destruction would probably lead to earthquakes and floods everywhere in the world, causing death and destruction beyond compare. And all this only because you fools let yourselves use by that '''priest''' just like he is used by his so-called god. ''Jogador:'' '''Dragons'''
[[Awareness of the Emperor]]: We came here from a distant land that is no longer. We took it upon us to become the rulers of this land. We brought order to the struggles and saved a dying empire. We deserve no less than to be accepted as leaders by the lesser beings. We allowed the lizards to exist and to serve us. ''Jogador:'' '''Priest'''
[[Awareness of the Emperor]]: He is just a willing vessel. He seems to serve as some sort of anchor or even avatar for the snake's power. Fortunately, his body is too weak to channel much of the snake's power. He might become a formidable opponent but he will still be mortal. With a '''sizeable force''' of capable opponents he can be brought down. ''Jogador:'' '''Sizeable Force'''
[[Awareness of the Emperor]]: Indeed, this will be your mission though. Since you cut off the way to control the dragon kings easily, I'll have to put some effort into holding them at bay. Another part of me tries to repair the damage you have caused, and yet another will try to interrupt the flow of power which this snake thing sends to its priest. ''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
[[Awareness of the Emperor]]: I am the emperor of Zao. Power and destiny made me the ruler over dragons and lizards. ''Jogador:'' '''Lizards'''
[[Awareness of the Emperor]]: They are more familiar to us than the brutish and stupid orcs. In their best moments they are even amusing. All they need is guidance, otherwise they are lost and helpless. ''Jogador:'' '''Orcs'''
[[Awareness of the Emperor]]: They are barely sentient at all. A despicable race beyond all hope. The minotaurs think they have them under control but it is only a matter of time before the orcs will crush them and revert to their old ways. ''Jogador:'' '''Minotaurs'''
[[Awareness of the Emperor]]: They were nearly extinct when we arrived. I understand that the minotaurs that pose a problem to us in these days are foreigners in this land. They think they can tame the orcs which I think is such an amusing assumption that I restrained myself from crushing them. I want to watch how they fall flat with this folly. They will fail in the end. It's only a question of how and when. ''Jogador:'' '''Humans'''
[[Awareness of the Emperor]]: You are different than the humans here. The humans here are not better than the animals of the mountains and the steppes. You people on the other hand ... well, you might prove a worthy challenge one day. But first and foremost there are other '''issues''' to attend which will take a few centuries. Only then I might take a look at your land if I am still interested. ''Jogador:'' '''Issues'''
[[Awareness of the Emperor]]: Once the trouble with this mad lizard priest is settled, I have to deal with the problem of the spreading corruption. I am sure I will find a suitable solution. Then the empire has to be restructured and the south to be retaken. After that a phase of rebuilding will begin. The empire lacks manpower and due to the corruption and the loss of land it lacks resources, this is certainly something that needs to be dealt with. ''Jogador:'' '''Corruption'''
[[Awareness of the Emperor]]: Even we dragons were not unified. We ... continued certain old habits that led to fights which in turn led to inevitable, irreplaceable losses. So by my power I bound the others to my will. Being the eldest and even more powerful than even most of my lesser brethren can imagine, it was my right to do so. In return I taught them to bind the lesser lizards to their will and so we '''reforged''' the empire. ''Jogador:'' '''Reforged'''
[[Awareness of the Emperor]]: I foresaw that with my ultimate demise the infighting would resume and destroy all what is left of us. So I decided that I was too important to die. My time was limited though and the only means of survival that I could come up with was to transform me into a lich, a creature of undeath. It was an ... unexpected experience. However, soon I learnt about the changes my new '''state''' of existence involved and the way how things work. ''Jogador:'' '''State'''
[[Awareness of the Emperor]]: Through my connection to the other dragons, my '''undeath''' spread in an unexpected way. And it did not stop at the dragons. It went on through them to the lizards they had bound and through them to the land itself. It seems the land itself became the place where the undeathly influence was finally dumped as it suffered much more than the beings that functioned as transmitters. However, you see that what you call corruption is only an unwanted by-product of something far greater and more important. ''Jogador:'' '''Undeath'''
[[Awareness of the Emperor]]: It is certainly no ideal state but a necessity. I take it upon me for the sake of the land. Without me my people would perish and so would the civilisation of the lizards. Or worse, they would continue to worship that unspeakable snake thing that is willing to devour the whole world to become a god. ''Jogador:'' '''Resistance'''
[[Awareness of the Emperor]]: Those fools are misled by the snake god and its treacherous priests. If it weren't for us dragons, the lizards had perished long ago. It was our power that crushed their enemies and our guidance that ended centuries of intrigue and infighting. We deserve their respect and '''loyalty'''. They owe us these things like they owe us their existence. ''Jogador:'' '''Loyalty'''
[[Awareness of the Emperor]]: They owe us their existence. Without us their empire would crumble. We are their only hope and the only hope of '''stability''' for this land. ''Jogador:'' '''Stability'''
[[Awareness of the Emperor]]: If the lizard empire crushed, the orcs would turn on each other and sooner or later wipe out the minotaurs and humans. Then the land would lapse into bloodshed and barbarism. We are the only source of order in this land and the only ones who have the power to enforce such an order. ''Jogador:'' '''Crystal'''
[[Awareness of the Emperor]]: The tainted crystals work reversely to their actual intention. It will take a while to reconfigure them. One part of my consciousness is already working on this problem. |}} [[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.wikitext:
{{Event}}{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Smaralda | job = Cartomante | city = Thais | subarea = Thais | location = [[Thais]] ({{Mapa|32231,32295,7:1|aqui}}). | implemented = 8.7 | notes =

* Faz parte da World Quest [[A Pirate's Death to Me]].

| buysell = sim | buys = Nada. | sells = {{Trades/Sell | Scum Bag}} | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''hi'''
[[Smaralda]]: Welcome ''Jogador''! Let us talk about '''fate'''.
''Jogador:'' '''fate'''
[[Smaralda]]: Fate is a road that we all travel but rarely notice. Long ago I have bound my fate to that of a '''pirate''' whose name can't be spoken anymore. ...
[[Smaralda]]: I try to ease his gruesome fate with my abilities.
''Jogador:'' '''pirate'''
[[Smaralda]]: The good old captain was never one of the evil bandits of the seas but a gentleman robber who actually fought for freedom and against slavery. ...
[[Smaralda]]: Of all the things, good or bad he did in his life, the most fateful was a promise he made to his people to bring back a holy icon that other pirates had robbed while he was away. ...
[[Smaralda]]: He tracked the icon to the '''Mourning''' '''Isles''' but there he met his cruel fate and died without fulfilling his promise.
''Jogador:'' '''mourning isles'''
[[Smaralda]]: These isles seemed to be cursed by the gods even before the first living beings arrived there. Since then they've had a history of pain, treachery and desolation. But the lure of its treasures is still strong. ...
[[Smaralda]]: Many would try to brave the undead inhabitants of the isles to rob them of their treasure but there is no '''ship''' of the living that can still reach the isles.
''Jogador:'' '''ship'''
[[Smaralda]]: No ordinary ship can hope to reach the legendary '''Mourning Isles'''. But there is one ship that could do it! It is the ship of the old '''pirate'''. ...
[[Smaralda]]: In these days he is looking for a crew of mortals to help him end his self-imposed '''curse'''.
''Jogador:'' '''curse'''
[[Smaralda]]: The old pirate made a promise to return an icon from the Mourning Isles. A promise he could not fulfil. ...
[[Smaralda]]: Again and again he is looking for helpers that will allow him to summon his ship to this world and reach these cursed isles to finally find that icon. ...
[[Smaralda]]: You might be able to help him, but only after my '''soul seeing''' reveals which spirit mark will govern your life for the next cycle. ...
[[Smaralda]]: Even then you will have to find three others with the same '''spirit''' mark bound to them to provide the pirate with a strong and capable crew.
''Jogador:'' '''soul seeing'''
[[Smaralda]]: You are marked by the "'''Seu Espiríto'''".
''Jogador:'' '''spirit'''
[[Smaralda]]: There are spirits all around us. Some are close to the world of the living, some are far away. Some of them sympathize with our trials and sense some kind of familiarity to us. ...
[[Smaralda]]: These spirits attach themselves to us for a period of time when they feel that our fate corresponds with certain aspects of their own. I learned how to visualise those spirits and therefore can say a bit about the future that might await you. ...
[[Smaralda]]: Even more, I connected those spirits to a certain symbolism to make the concept more accessible. I learned that people that share the same symbols are somehow connected by fate. ...
[[Smaralda]]: We can use this fact to help the captain to find his crew. He needs people who are connected to each other to help him in his quest.
''Jogador:'' '''name'''
[[Smaralda]]: I am only known as Smaralda in these days.
''Jogador:'' '''job'''
[[Smaralda]]: My endeavours of the past are unimportant. I'm nothing but an old woman that sometimes dabbles with the mystic arts. ...
[[Smaralda]]: Now I'm just a '''fortuneteller''' and sometimes a helper of '''fate'''. And I know a few '''old stories'''.
''Jogador:'' '''fortuneteller'''
[[Smaralda]]: I rarely use my gift in these days. I use it only to help the old '''pirate''' to find the rest that he deserves by finding a crew for his '''ship'''.
''Jogador:'' '''old stories'''
[[Smaralda]]: Of all stories that I could tell, there is only one that is of importance in these days. This is the story about the old '''pirate'''.
''Jogador:'' '''join''' ''(Para iniciar a world quest [[A Pirate's Death to Me]])''
[[Smaralda]]: Now that you have captured enough of the spectral scum you may use my crystal ball to meet the captain. ...
[[Smaralda]]: But keep in mind that you need three others with the same soul mark to proceed.
''Jogador:'' '''journey''' ''(Para verificar quantas jornadas já foram concluídas no seu servidor)''
[[Smaralda]]: This world was successful in ''xx'' journeys. 50 journeys are necessary to give the captain some peace for this month.
''Jogador:'' '''bye'''
[[Smaralda]]: Good bye, ''Jogador''.
}}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]
