pages.title: Spirit Speaker
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Spirit Speaker | job = Roleplay | city = Venore | subarea = Venore City | location = [[Venore City]] ({{mapa|32878,32111,7:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 10.1 | notes = Ele pode lhe contar algumas historias interessantes. Este NPC foi criado pelo jogador {{Character|Hashiru}} no concurso [http://www.tibia.com/news/?subtopic=newsarchive&id=2413 "Create Your Own NPC!"]. | buysell = não | buys = | sells = | falas = ''Jogador'': '''hi '''
[[Spirit Speaker]]: Can you '''''hear''''' that...!? Oh, hello there. Have you come seeking '''''wisdom'''''...? A '''''story''''' perhaps?
''Jogador'': '''hear '''
[[Spirit Speaker]]: Yes.. nature speaks, this whole continent has a voice and it screams for help when changes are about to happen, it senses danger and warns us of evil presences and changes of the world. ...
[[Spirit Speaker]]: This land is alive and every event we participate in has an impact on its people and on the environment. ...
[[Spirit Speaker]]: So be ready and aid the world in its time of need. You may be greatly rewarded.
''Jogador'': '''wisdom '''
[[Spirit Speaker]]: WISDOM! Such a desirable thing, isn't it? You have come to the right place, I have much knowledge to share about the world you live in, more than you could ever imagine. ...
[[Spirit Speaker]]: But not everyone was born to possess great wisdom, especially when they intend to use it as a tool of destruction. Like Ferumbras for example, who used his immense power to call upon great demons to lay '''''havoc''''' on the city of Thais.
''Jogador'': '''story '''
[[Spirit Speaker]]: The sword is known as the Sword of Fury. Is the '''''legend''''' true? Who knows.
''Jogador'': '''havoc '''
[[Spirit Speaker]]: Many have tried to wreak havoc and destruction on various cities over the years. In days past our cities were raided by hordes of orcs, but they were defeated in their attempts to conquer our capital cities by the brave adventurers of those times. ...
[[Spirit Speaker]]: They carried with them strong unique sets of armor, specifically crafted for that war. ...
[[Spirit Speaker]]: They were recovered by the warriors who defeated them; but those ancient pieces of armor are rarely seen these days.
''Jogador'': '''legend '''
[[Spirit Speaker]]: Ahh so you like legends, do you? Here's another one. It is said that the ancient pharaohs who ruled Ankrahmun in days long past, were mummified and buried with their most precious belongings in tombs beneath the sands of the desert. ...
[[Spirit Speaker]]: It is also said that they were buried with the pieces of an ancient magical helmet of great power. Legend holds that the pharaohs will not part from their '''''treasures''''' easily... even after death.
''Jogador'': '''treasures '''
[[Spirit Speaker]]: There are many treasures out there for adventurers like you to claim, child. If you are brave enough to descend into hell itself! ...
[[Spirit Speaker]]: There are many tasks around the world for experienced adventurers like you on the journey to the very Pits of Inferno! But beware! You never know what '''''horrors''''' stand between you and your desires.
''Jogador'': '''horrors '''
[[Spirit Speaker]]: Do you want to know what horror is, young adventurer? Horror has a name in these lands... actually, seven names. ...
[[Spirit Speaker]]: Apocalypse, Ashfalor, Bazir, Infernatil, Pumin, Tafariel and Verminor. The Ruthless Seven, seven archdemons under the command of a '''''god'''''.
''Jogador'': '''god '''
[[Spirit Speaker]]: Zathroth is the god that controls the Ruthless Seven and he is the God of Destruction, #N. He is the evil half of one of the elder god. The other half is Uman the Wise. ...
[[Spirit Speaker]]: Together they are one. Interesting, isn't it? Thought so.
''Jogador'': '''name '''
[[Spirit Speaker]]: I do not have a proper name, for I am a child of nature. I was given the '''''gift''''' to communicate with ancient ethereal beings; that is where my name comes from: the 'Spirit Speaker'.
''Jogador'': '''gift '''
[[Spirit Speaker]]: The gift that has been bestowed upon me is the ability to communicate with the spirits and other ethereal entities who are among us. ...
[[Spirit Speaker]]: It helps me uncover important knowledge about our surroundings. Knowledge I then share with the people who visit this place to inspire them to explore the wonders this world has to offer.
''Jogador'': '''job '''
[[Spirit Speaker]]: Job? I am a spirit speaker and a traveller of these lands. I discover its '''''mysteries''''' and learn about its past... our past. ...
[[Spirit Speaker]]: Now you may be wondering what I do with all that knowledge and the answer is simple - I share it.
''Jogador'': '''mysteries '''
[[Spirit Speaker]]: Mysteries! This world is full of them; take for instance the mysterious creature who lurks in the jungles of Port Hope which is said to carry one of the rarest plants known to botany! ...
[[Spirit Speaker]]: Or the tales of underwater kingdoms ruled by fish-like creatures. Or perhaps the legend surrounding a demonic tree on the Plains of Havoc. ...
[[Spirit Speaker]]: Interesting, isn't it? And this is just a taste of what is out there for you to explore.
''Jogador'': '''bye '''
[[Spirit Speaker]]: May the spirits guide you.
}} [[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.title: Omrabas
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Omrabas | job = Roleplay | city = Northern Darama | subarea = Drefia, Deeper Drefia | location = [[Deeper Drefia]] ({{mapa|33019,32452,9:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 10.1 | notes =

* Faz parte da [[The Gravedigger of Drefia Quest]].

 | buysell = não | buys = | sells = | falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas ==
'''Omrabas''': He will PAY for this... They will ALL pay!
'''Omrabas''': If I ever lay hands on him again...
'''Omrabas''': Typical. Easy come, easy go.
'''Omrabas''': == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Omrabas''': At last, a visitor! Welcome to my... humble abode. ''Jogador'': '''job'''
'''Omrabas''': I used to be a famous necromancer in my lifetime. However, some... people... conspired against me, and the result you see before you. ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Omrabas''': Did I not mention it? You have the exceptional honour of meeting the soul of Omrabas the Black. Presently residing inside this skull. ''Jogador'': '''drefia'''
'''Omrabas''': The sunken, undead soul of Darashia. The breathing, beautiful corpse of a once lively city, glowing darkly, unhealthily, gloriously... but I get carried away. ''Jogador'': '''mission'''
'''Omrabas''': Help me? You? I don't think you are ready for that yet. Come back when you are more experienced in the ways of Drefia. ''Jogador'': '''king'''
'''Omrabas''': That king above ground? He's been in charge for quite a while, I understand. No serious rivals, eh? Lucky him. ''Jogador'': '''army'''
'''Omrabas''': The Tibian king's parthetic soldiers, do you mean? Or are you alluding to... ''Jogador'': '''tibianus'''
'''Omrabas''': He's been in charge for quite a while, I understand. No serious rivals, eh? Lucky him. ''Jogador'': '''tibia'''
'''Omrabas''': These lands are ripe for the taking. Give me an army of undead, and... ''Jogador'': ''''''
'''Omrabas''': ''Jogador'': '''blood'''
'''Omrabas''': The sap of life. The juice of the living, the flow of the carnal energies... Oh, to feel it rushing through my veins once again! ''Jogador'': '''blood priest'''
'''Omrabas''': If you want my opinion, they're just bloated necromancers, really. Upstart, pretentious lot! Highly... specialised in the uses of blood, though, which can be useful at times. ''Jogador'': '''conspired'''
'''Omrabas''': I know he used my pupils against me, and when I am back in the flesh, he will pay! ...
'''Omrabas''': Never again will I be fooled by other dark brothers. Treacherous lot, all of them... ''Jogador'': '''pharaoh'''
'''Omrabas''': We always shared a... common interest in undeath. ''Jogador'': '''undead'''
'''Omrabas''': Yes, obviously I am one of the numerous undead here. We are in Drefia, after all. ''Jogador'': '''vampire'''
'''Omrabas''': Parasites. Came here to profit from our experiments and blood reserves. Arrogant lot, too. Keep to themselves, luckily. ''Jogador'': '''priestess'''
'''Omrabas''': Ah, our dark, stern beauties. Skilled with herbs and masterly dancers. Only drawback is, they charge you heavily for their services. ''Jogador'': '''necromancer'''
'''Omrabas''': Ha. Ungrateful imbecile lot. After all I've done for them in my lifetime... , ... ''Jogador'': '''mummy'''
'''Omrabas''': Very single-minded. Smelly. Tend to burn easily. ''Jogador'': '''demon skeleton'''
'''Omrabas''': Much better servants than simple skeletons. The binding spells are quite complex, though, but the effort is well worth it. ''Jogador'': '''ghost'''
'''Omrabas''': Many restless souls roam the sunken graveyards of Drefia. ...
'''Omrabas''': Whole families are buried here, so if you're on the search for relatives, just visit the crypts, you might meet them ...
'''Omrabas''': ... though not in the flesh, as it were. ''Jogador'': '''ghoul'''
'''Omrabas''': Useless, slobbering things. Only on the lookout for food. ''Jogador'': '''grim reaper'''
'''Omrabas''': Some Grim Reapers haunt a forsaken temple deep under Drefia. Only people with a death wish would venture there! ''Jogador'': '''gravedigger'''
'''Omrabas''': Nasty little creatures, aren't they? The result of a failed experiment, but the theory was sound. They can be useful, if you know how to tame them. ''Jogador'': '''lich'''
'''Omrabas''': Simple transformation, but not without use. Good servants. Can be quite clever. ''Jogador'': '''skeleton'''
'''Omrabas''': Besides simple guardings tasks? Hmm. Not very resourceful. And they tend to fall apart. ''Jogador'': '''zombie'''
'''Omrabas''': Can be useful. Have an unhealthy appetite, though. ''Jogador'': '''shadow pupil'''
'''Omrabas''': PSST! Keep your voice down, will you? Strange things they do, and - well, just be careful mentioning them, and watch your back around them. ''Jogador'': '''ritual'''
'''Omrabas''': All in good time. ''Jogador'': '''dragonbone'''
'''Omrabas''': The Dragonbone Cemetery? Not far from here. Old dragons lay there down to die, it is presumed. Or maybe they were slain there. Or died from a mysterious illness. ...
'''Omrabas''': Anyway, lots of dragon bones there. Skulls, horns, ribs... Only place to find dragon tears, strange things, but that subject requires more study. ''Jogador'': '''help'''
'''Omrabas''': Help me? You? I don't think so. Come back when you are more experienced in the ways of Drefia. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Omrabas''': Are you mocking me? Get lost! }}

pages.title: Ashari
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Ashari | job = Roleplay | city = Ab'Dendriel | npcclass = Humanóides | npcsprite = Elf | subarea = Hellgate | location = [[Hellgate]] ({{mapa|32771,31612,11:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 10.1 | notes = Líder dos elfos penitentes de uma casta amaldiçoada. Este NPC possui [[Tarefas Diárias]].

* Faz parte da [[The Repenters Quest]].

 | buysell = não | buys = | sells = | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Ashari:''' Hello, stranger! These caves must seem strange to you. I wonder what brings you here... maybe you are interested in some work? There are several tasks I could need a hand with.
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
'''Ashari:''' I am the first voice amongst this community.
''Jogador:'' '''First Voice'''
'''Ashari:''' I am the leader of our people in worldly matters. I am the one who gives everyone its responsibilities and sees over our resources.
''Jogador:'' '''Resources'''
'''Ashari:''' This world is unforgiving and barren. Little can be done about that, but those of the second generation left us with more than the sins of the ancestors. They also gave us a home, hope, and at least some meagre resources.
''Jogador:'' '''Second Generation'''
'''Ashari:''' We do not know for how long sinners have lived and died here in the afterworld before some of the second generation saw the damnation that the deeds of the first brought upon them. ...
'''Ashari:''' Second generation might have only been true for some of them. Some might have been third of fourth generation already, who knows. ...
'''Ashari:''' They were free of some of the taint of their mothers and fathers, and saw through their lies. Saw them as the sinners that they were. ...
'''Ashari:''' It became clear to them and their leader Feridil that only by distancing themselves from the sinful outcasts, they could begin the long walk on the road to salvation. ...
'''Ashari:''' They drove off the sinners and claimed a small part of this afterworld for themselves. They chose a home near the entrance to the afterworld to make it easier for the wise of Abar Dendri to watch and ultimately judge them. ...
'''Ashari:''' They also made note of each new sinner, that arrived in the afterworld. And they marked them, so they could later tell if a petitioner who came to join them, was of second generation at least. ...
'''Ashari:''' They secured the resources that they needed and organised their harvest. That was how our community came to be.
''Jogador:'' '''Taint'''
'''Ashari:''' Larfion, our shaman, knows more about such matters. He is the guardian of our souls.
''Jogador:'' '''Community'''
'''Ashari:''' We are bound together in our need to purify ourselves in this harsh afterworld. Our resources are limited and our enemies numerous. But it will help us to atone.
''Jogador:'' '''Purify'''
'''Ashari:''' Meditation and hard work purify body and soul. But the taint runs deep.
''Jogador:'' '''Afterworld'''
'''Ashari:''' This is but a mockery of the world of light. Here we do not live, but are not truly dead either. We are similar to the undead that roam these caves. But unlike them we have the hope to atone.
''Jogador:'' '''Atone'''
'''Ashari:''' Meditation and hard work purify body and soul. But the taint runs deep.
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
'''Ashari:''' Bye!
= Para pegar as tasks = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Ashari:''' Hello, stranger! These caves must seem strange to you. I wonder what brings you here... maybe you are interested in some work? There are several tasks I could need a hand with.
''Jogador:'' '''Tasks'''
'''Ashari:''' Oh if you want to help me, you can lend me a hand watering our garden, cultivating wild magic for our shaman, collecting fire for our settlement. ...
'''Ashari:''' You can also start by helping us sterilise the dangerous mushrooms that have been preventing us from entering our crystal mines. They are literally spreading like a disease lately. ...
'''Ashari:''' If you manage to get all of this done in a single day, I will offer a bonus!
''Jogador:'' '''Watering'''
'''Ashari:''' Thank you. We use the unscathed tears of the gods we found in these hellish dephts to water our gardens. It is thanks to these that we can survive down here. The garden feeds us as the fire gives us warmth. ...
'''Ashari:''' Take this vial and venture down the path of these depths to find the unspoilt cradle of tears. Oh - and please heed my words: there are old remains of the forest above down there. They seem connected to the cradle. Sometimes... they can come alive.
''Jogador:'' '''Tears'''
'''Ashari:''' The world weeps for the sins of our ancestors. They are bitter but they are a gift. Even the teas of the world are full of life and hope.
''Jogador:'' '''Vial'''
'''Ashari:''' Filigree flasks we create with our own crystal tools. Worthy vessels for the purest of tears. I already gave you one, you didn't lose it - did you?
''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''
'''Ashari:''' Oh? Well, then... we will have to make another one, right? Please return to me after a while, I will see what I can do.
''Jogador:'' '''Magic'''
'''Ashari:''' Our shaman, Larfion, has asked me again to cultivate some of the wild magic for him that roams free in some nearby caverns. I do not know what this is for, but he seems to need quite much of this lately. ...
'''Ashari:''' It is a demand we simply cannot fulfil with all our other tasks at hand. ...
'''Ashari:''' Please take this receptacle to the magical cavern, you will recognise it when you are surrounded by magic. There are strangely coloured crystals down there but they are harmless. ...
'''Ashari:''' You will need to concentrate to cultivate the wild magic there. Listen carefully as I will try to explain to you how this is done: ...
'''Ashari:''' The most important thing is the order. First you gather 'fury magic' which usually appears red, second you should gather 'nature magic', appearing green. The third component to combine the two previous is 'fire magic' which should be fiery yellow. ...
'''Ashari:''' To neutralise all three and complete the cultivation, you should add a tiny bit of 'water magic' which shimmers blue. The components in the receptacle will now melt to a physical form and form a dry, rough powder.
''Jogador:'' '''Fire'''
'''Ashari:''' Our ancestors were sent into the fire for their sins. Yet, our small settlement needs the fire to survive. We also need fire to cleanse ourselves in a traditional ritual. ...
'''Ashari:''' There are harmless flames emanating from the ashes of fire elementals in extremely hot areas. There is a cave not that far from here where we used to gather fire for the ritual using firecatcher urns. ...
'''Ashari:''' However, recently the heat down there has risen tremendously. The only way to gather the fire from the ashes would be to quickly get in, eliminate enough elementals and gather the flames from their ashes with the firecatcher urn I gave you.
''Jogador:'' '''Firecatcher urn'''
'''Ashari:''' I already gave you that task, once you have gathered the flames, bring the urn back with the vial I gave you.
''Jogador:'' '''Urn'''
'''Ashari:''' We use these unique urns to capture the harmless flames from the ashes of fire elementals. Didn't I already give one to you? Did you lose it?
''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''
'''Ashari:''' Oh? Well, then... we will have to make another one, right? Please return to me after a while, I will see what I can do.
''Jogador:'' '''Mushrooms'''
'''Ashari:''' We mine crystals from some nearby mines. The meagre ore veins we found were not enough to make and repair useful, durable tools for everyone. ...
'''Ashari:''' The crystal cave we used to visit to get the crystals is near our camp, yet we cannot go there anymore. The cave is also hotbed for large mushrooms. Those are not exactly edible but not dangerous, either. ...
'''Ashari:''' However, our workers there started to get sick mining there. We used to train firebugs to use them as a means to create fire. They would help a great deal in eliminating this spreading disease. ...
'''Ashari:''' When we discovered that it's a strange illness that befell the mushrooms, most workers refused to go even near that cave. Now we have no elf left to fight this plague. Please go to the mine and burn away that pest.
''Jogador:'' '''Bonus'''
'''Ashari:''' If you manage to finish all our tasks within a single day, you will receive a special bonus. Return to me once you are finished.
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
'''Ashari:''' Bye!
}} [[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.title: Larfion The Shaman
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Larfion The Shaman | job = Roleplay | npcclass = Humanóides | npcsprite = Elf | city = Ab'Dendriel | subarea = Hellgate | location = [[Hellgate]] ({{mapa|32780,31600,11:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 10.1 | notes = Ele é o shaman, líder espiritual dos elfos penitentes de uma casta amaldiçoada.

* Faz parte da [[The Repenters Quest]].

 | buysell = não | buys = | sells = | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Larfion The Shaman:''' I greet you - and I have to ask you to... just tell me if you have something for me.
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
'''Larfion The Shaman:''' I'm the spiritual guide and keeper of knowledge for this community.
''Jogador:'' '''Community'''
'''Larfion The Shaman:''' We are the shame born, the repenters, the pardoners. The sins of our ancestors are the poison in our souls and our shame in the eyes of those born in the light of the suns.
''Jogador:'' '''Ancestors'''
'''Larfion The Shaman:''' Our ancestors were outcasts and evil. We still bear their taint and shame. No such sinner is allowed in our ranks, but we welcome all those born down here. ...
'''Larfion The Shaman:''' Only who is of the second generation can atone for the unspeakable sins that led to the punishment of the ancestors.
''Jogador:'' '''Suns'''
'''Larfion The Shaman:''' The suns are the eternal eyes of the great judge. He who is the justice of the purified.
''Jogador:'' '''Great judge'''
'''Larfion The Shaman:''' The suns are the eternal eyes of the great judge. He who is the justice of the purified.
''Jogador:'' '''Purified'''
'''Larfion The Shaman:''' All those who are born without sin in the light of the suns are purified in death. Unlike us tainted ones.
''Jogador:'' '''Tainted'''
'''Larfion The Shaman:''' We are unclean because of the sins of our ancestors. In this harsh afterworld we are allowed to distance us from the ancestors and atone for their sins. If we die here, we are damned into nothingness. ...
'''Larfion The Shaman:''' Only if we live in purity and humility, we might find pardon in the eyes of the lightborn.
''Jogador:'' '''Lightborn'''
'''Larfion The Shaman:''' Those who are born under the light of the suns, are born pure. Unlike us. They live a life in light, splendour and without hunger, thirst or fear. They are wise and just and watching us. ...
'''Larfion The Shaman:''' If they deem us worthy, they will take us into the light on the day of the prophecy.
''Jogador:'' '''Prophecy'''
'''Larfion The Shaman:''' Our ancestors were soaked with evil. They were vile criminals that were cast out of the light and the lands of splendour that the ancestors called Abar Dendri. ...
'''Larfion The Shaman:''' The wise judges of Abar Dendri spoke justice and they spoke true. No outcast was ever to see the light of the suns again. No single life could atone for their sins. ...
'''Larfion The Shaman:''' Through those wise words they gave a clue. A shed of hope which they bestowed upon the sinners in their wisdom and mercy. ...
'''Larfion The Shaman:''' But they were blinded by the darkness of the afterworld, they have been banished and their minds were clouded by the evil of their sins. ...
'''Larfion The Shaman:''' Only Feridil of the second generation was enlightened enough to see what those words meant. He gathered the second born, slew the sinners and drove off those who escaped to cast them deeper into darkness. ...
'''Larfion The Shaman:''' Then the great judge spoke to him in a vision. He showed him the path to salvation by purifying the blood by generations of atonement.
''Jogador:'' '''Atonement'''
'''Larfion The Shaman:''' In their wisdom the wise of Abar Dendri provided the children of the sinners with an harsh environment to work off the sins through hard work. ...
'''Larfion The Shaman:''' With every drop of sweat and blood that is shed in our suffering a little bit of the ancestors sinfulnesses is driven out. ...
'''Larfion The Shaman:''' Only by enduring this trial we can better ourself. It is a slow process, since obviously the ancestors' sins were grave. ...
'''Larfion The Shaman:''' If we needed any proof for that, the fact that the wise of Abar Dendri have not yet deemed us worthy to return into the light should show any doubter that we are not cleansed yet.
''Jogador:'' '''Abar Dendri'''
'''Larfion The Shaman:''' Abar Dendri it is! As the words of the repenters that came before us told us. It is the land of plenty, without any need and where the light always shines and it is warm without a fire.
''Jogador:'' '''Something'''
'''Larfion The Shaman:''' Yes, well you see, I am... waiting for something. Did Ashari tell you anything? Or ask you to do something?
'''Larfion The Shaman:''' I greet you - and I have to ask you to... just tell me if you have something for me.
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
'''Larfion The Shaman:''' Yes, yes erm - goodbye. }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.title: Tomruk The Ruddy
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Tomruk The Ruddy | job = Roleplay | city = Northern Darama | subarea = Drefia, Deeper Drefia | location = [[Deeper Drefia]] ({{mapa|32972,32419,11:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 10.1 | notes =

* Faz parte da [[The Gravedigger of Drefia Quest]].

 | buysell = não | buys = | sells = | falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == '''Tomruk The Ruddy''': This is really sanguine!
'''Tomruk The Ruddy''': Ah, fresh blood. My favourite.
'''Tomruk The Ruddy''': Hmm... the conductors are too dry to transmit energy.
'''Tomruk The Ruddy''': Interesting reaction. Bloodcurdling. Must inspect further. == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Tomruk The Ruddy''': Hello hello! Please don't touch the equipment, it's very valuable. ''Jogador'': '''job'''
'''Tomruk The Ruddy''': Are you joking? Does the colour of my robes tell you anything? I'm a very important researcher! ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Tomruk The Ruddy''': You will address me with my full name: Tomruk The Ruddy. ''Jogador'': '''research'''
'''Tomruk The Ruddy''': A fellow student of the dark arts, eh? Well, I specialise in the various conductive abilities of blood, you see. ...
'''Tomruk The Ruddy''': Perhaps you had read my treatise...no? Well, it'll revolutionise practical necromancy, let me tell you! ''Jogador'': '''blood'''
'''Tomruk The Ruddy''': Ah, the sweet sap of life, the nectar of the gods, the river of emotions, the... best thing there is. ''Jogador'': '''blood hand'''
'''Tomruk The Ruddy''': Do you wish to join our ranks, talk to brother Elryed The Sanguine when he's back from his errand. ''Jogador'': '''blood priest'''
'''Tomruk The Ruddy''': It takes practice, skill and dedication, but you might get there if you try! ''Jogador'': '''necroman'''
'''Tomruk The Ruddy''': Backward bunch. Incredibly old-fashioned approach to blood and narrow-minded about it. ''Jogador'': '''drefia'''
'''Tomruk The Ruddy''': Well, it has its merits, yes. But I contemplate a study trip to the Plains of Havoc. Broadens your vision! ''Jogador'': '''omrabas'''
'''Tomruk The Ruddy''': Never heard of him. Brothers are given new names when they reach priesthood, anyway. ''Jogador'': '''scroll'''
'''Tomruk The Ruddy''': Plenty of those here in Drefia. Got one myself, as a matter of fact. Handed down to me. Quite old and torn. ''Jogador'': '''shadow pupil'''
'''Tomruk The Ruddy''': Huh. Always speak in riddles. If they deign to speak to you, that is. Paint strange pseudo-animals on the floor and prefer ashes to blood. ''Jogador'': '''tibia''' / '''king'''
'''Tomruk The Ruddy''': Breeds supplies for the blood god. ''Jogador'': '''tibianus'''
'''Tomruk The Ruddy''': Well, someone has to sort out all those peasants' concerns, I believe. ''Jogador'': '''army'''
'''Tomruk The Ruddy''': Shepherd dogs to their king. Don't care myself, frankly. There are worthier things. ''Jogador'': '''undead'''
'''Tomruk The Ruddy''': Hrm, yes, technically you could say that. Research has advanced a bit, so the concept is outdated. ''Jogador'': '''priestess'''
'''Tomruk The Ruddy''': Not much to do with them, more's the pity. Beautiful, lively things. ''Jogador'': '''vampire'''
'''Tomruk The Ruddy''': Ah, fascinating creatures. Unfortunately, I had a... professional misunderstanding with a viscount, and now, our relations are somewhat strained. ''Jogador'': '''zombie'''
'''Tomruk The Ruddy''': Good harriers for fresh supplies, but you have to keep them from gnawing at their find. ''Jogador'': '''skeleton'''
'''Tomruk The Ruddy''': Of what interest would those sad things be? Not a drop of blood in them! ''Jogador'': '''ghoul'''
'''Tomruk The Ruddy''': It can take some that way. Giving in to their hunger. Not much use then. ''Jogador'': '''farewell'''
'''Tomruk The Ruddy''': Hmm? Oh yes, farewell, farewell. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Tomruk The Ruddy''': My pleasure, I assure you. Farewell! }}

 | buysell = não | buys = | sells = | falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == '''Elyen Ravenlock''':
'''Elyen Ravenlock''': The rats... the rats in the walls...
'''Elyen Ravenlock''': Re Ha, Omrah, Tan Ra...
== Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Elyen Ravenlock''': Hello, brother. What is it now? ''Jogador'': '''job'''
'''Elyen Ravenlock''': I prefer to call it my calling. I am the Mistress of the Dark Chants in Drefia. ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Elyen Ravenlock''': I am the Dark Priestess Elyen Ravenlock. Your name is of no concern to me. ''Jogador'': '''drefia'''
'''Elyen Ravenlock''': The dark flower. Our chants are its perfume, our dances its colour. ''Jogador'': '''pristess'''
'''Elyen Ravenlock''': I serve the Dark Lord. As do you, but you do not know it yet. ''Jogador'': '''necrom'''
'''Elyen Ravenlock''': Our brothers in the service of the Dark Lord. ''Jogador'': '''blood'''
'''Elyen Ravenlock''': The dark well inside our fleshly hull. It sings to us, and to the Dark Lord. ''Jogador'': '''ritual'''
'''Elyen Ravenlock''': You could assist, I assume. ''Jogador'': '''rats'''
'''Elyen Ravenlock''': Urgith's chosen. They run through our halls, free and unhindered. Do not harm them. ''Jogador'': '''night'''
'''Elyen Ravenlock''': The Gardens Of Night surround our sacred temples, east of the Necromancer Halls. Dark and light mix there, as do our chants. ''Jogador'': '''shadow pupils'''
'''Elyen Ravenlock''': Our most elusive brethren. They do not like to be mentioned. ''Jogador'': '''blood priest'''
'''Elyen Ravenlock''': They are drawn to bl ood like a wasp is to honey. They have a ...special interest in it, I presume. ''Jogador'': '''blood hand'''
'''Elyen Ravenlock''': Butchers, henchmen, assassins to the unwary. Keep clear of them, brother. ''Jogador'': '''poison'''
'''Elyen Ravenlock''': For yourself or someone else? Give the details to our apothecaries upstairs, they will settle the price, too. ''Jogador'': '''scroll'''
'''Elyen Ravenlock''': Do not touch the sacred scrolls! Leave this room at once! ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Elyen Ravenlock''': Yes. }}

| buysell = sim | buys = Nada. | sells =
Letras A a L {{Trades/Sell |Abacus (Réplica) |Assassin Doll (Réplica) |Aurora's Collection (Réplica) |Aylie (Réplica) |Bag of Oriental Spices (Réplica) |Banor Doll (Réplica) |Bard Doll (Réplica) |Bookworm Doll (Réplica) |Chaos Critical Dice (Réplica) |Citizen Doll (Réplica) |Crimson Doll |Doll of Durin The Almighty |Dragon Eye (Réplica) |Dragon Goblet (Réplica) |Draken Doll (Réplica) |Dread Doll (Réplica) |Encyclopedia |Emblem (Réplica) |Friendship Amulet (Réplica) |Frozen Heart (Réplica) |Golden Falcon (Réplica) |Golden Newspaper (Réplica) |Goromaphone (Réplica) |Hand Puppets (Réplica) |Imortus (Réplica) |Jade Amulet (Réplica) |Key of Numerous Locks (Réplica) |Little Adventurer Doll (Réplica) |Loremaster Doll (Réplica) |Love Elixir (Réplica) |Lucky Clover Amulet (Réplica) |Magic Hat (Réplica)}} Letras M a Z {{Trades/Sell |Mathmaster Shield (Réplica) |Medusa Skull (Réplica) |Music Box (Réplica) |Noble Sword (Réplica) |Norseman Doll (Réplica) |Old Radio (Réplica) |Orc's Jaw Shredder (Réplica) |Pigeon Trophy (Réplica) |Phoenix Statue (Réplica) |Shield of Destiny (Réplica) |Shield of Endless Search (Réplica) |The Dragon Spirit (Réplica) |The Mexcalibur (Réplica) |Tibiora's Box (Réplica)}} | falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == '''Jorge''': Come over here if you have to resupply! == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Jorge''': Hi there! You have surely come here because you have heard of me, and what a great replicating artist I am, right? ...
'''Jorge''': Or could it be that you haven't heard of me? Anyway, I am always on the hunt for beautiful and rare items. Almost a collector, you could say. ...
'''Jorge''': My grandfather taught me the art of carving and replicating. In my younger years I have also developed a knack for hunting. I once started to catalogue all the monsters in this world. ...
'''Jorge''': So I resorted to copying interesting artefacts that were found inside all those monsters. Just look at my display here. They look just like the real ones, eh? ...
'''Jorge''': Anyway, can you help me, please? You seem to be eager to fight against any monster that comes your way! ''Jogador'': '''carving'''
'''Jorge''': Yes, carving. The fine art of taking an undefined, amorphous, something, a knife and making something beautiful out of it. ...
'''Jorge''': Actually, it is creating something by reducing it. Beautiful, eh? I had some years to practice what my grandpa taught me - so feel free to look around later, but first - can you help me? ''Jogador'': '''replicating'''
'''Jorge''': The art of creating something that looks and feels and behaves like the original. It requires a lot of appreciation for detail, diligence and time. But the outcome is ultimately rewarding, don't you think? Anyway, could you help me, please? ''Jogador'': '''raids'''
'''Jorge''': Yes, raids. From time to time, a special horde of monsters appears somewhere on this world. You will see it when it happens - just follow the people rushing there! Or ask your fellow adventurers when and where a certain raid is expected. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Jorge''': Take care! }}

pages.title: Lavirias
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}}
| name        = Lavirias
| job         = Roleplay
| npcclass    = Humanóides
| npcsprite   = Elf
| city        = Ab'Dendriel
| subarea     = Ab'Dendriel City
| location    = [[Ab'Dendriel City]] ({{mapa|32660,31685,7:2|aqui}}).
| implemented = 10.1
| notes       = Ao conversar com ela, pode-se perceber que ela gosta de estudar e de conhecer a natureza.
| buysell     = não
| falas = 
''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''</br>
'''Lavirias:''' Ashari visitor. I wonder what it is you seek in Ab'Dendriel.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''</br>
'''Lavirias:''' I guess I'm what you'd call a sage or perhaps a mystic.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Mystic'''</br>
'''Lavirias:''' I'm dedicated to delve into the deeper secrets of nature. As all seekers of knowledge, I have to dedicate much time and effort into the subject of my studies.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Nature'''</br>
'''Lavirias:''' I think nature is some kind of complicated mechanism and that we are all part of it. The function of some parts is more difficult to figure out then that of others.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Function'''</br>
'''Lavirias:''' Especially the part that Ashar'Tel plays in the workings of nature is, what I try to figure out.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Studies'''</br>
'''Lavirias:''' Since my studies center around the nature of Ashar'Tel, there is little I can base my research on but my own discoveries.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Ab'dendriel'''</br>
'''Lavirias:''' A city has to have a soul. I think the soul of Ab'Dendriel is Ashar'Tel. If the others would only see it that way too.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Ashar'tel'''</br>
'''Lavirias:''' Ashar'Tel's fame and myth has grown with time as the tree itself has grown over time. Though everybody sees something in this tree, it's rarely the same for everyone. ...</br>
'''Lavirias:''' Humans travel here and look at Ashar'Tel as an avatar of their god Crunor. Dwarves probably see only firewood. ...</br>
'''Lavirias:''' The Elven council sees it as a valuable resource yet I see something completely different.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Resource'''</br>
'''Lavirias:''' The tears of Ashar'Tel, the water of life, the blessing of the tree. It has probably more names then it has uses. ...</br>
'''Lavirias:''' The water that condenses as some kind of supernatural dew on Ashar'Tel's leaves is gathered and prepared by some of the eldest and wisest spellweavers of our kind.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Prepared'''</br>
'''Lavirias:''' The raw power of the water is wild and without direction it seems. To drink it is like trying to mount a wild stallion. It has to be tamed and guided into a direction to be of any use and not a danger.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Water'''</br>
'''Lavirias:''' The tears of Ashar'Tel, the water of life, the blessing of the tree. It has probably more names then it has uses. ...</br>
'''Lavirias:''' The water that condenses as some kind of supernatural dew on Ashar'Tel's leaves is gathered and prepared by some of the eldest and wisest spellweavers of our kind.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Danger''' / '''Dangerous'''</br>
'''Lavirias:''' It was obvious that the raw waters of Ashar'Tel might be dangerous, but the fate of the forest furies has shown how dangerous and unpredictable it can be.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Forest Furies'''</br>
'''Lavirias:''' Once they were only a rebellious sisterhood, inspired by foolish amazons from Carlin they tried a rebellion on their own. In their foolish, juvenile overconfidence they stole unrefined water of Ashar'Tel. ...</br>
'''Lavirias:''' Assuming the elders were withholding power for themselves or something else. In the end they learned the hard way that there are things better left to those with wisdom and experience. ...</br>
'''Lavirias:''' Their careless misuse of the waters deformed their body and mind. Sadly it did not stop there. ...</br>
'''Lavirias:''' As if it weren't bad enough for the furies to be transformed, a tribe of orcish raiders got the rest of the stolen water into their hands and spawned a new, abominable breed of orcs, the rorcs. ...</br>
'''Lavirias:''' They are a halve orc, halve terrorbird variant that is erroneously called 'rorcs'.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Different'''</br>
'''Lavirias:''' Using divination magic year over year on Ashar'Tel I can see and understand more about it then anyone else. I sense... well, something. A consciousness. ...</br>
'''Lavirias:''' An own will. Nothing like the one of elves, humans or even dwarves. Ultimately alien thoughts but they are thoughts. ...</br>
'''Lavirias:''' The tree is alive in more then the obvious way and it... has a purpose. It... wants something. Urgently! Sometimes it feels not only urgent but frighteningly fierceful. It is hard to explain.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Explain'''</br>
'''Lavirias:''' To understand what I do, you would have to trade everything for a life dedicated to studies like I did. You'd have to spend years of meditation and divination to get a glimpse of that what I can see and feel... yet not fully understand even now.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Understand'''</br>
'''Lavirias:''' Understanding is a process. It takes time. A lot of time. And right now I'm wasting a lot of time with idle chat, can we please continue? Good.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''</br>
'''Lavirias:''' I bid you farewell.
}}<noinclude>[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]</noinclude>

pages.title: Falonzo
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Falonzo | job = Pesquisador | city = Edron | subarea = Fury Hell | location = [[Fury Hell]] ({{mapa|33291,31792,13:4|aqui}}). | implemented = 10.1 | buysell = não | sells = | notes = | falas = ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
[[Falonzo]]: Greetings, adventurer!
''Jogador'': '''name'''
[[Falonzo]]: I'm professor Falonzo from the mage's guild.
''Jogador'': '''job'''
[[Falonzo]]: I'm a researcher of scientific council of the mage guild and I came to that place to study this anomaly.
''Jogador'': '''place'''
[[Falonzo]]: This plane is now inhabited by intruders and creatures that accidentally became dragged in. ...
[[Falonzo]]: It is neither completely of our world nor is it still that disconnected and unreachable as it used to be. I fear it's only a harbinger of something more dangerous and more sinister.
''Jogador'': '''anomaly'''
[[Falonzo]]: Well, the whole place here is an anomaly so to say. You can hardly have missed the fact that you arrived here through a mystical gate. ...
[[Falonzo]]: Well actually it's no gate at all but a rift in the fabric of nature. It is this minor plane trying to reconnect to our world.
''Jogador'': '''plane'''
[[Falonzo]]: This is a lesser plane of tarnished, elemental fire that once belonged to the world that we know. It was despoiled in the wars of the gods and broke loose from our world. Lost and drifting through the void, without a connection to our plane.
''Jogador'': '''intruders'''
[[Falonzo]]: Infernalists were the first who found their way into this sphere. Hoping to tap its rotten power somehow. Yet this sphere created creatures of its own and draw others here from other planes.
''Jogador'': '''dragged'''
[[Falonzo]]: This place became a fiery trap to certain beings with an affinity to fire. Somehow it reconnects randomly with the known world, to which it once belonged ...
[[Falonzo]]: but also to other places that it shares some affinity with like hellish places of unspeakable evil that spawn infernal creatures.
''Jogador'': '''sinister''' ou '''changed'''
[[Falonzo]]: Something is tearing at the fabric of reality. I can't tell what is it but the boundaries between worlds are fading. ...
[[Falonzo]]: A process that what watched for over a century but which has extremely grown in momentum over the last few years. Something is happening and it's for sure nothing good. ...
[[Falonzo]]: Be it as it may, the plane trying to reconnect was only a side effect. It still might teach us about what is happening and it has for sure attracted some attention already.
''Jogador'': '''lost'''
[[Falonzo]]: Well, that was how it used to be. Lost and without any connection to our world. But that was before things ... have changed.
''Jogador'': '''boundaries'''
[[Falonzo]]: We know about other planes of existence but in all history it has never been as easy to reach them as it is now. ...
[[Falonzo]]: Sometimes world seem to overlap and we can identify more and more such planes and worlds. More then we ever had imagined. All we can tell is, that something is changing. And not for the good.
''Jogador'': '''attention'''
[[Falonzo]]: Such an anomaly can't go unnoticed for long. That lead to the presence to unwanted intruders and other entities were dragged into by the nature of the sphere.
''Jogador'': '''bye'''
[[Falonzo]]: Good bye!
}}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.title: Gnommander
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Gnommander | job = Líder | job2 = Gnome | city = Gnomish Outposts | subarea = The Spike, Upper Spike | location = [[The Spike]] - [[Upper Spike]] ({{mapa|32243,32598,8:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 10.20 | notes = Ele comanda os recrutadores e recompensa jogadores que se aventuram na the spike.

* Ele pode vender o [[Cave Explorer Outfits]]. Para isso, peça por '''reward''' quando você tiver ''Fame Points'' suficientes na [[Spike Tasks Quest]].

 | buysell = não | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
[[Gnommander]]: Hi there! Welcome to the spike.
''Jogador:'' '''Spike'''
[[Gnommander]]: I'm the operating commander of the Spike, the latest great accomplishment of the gnomish race. ...
[[Gnommander]]: The Spike is a crystal structure, created by our greatest crystal experts. It has grown from a crystal the size of my fist to the structure you see here and now. ...
[[Gnommander]]: Of course this did not happen from one day to the other. It's the fruit of the work of several gnomish generations. Its purpose has changed in the course of time. ...
[[Gnommander]]: At first it was conceived as a fast growing resource node. Then it was planned to become the prototype of a new type of high security base. ...
[[Gnommander]]: Now it has become a military base and a weapon. With our foes occupied elsewhere, we can prepare our strike into the depths of the earth. ...
[[Gnommander]]: This crystal can withstand extreme pressure and temperature, and it's growing deeper and deeper even as we speak. ...
[[Gnommander]]: The times of the fastest growth have come to an end, however, and we have to slow down in order not to risk the structural integrity of the Spike. But we are on our way and have to do everything possible to defend the Spike.
''Jogador:'' '''Commander'''
[[Gnommander]]: I'm responsible for the security and reward heroes to our cause. If you are looking for missions, talk to Gnomilly, Gnombold and Gnomagery.
''Jogador:'' '''Reward'''
[[Gnommander]]: I can sell special outfit parts. If your fame is high enough, you might be worthy of such a reward.
''Jogador:'' '''Worthy'''
[[Gnommander]]: You are not worthy of a special reward yet. |}}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = The Gate Keeper | job = Roleplay | job2 = Guarda | city = Northern Darama | subarea = Drefia, Drefia Spirit Grounds | location = [[Drefia Spirit Grounds]] ({{mapa|32857,32428,10:2|aqui}}). | buysell = não | implemented = 10.20 | notes =

| falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
[[The Gate Keeper]]: Are you the Key Master?
''Jogador:'' '''No'''
[[The Gate Keeper]]:
''Jogador:'' '''hi'''
[[The Gate Keeper]]: Are you the Key Master?
''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''
[[The Gate Keeper]]: Enter the Spirit Grounds, Key Master.
''Jogador:'' '''Spirit Ground'''
[[The Gate Keeper]]: The realm between realms, where all doors open on themselves only. The place where the spirits dwell that have unfinished business or were... called.
''Jogador:'' '''Called'''
[[The Gate Keeper]]: The call of the Ancients was sounded. The Key Master knows it. We too have been summoned to prepare for their arrival.
''Jogador:'' '''Ancients'''
[[The Gate Keeper]]: Enough! Don't waste your breath, mortal. Go now onto the grounds to do what you came here to do.
''Jogador:'' '''Key Master'''

[[The Gate Keeper]]: The Key Master will find them and close the doors that were not meant to be open. ...
[[The Gate Keeper]]: And then he will unlock the Other Door.
''Jogador:'' '''Other Door'''
[[The Gate Keeper]]: The Key Master will know.
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''
[[The Gate Keeper]]: My name is unpronouncable in your language.
''Jogador:'' '''Unpronouncable'''
[[The Gate Keeper]]: The nearest you may come to is Zg'!kch of Cthle-ZüuKh'lkrlxchwr.
''Jogador:'' '''Undeads'''
[[The Gate Keeper]]: Travellers between the doors.
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
[[The Gate Keeper]]: I am the Gate Keeper. I guard the doors and await the Key Master.
''Jogador:'' '''Gods'''
[[The Gate Keeper]]: We are in their atrium. Some doors lead to them. Soon...
''Jogador:'' '''Soon'''
[[The Gate Keeper]]: Yes, soon. Or maybe it has happened already, long ago. ...
[[The Gate Keeper]]: Time has no meaning to them.
''Jogador:'' '''Necromancer'''
[[The Gate Keeper]]: Serving the dark ones. Some do not know what they are meddling with, rattling at the doors like children.
''Jogador:'' '''Shadows'''
[[The Gate Keeper]]: The breath of darkness, the eye of the night, the body of the other.
''Jogador:'' '''zgk'ch Cthlhg Drch'''
[[The Gate Keeper]]: Really! No need to be rude.
''Jogador:'' ''' zg'!kch Of Cthle-züukh'lkrlxchwr'''
[[The Gate Keeper]]: Really! No need to be rude.
''Jogador:'' '''Northern Ruins'''
[[The Gate Keeper]]:
''Jogador:'' '''Path'''
[[The Gate Keeper]]: Use a sharp blade, a powerful staff or spell to send them on their way.
''Jogador:'' '''Tibia'''
[[The Gate Keeper]]: Too many doors open. Too tempting for some. The shadows run and hide.
''Jogador:'' '''Death'''
[[The Gate Keeper]]: A broken seal on a letter long read.
}}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

[[Gnomux]]: Here you are.

pages.title: Gnomargery
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Gnomargery | job = Recrutador | job2 = Gnome | city = Gnomish Outposts | subarea = The Spike, Lower Spike | location = [[The Spike]] - [[Lower Spike]] ({{mapa|32243,32598,14:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 10.20 | notes = Ele oferece [[Tarefas Diárias|tarefas diárias]] para jogadores de level 80 ou superior em uma quest.

Conversando com ele, você poderá pegar as tasks de level 80+ da [[Spike Tasks]].

 | buysell = não | falas = ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
[[Gnomargery]]: Hi!
''Jogador'': '''job'''
[[Gnomargery]]: I'm the officer responsible for this area. I give out missions, accept mission reports and oversee our defences.
''Jogador'': '''gnome'''
[[Gnomargery]]: It's good to be a gnome for sure!
''Jogador'': '''spike'''
[[Gnomargery]]: Now that's gnomish ingenuity given shape! Who but a gnome would come up with such a plan to defeat our enemies.
''Jogador'': '''area'''
[[Gnomargery]]: On the levels outside, we encountered the first serious resistance of our true enemy. As evidenced by the unnatural heat in an area with little volcanic activity, there is 'something' strange going on here. ...
[[Gnomargery]]: Even the lava pools we have found here are not actually lava, but rock that was molten pretty much recently without any reasonable connection to some natural heat source. And for all we can tell, the heat is growing, slowly but steadily. ...
[[Gnomargery]]: This is the first time ever that we can witness our enemy at work. Here we can learn a lot about its operations. ...
[[Gnomargery]]: How they work, and possibly how to stop them. But therefore expeditions into the depths are necessary. The areas around us are highly dangerous, and a lethal threat to us and the Spike as a whole. ...
[[Gnomargery]]: Our first object is to divert the forces of the enemy and weaken them as good as we can while gathering as much information as possible about them and their movements. Only highly skilled adventurers stand a chance to help us down here. ...
[[Gnomargery]]: The area is as treacherous as dangerous, and all of its inhabitants are eager to tear everything unknown to them into pieces. }} [[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.title: Gnomilly
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Gnomilly | job = Recrutador | job2 = Gnome | city = Gnomish Outposts | subarea = The Spike, Upper Spike | location = [[The Spike]] - [[Upper Spike]] ({{mapa|32243,32598,9:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 10.20 | notes = Ela oferece [[Tarefas Diárias|tarefas diárias]] para jogadores de level 25 até 49 de uma quest.

* Conversando com ela, você poderá pegar as tasks de level 25 até 49 da [[Spike Tasks]].

 | buysell = não | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
[[Gnomilly]]: Hi!
''Jogador:'' '''Mission'''
[[Gnomilly]]: Sorry, but no! Your expertise could be put to better use elsewhere. Here awaits you no challenge. You are desperately needed in the deeper levels of the Spike. Report there immediately.
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
[[Gnomilly]]: I'm the officer responsible for this area. I give out missions, accept mission reports and oversee our defences.
''Jogador:'' '''Area'''
[[Gnomilly]]: On these levels we found evidence of some monumental battle that has taken place here centuries ago. We also found some grave sites, but oddly enough no clues of any form of settlement. ...
[[Gnomilly]]: Some evidence we have found suggests that at least one of the battles here was fought for many, many years. People came here, lived here, fought here and died here. ...
[[Gnomilly]]: The battles continued until someone or something literally ploughed through the battlefields, turning everything upside down. All this killing and death soaked the area with negative energy. ...
[[Gnomilly]]: Necromantic forces are running wild all over the place and we are hard-pressed to drive all these undead, spirits and ghosts, away from the Spike. ...
[[Gnomilly]]: Unless we can secure that area somehow, the Spike operation is threatened to become crippled by the constant attacks of the undead. ...
[[Gnomilly]]: The whole growing downwards could come to a halt, leaving us exposed to even more attacks, counter attacks, and giving the enemy time to prepare their defences. There's a lot to do for aspiring adventurers.
''Jogador:'' '''Gnome'''
[[Gnomilly]]: We are the only protectors of the world against the enemies below. With small stature comes great responsibilities, as they say. }} [[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.title: Gnombold
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Gnombold | job = Recrutador | job2 = Gnome | city = Gnomish Outposts | subarea = The Spike, Middle Spike | location = [[The Spike]] - [[Middle Spike]] ({{mapa|32243,32598,11:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 10.20 | notes = Ele oferece [[Tarefas Diárias|tarefas diárias]].

* Conversando com ele, você poderá pegar as tasks de level 50 até 79 da [[Spike Tasks]].

 | buysell = não | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
[[Gnombold]]: Hi!
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
[[Gnombold]]: I'm the officer responsible for this area. I give out missions, accept mission reports and oversee our defences.
''Jogador:'' '''Area'''
[[Gnombold]]: The levels around us are... well, they are strange. We are still not entirely sure how they were created. It seems obvious that they are artificial, but they seem not to be burrowed or the like. ...
[[Gnombold]]: We found strange stone formations that were not found on other layers around the Spike, but there is no clue at all if they are as natural as they look. It seems someone used some geomantic force to move the earth. ...
[[Gnombold]]: For what reason this has been done we can't tell as we found no clues of colonisation. ...
[[Gnombold]]: There are theories that the caves are some kind of burrow of some extinct creature or even creatures that are still around us, but exist as some form of invisible energy; but those theories are far-fetched and not supported by any discoveries. ...
[[Gnombold]]: Be that as it may, whatever those caves were meant for, these days they are crawling with creatures of different kinds and all are hostile towards us. The competition for food is great down here, and everything is seen as prey by the cave dwellers. ...
[[Gnombold]]: Some would like to feast on the crystal of the Spike, others would prefer a diet of gnomes. What they have in common is that they are a threat. If we can't keep them under control their constant attacks and raids on the Spike will wear us down. ...
[[Gnombold]]: That's where adventurers fit in to save the day.
''Jogador:'' '''Gnome'''
[[Gnombold]]: Gnomes have lived autonomous for so long that it still feels odd to work with strangers for many of us.}} [[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.wikitext:
{{DASH|''Este artigo é sobre o '''NPC''' Opticorder Forge. Para o objeto, veja [[Opticorder Forge (Objeto)]].}}{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Opticorder Forge (NPC) | job = Roleplay | city = Kazordoon | subarea = Kazordoon Dwarf Mines, Kazordoon Dwarf Mines (Pick 'N Shovel) | location = [[Kazordoon Dwarf Mines (Pick 'N Shovel)|Pick 'N Shovel Mine]] ({{mapa|32595,32011,9:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 10.20 | notes =

 | buysell = não | buys = | sells = | falas = ''Jogador'': '''hi '''

pages.title: Sandomo
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Sandomo | job = Inquisitor | city = Roshamuul | subarea = Lower Roshamuul | location = [[Lower Roshamuul]] ({{mapa|33505,32552,7:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 10.30 | notes =

* Faz parte da [[Roshamuul Quest]].

 | buysell = não | falas = ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
[[Sandomo]]: Hm. Greetings.
''Jogador'': '''mission'''
[[Sandomo]]: First, you will help us rebuilding this wretched bridge we cannot cross. We need mortar and there are several types of monsters who try to keep us away from it. ...
[[Sandomo]]: Then there is this enormous wall in the distance. Once we crossed the bridge, we will have to breach this monument. As I see it, you are working for the Inquisition now, I will hear no objection. You may even earn our gratitude.
''Jogador'': '''bridge'''
[[Sandomo]]: Our brother Mortis is constantly working on keeping the bridge intact. We tried some simple wood planks first but it didn't work out that... well. ...
[[Sandomo]]: What we need is enough mortar to actually build a durable traverse. And we will need even more mortar to maintain it as it constantly gets attacked by vile critters.
''Jogador'': '''mortar'''
[[Sandomo]]: We scouted some caves beneath the island which hold plenty of chalk to mix some good mortar. The entrances are not very far from here in fact. ...
[[Sandomo]]: However, the entrances are somewhat... twisted. The entrance we had mapped to a certain cave one day, would lead to a completely different cave on the next. ...
[[Sandomo]]: And even when emerging from one of the caves you never know where you are since its exits are just as deceptive. ...
[[Sandomo]]: Once you gathered some chalk, you should also find gravel on the island. If you have a pick and a bucket, you should be able to collect enough fine gravel to mix some mortar. ...
[[Sandomo]]: Do not forgeet to bring some buckets, if you are in short supply, brother Maun will hand some out to you - for a fee of course.
''Jogador'': '''bucket'''
[[Sandomo]]: Head to brother Maun if you are in need of basic supplies. He will help you - for a small fee.
''Jogador'': '''maun'''
[[Sandomo]]: Brother Maun is a valuable member of the Inquisition. He will help you out with supplies. Provided you can actually compensate of course.
''Jogador'': '''supplies'''
[[Sandomo]]: Head to brother Maun if you are in need of basic supplies. He will help you - for a small fee.
''Jogador'': '''monster''' ou '''critters'''
[[Sandomo]]: Several of the evil critters of this land will simply not cease to attack us and every project we undertook on this island. ...
[[Sandomo]]: They seem to keep us from fixing the giant traverse separating us from the rest of the island and you can see numerous guards in front of the wall even from down here. ...
[[Sandomo]]: There must be ways to draw them away from us - your mission is to find them. Now get to it and keep us these monsters at bay.
''Jogador'': '''wall'''
[[Sandomo]]: For all I know, we are about to breach a fortified bastion of pure evil. Once this nichtmare mural falls, we will have access to the whole island. ...
[[Sandomo]]: I will bring every trained man, woman and every volunteer I can muster to this battlefield. We will! Prevail. We will! Throw them back into the abyss they spawned from. ...
[[Sandomo]]: As I did not get that far into the island yet, I cannot give you much advice. Try to use your surroundings. Find something that works and make this wall tumble down. ...
[[Sandomo]]: It would also surely help if we could draw some of the creatures there away from it, as they are surely connected to this thing. I presume it is similar to the creatures guarding the bridge. ...
[[Sandomo]]: Maybe you can make some creatures angry somehow and make them focus on something else? Whatever you do, put your utmost effort into it.
''Jogador'': '''traverse'''
[[Sandomo]]: Our brother Mortis is constantly working on keeping the bridge intact. We tried some simple wood planks first but it didn't work out that... well. ...
[[Sandomo]]: What we need is enough mortar to actually build a durable traverse. And we will need even more mortar to maintain it as it constantly gets attacked by vile critters.
''Jogador'': '''surroundings'''
[[Sandomo]]: We should really use whatever this wretched island offers us against it. There are many ways to confront an enemy - make something out of everything. Bones, stones, resource deposits...
''Jogador'': '''job'''
[[Sandomo]]: I am Sandomo, lightbringer of the inquisition and commander of the Roshamuul mission. Well, at least of what is now left of that mission.
''Jogador'': '''inquisition'''
[[Sandomo]]: The inquisition is the cleansing fire of the gods. For only with their guidance we shall purge the land.
''Jogador'': '''Henricus'''
[[Sandomo]]: He is an inspiration to us all.
''Jogador'': '''Roshamuul'''
[[Sandomo]]: A dreadful and accursed place we have to prospect. I thank the gods that I can see this place so that I can praise the mercy of the divine to spare us from such an abominable fate.
''Jogador'': '''prospect'''
[[Sandomo]]: We are here to explore and prospect this desecrated shard of the gods creation. ...
[[Sandomo]]: This island is currently in a state of demonic stranglehold. Yet, the Inquisition WILL win this land back from the grasp of evil. ...
[[Sandomo]]: In my position as of the righteous Inquisition, I hereby declare you adjutant of the Inquisition - basically that means you are under MY command now.
''Jogador'': '''demonic'''
[[Sandomo]]: The servants of evil are powerful. Yet armed with faith and side to side with our brothers and sisters, we shall prevail. ...
[[Sandomo]]: This island however, is a different story altogether.
''Jogador'': '''command'''
[[Sandomo]]: First, you will help us rebuilding this wretched bridge we cannot cross. We need mortar and there are several types of monsters who try to keep us away from it. ...
[[Sandomo]]: Then there is this enormous wall in the distance. Once we crossed the bridge, we will have to breach this monument. As I see it, you are working for the Inquisition now, I will hear no objection. You may even earn our gratitude.
''Jogador'': '''gratitude'''
[[Sandomo]]: Oh, so you want a reward, hm? Well... let's see. What did you do for us - helping Mortis with his repairs and defended him? Or did you help in further destroying the mural amidst hordes of evil?
''Jogador'': '''repairs'''
[[Sandomo]]: Alright, so you mixed and delivered 0 mortar and ...
[[Sandomo]]: You killed 0 frazzlemaws and ...
[[Sandomo]]: You also hunted 1 silencers. That would equal 1 of inquisition gold - BUT we are currently short of this valuable metal so... do you want me to add this amount to my books for now or trade it for something else.
''Jogador'': '''trade'''
[[Sandomo]]: Ah yes, you currently have 0 of righteously earned inquisition gold in my book. 100 inquisition gold equals one cluster. How many clusters do you want in exchange?
''Jogador'': '''gold'''
[[Sandomo]]: Gold? Gold! Yes, well. Gold. Quite the predicament we're currently in here, right? Heh... well, there is not much I can do. ...
[[Sandomo]]: The ways of the inquisition to show gratitude are manyfold. Yes. Well, I hope you have some other important questions, I currently don't have a lot of time on my hands.
''Jogador'': '''cluster'''
[[Sandomo]]: Strange things, aren't they? We gathered quite a lot of them when we came here. We actually stockpiled them because we didn't know what... heh, I mean, well. They are of course of much value. ...
[[Sandomo]]: To someone like you, that is. I am perfectly serious about that. Then again, I always am.
''Jogador'': '''books'''
[[Sandomo]]: Of course, let's see. Hm, you have earned 1 of righteous inqusition gold. Do you want me to add this amount to my books? This will reset your current records, too, however - so?
''Jogador'': '''frazzlemaws'''
[[Sandomo]]: As with the guzzlemaws there seems to be an endless supply of these creatures. A frazzlemaw however, is far larger than the guzzlemaw and even more dangerous. ...
[[Sandomo]]: Remember to keep your distance when fighting them, their bite can not only hurt - you may be swallowed whole. Based on what I found out so far, they seemed to have a false god, the Overmaw.
''Jogador'': '''guzzlemaw'''
[[Sandomo]]: There are a lot of these snappy creatures on this island. We cannot say how many but so far we already fought countless specimens while defending the bridge, yet they keep coming. ...
[[Sandomo]]: If you happen to get bitten by one of them and the infected ichor starts spreading on your body... well, try to get rid of that part of your body. Good luck!
''Jogador'': '''Overmaw'''
[[Sandomo]]: As far as I could venture, I did some meager studies on the maw creatures. Seem to have some kind of false god. They call it the 'Overmaw' and bow to its will. They erect shrines to its honors all over the island. ...
[[Sandomo]]: If you take one down, they will just create another one on top of it. Maybe keeping these shrines intact but desecrating them in some way, would draw their attention.
''Jogador'': '''destroying'''
[[Sandomo]]: So, it seems you sounded 0 horns at the great mural and ...
[[Sandomo]]: You desecrated 0 shrines of the maws that roam these lands. And ...
[[Sandomo]]: You also lured 0 silencers away from the that cursed wall. Oh yes and ...
[[Sandomo]]: You actually eradicated 0 of the wretched eyeballs, Sight of Surrender. ...
[[Sandomo]]: That would equal 0 of inquisition gold - BUT we are currently short of this valuable metal so... do you want me to add this amount to my books for now or trade it for something else.
''Jogador'': '''Sight of Surrender'''
[[Sandomo]]: Oh well, these huge eyeballs are not to be trifled with. They can pack a punch and may be the most sturdy living thing I have ever seen in my devoted life in the inquisition. ...
[[Sandomo]]: Try not to attack them with blunt weapons, focus on their head gear and you may... well you may as well just flee before surrendering to them.
''Jogador'': '''Silencer'''
[[Sandomo]]: They seem to be very focussed on sounds. They have a distinct siren call and seem to actually 'communicate' with each other. Maybe there is a way to distract them from attacking us when using this against them. ...
[[Sandomo]]: From what I have seen and heard from up here, they are annoyed by extremely loud noises. When I say 'annoyed', I mean they get angry. And when I say 'angry', well those vicious beasts are as fast as lightning and as a demon itself.
''Jogador'': '''Demon'''
[[Sandomo]]: The servants of evil are powerful. Yet armed with faith and side to side with our brothers and sisters, we shall prevail. ...
[[Sandomo]]: This island however, is a different story altogether.
''Jogador'': '''Shock Head'''
[[Sandomo]]: I do not know a lot about these creatures. If we could only muster enough men, we could probably tame them and use them to transport supplies deeper into the island.
''Jogador'': '''bye'''
[[Sandomo]]: Praise the gods, I bid you farewell. }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]
