''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''</br>
'''Hamish:''' Hi there, fellow adventurer. What's your need? Say trade and we'll soon get you fixed up. Or ask me about potions, wands, or runes.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''</br>
'''Hamish:''' Hamish MacGuffin, at your disposal.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''</br>
'''Hamish:''' I craft highly efficient runes, wands and potions - always handy when you're in a fight against monsters! Ask me for a trade to browse through my stock.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Dawnport'''</br>
'''Hamish:''' Small and deceptively friendly-looking island. Well, I used to study the plants and herbs here for my potions. ...</br>
'''Hamish:''' Nowadays, I leave that to Oressa, she has a better way with that horrible wildlife here. I prefer to distil potions in the quiet of my lab. If you need some potions, runes or other magic equipment, ask for a trade.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Oressa'''</br>
'''Hamish:''' Our druid, down in the temple. Just appeared out of the blue one day. Keeps to herself. She must have some reason to stay with us rather than roam the bigger Mainland. Well, we all have our reasons.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Mainland'''</br>
'''Hamish:''' Dawnport is not far off from the coast of the Tibian Mainland. Lots of cities, monsters, bandits, brigands, mean folk and people of low understanding with no sense of respect towards alchemical genius. <mutters to himself> ...</br>
'''Hamish:''' Ahem. Once you're level 8, you should be experienced enough to choose your definite vocation and leave Dawnport for Main - and Tibia definitely needs more skilled adventurers to keep those monsters in check which roam our lands!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Rookgaard'''</br>
'''Hamish:''' Nope. Doesn't sound familiar.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Inigo'''</br>
'''Hamish:''' Inigo taught me a trick or two since I joined Mr Morris' little crowd. Quite a nice old chap who's seen much of the world and knows his way around here. You should definitely ask him if you need help.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Morris'''</br>
'''Hamish:''' If it wasn't for Mr Morris, maybe none of us would be alive. Or at least, none of us would be here. He's been everywhere and gathered some adventurers around him to investigate the secrets of Dawnport.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Coltrayne'''</br>
'''Hamish:''' Never asked about his past. Seems it's a pretty gloomy one. But he's an excellent blacksmith and seems content enough with his work here.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Garamond'''</br>
'''Hamish:''' Can be quite feisty if you doubt his seniorship. <snorts> Knows a thing or two about spells, though. Useful knowledge.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Plunderpurse'''</br>
'''Hamish:''' Now there's someone who has lived life to the full! Don't know though whether I should really believe that he's a clerk now.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Richard'''</br>
'''Hamish:''' Seems good-natured enough a guy. Nimble with his hands, be it cooking or carpentering. Seems to want to keep his mind off something, so he's always busy fixing stuff or cooking something up.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Ser Tybald'''</br>
'''Hamish:''' I wish I had thought of changing my name to that of a hero. Would have smoothed my way no end! ...</br>
'''Hamish:''' Anyway, whatever he was before he joined, Tybald now fits the bill of the legendary hero. He even has a crush on lady Oressa. Cute. <chuckles></br>
''Jogador:'' '''Wentworth'''</br>
'''Hamish:''' Keeran? He's a bit like Plunderpurse's shadow, isn't he? Loves numbers, but I believe underneath it all he always wanted to break out of his boring little job in the city.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Menesto'''</br>
'''Hamish:''' Hah, I told him he should take a potion or two! But nooo, he's always so sure of himself. Huh. Well, you'd better tell Oressa to patch him up, then.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Fluid'''</br>
'''Hamish:''' Ahah, you're a seasoned expert I see! But I'm sorry to say that life and mana fluids nowadays are no longer traded. However, we offer health and mana potions up to two sizes, just ask me for a trade. </br>
''Jogador:'' '''Potion'''</br>
'''Hamish:''' Great stuff. Potions will instantly refill something of your health or mana, which makes them very useful in a tight corner during a fight! ... </br>
'''Hamish:''' But you should always leave some capacity to carry your loot - loot can be made into gold to buy even more potions and stuff! <grins> ... </br>
'''Hamish:''' There are three kinds of potions in Tibia. Health and mana potions are the most frequently used, and can be used by everyone. ... </br>
'''Hamish:''' Then there's the spirit potion, which only very experienced paladins can use, to refill their holy magic powers. But that's for much later! ... </br>
'''Hamish:''' Here on Dawnport, I offer mana potions as well as small health potions and normal health potions. That's all you need right now, so don't worry. You will be able to purchase bigger mana and health potions in shops on the mainland, of course. </br>
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''</br>
'''Hamish:''' Use your runes wisely!
}}<noinclude>[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]</noinclude>

pages.title: Ser Tybald
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Ser Tybald | job = Knight Guild Leader | job2 = Paladin Guild Leader | city = Dawnport | subarea = Dawnport Centre | location = [[Dawnport Centre]] ({{mapa|32071,31881,4:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 10.55 | notes =Tybald era responsável por ensinar [[magias]] para [[Knights]] e [[Paladins]] iniciantes.

A partir do update '''15.22''', lançado em '''27 de janeiro de 2026''', não é mais possível comprar magias com este NPC. A CipSoft removeu a interação com a palavra '''"spell"''' e a funcionalidade de compra de magias, já que elas passaram a ser aprendidas automaticamente assim que o jogador atinge o nível necessário. | buysell = não | buys = Nada. | sells = Nada. | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Ser Tybald:''' Be greeted, young adventurer. If you have a question pertaining to spells, ask.
''Jogador:'' '''Spells'''
'''Ser Tybald:''' Each vocation has their own unique spells to enhance their fighting or defense, which none of the other vocations can use, and which you can only learn at a spell trainer of your vocation. ...
'''Ser Tybald:''' As you are still very young, you do not yet have many spells at your disposal. As you level up, more spells will be available to you. ...
'''Ser Tybald:''' Here on Dawnport, you can try out spells for free, but you will forget them once you leave for the Tibian Mainland. On Main, you will have to buy a spell at a spell teacher in a city in order to permanently know this spell.
''Jogador:'' '''Tibian mainland'''
'''Ser Tybald:''' Tibia is the world we live in. Dawnport is not far off from the Tibian Mainland, though it's a tricky passage with contrary winds. On Main, you will find more adventure, mystery and monsters and can prove yuorself a hero or villain.
''Jogador:'' '''Rookgaard'''
'''Ser Tybald:''' Ah, that was a long, long time ago.
''Jogador:'' '''Dawnport'''
'''Ser Tybald:''' From afar, the island glowed at midnight as if dawn was at hand. A fierce magical light, beckoning, calling out, promising power past redemption - but I am sure Garamond has a better idea as to the exact nature of that magical power. ...
'''Ser Tybald:''' To me however, it seemed almost holy, but with a potential to fall from grace. In short, it seemed to hold a promise of everything that is possible, be it good or bad. And after this light, the island was named. ...
'''Ser Tybald:''' TAnd indeed, the islands hosts many monsters that seem to crave the magical power as we do. But why? What does it offer them? Does one of their strange gods tell them to? ...
'''Ser Tybald:''' Be that as it may, we need help in defeating the hordes. We are but a handful of weather-beaten men and a beautiful lady, and we seem weak against these creatures, weaker than you. ...
'''Ser Tybald:''' So I will teach you spells that you may use in your fight against the evil that lurks here.
''Jogador:'' '''Tibia'''
'''Ser Tybald:''' Tibia is the world we live in. Dawnport is not far off from the Tibian Mainland, though it's a tricky passage with contrary winds. On Main, you will find more adventure, mystery and monsters and can prove yuorself a hero or villain.
''Jogador:'' '''Coltrayne'''
'''Ser Tybald:''' Now there is someone who has had his share of grief. No wonder he came to Dawnport to assist raising new heroes for the Tibian lands.
''Jogador:'' '''Hamish'''
'''Ser Tybald:''' The embodiment of a single-minded scientist. Lives for potions and alchemical explosions. Never sees the beauty of the lands, only their usefulness. Still, a master of his craft.
''Jogador:'' '''Inigo'''
'''Ser Tybald:''' He's a mentor to all young adventurers. If you have a question as to what you should or could do, and how this world works, talk to Inigo, he will be happy to help.
''Jogador:'' '''Mr Morris'''
'''Ser Tybald:''' We know each other from old, yes. Will we talk about it? No.
''Jogador:'' '''Oressa'''
'''Ser Tybald:''' What a beautiful lady. Do you know the Lay of the White Lady Illadria? ...
'''Ser Tybald:''' 'Calm and slender like a birch, soft and white like snow, yet strong and warm like the sun she is.' Well, it fits perfectly. I am her sworn protector.
''Jogador:'' '''Plunderpurse'''
'''Ser Tybald:''' That old pirate has settled down now it seems.
''Jogador:'' '''Richard'''
'''Ser Tybald:''' He's quite a good cook, which helps improve the mood on bad days. He's a carpenter by trade. Did a good job reinforcing this outpost, too.
''Jogador:'' '''Ser'''
'''Ser Tybald:''' It used to be a kind of title in other times, but it serves nicely as a first name here.
''Jogador:'' '''Tybald'''
'''Ser Tybald:''' My namesake was a remarkable figure in his days. He was a great hunter and fighter, and if you wish to become one also, you should learn a few spells for your future vocation.
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''
'''Ser Tybald:''' I am Ser Tybald.
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
'''Ser Tybald:''' My work is to teach young adventurers spells to use in combat or in a close corner. I specialise in paladin and knight spells for young adventurers from level 8 to 19.
''Jogador:'' '''Magic'''
'''Ser Tybald:''' Can be very efficient against monsters, especially if you are a magic-wielding sorcerer or druid. Knights are not very proficient magic users, but paladins can use holy magic, which is particularly effective against the undead.
''Jogador:'' '''Holy'''
'''Ser Tybald:''' Holy magic is one of the paladin's strengths. Using it, they can easily hunt anything that is undead, like skeletons or mummies. The other magic elements are more for druids or sorcerers.
''Jogador:'' '''Elements'''
'''Ser Tybald:''' Apart from holy magic, there's death, fire, earth, ice and energy magic. Each element is particularly effective against creatures of another element. Paladin#s can use only few of the other elements, they rely on holy magic.
''Jogador:'' '''Death'''
'''Ser Tybald:''' That's a lesson for another day.
''Jogador:'' '''Fire'''
'''Ser Tybald:''' Fire spells or a paladin's fire arrows are useful against earth creatures. Everything that crawls and sneaks, like spiders or worms, is an easy prey.
''Jogador:'' '''Earth'''
'''Ser Tybald:''' Earth spells or earth arrows are used against energy creatures. You can't always easily recognise those... but it's the spirit and wind type of monsters.
''Jogador:'' '''Ice'''
'''Ser Tybald:''' That's a lesson for another day.
''Jogador:'' '''Energy'''
'''Ser Tybald:''' Use energy spells or energy arrows against ice and water monsters. Fry your own fish, so to speak.
''Jogador:'' '''Quest'''
'''Ser Tybald:''' What is your quest? Oh, I see. No, my quest is to teach, as a penance for... never mind. If you seek a quest, you should ask Mr Morris, he always has something that needs doing.
''Jogador:'' '''Menesto'''
'''Ser Tybald:''' Ah, still so young and naive about the gods and demons... Still, I envy him his unspoilt beliefs. If I could turn back time... but never mind my ramblings. Are you perhaps here for a spell or two?
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
'''Ser Tybald:''' Always stay upwind, ! }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.title: Plunderpurse
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}}
| name        = Plunderpurse
| job         = Banqueiro
| city        = Dawnport
| subarea     = Dawnport Centre
| location    = [[Dawnport Centre]] ({{mapa|32055,31900,4:2|aqui}}).
| implemented = 10.55
| notes       = Plunderpurse é o banqueiro de Dawnport. Você pode depositar e tirar dinheiro, além de checar o balanço de sua conta. Ele também irá lhe ensinar como funciona o banco.
| buysell     = não
| buys        = 
| sells       =
| falas       = 
''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''</br>
'''Plunderpurse:''' Welcome, young adventurer! Harr! Deposit your gold or withdraw your money from your bank account. I can also explain the functions of your bank account to ya.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Functions'''</br>
'''Plunderpurse:''' Every Tibian has a global bank account. This means you can deposit your gold in one bank, and withdraw it from the same or any other Tibian bank in any city. ...</br>
'''Plunderpurse:''' Here on Dawnport, I run the bank. I keep any gold you deposit safe, so you can't lose it when you're out fighting or dying, heh. Ask me for your balance to learn how much money you've already saved. ...</br>
'''Plunderpurse:''' There are also advanced functions, but those are only available to you once you have reached the Tibian Mainland.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Advanced'''</br>
'''Plunderpurse:''' Once you are on the Tibian mainland, you can access new functions of your bank account, such as changing money, transferring money to other players safely or taking part in house auctions.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Change gold'''</br>
'''Plunderpurse:''' Ah, wonderful stuff! That and a bottle o' rum, o'course! Harrharr. You have some gold you want to deposit or withdraw, just tell me.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Job
'''Plunderpurse:''' Arr! I'm a  pira... er, I mean <cough> <cough>  ... clerk. Banking clerk. That's what I am. You need somethin'? Bank business, p'raps?</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Bank'''</br>
'''Plunderpurse:''' You can deposit and withdraw money from your bank account here.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Rookgaard'''</br>
'''Plunderpurse:''' Arrr. Not a very profitable place.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''</br>
'''Plunderpurse:''' Abram Plunderpurse, at your service. <bows></br>
''Jogador:'' '''Dawnport''' ou '''Dawn'''</br>
'''Plunderpurse:''' Yeah, well, some romantic at work there. Island was reached at dawn, new heroes and adventurers forthcoming, stuff like that. ...</br>
'''Plunderpurse:''' It's a nice enough island, but a bit small. Perfect training grounds before we unleash you on the Mainland! <winks></br>
''Jogador:'' '''Mainland'''</br>
'''Plunderpurse:''' Aye, Tibia is a vast world, my friend, with plenty of adventures, harbours, and loot! The Mainland is open to everyone; but there are many beautiful islands and more cities to explore, if you have premium rights and can use a ship. ...</br>
'''Plunderpurse:''' Once you have reached level 8 here on this isle, you can choose your definite vocation and leave for the Mainland.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Vocation'''</br>
'''Plunderpurse:''' There's a choice of four: knight, sorcerer, paladin or druid.  ...</br>
'''Plunderpurse:''' Exit through one of the four gates and you will be equipped with the specific gear of that vocation, so you can see which one suits you best. ...</br>
'''Plunderpurse:''' If you need more information on this subject, go ask Inigo.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Inigo'''</br>
'''Plunderpurse:''' He's an ol' trapper and knows his away around in Tibia, aye. Ask him how a thing works and he'll be sure to have an answer. ...</br>
'''Plunderpurse:''' That old hand can teach you a trick or two. Also buys any creature products you may have. Too old to go out hunting now, alas.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Coltrayne'''</br>
'''Plunderpurse:''' Gloomy sort. Keeps glaring at me for some reason. Or maybe for no reason, harr. Formidable blacksmith, anyway. Sharpest sword blade I've seen in a long time. </br>
''Jogador:'' '''Garamond'''</br>
'''Plunderpurse:''' Fetching white beard, I hope I grow one in due time, would impress the younger folk no end! Knowing some sorcerer and druid spells like he does wouldn't come amiss, either. Go to him if you need mage spells. </br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hamish'''</br>
'''Plunderpurse:''' Could've used his talent to brew up some more explosive runes back in the sea fight against... ah well, you wouldn't know the name anyway. Gotta admit, his potions are good stuff. </br>
''Jogador:'' '''Mr Morris'''</br>
'''Plunderpurse:''' That's Mr Morris to you, friend. Go get yourself a useful thing to do and ask him about a quest, will you. </br>
''Jogador:'' '''Quest'''</br>
'''Plunderpurse:''' Not my line of trade, friend! Mr Morris next door will tell you what needs doin' around here. </br>
''Jogador:'' '''Oressa'''</br>
'''Plunderpurse:''' Harrr, what a dame! Would like to buy her a pint one day. <leers> Unless she kills me with one of her icy looks first. Anyway, decent healer. Can help ya with choosing a vocation. </br>
''Jogador:'' '''Plunderpurse'''</br>
'''Plunderpurse:''' Aye, what about my name? You don't like it? Well, you don't have to wear it! And I am quite happy with that! </br>
''Jogador:'' '''Richard'''</br>
'''Plunderpurse:''' <shifts uneasily> Well, maybe I did come across his ship some time. In bad weather. And couldn't do a thing for those poor souls. And anyway, he swam ashore here. So it all worked out in the end, see. </br>
''Jogador:'' '''Ser Tybald'''</br>
'''Plunderpurse:''' I could swear he looks like that old pal I met back on... ah well, much salt water passed my ship since then. If ye need a spell or two for a knight or paladin, he's the spell teacher to go to. </br>
''Jogador:'' '''Wentworth'''</br>
'''Plunderpurse:''' Arrr. We go wayyyy back, Keeran an' me. Best you ask him, I'm no good at details. </br>
''Jogador:'' '''Menesto'''</br>
'''Plunderpurse:''' Heh heh. Took his gold off him in that last poker round, aye. Nice lad though, nice lad. </br>
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''</br>
'''Plunderpurse:''' Good bye, and remember: entrusting us with your gold is the safest way of storing it! Heh heh.
}}<noinclude>[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]</noinclude>

pages.title: Mr Morris
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Mr Morris | job = Roleplay | city = Dawnport | subarea = Dawnport Centre | location = [[Dawnport Centre]] ({{mapa|32070,31897,5:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 10.55 | notes =

* Faz parte da [[Dawnport Quest]].

 | buysell = não | buys = | sells = | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Mr Morris:''' Welcome, young adventurer. If you seek to help me with some things, I might have a little quest or mission for you.
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
'''Mr Morris:''' There's always someone who needs to be at the front, to take the first step into the unknown. My whole life has been full of such steps.
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''
'''Mr Morris:''' Mr Morris will do.
''Jogador:'' '''Dawnport'''
'''Mr Morris:''' Ah, that old story of how it was named? I spread it around. Can't remember really what its origins are. Interesting archeological findings here, though.
''Jogador:'' '''Secrets of dawnport'''
'''Mr Morris:''' Ah yes. Well, the magic that led us here seems to be most potent at a certain time, close before sunrise. Perhaps like a giant pulse, or beacon. Maybe the gods set it here, or a mad sorcerer, we don't know for sure yet... The portal deep down in the caves, resonating with magical energy where you came through, can maybe bring something else into this world as well. So it must be carefully guarded while we investigate the island for more clues... There are some very interesting archeological findings here on the island throughout. Seems the island has drawn some cults here, but why they are gone now, no one knows.
''Jogador:'' '''Archeological'''
'''Mr Morris:''' It seems that throughout its history, this island was inhabited by very different species. I like to study their remains.
''Jogador:'' '''Rookgaard'''
'''Mr Morris:''' Yeah. Long time I haven't been to that place. How's old Vascalir? Still hanging around in the academy? And Kraknaknork? Hah, I remember our brawl after that last card game. Fun times.
''Jogador:'' '''Guild '''
'''Mr Morris:''' Ah, I couldn't live without the thrill of adventure! The Adventurer's Guild has grown too relaxed, to my mind. I wasn't content staying there or just going on some small field trip into the Pits of Inferno! ...
'''Mr Morris:''' The Guild really needs some shaking up, some fresh blood. Well, anyway, the old adventurers were very keen on me exploring the far-off corners of our world. ...
'''Mr Morris:''' And I certainly wasn't going to miss the opportunity. On my way to some far-off corner, I fond this island and felt it was ideal for the training of young adventurers. So that's what we do here.
''Jogador:'' '''Coltrayne '''
'''Mr Morris:''' What about him? Is he in one of his dark moods again? That's his normal mood, I mean. Just buy your armor, weaponry and ammunition there and don't worry.
''Jogador:'' '''Garamond '''
'''Mr Morris:''' Tired of the academy, maybe, but not of teaching. If you need druid or sorcerer spells, go to him.
''Jogador:'' '''Hamish '''
'''Mr Morris:''' Ah, good old Hamish. A real wizard with potions. Will supply you with very useful magic equipment for hunting.
''Jogador:'' '''Inigo '''
'''Mr Morris:''' Ran across Inigo a few times on some remote islands, years and years ago. Talked him into coming along here, and he seems to enjoy helping newcomers find their way. Passing his knowledge on to the next generation.
''Jogador:'' '''Mr Morris '''
'''Mr Morris:''' Exactly. Has a nice ring to it.
''Jogador:'' '''Oressa '''
'''Mr Morris:''' She's a good listener if you should still hesitate as to the choice of your definite vocation.
''Jogador:'' '''Plunderpurse '''
'''Mr Morris:''' Well, for him it's always been just a question of 'Your gold or your life' - gold it is nowadays. You can stash your loose change at ol' Abram, but make sure to withdraw it once you leave Dawnport!
''Jogador:'' '''Richard '''
'''Mr Morris:''' We found him here half-dead and fixed him up, now he fixes us dinner and roof beams. Definitely someone you should check out for food, a rope and a shovel.
''Jogador:'' '''Ser Tybald '''
'''Mr Morris:''' Been together through many a desperate situation. A romantic underneath it all. Found the time to specialise on spells for paladins and knights somewhere along the way.
''Jogador:'' '''Wentworth '''
'''Mr Morris:''' Be careful that he doesn't bore you to death with accountants of, well, your bank account history.
''Jogador:'' '''Woblin '''
'''Mr Morris:''' Ah, the goblin who sneaks around here now and then? Lives in a cave to the west, somewhere.
''Jogador:'' '''Stone'''
'''Mr Morris:''' The Adventurer's Stone is imbued with magic that resonates in harmony with the magical energies of the temples in the cities of Tibia. . ...
'''Mr Morris:''' It only works if you're inside a city temple, but it can be any city temple - like Venore or Liberty Bay or Darashia - the stone will always work in a city temple and teleport you to the Adventurer's Guild upon use. ...
'''Mr Morris:''' Once you choose your vocation and leave Dawnport, you'll receive the Adventurer's Stone along with your vocation equipment. ...
'''Mr Morris:''' Once you're on the mainland in a city, maybe Venore, I recommend you use it in a temple and check out the Guild - old Rotem Valos is a nice guy to chat to.
''Jogador:'' '''Legion'''
'''Mr Morris:''' You ask after a legion helmet? I'm not aware that Coltrayne has one in stock, and it seems we're the first humans to set foot on this island... so if there is a legion helmet on Dawnport, it has not been found yet.
''Jogador:'' '''Book'''
'''Mr Morris:''' I have begun retrieving information. This is very interesting. Apparently they found lots of monsters, caves, and hidden treasures. Or maybe that blotch there means 'not a lot'? Anyway, lots to read and learn!
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
'''Mr Morris:''' Watch your back, young friend.
}}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}}
| name        = Oressa
| job         = Curador
| job2        = Sacerdote
| city        = Dawnport
| subarea     = Dawnport Centre
| location    = [[Dawnport Centre]] ({{mapa|32064,31892,6:2|aqui}}).
| implemented = 10.55
| notes       = Oressa irá oferecer informações sobre cada vocação para novos aventureiros além de cura caso o jogador esteja [[Poison|envenenado]], [[Fire|queimado]] ou [[Energy|eletrificado]].
| buysell     = não
| falas       =
''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''</br>
'''Oressa:''' Welcome to the temple of Dawnport, child. If you need healing, I can help you. Ask me about a vocation if you need counsel.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''</br>
'''Oressa:''' I am Oressa Fourwinds, the healer.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''</br>
'''Oressa:''' I can heal you if you are hurt. I can also help you choose your vocation.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Healer'''</br>
'''Oressa:''' If you are hurt my child, I will heal your wounds.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Vocation''' ou '''choose'''</br>
'''Oressa:''' A vocation is your profession and destiny, determining your skills and way of fighting. There are four vocations in Tibia: knight, sorcerer, paladin or druid. Each one has its unique special abilities. ...</br>
'''Oressa:''' When you leave the outpost through one of the four gates upstairs, you will be equipped with training gear of a specific vocation in order to defend yourself against the monsters outside. ...</br>
'''Oressa:''' You can try them out as often as you wish to. When you have gained enough experience to reach level 8, you are ready to choose the definite vocation that is to become your destiny. ...</br>
'''Oressa:''' Think carefully, as you can't change your vocation later on! You will have to choose your vocation in order to leave Dawnport for the main continent through one of these doors behind me. ...</br>
'''Oressa:''' Talk to me again when you are ready to choose your vocation, and I will set you on your way.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Knight'''</br>
'''Oressa:''' Knights are stalwart melee fighters, the toughest of all vocations. They can take more damage and carry more items than the other vocations, but they will deal less damage than paladins, druids or sorcerers. ...</br>
'''Oressa:''' Knights can wield one- or two-handed swords, axes and clubs, and they can cast a few spells to draw a monster's attention to them. ...</br>
'''Oressa:''' If you want to be a tough melee fighter who can resist much longer than anyone else, you should consider choosing the knight vocation.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Sorcerer'''</br>
'''Oressa:''' Sorcerers are powerful casters of death, energy and fire magic. They can do a little ice or earth damage as well. ...</br>
'''Oressa:''' Sorcerers cannot take much damage or carry many items, but they deal more damage than paladins or knights, and can target several enemies. ...</br>
'''Oressa:''' If you wish to be a caster of fire and energy, hurling death magic at your foes, you should consider choosing the sorcerer vocation.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Paladin'''</br>
'''Oressa:''' Paladins are sturdy distance fighters. They are tougher than druids or sorcerers and can carry more items, but they are less tough than a knight. ...</br>
'''Oressa:''' Paladins have the longest attack range, and can deal the most damage on a single target. ...</br>
'''Oressa:''' They can also use holy magic to slay the unholy and undead in particular. ...</br>
'''Oressa:''' If you like to keep a distance to your enemy, shooting while you outdistance him, you should consider choosing the paladin vocation.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Druid'''</br>
'''Oressa:''' Druids are healers and powerful masters of ice and earth magic. They can also do a little energy, fire or death damage as well. ...</br>
'''Oressa:''' Druids cannot take much damage or carry many items, but they deal more damage than paladins or knights, and can target several enemies. ...</br>
'''Oressa:''' If you wish to be a healer and wielder of powerful natural magic, you should consider choosing the druid vocation.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Doors'''</br>
'''Oressa:''' Behind each of those doors, the equipment and skills of one vocation lies - sorcerer, paladin, knight or druid. ...</br>
'''Oressa:''' When you have reached level 8, you can choose your definite vocation. You have to talk to me to receive it, and then you may open one of the doors, take up your vocation's gear, and leave the island. But be aware: ...</br>
'''Oressa:''' Once you have chosen your vocation and stepped through a door, you cannot go back or choose a different vocation. So choose well!</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Inigo'''</br>
'''Oressa:''' He has seen much, and likes to help the younger ones. If you have questions about what to do, or whom to ask for anything, go to Inigo.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Richard'''</br>
'''Oressa:''' Found a new way of living and took to it like a fish to water.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Coltrayne'''</br>
'''Oressa:''' Ah. Some wounds never heal. <sighs> Shipwrecked in body and mind. Nowhere to go, so he doesn't leave.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Morris'''</br>
'''Oressa:''' He broods over problems he won't share. But maybe you can help him with a little quest or two.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hamish'''</br>
'''Oressa:''' He lives only for his experiments and potions.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Dawnport'''</br>
'''Oressa:''' This is a strange place. Many beings are called to it. I dreamed of it long before I came here. ...</br>
'''Oressa:''' Something spoke to me, telling me I had to be its voice; a voice of the Oracle here for the sake of the adventurers that would come to defend Tibia against evil and need to choose their destiny.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Rookgaard'''</br>
'''Oressa:''' I have heard of it, yes.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Oressa'''</br>
'''Oressa:''' Yes, that is my name. <bows > Please tell me if you need healing or help in choosing a vocation. </br>
''Jogador:'' '''Garamond'''</br>
'''Oressa:''' He was known far and wide as a very able spell teacher, but some day he decided not to lead a quiet life anymore. </br>
''Jogador:'' '''Spell'''</br>
'''Oressa:''' Spells are magic cast. Each vocation has their own unique spells to boost their attack or increase their defense. Sorcerers and druids have more spells at the ready than paladins or knights. ... </br>
'''Oressa:''' You can learn spells at a spell teacher. Normally, you have to buy your spells at a teacher on the mainland. ... </br>
'''Oressa:''' Here on Dawnport, you can try out some spells for free - you only need the required vocation and the minimum level for the spell of your choice. Talk to Garamond for sorcerer and druid spells, and to Ser Tybald for knight and paladin spells. ... </br>
'''Oressa:''' Once you choose your definite vocation, you will forget these tryout spells. In order to really learn a spell, you will have to visit a spell teacher of your vocation in one of the major cities on the mainland. </br>
''Jogador:'' '''Menesto'''</br>
'''Oressa:''' He is injured? Then I should see to his wounds. I will pack some Dawnfire herbs and be off presently. Thank you. </br>
''Jogador:'' '''Plunderpurse'''</br>
'''Oressa:'''  He underwent an astonishing change a few years ago, when he quit his old... profession. </br>
''Jogador:'' '''Tybald'''</br>
'''Oressa:'''  He seems to like the strange company he's in now, but he never talks about himself. He is particularly silent in my company, though very chivalrous. </br>
''Jogador:'' '''Portal'''</br>
'''Oressa:'''  Yes, you said you came through it? It sounds so strange when you talk about your world, almost as if you told a dream. </br>
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''</br>
'''Oressa:''' Good bye, child.
}}<noinclude>[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]</noinclude>

{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Inigo | job = Comerciante | city = Dawnport | subarea = Dawnport Centre | location = [[Dawnport Centre]] ({{mapa|32070,31900,5:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 10.55 | notes = Inigo está no andar térreo do posto avançado da Adventurers' Guild em Dawnport e dará dicas e explicará todo o funcionamento do jogo para novos jogadores.

* O NPC [[Inigo]] pode te mandar para rookgaard, basta dizer: '''Hi - Rookgaard - Yes''' * Ao sair, você não poderá mais voltar, todos os equipamentos de Dawnport ficarão e você receberá o set básico de Rookgaard.

| buysell = sim | buys = {{Trades/Buy | Acorn | Antlers | Badger Fur | Bat Wing | Bear Paw | Broken Crossbow | Broken Helmet | Broken Shamanic Staff | Bunch of Troll Hair | Carrion Worm Fang | Cyclops Toe | Damselfly Eye | Damselfly Wing | Goblin Ear | Honeycomb | Lump of Dirt | Marsh Stalker Beak | Marsh Stalker Feather | Minotaur Horn | Minotaur Leather | Orc Leather | Orc Tooth | Pelvis Bone | Piece of Archer Armor | Piece of Swampling Wood | Poison Spider Shell | Purple Robe | Scorpion Tail | Shamanic Hood | Skull Belt | Small Pitchfork | Spider Fangs | Swampling Moss | Wolf Paw}} | sells = Nada. | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Inigo:''' You came through the portal! Though it must be different from where you came from, I'm sure you can help us. But first, I can help YOU.
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''
'''Inigo:''' Ah, back in the old days, I was called Inigo Verasquiriz, but I doubt my family would acknowledge me. Those that are still alive, that is.
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
'''Inigo:''' I used to be a hunter and trapper, but these bones have grown weary. I now tan furs and hides and trade in creature products. And I can help you find your way if you need directions.
''Jogador:'' '''Portal'''
'''Inigo:''' It seems to emanate a magical call or pulse that draws all sorts of creatures to it - no offense meant. When we first found it, we were flabbergasted - we thought maybe a mad sorcerer had built it, or a cult, to summon something evil. ...
'''Inigo:''' But we didn't find any conclusive hints. Menesto and a few others volunteered to guard the portal from the monsters of this isle. You say you came through it from your world! Astounding. ...
'''Inigo:''' You couldn't have chosen a better time. We really need help against the monsters that swarm this island, and the whole world of Tibia. If you're unsure on how to help exactly, I can give you directions.
''Jogador:'' '''Menesto'''
'''Inigo:''' Hasn't been with us for very long. Very interested in all things mystical, so Menesto was sent down to guard the strange crystal portal we found here. ...
'''Inigo:''' ... But of course, you met him. ... So it really is a portal, and you came through it from another plane of existence! I never quite believed the tales of old, not really. But now... it's wonderful, truly wonderful. ...
'''Inigo:''' Well, if you have any questions as to THIS plane of existence, which we call Tibia, just ask me. I can give directions, hints, you name it.
''Jogador:'' '''Tibia'''
'''Inigo:''' That's where we are - the world of Tibia. We're on a small island called Dawnport, not far from the coast of the Tibian Mainland, to be precise.
''Jogador:'' '''Play'''
'''Inigo:''' Our world Tibia is swarmed by many dangerous monsters, so fighting is something you will have to learn and master quickly. You can fight as a sorcerer, druid, paladin or knight. ...
'''Inigo:''' We need your help in keeping the monsters at bay - walk out of one of the four gates here, and you will receive one of the four vocations and its gear to try out and fight monsters. ...
'''Inigo:''' Dawnport is just a small, but dangerous island. You will have to reach level 8 at least and choose your definite vocation before you can leave for the mainland. To reach level 8, you will have to fight some monsters in order to progress. ...
'''Inigo:''' Fighting is essential in Tibia, and though Dawnport is quite safe in comparison to the mainland, be careful not to die, as dying HURTS. ...
'''Inigo:''' If you have any other questions, tell me.
''Jogador:'' '''Combat'''
'''Inigo:''' There are many dangers in Tibia. You may have to defend yourself not only against monsters, but if PvP is allowed, against other players, too. ...
'''Inigo:''' To attack, click on your chosen target in the battle list. A red frame will show you which target you are currently attacking. ...
'''Inigo:''' To automatically follow your target, click on 'Chase Opponent' in your combat controls - the top left button. ...
'''Inigo:''' You can also define your attack and defense mode, by selecting offensive, balanced or defensive fighting.
''Jogador:'' '''Pvp'''
'''Inigo:''' Depending on the world you chose in Tibia, players may attack you at all times or only if you consent. ...
'''Inigo:''' On an Optional PvP world, PvP is only possible if both players consent to it; but on Open PvP or Hardcore PvP worlds, any player may always attack you, so be watchful. ...
'''Inigo:''' A brown frame around a player indicates he or she is in a PvP situation. A skull next to a player name means he or she attacked or killed another player. ...
'''Inigo:''' Here on Dawnport, PvP is not allowed inside the outpost, and not possible until you have reached level 8 at least. If you have any other questions, tell me.
''Jogador:'' '''Players'''
'''Inigo:''' To chat with other players, you can click on one of the chat channels and see who is posting in there. ...
'''Inigo:''' If you want to message a specific player, right-click on his or her name and select 'Message to '. This will open up a chat channel where you can type in your message to him or her.
''Jogador:'' '''Npcs''' Ou '''talk'''
'''Inigo:''' NPC means someone like me or Hamish or Coltrayne, for example. You can easily discern us from players like you, because there is a speech bubble next to our name. ...
'''Inigo:''' We all have our different ways, but normally, addressing an NPC with 'hi' or 'hello' will open a conversation. ...
'''Inigo:''' Some NPCs will have secret words that they react to that are not highlighted in their conversation. In that case, you need to type in your question. ...
'''Inigo:''' To do so, open the NPC Chat Channel and click on the empty space below the NPCs dialogue, and start typing. ...
'''Inigo:''' You can try this out by asking an NPC about their job, as this is a keyword most will react to. If you have any other questions, tell me.
''Jogador:'' '''Questing'''
'''Inigo:''' Oh, I can handle my tasks myself, thank you. If you are looking for something to do, you should go to Morris and ask him for quests. You can also help us fight monsters.
''Jogador:'' '''Spells'''
'''Inigo:''' Every vocation has specific spells that can only be used if you have that vocation. Sorcerers and druids of course rely heavily on spells, while knights only have a few at their disposal. ...
'''Inigo:''' As an adventurer in training, you have a few spells at your disposal at the beginning, but more will become available as you progress. ...
'''Inigo:''' Once you're level 8, new spells become available upstairs at the spell trainers Garamond and Tybald. They can tell you more.
''Jogador:'' '''People'''
'''Inigo:''' Well, the other fellows you see here, selling stuff and so forth. Say a name and I'll tell you what I know of him or her.
''Jogador:'' '''Shovel'''
'''Inigo:''' Second best thing to a rope - a shovel will reveal secret entrances buried under loose stone piles, or under sand, or earth... you will see! ...
'''Inigo:''' Shovels can be bought at Richard's, like the other equipment, or food. If you don't have the money yet, go out and kill some monsters outside - and maybe you'll even find a shovel, who knows!
''Jogador:'' '''Dawnport'''
'''Inigo:''' We found the island following a strange glow we saw at night, close before dawn. We were looking for a source of unknown, powerful magic, and it seemed that this island was its source. ...
'''Inigo:''' When we arrived, we found goblins, minotaurs, trolls and undead warring on this island. We wondered why. Then they seemed to reach an agreement, and settled down in the caves. We decided to investigate. ...
'''Inigo:''' That is when we found the strange crystal portal, through which you came. Perhaps this is why the monsters battle, but won't leave. ...
'''Inigo:''' It certainly is a place of power, so Menesto's group was sent down to guard it. However, we are but few, so we need every help we can get to defend and maintain the outpost on this isle. ...
'''Inigo:''' That is why we need your help - choose the vocation that suits you, take up its arms and help us defend this place against the evil that wants to claim it! If you need any help in how to do these things, ask me.
''Jogador:'' '''Mainland'''
'''Inigo:''' The mainland harbours the most ancient cities of Tibia, and many dangers and adventures as well. When you have helped us defend Dawnport, and learned enough of the ways of Tibia to reach level 8 at least, you should leave for the mainland. ...
'''Inigo:''' There you can continue to battle evil - and believe me, there is much of that in our world, alas. ...
'''Inigo:''' Premium adventurers can also sail to the many islands that surround the mainland, which offer many more dangers and mysteries to be explored; and you can do quests to ride mounts, and dress in a variety of new outfits.
''Jogador:'' '''Fighting'''
'''Inigo:''' Go through one of the open gates on this floor and you will be equipped with training weapons and spells of a specific vocation. ...
'''Inigo:''' There are four vocations in Tibia: knight, druid, paladin and sorcerer. Each one has its unique abilities, strengths and weaknesses. Just try them out to see which one suits you best. ...
'''Inigo:''' We need your help in our battle. Fight monsters to gain experience and better skills, until you reach level 8 at least. Make sure you always have not only a weapon, but a rope with you, as well! ...
'''Inigo:''' Once you reached level 8 or more, you have to choose one vocation as your definite vocation before you can leave for the Tibian mainland, where more dangers await you. ...
'''Inigo:''' To choose your definite vocation, talk to Oressa downstairs in the temple. She can also heal you if you are severely wounded or poisoned - just say 'heal' or 'help' to her. ...
'''Inigo:''' If you have any other questions, tell me.
''Jogador:'' '''Vocations'''
'''Inigo:''' A vocation is your profession and chosen destiny, rolled into one. There are four vocations in Tibia: knight, sorcerer, paladin or druid. Each vocation has its unique special abilities with which to fight evil. ...
'''Inigo:''' You need to choose your vocation before you can leave Dawnport to go to the Mainland. But first, you have to gain enough experience to reach level 8 in order to do so. ...
'''Inigo:''' Once you've reached level 8 and want to choose your definite vocation, talk to Oressa downstairs in the temple. She can also heal you if you are hurt or poisoned. ...
'''Inigo:''' If you have any other questions, tell me.
''Jogador:'' '''Monsters'''
'''Inigo:''' Marvellous specimen we have here on Dawnport! Just be careful when you go hunting them, dying hurts in Tibia! I will happily buy any creature products you may find.
''Jogador:'' '''Questions''' / '''Help''' / '''Directions'''
'''Inigo:''' I can give you directions how to play, some basic survival and combat tips, or explain PvP, ...
'''Inigo:''' I can also tell you how to talk with other players or NPCs, or can inform you about questing or spells. ...
'''Inigo:''' I also have a list of small hints if you prefer that, and can tell you something of the people here. Just tell me what you want to know. ...
'''Inigo:''' Oh, but first that help I mentioned - you should get yourself a shovel, friend. It will come in handy when you set about finding secret entrances to dungeons or hidden treasures - many useful things lie hidden beneath earth, sand or stones!
''Jogador:'' '''Offensive'''
'''Inigo:''' Offensive fighting means you deal harder attacks, but have a weaker defense. Magical damage you deal is not affected by this. ...
'''Inigo:''' You should switch to offensive only if you want to finish off a monster quickly and are sure you can survive its harder attacks. I can also tell you something about balanced and defensive fighting.
''Jogador:'' '''Balanced'''
'''Inigo:''' Balanced fighting balances out your attack strength as well as your defense strength. Magical damage you deal is not affected by this. ...
'''Inigo:''' I can also tell you something about offensive and defensive fighting.
''Jogador:'' '''Defensive'''
'''Inigo:''' Defensive fighting increases your defense but reduces your attack strength. The magical damage you deal is not affected by this. ...
'''Inigo:''' I can also tell you something about offensive and balanced fighting.
''Jogador:'' '''Skull'''
'''Inigo:''' A white skull means that this player attacked and maybe killed another player without justification. ...
'''Inigo:''' A red skull means someone has killed many other players, while a black skull depicts someone on a serious killing spree - so watch out!
''Jogador:'' '''Hamish'''
'''Inigo:''' Some sort of misguided genius, I think. Brilliant with potions and runes, but couldn't get on with his master or with the other students. Ran away and set up his own little lab, selling to travellers along the road. ...
'''Inigo:''' Was robbed and left for dead by some plunderers, when Morris found him. Morris patched him up and said he could use him, so Hamish came here. If you need a wand, rune or potion, Hamish's your man.
''Jogador:'' '''Coltrayne'''
'''Inigo:''' Coltrayne doesn't say much about himself. What I gathered from the 15 years I've known him is that he was raised by a blacksmith as a foundling. ...
'''Inigo:''' When a fire destroyed his foster family's home, he took up an unsteady life, always wandering around. Then he met Morris and decided to go adventuring with him.
''Jogador:'' '''Morris'''
'''Inigo:''' Ah, there are lots of stories about Morris. Likes to insist on the 'Mr'. Nobody knows his first name, and the telling goes that he has gambled with a demon and lost his first name to him. ...
'''Inigo:''' The demon is said to have set Morris free so he can reclaim him at the end of his life, meanwhile having fun watching Morris struggle through hardship and adventures. ...
'''Inigo:''' Anyway. One way or another, Morris picked us all up and gathered us here. Not sure that sending others on missions is really all it's about for him, but if you're looking for a quest, go ask Morris for one.
''Jogador:'' '''Garamond'''
'''Inigo:''' Used to be a professor at the magic academy in Edron, I believe. Likes to see different places, so he joined our illustrous little group. Sells sorcerer and druid spells to our trainees.
''Jogador:'' '''Tybald'''
'''Inigo:''' I'm not sure that's his actual name, but I guess he has good reasons to stay incognito here. In any case, he's a formidable fighter and knows usefull spells for knights and paladins.
''Jogador:'' '''Richard'''
'''Inigo:''' Richard came here as a shipwrecked carpenter, and now sells tools and food to all adventurers. If you need a rope or shovel, fishing rod or some provisions for a hunt, you should trade with him!
''Jogador:'' '''Knight'''
'''Inigo:''' Knights are close combat fighters, the toughest vocation of all. They usually wield melee weapons such as swords, axes or clubs.
''Jogador:'' '''Druid'''
'''Inigo:''' Druids are nature magicians. Their speciality is casting ice and earth magic, as well as providing healing for others.
''Jogador:'' '''Paladin'''
'''Inigo:''' Paladins are well-trained distance fighters and can cast holy magic. You will usually see them wearing bows or crossbows.
''Jogador:'' '''Sorcerer'''
'''Inigo:''' Sorcerers are elemental magicians. They have mastered fire, energy and death magic.
''Jogador:'' '''Skills'''
'''Inigo:''' Not your level, but your skill with your weapon determines how much damage you make. With a distance weapon like a bow, you train your distance fighting skill, with a sword your sword fighting, etc. ...
'''Inigo:''' Druids and sorcerers train their magic level by using their mana through spells and runes. Their wand or rod damage is not affected by their magic level. If you have any other questions, tell me.
''Jogador:'' '''Rope'''
'''Inigo:''' You should never leave without a rope. NEVER. A rope can save your life. I once fell down into a poison spider lair - without a rope, I wouldn't be standing here today! ...
'''Inigo:''' You can buy a rope over at Richard's shop. If you don't have the money, kill and loot a few monsters - maybe one of them even has a rope with it, that sort of thing happens.
''Jogador:'' '''Oressa'''
'''Inigo:''' Our local healer. Don't know why that druid girl decided she wanted the unsteady life of an adventurer, but she's quite hardy, to tell the truth. I once saw her confront a polar bear.... but I'm getting carried away. ...
'''Inigo:''' If you need healing, go see her. Oressa can also help you decide if you want to choose your vocation to leave for the Mainland.
''Jogador:'' '''Temple'''
'''Inigo:''' When you die, you will be resurrected in the temple of the city you chose as your home. Temple NPCs, like Oressa here on Dawnport, can heal you if you're wounded or poisoned. Some special temple NPCs can also bless you. ...
'''Inigo:''' To be fully blessed, you should start the Pilgrimage of Ashes at a local guide in the harbour once you have reached the mainland.
''Jogador:'' '''Dying'''
'''Inigo:''' Don't be deceived by its sweet looks - Tibia is a rough world. If you die, you will lose skill and experience and perhaps even some items, and other players can rob your corpse. ...
'''Inigo:''' On the Mainland, you can buy blessings from temple NPCs to prevent item loss, but you will always lose some skills and experience, so be careful. ...
'''Inigo:''' Always have a rope with you, for a start. A rope is essential.
''Jogador:'' '''Druid Spells'''
'''Inigo:''' Every vocation has specific spells that can only be used if you have that vocation. Sorcerers and druids of course rely heavily on spells, while knights only have a few at their disposal. ...
'''Inigo:''' As an adventurer in training, you have a few spells at your disposal at the beginning, but more will become available as you progress. ...
'''Inigo:''' Once you're level 8, new spells become available upstairs at the spell trainers Garamond and Tybald. They can tell you more.
''Jogador:'' '''Tools'''
'''Inigo:''' In Tibia, you can use different tools with your environment, or for quests. The most important tools are rope and shovel. A fishing rod's also good when you need to eat, and are near a river or the sea.
''Jogador:'' '''Food'''
'''Inigo:''' Food is very important for your health and mana. If you are hurt in a fight with a monster, select 'Use' on food such as cheese, ham or meat to eat it. This will slowly refill your health and mana. Here at the outpost, you can buy food from Richard.
''Jogador:'' '''Fishing Rod'''
'''Inigo:''' Use a fishing rod on a patch of water to see if you can catch fish! Eating is essential in Tibia - if you don't eat when you're hungry, you won't regenerate health or mana. So you should aways have some food with you.
''Jogador:'' '''Train'''
'''Inigo:''' Go through one of the open gates on this floor and you will be equipped with training weapons and spells of a specific vocation. ...
'''Inigo:''' There are four vocations in Tibia: knight, druid, paladin and sorcerer. Each one has its unique abilities, strengths and weaknesses. Just try them out to see which one suits you best. ...
'''Inigo:''' We need your help in our battle. Fight monsters to gain experience and better skills, until you reach level 8 at least. Make sure you always have not only a weapon, but a rope with you, as well! ...
'''Inigo:''' Once you reached level 8 or more, you have to choose one vocation as your definite vocation before you can leave for the Tibian mainland, where more dangers await you. ...
'''Inigo:''' To choose your definite vocation, talk to Oressa downstairs in the temple. She can also heal you if you are severely wounded or poisoned - just say 'heal' or 'help' to her. ...
'''Inigo:''' If you have any other questions, tell me.
''Jogador:'' '''Bless'''
'''Inigo:''' The blessings of the gods will protect you from item loss and alleviate the skill and experience loss when you die. But you will have to undertake the Pilgrimage of Ashes on the mainland to get the blessings. ...
'''Inigo:''' If you die in a fight from a monster's attack, your blessings will be lost, and you will have to get them again. ...
'''Inigo:''' There is also a blessing that will protect you specifically from losses in a PvP fight. This blessing you willl need to get again when you have been killed in a PvP fight. ...
'''Inigo:''' Here on Dawnport, you are protected from losses in a PvP fight by the Adventurer's Blessing - unless you attack another player. If you attack another player or reach level 21, you will lose this blessing.
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''
'''Inigo:''' If you don't know the meaning of an icon on the minimap, move the mouse cursor on it and wait a moment.
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''
'''Inigo:''' If you seek more information, look at or click on objects near you, like wall signs, blackboards or books in book cases - many of them have useful information on Tibia or maybe even a quest you are doing. ...
'''Inigo:''' By the way, to receive more of my hints, just say hint again.
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''
'''Inigo:''' If you want to attack a monster, simply click on it in your battle list. A red frame around a monster shows you are attacking it.
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''
'''Inigo:''' If you already know where you want to go, click on the automap and your character will walk there automatically if the location is reachable and not too far away.
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''
'''Inigo:''' Always have a rope with you! If you fall into a hole and are surrounded by monsters, quickly use the rope with the ropespot to get back up and out.
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''
'''Inigo:''' 'Capacity' restricts the amount of things you can carry with you. It raises with each level.
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''
'''Inigo:''' Always have a look on your health bar. If you see that you do not regenerate health points anymore, eat something.
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''
'''Inigo:''' Always eat as much food as possible. This way, you'll regenerate health points for a longer period of time.
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''
'''Inigo:''' After you have killed a monster, you have 10 seconds in which the corpse is not moveable and no one else but you can loot it.
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''
'''Inigo:''' Be careful when you approach three or more monsters because you only can block the attacks of two! In such a situation, even a few salamanders can do severe damage or even kill you.
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''
'''Inigo:''' There are many ways to gather food. Many creatures drop food but you can also pick blueberries or bake your own bread. If you have a fishing rod and worms in your inventory, you can also try to catch a fish.
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''
'''Inigo:''' Baking bread is rather complex. First of all you need a scythe to harvest wheat. Then you use the wheat with a millstone to get flour. ...
'''Inigo:''' This can be be used on water to get dough, which can be used on an oven to bake bread. Use milk instead of water to get cake dough.
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''
'''Inigo:''' Dying hurts! Better run away than risk your life. You are going to lose experience and skill points when you die. And anyone can loot your corpse if you are not blessed.
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''
'''Inigo:''' When you switch to 'Offensive Fighting', you deal out more damage but you also get hurt more easily.
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''
'''Inigo:''' When you are on low health and need to run away from a monster, switch to 'Defensive Fighting' and the monster will hit you less severely.
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''
'''Inigo:''' Many creatures try to run away from you. Select 'Chase Opponent' to follow them.
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''
'''Inigo:''' The deeper you enter a dungeon, the more dangerous it will be. Approach every dungeon with utmost care or an unexpected creature might kill you. This will result in losing experience and skill points.
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''
'''Inigo:''' Due to the perspective, some objects in Tibia are not located at the spot they seem to appear (ladders, windows, lamps). Try clicking on the floor tile the object would lie on.
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''
'''Inigo:''' Almost as important as a rope is a shovel. Many things can be dug out of the sand, and a pile of loose stones might hide a secret entrance. ...
'''Inigo:''' But if you go down an unknown hole, make sure you have a rope with you to get you out quickly if necessary!
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''
'''Inigo:''' Stairs, ladders and dungeon entrances are marked as yellow dots on the automap.
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''
'''Inigo:''' You can get food by killing animals or monsters. You can also pick blueberries or bake your own bread. If you are too lazy or own too much money, you can also buy food.
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''
'''Inigo:''' Quest containers can be recognised easily. They don't open up regularly but display a message 'You have found ....'. They can only be opened once.
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''
'''Inigo:''' Better run away than risk to die. You'll lose experience and skill points each time you die.
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''
'''Inigo:''' You can form a party by right-clicking on a player and selecting 'Invite to Party'. The party leader can also enable 'Shared Experience' by right-clicking on him- or herself.
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''
'''Inigo:''' You can assign spells, the use of items, or random text to 'hotkeys'. You find them under 'Options'.
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''
'''Inigo:''' You can also follow other players. Just right-click on the player and select 'Follow'.
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''
'''Inigo:''' You can found a party with your friends by right-clicking on a player and selecting 'Invite to Party'. If you are invited to a party, right-click on yourself and select 'Join Party'.
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''
'''Inigo:''' Only found parties with people you trust! You can attack people in your party without getting a skull. This is helpful for training your skills, but can be abused to kill people without having to fear negative consequences.
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''
'''Inigo:''' The leader of a party has the option to distribute gathered experience among all players in the party. If you are the leader, right-click on yourself and select 'Enable Shared Experience'.
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''
'''Inigo:''' If you see someone with a skull symbol next to their name, it means he or she has attacked or even killed another player. Be careful around such people, as their next target might be you.
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''
'''Inigo:''' A brown frame around a player means he or she is in a PvP situation.
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''
'''Inigo:''' To open or close skills, battle or VIP list, click on the corresponding button. The buttons are displayed to the left or right of your game window.
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''
'''Inigo:''' If you want to trade an item with another player, right-click on the item and select 'Trade with ...', then click on the player with whom you want to trade.
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''
'''Inigo:''' Send private messages to other players by right-clicking on the player or the player's name and select 'Message to ....'. You can also open a 'private message channel' and type in the name of the player.
''Jogador:'' '''Hints'''
'''Inigo:''' There is nothing more I can tell you. If you are still in need of some hints, I can repeat them for you.
''Jogador:'' '''Shield'''
'''Inigo:''' To defend yourself against enemies, you will need armor and shields. You can purchase both at Coltrayne's shop.
''Jogador:'' '''Legion'''
'''Inigo:''' Ah yes, an interesting helmet. I am not aware that we have any in stock, though.
''Jogador:'' '''Depot'''
'''Inigo:''' On the Mainland, in every city there is a bank and a depot. A depot is a local stash for items. If you leave an item in a city depot, you need to return to that exact city to retrieve the item. ...
'''Inigo:''' As you can lose items when you die, always make sure you have a reserve rope and items in a depot, just in case!
''Jogador:'' '''Poisonous'''
'''Inigo:''' Poison is very dangerous! Don't ever drink green liquids, they are poisonous and will make you lose health!
''Jogador:'' '''Spider'''
'''Inigo:''' If you face spiders, beware of the poisonous ones. If you are poisoned, you will constantly lose health. Come to Oressa the healer, and she'll heal you from poison.
''Jogador:'' '''Inigo'''
'''Inigo:''' I was the first son and was given the traditional name. They expected much of me, but I disappointed them by becoming an adventurer. But I have never regretted this decision.
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
'''Inigo:''' Good hunting! }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

''Jogador'': '''Hi'''</br>
'''Richard:''' Hello there, mate. Here for a trade? My stock's just been refilled.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''</br>
'''Richard:''' I was a carpenter, back on Main. Wanted my own little shop. Didn't sit with the old man. So I shipped to somewhere else. Terrible storm. ...</br>
'''Richard:''' Woke up on this island. Had to eat squirrels before the adventurers found me and took me in. End of story.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''</br>
'''Richard:''' Richard. Just Richard. Lost my surname with my past in that storm. <winks></br>
''Jogador:'' '''Dawnport'''</br>
'''Richard:''' This island here's not too bad. Once I didn't have to live off squirrels, it became quite enjoyable. Nasty things live underground though, so take care where you tread and ALWAYS have a rope with you! ... </br>
'''Richard:''' Some of the others have been down there, didn't come out without several deep wounds each time. Mr Morris however is quite keen to find out more about the strange magical energies and the monsters deep down. </br>
''Jogador:'' '''Rope'''</br>
'''Richard:''' Only the best quality, I assure you. A rope in need is a friend indeed! Imagine you stumble into a rat hole without a rope - heh, your bones will be gnawed clean before someone finds ya! ...</br>
'''Richard:''' Now, about that rope - ask me for equipment to see my wares. <winks></br>
''Jogador:'' '''Rookgaard'''</br>
'''Richard:''' <shrugs> Never been, mate. Heard it's kinda cute, though.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Squirrel'''</br>
'''Richard:''' Don't talk to ME about squirrels! <shudders> Had to live off them the first days, when they were the only thing to go into my self-made acorn traps. Nasty. ...</br>
'''Richard:''' Can't get rid of horrible dreams of giant squirrels hunting me, now.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Inigo'''</br>
'''Richard:''' Old Inigo was the one who found me, actually, and brought me to the outpost. I was half starved by then. He taught me how to make better traps and how to fish... I owe much to Inigo.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Oressa'''</br>
'''Richard:''' Quiet little lady, her. Knows her way around the isle, looking for herbs and stuff; but mostly spends her time in the temple, helping younglings like you choose a vocation.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Coltrayne'''</br>
'''Richard:''' You know, I really don't want to poke into someone else's private life. Suffice it to say that everyone has chapters of his life he doesn't want to mention. Judging by Coltrayne's looks, we're looking at a trilogy here.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Garamond'''</br>
'''Richard:''' Can you believe how old he is? He won't say it, but I wouldn't be surprised if he had been around for loooooong time.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Morris'''</br>
'''Richard:''' Don't know what to make of him. Great researcher in all Dawnport matters, though. Always has a quest or two where he needs help, if you're looking for adventuring work.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Hamish'''</br>
'''Richard:''' Tries to act tough, but he's quite a witty and decent bloke who wouldn't hurt a fly. We enjoy a good laugh together in the evenings.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Plunderpurse'''</br>
'''Richard:''' You know, on the day that ol' pirate decides to make off with all that gold in the bank, I'm gonna come with him. Should be much more fun landing on a strange island with some gold to spend on booze and babes! <winks></br>
''Jogador:'' '''Ser Tybald'''</br>
'''Richard:''' Always acts his part, that one. Trustworthy in any plight. If it wasn't for his prowess in paladin and knight spells, we'd have had a tough time when the minotaurs once decided to attack - ah long story.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Ham'''</br>
'''Richard:''' Food is very important for your health! I have some keeping provisions here that will serve you nicely when you're in a fight. Ask me for food to dig into my stock. </br>
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''</br>
'''Richard:''' Have fun!
}}<noinclude>[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]</noinclude>

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = One-Eyed Joe | job = Pirata | city = Vandura | subarea = Nargor | location = [[Nargor]] ({{mapa|32026,32885,6:5|aqui}}). | implemented = 10.70 | notes =

* Faz parte da [[The Cursed Crystal Quest]].

 | buysell = não | falas = ''Jogador'': '''hi '''
'''One-Eyed Joe''': Hello there. I'm sorry, I hardly noticed you. I'm a bit nervous. The spooky '''''sounds''''' down there, you know.
''Jogador'': '''name '''
One-Eyed Joe: I'm One-Eyed Joe. From Josephina, got that? And I regard this eye patch as a personal feature of beauty!
''Jogador'': '''job '''
'''One-Eyed Joe''': I'm a pirate. Normally I'm sailing the seas, boarding other ships and gathering treasures. But at the moment my captain graciously assigned me to watch this '''''cursed''''' entrance.
= Para pegar a task = ''Jogador'': '''hi '''
''Jogador'': '''sounds '''
'''One-Eyed Joe''': These caves are incredibly beautiful, crystals in vibrant colours grow there like exotic flowers. There are more than a few captains who send down their men in order to quarry the precious '''''crystals'''''. ...
'''One-Eyed Joe''': But there are few volunteers. Often the crystal gatherers disappear and are never seen again. Other poor fellows then meet their former shipmates in the form of ghosts or skeletons. It's a '''''cursed''''' area, something evil is down there!
''Jogador'': '''crystals '''
'''One-Eyed Joe''': In my humble opinion a pirate should win a fortune by boarding ships not by crawling through caves and tunnels. But who am I to bring into question the captain's decision. All I know is that they sell the crystals at a high price. ...
'''One-Eyed Joe''': A certain amount of the crystals is ground to crystal dust with a special kind of mill. Don't ask me why. Some kind of magical component perhaps that they sell to mages and sorcerers.
''Jogador'': '''cursed '''
'''One-Eyed Joe''': As for myself I haven't been down there. But I heard some disturbing rumours. In these caves are wonderful crystal formations. Some more poetically inclined fellows call them the '''''crystal gardens'''''. ...
'''One-Eyed Joe''': At first glance it seems to be a beautiful - and precious - surrounding. But in truth, deep down in these caverns exists an old evil. Want to hear more?
''Jogador'': '''yes '''
'''One-Eyed Joe''': The evil I mentioned is a strange crystal, imbued with some kind of unholy energy. It is very hard to destroy, no weapon is able to shatter the thing. Maybe a jarring, very loud sound could destroy it. ...
'''One-Eyed Joe''': I heard of creatures, that are able to utter ear-splitting sounds. Don't remember the name, though. Would you go down there and try to destroy the crystal?
''Jogador'': '''yes '''
One-Eyed Joe: Great! Good luck and be careful down there!
''Jogador'': '''hi '''
'''One-Eyed Joe''': Ah, the brave adventurer who sought to destroy the evil crystal down there. Have you been successful?
''Jogador'': '''yes '''
'''One-Eyed Joe''': Hmm ... No, I don't think so. I still feel this strange prickling in my toes.
''Jogador'': '''hi '''
''Jogador'': '''hi '''
'''One-Eyed Joe''': Ah, the brave adventurer who sought to destroy the evil crystal down there. Have you been successful?
''Jogador'': '''no '''
'''One-Eyed Joe''': Too bad.
= Dica para proteger os ouvidos = ''Jogador'': '''protect ears '''
'''One-Eyed Joe''': Protect your ears? Hmm ... Wasn't there some fabulous seafarer who used wax or something to plug his ears? There was a story about horrible bird-women or something ...? No, sounds like hogwash, doesn't it.
= Reportando a Task = ''Jogador'': '''hi '''
'''One-Eyed Joe''': Well done! But know this: The cursed crystal seems to regenerate over time. It could be necessary to come back and repeat whatever you have done down there.
}}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Gilmak Copperbeard | job = Roleplay | city = Tiquanda | subarea = Asura Palace | location = [[Asura Palace]] ({{mapa|32933,32671,5:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 10.80 | notes =

* Faz parte da [[Within the Tides Quest]].

 | buysell = não | falas = ''Jogador'': '''hi '''
[[Gilmak Copperbeard]]: Ha! You're still '''''free''''', lucky you.
''Jogador'': '''name '''
[[Gilmak Copperbeard]]: My name is Gilmak Copperbeard.
''Jogador'': '''job '''
[[Gilmak Copperbeard]]: I'm a dwarf as you may easily see. We have a camp nearby, where my luckier brethren still dwell.
''Jogador'': '''free '''
[[Gilmak Copperbeard]]: Yes, unlike me. I'm a prisoner in this '''''palace'''''. I was careless enough to leave our camp in the north alone. So I was easy prey for the damned asuri.
''Jogador'': '''palace '''
[[Gilmak Copperbeard]]: At the first glance it is a place of great beauty, filled with riches and luxury, as you certainly have noticed yet. But in truth it is a threshold to hell, full of '''''demons'''''.
''Jogador'': '''demons '''
[[Gilmak Copperbeard]]: Yes, the so called asuri. They are demonic creatures who usually hide their '''''faces''''' and appear in the form of a beautiful woman.
''Jogador'': '''faces '''
[[Gilmak Copperbeard]]: In truth they are ugly and ill-favoured. And this palace is as foul as the asuri are. ...
[[Gilmak Copperbeard]]: Behind its marvellous veneer, it is full of prison cells, torture chambers and even rooms where sacrificial altars await the asuri's emaciated victims. Take care of yourself!
''Jogador'': '''bye '''
[[Gilmak Copperbeard]]: Farewell. Take care of yourself! }}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

== Frases Espontâneas ==
'''Cornell''': Passage to Grimvale available here! (''Se estiver em Edron'')</br>
'''Cornell''': Passage to Edron available here! (''Se estiver em Grimvale'')

== Palavras-Chave ==
=== Quando Cornell está em Edron ===
''Jogador'': '''hi '''</br>
'''Cornell''': Welcome on board, Sir ''Jogador''. May I sail you to the island nearby?

''Jogador'': '''sail'''</br>
'''Cornell''': Do you seek a passage to Grimvale for 100 gold?

''Jogador'': '''captain'''</br>
'''Cornell''': I'm offering a little ferry service between Edron and Grimvale.

''Jogador'': '''edron'''</br>
'''Cornell''': The isle of Edron is rumoured to have been the home of a powerful ancient race. But King Tibianus III reclaimed it for humanity and founded a colony.

''Jogador'': '''grimvale'''</br>
'''Cornell''': Grimvale is a small island north-east of here. But I have to warn you - strange and dangerous things are happening there.

''Jogador'': '''island'''</br>
'''Cornell''': Grimvale is not far. I sail there regularly.

''Jogador'': '''dangerous''' / '''curse''' / '''werewolves'''</br>
'''Cornell''': Yes, werewolves, indeed dwell on Grimvale. The were-sickness transforms the peaceful villagers into savage beasts. Why or how this curse found us, we do not know yet. Only that it is here now.

''Jogador'': '''mission'''</br>
'''Cornell''': You may want to go to Maeryn on Grimvale. Perhaps she has something to do for you.

''Jogador'': '''gladys'''</br>
'''Cornell''': Grimvale's druid. She was already old when I was still young, and has been living on Grimvale for ages. She's very interested in were-creature body parts. If you find any, she might give you some coin for them.

-----

=== Quando Cornell está em Grimvale ===
''Jogador'': '''hi '''</br>
'''Cornell''': Welcome on board, Sir ''Jogador''. May I sail you back?

''Jogador'': '''sail''' / '''edron'''</br>
'''Cornell''': Do you seek a passage to Edron for 100 gold?

''Jogador'': '''captain''' / '''fish'''</br>
'''Cornell''': I used to be a fisherman. But it's no use talking of the old, peaceful days...things will never be the same again in this village.

''Jogador'': '''village'''</br>
'''Cornell''': The humble cottages you see over there. The village is usually called Grimvale, just like the island.

''Jogador'': '''grimvale'''</br>
'''Cornell''': Grimvale is the small island you are standing upon. I warned you not to come here, but you wanted to see what was going on.

''Jogador'': '''island'''</br>
'''Cornell''': Then not. Have a nice stay on Grimvale - as far as that's possible here. (''Para de falar com você!'')

''Jogador'': '''mission'''</br>
'''Cornell''': You may want to go to Maeryn. Perhaps she has something to do for you.

''Jogador'': '''gladys'''</br>
'''Cornell''': Our druid. She was already old when I was still young, and has been living here on Grimvale for ages. She's very interested in were-creature body parts. If you find any, she might give you some coin for them.

-----

=== Independente de onde Cornell estiver ===
''Jogador'': '''name'''</br>
'''Cornell''': My name is Cornell.

''Jogador'': '''cornell'''</br>
'''Cornell''': That's my name, alright.

''Jogador'': '''job''' / '''tibia'''</br>
'''Cornell''': I'm offering a little ferry service between Edron and Grimvale.

''Jogador'': '''maeryn'''</br>
'''Cornell''': She's become a kind of protector for this village. A forceful woman, very courageous and experienced with the bow.

''Jogador'': '''owin'''</br>
'''Cornell''': He's the village's most experienced hunter. Not a young man anymore, but he can defend himself well enough against the werewolves. He's the one who knows most about Grimvale's forests, animals, and the werewolves here.

''Jogador'': '''bye'''</br>
'''Cornell''': Good bye.
}}

''Jogador:'' '''job'''
'''Tarun:''' I'm a merchant. I trade in spices, silk, jewelry and ivory. I traveled along the trade routes between Port Hope and Darashia together with my brother. But these times are over, I far.
''Jogador:'' '''merchant'''
'''Tarun:''' I maintain a small caravan to transport my goods between the cities of Darashia and Port Hope. It is even smaller now, as one of the rather greedy members stayed in the Kha'Zeel Mountans.
''Jogador:'' '''greedy'''
'''Tarun:''' Yes, there are rumours about countless treasures, hidden in the dragon lairs there. I warned my fellow not to disturb these dangerous creatures out of simple avarice, but just like my brother, he wouldn't listen tome.
''Jogador:'' '''brother'''
'''Tarun:''' My brother is missing. I fear, he went to this evil palace north of here. A place of great beauty, certainly filled with riches and luxury. But in truth it is a threshold to hell and demonesses are after his blood....
'''Tarun:''' He is my brother, and I am deeply ashamed to admit but I don't dare to go there. Perhaps your heart is more courageous than mine. Would you go to see this place and search for my broter?
''Jogador:'' '''yes'''
'''Tarun:''' I thank you! This is more than I could hpe!
