pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Ninev | job = Sacerdote | job2 = Roleplay | city = Kilmaresh | subarea = Issavi | location = [[Issavi]] ({{mapa|33868,31527,7|aqui}}). | implemented = 12.20 | notes = Nivev é sacerdotisa de Bastesh e cuida de seu templo em Issavi. Sempre que pode, ela cuida de criaturas marinhas em perigo.

* Faz parte da [[Kilmaresh Quest]].

| buysell = não | buys = | sells = | falas = {{TOC left}} {{clear}} === Palavras-Chave Gerais === ''Jogador'': '''Hi'''
'''Nivev''': Bastesh's blessing, dear guest!
''Jogador'': '''Name'''
'''Nivev''': My name is Ninev.
''Jogador'': '''Job'''
'''Nivev''': I'm a priestess of Bastesh and in charge of this temple, together with Iptar Sin, the high priest of Suon. Occasionally I look after wounded marine creatures like this poor shark here.
=== Cidades === ''Jogador'': '''[[Issavi]]'''
'''Nivev''': Issavi is this beautiful city here. It is rich and prosperous and many Kilmareshian sages hail from here. It's a good place for traders and merchants but also for scholars and scientists.
''Jogador'': '''[[Kilmaresh]]'''
'''Nivev''': This is the continent you are currently visiting. You will find vast, dry steppes here as well as high mountains, the river Nykri and the big city Issavi.
''Jogador'': '''[[Krailos]]'''
'''Nivev''': Once it was a part of the old empire. But now it is separated from Kilmaresh by a strait. All of this happened because of Suon's Wrath.
''Jogador'': '''[[Oramond]]'''
'''Nivev''': Oramond lies south of Krailos and is very different from Kilmaresh. Many minotaurs are living there as well as humans.
''Jogador'': '''[[Rathleton]]'''
'''Nivev''': It's a big city in Oramond. They have an Ambassador here in Issavi.
=== Deuses === ''Jogador'': '''[[Bastesh]]'''
'''Nivev''': She Who Knows is the patron of the oceans and sea creatures. My goddess is calm and mystical, the daughter of Uman and Sula. She is also called The Mistress of the Sea or The Keeper of Wisdom. ...
'''Nivev''': She was once attacked by the wild Fafnar, out of jealousy and pride. After the religious war between the worshippers of Suon and Fafnar, we adopted the world view that Suon's true sister wasn't Fafnar but Bastesh. ...
'''Nivev''': So we started worshiping her instead of the Wild Sun. Thus, Bastesh has a firm place in Kilmaresh's religious life for more than a thousand years.
''Jogador'': '''[[Fafnar]]'''
'''Nivev''': Fafnar the Smiter! Beware of her and her followers! Fafnar is the wild and relentless daughter of Fardos and also called the Scorching Sun. Unlike her brother Suon, she observes creation with hate and jealousy. ...
'''Nivev''': Her worship is forbidden in Kilmaresh since the downfall of the old empire and with good reason. Her followers once caused a religious civil war that led to the old empire's destruction. ...
'''Nivev''': But the cult of Fafnar secretly survived and the cultists still plague the new empire. They cause plenty of trouble here in Issavi and in all of Kilmaresh.
''Jogador'': '''Cult'''
'''Nivev''': The Fafnar cultists live and act in secret but they try to exert their influence wherever possible. This can happen by violence or by intrigue. ...
'''Nivev''': Sometimes they raid the city and surrounding villages, sometimes they try to influence powerful people here in Issavi.
''Jogador'': '''[[Fardos]]'''
'''Nivev''': Fardos is considered the creator, often called the Great Observer. We believe that it was his doing that we possess divine souls.
''Jogador'': '''[[Suon]]'''
'''Nivev''': Suon the King is a kind and benevolent god, a son of Fardos and we also call him the Life-Bringing Sun. Unlike his sister Fafnar he observes creation with love and blesses us with warmth and growth. ...
'''Nivev''': If you want to learn more about Suon you should talk to Iptar Sin, his high priest.
''Jogador'': '''Wrath'''
'''Nivev''': The sun god Suon has once smitten this continent because of the blasphemy of Fafnar's worshippers. This happened more than thousand years ago. Since that time, Kilmaresh is separated from the rest of the continent.
=== Midnight Flame === ''Jogador'': '''[[Narsai]]'''
'''Nivev''': She's an actually blind member of the Midnight Flame. There's something going on between her and Alyxo.
''Jogador'': '''Midnight Flame'''
'''Nivev''': This group is a small circle of chosen knights and oracles, led by the lamassu Arishum.
=== Pessoas === ''Jogador'': '''[[Alyxo]]'''
'''Nivev''': She's running the Seaside Theatre. You should go and see one of the performances. Don't be put off by the fact that she's a medusa.
''Jogador'': '''[[Ambassador Of Rathleton|Ambassador]]'''
'''Nivev''': The Ambassador of Rathleton is an envoy of Oramond. He has a residence in the eastern part of the city.
''Jogador'': '''[[Iptar-Sin|Iptar Sin]]'''
'''Nivev''': He is the high priest of Suon in Issavi. We are in charge of this temple together to symbolize the duality of Sun and Sea.
''Jogador'': '''[[Ramina]]'''
'''Nivev''': She's running Issavi's tavern. I encourage you to go for a meal there. Ramina serves delicious menus.
=== Sapphire Blade === ''Jogador'': '''[[Eshaya]]'''
'''Nivev''': He's the leader of the Sapphire Blade.
''Jogador'': '''Sapphire Blade'''
'''Nivev''': They are a group of elite warriors who all carry blades made of tagralt. They defend Issavi against all threats.
''Jogador'': '''Tagralt'''
'''Nivev''': It is a blue metal, only to be found here in Kilmaresh.
''Jogador'': '''[[Moe]]'''
'''Nivev''': I have no idea who you are talking about.
=== The Anuma === ''Jogador'': '''[[The Empress]]'''
'''Nivev''': These days we have a sphinx empress who is ruling Kilmaresh wisely and benevolently.
''Jogador'': '''Anuma'''
'''Nivev''': The Anuma are magical beings that inhabit the continent Kilmaresh. It is told that they were once created by the sun gods Suon and Fafnar. There are several kinds of Anuma: Sphinxes, lamassu, typhoons and manticores.
''Jogador'': '''[[Sphinx|Sphinxes]]'''
'''Nivev''': Sphinxes are generally benevolent towards humans but they are also enigmatic and aloof. Make sure to treat them with all due respect at any time.
''Jogador'': '''[[Lamassu]]'''
'''Nivev''': Lamassu are benevolent towards humans - unless you disturb the peace of holy sites or graveyards. In this case they can be very unforgiving.
''Jogador'': '''[[Gryphon|Gryphons]]'''
'''Nivev''': They don't act hostile towards humans but they are proud and withdrawn creatures. Make sure not to disturb their mountain territories.
''Jogador'': '''[[Manticore|Manticores]]'''
'''Nivev''': Manticores are much less kind than sphinxes or lamassu. Your best bet would be to steer clear of them.
== The Kilmaresh Quest == '''A Shark in Need''' ''Jogador'': '''Hi'''
'''Nivev''': Bastesh's blessing, dear guest!
''Jogador'': '''[[Shark]]'''
'''Nivev''': This poor shark is seriously injured. It seems it was attacked by a sea serpent. Those dangerous creatures seldom stray into the coastal waters around Kilmaresh but sometimes it happens.
'''Nivev''': This shark was lucky enough to escape alive but now it's in need of help. Unfortunately I don't have the needed medicine here in the temple. Would you keep an eye open and look for it while hurling yourself into adventures?
''Jogador'': '''Yes'''
'''Nivev''': You're a kind soul, Bastesh may bless you. What I need is a healing salve that resists salt water. Perhaps you can find some of it out there.
''Jogador'': '''Help'''
'''Nivev''': Did you find the cure?
''Jogador'': '''No'''
'''Nivev''': It is suffering! Please hurry!
''Jogador'': '''Bye'''
'''Nivev''': May Bastesh guard your dreams.
}} [[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

=== Palavras-Chave Gerais ===

''Jogador'': '''Hi'''</br >
'''Iptar-Sin''': Welcome to the Temple of Eternal Light! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.</br >

''Jogador'': '''Name'''</br >
'''Iptar-Sin''': My name is Iptar-Sin.</br >

''Jogador'': '''Job'''</br >
'''Iptar-Sin''': I'm the high priest of Suon and in charge of this temple, together with Ninev, the high priestess of Bastesh.</br >

''Jogador'': '''Heal'''</br >
'''Iptar-Sin''': You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the pilgrimage of ashes or get the protection of the twist of fate here.</br >

''Jogador'': '''[[Pilgrimage of Ashes Quest|Pilgrimage]]'''</br >
'''Iptar-Sin''': Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five blessings you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.</br >

''Jogador'': '''[[Twist of Fate]]'''</br >
'''Iptar-Sin''': This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ...</br >
'''Iptar-Sin''': It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least forty percent of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ...</br >
'''Iptar-Sin''': The twist of fate will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ...</br >
'''Iptar-Sin''': Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of ''x'' gold, child?</br >

''Jogador'': '''[[Blessings]]'''</br >
'''Iptar-Sin''': There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the spiritual shielding, the spark of the phoenix, the embrace of Tibia, the fire of the suns and the wisdom of solitude. Additionally, you can receive the twist of fate here. ...</br >
'''Iptar-Sin''': There are also two enhanced blessings for further reduction of experience loss.</br >

=== Cidades ===

''Jogador'': '''[[Issavi]]'''</br >
'''Iptar-Sin''': Issavi is this beautiful city here. It is rich and prosperous and many Kilmareshian sages hail from here. It's a good place for traders and merchants but also for scholars and scientists.</br >

''Jogador'': '''[[Kilmaresh]]'''</br >
'''Iptar-Sin''': This is the continent you are currently visiting. You will find vast, dry steppes here as well as high mountains, the river Nykri and the big city Issavi.</br >

''Jogador'': '''[[Krailos]]'''</br >
'''Iptar-Sin''': Once it was a part of the old empire. But now it is separated from Kilmaresh by a strait. All of this happened because of Suon's Wrath.</br >

''Jogador'': '''[[Oramond]]'''</br >
'''Iptar-Sin''': Oramond lies south of Krailos and is very different from Kilmaresh. Many minotaurs are living there as well as humans.</br >

''Jogador'': '''[[Rathleton]]'''</br >
'''Iptar-Sin''': It's a big city in Oramond. They have an Ambassador here in Issavi.</br >

=== Deuses ===

''Jogador'': '''[[Fafnar]]'''</br >
'''Iptar-Sin''': Fafnar the Smiter! Beware of her and her followers! Fafnar is the wild and relentless daughter of Fardos and also called the Scorching Sun. Unlike her brother Suon, she observes creation with hate and jealousy. ...</br >
'''Iptar-Sin''': Her worship is forbidden in Kilmaresh since the downfall of the old empire and with good reason. Her followers once caused a religious civil war that led to the old empire's destruction. ...</br >
'''Iptar-Sin''': But the cult of Fafnar secretly survived and the cultists still plague the new empire. They cause plenty of trouble here in Issavi and in all of Kilmaresh.</br >

''Jogador'': '''[[Fardos]]'''</br >
'''Iptar-Sin''': Fardos is considered the creator, often called the Great Observer. We believe that it was his doing that we possess divine souls.</br >

''Jogador'': '''[[Bastesh]]'''</br >
'''Iptar-Sin''': She Who Knows is the patron of the oceans and sea creatures. She's a calm and mystical goddess, the daughter of Uman and Sula. She is also called The Mistress of the Sea or The Keeper of Wisdom. ...</br >
'''Iptar-Sin''': If you want to learn more about Suon you should talk to Ninev, her high priestess.</br >

''Jogador'': '''[[Suon]]'''</br >
'''Iptar-Sin''': Suon the King! He is a kind and benevolent god, a son of Fardos and we also call him the Life-Bringing Sun. Unlike his sister Fafnar he observes creation with love and blesses us with warmth and growth. ...</br >
'''Iptar-Sin''': The worship of Suon and Bastesh grants Kilmaresh stability and growth - and this is exactly what the empire needs to prosper and flourish.</br >

''Jogador'': '''Wrath'''</br >
'''Iptar-Sin''': The sun god Suon has once smitten this continent because of the blasphemy of Fafnar's worshippers. This happened more than thousand years ago. Since that time, Kilmaresh is separated from the rest of the continent.</br >

''Jogador'': '''Cult'''</br >
'''Iptar-Sin''': The Fafnar cultists live and act in secret but they try to exert their influence wherever possible. This can happen by violence or by intrigue. ...</br >
'''Iptar-Sin''': Sometimes they raid the city and surrounding villages, sometimes they try to influence powerful people here in Issavi.</br >

=== Midnight Flame ===

''Jogador'': '''[[Kallimae]]'''</br >
'''Iptar-Sin''': She is the current leader of the Midnight Flame.</br >

''Jogador'': '''Midnight Flame'''</br >
'''Iptar-Sin''': This group is a small circle of chosen knights and oracles, led by the lamassu Arishum.</br >

''Jogador'': '''[[Narsai]]'''</br >
'''Iptar-Sin''': She's an actually blind member of the Midnight Flame. There's something going on between her and Alyxo.</br >

=== Pessoas ===

''Jogador'': '''[[Ambassador Of Rathleton|Ambassador]]'''</br >
'''Iptar-Sin''': The Ambassador of Rathleton is an envoy of Oramond. He has a residence in the eastern part of the city.</br >

''Jogador'': '''[[Alyxo]]'''</br >
'''Iptar-Sin''': She's running the Seaside Theatre. You should go and see one of the performances. Don't be put off by the fact that she's a medusa.</br >

''Jogador'': '''[[Moe]]'''</br >
'''Iptar-Sin''': I have no idea who you are talking about.</br >

''Jogador'': '''[[Ninev]]'''</br >
'''Iptar-Sin''': She is the high priest of Bastesh in Issavi. We are in charge of this temple together to symbolize the duality of Sun and Sea.</br >

''Jogador'': '''[[Ramina]]'''</br >
'''Iptar-Sin''': She's running Issavi's tavern. I encourage you to go for a meal there. Ramina serves delicious menus.</br >

=== Sapphire Blade ===

''Jogador'': '''[[Eshaya]]'''</br >
'''Iptar-Sin''': He's the leader of the Sapphire Blade.</br >

''Jogador'': '''Sapphire Blade'''</br >
'''Iptar-Sin''': They are a group of elite warriors who all carry blades made of tagralt. They defend Issavi against all threats.</br >

''Jogador'': '''Tagralt'''</br >
'''Iptar-Sin''': It is a blue metal, only to be found here in Kilmaresh.</br >

=== The Anuma ===

''Jogador'': '''[[The Empress]]'''</br >
'''Iptar-Sin''': These days we have a sphinx empress who is ruling Kilmaresh wisely and benevolently.</br >

''Jogador'': '''Anuma'''</br >
'''Iptar-Sin''': The Anuma are magical beings that inhabit the continent Kilmaresh. It is told that they were once created by the sun gods Suon and Fafnar. There are several kinds of Anuma: Sphinxes, lamassu, gryphons and manticores.</br >

''Jogador'': '''[[Sphinx|Sphinxes]]'''</br >
'''Iptar-Sin''': Sphinxes are generally benevolent towards humans but they are also enigmatic and aloof. Make sure to treat them with all due respect at any time.</br >

''Jogador'': '''[[Lamassu]]'''</br >
'''Iptar-Sin''': Lamassu are benevolent towards humans - unless you disturb the peace of holy sites or graveyards. In this case they can be very unforgiving.</br >

''Jogador'': '''[[Gryphon|Gryphons]]'''</br >
'''Iptar-Sin''': They don't act hostile towards humans but they are proud and withdrawn creatures. Make sure not to disturb their mountain territories.</br >

''Jogador'': '''[[Manticore|Manticores]]'''</br >
'''Iptar-Sin''': Manticores are much less kind than sphinxes or lamassu. Your best bet would be to steer clear of them.</br >

''Jogador'': '''Bye'''</br >
'''Iptar-Sin''': May Suon's light guide you into the right way!</br >
}}<noinclude>[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]</noinclude>

| falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
[[Saideh]]: Welcome stranger!
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
[[Saideh]]: In principle I have to guide people through this grave complex. But as I told you this is not possible right now. Therefore I'm jobless.
''Jogador:'' '''Ogres'''
[[Saideh]]: These creatures have explored this holy place for themselves. Only the bravest of the brave might be able to overcome this threat. ...
[[Saideh]]: There is just one possibility to change this situation for all of us who want to worship our beloved hero: The remains must be reburied into a safe place, accessible for everyone and protected from the ogres.
''Jogador:'' '''Hero'''
[[Saideh]]: His name is Dayyan the Brave. He was also called the Scorpion.
''Jogador:'' '''Dayyan'''
[[Saideh]]: He was the bravest of the brave. Our hero!
''Jogador:'' '''Help'''
[[Saideh]]: I would like you to face the ogres and reach the grave of our beloved hero. To open it is a bit tricky. The handle in the front of the sarcophagus is just for distraction and could wound somebody who touches it. ...
[[Saideh]]: The only way to open the grave is to put your left hand on the top and the right hand on the right edge at the same time. Speaking out loudly 'open scorpio ' will open it.
''Jogador:'' '''Grave'''
[[Saideh]]: Dayyan was our beloved emperor many years ago. He was kindhearted to his folk and sturdy towards all threats from outside, especially the dreaded ogres.

pages.title: Domizian
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Domizian | job = Comerciante | job2 = Professor | job3 = Roleplay | city = Northern Darama | subarea = Darashia | location = [[Darashia]] ({{Mapa|33262,32463,6:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 12.40 | notes = Estudioso e sábio que vive em Darashia. É amigo de Daniel Steelsoul e precisa de sua ajuda para investigar a maldição ''Were'' na região. Só é possível negociar com ele após completar uma quest.

* Faz parte da [[Grimvale Quest]]. * Só é possível negociar com ele após completar a missão ''An Ancient Feud'' da [[Grimvale Quest]].

[[Categoria:NPCs Liberados por Quest]] | buysell = sim | buys = {{Trades/Buy | Badger Boots | Fox Paw | Fur Armor | Ivory Carving | Lion's Mane | Werebadger Claws | Werebadger Skull | Werebear Fur | Werebear Skull | Wereboar Hooves | Wereboar Loincloth | Wereboar Tusk | Werefox Tail | Werehyaena Nose | Werehyaena Talisman | Werewolf Fang | Werewolf Fur}} | sells = Nada. | falas = {{TOC left}} {{clear}} === Palavras-Chave Gerais === ''Jogador'': '''Hi'''
'''Domizian''': Greetings, traveller!
''Jogador'': '''Name'''
'''Domizian''': I am Domizian.
''Jogador'': '''Job'''
'''Domizian''': You might deem me a sage and a scholar.
''Jogador'': '''[[Daniel Steelsoul|Daniel]]'''
'''Domizian''': He is the governor of Edron and grandmaster of the Knights of Banor's Blood. I made his acquaintance some years ago, when he was visiting Darashia.
''Jogador'': '''Leader'''
'''Domizian''': In case you talk about the werehyaena alpha leader: Her name is Rhargu. She lives deep down in the werehyaena lairs together with her pack.
''Jogador'': '''[[Rhargu]]'''
'''Domizian''': She's a werehyaena. The leader of the pack that causes so much trouble around Darashia.
''Jogador'': '''Trade'''
'''Domizian''': Of course, let me see what you have.
== The Grimvale Quest == === An Ancient Feud === '''Missão 1''' ''Jogador'': '''Curse''' / '''Were''' / '''Mission'''
'''Domizian''': So, Daniel Steelsoul sent you? He is a most respectable man and I'm honoured to know him. It is of advantage that you have already dealt with the were-sickness so you won't hurl yourself into this adventure unprepared. ...
'''Domizian''': Listen, the curse has indeed spread to the Darama Desert - but not recently. It exists here since a long time but only few know about it. Here, it's not werewolves or werebears. The danger that plagues this region are the werehyaenas. ...
'''Domizian''': Until now they were savage and smelly beasts who hunted down a travelling merchant now and then. But mostly they stayed in their subterranean lairs and lived off carrion. ...
'''Domizian''': But a few weeks ago something changed. Suddenly they had shamans, something I never saw before. Those shamans are using bone talismans and paint their fur with runes. Runes I saw just once before ... on an artefact from Drefia. ...
'''Domizian''': I'm afraid the werehyaenas have a kind of pact with the undead of Drefia but I don't have proof. Please go to their lairs and investigate. You will find the entrance north of the town, at a large standing stone. ...
'''Domizian''': Be careful down there, though! Werehyaenas might not be the only danger you will have to face. I heard strange stories about blood pools, a talking skull and even liches.
'''Após realizar a missão.''' ''Jogador'': '''Mission'''
'''Domizian''': So, the werehyaenas are indeed working together with Drefia's undead. That's very dangerous, to say the least. Please, if you can, find a way to stop this.
'''Após falar com Rhargu.''' '''Missão 2''' ''Jogador'': '''Destroy''' / '''Shrine'''
'''Domizian''': I guess you need something holy or at least blessed to destroy this evil site. The werelions know a ritual that allows you to bless fire in general. It should work with this torch, too. ...
'''Domizian''': But you can do that only at a special altar in our sanctum. Go to the Lion's Rock in the north-west of Darashia. Descend to the area where the most noble lions are guarding a secret entrance. ...
'''Domizian''': There is a door, you can only open if you know the right phrase. It is: 'The sun guides our hearts. The moon guards our dreams'. Down there you will find a room with a mosaic, showing a sun and a moon. ...
'''Domizian''': There is an altar where you can bless the torch. You have to find a lion mane flower and chop the petals up small. Then sprinkle the chopped petals into the flame while standing at the altar. ...
'''Domizian''': Thus, the fire will be blessed and should be able to burn down the evil bone shrine.
'''Após realizar a missão.''' ''Jogador'': '''Mission'''
'''Domizian''': You destroyed the pact between the werehyaenas and the undead! You did Darashia a great favour, that's for sure. But there are still so many of them, they could be a real threat to the caravans that try to reach the city. ...
'''Domizian''': Please, kill three hundred of those ferocious werehyaenas and their shamans.
'''Missão 3''' '''Após realizar a missão.''' ''Jogador'': '''Kill''' / '''Mission'''
'''Domizian''': Yes, there are less of them now! What a relief for Darashia. Well, I guess, now I can trust you enough to tell you a little secret about myself. I'm actually a werelion. Don't be scared, though. ...
'''Domizian''': There's something special to the werelions: We can control the curse and don't attack people like mindless beasts. This is the reason why I can live here in the city and talk to you in such a civilized way. ...
'''Domizian''': Well, the werehyaenas were a danger to Darashia but they also caused a very personal problem for me. Look, I assumed that they are up to something and that this something could be the undead in Drefia. ...
'''Domizian''': I warned our king, Heliodor, about it but he didn't believe me. I insisted and got short-tempered - which is never a good idea in the presence of your king. He exiled me as punishment for my impudence. ...
'''Domizian''': This is the reason why I live here in Darashia. This city has its conveniences but I would like to return to my pride. Please find Heliodor and tell him about the werehyaenas' pact with the undead. ...
'''Domizian''': Take this ring, it will allow you to enter the lower part of the sanctum. Wear it while you touch one of the lion columns in the centre of the sanctum's upper floor. Then you will reach the lower part.
''Jogador'': '''Special'''
'''Domizian''': The werelions are special among the therianthropes. We are not weak-willed victims of the curse. We control it. That means we can change form at will and are not feral beasts as soon as the full moon rises.
''Jogador'': '''Therianthropes'''
'''Domizian''': Therianthropy is the ability of human beings to metamorphose into other animals. The most well known form of therianthropy is found in stories concerning werewolves. ...
'''Domizian''': But there are many others, too, like bears, hyaenas or lions.
'''Missão 4''' '''Após falar com Heliodor.''' ''Jogador'': '''Mission'''
'''Domizian''': You found Heliodor and told him about the werehyaenas? He will consider to pardon me? I don't know how I could thank you! Take this as a small compensation for your efforts! '''Após a conclusão da quest.''' ''Jogador'': '''Curse'''/ '''King''' / '''Sanctum'''
'''Domizian''': My king will consider to pardon me! Thank you again! ''Jogador'': '''Bye'''
'''Domizian''': Farewell.
}}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = A Skull | job = Profeta | job2 = Cartomante | job3 = Roleplay | npcclass = Constructos | npcsprite = Skull | city = Northern Darama | subarea = Hyaena Lairs | location = [[Hyaena Lairs]] ({{mapa|33164,32492,11:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 12.40 | notes = Parece ter sido um(a) cartomante em vida. | buysell = não | falas = {{TOC left}} {{clear}} === Palavras-Chave Gerais === '''DIA''' ''Jogador'': '''Hi'''
'''A Skull''': *A horned skull rests on a stone pile here. Underneath the jaw bone, there are faint grinding marks on the rock, as if the skull was moved frequently.*
'''NOITE''' ''Jogador'': '''Hi'''
'''A Skull''': Greetings, traveller!
''Jogador'': '''Name'''
'''A Skull''': I forgot my own name a long time ago.
''Jogador'': '''Job'''
'''A Skull''': I consider myself a storyteller. So, if you are interested in a little story ... I also know a thing or two about the cards. ''Jogador'': '''Story'''
'''A Skull''': I thought so! Well, listen: The confused maiden shall defeat the forsaken wizard when the days grow long in the age of fate.
'''OU''' '''A Skull''': I thought so! Well, listen: The cold-hearted viper will not roam with the honest lion at the coming of death. === Cards === ''Jogador'': '''Cards'''
'''A Skull''': I know about eleven cards. ...
'''A Skull''': The Foremother, the Artist, the Gambler, the Fountain, the Ship of Emeralds, the Princess, the Heroic Monk, the Prophet, the Orphan, the Forgotten Minstrel and the Queen of Machines.
''Jogador'': '''Foremother'''
'''A Skull''': This card depicts an old woman with a scar on her face and a basket of fruit on a hill. It is associated with protection, compassion and a journey. Inverted, it represents deception and loss.
''Jogador'': '''Artist'''
'''A Skull''': This card depicts a middle-aged woman with brushes and an owl while the sun sets. It is associated with creativity and prosperity. Inverted, it represents a breakdown or a devastating announcement.
''Jogador'': '''Gambler'''
'''A Skull''': This card depicts a middle-aged man with golden hair and an oak tree inside a walled city. It is associated with renewal and transformation. Inverted, it represents treason and death.
''Jogador'': '''Fountain'''
'''A Skull''': This card depicts an old man, sitting at a fountain. It is associated with reunion, truth and joy. Inverted, it represents tyranny and violence.
''Jogador'': '''Ship of Emeralds'''
'''A Skull''': This card depicts a ship with a cargo of emeralds. It is associated with wealth and joy. Inverted, it represents financial difficulty and miscommunication.
''Jogador'': '''Princess'''
'''A Skull''': This card depicts a young woman with copper-colored eyes, wearing a crown. It is associated with romance, opportunity and generosity. Inverted, it represents illusion and death.
''Jogador'': '''Heroic Monk'''
'''A Skull''': This card depicts a young boy and a spider. It is associated with a heroic deed, nobility and strength. Inverted, it represents disappointment and exile.
''Jogador'': '''Prophet'''
'''A Skull''': This card depicts an old woman and a gryphon. It is associated with wisdom and prophecy. Inverted, it represents disease and a reversal of fortune.
''Jogador'': '''Orphan'''
'''A Skull''': This card depicts a small girl involved in a parting of ways. It is associated with forgiveness and kindness. Inverted, it represents surrender and disagreement.
''Jogador'': '''Forgotten Minstrel'''
'''A Skull''': This card depicts a tall young man with hazel eyes, holding a lute and a hawk. It is associated with willpower and royalty. Inverted, it represents grief and anger.
''Jogador'': '''Queen of Machines'''
'''A Skull''': This card depicts a young woman and a golem near a fortress. It is associated with science, secrets and research. Inverted, it represents ignorance and fear.
== The Grimvale Quest == === An Ancient Feud === '''Missão 1''' ''Jogador'': '''Undead'''
'''A Skull''': The undead of Drefia are working together with the werehyaenas. I overheard a secret conversation between the werehyaena leader and a lich right here!
''Jogador'': '''Leader'''
'''A Skull''': A fierce and cunning hyaena named Rhargu. She lives in her own cave down here.
''Jogador'': '''Bye'''
'''A Skull''': Farewell.
}} [[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.title: Rhargu
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Rhargu | job = Líder | job2 = Roleplay | city = Northern Darama | subarea = Hyaena Lairs | location = [[Hyaena Lairs]] ({{mapa|33169,32539,12:2|aqui}}) | implemented = 12.40 | notes = Ela é líder das werehyaenas de Darashia.

* Faz parte da [[Grimvale Quest]].

| buysell = não | falas = {{TOC left}} {{clear}} === Palavras-Chave Gerais === ''Jogador'': '''Hi'''
'''Rhargu''': Grr. Intruder!
''Jogador'': '''Name'''
'''Rhargu''': I'm Rhargu.
''Jogador'': '''Job'''
'''Rhargu''': I'm the leader of this werehyaena pack.
''Jogador'': '''[[Domizian]]'''
'''Rhargu''': Sounds like a stupid lion name.
== The Grimvale Quest == === An Ancient Feud === ''Jogador'': '''Curse''' / '''Undead'''
'''Rhargu''': Go away or we'll eat you!
=== Rhargu's Demand === '''Após falar com Domizian.''' ''Jogador'': '''Curse''' / '''Undead'''
'''Rhargu''': None of your business, the undead! On the other hand .. they haven't done so much for us. Gave us some talismans for our shamans. But no food! I asked for it. They never brought it. ...
'''Rhargu''': If you bring me the food I wish for, I could end this. Or tell you how to end it. But you have to bring me a boar haunch, those are so tasty! And a hard-boiled hydra egg. Always wanted to try one. ...
'''Rhargu''': Also, take this cask and fill it with salted cave rats. My favourite snack! At last, bring me five lion manes. Want to decorate my cave with them, grhrr.
''Jogador'': '''Haunch'''
'''Rhargu''': My best guess? Hunt down a boar.
''Jogador'': '''Hydra Egg'''
'''Rhargu''': Find a hydra, find its egg.
''Jogador'': '''Salted'''
'''Rhargu''': Catch some cave rats and salt them. It's really that simple. Use a net or something, I don't care.
''Jogador'': '''Manes'''
'''Rhargu''': Kill some lions and cut it off, huh.
'''Após realizar a missão.''' ''Jogador'': '''Mission'''
'''Rhargu''': Do you have my food? ''Jogador'': '''Yes'''
'''Rhargu''': Give me! And take this. A special torch, made of sandalwood. Burn down the bone shrine at the dragon skeleton with this torch. That will destroy the connection with the undead. ...
'''Rhargu''': And I have a little reward for you. Take this cask. It's funny but smelly. You can have it.
''Jogador'': '''Bye'''
'''Rhargu''': Yes, go away!
}}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Heliodor | job = Líder | job2 = Roleplay | city = Northern Darama | subarea = Lion Sanctum | location = [[Lion Sanctum]] ({{mapa|33133,32324,12:1|aqui}}). | implemented = 12.40 | notes = Ele é rei dos Werelions em Lion's Rock.

* Faz parte da [[Grimvale Quest]].

| buysell = não | falas = {{TOC left}} {{clear}} === Palavras-Chave Gerais === ''Jogador'': '''Hi'''
'''Heliodor''': Greetings!.
''Jogador'': '''Name'''
'''Heliodor''': My name is Heliodor.
''Jogador'': '''Job'''
'''Heliodor''': I'm the leader and king of the Daramian werelions.
''Jogador'': '''Domizian'''
'''Heliodor''': He was a member of my pride, yet a very presumptuous one. He called my authority into question so I had to exile him. A pride of lions has clear and unalterable rules that every member has to adhere to. As king I can't tolerate disobedience.
== The Grimvale Quest == === An Ancient Feud === '''Missão 4''' '''Após falar com Domizian.''' ''Jogador'': '''Curse'''
'''Domizian''': Alas, this is a very interesting story you are telling me! Thank you, human, for acquainting me! I will consider to pardon Domizian but I have to take my time to think it through. ...
'''Domizian''': But now, please leave this place. You did us a certain favour but for all that, humans are not welcome here.
}}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.title: Evrard The Miller
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Evrard The Miller | job = Fazendeiro | job2 = Roleplay | city = Vandura | subarea = Bounac | location = [[Bounac]]: * Durante o dia ({{mapa|32421,32463,7:2|aqui}}). * Durante a noite ({{mapa|32404,32493,6:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 12.40 | notes = Evrard é responsável pelo moinho local em Bounac. Só é possível encontrá-lo em seu moinho de dia, a noite ele fica em sua casa dentro da cidade. Assim como a maioria dos NPC's de Bounac, [[Evrard The Miller]] muda de nome e de aparência no período diurno e noturno.

* Faz parte da [[The Order of the Lion Quest]].

| buysell = não | falas = {{TOC left}} {{clear}} === Palavras-Chave Gerais === ''Jogador'': '''Hi'''
'''Evrard The Miller''': Greetings. Can I help you, traveller?
''Jogador'': '''Job'''
'''Evrard The Miller''': I am the local miller.
''Jogador'': '''Mill'''
'''Evrard The Miller''': Well, you can make some excellent flour here. Just put your grain under the millstone and and grind.
''Jogador'': '''John The Carpenter'''
'''Evrard The Miller''': John's been bitten by a snake as far as I heard. Hope he's alright.
== The Order of the Lion Quest == '''Missão 1''' ''Jogador'': '''Hi'''
'''Evrard The Miller''': Greetings. Can I help you, traveller?
''Jogador'': '''Yes'''
'''Evrard The Miller''': Alright, look. You already know that camp to the east, with the bad guys roaming around, right? Great. ...
'''Evrard The Miller''': They have a ledger and a map there, and I want that. Both these items. The ledger is in a warehouse at the harbour. ...
'''Evrard The Miller''': I don't know where that map is, though but I am sure they have one where they've marked all the locations they've been at. ...
'''Evrard The Miller''': And most importantly: BE QUIET! Try not to be seen. Be a shadow. Got that?
''Jogador'': '''Yes'''
'''Evrard The Miller''': Good, now go. Remember: be like a light summer breeze - quick, almost unnoticeable and most importantly QUIET!
'''Após realizar a missão.''' ''Jogador'': '''Hi'''
'''Evrard The Miller''': Ah it's you, any news? If you just want to use the mill, you can do so, too.
''Jogador'': '''News'''
'''Evrard The Miller''': What about the small errand I mentioned? Did you get the stuff?
''Jogador'': '''Yes'''
'''Evrard The Miller''': You did it! Let me just take a peek... ...
'''Evrard The Miller''': What? No, no - keep them. I uhm, don't want to have anything to do with this. Just wanted to... take a quick look, you know. ...
'''Evrard The Miller''': Have you been quiet as I asked you?
''Jogador'': '''Yes'''
'''Evrard The Miller''': Oh you have? Why did I hear screams of battle, fear and loathing from over there about the time you were gone? ...
'''Evrard The Miller''': And I really hope yours were the screams of battle and not those of fear. ...
'''Evrard The Miller''': Anyway, you did it and that's very good. I am thankful for that and I'll open up an underground route I sometimes use when I want to enter the city quickly. ...
'''Evrard The Miller''': This way you can get past any guards and find out more about the situation. And one more thing: ...
'''Evrard The Miller''': There's a passphrase: YSELDA. Remember that. Now go and the best of luck to you, traveller!
''Jogador'': '''Bye'''
'''Evrard The Miller''': Farewell then.
}} [[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.title: Flickering Soul
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Flickering Soul | job = Roleplay | city = Edron | subarea = Zarganash | location = [[Zarganash]] ({{mapa|33621,31419,10:1|aqui}}). | implemented = 12.40 | notes =

* Faz parte da [[Soul War Quest]]. * Trata-se da alma do rei necromante '''Goshnar''', líder da [[Brotherhood of Bones]].

| buysell = não | falas = ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
[[Flickering Soul]]: Be greeted, living soul!
''Jogador'': '''living'''
[[Flickering Soul]]: It has been a while since I roamed the world of the living in a mortal shell.
''Jogador'': '''mortal'''
[[Flickering Soul]]: I had many names in my live. The one that would be the most recognizable is probably the name Goshnar. Even that was an assumed name that I took, when i left my mundane past behind.
''Jogador'': '''Goshnar'''
[[Flickering Soul]]: I was once known as the necromant king....
[[Flickering Soul]]: For some it was meant as a curse, others used the name with reverence. To me it was just another stepping stone, in a life that burned with ambition.
''Jogador'': '''ambition'''
[[Flickering Soul]]: My ambitions were high and knew no limits. Mastery over life and death was but a milestone that I wanted to accomplish. In the end I aspired probably somewhat like godhood....
[[Flickering Soul]]: Though in hindsight even that wouldn't have been enough. There was a hunger in me that nothing could put to rest.
''Jogador'': '''milestone'''
[[Flickering Soul]]: Everything in my life was just a tool to further my goals. The brotherhood of bones was just a tool for me. As was everyone or everything. In the path I had chosen nothing mattered but me and my ambitions.
''Jogador'': '''everything'''
[[Flickering Soul]]: Necromancy was a passion at first, another tool while I amassed power and a crutch when my ambitions surpassed that what it could accomplish.
''Jogador'': '''accomplish'''
[[Flickering Soul]]: I was so convinced about my brilliance, my greatness, my destiny. And this hunger for more, it let me not have peace at any point in my life. I was always driven. There was no time to rest....
[[Flickering Soul]]: And there was no looking back. I never cared to remember my humble beginnings, what I had sacrificed to get where I was. All that I had left behind and that I had lost forever....
[[Flickering Soul]]: Now I see the bitter irony. I could bring back the dead, but I couldn't create second chances. I couldn't restore the truly important things that I had lost.
''Jogador'': '''dead'''
[[Flickering Soul]]: My demise did not meet me unprepared. As a powerful necromancer I had fettered my soul in the living world and the realms beyond. I had prepared for my return and was confident in my power.
''Jogador'': '''confident'''
[[Flickering Soul]]: My soul wandered the plains of Zarganash, waiting for my wards to power up. Waiting for my soul to be slowly pulled back and manifest in the world of the living once again. What I had not taken into consideration was peace.
''Jogador'': '''peace'''
[[Flickering Soul]]: Zarganash was not a place without it's dangers but for a soul as powerful as mine, there was little threat at all. For the first time in my existence I had to stop running forward. I had to wait for things to fit into their places....
[[Flickering Soul]]: And me, who had seen things that horrible, they would have obliterated a lesser man's mind, finally took the time to look back. And what I saw was frightening in its own right....
[[Flickering Soul]]: A great tiredness overcame me. With the flames of my ambitions calming down for the first time since I could remember, all my aspirations and plans seemed to petty and futile....
[[Flickering Soul]]: Everything I had worked for and my plans for the things to come seemed pointless and the things I had lost and never allowed myself to experience weighted heavily on my soul.
''Jogador'': '''soul'''
[[Flickering Soul]]: I talked to other souls, lost in Zarganash and most of them seemed like mirrors to myself. Their faults, their shortcomings, the things that were important to them and the things they had lost....
[[Flickering Soul]]: It was all like miniature copies of my own grand plans and losses. It made me think. And the great tiredness weighted even more heavy on me. A weariness of the world, of the hunger that drove me.
''Jogador'': '''weariness'''
[[Flickering Soul]]: Then I met a wise soul. A teacher that did not lecture. I never was impressed by anything but my own accomplishments but the inner balance and peace of this soul, it did impress me. A lot....
[[Flickering Soul]]: I, who fancied myself to have been the epitome of knowledge, learned things that were entirely new to me. But this knowledge wasn't about power. It was about me.
''Jogador'': '''knowledge'''
[[Flickering Soul]]: I recognized the extent of my folly and failure. I decided not to return to the world of the living.
''Jogador'': '''return'''
[[Flickering Soul]]: I decided to stay here, even pass on into the great beyond at some point. Yet I still feel the pull of my fetters. I can faintly hear those who think they are my followers, calling to me....
[[Flickering Soul]]: And I feel others, many others who carve for my powers and try to bring me back for their own gain.
''Jogador'': '''fetters'''
[[Flickering Soul]]: Over my time in Zarganash I split away the parts of me that my worldly fetters where bound to. Yet I had to recognize that they are still a part of me and I'm bound to them....
[[Flickering Soul]]: The fetters and the efforts to call me back, are empowering them. I feel them growing in strength and gaining awareness on their own. ...'''
[[Flickering Soul]]: They are beginning to feed not only on the fetters and incarnations but also on me. As I grow weaker they grow more powerful over time.
''Jogador'': '''powerful'''
[[Flickering Soul]]: The only way I can get rid of them is to disperse them, to 'kill' them so to say. But they are tainted parts of myself and even going near them might endanger my sanity and stability. So all I can do is to ask you to do this daunting task.
''Jogador'': '''task'''
[[Flickering Soul]]: I'm aware I have no right to ask and I have little to offer as a payment, but I ask you nonetheless. Will you face my fettered vices and destroy them for me?
''Jogador'': '''yes'''
[[Flickering Soul]]: Thank you for accepting this burden.
''Jogador'': '''burden'''
[[Flickering Soul]]: You will have to reach each of the negative parts of my personality, I split away. They are hidden deep in the depths of Zarganash and will have corrupted and twisted their surroundings into dangerous nightmares....
[[Flickering Soul]]: Even worse you'll likely encounter minions of those who want to claim my soul as their prize, for their own, depraved reasons. You will have to destroy my shards to set me free.
''Jogador'': '''shards'''
[[Flickering Soul]]: You haven't killed Malice yet. You haven't killed Hatred yet. You haven't killed Spite yet. You haven't killed Cruelty yet. You haven't killed Greed yet. ''Jogador'': '''The Pale Worm'''
[[Flickering Soul]]: His avatar might be destroyed for now and it'd grip on Zarganash considerably weakened. Yet he burrowed to deep into the essence of this realm to be anihilated this easy. ''Jogador'': '''Fermuba'''
[[Flickering Soul]]: My daughter was as ambitious as me, yet she lacked my intellect and my raw talent. She still was great and talented yet I sadly let her feel my disdain. One of the many errors that my way of hubris made me do. }} [[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Wes The Blacksmith | job = Comerciante de Equipamentos | city = Vandura | subarea = Bounac | location = [[Bounac]]: * Durante o dia ({{mapa|32422,32481,5:2|aqui}}). * Durante a noite ({{mapa|32374,32467,6:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 12.40 | notes = Wes é o ferreiro de Bounac. Quando não está em sua loja ele também trabalha como professor! Só é possível encontra-lo em sua loja de dia, a noite ele fica em sua casa dentro da cidade. Assim como a maioria dos NPC's de Bounac, [[Wes The Blacksmith]] muda de nome e de aparência no período diurno e noturno.

* Faz parte da [[The Order of the Lion Quest]].

| buysell = sim | buys = {{Trades/Buy | Nunchaku | Pair of Monk Fists | Sai }} | sells = {{Trades/Sell | Nunchaku | Pair of Monk Fists | Sai }} | falas = {{TOC left}} {{clear}} === Palavras-Chave Gerais === '''DIA''' ''Jogador'': '''Hi'''
'''Wes The Blacksmith''': Hail, customer! Welcome to Wes and son, blacksmith (and teacher). Can I do something for you?
''Jogador'': '''Yes'''
'''Wes The Blacksmith''': Good! Feel free to browse my hand-made equipment then!
''Jogador'': '''Browse'''
'''Wes The Blacksmith''': There you are, traveller!
''Jogador'': '''Name'''
'''Wes The Blacksmith''': My name's Wes. Pleased to meet you, traveller!
''Jogador'': '''Job''' / '''Smith''' / '''Teacher'''
'''Wes The Blacksmith''': I am a smith and part-time teacher.
''Jogador'': '''Son'''
'''Wes The Blacksmith''': That ne'er-do-well. Who knows what he's currently on about. He's seems keenly interested in distance fighting, however. Which is the ONE THING I do not have any equipment for.
''Jogador'': '''Kesar'''
'''Wes The Blacksmith''': Ah yes, our good king Kesar. The Younger of course. To be honest, he's not that young anymore. And not actually king, really. ...
'''Wes The Blacksmith''': We do not actually have a king 'round here. But we give him that feeling, y'know? He's a good leader after all and keeps this lot in check.
'''NOITE''' ''Jogador'': '''Hi'''
'''Wes The Blacksmith''': Hail, customer! Welcome to Wes and son, blacksmith (and teacher). Can I do something for you?
''Jogador'': '''Yes'''
'''Wes The Blacksmith''': Well, sorry, not at this hour. Feel free to come by my shop during daytime!
== The Order of the Lion Quest == '''Missão 1''' ''Jogador'': '''Yselda'''
'''Wes The Blacksmith''': Ah yes, right. You came to the right place, ahem. ...
'''Wes The Blacksmith''': Well, for quite some time we are planning to help our king during this awful siege. As you know the passphrase, one of us already trusts you. ...
'''Wes The Blacksmith''': Outsiders are not welcome here during the siege. If you want to get into the castle, you will have to earn all our trust. ...
'''Wes The Blacksmith''': If you can do that, a member of the lion guard who is in contact with us, will let you in. ...
'''Wes The Blacksmith''': Just ask any of us the passphrase and we will see what we can do for you.
''Jogador'': '''Yselda'''
'''Wes The Blacksmith''': Alright then, let's see if you are really trustworthy. I need more material to forge better equipment for our men. ...
'''Wes The Blacksmith''': Bring me about 20 broken longbows from fallen usurpers and we will see.
'''Após realizar a missão.''' ''Jogador'': '''Yselda'''
'''Wes The Blacksmith''': Alright then, let's see if you are really trustworthy. You have about 20 broken longbows there, this is exactly what I need to fulfill my next order from the king. ...
'''Wes The Blacksmith''': Are you willing to hand them over to me?
''Jogador'': '''Yes'''
'''Wes The Blacksmith''': Excellent, just what I needed. You have earned my trust, traveller. Good luck!
''Jogador'': '''Bye'''
'''Wes The Blacksmith''': Farewell!
}} [[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.title: Onfroi
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Onfroi | job = Comerciante de Itens Mágicos | job2 = Curador | city = Vandura | subarea = Bounac | location = [[Bounac]]: * Durante o dia ({{mapa|32428,32489,5:2|aqui}}). * Durante a noite ({{mapa|32428,32489,2:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 12.40 | notes = Onfroi (mais conhecido como "O Mago"), é responsável por vender potions e runas em Bounac. Ele vive em uma torre dentro da cidade que serve de loja e casa ao mesmo tempo. Só é possível negociar com ele de dia, a noite ele fica no último andar de sua torre. Assim como a maioria dos NPC's de Bounac, [[Onfroi]] muda de nome e de aparência no período diurno e noturno.

* Faz parte da [[The Order of the Lion Quest]].

| buysell = sim | buys = | sells = {{Trades/Sell |The Scorcher |The Chiller }} | falas = {{TOC left}} {{clear}} === Palavras-Chave Gerais === '''DIA''' ''Jogador'': '''Hi'''
'''Onfroi''': Welcome, traveller! Is it tea you're looking... oh, is it still morning? Anyway, browse my stock now.
''Jogador'': '''Name'''
'''Onfroi''': They call me TRAVELLER! Yehees! Oh, I mean, no - NO! They call me Onfroi. I am Onfroi, the wizard. Pleased to meet you, traveller!
''Jogador'': '''Job'''
'''Onfroi''': I am the local healer Currently. Well, most of the time. I'm actually a well-known wizard, you might not know me, though.
''Jogador'': '''Wizard'''
'''Onfroi''': Oh yes, that's me, indeed!
''Jogador'': '''Healer'''
'''Onfroi''': If you are hurt my child, I will heal your wounds.
''Jogador'': '''Potions'''
'''Onfroi''': We offer health, spirit and mana potions in up to four sizes: normal, strong, great and ultimate. Ask me for a trade to see my offers.
''Jogador'': '''Runes''' / '''Stock''' / '''Trade''' / '''Magic'''
'''Onfroi''': Of course, traveller. Feel free to browse!
''Jogador'': '''Bounac'''
'''Onfroi''': A fine place, I absolutely love it here. Time and space for all my experiments and I'm free to do as I please.
''Jogador'': '''John The Carpenter'''
'''Onfroi''': John is not here, we had to send him out of town for medicine as even I couldn't treat his bite.
'''NOITE''' ''Jogador'': '''Hi'''
'''Onfroi''': Welcome, traveller! Is it tea you're looking... oh, is it still morning? Anyway, browse my stock now.
''Jogador'': '''Runes''' / '''Stock''' / '''Trade''' / '''Magic'''
'''Onfroi''': Come to me during daytime, traveller. Unless you are in need of healing, these things can surely wait.
== The Order of the Lion Quest == '''Missão 1''' ''Jogador'': '''Hi'''
'''Onfroi''': Welcome, traveller! Is it tea you're looking... oh, is it still morning? Anyway, browse my stock now.
''Jogador'': '''Yselda'''
'''Onfroi''': You mean it, right? Where did you got that from, actually?. ...
'''Onfroi''': Now, I have indeed a favour to ask. If you can accomplish that, you've earned my trust surely. ...
'''Onfroi''': There is a crypt down below the town. It is old and the seismic activity has stirred up some bad energies down there. ...
'''Onfroi''': I want you to venture exactly to that crypt and see if there are any powerful creatures down there. ...
'''Onfroi''': And if there are... please... remove them. Rest assured that I have nothing to do with the rise of any mortally-depleted entities down there ...
'''Onfroi''': At least not this time. You see, the locals are starting to suspect me. But I'm not much of a fighter or warlock. ...
'''Onfroi''': So if there is indeed something below us and you can destroy let's say 20 of it, I'd be in your dept.
'''Após realizar a missão.''' ''Jogador'': '''Yselda'''
'''Onfroi''': You did it, excellent! Most respectable, you did great! That took a load of my mind. And you've earned my trust!
''Jogador'': '''Yselda'''
'''Onfroi''': Beautiful name. Mysterious and delicate. Have a fine day, my friend!
''Jogador'': '''Bye'''
'''Onfroi''': Farewell, traveller...
}} [[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

'''Fral The Butcher''': Hello, customer! I got meat.
''Jogador'': '''Meat'''
'''Fral The Butcher''': Sure, enjoy.
''Jogador'': '''Name'''
'''Fral The Butcher''': Name's Dinha. Fral Dinha. Nice to meet you, I guess.
''Jogador'': '''Job'''
'''Fral The Butcher''': I am a butcher. I cleave meat, among other things.
''Jogador'': '''Bounac'''
'''Fral The Butcher''': BOUNAC!
''Jogador'': '''Kesar'''
'''Fral The Butcher''': Kesar is a good ruler.
''Jogador'': '''John The Carpenter'''
'''Fral The Butcher''': The carpenter is currently out of town. '''NOITE''' ''Jogador'': '''Meat'''
'''Fral The Butcher''': What. Now? I got nothing here, find me in my shop during daytime if you want to buy meat.
== The Order of the Lion Quest == '''Missão 1''' ''Jogador'': '''Yselda'''
'''Fral The Butcher''': If you want to prove trustworthy to me, I need you to bring me some raw ham, about 20 chunks if you can. Then we'll see.
'''Após realizar a missão.''' ''Jogador'': '''Hi'''
'''Fral The Butcher''': Hello, customer! I got meat.
''Jogador'': '''Yselda'''
'''Fral The Butcher''': Good, I can smell about 20 pieces of raw ham there in your pockets. ...
'''Fral The Butcher''': Will you hand those over to me?
''Jogador'': '''Yes'''
'''Fral The Butcher''': Great, thanks. And? Oh, yes. Consider my trust... earned.
''Jogador'': '''Bye'''
'''Fral The Butcher''': Farewell.
}}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.title: Eustacio
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Eustacio | job = Roleplay | city = Venore | subarea = Venore City | location = [[Venore City]] ({{mapa|32937,32030,7|aqui}}). | implemented = 12.60 | notes = Eustacio é um empreendedor que está tentando conquistar seu espaço em Venore.

* Faz parte da [[A Pirate's Tail Quest]].

| buysell = não | buys = | sells = | falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == Não possui. == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador'': '''hi'''
'''Eustacio''': Hello my friend. What a delight to see you, even on a busy day. You can check your status or ask me about the location of the ongoing raids. ''Jogador'': '''name'''
'''Eustacio''': I am Eustacio. At your service. ''Jogador'': '''time'''
'''Eustacio''': It's just the time to make a fortune. ''Jogador'': '''job''' / '''busy'''
'''Eustacio''': I am an aspiring businessman, that thrives to climb the ladder of success in the Venorean society. ''Jogador'': '''aspiring'''
'''Eustacio''': I will make my own fortune and walk my way from the bottom to the top, even if it might take some decades. ''Jogador'': '''ladder'''
'''Eustacio''': As a newcomer to the Venorean trader union, it's my goal to rise in the ranks of the local traders and become a name to be reckoned with. ''Jogador'': '''ranks'''
'''Eustacio''': To reach my lofty goal though, I need some accomplishments to attach to my name. ''Jogador'': '''accomplishments'''
'''Eustacio''': Recently an opportunity has arisen. A new kind of pirates has shown up and is threatening our shipping routes. ''Jogador'': '''opportunity'''
'''Eustacio''': Right now the other trade barons are still in denial, in fear to scare of potential investors. ''Jogador'': '''denial'''
'''Eustacio''': That's were I can put my foot in the door by successfully fighting this new threat. ''Jogador'': '''threat'''
'''Eustacio''': For all I know the new pirates are some Corym clans that banded together. ''Jogador'': '''corym''' / '''pirats'''
'''Eustacio''': I do not know much about these Corym clans Pirats! ...
'''Eustacio''': All I know is that they are launching attacks on our cities and coasts and that they tossed together some ship wrecks to create a small armada of ships. ''Jogador'': '''armada'''
'''Eustacio''': They seem to employ new powerful magic to dominate our ships in sea battles. I doubt a victory on the seas can be acquired. ''Jogador'': '''victory'''
'''Eustacio''': We have to rout out their base and strike them there, disrupt their supply lines and coordination. ''Jogador'': '''disrupt'''
'''Eustacio''': The first step in our fight is to disrupt their operations, in the hopes it causes enough ruckus amongst them, ...
'''Eustacio''': so my other agents might catch some vital new information about their hideouts and supply lines. ''Jogador'': '''operations'''
'''Eustacio''': Reports came in about their attacks. Spies, small ships and one big ship with cannons. ...
'''Eustacio''': I'm not too sure what to make of it but we need to stop them nevertheless. It's a mission for you! ''Jogador'': '''society'''
'''Eustacio''': Dealing with the trade barons can be like swimming in a pool of sharks from time to time. ''Jogador'': '''sharks'''
'''Eustacio''': They are the sharks of our society. If they notice you bleeding, you are as good as finished. ...
'''Eustacio''': Business is always a difficult and dangerous field of expertise, especially in Venore. The trade barons are not too fond of competition. ''Jogador'': '''status''' / '''points'''
'''Eustacio''': I have my eyes and ears everywhere. If I had to give you points, you would have ''pontuação'' by now. ...
'''Eustacio''': I might consider telling you my secrets if you gather 1500 points. ''Jogador'': '''location''' ''(quando não há invasões acontecendo)''
'''Eustacio''': My agents didn't see anything of use yet. ''Jogador'': '''venore'''
'''Eustacio''': It's a beautiful town on the surface. But it is ruled by business and business is a constant war. ''Jogador'': '''bye'''
'''Eustacio''': Good bye, ''Jogador''. }}

pages.title: Tik'hi Tak'he
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Tik'hi Tak'he | job = Líder | job2 = Shaman | city = Kilmaresh | subarea = Rascacoon | location = [[Rascacoon]] ({{mapa|33730,31344,7:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 12.60 | notes =

* Faz parte da [[A Pirate's Tail Quest]].

 | buysell = sim | sells = Palavra chave ''"Accessories"'' {{Trades/Sell | Raccoon Backpack | Amethyst Necklace | Emerald Necklace | Diamond Necklace | Rhodolith Necklace | Garnet Necklace | Sapphire Necklace}} Palavra chave ''"Wall Decorations"'' {{Trades/Sell | Blue Shark Trophy | Brown Shark Trophy | Golden Shark Trophy | Hammerhead Trophy | Stripped Shark Trophy | Shark Jaws}} | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Tik'hi Tak'he: ''' Hail, visitor! Welcome! You can ask me about your 'trust points'!
''Jogador:'' '''job'''
'''Tik'hi Tak'he: ''' I am the shaman of Rascacoon.
''Jogador:'' '''shaman'''
'''Tik'hi Tak'he: ''' I'm the diviner of the will of the great raccoon and keeper of wisdom.
''Jogador:'' '''Rascacoon'''
'''Tik'hi Tak'he: ''' This colony lived in peace for centuries, but this peace is now severely disrupted. The pirats became a constant threat and annoyance.
''Jogador:'' '''colony'''
'''Tik'hi Tak'he: ''' This colony is called Rascacoon. But our tribe originates from a far way rascoohan city with the name Washingstone.
''Jogador:'' '''pirats'''
'''Tik'hi Tak'he: ''' When they were still known as Corym, there were only occasional clashes over loot and flotsam. But one day things changed.
''Jogador:'' '''Washingstone'''
'''Tik'hi Tak'he: ''' It's only a place of mystery and legend. We have no contact since generations and its location was lost in time.
''Jogador:'' '''changed'''
'''Tik'hi Tak'he: ''' Our spies found out that the Corym retrieved an ancient book from a trunk in a shipwreck. It taught them about the ways of the pirates.
''Jogador:'' '''ways'''
'''Tik'hi Tak'he: ''' Their leaders were convinced that this was a description of the old and forgotten ways of their people and they adopted it.
''Jogador:'' '''adopted'''
'''Tik'hi Tak'he: ''' They became the pirats that we know today. They became more organized and more aggressive.
''Jogador:'' '''aggressive'''
'''Tik'hi Tak'he: ''' Things escalated when they by chance discovered the explosiveness of the mold of one of their favourite cheeses.
''Jogador:'' '''mold'''
'''Tik'hi Tak'he: ''' They weaponized the mold and refined it to so called green powder to create devastating weapons.
''Jogador:'' '''powder'''
'''Tik'hi Tak'he: ''' For now they employ it to terrorize the seas and experiment with its power.
''Jogador:'' '''terrorize
'''Tik'hi Tak'he: ''' It's only a matter of time until they will come and use their weapons against us. Therefore they have to be stopped.
''Jogador:'' '''power'''
'''Tik'hi Tak'he: ''' I fear they have yet to unleash the true destructive power of this weapon. For all what we know they keep experimenting and refining it, somewhere deep in their dens. ...
'''Tik'hi Tak'he: ''' To disrupt those experiments might prove helpful.
''Jogador:'' '''stopped'''
'''Tik'hi Tak'he: ''' We know many secrets and studied the pirats for a long time. Our knowledge will prove helpful in fighting them.
''Jogador:'' '''knowledge'''
'''Tik'hi Tak'he: ''' Before we share our knowledge you have to help us, to strengthen our position and secure our colony.
''Jogador:'' '''help'''
'''Tik'hi Tak'he: ''' When we feel safe enough from their retribution, we can approve a strike to the heart of the pirats. Until then it will be your mission to assist our colony.
''Jogador:'' '''raccoon'''
'''Tik'hi Tak'he: ''' He is our creator and guide.
''Jogador:'' '''creator'''
'''Tik'hi Tak'he: ''' The mother of all gave birth to the gods. The gods immediately begun with the creation of the world, as this was their only purpose.
''Jogador:'' '''creation'''
'''Tik'hi Tak'he: ''' Their greatest accomplishment was the creation of the great raccoon. Of all of the gods creations only he was perfect and therefore he was unique.
''Jogador:'' '''unique'''
'''Tik'hi Tak'he: ''' But the great raccoon immediately felt an enormous loneliness, because all of creation had their peers to bond but the unique raccoon hadn't.
''Jogador:'' '''loneliness'''
'''Tik'hi Tak'he: ''' So after the gods were done with creation, the great raccoon stole the secret of life out of their trashcan and created us Rascoohans in his image.
''Jogador:'' '''image'''
'''Tik'hi Tak'he: ''' The great raccoon looks over us and we live our life to his enjoyment.
''Jogador:'' '''enjoyment'''
'''Tik'hi Tak'he: ''' When the gods moved on to create other world, the great raccoon stood behind and kept watching over us.
''Jogador:'' '''king'''
'''Tik'hi Tak'he: ''' What king? We have no king or leader. We have to convince other to cooperate and don't order them.
''Jogador:'' '''wisdom'''
'''Tik'hi Tak'he: ''' Are you sure that you want to listen to rascoohan wisdom? It might shatter the perception of reality for the weak.
''Jogador:'' '''Yes (Possíveis respostas)'''
'''Tik'hi Tak'he: ''' Fools rush in while the iron is still hot.
'''Tik'hi Tak'he: ''' It's better to be poor and healthy than to throw stones from inside a glasshouse.
'''Tik'hi Tak'he: ''' If a man fools you once, shame on him. But if you teach him how to fish, he'll probably won't bother you ever again.
'''Tik'hi Tak'he: ''' Never pass on a free snack or an unsecured trashcan - which is basically the same.
'''Tik'hi Tak'he: ''' Too many cooks are better than one.
'''Tik'hi Tak'he: ''' The early bird gets the worm. But the worm got up even more early and what good did it do him?
}}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.title: Captain Coohan
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Captain Coohan | job = Roleplay | city = Kilmaresh | subarea = Rascacoon | location = [[Rascacoon]] ({{Mapa|33763,31337,7|aqui}}). | implemented = 12.60 | notes = Captain Coohan é um habitante de Rascacoon e se considera o melhor capitão dos mares. | buysell = não | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Captain Coohan: ''' Ahoy, Ahoy, Ye' Landlubber.
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''
'''Captain Coohan: ''' My name is Ca'coohan Tse, which translates to 'rides even an alligator'. But you can call me, Captain Coohan.
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''
'''Captain Coohan: ''' Me is the greatest captn' of all ye' isle.
''Jogador:'' '''Island'''
'''Captain Coohan: ''' Aye, there are rumours about a hidden treasure on a small island east of here. If you are interested, why not go on a little journey with me? I have a raft which lays at anchor in the north of the island. ...
'''Captain Coohan: ''' Meet me there and we will set forth on a fantastic voyage!
''Jogador:'' '''pirats'''
'''Captain Coohan: ''' Captain Coohan is afraid if no pirat. With cleverness and luck I always evaded their ships.
''Jogador:'' '''Captain / captn'''
'''Captain Coohan: ''' I don't have a boat, friend! I have a raft! I call it the Trekkie.
''Jogador:'' '''Trekkie'''
'''Captain Coohan: ''' I worked on that raft for years. Now that it's ready to conquer the seas, I only need a decent crew.
''Jogador:'' '''crew'''
'''Captain Coohan: ''' I'm considering to hire a diverse crew, Perhaps an orc for security issues, and some soulless golem to keep all the information that we might gather. ...
'''Captain Coohan: ''' I might even consider to hire an elf, because I kind of like their ears.
''Jogador:'' '''Washingstone'''
'''Captain Coohan: ''' One day I will rediscover the fabled city of Washingstone.
}}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.title: Om'Wake Naha
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Om'Wake Naha | job = Roleplay | city = Kilmaresh | subarea = Rascacoon | location = [[Rascacoon]] ({{Mapa|33746,31332,7|aqui}}). | implemented = 12.60 | buysell = não | notes = Om'Wake Naha é um habitante de Rascacoon e responsável pelos suprimentos da colônia.

* Faz parte da [[A Pirate's Tail Quest]].

| falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Om'Wake Naha: ''' Hello, traveller! Be welcome!
''Jogador:'' '''name'''
'''Om'Wake Naha: ''' My name is Om'Wake Naha, which translates into 'has many things' in your language.
''Jogador:'' '''job'''
'''Om'Wake Naha: ''' I am responsible for supplies and trade of the colony.
''Jogador:'' '''supplies'''
'''Om'Wake Naha: ''' Pesky ratmen are constantly raiding our cheese supplies. I could use a helping hand or two, to get rid of this problem.
''Jogador:'' '''helping'''
'''Om'Wake Naha: ''' The pirats use transformation magic to enter my cheese cellar as rats and they devour and steal our precious cheese.
''Jogador:'' '''cheese'''
'''Om'Wake Naha: ''' Push as many cheese as you can into the cheese larder in the center of the cellar. Use the staffs that our shaman supplied to dispel the disguise of the rats to fight the intruders.
''Jogador:'' '''colony'''
'''Om'Wake Naha: ''' Our town, Rascacoon, is just a colony. Our ancestors came here from a place far away on a journey to see the all wonders the world has to offer.
''Jogador:'' '''Rascacoon'''
'''Om'Wake Naha: ''' We face many hardships and hazards but our people are resourceful and until the pirats showed up our colony was thriving.
''Jogador:'' '''ancestors'''
'''Om'Wake Naha: ''' After several years of travel and hardships our ancestors settled here.
''Jogador:'' '''settled'''
'''Om'Wake Naha: ''' One day, when our colony is huge and striving, some of the young ones will go on their own journey and after a long travel will build their own colony.
''Jogador:'' '''day'''
'''Om'Wake Naha: ''' This day is still far away. There is still space enough and so much to be accomplished that no one gets bored.
''Jogador:'' '''Washingstone'''
'''Om'Wake Naha: ''' It's only an old story. Our tribe left that place generations ago.
}}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

== Frases Espontâneas ==
Não possui.

== Palavras-Chave ==
''Jogador'': '''hi'''</br>
'''Lost Traveler''': Holy logic, it's YOU!!!

''Jogador'': '''you'''</br>
'''Lost Traveler''': Oh, ...</br>
'''Lost Traveler''': I mean it's not like you're are anyone important or I'm interfering with the time stream!

''Jogador'': '''time''' / '''job'''</br>
'''Lost Traveler''': Oh, well. I might be a stranded time traveller that would appreciate your help.

''Jogador'': '''help'''</br>
'''Lost Traveler''': My chronoflux compensator accidentality run out of charges and I'm kind of stranded here unless I find a way to recharge it.

''Jogador'': '''recharge'''</br>
'''Lost Traveler''': I really need your help in locating other time travellers and extract time particles from them.

''Jogador'': '''chronoflux'''</br>
'''Lost Traveler''': I can't tell you anything more. I really don't want to mess up with the time stream ...</br>
'''Lost Traveler''': again.

''Jogador'': '''again'''</br>
'''Lost Traveler''': I'm certainly more careful ...</br>
'''Lost Traveler''': especially after that Ferumbras incident.

''Jogador'': '''ferumbras'''</br>
'''Lost Traveler''': Oh, don't even ask!

''Jogador'': '''locating'''</br>
'''Lost Traveler''': I can provide you with a divining rod that should be able to locate time travellers with active particles on them.

''Jogador'': '''provide'''</br>
'''Lost Traveler''': The equipment you need will be created by the chronomatic dispenser right next to me. It works roughly only once each day, so take care with the equipment.

''Jogador'': '''travellers'''</br>
'''Lost Traveler''': As we are currently in a very interesting time period of tibia there should be an abundance of other tourists that you can locate and extract time particles from.

''Jogador'': '''locate'''</br>
'''Lost Traveler''': I can provide you with a divining rod that should be able to locate time travellers with active particles on them.

''Jogador'': '''extract'''</br>
'''Lost Traveler''': I can supply you with a sophisticated device that can extract time particles from time travelling tourists and transfer them directly to my time travelling device.

''Jogador'': '''supply'''</br>
'''Lost Traveler''': The equipment you need will be created by the chronomatic dispenser right next to me. It works roughly only once each day, so take care with the equipment.

''Jogador'': '''particles'''</br>
'''Lost Traveler''': I can supply you with a sophisticated device that can extract time particles from time travelling tourists and transfer them directly to my time travelling device.
}}
