 | falas = __NOTOC__ == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Fernlor:''' Ah, my diligent helper, it's you.
''Jogador:'' '''Help'''
'''Fernlor:''' As the High Scryer of the Arcane Academy, my arcane devices allow me to continuously monitor the magical aether for traces of disturbances.
''Jogador:'' '''Monitor'''
'''Fernlor:''' I constantly scan the magical aether for any trace of anomalies. ...
'''Fernlor:''' Usually, my findings are just of academic importance, but recently I stumbled over spikes far beyond the normal and usual scale.
''Jogador:'' '''Anomalies'''
'''Fernlor:''' I found a recent disturbance at some remote, uncharted isle far away in the east. This disturbance has to be investigated! ...
'''Fernlor:''' Uhm, yet I am no way an adventurer and hold my prestigious position in the academy not for taking risky chances. This is where you enter the picture.
''Jogador:'' '''Picture'''
'''Fernlor:''' As far as the people here are concerned you are some kind of hero. And even better, you often work for free! Which, I must say, really helps, given the limited resources allocated to my operation. ...
'''Fernlor:''' I need someone with your skill set to find out what's going on there.
}}

pages.title: Lai
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}}
| name        = Lai
| job         = Roleplay
| npcclass    = Humanos
| npcsprite   = 
| city        = Edron
| subarea     = Azzilon Castle
| location    = [[Azzilon Castle]] ({{mapa|33834,32354,4:2|aqui}}).
| implemented = 14.10.4e0c16
| buysell     = não
| buys        = 
| sells       = 
| notes       = 
| falas       = __NOTOC__
== Frases Espontâneas ==

== Palavras-Chave ==
''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''</br>
'''Lai''': Be greeted, seeker of knowledge! We should talk about your '''mission'''.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Job'''</br>
'''Lai''': I'm Lai, a '''traveller''' from far away.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Traveller'''</br>
'''Lai''': I came '''here''' on behalf of my '''people''', to track down one of us, who has lost his '''path'''.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Here'''</br>
'''Lai''': From what I could learn, studying the surroundings, this place was once known as Azzilon, a '''bastion''' of the gods of light and good.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Bastion'''</br>
'''Lai''': It was inhabited, if not built, by a race of plant people, that were some of the gods champions back then. Before even fully manned, it came under siege by the forces of '''evil''' though.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Evil'''</br>
'''Lai''': Back then, aeons ago, the bulk of the forces of evil, consisted of a breed of demon-like beings, collectively known as '''inferniarchs'''.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''People'''</br>
'''Lai''': I am not allowed to talk about this topic. This amount of secrecy harrows me deeply but there are oaths and obligations that bind me. So all I can say is that I am deeply sorry, but that is something to be revealed on another day.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Path'''</br>
'''Lai''': This man was one of my people. Once one of our greatest minds, his answer to the problems we are facing has led him on a wrong and crooked path. ...</br>
'''Lai''': He had already done things that would have been unthinkable to him in the past. Yet only recently he went a step even further and allied himself with a despicable demon '''prince'''. ...</br>
'''Lai''': He lends the demons his power, special talents and '''knowledge'''. So equipped, with the gifts of an Enpa, there is no telling what darkness these demons will bring to this realm.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Prince'''</br>
'''Lai''': An ambitious demon prince, known as Arbaziloth has taken residence here, conducting his '''evil''' schemes.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Knowledge'''</br>
'''Lai''': He is able to manipulate certain energies, albeit in a twisted way that should be avoided at all '''cost'''.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Cost'''</br>
'''Lai''': By walking forbidden paths the renegade enabled the '''demons''' to extract the bound power of their ancient ancestors.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Demons'''</br>
'''Lai''': In ancient times, before the dawn of humanity, many races waged a war in the name of the so called gods of good. At this place was the last stand of one of those ancient races. ...</br>
'''Lai''': Eventually though they were overrun by what were the '''ancestors''' of the demons that you know.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Ancestors'''</br>
'''Lai''': The first demons, known as inferniarchs, were crude constructs of evil, merged and melted together with magic. Their magic was strong but bound to their bodies for all eternity. ...</br>
'''Lai''': You see, the modern demons, when they 'die', their bodies dissolve and the magic that held them together returns to the flows of magic that permeates this world. ...</br>
'''Lai''': Those ancient demons though were fused with their magic which is trapped in their dead bodies for all eternity. ...</br>
'''Lai''': That is until the renegade made his alliance with the demon prince. I don't know how the demons repaid his services but he used his powers to free the magic of the dead demons, so the demon prince could use it to strengthen himself and his legions. ...</br>
'''Lai''': Yet this tinkering had '''unforeseen''' effects.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Unforeseen'''</br>
'''Lai''': In ancient times, before the dawn of humanity, many races waged a war in the name of the so called gods of good. At this place was the last stand of one of those ancient races. ...</br>
'''Lai''': The dead demon ancestors, bereft of their magic created a disharmony in their undecaying dead bodies and they have risen to a strange form of '''unlife'''.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Unlife'''</br>
'''Lai''': Lai: They are filled with a hunger that drives them, a hunger that can't be satiated, a hunger that turns them into mindless tools of destruction, controlled only by their eternal '''hunger'''.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Hunger'''</br>
'''Lai''': They hunger for something they lost. There is a great '''disharmony''' in their essence.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Disharmony'''</br>
'''Lai''': <sighs> There are things and concepts, I am not allowed to talk about. Those are topics for another day and another place.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Inferniarchs'''</br>
'''Lai''': They were the ancestors of the 'modern' demons. Corrupt creatures through and through, driven by blasphemic magic '''energy''' fused into their twisted forms.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Energy'''</br>
'''Lai''': All the magic that gave them a resemblance of life, was fused into their forms for eternity. ...</br>
'''Lai''': Unlike modern and evolved demons from back then, their energy would not diffuse back into the magic currents of the magic web, but be trapped into their forms for all '''eternity''', be they alive or dead.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Eternity'''</br>
'''Lai''': So it seemed at least. Until recently that is. ...</br>
'''Lai''': The fallen one, that I mentioned, used his knowledge in a twisted way to harvest said energy from the dead bodies that still littered this place of the epic siege aeons ago. ...</br>
'''Lai''': In unspeakably twisting his powers, he managed to syphon the magical energies in a way, that made it possible for Arbaziloth's minions to refine and '''weaponize''' them. ...</br>
'''Lai''': And even worse, his defilement of our tenets had unforeseen '''consequences'''.

''Jogador:'' '''Weaponize'''</br>
'''Lai''': I am not entirely sure what the demons and Arbaziloth in particular are doing, but it's safe to assume that they have nothing good in mind. ...</br>
'''Lai''': If humanity is lucky he might use the power to gain power amongst his own kin, yet that would be only some borrowed time until he sets his eyes on other goals.</br>

''Jogador:'' '''Consequences'''</br>
'''Lai''': The dead, never decomposing corpses of the inferniarchs, bereft of the magic that once held them together, rose again. ...</br>
'''Lai''': Yet, calling them simply undead would be imprecise in so many ways. There's an emptiness of unimaginable proportions within their bodies. ...</br>
'''Lai''': It defies the rules of nature and harmony so much that it animates them in an echo of what they've once been. ...</br>
'''Lai''': They are driven by an insatiable hunger for something they couldn't understand, even if they had some form of real conscience.</br>
}}

pages.title: A Vision Of The Past
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = A Vision Of The Past | job = Roleplay | npcclass = Plantas | npcsprite = Grove Guardian | city = Edron | subarea = Castle Catacombs | location = [[Castle Catacombs]] ({{mapa|34063,32371,14:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 14.10.4e0c16 | buysell = não | buys = | sells = | notes = | falas = __NOTOC__ == Frases Espontâneas == == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''A Vision Of The Past:''' Greetings visitor.
''Jogador:'' '''Visitor'''
'''A Vision Of The Past:''' The place you are visiting, is nothing but an echo of the past.
''Jogador:'' '''Echo'''
'''A Vision Of The Past:''' This place and I are just visions of a long gone area.
''Jogador:'' '''Visions'''
'''A Vision Of The Past:''' I am what no longer is alive. A mere memory stored in the walls of our fallen fortress.
''Jogador:'' '''Memory'''
'''A Vision Of The Past:''' The last memory of a once proud race, wiped out in their war against the demons.
''Jogador:'' '''Race'''
'''A Vision Of The Past:''' Once we were numerous. We seeded the world, that the gods entrusted us to protect. We became their champions and wardens in their wars against evil.
''Jogador:'' '''War'''
'''A Vision Of The Past:''' We fought in the name of the gods. We fought valiantly. We fought gloriously. Yet ultimately we failed.
''Jogador:'' '''Failed'''
'''A Vision Of The Past:''' We were great soldiers. Many battles were won by our wooden legions by physical prowess, magical insight and the blessings of the gods. Yet we were not prepared for the fury of the inferniarchs. ...
'''A Vision Of The Past:''' The inferniarchs managed to burn their hellish portals into weak pockets of the rock and from there wormed their way into the bowels of our fortress while we were fighting off their siege engines. ...
'''A Vision Of The Past:''' Even then we might have stood a chance, but we were not prepared for Rotrender.
''Jogador'': '''Rotrender'''
'''A Vision Of The Past:''' He was a massive inferniarch, the wildest and most despicable of them all. Where he walked, the ground was defiled and rot nested. His touch withered our bark and caused us to crumble...
'''A Vision Of The Past:''' He became the scourge of Azzilon. Our doom. In the end, we lured him into a cave where some of our finest had merged with stone and earth. ...
'''A Vision Of The Past:''' Their roots collapsed the cave over the fiend, crushing his poisonous body under masses of rock, ending its existence. ...
'''A Vision Of The Past:''' But the damage had been done, our defences breached. The hordes of the inferniarchs were everywhere. We did not go out without a glorious battle, taking inferniarchs with us in droves. ...
'''A Vision Of The Past:''' In the end they brought us down though. One by one the defenders fell and at some point even the victorious cackling of the remaining inferniarchs ceased and silence fell over Azzilon, to be forgotten by the world we fought for.
''Jogador:'' '''Prepared'''
'''A Vision Of The Past:''' We prepared for the great war to come. We planted the seeds for our future armies all over the world. A legion to behold would have risen, with the passing of the seasons. ...
'''A Vision Of The Past:''' But before the seeds could flourish, the sheer number of demons and their ferocity overwhelmed us.
''Jogador:'' '''Flourish'''
'''A Vision Of The Past:''' The legions were prepared to bloom, but without us to teach the next generation, our once proud race will fall into barbarism and disarray. ...
'''A Vision Of The Past:''' Or already has, as we are only a faint memory without substance or identity now.
''Jogador:'' '''Disarray'''
'''A Vision Of The Past:''' The fortress of Azzilon fell. Our race perished. All our preparations were for naught. Even our ultimate weapon wasn't prepared to save us.
''Jogador:'' '''Ultimate'''
'''A Vision Of The Past:''' We planted the seed for the ultimate weapon, safely hidden in the deepest depths of the high seas. If it had grown, it would have turned the tide of battle. But we underestimated time.
''Jogador:'' '''Time'''
'''A Vision Of The Past:''' We thought in the dimensions of trees, time meant little to us. It was an ally at best. But time turned out to become our worst enemy.
''Jogador:'' '''Enemy'''
'''A Vision Of The Past:''' Time had run out for us. We lost the next generations that we planted and our folly doomed our civilisation. Our best weapon was not even blossoming, when the demons came. This doomed us all.
''Jogador:'' '''Doomed'''
'''A Vision Of The Past:''' This echo is our last legacy, the legacy of a lost race. Let our fate be a reminder for others not to underestimate time. The things you seem to have in abundance may turn on you at some point.
'''A Vision Of The Past:''' Never forget, that time is precious, even when you seem to have it in abundance.
}}

pages.title: Enpa Rudra
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Enpa Rudra | job = Roleplay | npcclass = Humanos | npcsprite = Monk | city = Quirefang | subarea = Quirefang | location = [[Blue Valley]] ({{mapa|33604,31447,6:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 15.00.249ccc | notes = Enpa Rudra é um instrutor de magias para Monks. | buysell = sim | buys = Nada. | sells = {{Ensina |Magic Patch |Tiger Clash |Swift Jab |Light Healing |Find Person |Light |Magic Rope |Cure Poison |Levitate |Great Light |Haste |Double Jab |Restore Balance |Greater Tiger Clash |Intense Healing |Strong Haste |Find Fiend |Enlighten Party |Flurry of Blows |Sweeping Takedown |Chained Penance |Spirit Mend |Greater Flurry of Blows |Devastating Knockout |Mass Spirit Mend |Focus Serenity |Mentor Other |Balanced Brawl |Summon Monk Familiar }} Promotions {{Trades/Sell | Vocation Promotion}} | falas = __NOTOC__ == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Enpa Rudra:''' I welcome you, monk. Now that you have been brought here, tell me what you seek in this most sacred place. I can also teach you spells or promote you.
''Jogador:'' '''Seek'''
'''Enpa Rudra:''' Since Manop brought you here, you must be strong at heart, firm of will and eager to learn. ...
'''Enpa Rudra:''' He did not choose you, he merely decided not to stand in the path of the choice you already made and helped it manifest in the form of your arrival upon us in our valley. ...
'''Enpa Rudra:''' You will learn, you will fight, you will follow the Three-Fold Path.
''Jogador:'' '''Three-Fold Path'''
'''Enpa Rudra:''' All initiates have to undergo the Three-Fold path to understand the way of the Merudri and become true warrior monks. ...
'''Enpa Rudra:''' Many generations of monks have been chosen to travel the world of Tibia incognito to study and learn the ways of the outside world. The pilgrims are not to take part in skirmishes or settle down outside of the valley. ...
'''Enpa Rudra:''' Learning, documenting and training, they eventually find their way back to the valley after years of wandering. Embracing the three elements of harmony, enlightenment and power. ...
'''Enpa Rudra:''' These three elements of totality are to be found among the Merudri shrines which dot Tibian landscapes all over our world. ...
'''Enpa Rudra:''' Enpa-Deia Pema will answer all your questions concerning our sacred pilgrimage.
''Jogador:'' '''King'''
''' Enpa Rudra:''' Monks are no subjects and there is no king without subjects. Our community is bound by tradition and harmony. Our hierarchies are shaped by our legacy.
''Jogador:'' '''Hierarchies'''
''' Enpa Rudra:''' Our hierarchies are based around the concept of the Enpa, spiritual leader and guide to all Merudri, equal, however in rights and power. The Enpa is selected among Merudri and destined to become a warrior monk. ...
''' Enpa Rudra:''' Enpa-Jiva, confidants of the Enpa, are trusted to take on specific tasks, the Enpa needs help with. There is always a successor to the Enpa, which we call Enpa-Deia, there will be only one. ...
''' Enpa Rudra:''' An Enpa can reach a higher state and leave the physical form that binds us to our worldly existence to become Dhar-Enpa. ...
''' Enpa Rudra:''' Attaining the highest state of consciousness, Sempi-Enpa, requires absolute control and perfect balance. For generations, due to our legacy, no Dhar-Enpa has attempted to reach this state. ...
''' Enpa Rudra:''' When a successor has been found and is prepared to take on its designated role, the current Enpa will decide if it is time to leave the physical shell.
''Jogador:'' '''Legacy'''
''' Enpa Rudra:''' The Merudri, our ancestors, were once separated from their homeland and cut-off from the rest of their civilisation by the creation of a reality rift. ...
''' Enpa Rudra:''' Broken away from their home continent and floating through time and space, the Merudri found ways to manipulate the rift, which connected worlds to travel there, looking for a way home. ...
''' Enpa Rudra:''' During these times, our ancestors had to fight the Yng, a relentless foe, emerging through the rift and bound on consuming the rest of civilisation. ...
''' Enpa Rudra:''' When Sempi-Enpa Gaan closed the rift, the Yng threat was gone, but the cost was immeasurably high. The Sempi-Enpa lost control and got stuck in a dimensional pocket. ...
''' Enpa Rudra:''' Losing every last ounce of humanity he once possessed, this metaphysical being now roams another dimension either insane or, even more likely, absolutely determined and with ill intent. ...
''' Enpa Rudra:''' You can learn more of our legacy by tapping into our vast collected knowledge in the form of various books, written by monks here in our sanctuary.
''Jogador:'' '''Enpa-Deia'''
''' Enpa Rudra:''' The successor to the Enpa is selected at a young age. Once chosen, an Enpa-Deia will follow a strict regiment of learning and training to adjust to the future role of the Enpa. ...
''' Enpa Rudra:''' Our Enpa-Deia is Pema. She can help you on your path with equipment and spells.
''Jogador:'' '''Sempi-Enpa'''
''' Enpa Rudra:''' There comes a time when an Enpa reaches the utmost level of harmony, enlightenment and control. In this completely serene state, he can focus all his energy and wield tremendous power over himself - and others. ...
''' Enpa Rudra:''' It is possible for an Enpa to move on to a higher state and leave the physical body to become Dhar-Enpa. After this, most of the mind of an Enpa is focused on control and containment. ...
''' Enpa Rudra:''' Once a Dhar-Enpa decides to essentially become one with our world itself, he becomes Sempi-Enpa, eternal and powerful beyond imagination. ...
''' Enpa Rudra:''' Dhar-Enpa Gaan decided to leave his metaphysical state and become Sempi-Enpa to close the reality rift and seal the Yng from ever trespassing the valley again. He closed the rift but was not able to contain and control his power. ...
''' Enpa Rudra:''' Lost in a dimensional pocket that formed during the closing of the rift, he is lost to the Merudri and a potential threat to everything in this realm. It is for this reason, that only one other Enpa has decided to become Dhar-Enpa ever since.
''Jogador:'' '''Yng'''
''' Enpa Rudra:''' The Yng, our nemesis, scourge of our ancestors and defining our legacy. Entering our realm through the depths of the reality rift, they terrorised the Merudri for centuries.
''Jogador:'' '''Dhar-Enpa'''
''' Enpa Rudra:''' There comes a time when an Enpa reaches the utmost level of harmony, enlightenment and control. In this completely serene state, he can focus all his energy and wield tremendous power over himself - and others. ...

pages.title: Dahr-Enpa Rahng
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Dahr-Enpa Rahng | job = Roleplay | npcclass = Humanos | npcsprite = Monk | city = Quirefang | subarea = Blue Valley | location = [[Blue Valley]] ({{mapa|33544,31447,5:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 15.00.249ccc | buysell = não | buys = | sells = | notes = * Só interage com personagens da classe [[Monk]]; * Mencionado no livro [[The Temperate Spirit in the Cave (Book)|The Temperate Spirit in the Cave]]. | falas = __NOTOC__ == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Dahr-Enpa Rahng:''' Welcome, monk. This is not your place to be.
''Jogador:'' '''Blue valley'''
'''Dahr-Enpa Rahng:''' This valley has been my home and will be for the foreseeable time.
''Jogador:'' '''Pilgrimage'''
'''Dahr-Enpa Rahng:''' Every monk must undertake the Three-Fold Path. So did I and so is the way of the Merudri of the valley.
''Jogador:'' '''Merudri'''
'''Dahr-Enpa Rahng:''' I am Merudri, yet every monk can become Dhar-Enpa, once inducted to our ways and given the proper training.
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
'''Dahr-Enpa Rahng:''' Harmony, enlightenment, power.
}}

pages.title: Dajcho the Monk
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Dajcho the Monk | job = Roleplay | npcclass = Humanos | npcsprite = Monk | city = Quirefang | subarea = Blue Valley | location = [[Blue Valley]] ({{mapa|33652,31454,7:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 15.00.249ccc | buysell = não | buys = | sells = | notes = | falas = __NOTOC__ == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Dajcho the Monk:''' Welcome, fellow monk. Into this valley's blue, warm bosom you are invited. Stay with us, listen and learn.
''Jogador:'' '''name'''
'''Dajcho the Monk:''' My name is Dajcho, humble Monk from the valley, currently on the Three-Fold Path.
''Jogador:'' '''Blue valley'''
'''Dajcho the Monk:''' Our valley has been the center of our lives for generations. We are born here, learn the Merudri ways of our ancestors and no matter where our paths may take us, will return to this place eventually.
''Jogador:'' '''job'''
'''Dajcho the Monk:''' I am a monk on the Three-Fold Path. I am resting in the valley to gather strength but I plan to continue as soon as I can.
''Jogador:'' '''Pilgrimage / Three-Fold Path'''
'''Dajcho the Monk:''' I am currently on the path, my pilgrimage has led to severe difficulties, however and I have returned, prematurely, to the valley. ...
'''Dajcho the Monk:''' My journey along the path is not yet complete. I am here to gather strength and focus to continue. My experiences have been straining and dire. ...
'''Dajcho the Monk:''' Since you are a pilgrim as well, talk to our Enpa-Deia, she will help you on your path.
''Jogador:'' '''Experiences'''
'''Dajcho the Monk:''' The experiences I made on my pilgrimage are mine and mine alone. It is of my own free will to share them with fellow Merudri only as of now.
''Jogador:'' '''Enpa-Deia / Pema'''
'''Dajcho the Monk:''' Pema will be the successor to our Enpa Rudra. She will continue to fight for our legacy with just as much passion and wisdom when her time comes.
''Jogador:'' '''King'''
'''Dajcho the Monk:''' No kings rule over the valley.
''Jogador:'' '''shrines'''
'''Dajcho the Monk:''' Eleven shrines are dotting the landscape of this realm. The Three-Fold Path will lead a monk to do every single one of them.
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
'''Dajcho the Monk:''' Save passage, friend!
}}

pages.title: Bodh the Kan
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Bodh the Kan | job = Roleplay | npcclass = Humanos | npcsprite = Monk | city = Quirefang | subarea = Blue Valley | location = [[Blue Valley]] ({{mapa|33573,31453,7:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 15.00.249ccc | buysell = não | buys = | sells = | notes = | falas = __NOTOC__ == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Bodh the Kan:''' Hmh. Tread carefully around here, some of these plants are way older than you.
''Jogador:'' '''Name'''
'''Bodh the Kan:''' My name is Bodh.
''Jogador:'' '''Job / Kan'''
'''Bodh the Kan:''' We are Kan, keepers of the channelled growth. We are one with nature, linked in complete harmony.
''Jogador:'' '''Enpa-Deia'''
'''Bodh the Kan:''' The Enpa is not only our spiritual guide but also one with nature and an admirer of our sacred gardens. He would often come here and enjoy the peace and quiet around the blooming flowers. He seems to be quite busy recently, however.
''Jogador:'' '''Gardens'''
'''Bodh the Kan:''' Do you want to know about the temple gardens?
''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''
'''Bodh the Kan:''' The gardens are what keeps our soul grounded and in good health. Kan kept the harmony of these fertile soils for centuries. We also collect and cultivate foreign plants and rice.
''Jogador:'' '''rice / Zao'''
'''Bodh the Kan:''' Rice was brought to us from the ancient continent of Zao. The monks have been travelling to this location for generations to hone their skills, gather ingredients and refine their weapons.
''Jogador:'' '''Blue valley'''
'''Bodh the Kan:''' The valley is rich in vegetation. Bursting of fragrance and colour in the spring and summer, it truly is a sight to behold. You need an eye and a nose for things like this, of course.
''Jogador:'' '''King'''
'''Bodh the Kan:''' No kings in the Blue Valley, friend.
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''
'''Bodh the Kan:''' Careful around the gardens! I do not want to repeat myself.
}}

== Palavras-Chave ==
''Jogador'' (Monk):'''Hi'''</br>
'''Saih the Guardian''': Careful, monk. You know how to treat this sacred place.</br>

''Jogador'' (Outras vocações):'''Hi'''</br>
'''Saih the Guardian''': Careful there. You are welcome here but treat this sacred place with respect.</br>

''Jogador:'':'''name'''</br>
'''Saih the Guardian: '''Name is Saih, I greet you, traveller.</br>
''Jogador'':'''job'''</br>
'''Saih the Guardian: '''I am one of the guardians of the Blue Valley. My task is to keep the valley safe and take action in case our security is at risk.</br>
''Jogador'':'''Blue Valley'''</br>
'''Saih the Guardian: '''The valley has been our home as it has been the home of our ancestors who were separated from the birth-place. It is a place worth fighting for. As is the legacy of the Merudri and everything we achieved.</br>
''Jogador'':'''Merudri'''</br>
'''Saih the Guardian: '''We are Merudri, this valley has been our sanctuary for centuries and is the only thing left from our true ancestral home.</br>
''Jogador'':'''King'''</br>
'''Saih the Guardian: '''No kings in the valley, traveller.</br>
''Jogador'':'''Enpa-Deia'''</br>
'''Saih the Guardian: '''The Enpa is under our specific protection. As keeper of our legacy it is our sworn duty to protect and defend the Enpa, his sanctuary and everything within the borders of the valley.</br>
''Jogador'':'''Gardens / Kan'''</br>
'''Saih the Guardian: '''The gardens are tended to by our Kan, traditional gardeners. Honourable and caring. Watch your tone around them and treat them with respect.</br>
''Jogador'':'''Three-Fold Path'''</br>
'''Saih the Guardian: '''The path every pilgrim must undertake to become a warrior monk and true defender of the Merudri ways.</br>
''Jogador'':'''Zao'''</br>
'''Saih the Guardian: '''A place that has been known to us for generations. Many of us have been training there. It is also part of the Three-Fold Path.</br>


''Jogador'':'''Bye'''</br>
'''Saih the Guardian''': Beware!</br>

}}

''Jogador'':'''Hi'''</br>
'''Enpa-Deia Pema''': Harmony, friend. Allow me to welcome you in the Blue Valley. I offer guidance for the pilgrimage and can provide healing. Or can I help you otherwise?</br>

''Jogador'':'''Blue Valley'''</br>
'''Enpa-Deia Pema''': The valley is our home and a central hub to all Merudri. Most of us are undertaking their pilgrimage. Others are training, teaching and tending to the valley. Keeping our legacy and culture alive.</br>

''Jogador'':'''healing'''</br>
'''Enpa-Deia Pema''': You do not need any healing right now.</br>

''Jogador'':'''name'''</br>
'''Enpa-Deia Pema''': My name is Pema.</br>
''Jogador'':'''job'''</br>
'''Enpa-Deia Pema''': I am the Enpa-Deia, successor to the Enpa and custodian of our temple. I will support your pilgrimage and can provide equipment.</br>
''Jogador'':'''Enpa-Deia'''</br>
'''Enpa-Deia Pema''': The Enpa-Deia eventually succeeds the Enpa. Chosen at a very young age, a devoted life of dedicated training and sacrifice follows. ...</br>
'''Enpa-Deia Pema''': It is not only an honour, but heed to a call far greater than ourselves.</br>
''Jogador'':'''Enpa'''</br>
'''Enpa-Deia Pema''': Our spiritual guide and guardian. Wise and just he has opened the valley and our hearts and minds. For our legacy will live on even beyond our beloved home.</br>

''Jogador'':'''valley'''</br>
'''Enpa-Deia Pema''': The valley is our home and a central hub to all Merudri. Most of us are undertaking their pilgrimage. Others are training, teaching and tending to the valley. Keeping our legacy and culture alive.</br>
''Jogador'':'''equipment'''</br>
'''Enpa-Deia Pema''': Certainly.</br>
''Jogador'':'''Kan'''</br>
'''Enpa-Deia Pema''': Gardeners and keepers order.</br>
''Jogador'':'''Three-Fold Path'''</br>
'''Enpa-Deia Pema''': Pilgrims of the Merudri have placed eleven shrines all across this realm as part of the Three-Fold Path, our pilgrimage.</br>
''Jogador'':'''pilgrimage'''</br>
'''Enpa-Deia Pema''': You have honoured our legacy and the ways of our ancestors. On behalf of all Merudri I want to express my respect and thank you, venerable traveller.</br>
''Jogador'':'''King'''</br>
'''Enpa-Deia Pema''': There are no kings amidst the monks.</br>
''Jogador'':'''Queen'''</br>
'''Enpa-Deia Pema''': No kings, nor queens amidst the monks of the Blue Valley.</br>

}}

pages.title: Ambassador Manop
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Ambassador Manop | job = Roleplay | npcclass = Humanos | npcsprite = Monk | city = Dawnport | subarea = Dawnport Centre | location = [[Dawnport Centre]] ({{mapa|32058,31898,4:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 15.00.249ccc | notes = Ambassador Manop está no andar superior do posto avançado da Adventurers' Guild em Dawnport, na sala ao sul e à esquerda, próximo ao pedestal da vocação [[Monk]].

* Faz parte da [[The Way of the Monk Quest]].

| buysell = não | buys = | sells = | falas = __NOTOC__ == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Ambassador Manop:''' I welcome you, traveller of fate's unsearchable roads. On behalf of the Merudri, let this be an invitation from a humble guide along the way of enlightenment.
''Jogador:'' '''Invitation'''
'''Ambassador Manop:''' Your path has led you to an ambassador of the Merudri. I am Manop and will do my best to explain to you our purpose, legacy and your role in it. Shall I continue?
''Jogador:'' '''yes'''
'''Ambassador Manop:''' I am glad to make your acquaintance, seeker. You must have a lot of questions for which I would gladly provide answers. If you are interested in joining us as a true warrior monk, just ask.
''Jogador:'' '''Merudri'''
'''Ambassador Manop:''' We are Merudri, warrior monks. Honing serenity, preserving our legacy, defending the Blue Valley and beyond.
''Jogador:'' '''Monks'''
'''Ambassador Manop:''' The warrior monk combines harmony of the soul, enlightenment of the mind and the power of the body. Honing all these skills with focus and following the Merudri ways with dedication will allow a monk to reach true serenity of their spirit. ...
'''Ambassador Manop:''' A warrior monk is a weapon in itself, trained, dynamic and deadly. Make no mistake, we are using our skills to preserve, defend and protect our legacy. Violence is a means to a terrible end and we'll refrain from using it unless the utmost necessity. ...
'''Ambassador Manop:''' Given a monk has to utilise such measures, however, direct opposition will be eradicated.
''Jogador:'' '''Serenity'''
'''Ambassador Manop:''' Harmony, enlightenment and power are the keys and control is the door to true serenity.
''Jogador:'' '''Blue Valley'''
'''Ambassador Manop:''' The Blue Valley is our ancestral home and heart of the Merudri culture, or what is left of it. Our ancestors from the Valley have long been separated from the true home of the Merudri.
''Jogador:'' '''Pilgrimage'''
'''Ambassador Manop:''' The pilgrimage is the sacred Three-Fold Path every monk must go. Are you familiar with the Merudri ways of the monks?
''Jogador:'' '''Three-Fold Path'''
'''Ambassador Manop:''' Let me know if you are still looking for answers, seeker.
''Jogador:'' '''Seeker'''
'''Ambassador Manop:''' Once you have reached level 8, talk to me again and we will see if you are ready to join us on our pilgrimage.
}}

pages.title: Death (NPC)
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Death (NPC) | job = Roleplay | npcclass = | npcsprite = | city = | subarea = Book World | location = [[Edron]] ({{mapa|32570,32574,11|aqui}}). | implemented = 15.10.46b862 | buysell = não | buys = | sells = | notes = | falas = ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Death:''' Greetings, mortal! I am Death and I have waited here for you.
''Jogador:'' '''Death'''
'''Death:''' Indeed. But do not fear me. I am not the enemy you expect. I am a companion, a guide, a transition.
''Jogador:'' '''guide'''
'''Death:''' I am here to give you perspective. In your journey through Tibia, you have been confronted with darkness and loss. ...
''Death:''' It is natural to fear death, the end of everything you know. But I am not the end. I am a transition.
''Jogador:'' '''transition'''
'''Death:''' To something new. Life is a dance, and death is the turn that leads us in a new direction. Every ending is a new beginning, a blank slate, a chance for change. ...
'''Death:''' If you ask me the right questions, I can give you the insight you need to successfully complete your journey.
''Jogador:'' '''loss'''
'''Death:''' That is true, I take. But I also give something back: peace. Freedom from suffering and pain. And the memory of shared love will remain in your hearts forever.
''Jogador:'' '''acceptance'''
'''Death:''' You can accept me by embracing life. By cherishing every moment, every encounter, every experience. By knowing that everything is fleeting, and that is precisely what makes it so precious. ...
'''Death:''' So hear my advice.
''Jogador:'' '''advice'''
'''Death:''' Live! Love! Laugh! Cry! Feel! Experience everything life has to offer with all your heart. And when your time comes, go with dignity and without fear. For I will be there to welcome you. ...
'''Death:''' Now go on. Your journey is not over. And remember: death is not the end of the story. It is only a chapter. *He turns away, but the conversation leaves you with new thoughts and a deeper understanding*
}}

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Oblivis | job = Roleplay | npcclass = | npcsprite = | city = Thais | subarea = Thais Surroundings | location = [[Thais]] ({{mapa|32220,32118,7:1|aqui}}). | implemented = 15.12.c7d92c | buysell = não | buys = | sells = | notes = O NPC permite o reset de determinadas [[Quest]]s. {{Veja|Reset de Quest}} | falas = __NOTOC__ == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Oblivis:''' Greetings, adventurer! How can I help you?
''Jogador:'' '''Reset quest'''
'''Oblivis:''' I don't have a quest for you exactly. Though I could help you replay certain experiences with the help of my spell.
''Jogador:'' '''Replay'''
'''Oblivis:''' Wouldn't it be nice to go back and do things differently? I might have the right spell that could help you with that.
''Jogador:'' '''Spell'''
'''Oblivis:''' What experience should I let people forget with my spell?
''Jogador:'' '''Jack in the future'''
'''Oblivis:''' Jack? Ah yes, you must have done some quest for Spectulus, would you like to play those memories again? I could help you with that, for a price obviously.
''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''
'''Oblivis:''' Are you sure, you want to spend 100000000 gold to be able to replay this quest?
}}

| notes = | falas =__NOTOC__ == Falas gerais == '''Avriel:''' Welcome to my little shop, Sabarath Newhaven! Are you looking to trade anything precious?
''Jogador:'' '''Anna'''
'''Avriel:''' Anna often travels to the mainland to get supplies for my shop, it's great working with her. You can find her at the ferry house just north of here.
''Jogador:'' '''Gustavo'''
'''Avriel:''' Ah, my good friend Gustavo, he's keeping us safe from the north part of this island. I heard he's talking about needing some assistance, if you're interested don't be shy to talk to him.
''Jogador:'' '''Viola'''
'''Avriel:''' Viola always wins on our quiz nights, one can really learn much from her. I guess if your interested in learning more, she's the right person to talk to.
''Jogador:'' '''Flavius'''
'''Avriel:''' Flavius is running the bank here in Newhaven.
''Jogador:'' '''Tim'''
'''Avriel:''' If you ever need someone to handle the ugly things, he's your guard to do it.
''Jogador:'' '''Newhaven'''
'''Avriel:''' Ever since I moved here, life has just been great, if only those goblins wouldn't terrorise us. Maybe you could help us, talk to Gustavo for more information.
''Jogador:'' '''Thais'''
'''Avriel:''' You should visit Thais someday, it's our capital with lots of shops, trainers and great people.
''Jogador:'' '''King'''
'''Avriel:''' Our King Tibianus rules over everything.
''Jogador:'' '''Muglex'''
'''Avriel:''' These little creatures have been terrorising our village for quite some time now, I just hope we stay safe here.
== Falas mercado == ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Avriel:''' Welcome to my little shop, Jogador! Are you looking to trade anything precious?
''Jogador:'' '''Shop'''
'''Avriel:''' I am selling all kinds of equipment. Let me know if you're interested in a trade.
''Jogador:'' '''Trade'''
'''Avriel:''' Of course, take a look and see what might interest you.
|}}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Gustavo, the Guard | job = Guarda | npcclass = Humanos | npcsprite = Warrior | city = Newhaven | subarea = | location = [[Newhaven]] ({{Mapa|32560,32488,7:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 15.12.c7d92c | notes =

 | buysell = não | falas = __NOTOC__ == Falas espontâneas == '''Gustavo, the Guard:''' Bloody goblins!
'''Gustavo, the Guard:''' Long live the king!
'''Gustavo, the Guard:''' Hey there, young adventurer! Need a hint?
== Sobre NPCs == ''Jogador:'' '''Tim'''
'''Gustavo, the Guard:''' Tim is a good friend of mine. He works as a guard in the city of Thais.
''Jogador:'' '''Tibianus'''
'''Gustavo, the Guard:''' Tibianus III is our beloved king! He resides in the castle in the city of Thais.
''Jogador:'' '''Viola'''
'''Gustavo, the Guard:''' She's a well-read woman who knows a thing or two about magic. Maybe she can teach you a few spells. She might also have a small task for you. I've heard she's missing one of her books.
''Jogador:'' '''Flavius'''
'''Gustavo, the Guard:''' Flavius runs the small bank in this village. You can find him over there in his the house.
''Jogador:'' '''Anna'''
'''Gustavo, the Guard:''' She offers a passage to the Mainland. You can find her at the ferry house.
''Jogador:'' '''Avriel'''
'''Gustavo, the Guard:''' Avriel runs a small shop here in the village. You can buy useful things there, but you can also sell things you no longer need. You will find his shop in the south of the village.
''Jogador:'' '''Ben'''
'''Gustavo, the Guard:''' You're talking about the bear, aren't you? Yes, it's a long story. And one that I don't necessarily want to share with everyone. It's personal, you could say.
== Sobre cidades == ''Jogador:'' '''Thais'''
'''Gustavo, the Guard:''' Thais is our beautiful capital, ruled by our benevolent king Tibianus III.
== Sobre missões == ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Gustavo, The Guard:''' Those bloody goblins are too close to the village for my liking.
''Jogador:'' '''Goblins'''
'''Gustavo, The Guard:''' They call themselves the Muglex Clan. They may be small, but don't be fooled, they can be quite dangerous. You seem capable enough, though. ...
'''Gustavo, The Guard:''' Please take down twenty of these Muglex goblins. That should make life in the village safer again.
''Jogador:'' '''Goblins'''
'''Gustavo, The Guard:''' You rendered a great favour to this village. Thank you! Now take this ring as a form of my gratitude, I'm sure it will aid you in combat. Oh, and if you did not talk to Viola yet, you should visit her. ...
'''Gustavo, The Guard:''' She might also have a small task for you. I've heard she's missing one of her books.
}}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.title: Anna
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Anna | job = Capitão de Navios | npcclass = Humanos | npcsprite = Fencer | city = Newhaven | subarea = | location = [[Newhaven]] ({{Mapa|32553,32497,7:3|aqui}}). | implemented = 15.12.c7d92c | notes = Transporta jogadores para a [[Thais Peninsula]] ou, no caso de personagens da vocação [[Monk]], para [[Blue Valley]]. | buysell = não | falas = __NOTOC__ == Palavras chave == ''Jogador:'' '''Rookgaard'''
'''Anna:''' Oh sorry, I'm only here for the ferry service. Return if you are ready for a passage.
''Jogador:'' '''Gustavo'''
'''Anna:''' He is a capable fighter and keeps our village safe from the Muglex Clan goblins.
''Jogador:'' '''Tim'''
'''Anna:''' He is a friend of our guard Gustavo but he lives in the capital Thais.
''Jogador:'' '''Viola'''
'''Anna:''' Viola is a good friend of mine and knows a thing or two about magic. Maybe she can teach you a few spells.
''Jogador:'' '''Flavius'''
'''Anna:''' He runs the small bank in this village. You can find him over there in the house.
''Jogador:'' '''Avriel'''
'''Anna:''' Avriel runs a small shop here in the village. You can buy useful things there, but you can also sell things you no longer need. You will find his shop right south of the ferry house.
''Jogador:'' '''Thais'''
'''Anna:''' Thais is actually the oldest city in Tibia. But be careful on those streets, there are bandits everywhere. ...
'''Anna:''' It might be better if I take you to the Targuna. Ask me for a passage if you're interested.
''Jogador:'' '''Passage'''
'''Anna:''' I'm offering a ferry service to the island Targuna, are you interested?
''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''
'''Anna:''' Very well, I'll take you to the island Targuna then.
}}

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Viola | job = Guild Leader | npcclass = Humanos | npcsprite = Mage | city = Newhaven | subarea = | location = [[Newhaven]] ({{Mapa|32571,32507,7:3|aqui}}). | implemented = 15.12.c7d92c | notes = Viola vende magias para [[Druid]]s, [[Sorcerer]]s, [[Paladin]]s , [[Knight]]s e [[Monk]]s.

 | buysell = sim | sells = ''Magias'' {{Ensina | Cure Poison | Wound Cleansing | Magic Rope | Light}} | buys = | falas = ''Falas gerais'' ''Jogador:'' '''Mines'''
'''Viola:''' These mines were once a thriving force for workers and investors alike, ever since the last ores have been mined, these trenches have been abandoned for good.
''Jogador:'' '''Viola'''
'''Viola:''' Yes?
''Jogador:'' '''Newhaven'''
'''Viola:''' Our little island once had a strong economy based on the mines. Lots of workers came from overseas to work here. I still remember that beautiful harbour we had here, good old times.
''Jogador:'' '''Anna'''
'''Viola:''' Anna always enjoyed the thrill of the open sea. She often supplies Avriels shop with goods for all of us. Then you're ready to leave I suggest talking to her.
''Jogador:'' '''Avriels shop'''
'''Viola:''' Avriel takes care of our little shop just west from my house. When you're looking for supplies or want to sell stuff, you should talk to him.
''Jogador:'' '''Shop'''
'''Viola:''' You can find the shop just east of here. Avriel will get you going with everything you need.
''Jogador:'' '''Gustavo'''
'''Viola:''' Ahh, yes my dearest Gustavo. He's the guard of our little village protecting us from the muglex. If you're interested in helping, you should talk to him.
''Jogador:'' '''Flavius'''
'''Viola:''' Flavius is the banker on our island. When you need any financial advice, you will find him just north of my house.
''Jogador:'' '''Mainland'''
'''Viola:''' The mainland with its capital Thais
''Jogador:'' '''Thais'''
'''Viola:''' A good friend of mine used to live there, such a beautiful city. I always enjoyed my stay at Kingsday tho', can't recommend it enough.
''Jogador:'' '''King'''
'''Viola:''' The king's castle is in Thais, make sure to visit it someday.
''Jogador:'' '''Tibianus'''
'''Viola:''' He's been ruling over Tibia for quite some time now, may he take good care of us for years to come!
''Jogador:'' '''Time'''
'''Viola:''' It's exactly X:XX am/pm.
''Jogador:'' '''Tim'''
'''Viola:''' He once visited over from Thais, I heard Gustavo and him are are good friends.
''Falas para aprender magia''
''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Viola:''' Welcome Jogador! Are you here to learn new wisdom or do you have time for a mission?
''Jogador:'' '''Learn'''
'''Viola:''' I see you are eager to learn new spells.
''Jogador:'' '''Spells'''
'''Viola:''' I can teach you instant spells. What kind of spell do you wish to learn? You can also tell me for which level you would like to learn a spell, if you prefer that.
''Jogador:'' '''Instant spells'''
'''Viola:''' I sell healing spells and support spells. Which of these interests you most?
''Jogador:'' '''Healing spells'''
'''Viola:''' In this category I have 'Wound Cleansing' and 'Cure Poison'.
''Jogador:'' '''Wound Cleansing'''
'''Viola:''' Do you want to have the spell 'Wound Cleansing' for free?
''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''
'''Viola:''' You already know how to cast this spell.
''Jogador:'' '''Instant spells'''
'''Viola:''' I can teach you instant spells. What kind of spell do you wish to learn? You can also tell me for which level you would like to learn a spell, if you prefer that.
''Jogador:'' '''Instant spells'''
'''Viola:''' I sell healing spells and support spells. Which of these interests you most?
''Jogador:'' '''Healing spells'''
'''Viola:''' In this category I have 'Wound Cleansing' and 'Cure Poison'.
''Jogador:'' '''Cure Poison'''
'''Viola:''' Do you want to buy the spell 'Cure Poison' for 150 gold?
''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''
'''Viola:''' Here you are. Look in your spellbook for the pronunciation of this spell.
''Jogador:'' '''Support spells'''
'''Viola:''' In this category I have 'Magic Rope' and 'Light'
''Jogador:'' '''Magic Rope'''
'''Viola:''' Do you want to learn the spell 'Magic Rope' for 200 gold?
''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''
'''Viola:''' Here you are. Look in your spellbook for the pronunciation of this spell.
''Jogador:'' '''Light'''
'''Viola:''' Do you want to have the spell 'Light' for free?

'''Viola:''' Here you are. Look in your spellbook for the pronunciation of this spell.
}}[[Categoria:NPC em Revisão]]

pages.title: Flavius
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Flavius | job = Banqueiro | city = Newhaven | subarea = Newhaven | location = [[Newhaven]] ({{mapa|32566,32489,7:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 15.12.c7d92c | notes = | buysell = não | falas = ''Falas espontâneas'' '''Flavius:''' Any questions about the functions of your bank account? Feel free to ask me for help!
''Falas de interação''
'''Flavius:''' Welcome to the Tibian bank, young adventurer! Deposit your gold or withdraw your money from your bank account. Remember to deposit all of your gold before you leave here. I can also explain the functions of your bank account to you.
''Jogador:'' '''Bank'''
'''Flavius:''' You can deposit and withdraw money from your bank account here. I can also change money for you.
''Jogador:'' '''Deposit'''
'''Flavius:''' Please tell me how much gold it is you would like to deposit.
''Jogador:'' '''10'''
'''Flavius:''' Would you really like to deposit 10 gold?
''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''
'''Flavius:''' Alright, we have added the amount of 10 gold to your balance. You can withdraw your money anytime you want to.
''Jogador:'' '''Withdraw'''
'''Flavius:''' Please tell me how much gold you would like to withdraw.
''Jogador:'' '''10'''
'''Flavius:''' Are you sure you wish to withdraw 10 gold from your bank account?
''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''
'''Flavius:''' Here you are, 10 gold. Please let me know if there is something else I can do for you.
''Jogador:'' '''Deposit all'''
'''Flavius:''' Would you really like to deposit 162 gold?
''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''
'''Flavius:''' Alright, we have added the amount of 162 gold to your balance. You can withdraw your money anytime you want to.
''Jogador:'' '''Balance'''
'''Flavius:''' Your account balance is 590 gold.
''Jogador:'' '''Functions'''
'''Flavius:''' Every Tibian has a global bank account. This means you can deposit your gold in one bank, and withdraw it from the same or any other Tibian bank in any city. ...
'''Flavius:''' Here on Newhaven, I run the bank. I keep any gold you deposit safe, so you can't lose it when you're out fighting or dying, heh. Ask me for your balance to learn how much money you've already saved. ...
'''Flavius:''' There are also advanced functions, but those are only available to you once you have reached the Tibian mainland.
''Jogador:'' '''Advanced'''
'''Flavius:''' Your bank account will be used automatically when you want to rent a house or place an offer on an item on the market. Let me know if you want to know about how either one works.
''Jogador:'' '''Rent'''
'''Flavius:''' Renting a house has never been this easy. Simply make a bid for an auction on the house section of the official Tibia website. We will check immediately if you have enough money ...
'''Flavius:''' Please keep in mind that the sum you have used to bid will be unavailable unless somebody places a higher bid. Once you have acquired a house the rent will be charged automatically from your bank account every month.
''Jogador:'' '''Market'''
'''Flavius:''' If you buy an item from the market, the required gold will be deducted from your bank account automatically. On the other hand, money you earn for selling items via the market will be added to your account. It's easy!
}}

pages.title: Second in Command Demeron
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Second in Command Demeron | job = Roleplay | npcclass = | npcsprite = | city = Roshamuul | subarea = Isle of Ada | location = [[Isle of Ada]] ({{Mapa|33873,32243,7|aqui}}) | implemented = 15.20.7a5cc9 | buysell = não | buys = | sells = | notes = * Faz parte da [[The Order of the Stag Quest]]. | falas = __NOTOC__ == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Second in Command Demeron:''' If you don't carry any spares, state your business quickly or move along.
== Falas de Quest == ''Jogador:'' '''Spares'''
'''Second in Command Demeron:''' I will get back to this later. Now either you're just a confused bystander or you're on a mission to get on my nerves. What will it be?
''Jogador:'' '''Mission'''
'''Second in Command Demeron:''' If you can't tell me why you're here, stop distracting me and at least try helping some of my men knocking this measly camp into shape!
''Jogador:'' '''Tell'''
'''Second in Command Demeron:''' How did you even manage to get here with that sorry excuse of a sailing boat? So you say Kesar himself sent you, giving you details he did not disclose, even to us? And do you have any proof for that outrageous claim?
''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''
'''Second in Command Demeron:''' Royal Bounacean advisor? Why should Kesar constitute someone like you, this is saying nothing without proof. Has he really told you what this is all about?
''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''
'''Second in Command Demeron:''' A bastard?! Lower your voice, stranger, that's no trifling matter. At all... you say you have solid evidence of this?
''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''
'''Second in Command Demeron:''' A certificate of... oh my. That should have stirred something up in the ivory tower, heh. ...
'''Second in Command Demeron:''' Alright... well, excuse my temper, it's all hands on deck for us since we barely set foot on this accursed rock. Let's take a break and start this conversation properly. ...
'''Second in Command Demeron:''' We need to find the heir of this Eldoran then. His knights must be on this island somewhere, but we did not encounter any of them so far. If the threat you mentioned is real, they may be in grave danger, as are we. ...
'''Second in Command Demeron:''' Fight your way through the mines and further into the isle. We need to get to the bottom of this and we also need to find a way to survive: there is no escaping for us in our current state.
}}

pages.title: Guard Captain Hartford
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Guard Captain Hartford | job = Roleplay | npcclass = | npcsprite = | city = Roshamuul | subarea = Isle of Ada | location = [[Isle of Ada]] ({{Mapa|33881,32109,4|aqui}}) | implemented = 15.20.7a5cc9 | buysell = não | buys = | sells = | notes = * Faz parte da [[The Order of the Stag Quest]]. | falas = __NOTOC__ == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Guard Captain Hartford:''' HALT! Outsider, state your business!
== Falas de Quest == ''Jogador:'' '''Business'''
'''Guard Captain Hartford:''' So you tell me you took a stroll all the way up the mountain, right through the middle of the enemy lines, past the bulk of the cursed hordes in the outskirts and in here. ...
'''Guard Captain Hartford:''' All this with a healthy disregard of our bastion's massive walls, the defense perimeter of my guards down in the dell and the influence of the warlock. Explain yourself.
''Jogador:'' '''Explain'''
'''Guard Captain Hartford:''' I see. If Kesar himself got wind of this and decided to send help, then his court wizards must have to the same conclusion as Eldoran. We're screwed. ...
'''Guard Captain Hartford:''' Royally so, if I might add. There is no way through the outer perimeter right now. We need to defend the castle yard and I have no men to spare. ...
'''Guard Captain Hartford:''' That's the situation. If the others are pinned down and the mines are still lost, then we cannot get outside help or supplies. ...
'''Guard Captain Hartford:''' You have been very lucky - and very bold to make an attempt like this on your own. Alas, a few warriors would indeed have a greater chance than a battallion under these circumstances. ...
'''Guard Captain Hartford:''' I say we continue to stick to that plan. Say, are you in for another round?
''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''
'''Guard Captain Hartford:''' I counted on you. We have two main issues here: the cursed onslaught and the death from above. ...
'''Guard Captain Hartford:''' While we can still hold a considerable number of the cursed puppets in check, they keep coming and the warlock manages to recruit a steady amount of new material day by day. ...
'''Guard Captain Hartford:''' The numbers of order knights to succumb to the warlock's power is dwindling, for whatever reason. Yet they are increasingly difficult to defeat, the more men we lose. ...
'''Guard Captain Hartford:''' The winged horrors that haunt us during the night are another story entirely. We do not yet know how many of them exist or where their roost is located, but they want to occupy the bastion. ...
'''Guard Captain Hartford:''' If you can help us with those night harpies, we would be grateful and far in your debt. Just bring me a few of their beaks. ...
'''Guard Captain Hartford:''' To do so, gently pull the beak of a killed harpy, denn press it downward and pull it slightly to the left or right in a single, firm move. It takes some skill and my not always work but I need proof of at least a few more of them dead. ...
'''Guard Captain Hartford:''' If you show your goodwill, I will give you access to the upper hall, you will be able to contact Eldoran himself, if you can get through.
}}

pages.title: Eldoran the Ambitious
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Eldoran the Ambitious | job = Roleplay | npcclass = | npcsprite = | city = Roshamuul | subarea = Isle of Ada | location = [[Isle of Ada]] ({{Mapa|33862,32104,2|aqui}}) | implemented = 15.20.7a5cc9 | buysell = não | buys = | sells = | notes = * Faz parte da [[The Order of the Stag Quest]]. | falas = __NOTOC__ == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Eldoran the Ambitious:''' Someone made it! Do you bring word from my men in the outskirts?
== Falas de Quest == ''Jogador:'' '''Word'''
'''Eldoran the Ambitious:''' Wait, you are not one of the Stags, how did you get past the guard - can they still hold the yard?
''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''
'''Eldoran the Ambitious:''' Thought so! Yeah, these guys are tough cookies indeed. ...
'''Eldoran the Ambitious:''' So, you know my true heritage then. You have talked to Kesar and he sent you here... to help? I almost can't believe it. Are you truly willing to do his bidding, then, bearing all consquences?
''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''
'''Eldoran the Ambitious:''' Impressive. I must say, your attitude is quite to my liking. Now. There is not much we can do to get out of this stalemate unless we can breach enemy lines and get through to the warlock himself. ...
'''Eldoran the Ambitious:''' You say you made it through the outskirts, passt the mines and my men in the valley. How do they fare? I hope they are well. ...
'''Eldoran the Ambitious:''' My heralds did not get through to me for days now, supply lines have been cut, the harbour is out of reach and our flagship has already been destroyed in a warlock attack. ...
'''Eldoran the Ambitious:''' Besides parts of the bastion being already in ruins, the warlock also attacked the tower bridge and blocked any means of entry with verminous growth of the extremely unpleasant kind. ...
'''Eldoran the Ambitious:''' The same goes for the wretched remains of this once-proud bastion. Fire, destruction, plague and famine, the warlock did not spare a single one of us. ...
'''Eldoran the Ambitious:''' Most of the walls are crumbling and the piling dead are poisoning us. There is a stench lingering in the catacombs as excrutiating as it is deadly. ...
'''Eldoran the Ambitious:''' Now that you can picture the situation, there is the added inconvenience that we are pinned down right here. My men are to exhausted to be sent on another mission, I need you for this one. ...
'''Eldoran the Ambitious:''' First we need to burn the corpses that litter the lower dungeons and poison the river. Set fire to this piles of shame and return to me with word on the situation down there. ...
'''Eldoran the Ambitious:''' Afterwards I will grant you access to the lowest ward connecting the bastion with the gorge and the only remaining pathway to the warlock's tower.
''Jogador:'' '''News'''
'''Eldoran the Ambitious:''' So, did you set fire to the piles?
''Jogador:'' '''Yes'''
'''Eldoran the Ambitious:''' Most excellent! That finally gives us enough breathing room to regroup. I will see if I can send a fresh post to change the outer guard. It looks like I am in your debt, outsider. ...
'''Eldoran the Ambitious:''' Thanks to you, with a dwindling number of puppets and harpies, fresh supplies for my men and most of the remaining corpses burned, we can finally start pushing back. ...
'''Eldoran the Ambitious:''' There is a way down the lower catacombs, connecting the bastion with an ancient cave system, the Bloodfire Gorge. If all goes well and the warlock didn't seal this passage, there should be an entrance to his tower. ...
'''Eldoran the Ambitious:''' Neverind the frazzlemaws down there, we tamed them. Besides our regular steeds, they have proven quite an asset in melee combat while gnawing through the thick of any battlefield. ...
'''Eldoran the Ambitious:''' I have also granted you full access to our proud silver mines, maybe you can find something of use for your quest down there. ...
'''Eldoran the Ambitious:''' Try to find the warlock and challenge him in his tower, you are as strong as the best of us. We are still holding the onslaught at bay and may be able to have your back when you confront him. ...
'''Eldoran the Ambitious:''' If you can surprise him in his tower while attack his forces from the courtyard and in the outskirts, he will not amass enough of his minions to overwhelm you. We got this, now go!
''Jogador:'' '''News'''
'''Eldoran the Ambitious:''' ...let this sink a moment. Unbelievable. Outstanding! ...
'''Eldoran the Ambitious:''' Please, return to Bounac, go forth and tell Kesar we are safe. My navigator sends his regards and an easier route to reach the Adaean harbour safely in the future, once this mess is all cleaned up. Deliver it to him. ...
'''Eldoran the Ambitious:''' Maybe that one time we talked about trade connections was only the start of something far greater. And as to you... ...
'''Eldoran the Ambitious:''' I want you to take the sword of my forefather Eldoran. As it lies broken, it shall be a reminder of how this order once was in shackles but thanks to you, ultimately prevailed. ...
'''Eldoran the Ambitious:''' On behalf of all the knights of the Stag and myself, Eldoran Etzel, I bestow upon you the title of 'Honourable member of the Adaean Order of the Stag': come forth as a knight of the stag. ...
'''Eldoran the Ambitious:''' May your honourable life be filled with the spirit of adventure and fueled by the fire of the hunt. You have earned it.
}}

pages.title: Captain Marie-Denise Banner
pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Captain Marie-Denise Banner | job = Roleplay | npcclass = | npcsprite = | city = Roshamuul | subarea = Isle of Ada | location = [[Isle of Ada]] ({{Mapa|33837,32137,4|aqui}}) | implemented = 15.20.7a5cc9 | buysell = não | buys = | sells = | notes = * Faz parte da [[The Order of the Stag Quest]]. | falas = __NOTOC__ == Palavras-Chave == ''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''
'''Captain Marie-Denise Banner:''' Wait... the wall... the... combination... aaah.
''Jogador:'' '''Wall'''
'''Captain Marie-Denise Banner:''' It's... alright. Alright... I can stand- no, well... I can't stand. But... I can still... help you. ...
'''Captain Marie-Denise Banner:''' When I came to my senses, that golem... over there... was watching me. When I came to, it quickly pressed a combination of... buttons... at that wall... next to me. ...
'''Captain Marie-Denise Banner:''' The combination is... upper, upper, lower, lower, left, right... just... go, or I... aaah. ...
'''Captain Marie-Denise Banner:''' May this at least... be of... use to you... I know... what I have done.
''Jogador:'' '''Senses'''
'''Captain Marie-Denise Banner:''' I... killed... everyone. Their faces, their eyes... blood, everywhere. Aaah... I don't... know how it came to pass. But there is an... aaach.. entity, on this isle... ...
'''Captain Marie-Denise Banner:''' Something... controls the doomed knights that roam this... isle. They must all have... succumbed, to the power of this... thing. Like I did... my... self. ...
'''Captain Marie-Denise Banner:''' It was like a veil of blood before my eyes, I lost control of... everything. Witnessing... everything... aaah- helpless. ...
'''Captain Marie-Denise Banner:''' After some time... I managed... to get ahold of myself and... dragged my body forward, deeper into the isle. I did... *cough* not encounter a single souls on my... way here, willing to... talk. ...
'''Captain Marie-Denise Banner:''' You are the first... I meet who is not... openly hostile. Aaah...
'''Captain Marie-Denise Banner:''' I... am sorry. Don't tell... Demeron... I survived. The captain he once looked up to... died in that silver mine. I... aaah... won't come back... I... leaving, the unit. ...
'''Captain Marie-Denise Banner:''' There is... something... I have to do, when I recover. I can't help you much more... right now. But... ah... we will meet again.
}}

| falas = ''Jogador'': '''Hi''' (Caso não tenha sido feita a quest [[Targuna_Quest#Burning_Heart| Burning Heart]])
[[Emiliana]]: Hey, I really need your help on an important mission urgently.
''Jogador'': '''Hi''' (Caso já tenha sido feita a quest [[Targuna_Quest#Burning_Heart| Burning Heart]])
[[Emiliana]]: Well well well, if that isn't the glorious ''Jogador''!
''Jogador'': '''Name'''
[[Emiliana]]: Nice to meet you ''Jogador'', the name's Emiliana.
''Jogador'': '''Job'''
[[Emiliana]]: I used to teach imbuing all around the tibian world, maybe someday you will meet up with Alibinius at Thais. Imbuement is such a powerful thing if done correctly.
''Jogador'': '''Imbuement'''
[[Emiliana]]: Having the option to imbue astral power into your gear making it stronger, more potent and fitting for your style really can make a night and day difference.
[[Emiliana]]: You should try it out for yourself someday as well.
''Jogador'': '''Targuna'''
[[Emiliana]]: Such a pleasant little island, it's the perfect place to enjoy my peace and finally go after my hobbies again after travelling around Tibia for quite some time.
''Jogador'': '''Travel'''
[[Emiliana]]: I'd say you got two options, one reasonable and another one not as much. You could even travel with Matilda to Aragonia and see what the pirates are up to ... or.
[[Emiliana]]: You could be sane and travel to Thais with Captain Indigo and get to see the beauty of the Tibian mainland, your choice I suppose ...
''Jogador'': '''Matilda'''
[[Emiliana]]: Isn't that his turtle? She once got me to Aragonia and back for free. I definitely wasn't the smoothest ride, but I won't complain for that price ...
''Jogador'': '''Indigo'''
[[Emiliana]]: She owns the boat on the east of Targuna, which can take you straight to Thais, whenever you so desire. I heard if you hand her a ticket you get your ride free of charge.
[[Emiliana]]: I tell you, that's a deal!
''Jogador'': '''Captain Indigo'''
[[Emiliana]]: Our beloved Captain Indigo is the only way to travel to mainland from here, therefore she is the only connection for other resources, supplies and things alike. You can find and sell supplies at Aurelia's shop just south of my home.
''Jogador'': '''Aurelia'''
[[Emiliana]]: Aurelia has a little shop just south of me, so whenever you might need new supplies or want to sell some stuff, I'd suggest paying her a visit.
''Jogador'': '''Shop'''
[[Emiliana]]: Selling and buying supplies is all taken care off by our dearest Aurelia. You can find her at the south east side of Targuna, basically right south of my house.
''Jogador'': '''Aragonia'''
[[Emiliana]]: That pirate island, yeah. Not going to be there anytime soon and I'd advise you to do the same, if you still want to leave alive.
[[Emiliana]]: Those pirates are more dangerous than they might seem.
''Jogador'': '''Pirate'''
[[Emiliana]]: Who? Sterling?!
[[Emiliana]]: Well I'd say that's not a real pirate, though if you're talking about these pesky pirates on Aragonia, then wow these are definitely pirates to be scared of.
[[Emiliana]]: I wouldn't want to be around them.
''Jogador'': '''Sterling'''
[[Emiliana]]: He's not a real pirate honestly, I think part-time seems more fitting here, nevertheless he's a nice pirate to have around.
[[Emiliana]]: If you ever feel the need to travel to Aragonia, you should talk to him about it.
''Jogador'': '''Camilla'''
[[Emiliana]]: Our precious mayor Camilla takes care of every official request and everything representative in and around Targuna. She's rather new here, though we couldn't be better off with anyone else.
''Jogador'': '''Mayor'''
[[Emiliana]]: The mayor of Targuna has historically been residing in the upper floors and room of the depot in the middle of the Island, so if there's ever a need to visit Camilla at her office, you'll know exactly where to look.
''Jogador'': '''Adrian'''
[[Emiliana]]: Having Adrian as our financial advisor and helper here is surely nothing short of a blessing, so whenever you find yourself having little fortune in your pockets, pay him a visit and make sure you deposit it.
''Jogador'': '''Leonora'''
[[Emiliana]]: Everybody has to use the post office and so do we here on Targuna. Leonora takes care of all the work, by making it able to send and receive parcels, letters and many other things.
''Jogador'': '''Post office'''
[[Emiliana]]: Leonora is responsible for all our parcel and letter service here on Targuna, you can find her at her office just north of us.
''Jogador'': '''Lizzie'''
[[Emiliana]]: She told me about her research on ancient lizard groups ...
[[Emiliana]]: May sound interesting at first, but I wouldn't want to hear that again, I'll tell you that!
''Jogador'': '''Lizard'''
[[Emiliana]]: We once had a lizard problem at the north of the island, but I think it has been there for quite some time now ...
[[Emiliana]]: Maybe you could ask Lizzie about it, he's been researching them for some time now.
''Jogador'': '''Morla'''
[[Emiliana]]: She's the cute turtle that Sterling once saved from a storm at Aragonia, before these pirates took over it used to be paradise. Basically ideal for vocations and also if your interested in turtles, nearly have to
}}

pages.wikitext:
{{Infobox_NPC|List={{{1|}}}|GetValue={{{GetValue|}}} | name = Lizzie | job = Roleplay | npcclass = | city = Targuna | subarea = | location = [[Targuna]] ({{Mapa|31941,31920,7:2|aqui}}). | implemented = 15.24.95dcf3 | notes =

* Faz parte da [[Targuna Quest]].

| buysell = não | falas = ''Jogador'': '''Hi'''
'''Lizzie''': Hey there. I need your help urgently, we have to save Targuna!
''Jogador'': '''Name'''
'''Lizzie''': It's Lizzie, with double z.
''Jogador'': '''Lizzie'''
'''Lizzie''': That's the name, I bet you are here for the lizards.
''Jogador'': '''Job'''
'''Lizzie''': Well, short and simple - I research many types of lizards.
''Jogador'': '''Lizards / save / mission'''
'''Lizzie''': Finally! I need your help here adventurer.
'''Lizzie''': My research suggests there is an ancient lizard group, which poses a real threat to us here on Targuna. We need to put a stop to that NOW! Are you ready?
:''Jogador'': '''No'''
:'''Lizzie''': Please come back when your interests might have changed for the better.
''Jogador'': '''Targuna'''
'''Lizzie''': What a beautiful place it has become over the years.
'''Lizzie''': Especially after we constructed more buildings and opened more stores and offices, in order to make sure that every visitor has their need fulfilled.
''Jogador'': '''Indigo'''
'''Lizzie''': She's done quite the traveling to get here, if I remember correctly she started her journey somewhere in Ankrahmun, had to deal with something in Svargrond and ended up here on Targuna
'''Lizzie''': What a journey!
''Jogador'': '''Captain'''
'''Lizzie''': The boat on the south side of this island can bring you to Thais and back to Targuna. You should talk to the Captain whenever you're ready for the Tibian Mainland.
''Jogador'': '''Travel'''
'''Lizzie''': We have a few main travel options here, you can travel with Captain Indigo to Thais or use the turtle to travel to Aragonia.
'''Lizzie''': Though I keep forgetting the turtle's name ... What was it again, arrg!
''Jogador'': '''Turtle'''
'''Lizzie''': What turtle?
'''Lizzie''': I do research on lizards.
''Jogador'': '''Aragonia'''
'''Lizzie''': That pirate island?! I wouldn't want to mess with them, no thank you!
''Jogador'': '''Pirate'''
'''Lizzie''': Nothing in this world will bring me close to any of these dangerous pirates on Aragonia.
'''Lizzie''': But if we're talking about Sterling, well then I have another opinion ...
''Jogador'': '''Sterling'''
'''Lizzie''': He's great, I always enjoyed the after hours while fishing on the beach in the south. You can really talk about a lot with him, he's always open for adventures.
''Jogador'': '''Adrian'''
'''Lizzie''': At the bank you can deposit your well earned money, withdraw from your already existing fortune and even make transactions for other things in the tibian world.
''Jogador'': '''Bank'''
'''Lizzie''': Adrian has been doing all of our finances for quite some time now. The bank can be found right next to us, you can spot it easily with the sign next to it.
''Jogador'': '''Aurelia'''
'''Lizzie''': Aurelia is taking care of all supplies that come in on a regular basis from Thais. She sells these in her shop south of the depot.
''Jogador'': '''Shop'''
'''Lizzie''': The shop is right here, you can resupply and freshen up before heading into battle, Aurelia will take care of all these needs.
''Jogador'': '''Camilla'''
'''Lizzie''': Our mayor Camilla can be found in the upper levels of the depot. Once you're done with my mission you can make a report on my research and your findings.
''Jogador'': '''Mayor'''
'''Lizzie''': The mayor was elected unanimously, Camilla does such a great job of representing our island and us as citizens.
''Jogador'': '''Emiliana'''
'''Lizzie''': Isn't she the imbuement expert?!
'''Lizzie''': I heard she made quite the fortune with that and then settled down here on Targuna. I bet she has a lot to tell.
''Jogador'': '''Leonora'''
'''Lizzie''': Leonora runs the post office here in Targuna. Everything related to parcels and letters can be done in the post office.
''Jogador'': '''Post'''
'''Lizzie''': If there's ever a need to send a letter or a parcel, Leonora has you covered. Her office is in the northern part of the island.
''Jogador'': '''Morla'''
'''Lizzie''': Who? I don't know anybody of that name ...
''Jogador'': '''Bye / farewell'''
'''Lizzie''': Goodbye!
}}

''Jogador:'' '''Hi'''</br>
'''Mayor Pocaro:''' Ah. Our ally graces our settlement with another visit.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Job'''</br>
'''Mayor Pocaro:''' I am the mayor of Salgadora. Still in service of our kingdom, I guess, and for what that is worth.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Settlement'''</br>
'''Mayor Pocaro:''' Salgadora. Or what remains of it, at least. Most of our people fled when the creatures came. Fisherfolk, families... gone. I stayed. Someone had to.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Fled'''</br>
'''Mayor Pocaro:''' What you see now is no longer truly ours. The newcomers have taken over much of it. Researchers, mercenaries, opportunists. They build their houses, but they do not belong here.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Newcomers'''</br>
'''Mayor Pocaro:''' They tolerate each other. Barely. Everyone watches everyone else. Alliances are temporary things in times like these. At least the fight against the creatures unites us all.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Creatures'''</br>
'''Mayor Pocaro:''' We call them moonspawn. They come in waves. Relentless. Mindless. If we falter even once, this place will be overrun.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Overrun'''</br>
'''Mayor Pocaro:''' When the alarm sounds, everyone who can hold a weapon is expected to do so. No exceptions.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Expected'''</br>
'''Mayor Pocaro:''' You have already proven that you are more than just another scavenger.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Kingdom'''</br>
'''Mayor Pocaro:''' This land was not always as you see it now. Long before your kind set foot here, it was known as the Coral Kingdom of Thalassara. ...</br>
'''Mayor Pocaro:''' The capital, Coralmar, stood behind reefs that made it unreachable from the sea. A kingdom shaped by the tides, and protected by them.</br>
'''Mayor Pocaro:''' That is until that rock broke off, supposedly from the moon.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Reefs'''</br>
'''Mayor Pocaro:''' Even before all this, Coralmar could not be reached from the sea. The reefs would tear apart any ship that dared approach. ...</br>
'''Mayor Pocaro:''' Now? If anything still lives there, it is beyond our reach.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Moonspawn'''</br>
'''Mayor Pocaro:''' Then came the fall. A fragment of the moon struck the south. And with it, the first of the moonspawn appeared. ...</br>
'''Mayor Pocaro:''' At first, they thought they could master them. Control them. There were even some successes.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''War'''</br>
'''Mayor Pocaro:''' Their numbers grew, while ours dwindled. The cost of holding the land became too great. ...</br>
'''Mayor Pocaro:''' So a wall was raised. Everything beyond it was abandoned.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Wall'''</br>
'''Mayor Pocaro:''' All who were willing were evacuated on the king's decree. Those who refused, well, they stayed here. Like me.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''King'''</br>
'''Mayor Pocaro:''' King Marinho remained in Coralmar. Or so we are told. Since the wall was sealed, no word has reached us. ...</br>
'''Mayor Pocaro:''' For all we know, the capital still stands. Though it might have long since fallen.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Marinho'''</br>
'''Mayor Pocaro:''' He is a good man. The people love him. But he listened to the wrong voices. Too many advisors, too many promises. When it mattered, he hesitated.</br>
''Jogador:'' '''Bye'''</br>
'''Mayor Pocaro:''' Bye.</br>

}}
